A faction dedicated to advancing the reach of humanity in the galaxy and reclaiming what was lost. They will assist in defending your planets and with scouting and suppressing your neighbors. Locate their research outposts to aquire helpful alien technology. Make use of their deep space outposts which form temporary wormholes to distant parts of the galaxy.  <color=#f25e1c>LOW IMPACT:</color> This faction will assist their allies and have no downsides.
column2: 一个致力于扩大人类在银河系中影响力并回收失落之物的派系。他们将协助防御你的行星，并侦察和压制你的邻居。找到他们的研究前哨站以获取有用的外星科技。利用他们的深空前哨站形成通往银河系遥远区域的临时虫洞。  <color=#f25e1c>低影响：</color>该派系将协助盟友且没有任何负面影响。

column1: Data Centers (DCs) are the only no-cost source of AIP Reduction, gained by destroying them.  These are extra valuable when you are very close to marking-up the AI, but should be destroyed on sight regardless.  By default there will be 6 DCs in the galaxy, for an 80 planet galaxy.  This number increases slightly for bigger galaxies.  In a theoretical 160 planet galaxy it would be +50% (9).  Changing this amount affects the overall amount of AIP Reduction available in a galaxy, and as such, the overall game difficulty.  It is not particularly recommended to play around with this number.
column2: 数据中心（DC）是唯一一种不需要成本的AIP减少来源，通过摧毁它们获得。当你非常接近让AI标记你时，这些尤其有价值，但无论如何应该一见到就摧毁。  默认情况下，80个行星的星系中会有6个数据中心。对于更大的星系，这个数字会略微增加。在理论上160个行星的星系中，数量会增加50%（9个）。  更改这个数量会影响星系中可用的AIP减少总量，从而影响游戏的整体难度。不建议过多调整这个数值。

column1: Distribution Nodes are a major source of Hacking Points (HAP) in the galaxy and one of the only ways to gain Science/HAP without capturing planets.    By default there are 6 per galaxy.  Changing this amount has the potential to devalue HAP and Science, so handle with care.
column2: 分配节点是星系中入侵点数（HAP）的主要来源，也是在不占领行星的情况下获得科学/HAP的唯一途径之一。  默认情况下，每个星系有6个。更改这个数量可能会降低HAP和科学的价值，所以要谨慎处理。

column1: Emits unholy lightning around itself to victims caught in tractors. When it dies it explodes violently to damage up to 20 nearby enemy units.                             The explosion damage done to each victim starts at half the strength of the Spectral Wight's normal shot, but increases with the charge the ship has accumulated, up to a maximum of 10 times the strength of its main weapon. Dispatched to fight the Dyson Sidekick. Equipped with Engine Stunners to trap your transports.
column2: 围绕自身向被牵引光束捕获的受害者释放不洁闪电。死亡时剧烈爆炸，对最多20个附近敌方单位造成伤害。    对每个受害者的爆炸伤害起始为幽灵亡魂普通射击的一半，但会随着单位积累的充能增加，最高可达主武器伤害的10倍。被派遣来对抗戴森盟友。配备引擎眩晕器来困住你的运输船。

column1: Functions very much like a normal human empire, but also comes with spire cities and artifacts right from the start.          If you are familiar with the Fallen Spire faction, normally those act as a separate faction, and you can only grow them by gathering Spire Relics in various ways.  This faction skips the Spire Relic process, but keeps the rest of what makes Fallen Spire awesome:  If you like the quest-style attributes of Fallen Spire, then you should just use a regular human empire (or Ark Empire) and enable the Fallen Spire campaign.    If you just want Spire ships and a direct frontal assault type of game, then this is the faction for you. Not compatible with Fallen Spire.
column2: 其功能与普通人类帝国非常相似，但从游戏开始就拥有尖塔城市和神器。          如果你熟悉堕落尖塔派系，通常它们是一个独立的派系，你只能通过各种方式收集尖塔遗物来发展它们。  这个派系跳过了收集尖塔遗物的过程，但保留了堕落尖塔的其他优点：  如果你喜欢堕落尖塔的任务式玩法，那么你应该使用普通人类帝国（或方舟帝国）并开启堕落尖塔战役。  如果你只想要尖塔舰船和直接正面进攻的游戏方式，那么这个派系就是为你准备的。

column1: Functions very much like a normal human empire, but also comes with the ability to build Scourge Spawners and Armories, and manage the Scourge forces.  You will have additional Scourge defensive options. The scourge military operates independently, but you can request their aid by building a Scourge Summoner on a planet.
column2: 玩法与普通人类帝国非常相似，但也额外带有建造天灾生成器和军械库以及管理天灾部队的能力。  你将拥有额外的天灾防御选项。天灾军队独立运作，但你可以通过在行星上建造天灾召唤者来请求他们的援助。

column1: Major Data Centers (MDCs) are a major source of AIP Reduction in the galaxy (2 by default), if you capture them by taking the planet they are on.  But be careful to protect them very well.  The AI will actively target these, and if destroyed, charge a potentially game ending amount of AIP.  By default there are 2 per galaxy. Changing this amount will have a very large impact on the amount of AIP Reduction available and is not really recommended.
column2: 主要数据中心（MDC）是星系中AIP减少的重要来源（默认为2个），如果你通过占领它们所在的行星来捕获它们。但要非常小心地保护它们。AI会主动攻击这些设施，如果被摧毁，将会收取可能导致游戏结束的AIP数量。  默认情况下，每个星系有2个。更改这个数量将对可用的AIP减少量产生非常大的影响，因此不建议修改。

column1: This AI retaliates with (relatively) small exogalactic attacks every time you destroy one of its guard posts, warp gates, command stations, data centers... it's kind of attached to a lot of things, actually. Doesn't take criticism well.
column2: 每当你摧毁它的一个岗哨、 warp 门、指挥站、数据中心时，这个 AI 就会以（相对）小规模的河外攻击进行报复……实际上，它对很多东西都很在意。它可听不进批评。

column1: AI Eyes are Deadly Commander, Eyes are a particularly deadly AI weapon that you should examine carefully before you bring your forces onto the planet. If the strength of AI-hostile attacker is greater than the strength of the AI's defenders, then the Eye will activate, and something ranging from Very Bad to Extremely Bad will happen to your ships. Raiding the Inactive Eye The general strategy on a planet with an Eye is to send in a small elite force first, and destroy the Eye before bringing in rest of the fleet. Unfortunately, some Eyes are protected by guard posts on these planets! To render these Eyes vulnerable to attack, a number of guard posts will first need to be destroyed. The force needs to be small enough to not active the eye but strong enough to handle each guard post. Hit-and-run strikes or suicide attacks may be necessary to accomplish this task Fortunately, our fleet ships are all unmanned, so these tactics don’t put any human lives in jeopardy. TIP: If you're dealing with the forces freed during the attempt to get at an Eye, you can set up other forces of your own on an adjacent planet to 'catch' the newly-free threat.
column2: AI监视眼非常致命 指挥官，监视眼是一种特别致命的AI武器，在你将部队派往该行星之前，应该仔细研究。 如果AI敌对攻击者的实力大于AI防御者的实力，那么监视眼将被激活，你的单位将遭遇从非常糟糕到极其糟糕的情况。 突袭未激活的监视眼 在有监视眼的行星上，一般策略是先派一小支精锐部队，在带入其余舰队之前摧毁监视眼。 不幸的是，一些监视眼受到这些行星上的守卫哨所的保护！要使这些监视眼容易受到攻击，首先需要摧毁一些守卫哨所。 这支小部队的规模需要足够小，以免激活监视眼，但又要足够强大，能够应对每个守卫哨所。可能需要进行打了就跑的袭击或自杀式攻击来完成这项任务。 幸运的是，我们的舰队单位都是无人的，所以这些战术不会危及任何人的生命。 提示: 如果你在处理试图接近监视眼时释放出的部队，你可以在相邻行星上部署其他部队来“拦截”新产生的威胁。

column1: Many Guard Ships are Unaware in System Commander, our reconnaissance suggests this planet contains a large number of units in 'guard' mode. If we disturb these units but do not destroy them they will activate and become a threat. TIP: Consider attacking with sufficient force to wipe out defenders before they escape. TIP: Using forcefield frigates, engine disruption weapons, or tractor ships is a great way to prevent ships from escaping to fight another day.
column2: 星系中有许多守卫单位未察觉 指挥官，我们的侦察表明，这个行星上有大量处于“守卫”模式的单位。 如果我们惊动了这些单位但没有摧毁它们，它们将被激活并成为威胁。 提示: 考虑用足够的力量进行攻击，在守卫单位逃脱前将其消灭。 提示: 使用力场星舰、引擎干扰武器或牵引船是防止单位逃脱并再次作战的好方法。

column1: Massive AI Threat Levels Detected! Commander, our reconnaissance suggests a massive amount of the AI's forces have been alerted to our activity and are in 'threat' mode. High Threat Levels Are Very Dangerous Having many ships in 'threat' mode is very dangerous, as they may overwhelm our defenses by their sheer numbers. Consider hunting down large groups of 'threat' and/or reinforcing our defenses for the coming attack.
column2: 检测到AI大规模威胁等级！ 指挥官，我们的侦察表明，AI的大量部队已经察觉到我们的行动，并进入了“威胁”模式。 高威胁等级非常危险 有许多单位处于“威胁”模式非常危险，因为它们可能会以数量优势压倒我们的防御。 考虑追捕大量“威胁”单位和/或加强我们的防御，以应对即将到来的攻击。

column1: Moderate AI Threat Levels Detected Commander, our reconnaissance suggests a moderate amount of the AI's forces have been alerted to our activity and are in a 'threat' mode. AI Ship Behavior - AI ships in each system default to a 'guard' behavior until disturbed into 'threat' mode. - Ships in 'threat' become more aggressive and may attack if they notice a weakness in our defenses. - If 'threat' ships survive long enough, they will join the fleet controlled by the Hunter subroutine and become significantly more dangerous. - Selecting the yellow threat icon on the top of your screen will provide detailed information such as how much threat is visible and where it is located. Due to the distributed nature of the the AI’s systems, ships have independent behavior subroutines by default. Without this our effort would have been doomed before it began. TIP: Keep an eye on threat estimations and consider hunting down large groups of 'threat' to keep the level manageable.
column2: 检测到AI中度威胁等级 指挥官，我们的侦察表明，AI的部分部队已经察觉到我们的行动，并进入了“威胁”模式。 AI单位行为 - 每个星系中的AI单位默认处于“守卫”行为，直到被干扰进入“威胁”模式。 - 处于“威胁”模式的单位会变得更加激进，如果它们发现我们防御的弱点，可能会发起攻击。 - 如果“威胁”模式的单位存活足够长的时间，它们将加入由猎人子程序控制的舰队，变得更加危险。 - 选择屏幕顶部的黄色威胁图标将提供详细信息，如可见威胁的数量和位置。 由于AI系统的分布式性质，单位默认具有独立的行为子程序。如果没有这种机制，我们的行动在开始前就会失败。 提示: 密切关注威胁估计，并考虑追捕大量“威胁”单位，以保持威胁水平可控。

column1: New Citadel Commander, we have captured a 'citadel' class defensive structure. These mobile defensive stations are similar to the Battlestations we’ve developed, but are more specialized and directly powerful. The station itself is a slow but powerful defender in its own right, but its primary role is building an exclusive compliment of turrets on any planet. Upgrades We have developed a wide range of loadouts that affect the Citadel's weapon systems that you can change with Hacking Points (hold 'C' when selecting a citadel). Just like other flagships, science can be spent (hold 'C' when selecting a citadel) to improve both the station itself and its constructed turrets.
column2: 新堡垒 指挥官，我们俘获了一座“堡垒”级防御建筑。 这些移动防御站类似于我们开发的机动平台，但更专业、更强大。 堡垒本身是一个缓慢但强大的防御者，但其主要作用是在任何行星上建造专属的炮塔。 升级 我们开发了各种各样的负载配置，可以影响堡垒的武器系统，你可以用入侵点数进行更改（选中堡垒时按住“C”键）。 和其他旗舰一样，可以花费科技值（选中堡垒时按住“C”键）来提升堡垒本身及其建造的炮塔的实力。

column1: Ship Designs Available to Hack Commander, we have the opportunity to infiltrate the AIs ship schematic network in this system. The Advanced Research Station on this planet is vulnerable to our hacking nanomachines, and we can extract valuable ship designs to increase our fleet strength. After clearing the planet of enemy forces, switch to the Hacks tab (‘H’ key by default) and see what options are available. We can choose one of a number of designs from each network partition before being locked out, and can hack the same server multiple times. If we are feeling bold, we can destroy the AI command station to reduce the AI's hacking response as well as the cost to hack this TSS. General Hacking Mechanics A few notes from the science division: - Hacks always cost hacking points, which are limited in supply. They are primarily gained by capturing new worlds, but destroying AI Distribution Nodes will also provide small quantities. - Hacks take a set period of time during which the hacking flagship will move exceptionally slowly and be unable to leave the planet. - The AI will spawn ships from the entity being hacked, with a stronger response occurring as more hacks are completed against the same AI. - If you become hopelessly overwhelmed, you can right click the hack icon at the top of the screen to cancel it.
column2: 可入侵单位设计 指挥官，我们有机会渗透该星系中AI的单位蓝图网络。 该行星上的高级研究站容易受到我们的入侵纳米机器的攻击，我们可以提取有价值的单位设计，以增强我们的舰队实力。 在清除该行星上的敌方部队后，切换到入侵标签（默认按“H”键），查看可用选项。 我们可以从每个网络分区中选择一种设计，然后就会被锁定，并且可以多次入侵同一服务器。 如果我们胆子够大，可以摧毁AI指挥站，以减少AI的入侵反击，同时降低入侵这个TSS的成本。 一般入侵机制 科学部门的几点说明: - 入侵总是需要消耗入侵点数，而入侵点数的供应是有限的。它们主要通过占领新行星获得，但摧毁AI分布节点也会提供少量入侵点数。 - 入侵需要一段时间，在此期间，执行入侵的旗舰移动速度会非常慢，并且无法离开该行星。 - AI会从被入侵的实体中生成单位，随着对同一AI的入侵次数增加，反击会更强。 - 如果你陷入绝境，可以右键点击屏幕顶部的入侵图标来取消入侵。

column1: Threat Summary: Orbital Mass Driver (OMD) Commander, we have detected an Orbital Mass Driver in {PlanetName}. These pose a particularly significant threat to our flagships. These stationary defense installations have virtually unlimited range and deal extreme damage to targets with a high mass ships (greater than 5 tX). The only reprieve they offer is a long reload time between shots. Forcefields also effectively block Orbital Mass Driver attacks. Orbital Mass Drivers can also be captured through hacking. TIP: Leave your flagships behind and send in a smaller force of strikecraft with high alpha strike capabilities to quickly eliminate the Orbital Mass Driver.
column2: 威胁总结：轨道质量驱动器（OMD） 指挥官，我们在{PlanetName}行星上检测到一个轨道质量驱动器。这些设施对我们的旗舰构成了特别重大的威胁。 这些静态防御设施的射程几乎无限，对大质量单位（大于5 tX）造成极高的伤害。它们唯一的弱点是射击间隔时间长。 力场也能有效地阻挡轨道质量驱动器的攻击。 轨道质量驱动器也可以通过入侵占领。 提示: 留下你的旗舰，派遣一支较小的具有高爆发能力的突击舰部队，迅速消灭轨道质量驱动器。

column1: Threat Summary: Raid Engine Commander, we have detected an AI Raid Engine in {PlanetName}. These installations will generate relatively powerful waves of ships to send against us as long as we have forces present on this planet. When a Raid Engine is present on an AI-controlled planet, 2 seconds after your forces arrive it will spawn a wave of ships with a strength rating equivalent to 150% that of a standard wave, and continue to do so every two minutes. These ships can appear from any warpgate in the galaxy adjacent to your territory. Raid Engines are fairly fragile and will quickly collapse under concentrated fire. Keep in mind, however, that removal of an AI Raid Engine will increase AI Progress by 5. This will occur even if it self-destructs due to the elimination of the in-system command station.
column2: 威胁总结：突袭引擎 指挥官，我们在{PlanetName}行星上检测到一个AI突袭引擎。只要我们在这个行星上有部队，这些设施就会生成相对强大的单位波来攻击我们。 当一个突袭引擎存在于AI控制的行星上时，你的部队到达2秒后，它将生成一波强度相当于标准波150%的单位，并每两分钟继续生成一波。这些单位可以从星系中与你领土相邻的任何跃迁门出现。 突袭引擎相当脆弱，在集中火力攻击下会迅速崩溃。 不过，请记住，移除一个AI突袭引擎将使AI进度增加5。即使它因星系内指挥站被摧毁而自毁，也会发生这种情况。

column1: Threat Summary: Wormhole Projector Commander, we have detected a Wormhole Projector in {PlanetName}. A Wormhole Projector will create new wormhole links on the map, and is triggered by a Wormhole Invasion Once it takes enough damage, the wormhole projector will become Destabilized. Once Destabilized the projector will die and the wormhole will vanish shortly. Be careful not to have your fleet trapped when the wormhole vanishes! TIP: Some players find the new wormholes to be useful, and won't always destroy the generator.
column2: 威胁总结：虫洞投影仪 指挥官，我们在{PlanetName}行星上检测到一个虫洞投影仪。虫洞投影仪会在地图上创建新的虫洞连接，并由虫洞入侵触发。 一旦虫洞投影仪受到足够的伤害，它将变得不稳定。一旦不稳定，投影仪将损坏，虫洞将很快消失。小心不要让你的舰队在虫洞消失时被困住！ 提示: 一些玩家发现新的虫洞很有用，并不总是会摧毁投影仪。

column1: We are very outnumbered! Commander, our military simulations suggest the enemy in this system is much stronger than our current forces. Consider Regrouping and Gaining Strength - Given the difference in strength in this system, our attack is unlikely to succeed right now. - One option is to capture fleets and ships elsewhere in the galaxy. - Another is to spend our science to improve our fleet strength before attacking again. Not Every Planet Needs to be Captured If this planet is not near our borders and has little strategic value, then bypassing it is a viable option. Loading ships into our transports ('L' with the fleet selected) and flying through the system to planets behind them before unloading ('U' with fleet selected to unload; note you can queue the unload by holding Shift and pressing 'U') might be an option. Review the Source of Strength Use the planet view ('P' by default) and look for the source of the AI strength in this sytem. Is there an active Eye, Ion Cannon, or fortress that needed to be raided ahead of the main fleet? Strength Estimates Can Be Deceptive Strength doesn't necessarily indicate how a unit will fare in combat. If our units effectively counter the AI's forces at a planet, you may have an easier time than the numbers suggest.
column2: 我们严重寡不敌众！ 指挥官，我们的军事模拟表明，该星系中的敌人比我们目前的部队强大得多。 考虑重新集结并增强实力 - 鉴于该星系中的实力差距，我们目前的攻击不太可能成功。 - 一种选择是在星系的其他地方占领舰队和单位。 - 另一种选择是花费我们的科技值来提升舰队实力，然后再发起攻击。 并非每个行星都需要占领 如果这个行星不在我们的边界附近，且战略价值不大，那么绕过它是一个可行的选择。 将单位装载到我们的运输船中（选中舰队后按“L”键），飞过该星系到达后方的行星，然后卸载（选中舰队后按“U”键卸载；注意你可以按住Shift键并按“U”键来队列卸载）可能是一个选择。 审查力量来源 使用行星视图（默认按“P”键），查找该星系中AI力量的来源。 是否有活跃的监视眼、离子炮或堡垒需要在主力舰队进攻前进行突袭？ 实力估计可能具有欺骗性 实力并不一定表明一个单位在战斗中的表现。如果我们的单位能有效对抗行星上的AI部队，你可能会比数字显示的更容易取得胜利。

column2: 黑暗尖塔复仇发生器的断裂部分。

column2: 一头肉搏型守护者，配备极化器阵列用来撕裂装甲敌人，死亡时生成较弱的自身复制体。

column1: A bruiser of a guardian sporting an array of Polarizers with which it shreds armored foes.
column2: 一名皮糙肉厚的守卫，配备一组偏振器武器，专门用于摧毁装甲目标。

column1: A carrier filled to bursting with drones designed to attract enemy fire.
column2: 一艘满载旨在吸引敌人火力的无人机的母舰。

column1: A castoff weapon of the Samurai, now animated and aggressive.
column2: 武士丢弃的武器，现在变得有生命且具有攻击性。

column1: A celestial being of immense strength, the Angel sports extensive shielding and fearsome weapons. It is immune to weapon jamming and devour. Deployed by the Heavenly realm to destroy all evil in the galaxy.
column2: 天使是一种拥有强大力量的天界存在，拥有广泛的护盾和可怕的武器。免疫武器干扰和吞噬。由天堂领域部署，以消灭银河系中的所有邪恶。

column1: A central block of planets with multiple 'Arms' spreading out from it.                Not available on Deathwish mode and up.
column2: 一组中心行星，有多条“触手”从中心向外延伸。                在死亡愿望模式及以上不可用。

column1: A central cluster with a series of rings around it.                Not available on Deathwish mode and up.
column2: 一个中心星团，周围环绕着一系列星环。                死愿模式及以上不可用。

column1: A chokepoint in the middle, weird stuff around the edges
column2: 中间是咽喉要道，边缘是奇怪的东西

column1: A city ship has arrived into the galaxy. It will try to create structures accross the galaxy in order to grow more prosperous and powerful.  <color=#f25e1c>HIGH IMPACT:</color> Depending on the intensity and invasion time the impact of the faction will be vary greatly. For example an immediate invasion, intensity 10 will be around the realms of Medium to High Impact, while a having the invasion later could turn it into a complete flop. Note that killing the City Ship will make the faction unable to build new structures. Here's what you can expect overall : Roaming around in a powerful ship, this foe's impact is mainly felt if they manage to seed and upgrade a few structures. Even if they were to fail in that endeavor, the City Ship remains a noticeable enemy.
column2: 一艘流浪城市舰已抵达银河系。它将尝试在银河系中建造建筑以变得更加繁荣和强大。  <color=#f25e1c>高影响：</color>根据强度和入侵时间，该派系的影响将大不相同。例如，立即入侵、强度10将在中等到高影响之间，而较晚入侵则可能使其完全失败。请注意，杀死城市舰将使该派系无法建造新建筑。以下是总体预期： 驾驶着强大的单位游荡，如果它们成功播种并升级了一些建筑，这个敌人的影响就会显现。即使它们在这个努力中失败了，城市舰仍然是一个值得注意的敌人。

column1: A civilian trade ship. It is tasked with moving resources throughout your planets. Upgraded by Metal Generation and Light Tech.
column2: 一艘民用贸易船。负责在你的各行星之间运输资源。可受金属产出和轻型科技升级。

column1: A civilisation resides on board of this ship, prosperous like no other. The ship is now able to access improved weaponry, alongside bolstered integrity.
column2: 一个文明居住在这艘船上，繁荣程度无可匹敌。这艘船现在能够使用改进的武器系统，并拥有更强的结构完整性。

column1: A civilisation resides on board of this ship. After many gruelling trials, they have grown rather prosperous, making this ship able to use new and improved weapons.
column2: 一个文明居住在这艘船上。经过无数次艰苦的考验，他们已经变得相当繁荣，使这艘船能够使用全新且改进的武器。

column1: A civilisation resides on board of this ship. The technological level of the civilisation residing on this ship has transcended common sense, bolstering further the City Ship.
column2: 一个文明居住在这艘船上。居住于此的文明科技水平已经超越了常识，进一步强化了城市舰。

column1: A clan of alien warriors sworn to perfecting combat. Their language has no word for "ally". One is either Ascendant or Supplicant. The Ascendant is the greatest warrior whom all Supplicants serve. The Ascendant brings their servants closer to true Ascendancy, but should they fall, they are no longer the Ascendant.                 <color=#f25e1c>LOW IMPACT:</color> Grow in power as the game progresses, but do not have their own territory. Their allegiance changes when defeated in battle.
column2: 一个宣誓追求战斗极致的异族战士氏族。他们的语言中没有"盟友"这个词。一个人要么是至上者，要么是侍奉者。至上者是最伟大的战士，所有侍奉者为其服务。至上者使他们的仆人更接近真正的至上之境，但如果他们倒下，他们就不再是至上者。                  <color=#f25e1c>低影响：</color> 随着游戏进程增长力量，但没有自己的领土。他们的阵营在被击败时改变。

column1: A cloaked carrier specialized in supporting Spec-Ops fleet deployments with launches of short lived Raptor drones.
column2: 隐形航母，专门通过发射短寿命的猛禽无人机来支持特种作战舰队部署。

column1: A cloaked carrier specialized in supporting Spec-Ops fleet deployments. Builds drones slower but can stay cloaked for a while even during fights.
column2: 专门支援特战舰队部署的隐形航母。建造无人机较慢，但即使在战斗期间也能保持隐形一段时间。

column1: A cloaked factory for producing mines, orbiting the Mine Destroyer.
column2: 一艘用于生产雷区、环绕雷区驱逐舰轨道的隐形工厂。

column1: A cloaked factory for producing mines, orbiting the Mine Destroyer. This one costs even less metal and energy, and can produce faster.
column2: 一艘用于生产雷区、环绕雷区驱逐舰轨道的隐形工厂。此型号金属和能源消耗更低，且生产速度更快。

column1: A cloaked factory for producing mines, orbiting the Mine Destroyer. This one costs less metal and energy.
column2: 一艘用于生产雷区、环绕雷区驱逐舰轨道的隐形工厂。此型号金属和能源消耗更低。

column1: A cloaked mine that destroys itself to deal area damage, with a proximity trigger.
column2: 隐形地雷，通过自毁造成区域伤害，带有近炸引信。

column1: A cloaked outpost with no weapons that boosts ship speed. These are pemanent structures. Use them to make speedy paths between broken up territory.
column2: 无武器隐形前哨站，提升单位速度。这些是永久性建筑。用它们在破碎领土之间制造快速通道。

column1: A cloaked transport with fragile high damage frigates.
column2: 一艘隐形运输舰搭载脆弱但高伤害的护卫舰。

column1: A cloaked, long range turret with acid damage.
column2: 一座隐形、远程的炮塔，造成酸蚀伤害。

column1: A cloaked, unarmed outpost that boosts the speed of friendly ships. A highway of these can connect broken up territory.
column2: 隐形无武装前哨站，提升友军单位的速度。一条由它们组成的高速公路可以连接破碎的领土。

column1: A close-range mix used to wreck swarmers and fragile ships. Its sheer damage-per-second is diffused but outshines many others mixes. Picking the same starting battlestation twice will randomize the second one.
column2: 一种近距离组合，用于摧毁集群敌人和脆弱舰船。其每秒伤害虽然分散，但胜过许多其他组合。 如果两次选择相同的起始战斗空间站，第二个将随机化。

column1: A collection of NPC Ships that fly across a predefined galaxy path, building units for planet owners on their way.
column2: 一组NPC单位沿预定银河路径飞行，沿途为行星所有者建造单位。

column1: A collection of defenses using ambush tech.
column2: 使用伏击技术的防御集合。

column1: A collection of defenses using fusion tech.
column2: 使用聚变技术的防御集合。

column1: A collection of fused together scavenged wrecks of midsize Spire warships. Now governed by the will of its AI master.
column2: 由收集并融合的中型尖塔战舰残骸组成。现在受其 AI 主人的意志支配。

column1: A collection of ships using Melee tech, most of which use suicide attacks. Good thing your flagship can rebuild them!
column2: 使用近战技术的单位集合，大多数使用自杀式攻击。好在你的旗舰可以重建它们！

column1: A collection of ships using Piercing tech
column2: 使用穿透技术的单位集合

column1: A collection of ships using ambush tech.
column2: 使用伏击技术的单位集合。

column1: A colossal armed planetoid, its hangers teeming with vast numbers of swarm drones. The AI would not normally consider even the entire Milky Way galaxy worth the attention of a Mothership. What did you DO?!
column2: 一颗巨大的武装小行星，其机库中挤满了大量的蜂群无人机。AI 通常不会认为整个银河系都值得母舰关注。您到底做了什么？！

column1: A colossal armed planetoid. The AI would not normally consider even the entire Milky Way galaxy worth the attention of a Dreadnought. What did you DO?!
column2: 一颗巨大的武装小行星。AI 通常不会认为整个银河系都值得无畏舰关注。您到底做了什么？！

column1: A colossal armed planetoid. The AI would not normally consider even the entire Milky Way galaxy worth the attention of a mothership. The AI has made specialized modifications to blindside the Devourer Golem with perfect radiation reflection and decreased damage upon arrival. While the Doomsday Coil Beam has been slowed to a third it now uses a shield-bypassing frequency, dealing damage directly to hull, and greatly more so the higher the targets shields.
column2: 一个巨大的武装行星。AI 通常不会认为整个银河系都值得一艘母舰的关注。AI 进行了专门的改装，利用完美的辐射反射来偷袭吞噬者傀儡，并在刚抵达时减少伤害。虽然末日线圈光束的速度已降至三分之一，但它现在使用一种绕过护盾的频率，直接对船体造成伤害，并且目标护盾越高伤害越大。

column1: A colossal armed planetoid. The AI would not normally consider even the entire Milky Way galaxy worth the attention of a mothership. What did you DO?!
column2: 一个巨大的武装小行星。人工智能通常不会认为整个银河系值得一艘母舰关注。你到底做了什么？！

column1: A combination of ships that is all about explosions. Excellent firepower but somewhat slow and unfocused.
column2: 一支由专注于爆炸的舰船组成的舰队。火力强大，但速度较慢且缺乏针对性。

column1: A constructor made by the Azaran Empire to give birth to a guard post in order to bolster defenses in the chosen system.
column2: 阿扎兰帝国制造的构造体，用于诞生哨站以加强所选系统中的防御。

column1: A constructor made by the Azaran Empire to give birth to a remarkable facility showcasing the full technological prowess of the Empire.
column2: 阿扎兰帝国制造的构造体，用于诞生一个展示帝国全盛技术实力的非凡设施。

column1: A constructor made by the Azaran Empire to give birth to an unremarkable, but useful facility to bolster the might of the Empire.
column2: 阿扎兰帝国制造的构造体，用于诞生一个平凡但有用的设施来增强帝国实力。

column1: A counter-heavy fleet of an Ionosphere Raider which quickly dispatches low-albedo ships at long range, Torpedo Bombers that can destroy most larger enemies with a few volleys and Disrupter Corvettes to protect the fragile ships.
column2: 一支重反制的舰队，由电离层突击者组成，可在远距离迅速解决低反照率舰船；鱼雷轰炸机只需几轮齐射便能摧毁多数大型敌人，干扰者护卫舰则保护脆弱的舰船。

column1: A counter-heavy fleet of an Ionosphere Raider which quickly dispatches low-albedo ships at long range, Torpedo Bombers that can destroy most larger enemies with a few volleys and Disrupter Corvettes to protect the fragile ships. This fleet is full of faction-upgraded ships.
column2: 一支重反制的舰队，由电离层突击者组成，可在远距离迅速解决低反照率舰船；鱼雷轰炸机只需几轮齐射便能摧毁多数大型敌人，干扰者护卫舰则保护脆弱的舰船。  此舰队满载派系升级过的舰船。

column1: A counter-heavy fleet of an Ionosphere Raider which quickly dispatches low-albedo ships at long range, Torpedo Bombers that can destroy most larger enemies with a few volleys and Disrupter Corvettes to protect the fragile ships. This fleet is full of upgraded ships.
column2: 一支重反制的舰队，由电离层突击者组成，可在远距离迅速解决低反照率舰船；鱼雷轰炸机只需几轮齐射便能摧毁多数大型敌人，干扰者护卫舰则保护脆弱的舰船。  此舰队满载升级过的舰船。

column1: A covert salvage harvester placed by the Blackguard cruiser. The salvage depot can only spawn if there is a stationary enemy structure present on the planet, as the depot is designed to steal resources from hostile worlds. The salvage depot generates metal like a normal harvester but also targets mobile units with a tracer, applying greater metabolism. Destroy units targeted by the depot for extra metal.
column2: 由黑卫巡洋舰放置的秘密打捞采集器。只有当行星上存在静止的敌方建筑时，打捞站才能生成，因为该打捞站旨在从敌对行星窃取资源。打捞站像普通采集器一样生产金属，还会用追踪器锁定移动单位，使其代谢加速。摧毁被打捞站锁定的单位可获得额外金属。

column1: A critical piece of AI infrastructure that allows for the different AIs to communicate. Destroying all of these will prevent all the different AIs from communicating, initiating an AI Civil War. This will make the game much more challenging.
column2: AI 基础设施的关键部分，使不同 AI 之间能够通信。摧毁所有通信节点将阻止所有 AI 之间的通信，引发 AI 内战，这将使游戏变得更加具有挑战性。

column1: A crucial piece of AI monitoring infrastructure. If you claim this structure, AIP will go down by 60, but if it or your Command Station dies, it will go up more than it reduced.
column2: AI 监控基础设施的关键部分。如果你占领该结构，AIP 会降低 60，但如果它或你的指挥站被摧毁，AIP 会增加且幅度大于减少量。

column1: A cruiser large enough to house an array of energy collectors on its hull that take in the impact energy from weapons, then guide it into the ship's power converter to return a portion of the firepower while also leeching health from the attacker is almost immortal. For shortness sake the 'almost' is often omitted, but it quickly became a favorite among invasion forces for its tendency to bear the brunt of the attack and still survive.
column2: 一艘足够大的巡洋舰，其船体上装有一系列能量收集器，接收武器的冲击能量，然后将其引导到单位的功率转换器中，返回一部分火力，同时从攻击者身上吸取生命，几乎是不朽的。为了简洁起见，'几乎'经常被省略，但它很快成为入侵部队的最爱，因为它倾向于承受攻击的主要冲击并仍然存活。

column1: A crystal infused with Neinzul genetic material. Looking through it makes it look as though the world is bathed in alien blood and bring about death and slaughter in space, which is why some taken to calling it 'Curse Crystal'.
column2: 一种灌注了宁苏基因物质的晶体。透过它看世界仿佛沐浴在外星鲜血中，带来太空中的死亡与屠杀，因此有人称之为「诅咒水晶」。

column1: A crystal infused with the energy of stellar background radiation. Its ability to siphon even the faintest of signals makes it very potent in creating self-sufficient constructs, which makes it powerful and sought-after by many factions.
column2: 一种灌注了恒星背景辐射能量的晶体。其吸收最微弱信号的能力使其在创造自给自足结构方面非常强大，因此被众多派系觊觎。

column1: A cunning fighter of the Architrave that wields a trident beam weapon and will net foes that stumble in range of its tractor beams.
column2: 拱心石势力中一名狡猾的战士，它配备三叉戟光束武器，一旦敌人进入牵引光束射程，便会将其捕获。

column1: A cunning fighter of the Architrave that wields a trident beam weapon and will net foes that stumble in range of its tractor beams. Also possesses a weapon jammer.
column2: 拱门使团中一艘狡黠的战斗机，挥舞三叉戟光束武器，并用牵引光束网住闯入射程的敌人。还配备武器干扰器。

column1: A cunning fighter of the Architrave that wields a trident beam weapon, striking those within its three-pronged attack, and nets foes that stumble in range of its tractor beams. Enhanced with spire railcannon technology.
column2: 拱心石阵营中一名狡猾的战士，它配备三叉戟光束武器，能用其三叉攻击打击范围内的敌人，还能用牵引光束捕获误入射程的敌人。该单位还配备了尖塔轨道加农炮技术。

column1: A dangerous micro singularity which has been contained but blocks ship travel.
column2: 一个被控制住的危险微型奇点，但阻挡单位通行。

column1: A deadly adversary, the hoplomachus specializes in exploiting the mass of its enemies. It paralyzes groups of small-mass units at long range while getting in close range of massive targets to deal tremendous damage, especially if its victim has active shields.
column2: 霍普洛马库斯战舰是一个致命的对手，它擅长利用敌人的质量优势。它能在远距离使小质量单位群体瘫痪，同时接近大型目标并造成巨大伤害，尤其是当目标开启护盾时。

column1: A deadly adversary, the hoplomachus specializes in exploiting the mass of its enemies. It paralyzes groups of small-mass units at long range while getting in close range of massive targets to deal tremendous damage, especially if its victim has active shields. Enhanced with spire railcannon technology.
column2: 一个致命的对手，重装步兵战机（Hoplomachus）擅长利用敌人的质量。它能在远距离瘫痪小质量单位群，同时接近大型目标造成巨大伤害，尤其是当目标护盾开启时。它还配备了尖塔轨道炮技术。

column1: A deadly guardpost that integrates powerful Dark Zenith technology. Its primary weapon fires an ion blast that paralyzes enemy ship clusters and magnetically pulls ships towards itself. Beware especially its seekerbomb launcher, which can devastate ships. The seekerbomb is vulnerable as it accelerates, so destroy them while you can.
column2: 一个致命的岗哨，融合了强大的黑暗天顶技术。其主武器发射离子冲击，可瘫痪敌方舰船集群，并以磁力将舰船吸向自身。尤其要小心其寻的炸弹发射器，它能摧毁舰船。寻的炸弹在加速时较为脆弱，所以要趁此机会将其摧毁。

column1: A deadly melee Youngling launched by the Manticore. Ignores most crowd control effects and takes reduced damage from distant sources.
column2: 由蝎尾狮发射的致命近战幼体。无视大多数群体控制效果，受到远程伤害减少。

column1: A deadly melee drone launched by the Blade Spawner frigate. Ignores most crowd control effects and takes reduced damage from distant sources.
column2: 由刀刃生成护卫舰发射的致命近战无人机。忽略大多数群体控制效果，并且从远距离来源受到的伤害会减少。

column1: A deadly melee drone launched by the Spire Blade Spawner. Ignores most crowd control effects and takes reduced damage from distant sources.
column2: 由尖塔刃型生成器发射的致命近战无人机。忽略大多数群体控制效果，且受到的远程伤害降低。

column1: A decent number of Combat Engineers that can go anywhere you please, enemy planets or otherwise -- plus a Mobile Factory that is cloaked and can launch tractor drones to push enemies away.
column2: 相当数量的战斗工程师，可以前往任何你想要的地方，包括敌方行星——加上一座隐形移动工厂，可以发射牵引无人机推开敌人。

column1: A decent number of Combat Engineers that can go anywhere you please, enemy planets or otherwise -- plus a Mobile Factory that launches small drones improving ally damage!
column2: 相当数量的战斗工程师，可以前往任何你想要的地方，包括敌方行星——加上一座发射小型无人机提升友军伤害的移动工厂！

column1: A decent number of Combat Engineers that can go anywhere you please, enemy planets or otherwise -- plus a Mobile Factory that pushes and paralyzes lighter enemies!
column2: 相当数量的战斗工程师，可以前往任何你想要的地方，包括敌方行星——加上一座推开并麻痹较轻敌人的移动工厂！

column1: A decent number of Combat Engineers that can go anywhere you please, enemy planets or otherwise -- plus a cloaked mobile factory that you can take with you even deep into enemy territory!
column2: 相当数量的战斗工程师，可以前往任何你想要的地方，包括敌方行星——加上一座隐形移动工厂，可以带你深入敌方领土！

column1: A decent number of Combat Engineers that can go anywhere you please, enemy planets or otherwise -- plus a mobile factory with basic combat drones that you can take with you even deep into enemy territory!
column2: 大量战斗工程师可以前往任何你想去的地方，包括敌方行星。此外，还有一个配备基础战斗无人机的移动工厂，即使深入敌方领土也能随行！

column1: A decloaker on top of a concussive-force generator that detonates for trivial area damage, but knocks even larger enemies back and stuns their engines. It can fire in a rapid burst but then will need some time to reload.
column2: 反隐形装置架在冲击发生器之上，引爆时仅造成轻微的范围伤害，却能将更大的敌人击退并使其引擎瘫痪。它可快速连射一轮，之后需要一段时间重新装填。

column1: A dedicated sniper fleet that can strike at anything from its entry point. Excellent for taking out strategic targets. Expensive and not so great at straight up fights.
column2: 一支专门的狙击舰队，可以从其进入点打击任何目标。非常适合摧毁战略目标。造价昂贵，在正面战斗中表现不佳。

column1: A deep-drilling Hacking Mine, available only after extensive mining of this planet. As with the basic Mine, it can only be built on an AI-owned planet.
column2: 一个深层钻探的入侵矿场，仅在此行星进行大量采矿后可用。与基础矿场一样，只能建在AI拥有的行星上。

column1: A deep-drilling Metal Mine, available only after extensive mining of this planet. As with the basic Mine, it can only be built on an AI-owned planet.
column2: 一个深层钻探的金属矿场，仅在此行星进行大量采矿后可用。与基础矿场一样，只能建在AI拥有的行星上。

column1: A deep-drilling Science Mine, available only after extensive mining of this planet. As with the basic Mine, it can only be built on an AI-owned planet.
column2: 一个深层钻探的科技矿场，仅在此行星进行大量采矿后可用。与基础矿场一样，只能建在AI拥有的行星上。

column1: A defensive fleet composed of Riot Police and Security Troops. Experts at defending turrets and suppressing attacks, but lacks offensive power. A classic fleet.
column2: 由防暴警察和安全部队组成的防御舰队。擅长防守炮塔和压制攻击，但缺乏进攻能力。经典舰队。

column1: A defensive masterpiece from the Andor people, it acts as a mobile Federation Shipyard, and units protected by this will deal full damage.
column2: 安多尔人的防御杰作，充当移动联邦船坞，受其保护的单位将造成全额伤害。

column1: A defensive orb that attracts weapon fire of targets shooting within its zone of protection.
column2: 一种防御性球体，可吸引在其保护区域内射击目标的火力。

column1: A defensive outpost of the Necromancer granting vision on neighboring planets. Undead minions attrition more slowly at a Necropolis. As you mark up the Necropolis you will be able to build some new structures.   This is a defensive Necropolis, which holds territory but does not empower a flagship. It can only build defensive structures, and it grants map vision. The Defensive Necropolis also have module points to spend.
column2: 死灵法师的防御前哨站，可提供邻近行星的视野。在墓地中，不死族仆从的损耗速度会变慢。随着墓地等级提升，你将能够建造一些新建筑。  这是一个防御型墓地，可控制领土，但不会增强旗舰。它只能建造防御性建筑，并提供地图视野。防御型墓地也有可支配的模块点数。

column1: A defensive seed that attracts weapon fire of targets shooting within its zone of protection.
column2: 一颗防御种子，吸引在其保护区域内开火目标的武器火力。

column1: A defensive specialist, Hereward will lead his group in patrolling nearby planets using a group of Velociraptors.
column2: 作为防御专家，赫里沃德将率领他的团队使用一群迅猛龙舰巡逻附近的行星。

column1: A desecrated Templar fortress, now under the dominion of the Necromancer. Fires large barrages of necrotic missiles and produces drone-versions of various skeleton types
column2: 一座被亵渎的圣堂武士堡垒，如今已受死灵法师支配。它会发射大量坏死导弹，并生产各种骷髅类型的无人机版本。

column1: A destroyer which slowly 'terraforms' systems in favor of its owner: By producing extreme quantities of mines.
column2: 一艘缓慢「改造」星系以利于其所有者的驱逐舰：通过生产海量雷区。

column1: A destroyer which slowly 'terraforms' systems in favor of its owner: By producing extreme quantities of mines. This one costs even less metal and energy, and can produce faster and more child units.
column2: 一艘缓慢「改造」星系以利于其所有者的驱逐舰：通过生产海量雷区。此型号金属和能源消耗更低，且生产速度更快、子单位更多。

column1: A destroyer which slowly 'terraforms' systems in favor of its owner: By producing extreme quantities of mines. This one costs less metal and energy.
column2: 一艘缓慢「改造」星系以利于其所有者的驱逐舰：通过生产海量雷区。此型号金属和能源消耗更低。

column1: A devious Templar destroyer, the Seneschal is cloaked and has two paralyzing weapons specializing in singular large ships and groups of small ships, respectively.
column2: 圣殿骑士的狡猾驱逐舰，管家号处于隐形状态，配备两种麻痹武器，分别专门针对大型单体舰船和小型舰船群。

column1: A devious Templar destroyer, the Seneschal is cloaked and has two paralyzing weapons specializing in singular large ships and groups of small ships, respectively.
column2: 执事舰是一艘狡猾的圣殿骑士驱逐舰，它具备隐形能力，并且拥有两种麻痹武器，分别专门针对单个大型舰船和小型舰船群。

column1: A devious guardpost that integrates powerful Zenith Architrave phasing technology. The guardpost periodically phases to and from Multi-Phase. While in realspace, it is armed with spiderweb phasers, that in addition to phasing unshielded and low-energy usage ships, slows and reels targets towards itself. While in Multi-Phase, it is instead armed with deadly vorpal beams that deal more damage to weakened prey.
column2: 这是一个狡猾的岗哨，集成了强大的天顶拱心石相位技术。岗哨会周期性地在正常状态和多相位状态之间切换。在正常空间时，它配备了蛛网相位器，除了能让无护盾和低能耗的舰船进入相位状态外，还能减慢目标速度并将其拉向自身。处于多相位状态时，它则配备致命的锋刃光束，对受损的目标造成更多伤害。

column1: A direct assault against the AI homeworld would be futile while these still stand. You will need to either destroy or hack them.
column2: 只要这些还在，直接进攻AI母星就是徒劳的。你需要摧毁它们或者入侵它们。

column1: A disposable fusion rocket pod that rapidly empties within 12 salvos and devastates damaged enemies.
column2: 一种可消耗的聚变火箭发射巢，可在 12 轮齐射内迅速清空，对已受损敌人造成毁灭性打击。

column1: A disposable unit, the Universal Henchman is a pawn used as a shield for its masters, unaware of what they are preparing.
column2: 一个可抛弃的棋子，普遍爪牙是被用作主人的护盾的卒子，浑然不知他们在准备什么。

column1: A distinguished lieutenant now in charge of a small amount of lieutenants. Its main weapon blasts acid on foes, greatly increasing the common spaceman efficency.
column2: 一位杰出的尉官，现负责指挥少量尉官。其主武器向敌人喷射酸液，大幅提高了普通太空兵的效能。

column1: A distinguished major now in charge of a small amount of majors. Its main weapon blasts acid on foes, greatly increasing the common spaceman efficency, and also creates its own platoon in battle.
column2: 一位杰出的少校，现负责指挥少量少校。其主武器向敌人喷射酸液，大幅提高了普通太空兵的效能，同时还在战斗中创建自己的排。

column1: A distinguished soldier now in charge of a small amount of spacemen. Its main weapon blasts acid on foes, greatly increasing the common spaceman efficency.
column2: 一位杰出的士兵，现负责指挥少量太空兵。其主武器向敌人喷射酸液，大幅提高了普通太空兵的效能。

column1: A dreadfull sphere of acid and bile. It is deeply corrosive to things it hits.
column2: 一颗恐怖的酸液与胆汁球体。对击中的目标具有极强的腐蚀性。

column1: A durable Spire Corvette. Excellent all-around ship with translocating railguns.
column2: 一艘耐用的尖塔轻型护卫舰。全能型舰船，配备可瞬移的磁轨炮。

column1: A durable cloaked brawler, this Nadir ship has a corrosive weapon. It's cloaking device does not last long, just enough for it to get a powerful first salvo.  A bit more powerful than the other low-tier Nadier, and worth a bit more resources.
column2: 一艘耐久的隐形格斗舰，这个纳迪尔单位装备腐蚀武器。其隐形装置持续时间不长，只够打出一轮强力首波齐射。  A bit more powerful than the other low-tier Nadier, and worth a bit more 资源.

column1: A durable fleet of a Drone Battleship which can use stand-off tactics while reinforcing with a wide variety of drones, and Rampage Frigates which deal exceptional damage protected behind the drone chaff.
column2: 一支耐久的舰队，由无人机战列舰组成，可采取远距离牵制战术，同时以多种多样的无人机进行增援；狂怒护卫舰藏身于无人机箔片之后，可造成卓越伤害。

column1: A durable fleet of a Drone Battleship which can use stand-off tactics while reinforcing with a wide variety of drones, and Rampage Frigates which deal exceptional damage protected behind the drone chaff. This fleet is full of faction-upgraded ships.
column2: 一支耐久的舰队，由无人机战列舰组成，可采取远距离牵制战术，同时以多种多样的无人机进行增援；狂怒护卫舰藏身于无人机箔片之后，可造成卓越伤害。  此舰队满载派系升级过的舰船。

column1: A durable fleet of a Drone Battleship which can use stand-off tactics while reinforcing with a wide variety of drones, and Rampage Frigates which deal exceptional damage protected behind the drone chaff. This fleet is full of upgraded ships.
column2: 一支耐久的舰队，由无人机战列舰组成，可采取远距离牵制战术，同时以多种多样的无人机进行增援；狂怒护卫舰藏身于无人机箔片之后，可造成卓越伤害。  此舰队满载升级过的舰船。

column1: A facility dedicated to storage, increasing the maximum strength that the Azaran Empire can project in the galaxy.
column2: 一个专门用于储存的设施，增加阿扎兰帝国在银河系中可投射的最大力量。

column1: A facility dedicated to the production of parts and components or even training. Bolsters the production of the command center.
column2: 专门用于零件、部件生产甚至训练的设施。增强指挥中心的生产能力。

column1: A faction consisting of hardworking humans. As you expand to other planets, they will expand along with you to bolster your economy and offer you additional defensive and utility buildings on your colonies.
column2: 由勤劳的人类组成的派系。随着你向其他行星扩张，他们也会跟随扩张，增强你的经济，并在你的殖民地上提供额外的防御和实用建筑。

column1: A faction that inhabits deep space and likes to attack things with ships but must research for new types ships.                          <color=#f25e1c>LOW IMPACT:</color> This faction warps in on occasion and may steal a few small fighters. it's 'attacks' are typically tiny and harmless.
column2: 一个栖息在深空中并喜欢用单位攻击的派系，但必须研究新型单位。  <color=#f25e1c>低影响：</color>该派系偶尔会跃迁进入，可能会偷走几架小型战斗机。它的'攻击'通常微不足道且无害。

column1: A fairly indecent focus on bypassing protection and attracting attention here. Extremely powerful within range but helpless against cooler, longer-ranged opposition. Picking the same starting battlestation twice will randomize the second one.
column2: 相当激进地专注于突破防护并吸引注意力。在射程内极其强大，但面对更冷静、射程更远的对手则无能为力。 如果两次选择相同的起始战斗空间站，第二个将随机化。

column1: A far larger ship whose entire persona is to fire a large beam to obliterate singular or multiple ships.
column2: 一个更大的单位，其全部使命就是发射大型光束来消灭单个或多个单位。

column1: A fast Guardian prototype equipped with powerful adaptive multishot guns. They can split their shots between multiple targets like usual, focus all onto the same enemy or anything in between.
column2: 一种快速的守护者原型，配备强大的自适应多管火炮。它们可以像往常一样将炮弹分散到多个目标上，也可以将所有炮弹集中攻击同一个敌人，或者介于两者之间。

column1: A fast fleet of a Light Raider which is fast and hits hard, Needle Interceptors which are cheap and can quickly swarm out to hit slow, isolated targets and Sting Light Frigates which deal with shields and forcefields quickly.
column2: 一支快速的舰队，由轻型突击者组成，速度快且打击沉重；飞针拦截机价格低廉，能迅速成群涌出攻击缓慢、孤立的目标，螫刺轻型护卫舰则迅速清理护盾与力场。

column1: A fast fleet of a Light Raider which is fast and hits hard, Needle Interceptors which are cheap and can quickly swarm out to hit slow, isolated targets and Sting Light Frigates which deal with shields and forcefields quickly. This fleet is full of faction-upgraded ships.
column2: 一支快速的舰队，由轻型突击者组成，速度快且打击沉重；飞针拦截机价格低廉，能迅速成群涌出攻击缓慢、孤立的目标，螫刺轻型护卫舰则迅速清理护盾与力场。  此舰队满载派系升级过的舰船。

column1: A fast fleet of a Light Raider which is fast and hits hard, Needle Interceptors which are cheap and can quickly swarm out to hit slow, isolated targets and Sting Light Frigates which deal with shields and forcefields quickly. This fleet is full of upgraded ships.
column2: 一支快速的舰队，由轻型突击者组成，速度快且打击沉重；飞针拦截机价格低廉，能迅速成群涌出攻击缓慢、孤立的目标，螫刺轻型护卫舰则迅速清理护盾与力场。  此舰队满载升级过的舰船。

column1: A fast ship that will find a location to try to create a new Wormhole, then transform into the full Wormhole Borer.
column2: 一种快速飞船，会寻找位置尝试创建新的虫洞，然后转变为完整的虫洞钻孔机。

column1: A fast wormhole borer ship that will find a location to try to create a new Wormhole, then transform into the full Nephilim.
column2: 一艘快速虫洞钻探船，会找到一个位置尝试创建新虫洞，然后转变为完整的拿非利人。

column1: A fearsome Dark Zenith Ship, equipped with a chain lightning emitter for destroying groups of ships and plasma torpedoes for destroying structures and powerful ships.
column2: 一艘可怕的黑暗天顶战舰，装备了链式闪电发射器，用于摧毁成群的飞船，还配备了等离子鱼雷，用于摧毁建筑和强大的战舰。

column1: A fearsome Dark Zenith Ship, equipped with a chain lightning emitter for destroying groups of ships and plasma torpedoes for destroying structures and strong ships. This enraged variant has an additional weapon that gets stronger as the hersir gets closer to death.
column2: 一艘可怕的黑暗天顶战舰，装备了链式闪电发射器，用于摧毁成群的飞船，还配备了等离子鱼雷，用于摧毁建筑和强大的战舰。这个愤怒版有一个额外的武器，随着赫西尔战舰生命值降低而变强。

column1: A fearsome Dark Zenith Ship, equipped with a chain lightning emitter for destroying groups of ships and plasma torpedoes for destroying structures and strong ships. This fortified variant returns a portion of damage received back to sender.
column2: 一艘可怕的黑暗天顶战舰，装备了链式闪电发射器，用于摧毁成群的飞船，还配备了等离子鱼雷，用于摧毁建筑和强大的战舰。这个强化版会将受到的部分伤害返还给攻击者。

column1: A fearsome Dark Zenith Ship, equipped with a chain lightning emitter for destroying groups of ships and plasma torpedoes for destroying structures and strong ships. This sinister variant has an additional crowd-control weapon that paralyzes enemies.
column2: 一艘可怕的黑暗天顶战舰，装备了链式闪电发射器，用于摧毁成群的飞船，还配备了等离子鱼雷，用于摧毁建筑和强大的战舰。这个邪恶版有一个额外的群体控制武器，可以麻痹敌人。

column1: A fearsome Dark Zenith Ship, equipped with a chain lightning emitter for destroying groups of ships and plasma torpedoes for destroying structures and strong ships. This spirited variant is cloaked and faster.
column2: 一艘可怕的黑暗天顶战舰，装备了链式闪电发射器，用于摧毁成群的飞船，还配备了等离子鱼雷，用于摧毁建筑和强大的战舰。这个灵动版处于隐形状态且速度更快。

column1: A fearsome Dark Zenith Ship, equipped with a chain lightning emitter for destroying groups of ships and plasma torpedoes for destroying structures and strong ships. This stout variant is more durable than usual.
column2: 一艘可怕的黑暗天顶战舰，装备了链式闪电发射器，用于摧毁成群的飞船，还配备了等离子鱼雷，用于摧毁建筑和强大的战舰。这个坚固版比普通版更耐用。

column1: A fearsome Dark Zenith Ship, equipped with a stunner that slows the weapon reload of lightly-armored enemies, and plasma torpedoes for destroying structures and powerful ships. Also carries a tachyon array for detecting cloaked targets.
column2: 一个可怕的暗天顶单位，装备有减缓轻装甲敌人武器装填的眩晕器和用于摧毁建筑和强力单位的电浆鱼雷。还携带有探测隐形目标的超光速粒子阵列。

column1: A fighter for planetary defense reclaimed from downed enemies.
column2: 从被击落的敌人回收的行星防御战斗机。

column1: A fleet composed of Special Forces troops, the tip of the spear for humanity. This fleet is an expert in hit and run tactics. Glory to Humanity!
column2: 由特种部队组成的舰队，人类的矛尖。该舰队精通打了就跑的战术。荣耀属于人类！

column1: A fleet composed of frigates with experimental technologies.
column2: 由搭载实验性科技的护卫舰组成的舰队。

column1: A fleet composed of frigates with lost technologies.
column2: 由搭载失落科技的护卫舰组成的舰队。

column1: A fleet composed of heavily armoured starships, bombers, escort corvettes, and long range siege ships. Slow but powerful.
column2: 由重装甲星舰、轰炸机、护航护卫艇和远程攻城舰组成的舰队。缓慢但强大。

column1: A fleet composed of heavily armoured starships, bombers, escort fighters and railgun starships. Built for aggression and attacking.
column2: 由重装甲星舰、轰炸机、护航战斗机和轨道炮星舰组成的舰队。为侵略和攻击而生。

column1: A fleet comprised of a Thanatos class battleship and her escorts. The pride of the Imperial Navy. This Fleet is so powerful it is akin to cheating.
column2: 由一艘塔纳托斯级战列舰及其护航舰艇组成的舰队。帝国海军的骄傲。这支舰队强大到近乎作弊。

column1: A fleet comprised of a transport armed with guided missiles, and ships that fire long range guided missiles. Great against short ranged units. Guided missiles require factories and metal to reload.
column2: 由一艘配备制导导弹的运输舰和发射远程制导导弹的单位组成的舰队。对抗短程单位表现出色。制导导弹需要工厂和金属来重新装填。

column1: A fleet comprised of an abandoned Thanatos class battleship. The pride of the Imperial Navy, this fleet starts with a powerful battleship armed with powerful cannons but only has basic fighters as escorts.
column2: 由一艘被遗弃的塔纳托斯级战列舰组成的舰队。帝国海军的骄傲，这支舰队以一艘配备强力火炮的战列舰开局，但只有基础战斗机作为护航。

column1: A fleet comprised of geometric cubes and other exotic ships. Very good at tanking and reflecting damage, but is on the slower side overall and falls prey to anti-armour weapons.
column2: 由几何立方体和其他异星单位组成的舰队。非常擅长承受和反射伤害，但整体速度偏慢，且容易受到反装甲武器的攻击。

column1: A fleet designed to adapt to the Zenith Onslaught, using all new technologies.
column2: 一支专为适应天顶星猛攻而设计的舰队，采用了所有新技术。

column1: A fleet designed to exploit new technologies brought about by the Neinzul Abyss. Heavily armoured, slow, but exotic and powerful.
column2: 一支旨在利用内因祖尔深渊带来的新技术的舰队。重装甲、速度慢，但奇特且强大。

column1: A fleet focused on getting close and personal, silent and deadly.
column2: 专注近距离作战的舰队，无声而致命。

column1: A fleet representing the might of the Human Imperium. This fleet is relatively balanced, and is able to take on all adversaries. Glory to Humanity!
column2: 代表人类帝国力量的舰队。该舰队相对平衡，能够对抗所有敌人。荣耀属于人类！

column1: A fleet with an emphasis on control while leveling the place.
column2: 一支在扫平该区域时注重控制的舰队。

column1: A fleet with excessive range and some chaff.
column2: 一支拥有超远射程和一些诱饵的舰队。

column1: A fleet with orbital wards that repulse enemies. Uses a motley crew of ships to handle any situation.
column2: 一支配备轨道守护装置以击退敌人的舰队。使用形形色色的舰船来应对各种情况。

column1: A focal point for local defensive forces for the region. Boosts Turret and Ship capacity for Militia buildings on this and adjacent planets by 15% + 5% per Mark Level or a flat 1, whichever is greater. Upgraded by Command Tech.
column2: 该区域地方防御力量的焦点。使本行星和相邻行星上民兵建筑的炮塔和单位容量提升 15% + 每标记等级 5%，或固定提升 1，取较大值。可受指挥科技升级。

column1: A fragile but deadly Nadir ship, the Sneak is a cloaked bombardier that fires in bursts, cloaking before it fires another salvo. Its weapon specializes in taking out ships with powerful engines.

column1: A giant structure enveloping an entire STAR in order to harness its power is not something you want to tangle with... probably.  At any rate, you can't destroy a Dyson Sphere, so it all comes down to how you interact with it.          These spheres spawn alien ships that will periodically attack neighbors depending on what their allegiance is (you can set this up at the game start, but the default is for them to hate everyone).  If the AI controls their planet, then they will be particularly mad at the AI.  If you come and free them, then they may actually choose to help you out in the vicinity of their star for a while.  If you, on the other hand, capture the Dyson Sphere planet for yourself... prepare for them to be very angry and constantly harassing you from then on.  Multiple Dyson Spheres can be enabled at a time, and each can have a different colour and intensity. Enabling X Dyson Spheres divides the income of a given sphere by X so multiple Dyson Spheres won't be able to just crush the Galaxy.  Dyson Spheres can be Antagonized. If a Dyson Antagonizer exists, all the Dyson Spheres drop what they are doing and start sending units to attack you. Previously created Dyson Sphere ships will keep their previous alignment (so if they were friendly before, they will fight Antagonized ships).  If an Antagonizer shows up, you'll want to make it a priority to get rid of it!
column2: 一个包裹整颗恒星以获取能量的巨大结构，你大概不想与之纠缠...无论如何，你无法摧毁戴森球，所以关键在于如何与之互动。          这些球体会产生外星飞船，根据其阵营设定(游戏开始时可以设置，默认敌视所有人)定期攻击邻近行星。  如果AI控制它们的行星，它们会对AI特别愤怒。如果你解放它们，它们可能会选择在恒星附近帮助你一段时间。  但如果你自己占领戴森球行星...准备好迎接它们持续的愤怒骚扰吧。  可以同时启用多个戴森球，每个可以有不同颜色和强度。启用X个戴森球会将单个球的产出除以X，防止多个戴森球碾压整个星系。  戴森球可以被激怒。如果存在激怒者，所有戴森球都会停止当前行动开始攻击你。之前创建的飞船会保持原有阵营(如果之前友好，会对抗被激怒的飞船)。如果出现激怒者，优先消灭它是明智之举！

column2: 远程导弹炮台。每 6 秒冲击波，每 17 秒新星爆裂。卧倒！

column1: A long range sniper platform which returns fire to every attacker. This variant gains damage as it hull goes down and becomes invulnerable briefly before destroyed.
column2: 远程狙击平台，向每个攻击者还击。此变体随船体下降增加伤害，并在被摧毁前短暂无敌。

column1: A long range, fragile unit effective at destroying bubbleshields (forcefields). Dispatched to fight the Dyson Sidekick.
column2: 一种擅长摧毁气泡力场的远程脆弱单位。被派遣来对抗戴森盟友。

column1: A low level Spire vessel. During its time alone, it has grown to be notably stronger than normal. Repair it and it will help you.
column2: 一个低阶尖塔单位。在独自漂泊期间，它已变得比普通单位强大得多。修复它，它将为你效力。

column1: A major surge in Dark Spire energy detected.
column2: 检测到黑暗尖塔能量大幅激增。

column1: A map dedicated to information on the Elderlings. By default, all it shows are Elderlings on the map that you have discovered, and the time left for eggs to hatch.  As you put tracking hacks on Elderlings on the map, this map will be updated with additional information, including the ability to click hacked Elderlings in order to see their Territory.
column2: 一张专门展示长老族信息的地图。默认情况下，它只显示你已在地图上发现的长老族，以及虫卵孵化剩余的时间。  当你在地图上对长老族使用追踪黑客后，此地图会更新更多信息，包括可以点击被黑客入侵的长老族以查看其领地。

column1: A massive ship is being constructed here from an asteroid.
column2: 这里正在利用小行星建造一个巨型单位。

column2: 一种产生类似引力透镜效应的材料，但效果相反。用其强化的船体会使攻击向外偏转而未命中，除非从足够近的射程发射。暗天顶可用此材料增强单位，使其筑防。

column1: A mature form of the huskarl, the Dreng is able to provide greater defense to its allies by attracting damage to itself in a small zone of protection. This enraged variant has an additional weapon that gets stronger as the dreng gets closer to death.
column2: 赫斯卡尔舰的成熟形态，德伦格舰能够通过在一个小保护区域内吸引伤害，为其盟友提供更强的防御。这种愤怒变体有一件额外的武器，随着德伦格舰接近死亡，该武器会变得更强。

column1: A mature form of the huskarl, the Dreng is able to provide greater defense to its allies by attracting damage to itself in a small zone of protection. This fortified variant returns a larger portion of damage it receives than usual.
column2: 赫斯卡尔舰的成熟形态，德伦格舰能够通过在一个小保护区域内吸引伤害，为其盟友提供更强的防御。这种强化变体比平时能返还更大比例的受到的伤害。

column1: A mature form of the huskarl, the Dreng is able to provide greater defense to its allies by attracting damage to itself in a small zone of protection. This sinister variant has an additional crowd-control weapon that paralyzes enemies.
column2: 赫斯卡尔舰的成熟形态，德伦格舰能够通过在一个小保护区域内吸引伤害，为其盟友提供更强的防御。这种邪恶变体有一件额外的群体控制武器，能够麻痹敌人。

column1: A mature form of the huskarl, the Dreng is able to provide greater defense to its allies by attracting damage to itself in a small zone of protection. This spirited variant is cloaked and faster.
column2: 赫斯卡尔舰的成熟形态，德伦格舰能够通过在一个小保护区域内吸引伤害，为其盟友提供更强的防御。这种灵动变体处于隐形状态且速度更快。

column1: A mature form of the huskarl, the Dreng is able to provide greater defense to its allies by attracting damage to itself in a small zone of protection. This stout variant is more durable than usual.
column2: 赫斯卡尔舰的成熟形态，德伦格舰能够通过在一个小保护区域内吸引伤害，为其盟友提供更强的防御。这种坚固变体比平时更耐用。

column1: A mature form of the huskarl, the dreng is able to provide greater defense to its allies by attracting damage to itself in a small zone of protection.
column2: 赫斯卡尔舰的成熟形态，德伦格舰能够通过在一个小保护区域内吸引伤害，为其盟友提供更强的防御。

column1: A medium Kilrathi ship, the Grikath is exceptionally tanky, especially to enemies at long range. Its AOE attack will slow enemy weapons. Does more damage to ships in tractor beams.
column2: 一个中型基拉西单位，格里卡思极其坚韧，尤其对抗远距离敌人。其范围攻击会减缓敌方武器，对牵引光束中的单位造成更高伤害。

column1: A medium Kilrathi ship, the Jrathek wields a paralyzing weapon and a tractor beam.
column2: 一个中型基拉西单位，杰拉塞克配备有麻痹武器和牵引光束。

column1: A medium Terran ship, the Scimatar uses a cloaking device to sneak up on enemies, before releasing its fusion gun. Does more damage when it first arrives at a planet
column2: 一个中型人类单位，弯刀使用隐形装置接近敌人后再释放聚变炮，首次抵达行星时造成更高伤害。

column1: A medium Terran ship, the Wraith uses sophisticated hacking techniques to take control of enemy ships and transform them into your minions.
column2: 一个中型人类单位，幽灵使用精密的入侵技术控制敌方单位并将其转化为你的爪牙。

column1: A medium sized ship equipped with a few rocket launchers.
column2: 一个中等大小的单位，配备了几座火箭发射器。

column1: A medium sized ship equipped with a large coilbeam.
column2: 一个中等大小的单位，配备了一门大型线圈光束。

column1: A melee fighter with a weapon-jamming, armor-piercing blade. Dispatched to fight the Dyson Sidekick.
column2: 一名配备武器干扰、穿甲刀刃的近战战斗者。被派遣来对抗戴森盟友。

column1: A metal generator that has been converted for use by the Neinzul. Can be destroyed to restore it to its natural state at the cost of upsetting any Soldiers lying within. Release powerful inhibiting wavelengths.
column2: 一个被奈因祖尔改造后使用的金属发生器。摧毁它可以使其恢复自然状态，但会激怒其中的士兵。它会释放强大的抑制波。

column1: A military funded trade post. Upgraded by Economic and Logistic Command and Metal Generation Tech.
column2: 由军方资助的贸易哨站。可受经济和后勤指挥及金属产出科技升级。

column1: A militia ship, it is carrying materials required to construct a defensive building. Upgraded by Engineering and Medium Tech.
column2: 一艘民兵船，携带着建造防御建筑所需的材料。可受工程和中型科技升级。

column1: A mine designed to blast single targets, with ever so slight area damage.
column2: 一种设计用于爆破单个目标的雷，带有极其轻微的溅射伤害。

column1: A mine designed to blast single targets, with ever so slight area damage. This one costs even less metal.
column2: 一种设计用于爆破单个目标的雷，带有极其轻微的溅射伤害。此型号金属消耗更低。

column1: A mine designed to blast single targets, with ever so slight area damage. This one costs less metal.
column2: 一种设计用于爆破单个目标的雷，带有极其轻微的溅射伤害。此型号金属消耗更低。

column1: A miniature version of a Cluster Bomb.
A minion of the Withered Mummy.
A mix focused on killing big targets. Slow and vulnerable to strikecraft.
column2: 专注于击杀大型目标的混合舰队。速度缓慢，且容易受到战机的攻击。

column1: A mix focusing on suppressing enemies while the rest of the fleet takes out key targets and finish off stragglers.
column2: 这支舰队专注于压制敌人，同时其余单位负责消灭关键目标并清理残余敌军。

column1: A mix hating stealth units and created to find and destroy them.
column2: 这是一支专门针对隐形单位组建的舰队，旨在发现并摧毁它们。

column1: A mix of famous Romans and other Roman names
column2: 著名罗马人和其他罗马名字的混合

column1: A mix of high-damage and long range expensive ships to carry out overwhelming alpha strike. Universally slow reload time and terrible speed encourage quick repositioning while loaded.
column2: 一支由高伤害、远程且昂贵的舰船组成的舰队，可进行压倒性的首轮打击。普遍装填时间长，速度慢，因此装填时需迅速重新定位。

column1: A mix of powerful mostly anti-large ships along with a Target Painter Transport Flagship to crush big targets, intended to use their full potential later in the game.
column2: 混合了强大的反大型单位和一艘目标标记运输旗舰来摧毁大型目标，旨在游戏后期发挥其全部潜力。

column1: A more advanced Hacking Mine, available after extensive drilling of this planet. As with the basic Mine, it can only be built on an AI-owned planet.
column2: 一个更高级的入侵矿场，在此行星进行深度钻探后可用。与基础矿场一样，只能建在AI拥有的行星上。

column1: A more advanced Metal Mine, available after extensive drilling of this planet. As with the basic Mine, it can only be built on an AI-owned planet.
column2: 一个更高级的金属矿场，在此行星进行深度钻探后可用。与基础矿场一样，只能建在AI拥有的行星上。

column1: A more advanced Science Mine, available after extensive drilling of this planet. As with the basic Mine, it can only be built on an AI-owned planet.
column2: 一个更高级的科技矿场，在此行星进行深度钻探后可用。与基础矿场一样，只能建在AI拥有的行星上。

column1: A mortal going down the path of good with great conviction. The Zealot uses melee weaponry that deals bonus damage to armored enemies. Deployed by the Heavenly realm to destroy all evil in the galaxy.
column2: 一名怀着坚定信念走上正义之路的凡人。狂热者使用近战武器，对装甲敌人造成额外伤害。由天堂领域部署，以消灭银河系中的所有邪恶。

column1: A mortal on the brink of ascendance, it uses its own health to regenerate its allies on the brink of death. Deployed by the Heavenly realm to destroy all evil in the galaxy.
column2: 处于升华边缘的凡人，使用自身生命值来再生濒临死亡的盟友。由天堂领域部署，以消灭银河系中的所有邪恶。

column1: A mostly unknown biological energy source, predominantly contained within a species known as Elderlings.
column2: 一种未知的生物能量源，主要存在于被称为长老的物种体内。

column1: A much larger form of a Dyson Sphere, built by a subfaction of the Spire race.
column2: 一种更大规模的戴森球，由尖塔种族的一个分支建造。

column1: A much more simplified AI that is based around the full ensemble, but just... minus the most distressing stuff.
column2: 基于完全编队的极度简化AI版本，移除了最令人困扰的内容。

column1: A multiplier applied to all AIP as it is gained. This is an extreme option but could be used as an overall ai-difficulty adjustment.
column2: 应用于所有获得的AIP的乘数。这是一个极端选项，但可用作整体AI难度调整。

column1: A mutator of the recently birthed Scourge forms, evolving them into a more combat ready form of their main species. High level armories can upgrade units very quickly, or hybridize evolved warriors into terrifying weapons.
column2: 新诞生的Scourge形态的变异器，将它们进化成更适合战斗的主要种族形态。高级军械库可以快速升级单位，或将进化战士杂交成可怕的武器。

column1: A mutator of the recently birthed Scourge forms, evolving them into a more combat ready form of their main species. High level armories can upgrade units very quickly, or hybridize evolved warriors into terrifying weapons.
column2: 新诞生的天灾形态的变异器，将它们进化成更适合战斗的主要种族形态。高级军械库可以快速升级单位，或将进化战士杂交成可怕的武器。

column1: A nasty combination created to hard-counter incursions using raid-like ships. Picking the same starting battlestation twice will randomize the second one.
column2: 一种恶意的组合，专门用于强力反击使用突袭类舰船的入侵。 如果两次选择相同的起始战斗空间站，第二个将随机化。

column1: A neinzul defensive structure. Fires rapid electron pulses with a damage increase against units with low armor.
column2: 一座奈祖尔防御建筑。发射快速电子脉冲，对低装甲单位造成更高伤害。

column1: A neutral object that has been converted for use by the Neinzul. Can be destroyed to restore it to its natural state at the cost of upsetting any Soldiers lying within. Release powerful inhibiting wavelengths.
column2: 一个被奈因祖尔改造后使用的中立物体。摧毁它可以使其恢复自然状态，但会激怒其中的士兵。它会释放强大的抑制波。

column1: A new Instigator base has been constructed.
column2: 一个新的煽动者基地已建造完成。

column1: A new design of the AI that is remorselessly seeking your doom. Makes the game much more challenging if hostile to you.       <color=#f25e1c>HIGH IMPACT:</color> This faction drastically changes how the game will play if enabled as an enemy. Normally, there's not too much time pressure, but the Scourge ramp it up. Their units can be nasty, and tend to require specific solutions.
column2: 一种无情寻求毁灭你的新型AI设计。如果敌对，将使游戏更具挑战性。  <color=#f25e1c>高影响:</color> 如果启用为敌人，这个派系将极大地改变游戏玩法。通常游戏没有太大时间压力，但天灾会加剧这一点。它们的单位可能很棘手，往往需要特定的解决方案。

column1: A new horror unleashed by the AI. Uses acidic weaponry to soften up its targets, then chews them to pieces. Anyone attempting to retaliate against it risks merely empowering its vicious defence system to inflict further carnage.
column2: AI 释放的新恐怖。使用酸性武器软化目标，然后将其撕碎。任何试图反击的人都只会助长其邪恶的防御系统，造成更多屠杀。
一个新的泰利姆已生成。

column1: A newly birthed horrific mishmash of alien races with AI technology.
column2: 一个新诞生的、融合了外星种族与人工智能技术的可怕混合体。

column1: A nimble and tanky ship designed for Anti-Spire warfare. This ship has specially tuned defenses to help deflect the power of the spire beams, and does massive damage to even the tankiest of enemy hulls when it closes with them. Its vampiric sabot in response to ranged attacks has a minimum arming distance.
column2: 一艘灵活且耐打的舰船，专为反尖塔作战设计。该舰船拥有特殊调校的防御，可帮助偏转尖塔光束的威力，并且在接近敌人时，能对最耐打的敌舰造成巨大伤害。其针对远程攻击的吸血破坏装置有最小激活距离。

column1: A nimble but fragile artillery ship for the Architrave that fires its salvos in bursts. It also has a weak phaser that is neutralized by shields of at least 10K energy consumption of its target. Occasionally phases in and out of realspace.
column2: 拱心石阵营的一种灵活但脆弱的火炮舰艇，能进行齐射。它还配备了一门弱相位炮，若目标护盾的能量消耗至少达到 10000，则该相位炮会失效。它偶尔会在现实空间中进出相位。

column1: A nimble but fragile artillery ship for the Architrave that fires its salvos in bursts. It also has a weak phaser that is neutralized by shields of at least 10K energy consumption of its target. Occasionally phases in and out of realspace.
column2: 拱门使团中一艘灵巧但脆弱的炮舰，以爆发方式齐射。它还拥有一门微弱的相位炮，会被目标至少1万能量消耗的护盾所抵消。偶尔会进出现实空间进行相位移动。
一艘普通的长矛护卫舰。

column1: A number of Neinzul have started corrupting the resources of this galaxy, and begun to spread. Largely ignored by the AI for the moment, they will be competing with you for control over your resources. They appear to be relatively peaceful if left alone, but their hives actively inhibit the abilities of any ships within their territory.  If left alone and allowed to propagate in your territory, you may find yourself a new ally, albeit a very clingy one that greatly inhibits your regular economic power. Be wary to not allow them to cripple you while you're not looking.  <color=#f25e1c>VARIABLE IMPACT:</color> This faction works by claiming (and in some cases stealing) resources that are normally yours. They can be exceptionally sticky and hard to remove once ingrained in a sector of the galaxy.  If you only have one Wild Hives faction, they will otherwise be passive unless you attack them, leading to an overall Moderate impact.  If you have multiple instances of this faction however, they will actively compete with one another for resources, and will be much more aggressive. Rival Hives on the same planet will become aggressive, lashing out at not only each other, but at any ships that get in the way of their dispute.
column2: 一些奈因祖尔已经开始腐蚀这个星系的资源，并开始扩散。目前AI基本忽略它们，但它们将与你争夺资源控制权。如果不被打扰，它们看起来相对和平，但它们的蜂巢会积极抑制其领地内任何舰船的能力。  如果任其在你的领地内繁殖，你可能会得到一个新的盟友，尽管这个盟友非常黏人，会极大地抑制你的常规经济实力。要小心，不要让它们在你不注意的时候削弱你。  <color=#f25e1c>可变影响：</color> 这个派系通过宣称（在某些情况下是窃取）原本属于你的资源来运作。一旦在星系的某个区域扎根，它们就会异常顽固，很难清除。  如果你只有一个野生蜂巢派系，除非你攻击它们，否则它们会保持被动，总体影响为中等。  然而，如果你有多个这个派系的实例，它们将积极地相互竞争资源，并且会更具攻击性。同一行星上的敌对蜂巢会变得具有攻击性，不仅会互相攻击，还会攻击任何妨碍它们争端的舰船。

column1: A number of races have joined humanity to fight against the AI. Elements of the Templar, Zenith, Spire and Neinzul are united in this goal.  They hope to eventually build a dyson sphere, by using drills to ravage planets to get raw materials.  The AI will be joined by powerful Necromantic Reapers to oppose you.  You can check your economic status by clicking on the Metal symbol in the Resource Bar. There are many other Gameplay suggestions and explanations in the Tips Sidebar.
column2: 多个种族已加入人类共同对抗AI。圣殿骑士、天顶、尖塔和奈祖尔的成员为了这一目标团结在一起。  他们希望最终建造一个戴森球，通过使用钻机掠夺行星来获取原材料。  强大的死灵收割者将与AI联手对抗你。  你可以点击资源栏中的金属符号来查看经济状况。提示侧边栏中还有许多其他游戏建议和说明。

column1: A particularly resilient fleet adept at holding large forces at bay without prompting counterattacks.
column2: 一支特专精防御的舰队，擅长在不引发反击的情况下抵挡大量敌军。

column1: A particularly virulent Wight in drone form, able to spread necromancy to many targets with each attack.
column2: 一种特别致命的无人机形态尸鬼，每次攻击都能将死灵法术传播给多个目标。

column1: A pervasive fungus-like growth seems to collect on everything here. Maybe avoid the big spore pods when they burst.
column2: 一种普遍的菌类生长物似乎附着在这里的一切上。也许要避开那些破裂时的大型孢子荚。

column1: A place where spineful warriors roam. Houses a Skeleton Captain and sometimes causes Skeletons to appear.
column2: 一处充满勇猛战士的地方。容纳了一名骷髅领主，有时会引发骷髅出现。

column1: A player only set of units, larger and more powerful than Destroyers but can fills up the Elite slot in a fleet. Also contains anything they spawn.
column2: 仅玩家可用的一组单位，比驱逐舰更大、更强大，但会占据舰队中的精英槽位。还包括它们所生成的任何单位。

column1: A player only set of units, larger and more powerful than Frigates but can fills up the Elite slot in a fleet. Also contains anything they spawn.
column2: 仅玩家可用的一组单位，比护卫舰更大、更强大，但会占据舰队中的精英槽位。还包括它们所生成的任何单位。

column1: A poorly armored guardian with deadly corrosive blasts that dissolve the hulls of their foes. On death, spawns copies of itself that will spray nearby enemies with acid.
column2: 一个装甲薄弱的守护者，拥有致命的腐蚀爆炸可溶解敌方船体。死亡时生成自身复制体向附近敌人喷洒酸液。

column1: A poorly armored guardian, who makes up for their lack of damage with deadly corrosive blasts that dissolve the hulls of their foes. On death, sprays nearby ships with a final corrosive blast.
column2: 一个装甲薄弱的守卫，用致命的腐蚀爆炸弥补伤害不足，溶解敌人的船体。死亡时，向附近单位喷射最后的腐蚀爆炸。

column1: A poorly armored guardian, who makes up for their lack of damage with deadly corrosive blasts that dissolve the hulls of their foes. On death, sprays nearby ships with a final corrosive blast.
column2: 一名护甲薄弱的守护者，用致命的腐蚀冲击弥补其伤害不足，这种冲击能溶解敌人的船体。死亡时，会向附近的船只喷射最后的腐蚀冲击。

column1: A potent Protector, built using advanced Ambush technology. This ship is an expert at taking down any forces that have recently arrived on its planet.
column2: 强大的保护者，使用先进的伏击技术建造。该舰善于消灭最近抵达所在行星的一切部队。

column1: A potent Protector, built using advanced Concussion technology. This ship is an expert at dividing enemy forces with powerful AOE knockback, and shredding low armor targets.
column2: 强大的保护者，使用先进的震荡技术建造。该舰擅长用强力范围击退来分散敌军，并粉碎低装甲目标。

column1: A potent Protector, built using advanced Disruptive technology. This ship is the ultimate in protecting its allies with powerful debuffs, a potent forcefield, and self healing.
column2: 强大的保护者，使用先进的干扰技术建造。该舰以其强力减益效果、坚固力场和自愈能力成为保护盟友的终极利器。

column1: A potent Protector, built using advanced Fusion technology. This ship is an expert at taking down large hostiles.
column2: 强大的保护者，使用先进的聚变技术建造。该舰善于摧毁大型敌方单位。

column1: A potent Protector, built using advanced Generalist technology. This ship provides a large radius gravity generator and powerful rapid fire sniper shots.
column2: 强大的保护者，使用先进的通用技术建造。该舰提供广域重力发生器以及强力速射狙击弹。

column1: A potent Protector, built using advanced Melee technology. This ship is a slow moving and durable ship that can tractor an incredible number of enemy targets.
column2: 强大的保护者，使用先进的近战技术建造。该舰移动缓慢但极其坚固，能牵引数量惊人的敌方目标。

column1: A potent Protector, built using advanced Raid technology. This ship is excellent at taking down weaker ships to fuel its rampage.
column2: 强大的保护者，使用先进的突袭技术建造。该舰善于击杀较弱单位以激发其狂怒。

column1: A potent Protector, built using advanced Splash technology. This ship fires off a barrage of slow moving grenades at hostile forces.
column2: 强大的保护者，使用先进的溅射技术建造。该舰向敌方部队发射一连串缓慢移动的手榴弹。

column1: A potent Protector, built using advanced Subterfuge technology. This ship is capable of rapidly vaporizing moving ships and paralyzing the rest.
column2: 强大的保护者，使用先进的诡计技术建造。该舰能够快速蒸发移动中的单位并瘫痪其余的。

column2: 强大的保护者，使用先进的科技技术建造。该舰生成诱饵无人机，加速所在行星上的友军单位，并提供全行星范围的快子覆盖。

column1: A potent mix about deploying turrets for every increasing effects. The acid turrets will boost damage against its targets and Makeshift provides a swarm of explosive drones. Best used for mobile offense, with swarmers fleets. Picking the same starting battlestation twice will randomize the second one.
column2: 一种强大的组合，旨在部署炮塔以获得不断增强的效果。酸液炮塔将提升对目标的伤害，临时炮塔则会提供一群爆炸无人机。最适合与集群舰队配合进行机动作战。 如果两次选择相同的起始战斗空间站，第二个将随机化。

column1: A powerful Templar destroyer, the Grand Master wrangles large craft with a reverse tractor beam to optimize its focused battlecannons for disgusting damage.
column2: 圣殿骑士的强大驱逐舰，大团长号利用反向牵引光束控制大型舰船，以优化其聚焦战斗炮，造成巨大伤害。

column1: A powerful Templar destroyer, the Grand Master wrangles large craft with a reverse tractor beam to optimize its focused battlecannons for disgusting damage. Adapted for general purpose AI use.
column2: 大导师舰是一艘强大的圣殿骑士驱逐舰，它使用反向牵引光束控制大型舰船，从而让其聚焦的战列炮发挥出惊人的伤害。已针对通用 AI 使用进行了适配。

column1: A powerful fleet of an Amplifier Battleship which boosts all friendly units on the planet with damage and speed including itself, and a Lightshow Cruiser elevated to incredible power levels by the amplification.

column1: A powerful fleet of an Amplifier Battleship which boosts all friendly units on the planet with damage and speed including itself, and a Lightshow Cruiser elevated to incredible power levels by the amplification. This fleet is full of faction-upgraded ships.

column1: A powerful manifestation of the Dark Spire's Rage at all life.
column2: 黑暗尖塔对所有生命的愤怒的强大体现。

column2: 一具强大的木乃伊被死灵法术召唤而出。不在大墓地时会随时间缓慢损耗，但它可以通过吞噬敌人的灵魂来维持自身。它能用牵引场捕获船只以供后续吞噬，也能用死亡凝视击杀敌人。

column2: 一台强大的炮塔，专为远距离对付大量单位而建。

column2: 一座用于击败敌人最强单位的强力炮塔。此炮塔擅长消灭大型重装甲目标。其主武器是极化武器，对越厚重的装甲造成越高伤害。

column2: 一座强大的炮塔，用于阻止对黑暗天顶的攻击。

Its primary weapon is polarized to do increasing damage to thicker armor. The turret itself fires salvos of missiles that specialize in taking out units caught in the net.
