column2: 一座为抵御对戴森盟友的攻击而建的强大炮塔，配备两件强力武器分别对付有护盾和有装甲的敌人。 处于相位状态时，偏好使用斩首光束对付受伤单位。

column1: A powerful turret built to dissuade attacks against the Dyson Sidekick, armed with a long-range mass driver that turns its target's mass into a liability. It periodically launches phasion seeker bombs to phase out groups of ships, regardless if they have active shields.
column2: 一座强大的炮塔，用于劝阻对戴森伙伴的攻击，配备远程质射手，将目标的质量转化为其累赘。它会定期发射相位追踪炸弹，将成群的舰船相位化，无论它们是否拥有激活的护盾。

column1: A powerful turret built to dissuade attacks against the Dyson Sidekick.
column2: 一座为抵御对戴森盟友的攻击而建的强大炮塔。

column1: A powerful turret made to inflict heavy damage on enemies with large hulls.
column2: 一台强大的炮塔，旨在对拥有大船体的敌人造成沉重伤害。

column1: A powerful yet fragile fleet specializing in long range bombardment.
column2: 一支强大但脆弱的舰队，专精于远程轰炸。

column1: A powerful, long ranged defensive structure for the Armada to ward off enemies. Orbits the planet, based on the position of its placement. Deals more damage the further it is from its targets. Uses a crazy beam.
column2: 一座为无敌舰队抵御敌人的强大远程防御建筑。根据放置位置绕行行星。距离目标越远造成的伤害越高。使用一门疯狂的光束炮。

column1: A powerful, long ranged defensive structure for the Dyson to ward off enemies. Orbits the planet, based on the position of its placement. Deals more damage the further it is from its targets.
column2: 一座为戴森抵御敌人的强大远程防御建筑。根据放置位置绕行行星。距离目标越远造成的伤害越高。

column1: A powerful, long ranged defensive structure for the Dyson to ward off enemies. Orbits the planet, based on the position of its placement. Deals more damage the further it is from its targets. Uses a crazy beam.
column2: 一座为戴森抵御敌人的强大远程防御建筑。根据放置位置绕行行星。距离目标越远造成的伤害越高。使用一种疯狂的光束。

column1: A powerful, long ranged defensive structure for the Dyson to ward off enemies. Orbits the planet, based on the position of its placement. Deals more damage the further it is from its targets. Uses powerful rockets.
column2: 一座为戴森抵御敌人的强大远程防御建筑。根据放置位置绕行行星。距离目标越远造成的伤害越高。使用强力火箭。

column1: A powerful, long ranged defensive structure for the Necromancer to ward off enemies. Orbits the planet, based on the position of its placement. Deals more damage the further it is from its targets.
column2: 死灵法师用来抵御敌人的强大远程防御建筑。根据放置位置绕行星轨道运行。与目标距离越远，造成的伤害越高。

column1: A rally point for the Warden Fleet. The Warden Fleet waits at a base before it sets out to defend the AI.  <color=#f25e1c>IF DESTROYED:</color> The Warden's response near this planet is delayed, but <color=#ffa1a1>its budget is not reduced</color>.
column2: 守卫舰队的集结点。守卫舰队会在基地待命，直到出发防御 AI。摧毁此基地会延迟其响应时间，并削弱其增援能力。

column1: A rapid response fleet that can chase down nearly anything.
column2: 一支可以追击几乎任何目标的快速响应舰队。

column1: A relatively large collection of Neinzul that have found their way to our galaxy have fractured due to disagreements, each new small force reaching out to potential allies.  While no longer collectively strong, they will show undying loyalty to any that accept them.  <color=#f25e1c>MEDIUM IMPACT:</color> Enabling this faction causes a number of Neinzul to join in as allies to you, allies to the AI, and allies to minor faction teams.  These Neinzul act as a very potent mobile addition to any team they manage to join, and may potentially cover what would normally be a weakness.
column2: 一群规模较大的奈因祖尔来到了我们的星系，却因内部分歧而分裂，每一支新的小部队都在寻找潜在的盟友。  虽然它们不再像以前那样强大，但会对接纳它们的任何一方表现出坚定不移的忠诚。  <color=#f25e1c>中等影响：</color>启用这个派系会让一些奈因祖尔加入你的阵营、AI阵营以及小型派系队伍。  这些奈因祖尔对它们加入的任何队伍来说都是一股强大的机动力量，有可能弥补原本的弱点。

column1: A relatively tanky ship that creates drones to attack hostiles. Held together by spit, duct tape, and dreams of a future free from the AI.
column2: 一艘相对耐打的舰船，可制造无人机攻击敌人。全靠唾沫、胶带，以及对摆脱AI之未来的梦想勉强维持。

column1: A remnant of the human civil war. A fleet of corvettes used to escort larger starships. This fleet specializes in anti-air combat against fighter and bomber swarms.
column2: 人类内战的残余。一支用于护卫大型星舰的护卫艇舰队。该舰队专精于对抗战斗机和轰炸机群的防空作战。

column1: A replenishing minefield that orbit orbs of entropy, destroying ships caught in the orbs' tractor beams.
column2: 一个可补充的雷区，环绕熵之球，摧毁被困在球体牵引光束中的舰船。

column1: A repository of Dark Zenith knowledge.

A representative of the Cyborg Council for Galactic Peace, this fringe movement seeks the ultimate integration of biological and artificial intelligence. The ambassador will establish an armistice on the gravity well it is present, but such peace will last only as long as its presence to maintain it.
column2: 银河和平赛博理事会的代表，这个边缘组织寻求生物智能与人工智能的终极融合。大使会在其所在的引力井建立停火协议，但这种和平只有在其存在期间才能维持。

column1: A research laboratory aiming to make more with less, its crew works tirelessly to send new processes and machines every 5 minutes through which the command center can produce more troops in the same amount of time.
column2: 一个旨在事半功倍的研究实验室，其工作人员不知疲倦地每5分钟发送新流程和机器，使指挥中心能在相同时间内生产更多部队。

column1: A reservoir of Corbomite has been generated from the AI's energy waves.
column2: 一处科波麦特储库已由AI的能量波生成。

column1: A scientific masterpiece from the Skylaxian people, it acts as a mobile Federation Shipyard, and revives allies on its planets. Slowly regenerates its hull.
column2: 斯凯拉克斯人的科学杰作，充当移动联邦船坞，在其行星上复活盟友。缓慢恢复船体。

column1: A search and rescue nanomachine factory loosed by an Orchid Ark. These can save allied ships teleported to them and repaired at the expense of the spore.
column2: 由兰花方舟释放的搜救纳米机器工厂。可以消耗自身来传送并修复盟军单位。

column1: A selection of less than brave fleet names. (Created by StarKelp)
column2: 一些不太勇敢的舰队名称。（由 StarKelp 创建）

column1: A semi-fractal map type using squares
column2: 一种使用方块的半分形地图

column1: A shattered world. Fragments and dust have caused heavy Kessler Syndrome, halving the damage anything can do here.
column2: 一个破碎的世界。碎片和尘埃造成了严重的凯斯勒综合征，使这里任何造成的伤害减半。

column1: A short lived Neinzul structure that is slowly growing Clanlings inside itself. Releases Younglings in response to attacks on this planet.
column2: 一种短暂存在的内因祖尔结构，内部正在缓慢孕育氏族幼体。受到对该行星的攻击时会释放幼体。

column1: A short lived decoy that attracts fire away from its host.
column2: 短命的诱饵护卫舰，用于吸引敌方火力。

column1: A short lived decoy with minimal damage that attracts fire away from allied units and tractor beams enemies..
column2: 一个短命的诱饵，伤害极小，吸引火力远离友军单位并用牵引光束拉住敌人。

column1: A short lived decoy with minimal damage that attracts fire away from allied units. Its main gun pierces shields.
column2: 一个短命的诱饵，伤害极小，吸引火力远离友军单位。其主炮穿透护盾。

column1: A siege machine created by the Tempest cruiser. It will deplete itself after exhausting its ammunition, but will do incredible damage to structures, especially to the more massive structures like forts.
column2: 由风暴巡洋舰制造的攻城器械。弹药耗尽后它将自毁，但会对建筑造成巨大伤害，尤其是像堡垒这类更大型的建筑。

column1: A slow and very tanky ship used by the Architrave as a damage sink in battle. Enhanced with spire coilbeam technology
column2: 拱心石在战斗中用作伤害吸收的慢速且极为耐打的舰船。采用尖塔线圈光束技术进行了强化

column1: A slow and very tanky ship used by the Architrave as a damage sink in battle. Its hardened hull allows it to shrug off otherwise lethal damage, and its reactive weapon will retaliate on its attackers. Especially dangerous to those with a high energy usage.
column2: 克鲁佩拉里战舰是天顶拱心石在战斗中用作伤害吸收的慢速且极为耐打的舰船。其坚固的船体使其能够抵御原本致命的伤害，并且它的反击武器会对攻击者进行报复。对高能量消耗的目标尤其危险。

column1: A slow construct that seeks groups of enemies to release its starburst-pattern beam weapon, strategically released by the Radiant Cruiser.
column2: 一种行动缓慢的造物，它会寻找成群的敌人，释放其星爆模式的光束武器，由辐射巡洋舰策略性地释放。

column1: A slow moving high firepower destroyer tasked with defending the system.
column2: 移动缓慢、火力强大的驱逐舰，负责防御星系。

column1: A slow moving juggernaut with strong shields and stronger weapons.
column2: 缓慢移动的重型战舰，拥有坚固的护盾和更强的武器。

column1: A slow moving ship of immense durability and self healing properties.
column2: 一个移动缓慢但拥有巨大耐久和自愈能力的单位。

column1: A slow, cloaked ship that passes forcefields unimpeded. Metabolizes enemies, converting their scrap metal into salvage.
column2: 一艘速度缓慢、带有隐形装置的舰船，能够不受阻碍地穿过力场。它能吞噬敌人，将敌人的废金属转化为可回收资源。

column1: A small black hole, powered by some new AI gravity-reflection technology, can make a large enough gravity well to trigger a new wormhole to a star. If you are able to destroy the Projector then the new wormhole will destabilize over time and then vanish.
column2: 一个小型黑洞，由AI的新型重力反射技术驱动，可制造足够大的重力井以生成新的恒星虫洞。如果你能摧毁投影仪，新虫洞会逐渐失稳并最终消失。

column1: A small black hole, powered by some new AI gravity-reflection technology. It has been badly damaged and the gravity well has destabilized. The wormhole it created will be destroyed soon.
column2: 一个小型黑洞，由AI的新型重力反射技术驱动。它已严重受损，重力井已失稳，其生成的虫洞即将消失。

column1: A small gathering of people working for the betternment of their village. Barely noticeable.
column2: 一小群人为了村庄的繁荣而劳作。几乎不被注意。

column1: A small group of traitorous Dark Zenith wish to betray the Dark Alliance and join existing factions in this galaxy. If summoned, they start with but a single structure on an allied planet. However, if given time to get their economy going, they can still become a juggernaut.  <color=#f25e1c>Variable Impact:</color> They require a lot of protection in the early game but can become very powerful once established.
column2: 一小群叛逆的黑暗天顶势力想要背叛黑暗联盟，加入星系中的现有派系。如果被召唤，他们最初只会在一个盟友行星上拥有一座建筑。然而，如果给他们时间发展经济，他们仍然可以变得非常强大。  <color=#f25e1c>影响不定:</color> 他们在游戏早期需要大量保护，但一旦站稳脚跟，就会变得非常强大。

column1: A small modified carrier guardian that can spawn a large number of minor reinforcement warp gates, each increasing the planetary reinforcement yield.
column2: 一种小型改装航母守护者，可以生成大量小型增援跃迁门，每个都会提升行星增援产量。

column1: A small number of Combat Engineers that can go anywhere you please, enemy planets or otherwise -- plus a mobile factory with structure disabling drones that you can take with you even deep into enemy territory... that also speeds up allied ships when it is around!
column2: 少量战斗工程师可以前往任何你想去的地方，包括敌方行星。此外，还有一个配备结构瘫痪无人机的移动工厂，即使深入敌方领土也能随行。当它在场时，还能加速友方单位！

column1: A smaller form of a Dyson Sphere, built by a subfaction of the Spire race.
column2: 由尖塔种族的一个分支建造的小型戴森球。

column1: A smaller number of Combat Engineers that can go anywhere you please, enemy planets or otherwise -- plus a Mobile Factory that produces rescue beacons to save ships from destruction!
column2: 较少数量的战斗工程师，可以前往任何你想要的地方，包括敌方行星——加上一座生产救援信标拯救单位免遭摧毁的移动工厂！

column1: A smarter Warden with no fixed bases.  <color=#f25e1c>Warden Rallying:</color> Positions itself dynamically on or near the planets it thinks you are likely to attack. Higher Warden difficulties are smarter.  <color=#f25e1c>Strategy::</color> It has no Warden Fleet Bases, so <color=#ffa1a1>there is nothing to raid to slow its response</color>.
column2: 对标准行为的升级，监守舰队会根据其难度级别使用情报来预测并在它认为你可能会攻击的行星（或附近）进行部署。更高的监守难度级别会使其更加智能。

column1: A sniper for planetary defense reclaimed from downed enemies.
column2: 从被击落的敌人回收的行星防御狙击手。

column1: A source of fuel for the Xodian megaships. Without it their power is greatly reduced.
column2: 克赛迪安巨型单位的燃料来源。没有它，它们的力量会大大减弱。

column1: A source of utility for the Dark Zenith, the skald can phase out enemies for a short duration so they are unable to engage in combat.
column2: 作为黑暗天顶的实用舰船，斯卡尔德可以让敌人在短时间内相位消失，使其无法参与战斗。

column1: A source of utility for the Dark Zenith, the skald can phase out enemies for a short duration so they are unable to engage in combat. This enraged variant has an additional weapon that gets stronger as the dregil gets closer to death.
column2: 司卡尔德是黑暗天顶的实用单位，能让敌人短时间内脱离战斗。这个愤怒变体有一件额外的武器，随着司卡尔德生命值降低而变强。

column1: A source of utility for the Dark Zenith, the skald can phase out enemies for a short duration so they are unable to engage in combat. This fortified variant is hardened to resist damage that would otherwise kill it.
column2: 司卡尔德是黑暗天顶的实用单位，能让敌人短时间内脱离战斗。这个强化变体经过加固，能抵御原本致命的伤害。

column1: A source of utility for the Dark Zenith, the skald can phase out enemies for a short duration so they are unable to engage in combat. This sinister variant has an additional crowd-control weapon that paralyzes enemies.
column2: 司卡尔德是黑暗天顶的实用单位，能让敌人短时间内脱离战斗。这个邪恶变体有一件额外的群体控制武器，能麻痹敌人。

column1: A source of utility for the Dark Zenith, the skald can phase out enemies for a short duration so they are unable to engage in combat. This spirited variant is cloaked.
column2: 司卡尔德是黑暗天顶的实用单位，能让敌人短时间内脱离战斗。这个灵动变体处于隐形状态。

column1: A source of utility for the Dark Zenith, the skald can phase out enemies for a short duration so they are unable to engage in combat. This stout variant is more durable than usual.
column2: 司卡尔德是黑暗天顶的实用单位，能让敌人短时间内脱离战斗。这个坚固变体比平时更耐用。

column1: A special-purpose fleet of an Missile Submarine which demolishes large enemies and can change its state of matter, and Mine Destroyers which spam mines wherever they go, killing all types of enemies alike.
column2: 一支特殊用途的舰队，由导弹潜艇组成，可摧毁大型敌人并改变自身物态；地雷驱逐舰走到哪里就到处布雷，一视同仁地杀伤各类敌人。

column1: A special-purpose fleet of an Missile Submarine which demolishes large enemies and can change its state of matter, and Mine Destroyers which spam mines wherever they go, killing all types of enemies alike. This fleet is full of faction-upgraded ships.
column2: 一支特殊用途的舰队，由导弹潜艇组成，可摧毁大型敌人并改变自身物态；地雷驱逐舰走到哪里就到处布雷，一视同仁地杀伤各类敌人。  此舰队满载派系升级过的舰船。

column1: A special-purpose fleet of an Missile Submarine which demolishes large enemies and can change its state of matter, and Mine Destroyers which spam mines wherever they go, killing all types of enemies alike. This fleet is full of upgraded ships.
column2: 一支特殊用途的舰队，由导弹潜艇组成，可摧毁大型敌人并改变自身物态；地雷驱逐舰走到哪里就到处布雷，一视同仁地杀伤各类敌人。  此舰队满载升级过的舰船。

column1: A specialized combination ironically using Core technology. Small or large, cloaked and not. This has a response to (most) things. Don't expect exotic effects however. Picking the same starting battlestation twice will randomize the second one.
column2: 一种具有讽刺意味地使用核心技术的专业组合。无论敌人是小型还是大型，隐形还是非隐形，这种组合都能（在大多数情况下）应对。不过别指望有奇特的效果。 如果两次选择相同的起始战斗空间站，第二个将随机化。

column1: A spire defensive structure. Has lasers.
column2: 一座尖塔防御建筑。配备激光。

column1: A starting variant of the often found raid-only battlestation laying around the Milky Way. This mono-focused build has more turrets than usual and is powerful on the offense. Cheap and fast to deploy but too overspecialized. Picking the same starting battlestation twice will randomize the second one.
column2: 银河系中常见的仅用于突袭的战斗空间站的起始变体。这种单一专注的配置拥有比平常更多的炮塔，在进攻方面非常强大。部署成本低且速度快，但过于专精。 如果两次选择相同的起始战斗空间站，第二个将随机化。

column1: A strange mix of Spire and AI technology with the Marauders.
column2: 一种融合了尖塔和AI技术的奇特掠夺者舰船。

column1: A strange spire structure, chipped off from a Crystalium. Scrap this to activate it, antagonizing all Chromatic Spire in the galaxy, who will stop at nothing to destroy it.
column2: 一种奇特的尖塔结构，从水晶体上脱落下来。拆解它以激活它，这将激怒银河系中所有的彩色尖塔，它们会不择手段地摧毁它。

column1: A strange spire structure, chipped off from a Crystalium. The very existence of this active structure has antagonized all Chromatic Spire in the galaxy, and they will stop at nothing to destroy this.
column2: 一种奇特的尖塔结构，从水晶体上脱落下来。这个激活结构的存在激怒了银河系中所有的彩色尖塔，它们会不择手段地摧毁它。

column1: A strong Dark Zenith ship made exclusively by Pirate Epistyles. It rushes into battle in a bloodlust, striking with such force that it damages itself with its recklessness.
column2: 一艘强大的黑暗天顶飞船，仅由海盗柱顶过梁建造。它会带着杀戮的欲望冲入战场，攻击力度之大，因其鲁莽而自损。

column1: A strong Necromancer minion, summoned by necromancy. Damages those who dare to fire upon it. Attritions slowly over time (more slowly at a Necropolis).
column2: 一名强大的死灵法师爪牙，通过死灵法术召唤而来。会对敢于向它开火的敌人造成伤害。会随着时间缓慢损耗（在大墓地损耗更慢）。

column1: A strong Necromancer minion, summoned by necromancy. Wields a laser to powerful effect.
column2: 一名强大的死灵法师爪牙，通过死灵法术召唤而来。能强力使用激光。

column1: A strong Necromancer minion, summoned by necromancy. Will decay into a regular Wight after enough time in combat. Damages those who dare to fire upon it, bypassing shields partially. Revives itself once.
column2: 一名强大的死灵法师爪牙，通过死灵法术召唤而来。在战斗一段时间后会衰变为普通食尸鬼。会对敢于向它开火的敌人造成伤害，部分无视护盾。能复活一次。

column1: A strong Necromancer minion, summoned by necromancy. Will decay into a regular Wight after enough time in combat. Emits unholy lightning around itself to victims caught in tractors. When it dies it explodes violently to damage up to 20 nearby enemy units.     The explosion damage done to each victim starts at half the strength of the Spectral Wight's normal shot, but increases with the charge the ship has accumulated, up to a maximum of 10 times the strength of its main weapon.
column2: 一名强大的死灵法师爪牙，通过死灵法术召唤而来。在战斗一段时间后会衰变为普通食尸鬼。会向被牵引光束捕获的受害者发射不洁闪电。当它死亡时，会剧烈爆炸，对最多20个附近的敌方单位造成伤害。     爆炸对每个受害者造成的伤害起始于幽灵食尸鬼普通攻击伤害的一半，但会随着舰船积累的能量而增加，最多可达其主武器伤害的10倍。

column1: A strong Necromancer minion, summoned by necromancy. Will decay into a regular Wight after enough time in combat. Periodic, high single target damage, especially very massive targets, but harms itself on firing. Upon destruction, a now free from torture Wight is created.
column2: 一名强大的死灵法师爪牙，通过死灵法术召唤而来。在战斗一段时间后会衰变为普通食尸鬼。能进行周期性的高额单体伤害攻击，尤其是对非常巨大的目标，但开火时会伤害自身。被摧毁后，会产生一个摆脱折磨的食尸鬼。

column2: 一座强力的尖塔防御建筑，对高质量单位有效。

column2: 一座强力的尖塔防御建筑。对个人护盾效果良好。

column1: A structure built to mimic the Spheres we have seen throughout the galaxy, it is filled with humanity's weapons inside of its secure outer shell, and imbued with excess Dark Spire energy that our scientists have converted to allow it to fire at Sphere collectors.  Acts as a regular defensive structure when built on a planet without a Dark Spire Derelict.
column2: 这种结构模仿了我们在银河系各处看到的球体，其安全外壳内装有人类武器，并注入了我们的科学家已转化的过量黑暗尖塔能量，使其能够向球体收集者开火。  当建造在没有黑暗尖塔残骸的行星上时，它作为常规防御结构运作。

column1: A sturdy Citadel that gets stronger the longer it stays on a planet.

column1: A substance that seemingly defies a number of laws of nature. Up to a saturation point it absorbs the energy from all sources, and directing the energy released when saturated releases pure kinetic energy. The Civilian Industry can use this material to create Raid-tech ships and turrets.
column2: 一种似乎违反多项自然法则的物质。在达到饱和点之前它能吸收所有来源的能量，饱和后引导释放的能量则是纯粹的动能。民用工业可用此材料制造突袭科技单位和炮塔。

column1: A superior Eques, with all of its strengths but even more durable and destructive. Beware its phasion bombs and anti-engine weapons.
column2: 一种更高级的埃奎斯战舰，继承了埃奎斯的所有优势，并且更加耐用和具有破坏力。警惕它的相位炸弹和反引擎武器。

column1: A superior Eques, with all of its strengths but even more durable and destructive. Beware its phasion bombs and anti-engine weapons.

column2: 一个坚韧的低阶黑暗天顶单位。在一个小的保护区域内吸引伤害到自身，并将一部分伤害返还给攻击者。这个愤怒变体拥有一个额外的武器，随着哈斯卡尔接近死亡而变得更强。

column1: A tanky low-tier Dark Zenith unit. Attracts damage towards itself in a small zone of protection, and it returns a portion of this damage back to sender. This fortified variant is hardened to resist damage that would otherwise kill it.
column2: 一个坚韧的低阶黑暗天顶单位。在一个小的保护区域内吸引伤害到自身，并将一部分伤害返还给攻击者。这个强化变体经过加固，能够抵御原本会致命的伤害。

column1: A tanky low-tier Dark Zenith unit. Attracts damage towards itself in a small zone of protection, and it returns a portion of this damage back to sender. This sinister variant has an additional crowd-control weapon that paralyzes enemies.
column2: 一个坚韧的低阶黑暗天顶单位。在一个小的保护区域内吸引伤害到自身，并将一部分伤害返还给攻击者。这个邪恶变体拥有一个额外的群体控制武器，可以麻痹敌人。

column1: A tanky low-tier Dark Zenith unit. Attracts damage towards itself in a small zone of protection, and it returns a portion of this damage back to sender. This spirited variant is cloaked.
column2: 一个坚韧的低阶黑暗天顶单位。在一个小的保护区域内吸引伤害到自身，并将一部分伤害返还给攻击者。这个灵动变体处于隐形状态。

column1: A tanky, short-ranged defensive structure for the Dyson to ward off enemies. Damage output is substantially enhanced for every other Lightning Tower active on planet.
column2: 一座为戴森抵御敌人的耐打近程防御建筑。行星上每多一座激活的闪电塔，其伤害输出都会大幅提升。

column1: A tanky, short-ranged defensive structure for the Necromancer to ward off enemies. Damage output is substantially enhanced for every other Lightning Tower active on planet.
column2: 死灵法师的一种耐打、短程防御建筑，用于抵御敌人。行星上每多一座激活的闪电塔，其伤害输出都会大幅提升。

column1: A terrifying Ravager will fly to an un-ravaged planet and transform all its resources into powerful ships for the Reapers. The Reapers will get a lot of ships from an active Ravager, so you want to kill them quickly if you can.  Once the planet is ravaged, the Ravager will become Mobile again and fly away to new planets to Ravage them.
column2: 一只可怕的劫掠者将飞往未被掠夺的行星，将其所有资源转化为收割者的强大单位。收割者将从活跃的劫掠者那里获得大量单位，所以如果可以的话，你需要尽快杀死它们。  一旦行星被掠夺，劫掠者将再次变为移动状态，飞往新的行星进行掠夺。

column1: A terrifying manifestation of the Dark Spire's Rage at all life.
column2: 黑暗尖塔对所有生命的愤怒的恐怖体现。

column1: A terrifying manifestation of the Dark Spire's Rage at all life... now sold by the Zenith Trader. The Trader won't sell you this if you already have two in the galaxy.
column2: 黑暗尖塔对所有生命的愤怒的恐怖体现...现在由顶点商人出售。如果你在银河系中已经拥有两个，商人将不会再卖给你。

column1: A tough mix of ships with a frigate capable of disabling enemies turrets. Its Porcupine ships can inflict extreme damage, but are very fragile.
column2: 这是一支强悍的单位组合，其中一艘护卫舰能够瘫痪敌方炮塔。其箭猪级单位能造成巨大伤害，但十分脆弱。

column1: A tractor net designed to capture smaller ships and punish their attempt to free themselves by reflecting their attacks.
column2: 一种牵引网，旨在捕获小型舰船，并通过反射攻击来惩罚它们试图挣脱的行为。

column1: A transforming creation of the Lockdown Cruiser. While the enemy strength is greater than ours, this 'Deadlock' form will be active. Power is distributed to its impressive weapon, its shields, and its engine.
column2: 封锁巡洋舰的变形形态。当敌方实力强于我方时，这种“僵局者”形态将被激活。能量将分配给其强大的武器、护盾和引擎。

column1: A transforming creation of the Lockdown Cruiser. While the enemy strength is lower than ours, this 'Gridlock' form will be active. All power is diverted from weapons, shields, and the engine to power its gravitational core, which can slow enemies across the gravity well, as well as a minor blackhole generator that can prevent the enemy from fleeing through wormholes.
column2: 封锁巡洋舰的变形形态。当敌方实力弱于我方时，这种“锁定者”形态将被激活。所有能量将从武器、护盾和引擎转移，用于驱动其引力核心，该核心可以在引力场内减缓敌人的速度，同时还有一个小型黑洞发生器，可阻止敌人通过虫洞逃脱。

column1: A turret built to quickly dispatch those who cannot espace fate. Useful in tandem with tractors, but otherwise often found lacking.

column1: AJEA (Auto-Juggle Energy Assistant) is a sort of 'smart grid' for AIW2. If your net energy is lower than the amount specified below AJEA will automatically build more Matter Converters to match or exceed the set amount. If afterwards your raw net energy allows for some of these to be destroyed AJEA will automatically do so as well. In effect AJEA very quickly prevents brownouts while min/maxing the economy for as little conversion as needed. It's still very possible to ruin your economy, conversion is not very efficient - but if so you will be warned by a notification.   There are also some conditions under which AJEA will not work: When both metal and energy income are negative (which is probably impossible without mods or bugs), when all Matter Converters running still wouldn't be enough to match the energy needed not to brown out (this may happen if the player has lost a lot of planets but still has full fleets for some reason), and when a brownout is ongoing and AJEA could match the energy needed to get out of the red, but in doing so would burn metal so fast it'd run out before the brownout ends.  The specified amount may be increased if you attempt to capture something that costs more energy than set (do mind that on any game mode other than deathwish pausing somethinig to be captured will stop its capture, also making AJEA ignore it). AJEA will also look at each player's current build selection and how many they may attempt to build (1x, 5x, 10x, 50x, up to the max possible if any), if needed freeing up at least this much energy.
column2: AJEA（自动调整能源助手）是AIW2的「智能电网」。如果您的净能源低于下面指定的数值，AJEA将自动建造更多物质转换器以达到或超过设定值。如果之后您的原始净能源允许摧毁其中一些，AJEA也会自动执行。 实际上，AJEA能非常快速地防止低电力，同时尽量以最少的转换来最大化经济效率。但它仍然可能搞砸你的经济——转换效率并不高——不过如果出问题，你会收到通知提醒。   以下情况下AJEA不会工作： 当金属和能源收入均为负（没有mod或bug的话这几乎不可能发生），当所有运行中的物质转换器仍不足以匹配避免低电力所需的能源（可能在玩家失去大量行星但仍保留完整舰队时发生），以及当低电力正在进行中且AJEA可以匹配恢复能源所需的能量，但这样做会过快烧尽金属以至于在低电力结束前就用光了。  指定的数值可能会在你尝试占领耗能超过设定的东西时增加（注意在任何非死愿难度下暂停占领会中止其占领，同时AJEA也会忽略它）。 AJEA还会查看每个玩家当前的建造选择及其可能的建造数量（1倍、5倍、10倍、50倍，最多到可能的上限），必要时释放至少这么多能源。

column1: After a long period of time (roughly 2 hours for a single AI), a 'Cross Planet Attack' (CPA) will be announced.  The AI will take a large number of the ships guarding its planets and send them to attack you; these do not create new units. These ships can be from any mark planet, so you might get some very high mark ships headed at you.   Unlike waves, this isn't against any specific planet.  These can be very large, and are much more dangerous than Waves.
column2: 经过较长时间（单个 AI 大约需要 2 小时）后，会宣布发起“跨行星攻击”（CPA）。  AI 会调集大量守卫其行星的单位来攻击你；这些单位不会生成新单位。这些单位可能来自任何等级的行星，所以你可能会遭遇一些等级非常高的单位。   与波次攻击不同，这种攻击并非针对某个特定行星。  这些攻击规模可能非常大，而且比波次攻击危险得多。

column1: After an <color=#ff6634>800-year civil war</color> between humans fighting amongst the stars, we finally birthed a force that would end all human wars forever: <color=#ff6634>Artificial Intelligence</color>.  Quickly eclipsing the humans in power and taking control of most of their automated forces, the AI nearly wiped the human race from the face of the galaxy.  <color=#ff6634>Only scattered pockets of humans remain</color>, hiding amidst the scattered wreckage from the civil war and the AI-led extermination that followed.  You are in command of the last substantial remaining human military force.  It is so small that <color=#ff6634>the AI is either unaware of it, or just doesn't care.</color>  Potentially coincidentally, something outside the galaxy seems to have distracted the AI far more than humans ever did.  You must grow your forces, capturing and reactivating fleets from the old wars... but <color=#ff6634>you must be careful</color> not to grow so strong that the eye of the AI turns back toward you.  Gain just enough power, capture just enough fleets, take back just enough planets, that you can destroy the massive structures known as 'AI Overlords' and <color=#ff6634>end this new war before the AI is even fully aware it has begun</color>.  If you are too greedy, if you make yourself too threatening, <color=#ff6634>if you let the AI realize you might be a true threat...</color> expect us all to lose everything.  You must use discretion, avoid distraction and temptation, and wield your forces like a scalpel.  Take risks, be bold, but don't try to be a conqueror. <color=#ff6634>Go for the core.</color>
column2: 在人类之间持续了 <color=#ff6634>800 年的星际内战</color> 之后，我们终于创造出了一股将永远结束人类所有战争的力量：<color=#ff6634>人工智能</color>。  人工智能的力量迅速超越了人类，并控制了他们的大部分自动化部队，几乎将人类从银河系中抹去。 <color=#ff6634>只剩下零星的人类群体</color>，躲藏在内战和随后人工智能发起的灭绝行动留下的残骸中。  你指挥着最后一支规模可观的人类军事力量。它规模如此之小，以至于 <color=#ff6634>人工智能要么没有意识到它的存在，要么根本不在乎。</color>  可能巧合的是，星系外的某些事物似乎比人类更能分散人工智能的注意力。  你必须壮大你的部队，从旧战争中夺取并重新激活舰队……但 <color=#ff6634>你必须小心</color>，不要变得过于强大，以免引起人工智能的注意。  获得足够的力量，夺取足够的舰队，夺回足够的行星，这样你就可以摧毁被称为“人工智能霸主”的巨大结构，并 <color=#ff6634>在人工智能甚至还没有完全意识到战争已经开始之前就结束这场新战争</color>。  如果你过于贪婪，如果你让自己变得过于具有威胁性，<color=#ff6634>如果你让人工智能意识到你可能是一个真正的威胁……</color> 那么我们都将失去一切。  你必须谨慎行事，避免分心和诱惑，像使用手术刀一样运用你的部队。要敢于冒险，要大胆，但不要试图成为征服者。<color=#ff6634>直击核心。</color>

column1: After decades of silence, a rogue scientist has contacted us, offering potent spire technology to defend our planets. The power required to fuel these defenses is immense, however, and we can only keep them up for a limited time.

column1: After our most recent analysis we are now able to weaponize micro-singularities in such a way that it does not tear apart the ship or structure producing them. This allows for terrifying melee attacks, and by channeling the energy from attacks hitting a Schwarzschild Radius retaliatory gravity pull with which we can draw in enemies by letting them attack the ship that will shred them.
column2: 经过我们最近的分析，我们现在能够将微型奇点武器化，使其不会撕裂产生它们的单位或建筑。这允许进行可怕的近战攻击，并通过引导来自攻击的能量，利用史瓦西半径的报复性引力牵引，我们可以让敌人通过攻击那个将撕碎它们的单位来被拉入。

column1: After the xml files are initially loaded, or are reloaded into the in-memory data tables (from changing active mods or expansions), write a text file for each one into a DataTablesAfterInitial and DataTablesAfterReload subfolders in the PlayerData folder.    The purpose of this is mainly to use with diffing tools between this copy and the on-main-load copy and see if something went wrong during the reload.  If you are modding and made changes to some ships and want to see how those changes cascaded, this would be one way to do that.  This is also a way for us to verify correctness when we make structural changes internally.

column1: All of your mobile combat forces have a flagship, which might be a transport, an Ark, a Golem, or something else along those lines.          These flagships provide crucial supply to their forces, but they also act as a transport.  With the flagship selected, just hit the L key to cause ships of the fleet to load into their flagship, or the U key to unload ships from the transport.  While ships are inside the transport, they won't take damage and they also won't accidentally aggro the AI.  Plus sometimes it's a good way to move slow ships more quickly across a long distance.  Ships even get a 3x speed bonus when they are moving across a planet to get into their transport.  If there are a few enemy planets that you DON'T want to capture (not valuable enough) in between you and the planet you have your eye on, then you should take whatever fleets you plan to use, load them up as transports (L key), possibly put the transports/golems/arks into hold fire mode (N key), and fly over to your target.  Then toggle off hold fire mode (N again), and unload those transports (U key).  Note that if Factories are supplying new ships to a fleet while it has ships loaded into its flagship, then all the new ships will go into the flagship as transported ships.  It's not possible to tell only some of your ships in one fleet to get into their flagship (except by default when ships are on a different planet than their flagship and thus can't obey).  It's also not possible to accidentally have ships get into the wrong transport, or for a transport to be full.  All nice and tidy!
column2: 你所有的移动战斗部队都有一艘旗舰，可能是运输舰、方舟舰、魔像舰或者类似的单位。  这些旗舰不仅为部队提供关键补给，还能充当运输工具。选中旗舰后，按 L 键可让舰队中的单位装载到旗舰上，按 U 键则可让单位从运输舰中卸载下来。  当单位在运输舰内部时，它们不会受到伤害，也不会意外激怒 AI。而且有时候这也是让慢速单位快速长途移动的好方法。单位在前往运输舰的过程中甚至能获得 3 倍的速度加成。  如果你和你看中的行星之间有几个你不想占领（价值不够）的敌方行星，那么你应该把计划使用的舰队装载到运输舰中（按 L 键），可能还需要将运输舰/魔像舰/方舟舰设置为停火模式（按 N 键），然后飞到目标行星。之后再次按 N 键关闭停火模式，再按 U 键卸载运输舰中的单位。  注意，如果工厂在舰队的单位装载到旗舰时为其提供新单位，那么所有新单位都会作为运输单位进入旗舰。无法只让舰队中的部分单位进入旗舰（除非默认情况下单位与旗舰不在同一行星而无法执行命令）。也不会出现单位意外进入错误运输舰或运输舰满载的情况。一切都井然有序！

Once it deals with its immediate threats, it will regenerate its hull in a few minutes.
column2: 拱门使团中最强大的战士之一，穆尔米洛迅速切入近战。其恶毒的相位炮除了将脆弱的敌人相位化之外，还会随自身与目标船体生命值的降低而提升伤害。一旦解决眼前的威胁，它会在几分钟内再生船体。

column1: Amplifies allied damage, buth multiplicatively and additively with its different weapons.
column2: 通过不同的武器以乘法和加法方式放大友军伤害。

column1: An AI Coprocessor assists the main AI system. Destroying one coprocessor will increase AI Progress, but with a substantial decrease in AI Progress when you destroy them all.
column2: AI 协处理器辅助主 AI 系统。摧毁一个协处理器会增加 AI 进度，但当你摧毁所有协处理器时会大幅降低 AI 进度。

column2: AI 控制的戈耳工聚合体。为麻痹武器供能，并在承受伤害时碎裂为独立的攻击单位。

column1: An AI copy of a powerful manifestation of the Dark Spire's Rage at all life. Now unchained of its previous limits.
column2: 黑暗尖塔对所有生命的愤怒的强大体现的AI复制版本，现已解除之前的限制。

column1: An AI grown version of the smallest of the Spire warships equipped with long range rail guns. Much weaker than the original and lacking of free will.
column2: AI 培育的装备远程轨道炮的最小型尖塔战舰版本。比原版弱得多，且缺乏自主意识。

column1: An AI grown version of the smallest of the Spire warships. Much weaker than the original and lacking of free will.
column2: AI 培育的最小型尖塔战舰版本。比原版弱得多，且缺乏自主意识。

column1: An AI replica of a Spire destroyer, with some new Hateful enhancements. Beware its zombifying gun!
column2: 一艘尖塔驱逐舰的AI复制品，带有一些新的仇恨增强。小心它的尸化炮！

column1: An AI replica of a Spire destroyer, with some new Hateful enhancements. This beam also does corrosive damage!
column2: 一艘尖塔驱逐舰的AI复制品，带有一些新的仇恨增强。此光束也会造成腐蚀伤害！

column1: An AI replica of a Spire destroyer. Created by studying, collecting and merging spire corpses from the assault on the Spire homeworlds, these spire corpse amalgams are weaker, but no less dangerous.
column2: AI 仿制的尖塔驱逐舰。通过研究、收集和融合对尖塔母星进攻中获得的尖塔残骸制造而成，这些尖塔残骸组合体虽然较弱，但同样危险。

column1: An AI server farm, with heavy weapons and firepower to fend off would be saboteurs.
column2: 一个配备重型武器的AI服务器集群，足以击退任何试图破坏的敌人。
一个 AI 服务器农场。

column1: An All-rounder mix that can pack a punch. Stack the stronger-in-pack Harmonic on one planet while spreading the rest of the turrets around your planets, you'll be ready for most problems. Picking the same starting battlestation twice will randomize the second one.
column2: 一种全能型组合，能造成强大打击。将更强力的谐波炮塔集中部署在一颗行星上，同时将其余炮塔分散到你的各个行星上，这样你就能应对大多数问题。 如果两次选择相同的起始战斗空间站，第二个将随机化。

column1: An Architrave defensive structure mid-warp in.
column2: 一个正在跃迁中的拱心石防御建筑。

column1: An Architrave utility structure mid-warp in.
column2: 一个正在跃迁过程中的天顶拱心石实用建筑。

column1: An Exo-Galactic strike force is inbound.
column2: 一支外星系打击部队正在逼近。

column1: An Interceptor Citadel, engineers, and a tachyon sentry frigate.
column2: 拦截者堡垒、工程师和快子哨戒护卫舰。

column1: An Outpost for Kaizers Marauders, claiming the planet and allowing its resources to be harvested. This one constantly builds new drones.
column2: 凯泽掠夺者的前哨站，占领行星并使其资源可被采集。此型号持续建造新的无人机。

column1: An Outpost for Kaizers Marauders, claiming the planet and allowing its resources to be harvested. This one has a sabot gun to defend itself.
column2: 凯泽掠夺者的前哨站，占领行星并使其资源可被采集。此型号配有穿甲弹炮用于自卫。

column1: An Outpost for Kaizers Marauders, claiming the planet and allowing its resources to be harvested. This one has higher shields and a bubble forcefield.
column2: 凯泽掠夺者的前哨站，占领行星并使其资源可被采集。此型号拥有更高的护盾和泡泡力场。

column2: 凯泽掠夺者的前哨站，占领行星并使其资源可被采集。此型号产出更多能源，拥有更坚固的船体。

column1: An abandoned fleet that has already been raided for salvage. Starts only with Dagger space fighters. A very challenging start, meant for only true Fleet Commanders.
column2: 一支已被搜刮过残骸的废弃舰队。仅以「匕首」太空战斗机开局。极具挑战，专为真正的舰队指挥官准备。

column2: 一种先进的酸液炮塔，能够腐蚀比普通炮塔更厚的装甲，使舰船压缩机能更有效地回收舰船。它能攻击多个敌人，并使敌人在短时间内承受更多伤害。

column1: An advanced probe for a Zenith Miner; after sufficiently scanning a system, the Miner will arrive to eat the system. Looks like it's vulnerable to hacking though.
column2: 天顶矿工的高级探测器；在对一个星系进行充分扫描后，矿工会抵达并吞噬该星系。不过看起来它容易受到黑客攻击。

column1: An advanced weapon firing long-range ionized bolts that deal increasingly large amounts of damage to targets that have a mark level no higher than it. It is unable to target anything that is higher mark level, or which is markless.
column2: 一种先进武器，发射远程离子弹，对标记等级不高于自身的目标造成越来越高的伤害。无法攻击高于自身标记等级或无标记的单位。

column1: An advanced weapon firing long-range ionized bolts that deal increasingly large amounts of damage to targets that have a mark level no higher than it. It is unable to target anything that is higher mark level, or which is markless.
column2: 一种高级武器，发射远程电离弹，对等级不高于其自身的目标造成递增的大量伤害。无法瞄准任何更高等级或没有等级的目标。

column1: An advanced weapon sends projectiles stripped from an iron asteroid to deal heavy damage to higher mass targets, but does almost nothing to smaller ones.
column2: 一种高级武器发射从铁质小行星剥离的射弹，对高质量目标造成大量伤害，但对较小目标几乎没有效果。

column1: An advanced weapons array armed with multiple Firststrike Missile launchers and a Reflex Rocket launcher that fires each time it is attacked.
column2: 一个先进武器阵列，配备多个首击导弹发射器和一个每次被攻击时都会发射的反射火箭发射器。

column1: An advanced weapons array armed with multiple Railcannon and a Reflex Shock Cannon that deals low damage but paralyzes smaller craft attempting to attack the installation.
column2: 一种先进的武器阵列，配备多门轨道炮和一门反射式电击炮，反射式电击炮造成的伤害较低，但能使试图攻击该设施的小型飞船瘫痪。

column1: An advanced, heavy raider with more 'staying power', able to reinforce with constant drones and long-range fusion bomb fire.
column2: 先进的重型突击者，具备更强的「续航能力」，可通过持续无人机增援和远程核聚变炸弹火力进行补强。

column1: An advanced, heavy raider with more 'staying power', able to reinforce with constant drones and long-range fusion bomb fire. This one has been upgraded to become more durable and resilient.
column2: 先进的重型突击者，具备更强的「续航能力」，可通过持续无人机增援和远程核聚变炸弹火力进行补强。此型号已升级，更加耐久和坚韧。

column1: An anchor formed by the harpoon that can only target a capital class ship, preventing it from moving for a short duration.
column2: 由鱼叉飞弹形成的锚定器，只能锁定主力舰，能在短时间内阻止其移动。

column1: An ancient Spire artifact of the Lost Spire Expedition... All the Spire Relics we have encountered had references to this legendary ship thus far.  Originally sent to colonize our galaxy just before the Spire civil war broke out, the Exodian Blade deactivated and fell into disrepair under mysterious circumstances.  We don't even know how this thing is powered. Has a devastating humongous beam cannon that disintegrates anything it shoots through, and has a high rate of fire, that can pierce through any number of ships, and it has an infinite range. Summoning and repairing this will be extremely expensive and time consuming, but it will put this capital starship under our direct control, and it will cost us 170 AIP.  Since we don't have the resources or the time, we won't be able to restore all of it's full functionalities even if we repair it. It has a very unstable core; it can't generate any shields, moves very slowly, and will permanently perish if it's destroyed; producing a nuclear blast that annihilates everything in the system, and cost an additional 30 AIP. The blast is ineffective against mark 7 units.      Summoning and repairing this capital starship will make us unable to build the Spire Transceiver, so we must make a choice between the two.
column2: 失落尖塔远征队的远古尖塔神器……迄今为止我们遇到的所有尖塔遗物都提到了这个传说中的单位。 原本在尖塔内战爆发前被派来殖民我们的银河系，灭世之刃在神秘情况下失能并陷入破败。 我们甚至不知道这东西是如何驱动的。它拥有一门毁灭性的巨型光束炮，能分解任何被射穿的东西，射速高，可穿透任意数量的单位，且拥有无限射程。召唤并修复它将极其昂贵且耗时，但这艘主力舰将处于我们的直接控制之下，代价是170 AIP。 由于我们缺乏资源和时间，即使修复它也无法恢复其全部功能。它的核心极不稳定；无法生成任何护盾，移动非常缓慢，一旦被摧毁将永久消亡；产生核爆消灭系统中的一切，并额外消耗30 AIP。爆炸对马克7单位无效。     召唤并修复这艘主力舰将使我们无法建造尖塔收发器，因此我们必须二选一。

column1: An unknown Zenith beacon, connected to an unknown recipient. Can sometimes create massive shifts in a fight. The latter two are out of the window if it reaches or is spawned at Tier 4, at which point it can attack structures even if not enraged and should be effectively unbeatable to anything but nomad planets, rendering any other hostile factions fighting on the same planet defeated immediately.

column1: An unknown structure built by the Xodians.
column2: 克赛迪安建造的未知建筑。

column2: 虚空召唤者前哨站利用曲速网格制造的不稳定奇点。这个裂隙会吸引那些无法逃脱其事件视界的舰船，并以巨大的内爆力将它们碾碎。此外，裂隙产生的引力会减缓除最强引擎舰船之外的所有舰船的速度，并阻止它们通过虫洞离开。

column2: 由虚空催化剂释放的不稳定奇点。这个裂隙会将无法逃脱其事件视界的舰船吸入，并以巨大的内爆力量将其粉碎。

column1: Analysis of ancient Zenith relics revealed that some of these behemoths had the ability to shift into other dimensions. They could use it to protect themselves and escape danger or pull others into a smaller battlefield they could dominate, leaving armies unable to join the fight. A modified Auto Bomb can unleash a similar explosion, shifting enemies with low energy emissions into another plane of existence for a short time.
column2: 对古代泽尼斯遗迹的分析揭示，其中一些庞然大物具有转换到其他维度的能力。它们可以利用它来保护自己并逃离危险，或者将其他人拉入它们可以主导的较小战场，使军队无法加入战斗。改装的自动炸弹可以释放类似的爆炸，将低能量发射的敌人转换到另一个存在平面一段时间。

column1: Analyzing the Chrysalis born of the Mortar Devourer allowed us insight on its adaptive explosive shells. A volatile mix that does not simply explode and deal equal damage in a great range, it almost... instinctively focuses its charge against a single opponent more than all others. This allows for greater focused damage while not preventing it from dealing high damage to nearby enemies.
column2: 分析由迫击炮吞噬者产生的蛹，让我们深入了解了其自适应爆炸弹壳。一种不稳定的混合物，不会简单地爆炸并在大范围内造成等量伤害，它几乎是……本能地将其装药集中针对单一对手而非其他目标。这允许更大的集中伤害，同时不阻止其对附近敌人造成高伤害。

column1: Any of your offensive fleets (officer or transport-based) can do the job of a hacker or a colony ship if you take them to a planet.          We had these other units in the sequel for quite some time, but ultimately it was just making a two-step process out of it for no good reason.  Just bring along the centerpiece of an offensive fleet and that's all you need, now: it keeps things moving and doesn't actually remove any strategy.  Science, on the other hand, is gathered by command stations now.  If you need to capture a planet, then it will automatically work on gathering the science until it is exhausted.  As far as capturing science from neutral planets goes... well, you can either temporarily capture it until you have all the science you wanted, or you can use a hack to get it.  One example of a reason not to temporarily capture a planet is if a Dyson Sphere is sitting on it: you'll really piss that thing off.  So that's a case where it's worth the hacking points to just get that science on the sly.
column2: 现在任何进攻舰队(军官或运输型)的核心单位都能执行入侵或殖民船的功能，只需带到目标行星即可。          我们曾在本作中保留这些单位很长时间，但最终发现它们只是毫无必要地增加了操作步骤。现在只需带上进攻舰队核心单位就够了：既保持了游戏节奏，又没削弱策略深度。  科研点数现在由指挥站自动收集。占领行星后，指挥站会自动收集科研直到耗尽。  至于从中立行星获取科研...你可以临时占领直到收集完毕，或者使用入侵手段获取。比如当行星上有戴森球时，临时占领会激怒它，这时就值得花费入侵点数暗中获取科研。

column1: As you capture planets from the AI, you gain hacking points -- same as you are able to gather science.  But while science is spent on tech upgrades, hacking points are spent on disrupting your enemies or giving you new advantages.          To do a hack, look in the Hacking tab of the left sidebar.  That will show you all of the hacks available at the planet you are currently viewing.  Different planets have different options available, depending on what enemy units are there.  THAT said, there are other ways to spend hacking points -- often times, against your own units.  If you go into the fleets tab and click a fleet, you will see various options for upgrading Golems or Arks via hacking points, or for switching the types of Transports or Combat Factories via the same.  All of the 'hack yourself' items are pretty much in the fleet tab for each fleet, while anything focused more outward is always in the hacks tab.  However -- sigh -- in the science tab, way down at the bottom, there is a Retrieve Spent Science button that lets you do a very fancy hack to re-spec certain technologies you've unlocked.  So there are some various odds and ends around.  As for hacks against enemies: each hack visible in the sidebar will show the cost in hacking points and the time it will take for the hack. Looking at the colour of the time will give you an approximate sense of how much AI response you can expect from your hack (the more red the text, the scarier the response).  There are also a variety of hacks that just say Instant in the sidebar, and those ones happen immediately, without any enemy response.  The hacks against yourself are also AI-response-free.  Unexplored planets have hacks that allow for early scouting of them, but that can be a big hacking-point sink.
column2: 当你从AI手中夺取行星时，会获得入侵点数(HaP) - 就像获取科技点数一样。但科技点数用于技术升级，而入侵点数则用于干扰敌人或获取新优势。          要进行入侵操作，请查看左侧边栏的入侵标签页。这将显示当前查看行星上所有可用的入侵选项。不同行星根据敌方单位的不同会提供不同选项。  不过，入侵点数还有其他用途 - 通常是对己方单位使用。如果你进入舰队标签页并点击一支舰队，会看到各种使用入侵点数升级戈仑或方舟的选项，或者用同样方式切换运输舰或机动兵工厂的类型。  所有'自我入侵'选项基本都在各舰队的舰队标签页中，而对外操作则总是在入侵标签页中。但是 - 唉 - 在科技标签页最底部有一个'回收已用科技'按钮，可以让你执行非常高级的入侵操作来重新分配已解锁的技术。所以各处都有些零散功能。  至于对敌入侵操作：边栏中显示的每个入侵操作都会标明所需入侵点数和时间。查看时间的颜色可以大致了解AI可能的反应强度(文字越红，反应越可怕)。  还有一些边栏中标记为'即时'的入侵操作，这些会立即生效且不会引起敌方反应。对自身的入侵操作也不会触发AI反应。  未探索的行星提供早期侦察的入侵选项，但这可能会消耗大量入侵点数。

column1: Battlestations and Citadels can be important, but are rare.  You can capture these to get a mobile force of turrets, forcefields, minefields, and whatever else to use on your planets or enemy planets.          These can be great for beachheads on enemy planets or to help defend chokepoints on your planets.

column1: Beacons allow for some minor factions to be enabled mid-game.  Beacons are essentially an extension of the game lobby; they allow you to tune an existing game.  Open Beacons lets you freely choose a beacon faction's strength and allegiance, so it's locked off starting at Challenger mode and up.  If you'd like to play a 'Pure 10' game, please disable beacons (and play on expert mode, which disables beacons for you).
column2: 信标允许在游戏中期启用一些次要派系。    如果你想玩'纯净10'游戏，请禁用信标(并在专家模式下游戏，该模式会自动为你禁用信标)。

column1: Beacons are a way to bring the gameplay flexibility of the game lobby forward into the game itself. You can hack beacons to add additional factions to your gameplay.   The goal is to allow players to dynamically update their game to taste; feel like you're losing? Add in an ally. Want some more challenge? Add a scary new opponent.  Use of beacons is optional, and they can be disabled in the game lobby.
column2: 信标是一种将游戏大厅的游戏灵活性带入游戏本身的方式。你可以破解信标，为你的游戏添加额外的派系。   目标是让玩家能够根据自己的喜好动态更新游戏；觉得自己要输了？添加一个盟友。想要更多挑战？添加一个可怕的新对手。  信标的使用是可选的，并且可以在游戏大厅中禁用。

In order to create the ultimate support frigate these were combined with built-in repair beams. This counteracts a fleet's attrition in large fights without restricting the damage inflicted on enemies.

Defeating this powerful form will grant its Necromancer Flagship <color=#E16CFF>Blueprint</color>. Each Elderling has a unique <color=#E16CFF>Blueprint</color> that grants the Flagship its specific weapon. Beware, killing a Sacrificial Elderling will increase <color=#ff5454>AIP</color> in proportion to the power level of the Elderling.
column2: 通过向古灵发射破解辐射，你可以使其转变为更强大的形态。击败这个强大的形态将获得死灵法师旗舰的 <color=#E16CFF>蓝图</color>。每个古灵都有一个独特的 <color=#E16CFF>蓝图</color>，可为旗舰提供特定的武器。请注意，杀死献祭古灵将根据古灵的力量等级增加 <color=#ff5454>人工智能点数（AIP）</color>。

column1: By blasting an Elderling with hacking radiation, you can reveal the territory it normally patrols, and other important data, which can be browsed by mousing over it at any time. column2: 通过向古灵发射破解辐射，你可以揭示它通常巡逻的领地以及其他重要数据，随时将鼠标悬停在上面即可浏览。  此外，使用古灵信息星系显示模式（将过滤器设置为古灵信息），你可以一目了然地看到它们的许多统计数据，并且可以点击它以完整可视化其领地。

column1: By default your forces are a full Dark Zenith Invasion. By using Svikari, you will spawn with a small force with your empire ally.
column2: 默认情况下你的部队是一支完整的暗天顶入侵部队。选择斯维卡里的话，你将以一支小型部队与你的帝国盟友一同出生。如果你选择DZ帝国，必须选择全面入侵。

column1: By default, Allied factions like Marauders and Nanocaust will generate AIP when they destroy AIP-increasing structures. Disabling this will make the game easier. This option can be combined with 'Allied factions destroy command station' to good effect.
column2: 默认情况下，像掠夺者和纳米瘟疫这样的盟友派系在摧毁会增加AIP的结构时会产生AIP。禁用此选项将使游戏更容易。该选项可以与'盟友派系摧毁指挥站'配合使用，产生良好效果。

column1: By default, Shield Generators can be hacked. Disabling this will remove the option to hack Shield Generators, forcing the player to destroy more Command Stations and thus incur more AI Progress.
column2: 默认情况下，护盾发生器可以被入侵。禁用此选项将移除入侵护盾发生器的选项，迫使玩家摧毁更多指挥站从而积累更多AI进度。

column1: By default, factions allied to the player cannot overload a Core Shield even if they destroy an appropriate Command Station as allowing them to do so can result in cheese. If this is enabled, this restriction will be removed assuming that Overloading is also enabled.
column2: 默认情况下，与玩家结盟的派系不能过载核心护盾，即使他们摧毁了合适的指挥站也不行，因为允许他们这样做可能导致投机取巧。 如果启用此选项，此限制将被移除——前提是过载功能也被启用。

column1: By default, only strikecraft, guardians and frigates can be zombified. Things like Dyson ships or Dire Guardians are immune to zombification. Enabling this setting allows Dire Guardians and other powerful units to be zombified. This makes the game much easier if you have lots of zombification.
column2: 默认情况下，只有攻击舰、守护者和护卫舰可以被僵尸化。像戴森飞船或骇人守护者这样的单位对僵尸化免疫。启用此设置允许骇人守护者和其他强大单位被僵尸化。如果你有大量僵尸化能力，这会使游戏变得更加容易。

column1: By default, shapes are outlines. This setting turns some or all of them into points with many spokes.
column2: 默认情况下形状是轮廓。此设置会将其中部分或全部转换为带有许多辐条的点。

column1: By default, the DZ Full Invasion will arrive with all their Upgrades. This setting will cause them to have a different set of upgrades based on when they invade; earlier invasions still have to do research.
column2: 默认情况下，DZ全面入侵将带着他们所有的升级到达。此设置将导致他们根据入侵时间有不同的升级组合；较早的入侵仍需要进行研究。

column1: By default, the screen will pan in the direction of your cursor when you place your cursor at the edge of the screen.  However, some folks find this annoying; so you can turn it off.
column2: 默认情况下，在星系地图界面中，当鼠标移动到屏幕边缘时会自动向该方向平移视图。如果您觉得这种自动边缘平移功能干扰操作，可以禁用此选项。

column1: By default, the screen will pan in the direction of your cursor when you place your cursor at the edge of the screen.  However, some folks find this annoying; so you can turn it off.

column1: By default, units in AI waves are 'Relentless' - they will not retreat, and will fight to the death.     Disabling this lets them retreat if they are outmatched.  This setting is not intended for general use, and is hidden away, meant to be seen only by modders who may use it.
column2: 默认情况下，AI浪潮中的单位是'无情的' - 它们不会撤退，会战斗到死。     禁用此选项可让它们在被压制时撤退。  此设置不适用于一般用途，并被隐藏起来，仅供可能使用它的模组制作者查看。

column1: By destroying the probe you will prevent the Zenith Miner from arriving.
column2: 通过摧毁探测器，你将阻止天顶采矿者的到来。

column1: By how many percent may the amount of Hacking Points that can be gathered on a planet vary? I.e. if on average 30 Hacking Points are on a planet, and the variance is set to 50%, each planet will randomly have between 15 and 45 Hacking Points. If the variance is set to 0 then every planet will have the exact amount set above. Note that the adjacency bonus is not affected by this setting.
column2: 一个行星上可收集的入侵点数量可能会有多少百分比的变化？例如，如果一个行星平均有30个入侵点数，变异率设置为50%，则每个行星将随机拥有15到45个入侵点数。 如果变异率设置为0，则每个行星都将拥有上面设置的确切数量。 请注意，相邻加成不受此设置影响。

column1: By how many percent may the amount of Science Points that can be gathered on a planet vary? I.e. if on average 2000 Science Points are on a planet, and the variance is set to 50%, each planet will randomly have between 1000 and 3000 Science Points. If the variance is set to 0 then every planet will have the exact amount set above. Note that the adjacency bonus is not affected by this setting.
column2: 一个行星上可收集的科学点数量可能会有多少百分比的变化？例如，如果一个行星平均有2000个科学点数，变异率设置为50%，则每个行星将随机拥有1000到3000个科学点数。 如果变异率设置为0，则每个行星都将拥有上面设置的确切数量。 请注意，相邻加成不受此设置影响。

column1: By reprogramming this probe you can make the Zenith Miner change the planet rather than destroying it.  This hack will cause the planet to become Nomadic; it will now act just like a Nomad Planet. Note that this planet will not have a Nomad Nexus, so you won't be able to crash or stop it.

column1: Challenger Mode is intended for players who are looking for a more strategic experience than Humanity Ascendant, but don't want the full Expert package and all the guardrails it entails.  If you have any questions about the various modes, please visit the Arcen Games discord where there is a dedicated expert_challenger_deathwish channel and feel free to ping Strategic Sage with your inquiries.  As always, the Mantis website awaits your feedback and/or bug reports as well.  Both are readily accessible from the main menu.  In a Challenger game a handful of settings are always turned on as compared to Humanity Ascendant.  Distributed Economy.  The asteroids on a planet, not the command stations you build, contribute most of the metal and energy.  This lends additional strategic variety and weight decisions about what planets to capture, and what types of command stations to build there.   Enforced Balance.  Engineering tech costs are increased, as well as those for direct upgrades of battlestations and command stations.  Turret costs are increased and ranges decreased on non-human planets.  Brutal Guardians are on, and some other lobby options that are available to be changed on HA are now locked in place.  Limited 'Cheese'.  A couple of starting fleet options are removed, as skilled use of them confers a fairly extreme advantage.  Increased AI Response.  There is a modest multiplier to the resources the AI has for items like hacking exostrike response, Dire CPAs (if turned on), etc.  AI Reserves grace period is turned off, and so on.  Reduced Resources.  At the start of the game you have lowered available Hacking Points and Knowledge.  Additional planets acquired will give a slightly reduced amount of Hacking Points as well.
column2: 挑战者模式专为那些希望获得比“人类崛起”模式更具战略性体验，但又不想采用专家模式全部限制规则的玩家设计。如果你对各种模式有任何疑问，请访问阿尔森游戏的 Discord 频道，那里有一个专门的 expert_challenger_deathwish 频道，你可以随时向战略贤者提问。一如既往，螳螂网站也欢迎你的反馈和 bug 报告。这两个渠道都可以从主菜单轻松访问。  与“人类崛起”模式相比，挑战者模式会始终开启一些设置。  分布式经济。行星上的小行星而非你建造的指挥站，将提供大部分的金属和能量。这为战略决策增添了更多变化，让你在选择占领哪些行星以及在那里建造何种指挥站时需要更加慎重。  强制平衡。工程科技的成本会增加，战列舰和指挥站的直接升级成本也会提高。非人类行星上的炮塔成本增加，射程缩短。残暴守护者机制开启，一些在“人类崛起”模式中可以调整的大厅选项在挑战者模式中被锁定。  限制“投机取巧”策略。移除了几种起始舰队选项，因为熟练运用这些选项会带来极大的优势。  增强 AI 反应。AI 在入侵外击反击、致命跨行星攻击（如果开启）等方面的资源会有适度的乘数加成。AI 预备队的宽限期被取消，等等。  资源减少。游戏开始时，你的可用入侵点数和知识量会降低。占领额外的行星获得的入侵点数也会略有减少。

column1: Challenger mode locks a variety of options that allow for cheesing gameplay, adjusts the balance for slightly more advanced play, and unlocks a number of don't-hit-new-players-with-that features like Ultimate Fortresses.              Fundamentally this is still the same game as Humanity Ascendant, except the balance is not skewed so far in your favor, and you can't skew it even more in your favor.  This is probably the preferred way for the developers to play.  This mode also does not increase complexity by adding things like fuel, BUT you have the option to turn things like that on in any mode.
column2: 挑战者模式锁定了各种允许取巧玩法的选项，调整了平衡性以适应更高级的玩法，并解锁了一些不适合新手的功能，如终极堡垒。              从根本上说，这仍然是与“人类崛起”相同的游戏，只是平衡性不再那么偏向于你，而且你也无法进一步让平衡性偏向自己。这可能是开发者喜欢的游戏方式。此模式也不会通过添加燃料等元素来增加游戏复杂度，但你可以在任何模式下开启这些元素。

column1: Combat Sentry Frigates, after the first prototype, became the model for countering stealth attacks. Ship designers took it a step further, adding a whole host of radar arrays and high-speed quantum computers. The result was a ship that could not only decloak enemies at amazing speed but also find the smallest stress points in enemy armor by examining the 'shockwaves' when hit with its multispectal beam weapons.

column1: Commander,  During a recent routine scan for variations in the AI's warp grid, our personnel detected an abnormal subspace signal on {PlanetName}. Further analysis confirmed that we have no record of similar phenomena. It seems to be generated by some sort of alien Relic.  We should consider sending a flagship to research this relic; our Hacking interface should enable us to understand it more clearly. Scans also show increased AI warp activity in that area. While this lab cannot issue military recommendations, for the sake of our team I personally request that you carry a very large stick.   Hacking this planet will begin the Spire Campaign, which transforms the game into an all-out war against the AI. This will involve major AI assaults on your planets, so you should make sure to have your empire in order before beginning.
column2: 指挥官，  在最近一次对人工智能跃迁网格变化的例行扫描中，我们的人员在{PlanetName}检测到一个异常的次空间信号。进一步分析证实，我们没有类似现象的记录。它似乎是由某种外星遗迹产生的。  我们应该考虑派遣一艘旗舰来研究这个遗迹；我们的黑客接口应该能让我们更清楚地了解它。扫描还显示该区域的人工智能跃迁活动增加。虽然本实验室无法提出军事建议，但为了我们团队的利益，我个人请求你携带一根非常大的棍子。  入侵这个行星将开启尖塔族战役，这将使游戏转变为与人工智能的全面战争。这将涉及人工智能对你行星的大规模攻击，因此在开始之前，你应该确保你的帝国秩序井然。

column1: Commander,  It's hard to read feelings from a rock, but the refugees are rejoicing. Also, there's a fascinating resonance being set up between this city and the Capitol; it's like this new city is Bolstering the energies of the previous capitol.
column2: 指挥官，  很难从一块石头读出感情，但难民们正在欢呼。此外，这座城市和首都之间正在建立一种迷人的共振；就像这座新城市正在增强前首都的能量。

column1: Commander,  Our new spire allies are truly amazing. Apparently, they grow their ships rather than manufacturing them! That's not all, though. They are even able to modify their ships in the field! As our allies have decided to defer to your command, they are permitting you to make modifications to their ship lines. You'll find an interface in your fleet menu entitled 'modules' next to any ship line which can be modified. If you select that option, you'll be presented with a menu of modules to apply to the line.  Each spire ship line from each planet can be assigned a template (so all the frigates from their capital will be identical, etc.). As the spire cities grow in complexity, the ships grown from them become capable of handling additional and/or more complicated modules. You'll see a reminder at the top of your display if any ships have the capacity for additional modules.  Please be aware that changing modules is quite taxing, and the ships will be disabled during the reconfiguration process. I strongly recommend against changing modules in the middle of a firefight.
column2: 指挥官，  我们新的尖塔族盟友确实令人惊叹。显然，他们是培育舰船而不是制造它们！不仅如此，他们甚至能够在现场修改他们的舰船！由于我们的盟友决定服从你的指挥，他们允许你修改他们的舰船系列。你将在舰队菜单中找到一个名为'模块'的界面，位于任何可以修改的舰船系列旁边。如果你选择该选项，你将看到一个可以应用到该系列的模块菜单。  每个行星的每个尖塔族舰船系列都可以分配一个模板（因此他们首都的所有护卫舰都将相同，等等）。随着尖塔族城市变得越来越复杂，从它们培育出来的舰船能够处理额外的和/或更复杂的模块。如果任何舰船有容量容纳额外模块，你将在显示屏顶部看到提醒。  请注意，更改模块非常耗费资源，舰船在重新配置过程中将被禁用。我强烈建议不要在交火中间更改模块。

column1: Commander,  The Spire have built their second Flagship, and it's a beauty. They seem to be radiating pride. This will give our forces a lot more flexibility defending our Empire.
column2: 指挥官，  尖塔族已经建造了他们的第二艘旗舰，它非常漂亮。他们似乎散发着自豪。这将给我们的部队在保卫帝国时提供更大的灵活性。

column1: Commander,  The Spire have managed to construct their third Flagship and final flagship. They seem to be radiating determination.
column2: 指挥官，  尖塔族已经成功建造了他们的第三艘也是最后一艘旗舰。他们似乎散发着决心。

column1: Commander,  This... is a day we will remember. Assuming we survive. We have found the source of the powerful energy signal on {PlanetName}. This relic seems to have been the power core of an alien starship, a starship crewed by an unknown alien race. It seems to have hidden out of phase with our reality until our scanners triggered some kind of reaction. While only minor fragments of the ship itself have survived, a portion of the crew and rudimentary propulsion capability remain intact.   Our previous contact with the Zenith and others has made the linguistic situation at least possible, but we're still working on getting these translators to do something other than spit out gibberish. Gibberish aside, we have been able to determine that they are on the run from the AI, and want us to rescue them. We can only assume that this means taking them to a safe planet where we can protect them from the AI. Given the sheer power level present in that core, this new race clearly has the capability to be dangerous. Whether to us or the AI has yet to be determined. It's your call whether or not this is a good idea. In any event, what's left of the alien ship will now obey your commands.  Judging by local AI warp activity, we'd better get it moving!
column2: 指挥官，  这...将是一个我们铭记的日子。假设我们能幸存下来。我们在{PlanetName}找到了强大能量信号的来源。这个遗迹似乎是一艘外星飞船的动力核心，这艘飞船由一个未知的外星种族驾驶。它似乎隐藏在与我们的现实不同相位中，直到我们的扫描仪触发了某种反应。虽然飞船本身只有少量碎片幸存，但一部分船员和基本的推进能力仍然完好无损。  我们之前与泽尼斯人和其他种族的接触使得语言交流至少成为可能，但我们仍在努力让这些翻译器不仅仅是输出胡言乱语。抛开胡言乱语不谈，我们已经确定他们正在逃离人工智能，并希望我们拯救他们。我们只能假设这意味着带他们到一个安全的行星，在那里我们可以保护他们免受人工智能的伤害。考虑到那个核心中存在的巨大力量，这个新种族显然有能力造成危险。无论是对我们还是对人工智能，还有待确定。是否这样做取决于你的决定。无论如何，外星飞船的残余部分现在将服从你的命令。  根据当地的人工智能跃迁活动，我们最好让它移动起来！

column1: Commander,  We're detecting some odd energy readings in the subspace band. We should keep an eye out for anomalies and unexpected events. Something big is coming.
column2: 指挥官，  我们在次空间频段检测到一些异常的能量读数。我们应该留意异常现象和意外事件。某些重大的事情即将发生。

column1: Commander,  We've begun to understand how a Spire City works. Each city comes with several 'Casings' that support building additional Spire structures. There are a variety of these structures; some have a military purpose, others seem like they function similarly to our own metal extractors and generators. We're still working out what they all do.  It's important to note that the Spire must build a Shipyard in a city to allow for the production of their offensive ships at that city. A Shipyard can build ships for any nearby Spire fleets, even those without a shipyard at their own home city.  Their cities seem to have resonance generators that work more effectively when more of them exist. This suggests that if we can help create more Spire Cities, their existing cities might 'mark up'. Higher-Mark cities would allow for more casings and more powerful ships and structures.  Hovering over a Spire City will tell you what requirements must be met to upgrade that city's mark level. When a city is ready to upgrade you will see a Notification; interacting with that Notification will allow the city to mark up.  The Spire starts with a Flagship from it's Galactic Capitol, and gets an additional Flagship from their 3rd and 5th cities. All other cities will Bolster those fleets. When a Fleet is bolstered by a city, structures built in the bolstering city will affect the Fleet. This gives you 3 fleets, and each fleet can now be made very powerful. The Spire can choose which Fleet to bolster (See the Fleets Menu).  You cannot place spire cities adjacent to each other, or on AI Bastion or Homeworlds.
column2: 指挥官，  我们已经开始了解尖塔族城市的工作原理。每个城市都带有几个'外壳'，支持建造额外的尖塔族建筑。这些建筑有多种类型；有些具有军事用途，另一些似乎功能类似于我们自己的金属提取器和发电机。我们仍在研究它们各自的用途。  需要注意的是，尖塔族必须在城市中建造船坞，才能在该城市生产他们的攻击舰船。船坞可以为任何附近的尖塔族舰队建造舰船，即使那些舰队自己的主城市没有船坞。  他们的城市似乎有共振生成器，当更多生成器存在时工作更有效。这意味着如果我们能帮助创建更多尖塔族城市，它们现有的城市可能会'升级'。更高等级的城市将允许更多的外壳和更强大的舰船和建筑。  将鼠标悬停在尖塔族城市上将告诉你升级该城市等级必须满足的要求。当城市准备好升级时，你会看到一个通知；与该通知互动将允许城市升级。  尖塔族从它的银河首都获得一艘旗舰，并从它的第3和第5座城市获得额外的旗舰。所有其他城市将增强这些舰队。当城市增强舰队时，在增强城市中建造的建筑将影响舰队。这给你3个舰队，每个舰队现在可以变得非常强大。尖塔族可以选择增强哪个舰队（参见舰队菜单）。  你不能将尖塔族城市彼此相邻建造，也不能在人工智能堡垒或母世界上建造。

column1: Commander,  We've made some progress in understanding the Spire. Here is an attempted transliteration:  From: (attempted transliteration) Entelemaren Exaron {FactionColor} Gratitude. Surprise. Suspicion. Patience. Rebuilding. Can Help. Small. Looking. For others. </color> We have made some progress understanding the Spire's communications; it seems like Exaron is their leader or spokesbeing. As far as we can tell they were not counting on help from humans. We may know nothing of them, but they've apparently heard a lot about us. And not in a positive way. Regardless, they are willing to set our recent actions in rescuing them against our dubious reputation, and are also very grateful for our allowing them to settle their small number of refugees in this system.  It seems they have detected a new Relic in the galaxy with more refugees, and have requested that we dispatch one of our fleets to recover the object. We pressed them for some details. Given the circumstances, they were not reluctant.  It seems these Relics are powerful shards of energy that can each power a city.  We're not quite sure what these shards were powering before, but the Spire can clearly build cities around them now.  Do we want them to expand? That's a decision for you, Commander. But they have conducted themselves honorably thus far.  One final note: they caution us that the AI is aware of their presence, and that the Spire and the AI have a... complicated history. If we continue to pursue this path, we should be prepared for powerful attacks.
column2: 指挥官，  我们在理解尖塔族方面取得了一些进展。以下是尝试的音译：  来自：（尝试的音译）恩特勒马伦·埃克萨隆 {FactionColor} 感激。 惊讶。 怀疑。 耐心。 重建。 可以帮忙。一点点。 正在寻找。其他人。 </color> 我们在理解尖塔族的交流方面取得了一些进展；埃克萨隆似乎是他们的领导者或发言人。据我们所知，他们没有指望人类的帮助。我们可能对他们一无所知，但他们显然听说过很多关于我们的事情。而且不是正面的。无论如何，他们愿意将我们最近拯救他们的行动与我们可疑的声誉相权衡，并且非常感激我们允许他们在这个星系中安置少量的难民。  他们似乎在银河系中检测到了一个新的遗迹，里面有更多难民，并要求我们派遣一支舰队去回收这个物体。我们追问了一些细节。鉴于情况，他们并不不情愿。  这些遗迹似乎是强大的能量碎片，每个都能为一个城市提供动力。我们不太确定这些碎片之前在为什么提供动力，但尖塔族现在显然可以围绕它们建造城市。  我们想让他们扩张吗？那是你的决定，指挥官。但到目前为止，他们的行为是光荣的。  最后一点：他们警告我们，人工智能知道他们的存在，尖塔族和人工智能有一个...复杂的历史。如果我们继续追求这条道路，我们应该准备好迎接强大的攻击。

column1: Commander,  We've uncovered a wealth of information about the Spire from the wreckage of this AI base.  Sometime in the last few hundred years, the AI detected the Spire, who had already colonized several nearby galaxies. After much preparation, the AI launched a devastating surprise attack against the Spire homeworld. The Spire attempted to use their TransWarp technology to warp their full Imperial Fleet home to defend the center of their civilization. However, while the jump was happening the AI sabotaged the Transceiver on the homeworld. Instead of arriving in a blaze of vengeance, the Spire Fleet was trapped in inter-dimensional space. The Spire’s local defenses were no match for the AI and their Scourge allies.  In desperation, the Spire launched a number of Relics in an attempt to escape and find new places to rebuild their empire. One of those who escaped was Exaron the Seventh, Sovereign of the Imperial Spire, much to the consternation of the AI. The AI is also very worried that Exaron may now be allied to us.  If we can make the Spire Cities strong enough, we might be able to construct a new transwarp Transceiver that would allow the main Imperial Fleet to escape the interdimensional rift they've been trapped in. This would allow us to end the AI once and for all. If the AI picks up transwarp energy signatures, we should expect a truly massive AI assault.
column2: 指挥官，  我们从这个人工智能基地的残骸中发现了大量关于尖塔族的信息。  在过去的几百年里，人工智能探测到了尖塔族，他们已经在附近的几个星系建立了殖民地。经过充分准备，人工智能对尖塔族母星发起了毁灭性的突然袭击。尖塔族试图使用他们的跨维度传送技术将完整的帝国舰队传送回家保卫文明中心。然而，在跳跃过程中，人工智能破坏了母星上的收发器。尖塔族舰队没有带着复仇的光芒到达，而是被困在了维度间空间。尖塔族的当地防御无法与人工智能及其天灾军团盟友匹敌。  绝望中，尖塔族发射了许多遗迹，试图逃脱并找到重建帝国的新地方。逃脱者之一是第七代埃克萨隆，帝国尖塔族的统治者，这让人工智能非常震惊。人工智能也非常担心埃克萨隆现在可能与我们结盟。  如果我们能让尖塔族城市足够强大，我们或许能够建造一个新的跨维度传送收发器，让主力帝国舰队逃离他们被困的维度间裂隙。这将使我们能够一劳永逸地消灭人工智能。如果人工智能探测到跨维度能量信号，我们应该预料到人工智能会发动真正大规模的攻击。

column1: Commander,  We've worked through most of the basic communication barriers with the alien refugees. They call themselves the Spire. They aren't very talkative, but they are grateful to have a place for them to rebuild their Galactic Capitol on {PlanetName}.  They are also rocks.  Er, that's perhaps not very diplomatic. To put it another way: their bodies are crystalline formations. Exact composition unknown, for reasons you can deduce. They have constructed a new home base in our Galaxy and have offered to build a small number of what they called 'tiny craft' to help us. We don't know if the translators are still on the fritz or what, but the design they transmitted is far from tiny.    We're not sure if they've been studying us before now, but they've managed to build something similar in function to, though vastly more powerful than our own flagships.  We believe that the 'tiny craft' will associate with this flagship similarly to how our own strikecraft and frigates do with ours, though they seem more tightly linked to their city core and associated flagship.  We won't have the same flexibility to move ships between these fleets, but the sheer firepower they possess makes up for at least part of this inconvenience.  Finally, it seems they are scanning subspace to try to locate other refugees. Or perhaps other artifacts. We couldn't really figure out which. Either way, it seems they are our best lead to finding out what's going on... if we want to know.
column2: 指挥官，  我们已经与外星难民克服了大部分基本的沟通障碍。他们自称为尖塔族。他们不太健谈，但他们很感激有一个地方可以在{PlanetName}重建他们的银河首都。  他们也是石头。  呃，这可能不太外交。换句话说：他们的身体是结晶体。确切的成分未知，原因你可以推断。他们已经在我们的银河系中建立了一个新的家园基地，并提出建造少量他们称之为'微型飞船'的东西来帮助我们。我们不知道翻译器是否仍然故障，或者他们传输的设计远非微型。  我们不确定他们之前是否一直在研究我们，但他们已经建造了功能上类似于我们自己的旗舰，但威力要大得多的东西。我们相信这些'微型飞船'将与这艘旗舰相关联，就像我们自己的攻击机和护卫舰与我们自己的旗舰相关联一样，尽管它们似乎与它们的城市核心和相关旗舰联系更紧密。我们不会有同样的灵活性在这些舰队之间调动飞船，但它们拥有的巨大火力至少弥补了部分不便。  最后，他们似乎正在扫描次空间，试图定位其他难民。或者可能是其他文物。我们真的无法确定。无论哪种方式，他们似乎都是我们了解正在发生什么的最佳线索...如果我们想知道的话。

column1: Commander,  While our ships are state-of-the-art, our remaining engineers don't understand the meaning of the word 'rest'. They've figured out ways to modify certain ships even after construction. Not all of them, mind you, but some. If you're seeing this note, then you have at least one modular ship line at your command.  Right... ship lines. Apparently it's too complicated to configure every single ship individually, so the engineers have limited you to applying templates to entire ship lines at once. If you look at your fleet management interface, any ship line capable of modification will have a button labeled 'modules'. Ships can only support a certain number of modules, but higher mark ships may be able to support both a greater number of modules as well as more complex individual modules.  You should be aware that changing out modules will disable the ship line for a short duration, so don't plan on suddenly adding better shields to help with a 'strategic withdrawal' from enemy territory.  Now, if you'll excuse me, I need to deliver a few kilograms of pure caffeine to the engineers' lounge.
column2: 指挥官，  虽然我们的舰船是最先进的，但我们剩余的工程师并不理解'休息'这个词的含义。他们已经找到了在建造后修改某些舰船的方法。请注意，并非所有舰船都可以修改，但有些可以。如果你看到这个提示，那么你至少有一个模块化舰船系列在你的指挥之下。  对了...舰船系列。显然，单独配置每艘舰船太复杂了，所以工程师们限制你一次将模板应用到整个舰船系列。如果你查看你的舰队管理界面，任何能够修改的舰船系列都会有一个标有'模块'的按钮。舰船只能支持一定数量的模块，但更高等级的舰船可能能够支持更多数量的模块以及更复杂的单个模块。  你应该知道，更换模块会使舰船系列暂时禁用一段时间，所以不要计划突然添加更好的护盾来帮助从敌人领土'战略撤退'。  现在，如果你不介意的话，我需要给工程师休息室送几千克纯咖啡因。

column1: Commander, Coalition units on {PlanetName} have begun the slow process of dismantling the VG on the planet. We detect raising energy signatures from Dark Spire in response to this, and should prepare accordingly. It may be in our best interests to assist the Coalition in their actions to more swiftly clear the galaxy of this threat.
column2: 指挥官，{PlanetName}上的联盟部队已经开始缓慢拆解该行星上的先锋。我们检测到黑暗尖塔族对此做出的能量信号增加，应该做好相应准备。协助联盟的行动可能符合我们的最佳利益，以更快地清除银河系中的这个威胁。

column1: Commander, Coalition units on {PlanetName} have managed to destroy a Dark Spire VG. Our scanners have detected a number of derelict structures have been blasted into neighboring systems, but they look to be rapidly decaying.  More interestingly, each Dyson Sphere appears to be preparing Collector ships to go out and claim these Derelicts for their own needs. These Collectors appear to be empowered with energy from their respective spheres, making them impenetrable to normal weapon fire.  Some of our scientists believe that if we were to combine the power of one of the Dark Spire derelicts with designs they have based off the Dyson Spheres as a whole, they would be able to supercharge these structures in order to be capable of firing on the Collectors. Equally usefully, they believe that these designs could than be reused to defend our own planets at a later date.  While we do not believe our selves capable of making practical use of these derelicts beyond that, it would behoove us to assist whichever Sphere we wish to grow stronger. If we have any desire to do so, our scientists recommend you send a Battlestation to one of the Derelict planets post haste.
column2: 指挥官，{PlanetName}上的联盟部队已经成功摧毁了一个黑暗尖塔族先锋。我们的扫描仪检测到一些废弃结构被炸到邻近星系，但它们看起来正在迅速衰变。  更有趣的是，每个戴森球似乎都在准备收集舰船出去为自己收集这些残骸。这些收集者似乎被各自球体的能量赋能，使它们对普通武器火力免疫。  我们的一些科学家认为，如果我们能将一个黑暗尖塔族残骸的力量与他们基于整个戴森球的设计结合起来，他们将能够为这些结构充能，使其能够向收集者开火。同样有用的是，他们相信这些设计以后可以重新用于保卫我们自己的行星。  虽然我们不认为自己能够超出这个范围实际利用这些残骸，但协助我们希望变得更强的任何球体将对我们有利。如果我们有任何这样做的愿望，我们的科学家建议你尽快派遣一艘战斗站到其中一个残骸行星。

column1: Commander, The Exogalactic Transceiver on {PlanetName} is complete! I've been watching the skies for a long time, commander, and I have never seen radiation like that. From what the Spire tell me, it will take some time to re-establish the intergalactic channels of communication and transit. During this time, we are in grave peril, as there is simply no way the AI does not know what we are doing. This is a flare-lit tip-off, commander, and the AI is not stupid. At this stage, if it truly comes down to it, we need only protect Home Command and the transceiver itself. One way or the other, this war should be over soon.
column2: 指挥官， {PlanetName}上的星系外收发器完成了！我一直在观察天空很长时间，指挥官，我从未见过那样的辐射。 据尖塔族告诉我，重新建立星系间的通信和运输通道需要一些时间。在此期间，我们处于严重的危险之中，因为人工智能不可能不知道我们在做什么。这是一个信号灯般的提示，指挥官，人工智能并不愚蠢。 在这个阶段，如果真的到了紧要关头，我们只需要保护家园指挥中心和收发器本身。无论如何，这场战争应该很快就会结束。

column1: Commander, a Migrant has entered {PlanetName} that bares strikingly familiar markings to one we've assisted in the past.
column2: 指挥官，一个移民者进入了 {PlanetName}，上面带有与我们过去协助过的一个惊人相似的标记。

column2: 指挥官，一个中等大小的宁苏单位开始模仿我们的行动。

column1: Commander, a Neinzul Worker ship on {PlanetName} has started to decay. Our scientists believe this to be due to its inability to leave the planet, for one reason or another. Should it be unable to escape for much longer, it will soon trigger a defensive response from all Wild Hives on the planet.
column2: 指挥官，{PlanetName}上的一艘奈因祖尔工人舰船已经开始 decay。我们的科学家认为这是由于它因某种原因无法离开行星。如果它长时间无法逃脱，很快就会触发行星上所有野生蜂巢的防御反应。

column1: Commander, a Roaming Enclave has managed to safely arrive in our territory.  Once it arrived and seemed to realize it was no longer being fired at, it began slowly moving around the planet, almost as though its looking for something...  Our scientists have been preparing for this for a long time now, and they were not disappointed. The moment that the Roaming Enclave arrived, scanners picked up huge energy reading within it.  As best we can tell, there are two large power sources within the Roaming Enclave, one situated towards the center of the ship, and another towards its engines.  We have managed to translate even more of its language, but it is still quite rough.  Translation: Curious, the m... warted by the cr... erhaps. Yes, ye... a good nest indeed.
column2: 指挥官，一个漫游飞地已经设法安全到达我们的领土。  一旦它到达并似乎意识到它不再被攻击，它开始缓慢地在行星周围移动，就好像它在寻找什么...  我们的科学家为这一刻准备了很久，他们没有失望。漫游飞地一到达，扫描仪就在内部检测到巨大的能量读数。  据我们所知，漫游飞地内有两个大型电源，一个位于舰船中心附近，另一个位于引擎附近。  我们已经设法翻译了更多它的语言，但它仍然相当粗糙。  翻译：好奇，m...被 cr... erhaps 击中。是的，ye...确实是一个好巢。

column1: Commander, a Roaming Enclave has safely arrived into our territory.
column2: 指挥官，一个游荡飞地已安全抵达我们的领土。

column2: 指挥官，一个泽尼斯矿工杀死了一个戴森球。这是一个悲剧的日子。

column1: Commander, a number of Neinzul, calling themselves the Pearl Custodians, have warped onto our homeworld. They have broadcast a request for alliance, which we have already accepted, and given us a brief explanation of why they are here.  They are one of a number of splinter groups of a now defunct Neinzul Empire, who have split apart due to infighting. In a bid to reclaim their lost safety, they have been scouring the universe looking for aliens to integrate with, due to their far decreased numbers. They believe that a number of their fellow Custodians may also be arriving in the galaxy soon, if they haven't already, and will each attempt to align themselves with another group. When questioned if they believes any to be daring enough to align with the AI, they all collectively replied with a single word: Diamond.  While we won't bore you with the more specifics of our agreement Commander, there are four important things you should know. First, the Custodians are a very powerful, and organized, force. They are ready to prove themselves against our enemies to cement the alliance, but will not intentionally kill themselves to do so. Expect Roaming Enclaves of both our allies, and others, to be much more willing to retreat from a fight.  Second, all of the Roaming Enclaves, that you may have already seen on our homeworld, share an innate bond with a Hive that they brought with them through Warp Space. The Hive will be passively producing warships to assist its aligned Roaming Enclave over time. Should either die, the other will quickly die with it. The same logic applies to any other Custodians we run into; if a Custodian group gets too powerful, aim for the Hives.  Third, these are but a fraction of their total forces. They have split out in thousands of directions while scouring the universe, and communications with their various groups will take time. So while they are capable of producing additional Clanlings and Younglings to bolster their forces, additional Roaming Enclaves will be reliant on these outside forces arriving.  Lastly, each Custodian group we run into shares the same Youngling and Clanling style, but has unique Roaming Enclave warships. We would be wise to see what each Custodian is capable of before engaging them in combat.
column2: 指挥官，一些自称珍珠守护者的奈因祖尔已经跃迁到了我们的母星。他们 broadcast 了一个联盟请求，我们已经接受了，并简要解释了他们为什么在这里。  他们是现在已不存在的奈因祖尔帝国的几个分裂团体之一，由于内斗而分裂。为了夺回失去的安全，他们一直在宇宙中搜寻外星人进行融合，因为他们的人数大大减少。他们相信他们的一些守护者同伴也可能很快到达银河系，如果他们还没有到达的话，并且每个都会尝试与另一个团体结盟。当被问及是否认为有人胆敢与人工智能结盟时，他们集体回答了一个词：钻石。  虽然我们不会让你厌烦我们协议的更多细节，指挥官，但有四件重要的事情你应该知道。首先，守护者是一支非常强大且有组织的部队。他们准备好向我们的敌人证明自己以巩固联盟，但不会为此故意自杀。预期漫游飞地，无论是我们的盟友还是其他人，都会更愿意从战斗中撤退。  其次，所有漫游飞地，你可能已经在我们的母星上看到过，与它们通过跃迁空间带来的蜂巢有着天生的联系。随着时间的推移，蜂巢将被动地生产战舰来协助其结盟的漫游飞地。如果其中一个死亡，另一个也将很快死亡。同样的逻辑适用于我们遇到的任何其他守护者；如果一个守护者团体变得太强大，就瞄准蜂巢。  第三，这只是他们全部部队的一小部分。他们在搜寻宇宙时分裂成数千个方向，与各个团体的通信将需要时间。所以虽然他们能够生产额外的氏族成员和幼体来增强他们的力量，但额外的漫游飞地将依赖于这些外部力量的到来。  最后，我们遇到的每个守护者团体都共享相同的幼体和氏族成员风格，但拥有独特的漫游飞地战舰。在与他们战斗之前，了解每个守护者的能力是明智的。

column1: Commander, after more time analyzing this Architrave, it looks like we may be able to communicate with them via Hacking. There is a Portal on {PlanetName} that seems to be how they are maintaining presence in our galaxy.  While it doesn't look like we can destroy the portal, perhaps we could communicate with them by Hacking it? Having some sort of temporary truce might be worth the battle it would take to achieve the truce.  Since the ZA will get more and more powerful the longer their planets are under attack, it would be easiest to strike when they are at peace, since this will be a long fight.  (If you selected Player-Allied Architrave in the game lobby then they will always be your ally, though you can't hack them)
column2: 指挥官，经过更多时间分析这个拱顶石，看起来我们或许可以通过黑客入侵与它们进行通信。{PlanetName}上有一个传送门，似乎是它们在我们银河系中维持存在的手段。  虽然看起来我们无法摧毁传送门，但也许我们可以通过黑客入侵与它们通信？某种临时休战可能值得为实现休战而进行的战斗。  由于拱顶石的行星受到攻击的时间越长，它们就会变得越强大，因此在它们和平时发动攻击将是最容易的，因为这将是一场漫长的战斗。  （如果你在游戏大厅选择了玩家联盟拱顶石，那么它们将永远是你的盟友，尽管你不能入侵它们）

column1: Commander, as you're aware, the AI command stations have a distinctive radiation signature to them. We've just noticed that signature dissipate from a system near the Dark Zenith presence. Our scientists believe that the Dark Zenith have started directly attacking AI strongholds. While we're glad to have the AI focus on a new threat, it does seem to react to threats with an increasing allocation of resources. Given that we're also fighting the AI, those 'resources' might become problematic for us as well.      If the Dark Zenith are claiming systems for their own, we must assume that they won't stop with the AI. I strongly recommend building defenses before the Dark Zenith reach our territory. Strong defenses.
column2: 指挥官，如你所知，人工智能指挥站有独特的辐射特征。我们刚刚注意到黑暗泽尼斯附近的星系中该特征消失了。我们的科学家认为黑暗泽尼斯已经开始直接攻击人工智能据点。虽然我们很高兴人工智能关注新威胁，但它似乎确实会对威胁做出越来越大的资源分配反应。鉴于我们也在与人工智能作战，这些'资源'可能也会对我们造成问题。  如果黑暗泽尼斯正在为自己夺取星系，我们必须假设他们不会止步于人工智能。我强烈建议在黑暗泽尼斯到达我们的领土之前建立防御。强大的防御。
