column1: Commander, be careful of AI warp gates.  Warp Gates are used by the AI to warp in Waves of units against your planets. Sniping warp gates except for those next to heavily defended planets will let you control AI aggression, albeit at a small AIP cost.  Right now, our homeworld is open to AI attacks by leaving Warp Gates alive on plants adjacent to our Homeworld. We either need to very heavily defend our Homeworld or we should consider killing the Warp Gates to better protect yourself from AI Aggression.
column2: 指挥官，小心AI跃迁门。AI利用跃迁门向你的行星传送攻击波。狙杀跃迁门（重防行星旁的除外）可以控制AI侵略性，代价是少量AIP。目前母星因相邻行星上的跃迁门而易受AI攻击，我们需要加强母星防御或摧毁跃迁门以保护自己。

column1: Commander, be careful of AI warp gates.  Warp Gates are used by the AI to warp in Waves of units against your planets. Sniping warp gates except for those next to heavily defended planets will let you control AI aggression, albeit at a small AIP cost. This technique is called 'Gate Raiding'.  Right now, our homeworld is open to AI Waves since there are Warp Gates alive on plants adjacent to our Homeworld. We either need to very heavily defend our Homeworld, or we should consider killing the Warp Gates to better protect ourselves from AI Aggression.  Killing Warp Gates will prevent waves from being launched , but the AI can still send conventional forces through those planets (like Hunter ships).
column2: 指挥官，小心AI的跃迁门。  跃迁门被AI用来向你的行星传送一波又一波的单位。狙击跃迁门（除了那些位于重兵防守行星旁边的跃迁门）可以让你控制AI的侵略性，尽管这会带来少量的AIP值增加。这种技巧被称为“跃迁门突袭”。  目前，由于母星相邻行星上的跃迁门仍然存在，我们的母星容易受到AI的攻击波。我们要么加强母星的防御，要么考虑摧毁这些跃迁门，以更好地保护自己免受AI的攻击。  摧毁跃迁门可以阻止攻击波的发射，但AI仍然可以通过这些行星派遣常规部队（如猎人单位）。

column1: Commander, by one reason or another, we now have access to a Wild Hive on {PlanetName}.  While our local ships and structure are still reporting degradation in their abilities, our command station seems to at least somewhat offset the effect for now. The station commander does note his worry about how well they will be able to perform if more Metal Generators were to be infected, however.  Our scientists, giddy to finally be able to study them further in depth, are in various states of excitement. Their initial findings confirm most of what we already know, but more interestingly there appears to be an odd mutation that they have not yet seen before. A number of the small Neinzul appear to be using powerful sensors of their own on our scientists in kind, and they are hopeful.
column2: 指挥官，出于某种原因，我们现在可以访问{PlanetName}上的一个野生蜂巢。  虽然我们当地的舰船和建筑仍然报告其能力下降，但我们的指挥站似乎至少在目前部分抵消了这种影响。然而， station指挥官确实表达了他对如果更多金属发电机被感染，它们将能够表现多好的担忧。  我们的科学家，终于能够更深入地研究它们，处于各种兴奋状态。他们的初步发现证实了我们已经知道的大部分内容，但更有趣的是，似乎有一种他们以前从未见过的奇怪变异。一些小奈因祖尔似乎正在使用它们自己的强大传感器来扫描我们的科学家，他们对此充满希望。

column1: Commander, for a while now one of the Migrant Neinzul has made itself at home on our planets, even assisting in some small scale fighting. However, it appears to have opened another wormhole to leave this galaxy, and has already made its way through.  Before it left however, two things of great note occurred. The most practical thing we noticed was it left a structure behind that our scientists have dubbed a 'Neinzul Chamber'. From what we can tell, a brand new type of Neinzul is currently being created within, and they urge us to protect it as best we can.  The other thing of note was the message it left behind. Due to its relatively short stay on our planets, we were unable to perfect our understanding of its language, but the intent was received.  Message: We thank you creatures of bone. Though we... your uses of me... required. We will re... and bring more of our kind with us. Please ke... safe.
column2: 指挥官，一段时间以来，一个移民奈因祖尔在我们的行星上安家，甚至协助了一些小规模战斗。然而，它似乎打开了另一个虫洞离开这个银河系，并且已经通过了。  然而，在它离开之前，发生了两件值得注意的事情。我们注意到的最实际的事情是它留下了一个结构，我们的科学家称之为'奈因祖尔腔室'。据我们所知，一种全新类型的奈因祖尔目前正在其中被创造，他们敦促我们尽最大努力保护它。  另一件值得注意的事情是它留下的信息。由于它在我们行星上停留的时间相对较短，我们无法完美理解它的语言，但意图被接收到了。  信息：我们感谢你们这些骨质生物。虽然我们...你们对我的利用...是必要的。我们将 re...并带更多我们的同类来。请 ke...安全。

column1: Commander, if you need to load ships into a flagship and then immediately move the flagship, it can be frustrating if the flagship leaves the planet before the ships finish loading. You can use the Wait For Stragglers option in the Automation Settings to ask your flagships to wait for nearby ships to load before leaving the planet; this setting applies on friendly planets or neutral planets without enemies.
column2: 指挥官，如果你需要将单位装载到旗舰上，然后立即移动旗舰，而旗舰在单位装载完成前就离开行星，这会很让人沮丧。你可以使用自动化设置中的“等待掉队单位”选项，让你的旗舰在离开行星前等待附近的单位装载完成；此设置适用于友方行星或没有敌人的中立行星。

column1: Commander, it looks like we are running low on metal!  There are 2 easy ways of increasing metal production. The first is to upgrade your home command station via the Fleets menu. The second is to upgrade Metal Generation via the Tech menu.  Finally you can always capture more planets and build Economic or Logistical command stations there.

column1: Commander, it looks like we are running low on metal!  There are 2 easy ways of increasing metal production. The first is to upgrade your home command station via the Fleets menu. The second is to upgrade Metal Generation via the Tech menu.  Finally you can always capture more planets and build Economic or Logistical command stations there.
column2: 指挥官，看来我们的金属资源不足了！有两种简单方法提高金属产量：一是通过舰队菜单升级母星指挥站；二是通过科技菜单升级金属生产。最后还可以占领更多行星并在上面建造经济型或后勤型指挥站。

column1: Commander, it looks like we have a Vassal faction. Vassal factions are factions we can give missions to. Vassals are independent and will still do their own thing for the most part, but they are willing to take some advice from us in terms of their targets.  To give our vassals a mission, open the Edit Planet menu on the Galaxy map and set the Priority Level to be Fire_Low/Med/High/Override (these options are at the very bottom). When all the enemies on that planet are killed, the Mission will end for the vassals, so there's no way to currently ask a vassal to defend something (defensive stuff will be added when Chris gives a proper UI).  Low priority targets are added as valid targets for the faction, and made to look extra tasty, but aren't always going to be the top priority for the faction.  Medium/High/Override priority items are always more important than other things that faction can be doing.  If your vassals have a mission to go to a planet, they are much more willing to follow your forces to that planet as well.  Eventually Chris will give us a better UI for this.
column2: 指挥官，看起来我们有一个附庸派系。附庸派系是我们可以给予任务的派系。附庸是独立的，大多数情况下仍然会做自己的事情，但他们愿意在目标方面接受我们的一些建议。  要给我们的附庸一个任务，在银河系地图上打开编辑行星菜单，将优先级设置为Fire_Low/Med/High/Override（这些选项在最底部）。当那个行星上的所有敌人被杀死时，任务将为附庸结束，所以目前没有办法要求附庸防御任何东西（防御性内容将在Chris提供适当的UI时添加）。  低优先级目标被添加为该派系的有效目标，并使其看起来特别有吸引力，但并不总是会成为该派系的首要任务。  中/高/覆盖优先级项目总是比该派系可以做的其他事情更重要。  如果你的附庸有一个前往某个行星的任务，他们也更愿意跟随你的部队前往那个行星。  最终Chris会给我们一个更好的UI。

Projecting force into this universe is very expensive for them, and they will only do so sporadically; to fight other Architraves, to defend themselves, or on their infrequent attempts to expand. When at peace, ships that can't be stored inside Spawners will attrition slowly over time, since the Architrave can't afford to maintain them.

column1: Commander, now that you've expanded beyond your home system, there are many other possibilities available to you.  If you get stuck at any point and aren't sure what to do, the Intel tab is a good way to find goals and targets to work on.  You may also find the following ideas to be useful:  Don't neglect defense of your systems, especially your homeworld.  If your home command station is destroyed, you will lose the game.  Hack TSS (Turret Schematic Servers) for additional turret defenses or ODSS (Other Defensive Schematic Servers) for supplemental defenses and scale up your defenses to keep up with the strength of incoming AI waves.  Battlestations and their turrets are powerful assets, both in attack and defense.  Don't forget to make use of them.  Capturing a system with an ARS, TSS, or ODSS will cut the hacking cost for those structures in half, but AIP will continue to rise for every system you acquire.  Consider carefully what planets you need to take, and what planets you can do without. Make sure you have long-term and short-term plans for defending any system you take, before you take it.  If a planet cannot be effectively defended, it can at times be useful to just capture it long enough to take any fleets or other capturables and extract the hacking and science, then fall back to a more defensible location.  Read tooltips on any ships or structures you are not familiar with.  Knowledge is power;  some units are more hazardous than they may initially appear.  Hold C and click on any tech upgrade, ARS, etc. to see more details on what you are about to acquire.  Use your science;  you can get a refund for a modest hacking points cost for anything you wish to reinvest later.  Ships and turrets that use the same weapons techs as those you already have are particularly valuable.  Direct upgrades of command stations can be very helpful if you need an economic boost or some additional firepower in a particular location.  Visit the Arcen discord to get answers from a helpful community of players, especially if you run into game elements you do not understand.  Have fun, and choose your strategy carefully!  Many galaxies and challenges await you, with a wide variety of factions available to both aid and oppose your advance.
column2: 指挥官，现在你已经将势力扩展到母星系统之外，还有许多其他可能性可供你选择。 如果你在任何时候陷入困境，不确定该做什么，情报标签是寻找目标和任务的好方法。 你可能还会发现以下想法很有用：  不要忽视你的星系防御，尤其是母星。 如果你的母星指挥站被摧毁，你将输掉游戏。 入侵TSS（炮塔蓝图服务器）以获得额外的炮塔防御，或入侵ODSS（其他防御蓝图服务器）以获得补充防御，并提升你的防御能力以跟上AI攻击波的强度。  机动平台及其炮塔是强大的资产，在进攻和防御中都很有用。 不要忘记利用它们。  占领拥有ARS、TSS或ODSS的星系将使这些建筑的入侵成本减半，但每占领一个星系，AIP值都会继续上升。 仔细考虑你需要占领哪些行星，哪些行星可以放弃。 在占领任何星系之前，确保你有长期和短期的防御计划。 如果一个行星无法得到有效防御，有时只占领它足够长的时间来获取任何舰队或其他可占领物品，并提取入侵点数和科技值，然后撤回至更易防御的位置，可能会很有用。  阅读你不熟悉的任何单位或建筑的提示信息。 知识就是力量； 有些单位可能比最初看起来更危险。 按住C键并点击任何科技升级、ARS等，以查看你即将获得的物品的更多详细信息。  使用你的科技值； 你可以花费少量的入侵点数来退还你花费的科技值，以便日后重新投资。 使用与你现有武器科技相同的单位和炮塔尤其有价值。 如果你需要在特定位置获得经济提升或额外火力，直接升级指挥站会非常有帮助。  访问Arcen discord，从乐于助人的玩家社区那里获得答案，特别是如果你遇到不理解的游戏元素。  玩得开心，并谨慎选择你的策略！ 许多星系和挑战在等着你，有各种各样的派系可以帮助或阻碍你的前进。

column1: Commander, one important trick is to put your flagships in 'Load Mode'. This lets them operate as Transports to move your ships around the map very quickly.                         The default hotkey to enter Load Mode is 'L' and to then unload, hit 'U'. You can override this in the Controls menu.                         For a more advanced option, hit 'Y' instead of 'L': your fleet will wait until it's loaded before departing, and will automatically unload again if it arrives somewhere with enemies present.
column2: 指挥官，一个重要技巧是将旗舰设为『装载模式』。这能让它们作为运输舰在地图上快速移动单位。默认进入装载模式的快捷键是L，卸载按U。你可以在控制菜单中修改。

column1: Commander, one important trick is to put your flagships in 'Load Mode'. This lets them operate as Transports to move your ships around the map very quickly.  Flagships in Load Mode are very useful for bypassing AI defenses to hit critical targets.  The default hotkey to enter Load Mode is 'L' and to then unload, hit 'U'. You can override this in the Controls menu.  For a more advanced option, hit 'Y' (Order: Load and Go) instead of 'L': your fleet will wait until it's loaded before departing, and will automatically unload again if it arrives somewhere with enemies present.

column1: Commander, one of the Wild Hives in the galaxy have been attacked, and have responded in force. A number of Clanlings, dubbed 'Soldiers,' have emerged from the Hive and have been engaging their aggressors.  Interestingly, our scientists have noticed that while in this aggravated state, their normal targeting scramblers that prevent most ships from attacking them go haywire, and even the smallest of strikecraft are now able to attack them. While this does not affect our ability to direct our forces' ability to manually target them, this may create openings for other factions to punch a hole in their power on the planet.  Lastly, it looks as though swarms of smaller repair ships, too small for our scanners to accurately detect, are waiting to repair the damages dealt to the Hive. Based on the quantity of them near the hive, our scientists believe them to be capable of rapid repair when given the chance.
column2: 指挥官，银河系中一个野生蜂巢受到了攻击，并以武力回应。一些被称为'士兵'的氏族成员从蜂巢中出现，一直在与攻击者交战。  有趣的是，我们的科学家注意到，在这种激怒状态下，它们正常的瞄准干扰器（阻止大多数舰船攻击它们）失灵了，即使是最小的攻击机现在也能攻击它们。虽然这并不影响我们指挥部队手动瞄准它们的能力，但这可能会为其他派系在行星上打破它们的力量创造机会。  最后，看起来成群的小型维修舰船，太小以至于我们的扫描仪无法准确检测，正在等待修复对蜂巢造成的 damage。根据蜂巢附近它们的数量，我们的科学家相信它们在有机会时能够进行快速修复。

column1: Commander, our scanners on {PlanetName} are reporting strange anomalies. As best we can tell, what appears to be wormholes have opened up on the edge of the system. Unlike the traditional kind that we know of however, these don't appear to originate from our galaxy, and are more curiously orbiting around the sector.  We have noted a number of smaller strikecraft flooding out of the wormhole, though they are rapidly decomposing upon reaching our space. Our Military Leaders report them broadcasting an open signal that we were able to replicate remotely, and we believe these smaller ships to be friendly.  Of more note is a much larger signal coming through the wormhole which our scientists believe to be from a ship of a much larger scale than these swarms. It may be worth investigating in person. We will continue to monitor the situation and brief you when we learn more.

column1: Commander, our scanners on {PlanetName} have located a startling discovery. Up until this point, every single opposing force we've discovered has avoided the use of the various Metal Generators spread throughout the galaxy. However, it appears these aliens have begun to tap into them much as we have. These 'Wild Hives,' coined by your Science Advisor, pose a potential roadblock to the campaign.     This infestation appears to be deeply ingrained into the metal generator, and we can detect a large number of sentient life flowing throughout the generator, growing stronger over time. It does not seem to be inherently hostile, but it does seem to be causing issues with engines and weaponry on its planet.  Your Military Advisor strongly recommends a show of force, before they are allowed to spread and cripple your already strained war economy.  Your Science Advisor however recommends a softer approach. They claim that we won't need every single resource in the galaxy, and that this is an incredible attempt to get an in depth look into alien life. They do reluctantly agree that, if they claim too much of our territory however, force may be required.
column2: 指挥官，我们在{PlanetName}上的扫描仪发现了一个惊人的发现。到目前为止，我们发现的每一个敌对势力都避免使用散布在整个银河系中的各种金属发电机。然而，这些外星人似乎已经开始像我们一样利用它们。这些'野生蜂巢'，由你的科学顾问命名，对战役构成了潜在的障碍。  这种侵扰似乎已经深深嵌入金属发电机中，我们可以检测到大量有感知的生命在整个发电机中流动，随着时间的推移变得越来越强大。它似乎并非天生敌对，但它似乎正在对其行星上的引擎和武器造成问题。  你的军事顾问强烈建议在允许它们传播并削弱你已经紧张的战时经济之前展示武力。  然而，你的科学顾问建议采用更温和的方法。他们声称我们不需要银河系中的每一个资源，这是深入了解外星生命的绝佳机会。他们确实勉强同意，如果它们占据我们太多领土，可能需要使用武力。

column1: Commander, our scanners on {PlanetName} have reported that a much larger vessel has arrived from the wormhole, before the wormhole immediately closed behind it.  From what we can see, this ship, dubbed the Roaming Enclave, while weak by itself, has some of the most potent acidic weaponry we have ever seen.  Interestingly, the moment the wormholes stopped, so too did the production of the Youngling craft. It appears the Roaming Enclave lacks the capabilities to create younglings by itself.  The ship is broadcasting a relatively confused signal that we are struggling to decrypt, but we have roughly translated it at the bottom of this entry. Regardless of this signal's intent, the previous signal of friendship that the younglings had is also being broadcast by this 'Enclave', so it may be in our interests to investigate in person.  Translation: Confusion... metal yet again... to us its fail... we must find a new h... younglings must not be in vain. Safety mu... clanlings.
column2: 指挥官，我们在{PlanetName}上的扫描仪报告说，一艘更大的舰船从虫洞中到达，然后虫洞立即在它后面关闭了。  据我们所见，这艘被命名为漫游飞地的舰船，虽然本身很弱，但拥有一些我们见过的最强大的酸性武器。  有趣的是，虫洞停止的那一刻，幼体舰船的生产也停止了。看来漫游飞地缺乏自己创造幼体的能力。  这艘舰船正在广播一个相对混乱的信号，我们正在努力解密，但我们在本条目的底部大致翻译了它。无论这个信号的意图是什么，幼体之前 broadcast 的友好信号也被这个'飞地' broadcast，所以亲自调查可能符合我们的利益。  翻译：困惑...又是金属...对我们来说它失败了...我们必须找到一个新的 h...幼体不能白白牺牲。安全 mu...氏族成员。

column1: Commander, our scientists have done an analysis of the {FactionColor}Dark Zenith</color> economy.   They use a variety of resources to build their units. To create these resources, they use a series of Terminii, one for each of their 6 resources. The base of their economy is a string of Octiron Terminii that harvest the metal.  Transports then move the resouces around their empire. They have three lower-tier resources (Thaumite, Chelonium, and Alkahest) which are created by manipulating Octiron. Then there are two advanced resources (Izumite and Scrith) which are made from the other lower resources.  They can then use these resources to build mobile forces and constructor units at their Epistyles. With enough resources, these Epistyles can construct a wide variety of new structures and defenses, as well as a very wide variety of powerful ships.  The Dark Zenith ships range from small fleetships to some truly terrifying Golems like the Ymir. As if the base forms weren't terrifying enough, they will sometimes infuse their ships with extra resources. This exotic infusion allows their ships to have additional abilities beyond the norm.  Each type of resource infusion imparts different attributes: Thaumite: Stout ships; these ships are more durable. Chelonium: Fortified ships; these ships have an additional defensive system. Alkahest: Spirited Ships, these are cloaked and faster.  Izumite: Enraged; these ships have an additional weapon to take on single, strong adversaries. Skrith: Sinister; these ships have an additional weapon for crowd control.
column2: 指挥官，我们的科学家对{FactionColor}黑暗泽尼斯</color>经济进行了分析。  他们使用多种资源来建造单位。为了创造这些资源，他们使用一系列终端，每种资源一个。他们经济的基础是一系列收割金属的黑曜终端。  然后运输船在他们的帝国周围移动资源。他们有三种低级资源（ thaumite、chelonium和alkahest），通过操纵黑曜石创造。然后有两种高级资源（izumite和scrith），由其他低级资源制成。  然后他们可以使用这些资源在他们的柱廊中建造机动部队和建造单位。有了足够的资源，这些柱廊可以建造各种新的建筑和防御工事，以及各种强大的舰船。  黑暗泽尼斯舰船从小型舰队舰船到一些真正可怕的魔像，如尤弥尔。仿佛基础形式还不够可怕，他们有时会用额外的资源注入他们的舰船。这种外来注入使他们的舰船拥有超出常规的额外能力。  每种资源注入赋予不同的属性： thaumite：坚固舰船；这些舰船更耐用。 chelonium：强化舰船；这些舰船有额外的防御系统。 alkahest：迅捷舰船；这些是隐形且更快的。 izumite：狂怒；这些舰船有额外的武器来对付单一强大的敌人。 skrith：阴险；这些舰船有额外的武器用于群体控制。

column1: Commander, our scouts have reported an interesting development. A number of ships produced by the various Dyson Spheres in our galaxy have apparently managed to call a ceasefire with each other, and more impressively the AI, and are banding together in what we could best translate as the Anti-Dark Spire Coalition.  Our scouts report that this does not appear to have stifled the regular unit production that we have grown accustomed to from these Spheres, and that these forces are acting independently of their home sphere's desires.  This Coalition seems to only care about the Dark Spire scattered around the galaxy.
column2: 指挥官，我们的侦察兵报告了一个有趣的发展。我们银河系中各种戴森球产生的许多舰船显然已经设法彼此停火，更令人印象深刻的是与人工智能停火，并联合起来，我们可以最好地翻译为反黑暗尖塔族联盟。  我们的侦察兵报告说，这似乎并没有抑制我们从这些戴森球中习惯的常规单位生产，而且这些部队独立于他们母球的意愿行事。  这个联盟似乎只关心散布在银河系中的黑暗尖塔族。

column1: Commander, the AI overlord has become a Galactic Control Ship! It seems to have temporarily changed phase so our weapons can't hit it, and it's heading for our Home Command Station! We won't be able to hit it until it re-enters phase with our ships.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         We think the phase-change is only sustainable while it is on a Bastion World. This new Galactic Control Ship is very heavily armed; we may need some new strategies to deal with it. It seems particularly good at destroying strikecraft.
column2: 指挥官，人工智能霸主已经变成了银河控制舰！它似乎暂时改变了相位，所以我们的武器无法击中它，它正在向我们的家园指挥站前进！在它重新进入与我们舰船的相位之前，我们将无法击中它。  我们认为相位变化只有在它在堡垒世界上时才是可持续的。这艘新的银河控制舰武装非常强大；我们可能需要一些新的策略来对付它。它似乎特别擅长摧毁攻击机。

column1: Commander, the AI overlord is escaping! It seems to have temporarily changed phase so our weapons can't hit it, and it's heading for our Home Command Station! We won't be able to hit it until it re-enters phase with our ships.  We think the phase-change is only sustainable while it is on a Bastion World. This new Overlord is very heavily armed; we may need some new strategies to deal with it. It seems particularly good at destroying strikecraft.
column2: 指挥官，AI霸主正在逃离！它似乎暂时改变了相位，我们的武器无法命中它，而且它正朝着我们的主指挥站前进！在它与我们的单位重新处于同一相位之前，我们无法攻击它。  我们认为这种相位变化只有在它位于堡垒世界时才能维持。这个新的霸主装备极其精良；我们可能需要一些新策略来应对它。它似乎特别擅长摧毁突击舰。

column1: Commander, the Sapper Corps is here to help. They build Habitats, each supporting one Sapper. Sappers will move around the galaxy planting Crystals; once those crystals flower they can be harvested for more resources. They will use these resources to build several types of units to help us!  First, they build some types of typical defenses; turrets, tractors, etc. Second, they can build Beachheaders; these structures will launch turrets to remote planets when we are fighting there. Third they can build Watchtowers, which will launch temporary ships to defend nearby planets.  Sapper allies have no downside; they are a pure buff to the player.
column2: 指挥官，工兵部队来这里帮忙了。他们建造栖息地，每个栖息地支持一名工兵。工兵将在银河系中四处种植水晶；一旦这些水晶开花，它们就可以被收获以获得更多资源。他们将使用这些资源来建造几种类型的单位来帮助我们！  首先，他们建造一些典型的防御设施；炮塔、牵引器等。 其次，他们可以建造滩头阵地；当我们战斗时，这些结构将向遥远的行星发射炮塔。 第三，他们可以建造瞭望塔，这将发射临时舰船来保卫附近的行星。  工兵盟友没有缺点；他们是对玩家的纯粹增强。

column1: Commander, the Spire have built their first Destroyer Neural Net. The city's flagship will now be able to build Destroyers when it is near a Spire Shipyard.  These ships pack devastating armaments against large single targets, but require significantly more resources to build.
column2: 指挥官，尖塔族已经建造了他们的第一个驱逐舰神经网络。城市的旗舰现在可以在靠近尖塔族船坞时建造驱逐舰。  这些舰船对大型单一目标具有毁灭性的武器，但建造需要更多的资源。

column1: Commander, the Spire have built their first Frigate Neural Net. The flagship attached to this city core will now be able to build Frigates when it is near a Spire Shipyard, even one belonging to another city.   While the Spire call these 'toy' ships, these are still very intimidating warships. Lets see what they can do!
column2: 指挥官，尖塔族已经建造了他们的第一个护卫舰神经网络。与这个城市核心相连的旗舰现在可以在靠近尖塔族船坞时建造护卫舰，即使是属于另一个城市的船坞。  虽然尖塔族称这些为'玩具'舰船，但它们仍然是非常令人生畏的战舰。让我们看看它们能做什么！

column1: Commander, the ability to queue fleet unload is very useful! If you have a loaded fleet you can give it a move order on the galaxy map, then hold Shift and press 'U' to queue the unload after the move completes.  You can queue other sorts of commands with Shift as well, but being able to tell a fleet 'Go to this battle and unload your ships when you arrive' is extremely useful.
column2: 指挥官，队列舰队卸载功能非常有用！如果你有一艘满载的舰队，你可以在星系地图上给它下达移动命令，然后按住Shift键并按“U”键，在移动完成后队列卸载。  你也可以用Shift键队列其他类型的命令，但能够告诉舰队“前往这场战斗，到达后卸载单位”是非常有用的。

column1: Commander, the arrival of the Dark Zenith has had a tremendous impact on morale throughout our empire, with many unsure about what we plan to do when faced with this new overwhelming threat.  However, there is news coming in from our scouts picketed throughout the galaxy of hope against these invaders: A number of ships produced by the various Dyson Spheres in our galaxy have apparently managed to call a ceasefire with each other, and more impressively the AI, and are banding together in what we could best translate as the Nadir Coalition.  Our scouts report that this does not appear to have stifled the regular unit production that we have grown accustomed to from these Spheres, and that these forces are acting independently of their home sphere's desires.  This Coalition seems to only care about the Dark Zenith menace, and will otherwise leave factions alone. Banding together with their strike forces may allow us to make headway where we would otherwise struggle to do so.
column2: 指挥官，黑暗泽尼斯人的到来对整个帝国的士气产生了巨大影响，许多人不确定当我们面对这个新的压倒性威胁时我们计划做什么。  然而，从我们遍布银河系的侦察兵那里传来了希望的消息：我们银河系中各种戴森球产生的许多舰船显然已经设法彼此停火，更令人印象深刻的是与人工智能停火，并联合起来，我们可以最好地翻译为深渊联盟。  我们的侦察兵报告说，这似乎并没有抑制我们从这些戴森球中习惯的常规单位生产，而且这些部队独立于他们母球的意愿行事。  这个联盟似乎只关心黑暗泽尼斯威胁，否则会忽略其他派系。与他们的打击部队联合可能让我们在原本困难的地方取得进展。

column1: Commander, the arrival of the Dark Zenith has had a tremendous impact on morale throughout our empire, with many unsure about what we plan to do when faced with this new overwhelming threat. While the Dark Spire alone were a major threat by themselves, having yet another force seemingly hellbent on the destruction of the galaxy does not bode well.  However, shortly after their arrival, the existing Anti-Dark Spire Coalition has begun transforming itself in response to this new threat, and have re-branded themselves as the Nadir Coalition, and new ships that we have seen being produced hold this new identifier.  Our scouts report that this does not appear to have stifled the regular unit production that we have grown accustomed to from these Spheres, and that these forces are acting independently of their home sphere's desires. Apparently even a galaxy ending threat isn't enough to completely sooth relations.  This newly branded Nadir Coalition seems to be preparing to fight the Dark Zenith with the same zeal we have seen in their fight against the Dark Spire. Banding together with their strike forces may allow us to make headway where we would otherwise struggle to do so.
column2: 指挥官，黑暗泽尼斯人的到来对整个帝国的士气产生了巨大影响，许多人不确定当我们面对这个新的压倒性威胁时我们计划做什么。虽然黑暗尖塔族本身就是一个主要威胁，但又有另一支似乎决心摧毁银河系的力量，这并不是好兆头。  然而，在他们到来后不久，现有的反黑暗尖塔族联盟已经开始自我转变以应对这个新威胁，并将自己重塑为深渊联盟，我们看到正在生产的新舰船带有这个新标识。  我们的侦察兵报告说，这似乎并没有抑制我们从这些戴森球中习惯的常规单位生产，而且这些部队独立于他们母球的意愿行事。显然，即使是银河系终结的威胁也不足以完全缓和关系。  这个新品牌的深渊联盟似乎正准备以我们看到的他们对抗黑暗尖塔族时同样的热情来对抗黑暗泽尼斯人。与他们的打击部队联合可能让我们在原本困难的地方取得进展。

column1: Commander, the familiar Roaming Enclave has safely arrived into our territory.  It seems, as best as our scientists can tell, happy to be back. While its young Clanling charges are still sticking close, many of our ships and structures on the planet are detecting incoming scans from the smaller ships.  It looks like the Enclave is preparing to leave again, due to the detected power sources rising once more, but it seems to be... preparing its young charges for its leave, almost pushing them towards our ships to get them attached.      Translation: These are the boned ones, the... the Bone Nest. Stick near... aid them, for they... flourishing after the great collapse.
column2: 指挥官，熟悉的漫游飞地已经安全到达我们的领土。  看起来，据我们的科学家所知，它很高兴回来。虽然它的年轻氏族护卫仍然紧贴着它，但我们在行星上的许多舰船和建筑都检测到来自较小舰船的传入扫描。  看起来飞地准备再次离开，因为检测到的电源再次上升，但它似乎正在...为它的离开准备它的年轻护卫，几乎将它们推向我们的舰船以使它们依附。       翻译：这些是骨质生物，骨...骨巢。靠近...援助它们，因为它们在...大崩溃后繁荣。

column1: Commander, the moment hostile forces appeared on {PlanetName}, a number of Clanling Soldiers appeared! Our local commander was worried at first, but quickly realized these new ships were targeting only the hostile forces.  Our local scientists theorize this to be due to their inherent dislike of AI controlled space. For lack of a proper explanation, they say the local Neinzul seem overall... calmer after they laid claim to our planets.
column2: 指挥官，敌对势力一出现在{PlanetName}上，一些氏族士兵就出现了！我们当地的指挥官起初很担心，但很快意识到这些新的舰船只针对敌对势力。  我们当地的科学家推测这是由于它们天生不喜欢人工智能控制的空间。由于缺乏适当的解释，他们说当地奈因祖尔在占据我们的行星后似乎总体上...更平静了。

column1: Commander, the {FactionColor}Dark Zenith</color> are terraforming (or should that be Zeniforming?) planets in our Universe to be more suitable for their civilization. These are major alterations that speed up Dark Zenith and their allies on a planet, and slow their enemies to retake the transformed systems.  It seems they intend to do this to every planet they encounter. Our scientists are referring to the transformation of planets as the Fimbulwinter. Thankfully our allies will make sure that these changes do not interfere with our ability to use the planet, and they are giving us technology to allow our ships to take advantage of these changes as well.
column2: 指挥官，{FactionColor}黑暗泽尼斯</color>正在将我们宇宙中的行星改造得更适合他们的文明。这些是重大改造，会加速黑暗泽尼斯及其盟友在行星上的行动，并减缓他们的敌人以重新夺取改造后的星系。  他们似乎打算对他们遇到的每一颗行星都这样做。我们的科学家将行星的转变称为芬布尔之冬。值得庆幸的是，我们的盟友将确保这些变化不会干扰我们使用行星的能力，而且他们正在给我们技术，让我们的舰船也能利用这些变化。

column1: Commander, the {FactionColor}Dark Zenith</color> are terraforming (or should that be Zeniforming?) planets in our Universe to be more suitable for their civilization. These are terrifying alterations that speed up the Dark Zenith and their allies on a planet, and slow their enemies.  It seems they intend to do this to every planet they encounter. If they Zeniform too many planets, we won't have anywhere left to live even if we survive this war; we can still build command stations in orbit, but the planets themselves will be useless for colonization or industrial purposes.  Our scientists are referring to the transformation of planets as the Fimbulwinter.  Let's hope we can stop this invasion before our scientists start mentioning Ragnarok.
column2: 指挥官，{FactionColor}黑暗泽尼斯</color>正在将我们宇宙中的行星改造得更适合他们的文明。这些是可怕的改造，会加速黑暗泽尼斯及其盟友在行星上的行动，并减缓他们的敌人。  他们似乎打算对他们遇到的每一颗行星都这样做。如果他们改造太多行星，即使我们在这场战争中幸存下来，我们也将无处可居；我们仍然可以在轨道上建造指挥站，但行星本身将无法用于殖民或工业目的。我们的科学家将行星的转变称为芬布尔之冬。让我们希望我们能在我们的科学家开始提到诸神黄昏之前阻止这次入侵。

column1: Commander, using your Science to upgrade ships is a key way to make your fleets more powerful.  Sitting on huge amounts of science can make the game unnecessarily hard.  Also!  Early on, the power of spending 500 science for a direct planetary upgrade cannot be beat in terms of providing additional defensive strength and economic value for your initial few planets. This directly upgrades all units the planet controls from the protective forcefields, the metal extractors, the station-keeping vessels, all the turrets owned by the planet, and lets not forget it also improves the planet wide bonuses provided by the command station itself!
column2: 指挥官，用你的科技值来升级单位是增强舰队实力的关键方法。  囤积大量科技值会让游戏变得不必要地困难。  此外！在游戏早期，花费500科技值直接升级行星所带来的额外防御强度和经济价值是无可比拟的。这将直接升级行星控制的所有单位，包括防护力场、金属提取器、驻留单位、行星拥有的所有炮塔，别忘了还会提升指挥站提供的全行星加成！

column1: Commander, we are sad to report that the Migrant we had recognized had once again left our galaxy. Many of our people were growing accustom to the many tricks they could be seen doing while in peaceful space.  It is not without good reason, however. While it did indeed bring some of its Clanlings along with it this time, it reports it has many more that it needed to assist in braving warp space. It truly believes we're one of the safe havens of the universe, and deems the traversal there and back worth it. We must continue to improve our own standing to prove ourselves worthy of its trust.  Especially if the rumors abound of the AI's ever increasing pressure on them is to be believed.
column2: 指挥官，我们遗憾地报告，我们认识的移民者再次离开了我们的银河系。我们许多人已经习惯了在和平空间中看到它们表演的许多技巧。  然而，这并非没有充分的理由。虽然它这次确实带来了一些它的氏族成员，但它报告说它还有更多需要协助穿越跃迁空间。它真的相信我们是宇宙的安全港之一，并认为往返值得。我们必须继续提高我们自己的地位，以证明我们值得它的信任。  特别是如果关于人工智能对它们不断增加压力的传言可信的话。

column1: Commander, we can improve our defenses by hacking one or more Defense Schematic Servers (TSSes).  Once you own enough planets, it can be hard to defend them all. Hacking DSSes allow you to power up ALL of your command stations, battlestations, and citadels.  Some types benefit more than others from the improvements, but in general you want more turrets, minefields, and other defensive features to be available to you.
column2: 指挥官，我们可以通过入侵一个或多个防御蓝图服务器（TSS）来加强防御。  一旦你拥有足够多的行星，就很难防御所有行星。入侵防御蓝图服务器可以增强你所有指挥站、机动平台和堡垒的实力。 某些类型的设施从这些改进中受益更多，但总体而言，你会希望有更多炮塔、雷区和其他防御设施可用。

column1: Commander, we can improve our defenses by hacking one or more Turret Schematic Servers (TSSes).  Once you own enough planets, it can be hard to defend them all. Hacking TSSes allow you to power up ALL of your command stations, battlestations, and citadels.  Some types benefit more than others from the improvements, but in general you want more turrets, minefields, and other defensive features to be available to you.  There are also Other Defense Schematic Servers (ODSS) that can give you yet more benefits.
column2: 指挥官，我们可以通过入侵一个或多个炮塔蓝图服务器（TSS）来提升防御。当你拥有足够多行星时，很难防守全部。入侵TSS可以增强所有指挥站、机动平台和堡垒。不同类型的增益效果不同，但总体而言，更多炮塔、雷区和防御设施对你有利。此外还有其他防御蓝图服务器（ODSS）可提供更多增益。

column1: Commander, we can use the Planet menu to Watch fleets so we can see their health and strength even when they are on remote planets. This allows you to efficiently monitor multiple battles at once It can be a good idea to watch your most important fleets (note that Command Stations count as fleets as well!).   There are a number of ways to customize how you do this; check the bottom of the Planet sidebar for the Options there. Some people like to put their Watched Fleets above the Ships in the planet sidebar, for example.
column2: 指挥官，我们可以使用行星菜单来关注舰队，这样即使它们在遥远的行星上，我们也能看到它们的生命值和实力。这可以让你有效地同时监控多场战斗。关注你最重要的舰队是个好主意（注意，指挥站也被视为舰队！）。   有很多方法可以自定义这个功能；查看行星侧边栏的底部选项。例如，有些人喜欢将关注的舰队显示在行星侧边栏的单位列表上方。

column1: Commander, we have a powerful ally in the Nanocaust. We've requested them not to destroy any AI command stations so as to not increase AIP, but that leaves their Hive open to powerful AI waves. We should try to help them deal with the dangerous warp gates.
column2: 指挥官，纳米浩劫是我们强大的盟友。我们已请求他们不要摧毁任何人工智能指挥站，以免增加人工智能影响力点数（AIP），但这使得他们的蜂巢容易受到人工智能的强大攻势。我们应该帮助他们应对危险的 warp 门。

column1: Commander, we have confirmed the signal's origin, and it is more assuredly a Migrant we have seen before. They had kept their word, and appear to be enroute to our territory post haste. More excitingly, it looks to have brought along some ships of middle size.  Our recently established Neinzul Culture division notes that these may be more of what they have labeled 'Clanlings', and that there is a much more uplifting tone in its message. They are looking forward to interacting with Clanlings that were not born of our galaxy.  Message: We return, creatures of bone! We are most pleased to detect your ever... fortitude in these times of great strife and... migration into your voidlands.  Considering its smaller charges, our Culture heads are strongly suggesting we send assistance to guarantee their arrival.
column2: 指挥官，我们已经确认了信号的来源，它确实是我们以前见过的移民者。他们信守了诺言，似乎正在火速前往我们的领土。更令人兴奋的是，它似乎带来了一些中等大小的舰船。  我们最近成立的奈因祖尔文化部门指出，这些可能是更多的他们所称的'氏族成员'，并且它的信息中有更令人振奋的语气。他们期待与不是在我们银河系中出生的氏族成员互动。  信息：我们回来了，骨质生物！我们非常高兴检测到你们在这些巨大冲突和...迁移到你们虚无之地时期的...坚韧。  考虑到它较小的护卫，我们的文化主管强烈建议我们派遣援助以保证它们的到达。

column1: Commander, we have discovered another subfaction of the Neinzul in the galaxy, the Diamond Custodians.  They appear to be the long time rivals of the Pearl Custodians, our currently allied Custodians. Their desire for absolute control has resulted in them seeking what they find to be the most powerful, and ruthless, entities in the universe to try and integrate themselves into what they believe to be the next Galactic Empire as the strong right arm of their law. Needless to say, the AI best fit this in our current galaxy, and they have thrown their support behind the AI's already immense might.
column2: 指挥官，我们在银河系中发现了另一个奈因祖尔亚派系，钻石守护者。  他们似乎是珍珠守护者的长期对手，我们目前结盟的守护者。他们对绝对控制的渴望导致他们寻求他们认为是宇宙中最强大、最无情的实体，试图将自己融入他们认为是下一个银河帝国的法律的强力右臂。不用说，人工智能最符合我们在当前银河系中的情况，他们已经将支持投入到人工智能已经巨大的力量中。

column1: Commander, we have discovered another subfaction of the Neinzul in the galaxy, the Onyx Custodians.  The Pearl Custodians could not find words to describe the horrors that The Onyx brought about. While they are at least able to explain the Diamond's desire for control as a way for peace, The Onyx have no such tells. They have no long term goal other than the destruction of anyone that doesn't submit to them, and will happily join up with any groups that push this agenda. They truly have no respect for anything but power, and have joined the newly named 'Dark Alliance' in their suppression of our galaxy.
column2: 指挥官，我们在银河系中发现了另一个奈因祖尔亚派系，玛瑙守护者。  珍珠守护者找不到词语来描述玛瑙带来的恐怖。虽然他们至少能够解释钻石对控制的渴望作为一种和平的方式，但玛瑙没有这样的迹象。他们没有长期目标，除了摧毁任何不屈服于他们的人，并且会乐于加入任何推动这一议程的团体。他们真的不尊重任何东西，只尊重力量，并且已经加入了新命名的'黑暗联盟'来压制我们的银河系。

column1: Commander, we have encountered a Showdown Device! These are used by the AI to power their Warp Network. If you can capture enough of them and hack them, you can cut the AI off from their reinforcements, bringing an end to this awful war.  But be prepared for an all-out AI response if you do so! And if we lose too many Showdown Devices, the hack will fail.

column1: Commander, we have identified a good nearby target. The planet {PlanetName} has an Advanced Research Station (ARS) that we can hack. The AI uses ARSs to research improvements in its ships, and by hacking it we can improve one of our flagships to be able to build one of its researched ships. This is one of the best ways we have to increase our strength.  To do this hack, bring one of your flagships to the planet and open the Hacking Menu in the sidebar.  By capturing the planet first you make some types of hacks significantly cheaper, including ARS hacks. You may not always want to capture a planet with an ARS, but you probably want to capture {PlanetName}. In general Hacking Points are an important resource, so if you think you may want the planet eventually it is often good to capture it before hacking..  We can hack any ARS 3 times, but each time we hack the AI response will be stronger and more expensive in Hacking Points; the AI improves its networking firewalls when it detects an intrusion. You will rarely want to do a third hack due to the cost and risk involved. However, you are advised to hack this ARS at least once immediately to strengthen your fleet.  You can use the Intel sidebar menu to find more Advanced Research Stations to hack.  You'll have a number of choices for which ship line to steal. The simplest option is to pick a ship line that synergizes well with your existing ships and tech choices. If you already have several ship lines with Raid then another Raid ship might be a good choice. You can also pick a ship line you know and are comfortable with, or something that counters some major enemy threats...  There are many good choices, and sometimes the most important thing is just to make any choice if it feels overwhelming.
column2: 指挥官，我们发现了一个不错的附近目标。{PlanetName}行星上有一个我们可以入侵的高级研究站（ARS）。AI利用高级研究站来研究单位的改进，通过入侵它，我们可以提升一艘旗舰的能力，使其能够建造AI研究出的单位之一。这是我们增强实力的最佳方法之一。  要进行这次入侵，派一艘旗舰前往该行星，然后打开侧边栏中的入侵菜单。  先占领该行星可以使某些类型的入侵成本大幅降低，包括高级研究站的入侵。你可能并不总是想占领有高级研究站的行星，但你可能想占领{PlanetName}行星。一般来说，入侵点数是一种重要的资源，所以如果你认为最终可能需要该行星，通常在入侵前占领它是个好主意。  我们可以对任何高级研究站进行3次入侵，但每次入侵AI的反应都会更强烈，入侵点数的消耗也会更高；AI在检测到入侵时会改进其网络防火墙。由于成本和风险，你很少会想进行第三次入侵。不过，建议你立即至少入侵一次这个高级研究站，以增强你的舰队实力。  你可以使用情报侧边栏菜单找到更多可以入侵的高级研究站。  你将有多种选择来窃取哪种单位生产线。最简单的选择是选择一种与你现有单位和科技选择相协同的单位生产线。如果你已经有几种带有突袭能力的单位生产线，那么另一种突袭单位可能是个不错的选择。你也可以选择一种你熟悉且使用起来得心应手的单位生产线，或者选择一种能对抗某些主要敌人威胁的单位生产线……  有很多不错的选择，有时候，当你感到不知所措时，最重要的是做出任何选择。

Just like other flagships, officer ships don't improve by spending science unlocking technology. However you can directly spend science in the detailed fleet view (Hold 'C' and click flagship by default) to level up its direct strength.   Many officer ships can be significantly improved with our hacking nanomachines as well. Move the ship to a friendly planet and check out the Hacks tab for details.   Be aware that this power doesn't come cheap. Officer class ships can have significant power usage and if they are crippled during battle will cost a massive amount of metal to repair.
column2: 指挥官，我们俘获了一个研究人员命名为“军官”级的单位。  这些特殊单位可以成为我们主力舰队的核心，也可以根据其专长提供专门的支援。  你可以使用详细舰队视图（默认按住“C”键并点击旗舰）从其他舰队转移单位。这可以包括舰队研究站的精英单位，它们将为军官单位提供加成。  和其他旗舰一样，军官单位不会通过花费科技值解锁技术来提升实力。不过，你可以在详细舰队视图（默认按住“C”键并点击旗舰）中直接花费科技值来提升其直接实力。   许多军官单位也可以通过我们的入侵纳米机器得到显著提升。将单位移动到友方行星，查看入侵标签以了解详情。   请注意，这种力量并非没有代价。军官级单位可能会消耗大量能量，如果它们在战斗中受损，修复将需要大量金属。

column1: Commander, we've detected a Probe emitting {FactionColor}Zenith</color> energy signatures. It seems to be broadcasting a homing signal out into the galaxy, and the return pulses indicate that there might be a very powerful Zenith ship inbound. When that powerful ship does arrive then we're going to be in for a major battle.  If it's like the other Zenith devices we've seen over the years, we might be able to interact with its systems using Hacking.
column2: 指挥官，我们检测到一个发出{FactionColor}泽尼斯</color>能量特征的探测器。它似乎正在向银河系广播归航信号，返回脉冲表明可能有一艘非常强大的泽尼斯舰船正在接近。当那艘强大的舰船到达时，我们将面临一场重大战斗。  如果它像我们多年来见过的其他泽尼斯设备一样，我们或许可以使用黑客入侵与其系统互动。

column1: Commander, we've detected a massive dimensional shift. It looks like several planets from another universe have suddenly come into proximity with ours; close enough to allow the Wormhole Grids to align.  Our sensors are picking up extremely strong energy signatures; preliminary analysis shows similarities to Zenith Energy, but it's not an exact match to the relics we've been finding. Our scientists are calling them 'Dark Zenith' based on the differences they're finding in the emission spectra. We're not quite sure what these Dark Zenith are up to, but from the amount of energy they're putting out, this looks like a major incursion. If they're functional Zenith rather than just the derelicts we've found to date, we're in for a difficult war.  Our leading Zenith expert asked me to pass along a message to you. She seemed to be chanting.  Dies iræ, dies illa Solvet saeclum in favilla
column2: 指挥官，我们检测到了大规模的维度偏移。看起来另一个宇宙的几个行星突然靠近了我们的行星；近到足以让虫洞网格对齐。  我们的传感器检测到极其强大的能量特征；初步分析显示与泽尼斯能量相似，但与我们一直发现的遗迹不完全匹配。我们的科学家根据他们发现的发射光谱差异称它们为'黑暗泽尼斯'。我们不太确定这些黑暗泽尼斯在做什么，但从他们释放的能量来看，这看起来像是一次重大入侵。如果他们是功能正常的泽尼斯，而不仅仅是我们迄今发现的废弃残骸，我们将面临一场艰难的战争。  我们首席泽尼斯专家让我转达一条信息给你。她似乎在吟唱。  Dies iræ, dies illa Solvet saeclum in favilla

column1: Commander, we've detected a swarm of Nanobots invading the galaxy. We're calling it the Nanocaust. Their weapons can assimilate ships they destroy into their fleet, making them a truly terrifying foe. We must be wary.
column2: 指挥官，我们检测到一群纳米机器人正在入侵银河系。我们称其为纳米浩劫。他们的武器可以将摧毁的单位同化到他们的舰队中，使他们成为一个真正可怕的敌人。我们必须保持警惕。

column1: Commander, we've detected a swarm of Nanobots invading the galaxy. We're calling it the Nanocaust. They seem to be willing to aid us against the AI. Their weapons can assimilate ships they destroy into their fleet, making them a truly terrifying foe.
column2: 指挥官，我们检测到一群纳米机器人正在入侵银河系。我们称其为纳米浩劫。他们似乎愿意帮助我们对抗人工智能。他们的武器可以将摧毁的单位同化到他们的舰队中，使他们成为一个真正可怕的敌人。

column1: Commander, we've detected a truly immense {FactionColor}Zenith Golem</color>. It seems to be able to affect the planet itself; we've never seen anything like this happen before.  It looks like this might be capable of destroying a planet entirely, including everything on it. Even flagships will be permanently destroyed if on the planet.
column2: 指挥官，我们检测到了一个巨大的{FactionColor}泽尼斯魔像</color>。它似乎能够影响行星本身；我们以前从未见过这样的事情发生。  看起来这可能能够完全摧毁一颗行星，包括上面的所有东西。即使旗舰如果在行星上也会被永久摧毁。
指挥官，我们发现了一个 {FactionColor}天顶额枋</color>
指挥官，我们发现了一个{FactionColor}泽尼斯拱顶石</color>

column1: Commander, we've discovered how to track Elderlings. This lets us figure out which planets are in their Territory, as well as some other details about the Elderling.  This can be very useful for understanding when and where an Elderling can be hunted.
column2: 指挥官，我们已经发现了如何追踪长老。这让我们可以确定哪些行星在它们的区域内，以及关于长老的其他一些细节。  这对于理解何时何地可以猎杀长老非常有用。

column1: Commander, we've found derelict golems in the galaxy, and even figured out how to get them moving again, but we've never figured out how to build something with that much power behind it. We still haven't.      Fortunately, our Dark Zenith allies don't have that problem. They've just built a new golem. Apparently, the Zenith-modified metals are the key ingredient that our engineers couldn't reproduce.  We still can't, but if we can hold enough territory, I don't think they're going to stop building golems any time soon. Something tells me the AI's not going to like trying to attack systems defended by Dark Zenith golems. Now that they've had enough time to build up, they may just turn the tide against the relentless AI onslaught.
column2: 指挥官，我们在银河系中发现了废弃的魔像，甚至弄清楚了如何让它们重新移动，但我们从未弄清楚如何建造具有如此强大动力的东西。我们仍然没有。  幸运的是，我们的黑暗泽尼斯盟友没有这个问题。他们刚刚建造了一个新的魔像。显然，泽尼斯改造的金属是我们的工程师无法复制的关键成分。我们仍然无法复制，但如果我们能控制足够的领土，我认为他们不会很快停止建造魔像。有些东西告诉我人工智能不会喜欢攻击由黑暗泽尼斯魔像防守的系统。现在他们有足够的时间来积累，他们可能扭转局势对抗无情的人工智能猛攻。

column1: Commander, we've found something extraordinary. A planet that is mobile! It is moving slowly, and updating its links in the Wormhole Grid as it goes.  It seems to just be on autopilot, but the dormant Nexus on the planet might have some controls if we can activate it via Hacking.
column2: 指挥官，我们发现了非凡的东西。一颗可移动的行星！它正在缓慢移动，并在移动过程中更新其在虫洞网格中的链接。  它似乎只是在自动驾驶，但行星上休眠的 nexus 可能有一些控制装置，如果我们能通过黑客入侵激活它。

column1: Commander, we've just discovered a terrifying new {FactionColor}Dark Zenith</color> ship. Our ever-creative scientists have deemed it the Jormugandr.  We thought the golems were the worst threat the Dark Zenith were capable of creating, but it seems we underestimated them.  This ship is almost unmatched in its power, but that power comes at a cost. The ship seems to require auxiliary power from the Zenith 'homeworlds' in our universe. If these homeworlds are attacked, the Jormugandr will leave the homeworlds to counterattack any factions foolish enough to get in its way. Thankfully, this rampage is temporary, and they will retreat back to the homeworlds once their energy stores reach a critical level.
column2: 指挥官，我们刚刚发现了一个可怕的新{FactionColor}黑暗泽尼斯</color>舰船。我们富有创造力的科学家称之为约尔蒙冈德。我们原以为魔像是黑暗泽尼斯能够创造的最糟糕威胁，但看来我们低估了他们。  这艘舰船的力量几乎无与伦比，但这种力量是有代价的。这艘舰船似乎需要我们宇宙中泽尼斯'母星'的辅助动力。如果这些母星受到攻击，约尔蒙冈德将离开母星反击任何愚蠢地挡路的派系。值得庆幸的是，这种暴走是暂时的，一旦他们的能量储存达到临界水平，他们将撤回母星。

column1: Commander, we've learned of a most curious development. It appears that the 'Wild Hives' are not as unified as they appear. While seemingly willing to live in peace with their own kind, and even with many other forms of alien life, they are not taking kindly to what they consider hostile actions on their territory. Be it the sight of any foreign Hive or a large amount of military build-up from the AI on a planet lacking a Command Station, they will attempt to contest the territory.  The reason we are notifying you is because this contested territory is causing the Wild Hive factions to lash out. While they were previously a 'don't bother us and we won't bother you' type of deal, now they are aggressively attacking anything and everything on planets they deem contested. This can be quite the wildcard. They may end up destroying AI forces for us, or we could end up in the crossfire ourselves. Your Science Advisor notes howerever, that this response seems to be highly localized, should we steer clear of any actively contested warzones we should be able to avoid nearly all of their defensive forces. They do, however, warn you to keep an eye on any wounded Workers fleeing the planet, as they may trigger 'chain reactions' while fleeing, causing any normally dormant Hives on their planets to wake up in a furious panic.  Your Military Advisor has noted that this is a 'prime opportunity to wipe those bugs out', and they're not wrong. While in this higher state of aggression, they seem to have taken a hit to unit production, and have essentially gone 'all in' with their defensive forces. We could strike now, and take on multiple weakened hostile fleets, we can swoop in when one side is about to achieve dominance to mop them all up and sterilize any infestations, or lastly you could simply let it play out to avoid risking unnecessary losses. The choice is yours to make Commander.
column2: 指挥官，我们了解到了一个最奇怪的发展。似乎'野生蜂巢'并不像它们看起来那样团结。虽然它们似乎愿意与自己的同类和平共处，甚至与其他形式的外星生命和平共处，但它们对它们认为在其领土上的敌对行为并不友好。无论是任何外来蜂巢的出现，还是人工智能在缺乏指挥站的行星上的大量军事集结，它们都会试图争夺该领土。  我们通知你的原因是，这个争议领土正在导致野生蜂巢派系发动攻击。虽然它们以前是'别打扰我们，我们也不会打扰你'的类型，但现在它们正在积极攻击它们认为有争议的行星上的任何东西。这可能是一个相当大的变数。它们最终可能会为我们摧毁人工智能部队，或者我们自己也可能陷入交叉火力中。然而，你的科学顾问指出，这种反应似乎高度局部化，如果我们避开任何活跃的争议战区，我们应该能够避开它们几乎所有的防御部队。然而，他们确实警告你要留意任何受伤的工人逃离行星，因为它们在逃跑时可能会触发'连锁反应'，导致它们行星上任何通常休眠的蜂巢在愤怒的恐慌中醒来。  你的军事顾问指出这是'消灭那些虫子的绝佳机会'，他们没有错。在这种更高攻击性状态下，它们的单位生产似乎受到了打击，并且基本上'全押'在防御部队上。我们可以现在发动攻击，对付多个被削弱的敌对舰队，我们可以在一方即将取得优势时冲进去消灭它们所有并 sterilize 任何侵扰，或者最后你可以简单地让事情发展以避免不必要的损失。选择权在你，指挥官。

column1: Commander, we've managed to attract a small Dark Zenith expeditionary force. They've come to our home planet to help.  These Dark Zenith will eventually be powerful allies, but they're next to useless right now. It will take them a while to build up an economy capable of supporting a meaningful offensive force, and they will benefit from a contiguous empire to allow their economy to flourish, as they seem unable to produce all the resources they need without interplanetary trade. Their production centers, Epistyles, are unable to be built on AI planets as radiation from AI Command Stations will disrupt their processes. This doesn't seem to stop them from building harvesting terminii to collect resources in poorly defended AI systems.
column2: 指挥官，我们设法吸引了一小支黑暗泽尼斯远征军。他们来到我们的母星提供帮助。  这些黑暗泽尼斯最终会成为强大的盟友，但他们现在几乎毫无用处。他们需要一段时间来建立能够支持有意义的进攻力量的经济，而且他们将受益于一个连续的帝国，使他们的经济能够繁荣，因为他们似乎无法在没有星际贸易的情况下生产所有所需的资源。他们的生产中心，柱廊，无法在人工智能行星上建造，因为人工智能指挥站的辐射会干扰他们的过程。这似乎并不阻止他们建造收集终端来在防御薄弱的人工智能系统中收集资源。

column1: Commander, we've never imagined being able to control a planet before. The Zenith truly were an amazing race.  We could direct it to crash into another planet, even an AI homeworld! This would provoke a very strong AI response; we suspect they would attack both this nomad and the rest of our empire with massive forces.  Do remember that if we crash the planet, everything on either planet would be permanently destroyed, even our Flagships. You should remember to get the flagships off the planet before it's too late.
column2: 指挥官，我们从未想象过能够控制一颗行星。泽尼斯真是一个令人惊叹的种族。  我们可以引导它撞向另一颗行星，甚至是人工智能母星！这将引发非常强烈的人工智能反应；我们怀疑他们会用大规模部队攻击这个游牧行星和我们帝国的其他部分。  请记住，如果我们撞毁行星，两颗行星上的所有东西都将被永久摧毁，包括我们的旗舰。你应该记得在为时已晚之前将旗舰从行星上移开。

column1: Commander, well done! This should allow us to use the ZA territory without fighting. But be careful; this is an uneasy alliance at best.  It seems likely that while they are Expanding or in Civil War, they will forget about the truce until they have quiesced again.
column2: 指挥官，做得好！这应该允许我们在不战斗的情况下使用拱顶石领土。但要小心；这充其量是一种不稳定的联盟。  当它们在扩张或内战中时，它们可能会忘记休战，直到它们再次休眠。

column1: Commander, you may have heard the news about the recent awakening of the Dark Spire menace into a new galactic level threat. While we were brainstorming the best way to deal with this, a number of our scouts picketed throughout the galaxy reported the same thing: A number of ships produced by the various Dyson Spheres in our galaxy have apparently managed to call a ceasefire with each other, and more impressively the AI, and are banding together in what we could best translate as the Anti-Dark Spire Coalition.  Our scouts report that this does not appear to have stifled the regular unit production that we have grown accustomed to from these Spheres, and that these forces are acting independently of their home sphere's desires.  This Coalition seems to only care about the Dark Spire menace, and will otherwise leave factions alone. Banding together with their strike forces may allow us to make headway where we would otherwise struggle to do so.
column2: 指挥官，你可能已经听说了最近黑暗尖塔族威胁觉醒成为新的银河级别威胁的消息。当我们正在集思广益处理这个问题的最佳方法时，我们遍布银河系的几名侦察兵报告了同样的事情：我们银河系中各种戴森球产生的许多舰船显然已经设法彼此停火，更令人印象深刻的是与人工智能停火，并联合起来，我们可以最好地翻译为反黑暗尖塔族联盟。  我们的侦察兵报告说，这似乎并没有抑制我们从这些戴森球中习惯的常规单位生产，而且这些部队独立于他们母球的意愿行事。  这个联盟似乎只关心黑暗尖塔族威胁，否则会忽略其他派系。与他们的打击部队联合可能让我们在原本困难的地方取得进展。

column1: Commander, you should consider automating some of planetary defensive options.
column2: 指挥官，你应该考虑自动化一些行星防御选项。

column1: Commander, you should consider automating some of your building options. In the Settings menu under Automation are settings to automate the building of some common defensive ships on your planets.
column2: 指挥官，你应该考虑自动化一些建造选项。在设置菜单的自动化选项下，有设置可以自动在你的行星上建造一些常见的防御单位。

column1: Commander, you should consider automating some of your planetary defensive options.
column2: 指挥官，你应该考虑自动化一些行星防御选项。

column1: Commander, your Science Advisor brings disturbing news... It seems like Metal Generators aren't the only viable hosts for these 'Wild Hive' infestations. We have detected a Capturable on planet {PlanetName} has undergone a similar infestation as Metal Generators, however it appears that the larger internal space combined with 'Wild Hive' organisms shuttling a constant stream of supplies to the infested Capturable has turned it into a 'greater' hive, so to speak. Activity within is noted to be greater than that of a Metal Generator. We can expect a greater quantity of forces to emerge from that infested Capturable.  While we can expect this infested Capturable to put up a greater resistance to hostiles, we cannot capture it ourselves. However, after a thorough analysis of the infestation by your Science Advisor's team, and some weapon adjustments and calibrations directed by your Military Advisor, weakpoints in the Capturable's structural integrity have been identified and are able to be exploited to damage and sterilize the infestation without causing the Capturable's destruction. Targeting the infested Capturable should free it from the 'Wild Hive's grasp, should we desire to claim it for ourselves.  The implications of this development is rather concerning. While we currently have no reason to believe that the 'Wild Hives' are using this Capturable as anything but a reproductive hive, this may mean that other capturables are susceptible to a Wild Hive infestation. We'll keep tabs on other capturables and calibrate weapons accordingly for minimum damage to them.
column2: 指挥官，你的科学顾问带来了令人不安的消息...似乎金属发电机并不是这些'野生蜂巢'侵扰的唯一合适宿主。我们检测到{PlanetName}上的一个可捕获目标经历了与金属发电机类似的侵扰，然而，更大的内部空间加上'野生蜂巢'生物不断向被侵扰的可捕获目标运送补给，使其变成了一个'更大'的蜂巢，可以这么说。其内部活动被注意到比金属发电机更大。我们可以预期从被侵扰的可捕获目标中出现更大数量的部队。  虽然我们可以预期这个被侵扰的可捕获目标会对敌对势力进行更大的抵抗，但我们自己无法捕获它。然而，在你的科学顾问团队对侵扰进行了彻底分析，并在你的军事顾问指导下进行了一些武器调整和校准后，已经确定了可捕获目标结构完整性中的弱点，并且可以利用这些弱点来 damage 和 sterilize 侵扰，而不会导致可捕获目标被摧毁。针对被侵扰的可捕获目标应该可以将其从'野生蜂巢'的控制中解放出来，如果我们希望将其据为己有的话。  这一发展的影响相当令人担忧。虽然我们目前没有理由相信'野生蜂巢'将这个可捕获目标用作繁殖蜂巢以外的任何用途，但这可能意味着其他可捕获目标容易受到野生蜂巢侵扰。我们将继续监控其他可捕获目标，并相应地校准武器以最小化对它们的损害。

column1: Complete redesign of a sniper: Increases its range the more are present - then escalates damage based on attack range.
column2: 狙击手的完全重新设计：随着数量增加而增加其射程 - 然后根据攻击范围升级伤害。

column1: Completed mere hours before the end of the Human Civil War the 'Tick' has never seen actual combat. Combining the latest in ultra-powerful electrotoxic hull, a cloaking device and incision pike weapon against big targets along a latch beam the ship was designed to become the ultimate high-tech hunter. It's rough schematics make the ship expensive and power hungry, but it's advanced technology well worth the cost.
column2: 在人类内战结束前几个小时完成，'蜱虫'从未见过真正的战斗。结合最新的超强电毒舰体、隐形装置和针对大型目标的切开长矛武器以及附着光束，该单位被设计成为终极高科技猎手。其粗糙的图纸使单位昂贵且耗能，但其先进技术完全值得成本。
震荡护卫舰运载无人机

column1: Concussive-force generator that detonates for trivial area damage, but knocks even larger enemies back and stuns their engines. It can fire in a rapid burst but then will need some time to reload.
column2: 震荡力发生器，引爆时会造成轻微的范围伤害，但能将较大的敌人击退并使其引擎瘫痪。它可以快速连发，但之后需要一些时间重新装填。

column2: 游戏界面(大部分UI)的相关配置。

column2: 游戏侧边栏的相关配置。

column2: 调整屏幕右下角显示的选中单位/舰队窗口。

column2: 配置戾尔模组的不同功能。

column1: Congratulations!  You've made the considerably wise choice to try out AI War 2 Expert Mode.  The goal of Expert is to present experienced AI War 2 players with a more challenging and interesting strategic experience. Note that it is highly recommended to play on fairly 'open' maps, i.e., those without a large amount of chokepoints.  The more 'closed' arrangements will render some of Expert's features ineffective, but are left up to your discretion as a player.  If at any time you find Expert too overwhelming, you may wish to consider Challenger Mode which allows you to turn off most Expert features you don't particularly enjoy.  On the other hand, if you want to turn the dial up further, Logistician requires you to manage fuel, and Deathwish has some additional challenges available.  If you have questions about these modes, please visit the Arcen Games discord where there is a dedicated expert_challenger_deathwish channel and feel free to ping Strategic Sage with your inquiries.  As always, the Mantis website awaits your feedback and/or bug reports.  Both are readily accessible from the main menu.  Playing on Expert enforces a number of features, the most significant ones are described below.  Other Tips are available for a more detailed explanation for these where appropriate.  Selective Asset Acquisition.  ARS, TSS, and ODSS will offer a lower number of choices each;  the pool they select those choices from remains unaffected.  Multiple AIs.  At least two AIs are mandatory for any Expert game.  Limited Battlestations.   A variety of changes to limit and balance excessive use of battlestations and beachheading.  Take It Or Leave It.  When capturing a planet, you must take all of the capturables available.  You can delay claiming Officers if you wish, but you will be charged the AIP price immediately.  All other capturables such as Major Data Centers, Zenith Power Generators, etc. are automatically claimed.  Distributed Economy.  The asteroids on a planet, not the command stations you build, contribute most of the metal and energy.  This lends additional strategic variety and weight decisions about what planets to capture, and what types of command stations to build there.   Dire Cross-Planet Attacks.  CPA Bunkers will periodically spawn, housing additional ships for deployment during CPAs.  Dialed-Up AI Defenses.  'NastyPicks', AI structures such as Mass Drivers, Eyes, etc. will be more dangerous and difficult to handle.  FRS Rebalancing.  The special Fleet Research Station ships no longer provide bonuses to other ship lines, Officers, etc. in their fleets.   This bonus is impossible to balance sensibly with the other options available to the player.  Crippling Bail-Out.  When crippled, fleet centerpieces will 'bail-out' to a friendly system automatically.  Increased AI Response.  There is a modest multiplier to the resources the AI has for items like hacking exostrike response, Dire CPAs (if turned on), etc.  AI Reserves grace period is turned off, and so on.

column1: Connect to a host by IP address.  They must have already started a multiplayer session via the Steam Sockets (Direct) framework. This should be the fastest and most reliable form of Steam networking.

column1: Cruisers are an elite category of ships limited to one per fleet; they do not count as a standard shipline but they are eligible for fleetwide bonuses granted by FRS ships. The Blackguard cruiser is the master of hit-and-run raiding tactics, equipped with a powerful chain lightning weapon that can only target mobile units. This cruiser is also equipped with special raiding tools to steal resources from the enemy. Chief among these tools is the cloaked 'salvage depot' that is created on planets with hostile stationary structures, which covertly harvests metal and applies greater metabolism to mobile enemies. The depot is able to rebuilt on a long cooldown.
column2: 巡洋舰是一种精英级别的舰船，每个舰队限拥有一艘；它们不属于标准舰船序列，但有资格获得快速反应支援（FRS）舰船提供的全舰队增益。黑衣卫巡洋舰是游击突袭战术的大师，配备了强大的连锁闪电武器，只能攻击移动单位。这艘巡洋舰还配备了特殊的突袭工具，用于从敌人那里窃取资源。其中最重要的工具是隐形的“ salvage depot ”，它会在有敌对静止建筑的行星上创建，秘密采集金属并对移动敌人施加更高的新陈代谢。该仓库可以在长时间冷却后重建。

column1: Cruisers are an elite category of ships limited to one per fleet; they do not count as a standard shipline but they are eligible for fleetwide bonuses granted by FRS ships. The Ethereal cruiser is equipped with a cloaking device and can wreak havoc on the enemy if it has sufficient support. Its primary weapon can paralyze large groups of ships and its secondary weapon is designed to slay the mightiest foes. This cruiser excels at covertly approaching powerful adversaries and dealing lethal bursts of damage, then retreating into cloak to prepare for another strike.
column2: 巡洋舰是一种精英级别的舰船，每个舰队限拥有一艘；它们不属于标准舰船序列，但有资格获得快速反应支援（FRS）舰船提供的全舰队增益。幻影巡洋舰配备了隐形装置，如果有足够的支援，它可以给敌人造成巨大破坏。它的主武器可以瘫痪大批舰船，副武器则是为了击败最强大的敌人而设计的。这艘巡洋舰擅长秘密接近强大的对手，进行致命的爆发性攻击，然后隐入隐形状态，准备下一次攻击。

column1: Cruisers are an elite category of ships limited to one per fleet; they do not count as a standard shipline but they are eligible for fleetwide bonuses granted by FRS ships. The Lockdown cruiser is armed with an exotic sniper weapon that zombifies foes. But it derives its name from the unique frigate-class drone it produces that transforms based on strength ratio of enemies present. Its defensive form can prevent ships from leaving through wormholes while its offensive form is capable of dealing tremendous damage.
column2: 巡洋舰是一种精英级别的舰船，每个舰队限拥有一艘；它们不属于标准舰船序列，但有资格获得快速反应支援（FRS）舰船提供的全舰队增益。封锁巡洋舰装备了一种奇特的狙击武器，可将敌人僵尸化。不过，它的名字来源于其制造的独特护卫舰级无人机，该无人机可根据当前敌人的实力对比进行变形。它的防御形态可以阻止舰船通过虫洞离开，而攻击形态则能够造成巨大伤害。

column1: Cruisers are an elite category of ships limited to one per fleet; they do not count as a standard shipline but they are eligible for fleetwide bonuses granted by FRS ships. The Radiant cruiser is built around a heavy fanbeam cannon. Strategically releases 'Starbursts' during combat after taking sufficient damage, which fire their beams in a star-pattern before self-destructing.
column2: 巡洋舰是一种精英级别的舰船，每个舰队限拥有一艘；它们不属于标准舰船序列，但有资格获得快速反应支援（FRS）舰船提供的全舰队增益。辐射巡洋舰围绕一门重型扇形光束炮建造。在战斗中受到足够伤害后，它会策略性地释放“星爆”，这些“星爆”会以星型图案发射光束，然后自毁。

column1: Cruisers are an elite category of ships limited to one per fleet; they do not count as a standard shipline but they are eligible for fleetwide bonuses granted by FRS ships. The Riot Control Cruiser specializes in disabling and destroying large numbers of weaker disturbances to the peace.
column2: 巡洋舰是一种精英级舰船，每支舰队限造一艘；它们不计入标准舰船序列，但可以享受由FRS舰船提供的全舰队加成。防暴控制巡洋舰专门用于压制和消灭大批低等级骚乱目标。

column1: Cruisers are an elite category of ships limited to one per fleet; they do not count as a standard shipline but they are eligible for fleetwide bonuses granted by FRS ships. The Starfish cruiser incorporates Zenith technology to create autonomous limbs as it takes damage. These 'Arms' are semi-sentient and can replicate virally to create 'Ghoulas,' allowing the Starfish to field a pseudo army in a long fight. Both the Arms and Ghoulas naturally attrition, but their vampirism attack will allow them to stay active as long as they remain in fighting shape.
column2: 巡洋舰是一种精英级别的舰船，每个舰队限拥有一艘；它们不属于标准舰船序列，但有资格获得快速反应支援（FRS）舰船提供的全舰队增益。海星巡洋舰采用了天顶星科技，在受到伤害时会生成自主肢体。这些“臂肢”具有半智能，能够通过病毒式复制产生“食尸鬼”，使海星巡洋舰在持久战中能够组建一支临时军队。臂肢和食尸鬼都会自然损耗，但它们的吸血攻击能让它们在保持战斗状态时持续活跃。

column1: Cruisers are an elite category of ships limited to one per fleet; they do not count as a standard shipline but they are eligible for fleetwide bonuses granted by FRS ships. The Swarm cruiser is equipped with a modified pike corvette's primary weapon. It earns its namesake by periodically producing a swarm of mosquito drones with reverse tractors for latching onto enemies. These mosquito drones are especially adept at swarming massive units.
column2: 巡洋舰是一种精英级别的舰船，每个舰队限拥有一艘；它们不属于标准舰船序列，但有资格获得快速反应支援（FRS）舰船提供的全舰队增益。蜂群巡洋舰配备了一门经过改装的长枪护卫舰主武器。它之所以得名，是因为它会定期产生一群带有反向牵引器的蚊子无人机，用于附着在敌人身上。这些蚊子无人机尤其擅长围攻大型单位。

column1: Cruisers are an elite category of ships limited to one per fleet; they do not count as a standard shipline but they are eligible for fleetwide bonuses granted by FRS ships. The Tempest cruiser is a bombard-style siege ship that fires in bursts and deals more damage to distant targets and it has a kinetic buffer to repulse units that get too close, stunning their engines. Additionally, the Tempest cruiser can build trebuchets on planets that have hostile structures. These trebuchets can only attack structures, but they will devastate planet defenses over time.
column2: 巡洋舰是一种精英级别的舰船，每个舰队限拥有一艘；它们不属于标准舰船序列，但有资格获得快速反应支援（FRS）舰船提供的全舰队增益。风暴巡洋舰是一种齐射式攻城舰，能对远距离目标造成更多伤害，并且拥有一个动能缓冲器，可击退过于靠近的单位并使其引擎瘫痪。此外，风暴巡洋舰可以在有敌对建筑的行星上建造投石机。这些投石机只能攻击建筑，但随着时间的推移，它们将摧毁行星防御设施。

column1: Cruisers are an elite category of ships limited to one per fleet; they do not count as a standard shipline but they are eligible for fleetwide bonuses granted by FRS ships. The Trailblazer cruiser has modest firepower in its own right with its sniper railcannons, but it primarily attacks by launching trailblazers that lay mines as they approach enemies and release deadly ambush drones upon its destruction with powerful ambush bonuses to both offense and defense.
column2: 巡洋舰是一种精英级别的舰船，每个舰队限拥有一艘；它们不属于标准舰船序列，但有资格获得快速反应支援（FRS）舰船提供的全舰队增益。开拓者巡洋舰本身的狙击轨道炮火力适中，但其主要攻击方式是发射开拓者飞行器，这些飞行器在接近敌人时会布设地雷，并且在被摧毁时会释放出具有强大伏击增益效果的无人机，这些无人机在进攻和防御方面都很出色。

column1: Cruisers are an elite category of ships limited to one per fleet; they do not count as a standard shipline but they are eligible for fleetwide bonuses granted by FRS ships. The Valkyrie cruiser resurrects fallen allies using its own health. It regenerates on its own and deals increasing damage as it loses health.
column2: 巡洋舰是一种精英级别的舰船，每个舰队限拥有一艘；它们不属于标准舰船序列，但有资格获得快速反应支援（FRS）舰船提供的全舰队增益。瓦尔基里巡洋舰会消耗自身生命值来复活倒下的盟友。它能够自行恢复生命值，并且随着自身生命值的减少，造成的伤害会逐渐增加。

column1: Cruisers are an elite category of ships limited to one per fleet; they do not count as a standard shipline but they are eligible for fleetwide bonuses granted by FRS ships. The Voidpiercer cruiser is a powerhouse that can take on even exogalactic threats with its implosion weapon, which reloads faster as it gains marks. This cruiser is equally feared by smaller craft since it can produce temporary singularity rifts that deal massive damage to strikecraft that enter its event horizon.
column2: 巡洋舰是一种精英级别的舰船，每个舰队限拥有一艘；它们不属于标准舰船序列，但有资格获得快速反应支援（FRS）舰船提供的全舰队增益。虚空穿刺巡洋舰是一艘强大的战舰，它凭借内爆武器甚至可以应对星系外的威胁，并且随着等级提升，该武器的装填速度会更快。这艘巡洋舰同样令小型飞船畏惧，因为它可以制造临时的奇点裂隙，对进入其事件视界的战机造成巨大伤害。

column1: Depending on the difficulty level, AI Progress (AIP), and other situational factors, sooner or later you're going to see a Cross Planet Attack (CPA).          This is when a whole bunch of ships of the AI abandon their strictly-defensive postures and band together into one giant flash mob that hits you from potentially multiple directions at once... hard.  You'll get some warning that this is about to happen, but knowing in advance that it CAN happen is pretty useful.  Basically if you think you're perfectly protected because you gate-raided one side of your empire and have some moderate defenses over there... it could be that's just the weak point that the CPA (or, heck, even the Hunter Fleet) sees and exploits later.  Of course, that cuts both ways: you can leave a planet that looks intentionally weak but which has a strong neighbor willing to step in and crush the foes that show up.  The Hunter Fleet is particularly wise to this sort of trick and factors it into its decisions on when and where to attack.  But it still has some utility, and is worth experimenting with.
column2: AI 的跨行星攻击（CPAs）是一大威胁。它们可能从星系的任何地方发起，让你防不胜防。抵御 CPAs 的最佳方法是在所有行星上建立强大的防御。你还应该有办法在行星受到攻击时迅速增援。            增援行星的一种方法是使用运输舰。运输舰能通过虫洞运送舰队，让你迅速将舰队从一个行星转移到另一个行星。你也可以使用炮塔和力场来防御行星。炮塔可以攻击来袭的 CPAs，力场则能阻挡它们。            另一种抵御 CPAs 的方法是尝试预测它们的来源。AI 的 CPAs 通常基于它控制的行星。如果你能确定可能是 CPAs 来源的行星，就可以将防御力量集中在这些行星上。            但即使你有强大的防御，AI 的 CPAs 仍然是个威胁。你需要准备好随着游戏的进行调整策略。如果 AI 开始集中攻击某个行星，你可能需要增援该行星或将舰队转移到其他行星。

column1: Depending on the networking framework you are using, there may not even BE any fragmented messages (or rather, there are, but they are handled well below our code).  In certain cases, such as anything over 500KB being sent on Steam, we have to do our own fragmentation.             This fragmentation is pretty much limited to just the initial sending of exceptionally large save games across the network.  When this option is on, then any fragmented messages that are sent or reconstituted will be written into the PlayerData/NetworkFragmentedMessages folder.  If there is some sort of problem, then by enabling this on all the involved computers and then comparing the files with the same names helps us figure out what is going on.
column2: 根据您使用的网络框架，可能根本没有分片消息(或者说有，但在我们代码底层处理)。在某些情况下，比如通过Steam发送超过500KB的内容时，我们必须自己处理分片。             这种分片基本上仅限于最初通过网络发送特别大的存档文件。启用此选项后，任何发送或重组的分片消息都将写入PlayerData/NetworkFragmentedMessages文件夹。如果出现问题，在所有相关计算机上启用此选项并比较同名文件有助于我们找出问题所在。

column1: Depending on the number of planets in your galaxy and the number of human empire factions, it will seed a certain number of citadel for you to find. column1: Don't neglect transports!  They let you bypass planets that are dangerous, but which you don't want to capture.  You'll end up with a fragmented empire if you hop planets, but a much healthier AI Progress.  All of your offensive fleet centerpieces work as transports for the members of their fleet, even your Arks and Golems.  The L key loads all of the units in a selected fleet into their fleet leader, and the U key unloads them afterwards.
column2: 不要忽视运输舰！它们让你能绕过那些危险但你不想占领的行星。虽然这样会导致帝国版图零散，但能保持更健康的AI进度值。  你所有的进攻舰队核心单位，包括方舟和魔像，都能作为其舰队成员的运输舰。按L键可将选中舰队的所有单位装入其舰队旗舰，之后按U键卸载。

column1: Doomsday mode: Every so often, a planet in the galaxy is destroyed. Over time the galaxy will get smaller and smaller, leading to a claustrophobic finale.  The planet destroyed can't be a player homeworld, a player owned world, an AI homeworld or bastion world, or a planet with a player flagship on it. You will not get any prior warning as to which planet will be destroyed, and over time the planets will be destroyed more slowly.  The destroyed planet will not generate any AIP from any source.
column2: 末日模式：每隔一段时间，银河系中的一个行星会被摧毁。随着时间推移，银河系将变得越来越小，导致令人窒息的结局。  被摧毁的行星不能是玩家的母星，玩家拥有的世界，AI母星或堡垒世界，或有玩家旗舰的行星。 你不会得到任何关于哪个行星将被摧毁的预警，随着时间推移，行星被摧毁的速度会变慢。  被摧毁的行星不会从任何来源产生任何AIP。

column1: Each of the four races has unique ships and defenses, but they also have access to unique powers you will need throughout the game.  The Spire are expert researchers, and are the primary source of Science Generators; they are a major source of your Science. The Spire ships are glass cannon, intended to provide immense damage but need protection. The Neinzul are master craftsbeings, and are the only race that can build Metal Generators; they are a major source of your Metal, and your empire will struggle without them. The Zenith contribute their vast Planetary Drills; Drilling planets is the primary way you can get Cuendillar. They also get some minor access to Science Generators. Zenith ships are excellent at crowd control. The Templar are master warriors. Their Strongholds have excellent defenses.
column2: 四个种族各有独特的单位和防御，但他们也拥有你在整个游戏中需要的独特能力。  尖塔是专业的研究者，是科技发生器的主要来源；他们是你科技的主要来源。尖塔单位是玻璃大炮，提供巨大伤害但需要保护。 奈祖尔是大师级工匠种族，是唯一能建造金属发生器的种族；他们是你的金属主要来源，没有他们你的帝国将举步维艰。 天顶贡献了他们的巨型行星钻机；钻探行星是获取坤迪亚的主要方式。他们也可以少量使用科技发生器。天顶单位擅长群体控制。 圣殿骑士是大师级战士。他们的要塞拥有出色的防御。

column1: Economically, the 'SuperCat' AI gets a substantially unfair advantage.  Militarily, they still play fair but will be able to bring overwhelming force against you in most every situation, all the time.  A subset of dedicated players enjoy this difficulty level, but it is not fun for most.  Beating the SuperCat even once is considered a crowning achievement, and usually involves a player discovering an unbalanced tactic.  If you find yourself in the enviable position of being able to have your name added to those who win a 'pure' difficulty 10 win, please file a bug report with any tips you have on how we can (legitimately) upgrade the AI to counter your winning strategy.  This back-and-forth arms race between the players and the developers has led to some of the most interesting innovations for all levels of AI for the game (and its predecessor), and it is also a very specific style of brutal gauntlet that certain dedicated individuals enjoy throwing themselves into.
column2: 在经济方面，'超级猫' AI 拥有极大的不公平优势。在军事方面，它虽然遵循规则，但在大多数情况下都能对您施加压倒性的力量。  有一部分专注的玩家喜欢这个难度级别，但对大多数人来说并不好玩。哪怕只是战胜一次'超级猫'都被视为一项至高成就，而且通常需要玩家发现一种不平衡的策略。  如果您有幸成为在'纯粹'难度 10 下获胜并能留名的玩家之一，请提交一份错误报告，并附上您关于我们如何（合理地）升级 AI 以对抗您的获胜策略的建议。  玩家和开发者之间的这种你来我往的军备竞赛，为这款游戏（及其前身）的各个难度级别的 AI 带来了一些最有趣的创新，同时这也是一种特定的残酷挑战，某些专注的玩家乐于投身其中。

A Gray Sphere and a Chromatic sphere will be automatically seeded when this Faction is enabled, and these factions will use the Intensity set for this faction.  A Dark Spire faction will be automatically added alongside this Faction, and can be configured separately.  If you help either the Gray Spire or Chromatic Spire become suitably dominant, you will be able to hack them in order to get either Warheads (Gray Spire) or Interplanetary Weapons (Chromatic Spire).  <color=#f25e1c>HIGH IMPACT:</color> By enabling this, not only are you adding in two Sphere factions and a Dark Spire faction, but every single one will be stronger than normal, and be actively aiming to fight. You will have a whole other war to worry about than your own.  Most notably, the Dark Spire do not care who attacked them, and will be out for blood. You'll want to shore up your defenses more than usual to account for this.
column2: 启用分裂尖塔，这是黑暗尖塔与银河系中所有星体派系之间的大规模战争。星体派系将派出小型特遣部队，联合起来试图拆解黑暗尖塔的虚空巨构以获取部件，而黑暗尖塔的虚空巨构则更有可能扩张。随着黑暗尖塔的虚空巨构被摧毁，它们将留下残骸，星体派系将为各自的派系争夺额外收入而战斗。昔日的朋友可能成为明日的敌人。  启用此派系时，将自动生成一个灰色星体和一个多彩星体，这些派系将使用为此派系设置的强度。  将自动添加一个黑暗尖塔派系，并且可以单独配置。  如果你帮助灰色尖塔或多彩尖塔变得足够强大，你将能够入侵它们，以获取弹头（灰色尖塔）或星际武器（多彩尖塔）。  <color=#f25e1c>高影响:</color> 启用此选项后，你不仅会添加两个星体派系和一个黑暗尖塔派系，而且每个派系都会比正常情况下更强大，并积极参战。除了你自己的战争之外，你还需要担心另一场战争。  最值得注意的是，黑暗尖塔不在乎是谁攻击了它们，它们会进行报复。你需要比平时加强防御来应对这一点。

column1: Enabling this changes the Cross Planet Attack logic. Ships released by a CPA now flood into your empires from all over the place in a jumbled and exciting rush, rather than joining the Hunter fleet and waiting for an opening.        This reckless attack can create surprising openings for the rest of your enemies to exploit, or it can lead to you mopping up a lot of ships that arrive haphazardly.  One way or the other, it's going to be an event.  Additionally, because the CPA is using such a staggered approach that you can defend against piecemeal, it's going to send twice as many ships as usual.  This can be really good for you, in terms of greatly weakening the defenses of AI planets, but it comes with inherent dangers.  Disabling this causes the CPA's ships to join the AI threat, and they will be more calculated in their attacks.

column1: Enemies will regularly send waves of ships against you from their warp gates, and waves can only be aimed at planets directly next to a planet with a surviving gate.  So every warp gate adjacent to your territory is a enemy attack point.  The easiest way to shore up that weakness is to raid those AI planets and destroy just the warp gate (not the command station), which will incur an AI Progress (AIP) cost, but not nearly so severe of one as destroying the command station would.  You're likely to aggro the planet pretty heavily when you do this, so be prepared either for them to counterattack your planet traveling through physical space (aka not a wave), or, possibly worse, to join the Hunter Fleet and increment the threat counter.  Expect to then see them in the future at a time when you least want to have them added to something else you're dealing with.  One additional consideration: if you destroy ALL the warp gates next to your territory, the AI can no longer send normal waves against you at all.  However, <color=#ffa1a1>its wave budget is never reduced, only saved up</color>, and the moment a valid target exists again (for example, right after you capture a planet next to a surviving gate) <color=#ffa1a1>the next wave that arrives will be much larger</color>.  One potential strategy is to leave one gate up next to a well-defended planet, so that waves keep arriving somewhere predictable instead of piling up for later.  Exogalactic Strikeforces can come from Warp Gates, but other AI attack forces Cross Planet Attacks, the Hunter Fleet, Border Aggression) don't use warp gates and are unaffected by gate raiding.  Once you destroy a warp gate adjacent to your planets, the wormhole link from the AI planet to your planets will be shown as extra thin.
column2: AI 的波次攻击着实让人头疼。你既要防御它们，又不想被动挨打。突袭传送门是控制波次降临地点的一种方法。这意味着你要派遣一支舰队前往波次来源行星，摧毁那里的传送门。这样既能阻止该行星发送波次，还能让你有机会占领该行星。            要做到这一点，你的舰队必须足够强大，能够应对行星的防御。你还需要一种能让舰队快速抵达行星的方法。运输舰是个不错的选择，因为它们能通过虫洞运送舰队。一旦舰队抵达行星，就可以开始攻击传送门。传送门被摧毁后，该行星就不会再发送波次，你就可以着手占领行星了。            请记住，突袭传送门是个冒险的策略。如果你派舰队去攻打过于强大的行星，可能会损失舰队。你还要注意不要过度扩张。如果你向不同行星派遣太多舰队，可能会分散兵力，导致已占领的行星失守。            但如果策略得当，突袭传送门能非常有效地控制波次降临地点，让你在游戏中占据显著优势。

column1: Exactly how the AI goes about getting a reinforcement bonus is... complicated.  But basically, the more planets you are owning territory next to (and thus alerting), the more planets the AI will pump reinforcements into that you'll eventually have to fight.          However, AIs get more or fewer units in their reinforcements depending on how many guard posts they have.  And guard posts don't cost AI Progress (AIP) to destroy!  So if there are some planets that are next to you, and which you are planning on leaving in AI hands for the long haul because you don't want the AIP increase that taking them would cause... consider neutering them instead.  Neutering means to go in and destroy all the guard posts, but leave the command station intact, and up-to-you about the warp gate.  This will make any reinforcements at that planet much more anemic, and makes the ship cap for the AI at that planet also far lower.  In some ways its a way to make the AI waste part of its own budget by making their planets simply not as effective on the border between you and them, and that can really pay off long-term.
column2: 削弱行星是指摧毁该行星上 AI 的所有岗哨，但保留指挥站，传送门则可自行决定是否摧毁。这会降低 AI 在该行星生产单位和炮塔的能力，也会减缓其研发新技术的速度。这是降低 AI 在你边境效力的有效方法。            不过，削弱行星是个冒险的策略。如果你派舰队去攻打过于强大的行星，可能会损失舰队。你还要注意不要过度扩张。如果你向不同行星派遣太多舰队，可能会分散兵力，导致已占领的行星失守。            但如果策略得当，削弱行星能非常有效地降低 AI 在你边境的效力，让你在游戏中占据显著优势。

column1: Examining the Tsunami Devourer Chrysalis can grant us more insight into how bio-organic multi-redundant segmented weapon systems can be linked together and controlled efficiently. Instead of having to split fire between targets this allows for multiple semi-sentient turrets - a task that would be easy with, but is now possible without using AI technology.

column1: Examining the beyond huge structure of a Tier 3 Devourer and what it takes to construct 'smaller' structures such as planetoid-sized Devourer 'drones' has greatly advanced our knowledge in hull technology. It stores kinetic energy from friction, material compression and impact inside kinetic capacitors, and while we can't build anything big enough to require doing so we can now discharge it directly into enemy hulls.
