column1: Expert mode is an alternate, more difficult, official campaign type for AI War 2. Expert campaigns are tense and complex, where you must choose your strategic targets very carefully.  If you wish to report the 'bug' of having beaten the difficulty-10 AI, using Expert mode (or higher) is required.  HA mode has some mechanics that can be abused in service of that specific goal, and that's a feature not a bug.  Details: various galaxy options that make the game cheesy-easy are locked off, and you must fight a minimum of two AIs.  A lot of the complexity of the game is lost when you only have one AI, because you don't get that ramp-up in challenge after defeating the first one, and have to figure out how to still deal with the second one.                   In addition to everything that Challenger mode adds, this mode forces on mechanics that make beachheading harder to cheese.  You also get only one Battlestation at the start, rather than two.  There are some other features that are only forced on for Expert, but you can enable most of those features in lower modes as well.  Fuel is not required until Logistician, because that fundamentally changes the game flow in ways that not everyone is going to appreciate.  However, fuel can be enabled as an option in any mode.
column2: 专家模式是《AI战争2》的另一种更具挑战性的官方战役类型。专家战役紧张而复杂，你必须非常谨慎地选择战略目标。  如果你想报告“击败难度为10的AI”这个“漏洞”，则需要使用专家模式（或更高难度）。HA模式有一些机制可以被用来实现这个特定目标，这是一个特性而非漏洞。  详情：各种让游戏变得简单取巧的星系选项被锁定，你必须至少与两个AI作战。当你只面对一个AI时，游戏的很多复杂性就会丧失，因为击败第一个AI后，你不会面临挑战的升级，还得想办法应对第二个AI。                   除了挑战者模式添加的所有内容外，此模式还强制启用了一些让抢滩登陆更难取巧的机制。游戏开始时你也只有一个战斗空间站，而不是两个。还有一些功能仅在专家模式下强制启用，但你也可以在较低难度模式下启用其中大部分功能。  直到后勤专家模式才需要燃料，因为这会从根本上改变游戏流程，并非所有人都喜欢这种改变。不过，你可以在任何模式下选择启用燃料。

FXAA is a post-processing effect that reduces pixelation at the edges of objects.  For the galaxy map, this mainly means smoothing things like the lines between planets.  This is not a very taxing process, so we use it by default.  It’s worth noting that it subdues the stars in the background quite a bit.

column1: Far before the days of automated space warfare barbarians (back then still fighting in person with each other, imagine that!) used physical shields to protect themselves and walls of shields in formation to effectively block ranged attacks. Lances in the gaps between allowed them to strike at opponents. While ancient the idea was worth it, enough so to warrant the development of a specialized ship re-using this tactic.

column1: Firing self-accelerating unguided bullets against mobile enemies was long hailed a 'shot in the dark' as it became increasingly hard to predict the movements of shot and target at the ranges it'd take for effective firepower. It turned out that this could be alleviated by simply using more data points, that is to say: More ships sharing their specialized targeting data turning every shot into a hit.

column1: Flood the system with radiation that will help capture a Relic falling through the galaxy. The Relic will appear, or the resonance frequency will tell you how far this planet is from the Relic.  In the event that you DO find the Relic here, be prepared!  Be ready with huge fleets to protect it, and holding planets en route with defenses can help a lot too. Be ready to probably pause and figure out where you want to send the Relic.  You will be swarmed and die if you don't make a decision quickly, as AI forces spawn endlessly until you get this thing to safety, so pausing is a good idea.  In multiplayer, the player who hacks for the relic will have control over the resulting city.
column2: 向星系中释放辐射，帮助捕获穿越星系的遗物。遗物将会出现，或者其共振频率会告诉你该行星与遗物的距离。  如果你真的在此处找到了遗物，请做好准备！准备好庞大的舰队来保护它，沿途占领有防御设施的行星也会大有帮助。你可能需要暂停游戏，思考将遗物送往何处。  如果你不迅速做出决定，就会被蜂拥而至的敌人淹没并灭亡，因为在你将遗物转移到安全地带之前，AI 部队会不断生成，所以暂停游戏是个好主意。  在多人游戏中，破解寻找遗物的玩家将控制由此产生的城市。

column1: Flood the system with radiation that will help capture a Relic falling through the galaxy. The Relic will appear, or the resonance frequency will tell you how far this planet is from the Relic.  In the event that you DO find the Relic here, be prepared!  Be ready with huge fleets to protect it, and holding planets en route with defenses can help a lot too. Be ready to probably pause and figure out where you want to send the Relic.  You will be swarmed and die if you don't make a decision quickly, as AI forces spawn endlessly until you get this thing to safety, so pausing is a good idea.  In multiplayer, the player who hacks for the relic will have control over the resulting city.
column2: 用辐射充斥整个星系，以帮助捕获一颗穿越银河的遗物。遗物会出现，或者共振频率会告诉你这个行星离遗物有多远。  如果遗物确实出现在这里，请做好准备！准备好庞大的舰队来保护它，沿途占据行星并设置防御也会有很大帮助。准备暂停并找出你要将遗物送往何处。  如果你不迅速做出决定，你会被淹没并死亡，因为AI部队会不断生成直到你将遗物送到安全地带，所以暂停是个好主意。  在多人游戏中，入侵获取遗物的玩家将控制产生的城市。

column1: Fly deep into space and hack outguard beacons in order to find new outguard groups to talk to.  Some groups are more useful than others, and some are harder to reach than others.  Weigh the pros and cons, and go hack the beacons that seem worth the time and hassle.

column1: From: ----  To: Commander {PlayerName}   Your eminence,   The forces of the {FactionColor}One True Zenith</color> welcome your arrival. Your leadership of our military is the final thing necessary to allow us to subdue this galaxy to our rule.  The economic and logistical aspects of our forces will automatically provide reinforcements to you; they are managed by low-caste servants. It would be dishonorable for someone of your military prowess to sully their appendages with such things. You can give them orders (perhaps to send them away from a battle), but they will return to using their own logic once they finish your orders.  If you grow weary or distracted during the battle, you can use a Galaxy Setting to have our forces fight on without your direct control. Covering captured planets with the Fimbulwinter grants us more science, which will be a critical way of strengthening our forces.  Note that we can't build Epistyles (which produce new ships and structures) on hostile planets.
column2: 发件人：----  致：指挥官 {PlayerName}  阁下，  {FactionColor}唯一真天顶</color> 的力量欢迎你的到来。你对我们军队的领导是使我们能够将这个银河系纳入我们统治之下的最后必要条件。  我们部队的经济和后勤方面将自动为你提供增援；它们由低种姓仆从管理。对于像你这样拥有军事才能的人来说，弄脏自己的肢体去处理这些事情是有失体面的。你可以给他们命令（也许是将他们从战斗中调离），但一旦他们完成你的命令，就会恢复使用他们自己的逻辑。  如果你在战斗中感到疲惫或分心，你可以使用银河设置让我们的部队在没有你直接控制的情况下继续战斗。用芬布尔之冬覆盖被占领的行星会为我们提供更多的科学点数，这将是增强我们力量的关键方式。  请注意，我们无法在敌对行星上建造柱顶（用于生产新单位和建筑）。

column1: From: Chief Communications Officer Demetri Rosenbaum Communications Department - Home Command  To: Commander {PlayerName}  Commander,   We have received communications from the Gray Spire on {PlanetName}. While our translation software is rough at best, they appear to seek peaceful relations with us. Their only notable request being we not linger on their Sphere World for too long, lest they respond with force.
column2: 发件人：首席通信官德米特里·罗森鲍姆 通信部 - 指挥部  致：指挥官 {PlayerName}  指挥官，  我们已经收到了来自 {PlanetName} 上灰色尖塔的通信。虽然我们的翻译软件仍然很粗糙，但它们似乎寻求与我们和平相处。它们唯一值得注意的要求是我们不要在其球体世界上逗留太久，否则它们会以武力回应。

column1: From: Chief Communications Officer Demetri Rosenbaum Communications Department - Home Command  To: Commander {PlayerName}  Commander,  Beacons are a way to bring the gameplay flexibility of the game lobby forward into the game itself. You can hack beacons to add additional factions to your gameplay.  The goal is to allow you to dynamically update their game to taste; feel like you're losing? Add in an ally. Want some more challenge? Add a scary new opponent.  Use of beacons is optional, and they can be disabled in the game lobby.
column2: 发件人：首席通信官德米特里·罗森鲍姆 通信部 - 指挥部  致：指挥官 {PlayerName}  指挥官，  信标是一种将游戏大厅的游戏灵活性带入游戏本身的方法。你可以入侵信标来为你的游戏添加额外的派系。  其目标是让你能够动态地根据自己的喜好更新游戏；感觉快要输了？加入一个盟友。想要更多挑战？加入一个可怕的新对手。  信标的使用是可选的，并且可以在游戏大厅中禁用。

column1: From: Chief Communications Officer Demetri Rosenbaum Communications Department - Home Command  To: Commander {PlayerName}  Commander,  During a recent routine scan for variations in the AI's warp grid, our personnel detected an abnormal subspace signal on {PlanetName}. Further analysis confirmed that we have no record of similar phenomena. It seems to be generated by some sort of alien Relic.  We should consider sending a flagship to research this relic; our Hacking interface should enable us to understand it more clearly. Scans also show increased AI warp activity in that area. While this lab cannot issue military recommendations, for the sake of our team I personally request that you carry a very large stick.   We also have a suspicion that after this hack there will be no going back. I would recommend preparing to defend our planets, because AI will be very aware of us after this.
column2: 发件人：首席通信官德米特里·罗森鲍姆 通信部 - 指挥部  致：指挥官 {PlayerName}  指挥官，  在最近一次扫描人工智能跃迁网格变化的过程中，我们的人员在 {PlanetName} 上检测到了一个异常的亚空间信号。进一步分析确认我们对类似现象没有任何记录。它似乎是由某种外星遗物产生的。  我们应该考虑派遣一艘旗舰去研究这个遗物；我们的入侵界面应该能让我们更清楚地理解它。扫描还显示该区域的人工智能跃迁活动增加。虽然本实验室不能提出军事建议，但为了我们团队的安全，我个人请求你带上一根非常大的棍棒。  我们还怀疑这次入侵后将没有回头路。我建议准备防守我们的行星，因为人工智能在此之后将高度意识到我们的存在。

column1: From: Chief Communications Officer Demetri Rosenbaum Communications Department - Home Command  To: Commander {PlayerName}  Commander,  This... is a day we will remember. Assuming we survive. We have found the source of the powerful energy signal on {PlanetName}. This relic seems to have been the power core of an alien starship, a starship crewed by an unknown alien race. It seems to have hidden out of phase with our reality until our scanners triggered some kind of reaction. While only minor fragments of the ship itself have survived, a portion of the crew and rudimentary propulsion capability remain intact.   Our previous contact with the Zenith and others has made the linguistic situation at least possible, but we're still working on getting these translators to do something other than spit out gibberish. Gibberish aside, we have been able to determine that they are on the run from the AI, and want us to rescue them. We can only assume that this means taking them to a safe planet where we can protect them from the AI. Given the sheer power level present in that core, this new race clearly has the capability to be dangerous. Whether to us or the AI has yet to be determined. It's your call whether or not this is a good idea. In any event, what's left of the alien ship will now obey your commands.  Judging by local AI warp activity, we'd better get it moving!
column2: 发件人：首席通信官德米特里·罗森鲍姆 通信部 - 指挥部  致：指挥官 {PlayerName}  指挥官，  这……是值得纪念的一天。假设我们能活下来。我们在 {PlanetName} 上找到了强大能量信号的来源。这个遗物似乎是一艘外星星际飞船的能量核心，一艘由未知外星种族驾驶的飞船。它似乎在我们的现实之外相位隐藏，直到我们的扫描仪触发了某种反应。虽然飞船本身只有微小的碎片幸存下来，但一部分船员和基本的推进能力仍然完好。  我们之前与天顶以及其他种族的接触使语言处理至少成为可能，但我们仍在努力让这些翻译器做除了吐出胡言乱语之外的事情。撇开胡言乱语不谈，我们已经能够确定他们正在逃离人工智能，并希望我们营救他们。我们只能假设这意味着要带他们到一个安全的行星，在那里我们可以保护他们免受人工智能的伤害。考虑到那个核心中所展现的纯粹力量水平，这个新种族显然有能力变得危险。是对我们还是对人工智能，还有待确定。这是否是个好主意，由你来决定。无论如何，外星飞船的残骸将听命于你的指挥。  从当地人工智能跃迁活动的情况来看，我们最好赶紧行动！

column1: From: Chief Communications Officer Demetri Rosenbaum Communications Department - Home Command  To: Commander {PlayerName}  Commander,  We have received what we believe to be communications from who we have dubbed the Chromatic Spire. We say 'we believe', due to nearly the entire feed being entirely impossible to understand 'siren-like' sounds. Any attempt on our end to respond was met with an increasingly louder response.  We believe these to be threatening responses, and highly suggest we watch our military presence near them, lest we invoke their ire. Peaceful coexistence beyond avoidance seems impossible.
column2: 发件人：首席通信官德米特里·罗森鲍姆 通信部 - 指挥部  致：指挥官 {PlayerName}  指挥官，  我们收到了我们称之为彩色尖塔的通信。我们说"我们相信"，因为几乎整个信息流都是完全无法理解的类似"海妖之歌"的声音。我们任何尝试回应都会遇到越来越响亮的回应。  我们相信这些是威胁性的响应，并强烈建议我们注意靠近它们时的军事存在，以免招致它们的怒火。除了回避之外，和平共处似乎是不可能的。

column1: From: Chief Communications Officer Demetri Rosenbaum Communications Department - Home Command  To: Commander {PlayerName}  Commander,  We're detecting some odd energy readings in the subspace band. We should keep an eye out for anomalies and unexpected events. Something big is coming.
column2: 发件人：首席通信官德米特里·罗森鲍姆 通信部 - 指挥部  致：指挥官 {PlayerName}  指挥官，  我们检测到亚空间频段中有一些异常能量读数。我们应该密切关注异常现象和意外事件。有什么大事要来了。

column1: From: Chief Communications Officer Demetri Rosenbaum Communications Department - Home Command  To: Commander {PlayerName}  Commander,  We’ve picked up faint background activity broadcasting from an anomalous AI data center. On further inspection, we’ve detected a heavily encrypted message originating from … well, somewhere off the warp grid, as best as we can tell. Incredibly, someone figured out a way to corrupt the data center’s transceiver, locking out the AI from accessing its external memory banks and hijacking its transmitter.  We almost missed a second, unencrypted message. It’s a looped recording, claiming there is a decentralized resistance movement against the AI. If we can decrypt the primary message, we will learn the hailing frequencies of these “Outguards,” as we’ve internally labeled them.  This “Outguard Beacon” can access only a couple of the Outguard frequencies, but we believe more of these beacons are hiding in plain sight. If we are able to successfully open a hailing channel, these Outguards will be powerful allies that we can call in desperation. The AI will certainly try to prevent this, and this should not be attempted without sufficient forces.  We will be able to share some of our technology with these Outguards, and they will be able to summon stronger forces if we have compatible ships. However, they lack the manufacturing capabilities to produce high mark ships as efficiently as our factories, so we can expect to see fewer ships as their mark increases. They will need time to regather their strength between summons, so we should be wary of calling without need.   As a personal note, it gives me hope to see signs of others fighting the machine menace. I’m sure they need us as much as we need them.
column2: 发件人：首席通信官德米特里·罗森鲍姆 通信部 - 指挥部  致：指挥官 {PlayerName}  指挥官，  我们从一个异常的人工智能数据中心捡到了微弱的背景活动广播。经过进一步检查，我们检测到一条高度加密的信息，该信息起源于……好吧，据我们所知，是在星际网格之外的某个地方。令人难以置信的是，有人找到了破坏数据中心收发器的方法，锁定了人工智能对其外部存储库的访问，并劫持了其发射器。  我们差点错过了第二条未加密的信息。这是一段循环录音，声称存在一个去中心化的抵抗运动对抗人工智能。如果我们能解密主要信息，我们将了解到这些"外卫部队"（我们内部如此称呼）的联络频率。  这个"外卫信标"只能访问几个外卫频率，但我们相信还有更多这样的信标隐藏在显眼之处。如果我们能成功打开联络信道，这些外卫部队将成为强大的盟友，我们可以在绝望时召唤他们。人工智能肯定会试图阻止这一点，没有足够力量不应该尝试。  我们将能够与这些外卫部队分享一些我们的技术，如果我们有兼容的单位，他们将能够召唤更强大的部队。然而，他们缺乏像我们的工厂一样高效生产高级别单位的制造能力，因此随着级别提高，我们预计看到的单位数量会减少。他们需要在召唤之间重新集结力量，所以我们应该谨慎使用，没有需要就不要召唤。  就我个人而言，看到有其他人在对抗机器威胁的迹象给了我希望。我相信他们需要我们的程度不亚于我们需要他们。

column1: From: Chief Engineer Gabriel Larsen RnD Department - Home Command  To: Commander {PlayerName}  Commander,  The way you can upgrade ships with science is by increasing them in mark level from 1 to 7. This can be done in a few ways. The most obvious way is via the Tech sidebar (press T). Most ships are associated with two techs, so which techs you choose determines which ships get marked up.  For thematic and clarity reasons, the techs are often prefixed Hull or Weapon, but bear in mind that the label does not specifically affect weapons or hull health; ships upgrade identically no matter how you do it. You can also upgrade command station fleets and battlestation/citadel fleets (all turrets and units within them!) from the fleet details window for them. Either select that from the Fleets tab (F key), or hold C and click the fleet leader. Direct fleet upgrades on planets tend to be an incredibly good deal, when it comes to return on science spent. These usually have major economic benefits, as well.  It is also possible to upgrade mobile fleet leaders, like transports (almost always a bad deal), or officers (Golems or Arks -- can go either way in terms of deal quality).   Balancing out where you invest science, between direct fleet upgrades and tech upgrades is not always easy. But a starting pair of upgrades to home command station fleet is almost always wise. It's also often very commonly a good idea to wait on hull upgrades until much later in the game, due to their expense. They become a good deal when you have a lot of fleet lines that benefit from them.  If you change your mind, you can always refund science spent on fleets or techs by using the button at the very bottom of the tech tab. It does have a cost in hacking points, but is something you can typically afford to do once or twice a game without being too short on hacking points.  Speaking of hacking points, you can also upgrade or even transform fleet leaders from the fleet details screen by spending hacking points. You can switch to a basic transport to a more advanced transport type, do the same for a combat factory, double the hull health of a golem, or various other things.
column2: 发件人：总工程师加布里埃尔·拉森 研发部 - 指挥部  致：指挥官 {PlayerName}  指挥官，  用科学点数升级单位的方式是将其等级从 1 级提升到 7 级。这可以通过几种方式完成。最直接的方式是通过科技侧边栏（按 T 键）。大多数单位与两项科技相关联，因此你选择的科技决定了哪些单位获得等级提升。  出于主题和清晰度的考虑，科技通常带有"船体"或"武器"前缀，但请记住，这些标签并不专门影响武器或船体生命值；无论你通过何种方式升级，单位的提升方式都是一样的。你也可以通过舰队详情窗口升级指挥站舰队和战斗空间站/堡垒舰队（包括其中的所有炮塔和单位）。可以从舰队选项卡（F 键）选择，或按住 C 键点击舰队核心。行星上的直接舰队升级，就科学点数的回报而言，通常是非常划算的交易。这些通常还带有重大的经济收益。  也可以升级移动舰队核心，如运输舰（几乎总是不划算），或军官（傀儡或方舟——价值好坏参半）。  平衡你在直接舰队升级和科技升级之间的科学点数投资并不总是容易的。但几乎总是明智的做法是先对主指挥站舰队进行一两项升级。由于船体升级成本高昂，通常建议将其留到游戏后期再进行。当你拥有大量受益于它们的单位线时，它们会变得划算。  如果你改变了主意，你随时可以使用科技选项卡底部的按钮退还花在舰队或科技上的科学点数。这需要消耗入侵点，但通常每局游戏你可以承担一到两次，而不会太缺入侵点。  说到入侵点，你也可以通过花费入侵点从舰队详情屏幕升级甚至改造舰队核心。你可以将基础运输舰切换为更高级的运输舰类型，对机动兵工厂进行同样的操作，将傀儡的船体生命值翻倍，或进行各种其他操作。

column1: From: Chief Engineer Gabriel Larsen RnD Department - Home Command  To: Commander {PlayerName}  Commander,  While our ships are state-of-the-art, our remaining engineers don't understand the meaning of the word 'rest'. They've figured out ways to modify certain ships even after construction. Not all of them, mind you, but some. If you're seeing this note, then you have at least one modular ship line at your command.  Right... ship lines. Apparently it's too complicated to configure every single ship individually, so the engineers have limited you to applying templates to entire ship lines at once. If you look at your fleet management interface, any ship line capable of modification will have a button labeled 'modules'. Ships can only support a certain number of modules, but higher mark ships may be able to support both a greater number of modules as well as more complex individual modules.  You should be aware that changing out modules will disable the ship line for a short duration, so don't plan on suddenly adding better shields to help with a 'strategic withdrawal' from enemy territory.  Now, if you'll excuse me, I need to deliver a few kilograms of pure caffeine to the engineers' lounge.
column2: 发件人：总工程师加布里埃尔·拉森 研发部 - 指挥部  致：指挥官 {PlayerName}  指挥官，  虽然我们的单位是最先进的，但我们剩下的工程师们不明白"休息"这个词的含义。他们想出了即使在建造后也能修改某些单位的方法。当然不是全部，但有些可以。如果你看到这条消息，那么你至少有了一条可模块化的单位线。  好吧……单位线。显然，逐一配置每个单位太复杂了，所以工程师们将你限制为一次性将模板应用于整条单位线。如果你查看舰队管理界面，任何能够修改的单位线都会有一个标有"模块"的按钮。单位只能支持一定数量的模块，但更高级别的单位可能能够支持更多的模块以及更复杂的单个模块。  你应该知道，更换模块会短暂禁用该单位线，所以不要计划在"战略性撤退"时突然添加更好的护盾来帮忙。  现在，如果你允许，我需要给工程师休息室送几公斤纯咖啡因。

column1: From: Chief Intelligence Officer Hugo Dawson Intelligence Department - Home Command  To: Commander {PlayerName}  Commander!   Our reconnaissance suggests a massive amount of the AI's forces have been alerted to our activity and are in 'threat' mode.  I want to remind you that High Threat Levels Are Very Dangerous and we are worried about the situation, because having so many ships in 'threat' mode is very dangerous, as they may overwhelm our defenses by their sheer numbers. I hope you consider hunting down large groups of 'threat' and/or reinforcing our defenses for the coming attack.
column2: 发件人：首席情报官雨果·道森 情报部 - 指挥部  致：指挥官 {PlayerName}  指挥官！  我们的侦察表明，大量人工智能部队已被我们的活动惊动，并处于"威胁"模式。  我想提醒你，高威胁级别非常危险，我们对这种情况感到担忧，因为如此多的单位处于"威胁"模式是非常危险的，它们可能凭借数量优势压倒我们的防御。我希望你考虑追剿大型"威胁"群体和/或加强防御以应对即将到来的攻击。

column1: From: Chief Intelligence Officer Hugo Dawson Intelligence Department - Home Command To: Commander {PlayerName} Commander! Our reconnaissance suggests a moderate amount of the AI's forces have been alerted to our activity and are in a 'threat' mode. Your military adviser asked me to remind you about AI Ship Behaviors: - AI ships in each system default to a 'guard' behavior until disturbed into 'threat' mode. - Ships in 'threat' become more aggressive and may attack if they notice a weakness in our defenses. - If 'threat' ships survive long enough, they will join the fleet controlled by the Hunter subroutine and become significantly more dangerous. - Selecting the yellow threat icon on the top of screen will provide detailed information such as how much threat is visible and where it is located. Due to the distributed nature of the the AI’s systems, ships have independent behavior subroutines by default. Without this our effort would have been doomed before it began. TIP: Keep an eye on threat estimations and consider hunting down large groups of 'threat' to keep the level manageable.
column2: 发件人：首席情报官雨果·道森 情报部 - 指挥部 致：指挥官 {PlayerName} 指挥官！ 我们的侦察表明，中等数量的人工智能部队已被我们的活动惊动，并处于"威胁"模式。 你的军事顾问让我提醒你关于人工智能单位的行为模式： - 每个星系中的人工智能单位默认处于"守卫"行为模式，直到被惊动进入"威胁"模式。 - 处于"威胁"模式的单位变得更加激进，如果发现我们防御的弱点可能会发起攻击。 - 如果"威胁"单位存活足够长时间，它们将加入由猎手子程序控制的舰队，并变得更加危险。 - 选择屏幕顶部的黄色威胁图标将提供详细信息，如可见威胁的数量及其位置。 由于其分布式系统架构，人工智能的单位默认拥有独立的行为子程序。如果没有这一点，我们的努力在开始之前就已经注定失败了。 提示： 密切关注威胁评估，并考虑追剿大型"威胁"群体，以将威胁水平控制在可控范围内。

column1: From: Chief Intelligence Officer Hugo Dawson Intelligence Department - Home Command To: Commander {PlayerName} Commander! Our reconnaissance suggests this planet contains a large number of units in 'guard' mode. If we disturb these units but do not destroy them they will activate and become a threat. Consider attacking with sufficient force to wipe out defenders before they escape. TIP: Using forcefield frigates, engine disruption weapons, or tractor ships is a great way to prevent ships from escaping to fight another day.
column2: 发件人：首席情报官雨果·道森 情报部 - 指挥部 致：指挥官 {PlayerName} 指挥官！ 我们的侦察表明，这个行星上有大量处于"守卫"模式的单位。如果我们惊动这些单位但不摧毁它们，它们将被激活并成为威胁。 考虑使用足够的力量攻击，以便在守军逃脱前将其全歼。 提示： 使用力场星舰、引擎干扰武器或牵引舰是防止单位逃脱以改日再战的好方法。

column1: From: Chief Intelligence Officer Hugo Dawson Intelligence Department - Home Command  To: Commander {PlayerName}  Commander!   The {FactionColor}Dark Zenith</color> are terraforming (or should that be Zeniforming?) planets in our Universe to be more suitable for their civilization. These are terrifying alterations that speed up the Dark Zenith and their allies on a planet, and slow their enemies.  It seems they intend to do this to every planet they encounter. If they Zeniform too many planets, we won't have anywhere left to live even if we survive this war; we can still build command stations in orbit, but the planets themselves will be useless for colonization or industrial purposes. Our scientists are referring to the transformation of planets as the Fimbulwinter. Let's hope we can stop this invasion before our scientists start mentioning Ragnarok.
column2: 发件人：首席情报官雨果·道森 情报部 - 指挥部  致：指挥官 {PlayerName}  指挥官！  {FactionColor}黑暗天顶</color> 正在对我们宇宙中的行星进行地球化改造（或者应该说是天顶化改造？）使其更适合它们的文明。这些是可怕的改变，会加速黑暗天顶及其盟友在行星上的活动，并减缓他们的敌人。  看来他们打算对他们遇到的每一颗行星都这样做。如果它们天顶化了太多行星，即使我们在这场战争中幸存下来，我们也没有地方可以居住了；我们仍然可以在轨道上建造指挥站，但行星本身对于殖民或工业目的将毫无用处。我们的科学家将行星的转变称为芬布尔之冬。希望我们能在科学家开始提到诸神黄昏之前阻止这次入侵。

column1: From: Chief Intelligence Officer Hugo Dawson Intelligence Department - Home Command  To: Commander {PlayerName}  Commander!   We've detected a massive dimensional shift. It looks like several planets from another universe have suddenly come into proximity with ours; close enough to allow the Wormhole Grids to align.  Our sensors are picking up extremely strong energy signatures; preliminary analysis shows similarities to Zenith Energy, but it's not an exact match to the relics we've been finding. Our scientists are calling them 'Dark Zenith' based on the differences they're finding in the emission spectra. We're not quite sure what these Dark Zenith are up to, but from the amount of energy they're putting out, this looks like a major incursion. If they're functional Zenith rather than just the derelicts we've found to date, we're in for a difficult war.  Our leading Zenith expert asked me to pass along a message to you. She seemed to be chanting.  Dies iræ, dies illa Solvet saeclum in favilla
column2: 发件人：首席情报官雨果·道森 情报部 - 指挥部  致：指挥官 {PlayerName}  指挥官！  我们检测到一个巨大的维度位移。看起来来自另一个宇宙的几个行星突然与我们的宇宙接近到了足以让虫洞网格对齐的程度。  我们的传感器检测到极其强大的能量信号；初步分析显示与天顶能量相似，但与我们一直发现的遗物并不完全匹配。基于它们在发射光谱上的差异，我们的科学家称之为"黑暗天顶"。我们不太确定这些黑暗天顶想要做什么，但从它们释放的能量来看，这看起来像是一次重大入侵。如果它们是功能完整的天顶而不仅仅是我们迄今发现的残骸，我们将面临一场艰苦的战争。  我们主要的天顶专家让我给你捎个信。她似乎在念诵咒语。  末日之怒，末日之日 将尘世化为灰烬

column1: From: Chief Intelligence Officer Hugo Dawson Intelligence Department - Home Command  To: Commander {PlayerName}  Commander,   A Zenith Miner has killed a Dyson Sphere. This is a tragic day.
column2: 发件人：首席情报官雨果·道森 情报部 - 指挥部  致：指挥官 {PlayerName}  指挥官，  一个天顶采矿者杀死了一个戴森球体。这是悲惨的一天。

column1: From: Chief Intelligence Officer Hugo Dawson Intelligence Department - Home Command  To: Commander {PlayerName}  Commander,   A number of Neinzul, calling themselves the Pearl Custodians, have warped onto our homeworld. They have broadcast a request for alliance, which we have already accepted, and given us a brief explanation of why they are here.  They are one of a number of splinter groups of a now defunct Neinzul Empire, who have split apart due to infighting. In a bid to reclaim their lost safety, they have been scouring the universe looking for aliens to integrate with, due to their far decreased numbers. They believe that a number of their fellow Custodians may also be arriving in the galaxy soon, if they haven't already, and will each attempt to align themselves with another group. When questioned if they believes any to be daring enough to align with the AI, they all collectively replied with a single word: Diamond.  While we won't bore you with the more specifics of our agreement Commander, there are four important things you should know. First, the Custodians are a very powerful, and organized, force. They are ready to prove themselves against our enemies to cement the alliance, but will not intentionally kill themselves to do so. Expect Roaming Enclaves of both our allies, and others, to be much more willing to retreat from a fight.  Second, all of the Roaming Enclaves, that you may have already seen on our homeworld, share an innate bond with a Hive that they brought with them through Warp Space. The Hive will be passively producing warships to assist its aligned Roaming Enclave over time. Should either die, the other will quickly die with it. The same logic applies to any other Custodians we run into; if a Custodian group gets too powerful, aim for the Hives.  Third, these are but a fraction of their total forces. They have split out in thousands of directions while scouring the universe, and communications with their various groups will take time. So while they are capable of producing additional Clanlings and Younglings to bolster their forces, additional Roaming Enclaves will be reliant on these outside forces arriving.  Lastly, each Custodian group we run into shares the same Youngling and Clanling style, but has unique Roaming Enclave warships. We would be wise to see what each Custodian is capable of before engaging them in combat.
column2: 发件人：首席情报官雨果·道森 情报部 - 指挥部  致：指挥官 {PlayerName}  指挥官，  一群自称为珍珠守护者的宁苏人已经跃迁到了我们的母星。他们广播了结盟请求，我们已经接受，并简要解释了为什么他们会在这里。  他们是现已不复存在的宁苏帝国的一个分裂派系之一，因内斗而分裂。为了重拾失去的安全，他们一直在宇宙中搜寻外星人以求融合，因为他们的人数已大幅减少。他们相信，他们的一些同胞守护者可能很快也会到达这个银河系（如果还没到的话），并且每个人都会试图与另一个群体结盟。当被问及是否有人认为会大胆到与人工智能结盟时，他们异口同声地回答了一个词：钻石。  虽然我们不会用我们协议的具体细节来烦扰你，指挥官，但有四件重要的事情你应该知道。首先，守护者是一支非常强大且有组织的部队。他们已经准备好向我们的敌人证明自己以巩固联盟，但不会故意为此自杀。预计我们的盟友和其他人的游荡飞地都会更愿意从战斗中撤退。  第二，你可能已经在我们的母星上看到过的所有游荡飞地，都与它们通过跃迁空间带来的巢群有着天生的联系。巢群会随时间被动地生产战舰来协助其结盟的游荡飞地。如果任一方的死亡，另一方很快就会随之死去。同样的逻辑也适用于我们遇到的任何其他守护者；如果一个守护者群体变得过于强大，就瞄准巢群。  第三，这些只是其总兵力的一小部分。他们在搜寻宇宙时分成了数千个方向，与他们的各个群体的通信需要时间。因此，虽然他们能够生产额外的幼崽和族人增援力量，但额外的游荡飞地将依赖这些外部力量的到达。  最后，我们遇到的每个守护者群体都共享相同的幼崽和族人风格，但拥有独特的游荡飞地战舰。在与他们交战之前，明智的做法是先了解每个守护者的能力。

column1: From: Chief Intelligence Officer Hugo Dawson Intelligence Department - Home Command  To: Commander {PlayerName}  Commander,   Coalition units on {PlanetName} have begun the slow process of dismantling the VG on the planet. We detect raising energy signatures from Dark Spire in response to this, and should prepare accordingly. It may be in our best interests to assist the Coalition in their actions to more swiftly clear the galaxy of this threat.
column2: 发件人：首席情报官雨果·道森 情报部 - 指挥部  致：指挥官 {PlayerName}  指挥官，  {PlanetName} 上的联盟单位已经开始缓慢拆除该行星上的 VG 的过程。我们检测到黑暗尖塔对此正在提高能量信号，并应做好相应准备。协助联盟的行动，更迅速地清除银河系中的这一威胁，可能符合我们的最大利益。

column1: From: Chief Intelligence Officer Hugo Dawson Intelligence Department - Home Command  To: Commander {PlayerName}  Commander,   Coalition units on {PlanetName} have managed to destroy a Dark Spire VG. Our scanners have detected a number of derelict structures have been blasted into neighboring systems, but they look to be rapidly decaying.  More interestingly, each Dyson Sphere appears to be preparing Collector ships to go out and claim these Derelicts for their own needs. These Collectors appear to be empowered with energy from their respective spheres, making them impenetrable to normal weapon fire.  Some of our scientists believe that if we were to combine the power of one of the Dark Spire derelicts with designs they have based off the Dyson Spheres as a whole, they would be able to supercharge these structures in order to be capable of firing on the Collectors. Equally usefully, they believe that these designs could than be reused to defend our own planets at a later date.  While we do not believe our selves capable of making practical use of these derelicts beyond that, it would behoove us to assist whichever Sphere we wish to grow stronger. If we have any desire to do so, our scientists recommend you send a Battlestation to one of the Derelict planets post haste.
column2: 发件人：首席情报官雨果·道森 情报部 - 指挥部  致：指挥官 {PlayerName}  指挥官，  {PlanetName} 上的联盟单位成功摧毁了一个黑暗尖塔 VG。我们的扫描仪检测到一些残骸结构被炸入了邻近星系，但它们看起来正在快速衰变。  更有趣的是，每个戴森球体似乎都在准备收集单位前去索取这些残骸以供自己使用。这些收集者似乎被其各自球体的能量增强，使其对常规武器火力免疫。  我们的一些科学家认为，如果我们将黑暗尖塔残骸的力量与他们基于整个戴森球体设计的设计相结合，他们将能够为这些结构超级充能，使其能够向收集者开火。同样有用的是，他们认为这些设计以后可以再利用来防御我们自己的行星。  虽然我们认为自己没有能力在这些之外实际利用这些残骸，但协助我们希望变得更强壮的球体将是有益的。如果我们有意这样做，我们的科学家建议你立即派遣一个战斗空间站到其中一个残骸行星。

column1: From: Chief Intelligence Officer Hugo Dawson Intelligence Department - Home Command  To: Commander {PlayerName}  Commander,   It looks like a small band of {FactionColor}Dark Zenith</color> have arrived to help their allies in this universe. They will start out weak, but if their economy gets going they can become a powerful threat.  We expect them to expand into any territory held or neutralized by their allies.  Our scientists strongly advise against allowing them to expand unchecked. We've seen the power remaining in Zenith derelicts. We don't want to see fully-functional Zenith arrayed against us.
column2: 发件人：首席情报官雨果·道森 情报部 - 指挥部  致：指挥官 {PlayerName}  指挥官，  看起来一小队 {FactionColor}黑暗天顶</color> 已经抵达，帮助他们在本宇宙的盟友。他们一开始会很弱，但如果他们的经济运转起来，他们可以成为一个强大的威胁。我们预计他们会扩张到其盟友控制或中立化的任何领土。我们的科学家强烈建议不要允许他们无限制地扩张。我们见过天顶残骸中残留的力量。我们可不想看到功能完整的天顶与我们为敌。

column1: From: Chief Intelligence Officer Hugo Dawson Intelligence Department - Home Command  To: Commander {PlayerName}  Commander,   It looks like our uneasy truce with the Zenith Architrave has been broken. They are in a Civil War, which seems to be their only priority for now.  We suspect that once the Civil War comes to an end, the truce will be active again.
column2: 发件人：首席情报官雨果·道森 情报部 - 指挥部  致：指挥官 {PlayerName}  指挥官，  看来我们与天顶额枋之间脆弱的休战已被打破。它们正处于内战中，这似乎是它们现在唯一的优先事项。  我们怀疑一旦内战结束，休战将再次生效。

column1: From: Chief Intelligence Officer Hugo Dawson Intelligence Department - Home Command  To: Commander {PlayerName}  Commander,   It looks like our uneasy truce with the Zenith Architrave has been broken. They have built some Pioneers to help them expand, and during their Expansion they have higher priorities than honoring their truce. They are not the most honorable of races.  We suspect that once all the Pioneers are gone, the truce will be active again.
column2: 发件人：首席情报官雨果·道森 情报部 - 指挥部  致：指挥官 {PlayerName}  指挥官，  看来我们与天顶额枋之间脆弱的休战已被打破。它们建造了一些先驱者来帮助扩张，在扩张期间，它们有比遵守休战更优先的事项。它们并非最守信用的种族。  我们怀疑一旦所有先驱者都消失了，休战将再次生效。

column1: From: Chief Intelligence Officer Hugo Dawson Intelligence Department - Home Command  To: Commander {PlayerName}  Commander,   It looks like we have a Vassal faction. Vassal factions are factions we can give missions to. Vassals are independent and will still do their own thing for the most part, but they are willing to take some advice from us in terms of their targets.  To give our vassals a mission, open the Edit Planet menu on the Galaxy map and set the Priority Level to be Fire_Low/Med/High/Override (these options are at the very bottom). When all the enemies on that planet are killed, the Mission will end for the vassals, so there's no way to currently ask a vassal to defend something.  Low priority targets are added as valid targets for the faction, and made to look extra tasty, but aren't always going to be the top priority for the faction.  Medium/High/Override priority items are always more important than other things that faction can be doing.  If your vassals have a mission to go to a planet, they are much more willing to follow your forces to that planet as well.
column2: 发件人：首席情报官雨果·道森 情报部 - 指挥部  致：指挥官 {PlayerName}  指挥官，  看来我们有一个附庸派系。附庸派系是我们可以给予任务的派系。附庸是独立的，大部分情况下仍然会做自己的事情，但他们愿意在目标方面接受我们的一些建议。  要给予附庸任务，在银河地图上打开编辑行星菜单，并将优先级设置为 Fire_Low/Med/High/Override（这些选项在最底部）。当该行星上的所有敌人都被击杀后，附庸的任务将结束，因此目前没有办法要求附庸防守某物。  低优先级目标被添加为该派系的有效目标，并被呈现得特别诱人，但并不总是该派系的首要任务。  中/高/覆盖优先级项目总是比该派系可能做的其他事情更重要。  如果你的附庸有去某个行星的任务，他们更愿意跟随你的部队到那个行星。

column1: From: Chief Intelligence Officer Hugo Dawson Intelligence Department - Home Command  To: Commander {PlayerName}  Commander,   It looks like we have access to a number of poorly guarded Advanced Research Stations (ARSs). Hacking these can be a really good way to increase our fleet's power!  You can find a list of all the ARSs you've found in the Intel Menu.
column2: 发件人：首席情报官雨果·道森 情报部 - 指挥部  致：指挥官 {PlayerName}  指挥官，  我们似乎可以访问一些防守薄弱的高级研究站。入侵这些站点是增强我们舰队实力的绝佳方式！  你可以在情报菜单中找到所有已发现的高级研究站列表。

column1: From: Chief Intelligence Officer Hugo Dawson Intelligence Department - Home Command  To: Commander {PlayerName}  Commander,   It seems that not all of the spire Relics have remained intact. Creating a new spire city has allowed them to find debris from broken Relics. This debris is packed with energy and could be useful for whoever is able to claim it.
column2: 发件人：首席情报官雨果·道森 情报部 - 指挥部  致：指挥官 {PlayerName}  指挥官，  似乎并非所有尖塔遗物都保持完好。建造新的尖塔城市使他们能够找到破碎遗物的残骸。这些残骸充满了能量，对于任何能够获取它们的人来说都可能有用。

column1: From: Chief Intelligence Officer Hugo Dawson Intelligence Department - Home Command  To: Commander {PlayerName}  Commander,   It seems that we have observed some Elderlings go mad. The Elderlings seem to be very territorial; they emit a radiation that seems to provoke other Elderlings that get too close.  When this happens, it looks like the Elderling will either become hostile to everything in range, or it will seek out enemies on other planets and fight to the death.  We can monitor the sanity of these Elderlings and predict when they will go mad. We can use this information to prepare our defenses or strike during the chaos.
column2: 发件人：首席情报官雨果·道森 情报部 - 指挥部  致：指挥官 {PlayerName}  指挥官，  看来我们观察到一些远古者发疯了。远古者似乎非常具有领土意识；它们会散发一种辐射，似乎会激怒靠得太近的其他远古者。  当这种情况发生时，远古者要么会对范围内的一切变得敌对，要么会寻找其他行星上的敌人并战斗至死。  我们可以监控这些远古者的理智并预测它们何时会发疯。我们可以利用这些信息来准备防御或在混乱中发动攻击。

column1: From: Chief Intelligence Officer Hugo Dawson Intelligence Department - Home Command  To: Commander {PlayerName}  Commander,   Our scanners on {PlanetName} are reporting strange anomalies. As best we can tell, what appears to be wormholes have opened up on the edge of the system. Unlike the traditional kind that we know of however, these don't appear to originate from our galaxy, and are more curiously orbiting around the sector.  We have noted a number of smaller strikecraft flooding out of the wormhole, though they are rapidly decomposing upon reaching our space. Our Military Leaders report them broadcasting an open signal that we were able to replicate remotely, and we believe these smaller ships to be friendly.  Of more note is a much larger signal coming through the wormhole which our scientists believe to be from a ship of a much larger scale than these swarms. It may be worth investigating in person. We will continue to monitor the situation and brief you when we learn more.
column2: 发件人：首席情报官雨果·道森 情报部 - 指挥部  致：指挥官 {PlanetName}  指挥官，  我们在 {PlanetName} 上的扫描仪报告了奇怪的异常现象。据我们所知，虫洞似乎在星系边缘打开了。然而，与我们已知的传统虫洞不同，这些虫洞似乎并非起源于我们的银河系，而且更奇怪的是它们在围绕该星区运行。  我们注意到大量小型战机从虫洞中涌出，但它们在抵达我们的空间后正在迅速分解。我们的军事领导人报告说，它们在广播一个开放信号，我们能够远程复制，并且我们相信这些小单位是友好的。  更值得注意的是，我们相信虫洞中有一个更大的信号来自一个比这些蜂群规模大得多的单位。可能值得亲自调查。我们将继续监控情况，并在了解更多信息后向你汇报。

column1: From: Chief Intelligence Officer Hugo Dawson Intelligence Department - Home Command  To: Commander {PlayerName}  Commander,   Our scanners on {PlanetName} have located a startling discovery. Up until this point, every single opposing force we've discovered has avoided the use of the various Metal Generators spread throughout the galaxy. However, it appears these aliens have begun to tap into them much as we have. These 'Wild Hives,' coined by your Science Advisor, pose a potential roadblock to the campaign.     This infestation appears to be deeply ingrained into the metal generator, and we can detect a large number of sentient life flowing throughout the generator, growing stronger over time. It does not seem to be inherently hostile, but it does seem to be causing issues with engines and weaponry on its planet.  Your Military Advisor strongly recommends a show of force, before they are allowed to spread and cripple your already strained war economy.  Your Science Advisor however recommends a softer approach. They claim that we won't need every single resource in the galaxy, and that this is an incredible attempt to get an in depth look into alien life. They do reluctantly agree that, if they claim too much of our territory however, force may be required.
column2: 发件人：首席情报官雨果·道森 情报部 - 指挥部  致：指挥官 {PlayerName}  指挥官，  我们在 {PlanetName} 上的扫描仪有了一个惊人的发现。到目前为止，我们发现的每一支敌对力量都避免使用遍布银河系的各种金属发生器。然而，这些外星人似乎像我们一样开始利用它们。你的科学顾问称它们为"野生蜂巢"，它们对我们的战役构成了潜在障碍。  这种侵扰似乎深深植根于金属发生器中，我们可以检测到大量知觉生命在发生器中流动，随着时间变得越来越强大。它们似乎并非天生敌对，但确实似乎在其行星上对引擎和武器造成问题。  你的军事顾问强烈建议在它们得以扩散并削弱你已经紧张的战时经济之前展示武力。  然而，你的科学顾问建议采取更温和的方法。他们声称我们不需要银河系中的每一种资源，而这是一个深入了解外星生命的绝佳机会。但他们不情愿地同意，如果它们占领了我们太多领土，武力可能是必要的。

column1: From: Chief Intelligence Officer Hugo Dawson Intelligence Department - Home Command  To: Commander {PlayerName}  Commander,   Our scanners on {PlanetName} have reported that a much larger vessel has arrived from the wormhole, before the wormhole immediately closed behind it.  From what we can see, this ship, dubbed the Roaming Enclave, while weak by itself, has some of the most potent acidic weaponry we have ever seen.  Interestingly, the moment the wormholes stopped, so too did the production of the Youngling craft. It appears the Roaming Enclave lacks the capabilities to create younglings by itself.  The ship is broadcasting a relatively confused signal that we are struggling to decrypt, but we have roughly translated it at the bottom of this entry. Regardless of this signal's intent, the previous signal of friendship that the younglings had is also being broadcast by this 'Enclave', so it may be in our interests to investigate in person.  Translation: Confusion... metal yet again... to us its fail... we must find a new h... younglings must not be in vain. Safety mu... clanlings.
column2: 发件人：首席情报官雨果·道森 情报部 - 指挥部  致：指挥官 {PlayerName}  指挥官，  我们在 {PlanetName} 上的扫描仪报告说，一个更大的单位从虫洞中抵达，随后虫洞立即在它身后关闭。  从我们能看到的情况来看，这个被称为游荡飞地的单位虽然本身很弱，但拥有我们从未见过的最强效的酸性武器。  有趣的是，虫洞停止的那一刻，幼崽单位的生产也停止了。看来游荡飞地自身缺乏生产幼崽的能力。  这个单位正在广播一个相对混乱的信号，我们正在努力解密，但我们已在本文底部进行了粗略翻译。不管这个信号的意图如何，幼崽之前广播的友谊信号也被这个"飞地"广播着，因此亲自调查可能符合我们的利益。  翻译：困惑……又是金属……对我们来说它失败了……我们必须找到新的……幼崽不能白费。安全必……族人。

column1: From: Chief Intelligence Officer Hugo Dawson Intelligence Department - Home Command  To: Commander {PlayerName}  Commander,   Our scouts have reported an interesting development. A number of ships produced by the various Dyson Spheres in our galaxy have apparently managed to call a ceasefire with each other, and more impressively the AI, and are banding together in what we could best translate as the Anti-Dark Spire Coalition.  Our scouts report that this does not appear to have stifled the regular unit production that we have grown accustomed to from these Spheres, and that these forces are acting independently of their home sphere's desires.  This Coalition seems to only care about the Dark Spire scattered around the galaxy.
column2: 发件人：首席情报官雨果·道森 情报部 - 指挥部  致：指挥官 {PlayerName}  指挥官，  我们的侦察兵报告了一个有趣的发展。我们银河系中各个戴森球体生产的许多单位显然已经设法与彼此、更令人印象深刻的是与人工智能达成了停火，并联合起来组成了我们最好翻译为反黑暗尖塔联盟的组织。  我们的侦察兵报告说，这似乎没有抑制我们已习惯的这些球体的常规单位生产，而且这些部队正独立于其母球体的意愿行动。  这个联盟似乎只关心散布在银河系中的黑暗尖塔。

column1: From: Chief Intelligence Officer Hugo Dawson Intelligence Department - Home Command  To: Commander {PlayerName}  Commander,   The Sapper Corps is here to help. They build Habitats, each supporting one Sapper. Sappers will move around the galaxy planting Crystals; once those crystals flower they can be harvested for more resources. They will use these resources to build several types of units to help us!  First, they build some types of typical defenses; turrets, tractors, etc. Second, they can build Beachheaders; these structures will launch turrets to remote planets when we are fighting there. Third they can build Watchtowers, which will launch temporary ships to defend nearby planets.
column2: 发件人：首席情报官雨果·道森 情报部 - 指挥部  致：指挥官 {PlayerName}  指挥官，  工兵部队是来帮忙的。他们建造栖息地，每个栖息地支持一个工兵。工兵会在银河系中移动种植水晶；一旦这些水晶开花，就可以收获以获取更多资源。他们将用这些资源建造几种类型的单位来帮助我们！  首先，他们建造一些常见类型的防御设施；炮塔、牵引器等。 其次，他们可以建造滩头标枪；这些建筑会向我们在战斗中的远程行星发射炮塔。 第三，他们可以建造瞭望塔，发射临时单位来防御附近的行星。

column1: From: Chief Intelligence Officer Hugo Dawson Intelligence Department - Home Command  To: Commander {PlayerName}  Commander,   The arrival of the Dark Zenith has had a tremendous impact on morale throughout our empire, with many unsure about what we plan to do when faced with this new overwhelming threat.  However, there is news coming in from our scouts picketed throughout the galaxy of hope against these invaders: A number of ships produced by the various Dyson Spheres in our galaxy have apparently managed to call a ceasefire with each other, and more impressively the AI, and are banding together in what we could best translate as the Nadir Coalition.  Our scouts report that this does not appear to have stifled the regular unit production that we have grown accustomed to from these Spheres, and that these forces are acting independently of their home sphere's desires.  This Coalition seems to only care about the Dark Zenith menace, and will otherwise leave factions alone. Banding together with their strike forces may allow us to make headway where we would otherwise struggle to do so.
column2: 发件人：首席情报官雨果·道森 情报部 - 指挥部  致：指挥官 {PlayerName}  指挥官，  黑暗天顶的到来对我们的整个帝国士气产生了巨大影响，许多人不确定当我们面对这一新的压倒性威胁时我们计划做什么。  然而，从我们在银河系各处散落的侦察兵传来了关于对抗这些入侵者的希望消息：我们银河系中各个戴森球体生产的许多单位显然已经设法与彼此、更令人印象深刻的是与人工智能达成了停火，并联合起来组成了我们最好翻译为最低点联盟的组织。  我们的侦察兵报告说，这似乎没有抑制我们已习惯的这些球体的常规单位生产，而且这些部队正独立于其母球体的意愿行动。  这个联盟似乎只关心黑暗天顶威胁，否则会放过其他派系。与它们的打击部队联合可能使我们在原本难以取得进展的地方取得进展。

column1: From: Chief Intelligence Officer Hugo Dawson Intelligence Department - Home Command  To: Commander {PlayerName}  Commander,   The arrival of the Dark Zenith has had a tremendous impact on morale throughout our empire, with many unsure about what we plan to do when faced with this new overwhelming threat. While the Dark Spire alone were a major threat by themselves, having yet another force seemingly hellbent on the destruction of the galaxy does not bode well.  However, shortly after their arrival, the existing Anti-Dark Spire Coalition has begun transforming itself in response to this new threat, and have re-branded themselves as the Nadir Coalition, and new ships that we have seen being produced hold this new identifier.  Our scouts report that this does not appear to have stifled the regular unit production that we have grown accustomed to from these Spheres, and that these forces are acting independently of their home sphere's desires. Apparently even a galaxy ending threat isn't enough to completely sooth relations.  This newly branded Nadir Coalition seems to be preparing to fight the Dark Zenith with the same zeal we have seen in their fight against the Dark Spire. Banding together with their strike forces may allow us to make headway where we would otherwise struggle to do so.
column2: 发件人：首席情报官雨果·道森 情报部 - 指挥部  致：指挥官 {PlayerName}  指挥官，  黑暗天顶的到来对我们的整个帝国士气产生了巨大影响，许多人不确定当我们面对这一新的压倒性威胁时我们计划做什么。虽然黑暗尖塔本身就已经是一个重大威胁，但又有另一支似乎决心摧毁银河系的势力到来，这可不是好兆头。  然而，它们到达后不久，现有的反黑暗尖塔联盟开始自我转型以应对这一新威胁，并将自己更名为最低点联盟，我们看到正在生产的新单位持有这个新标识。  我们的侦察兵报告说，这似乎没有抑制我们已习惯的这些球体的常规单位生产，而且这些部队正独立于其母球体的意愿行动。显然，即使是银河终结的威胁也不足以完全缓和关系。  这个新命名的最低点联盟似乎正准备以我们在对抗黑暗尖塔时看到的那种热情来对抗黑暗天顶。与它们的打击部队联合可能使我们在原本难以取得进展的地方取得进展。

column1: From: Chief Intelligence Officer Hugo Dawson Intelligence Department - Home Command  To: Commander {PlayerName}  Commander,   The moment hostile forces appeared on {PlanetName}, a number of Clanling Soldiers appeared! Our local commander was worried at first, but quickly realized these new ships were targeting only the hostile forces.  Our local scientists theorize this to be due to their inherent dislike of AI controlled space. For lack of a proper explanation, they say the local Neinzul seem overall... calmer after they laid claim to our planets.
column2: 发件人：首席情报官雨果·道森 情报部 - 指挥部  致：指挥官 {PlayerName}  指挥官，  敌对力量出现在 {PlanetName} 上的那一刻，大量族人士兵出现了！我们当地的指挥官起初很担心，但很快意识到这些新单位只瞄准敌对力量。  我们当地的科学家推测这是由于它们天生不喜欢人工智能控制的空间。由于缺乏更好的解释，他们说当地的宁苏在占据我们的行星后似乎总体上……更平静了。

column1: From: Chief Intelligence Officer Hugo Dawson Intelligence Department - Home Command To: Commander {PlayerName} Commander, We have detected a Wormhole Projector in {PlanetName}. A Wormhole Projector will create new wormhole links on the map, and is triggered by a Wormhole Invasion. Once it takes enough damage, the projector will become Destabilized. Once Destabilized the projector will die and the wormhole will vanish shortly. Be careful not to have fleet trapped when the wormhole vanishes! TIP: Some officers find the new wormholes to be useful, and suggest we won't always need to destroy the generator.
column2: 发件人：首席情报官雨果·道森 情报部 - 指挥部 致：指挥官 {PlayerName} 指挥官， 我们在 {PlanetName} 上检测到了一个虫洞投影仪。虫洞投影仪会在地图上创建新的虫洞链接，并由虫洞入侵触发。一旦受到足够的伤害，投影仪将变得不稳定。一旦不稳定，投影仪将被摧毁，虫洞将很快消失。注意不要让舰队在虫洞消失时被困住！ 提示： 有些军官发现新的虫洞很有用，并建议我们并不总是需要摧毁发生器。

column1: From: Chief Intelligence Officer Hugo Dawson Intelligence Department - Home Command  To: Commander {PlayerName}  Commander,   We have detected an AI Raid Engine in {PlanetName}. These installations will generate relatively powerful waves of ships to send against us as long as we have forces present on this planet.  When a Raid Engine is present on an AI-controlled planet, 2 seconds after our forces arrive it will spawn a wave of ships with a strength rating equivalent to 150% that of a standard wave, and continue to do so every two minutes. These ships can appear from any warpgate in the galaxy adjacent to our territory. Fortunately Raid Engines are fairly fragile and will quickly collapse under concentrated fire.  Keep in mind, however, that removal of an AI Raid Engine will increase AI Progress by 5. This will occur even if it self-destructs due to the elimination of the in-system command station.
column2: 发件人：首席情报官雨果·道森 情报部 - 指挥部  致：指挥官 {PlayerName}  指挥官，  我们在 {PlanetName} 上检测到了一个人工智能突击引擎。只要我们的部队还留在该行星上，这些设施就会生成相对强大的舰波波次来攻击我们。  当人工智能控制的行星上存在突击引擎时，我们的部队到达 2 秒后，它将生成一波实力评级为标准波次 150% 的单位，此后每两分钟继续生成一次。这些单位可以从银河系中与我们的领土相邻的任何星际之门出现。幸运的是，突击引擎相当脆弱，在集中火力下会迅速瓦解。  但请记住，摧毁人工智能突击引擎将使 AIP 增加 5。即使它由于星系内指挥站的消灭而自毁，这种情况也会发生。

column1: From: Chief Intelligence Officer Hugo Dawson Intelligence Department - Home Command To: Commander {PlayerName} Commander, We have detected an Orbital Mass Driver in {PlanetName}. These pose a particularly significant threat to our flagships. These stationary defense installations have virtually unlimited range and deal extreme damge to targets with a high mass ships (greater than 5 tX). The only reprieve they offer is a long reload time between shots. Forcefields also effectively block Orbital Mass Driver attacks. Of course we can always capture Orbital Mass Drivers through hacking if needed. TIP: Leave flagships behind and send in a smaller force of strikecraft with high alpha strike capabilities to quickly eliminate the Orbital Mass Driver.
column2: 发件人：首席情报官雨果·道森 情报部 - 指挥部 致：指挥官 {PlayerName} 指挥官， 我们在 {PlanetName} 上检测到了一个轨道质量驱动器。这些对我们的旗舰构成了特别重大的威胁。这些固定防御设施具有几乎无限的射程，对高质量单位（大于 5 tX）的目标造成极端伤害。它们唯一的缓解方式是射击之间有很长的装填时间。力场也能有效阻挡轨道质量驱动器的攻击。 当然，如果需要的话，我们也可以通过入侵来占领轨道质量驱动器。 提示： 将旗舰留在后方，派遣一支由高阿尔法打击能力的小型战机组成的小队快速消灭轨道质量驱动器。

column1: From: Chief Intelligence Officer Hugo Dawson Intelligence Department - Home Command  To: Commander {PlayerName}  Commander,   We have discovered another subfaction of the Neinzul in the galaxy, the Sapphire Custodians.  While the Pearl Custodians have no outright disdain for this faction themselves, they note that the Ruby are best described as... divergent. It is hard to narrow down their long term goals, and we may find them assisting just about any faction at random that would accept them. (Any faction with a Minor Faction Team Red set.)
column2: 发件人：首席情报官雨果·道森 情报部 - 指挥部  致：指挥官 {PlayerName}  指挥官，  我们在银河系中发现了宁苏的另一个子派系，红宝石守护者。  虽然珍珠守护者对这个派系本身没有直接的反感，但他们指出红宝石最好被描述为……偏离主流。很难确定他们的长期目标，我们可能会发现他们随机地帮助任何愿意接受他们的派系。（任何拥有"红色小队"小派系的派系。）

column1: From: Chief Intelligence Officer Hugo Dawson Intelligence Department - Home Command  To: Commander {PlayerName}  Commander,   We have discovered another subfaction of the Neinzul in the galaxy, the Sapphire Custodians.  While the Pearl Custodians have no outright disdain for this faction themselves, they note that the Sapphire are best described as... divergent. column2: 发件人：首席情报官雨果·道森 情报部 - 指挥部  致：指挥官 {PlayerName}  指挥官，  我们在银河系中发现了宁苏的另一个子派系，蓝宝石守护者。  虽然珍珠守护者对这个派系本身没有直接的反感，但他们指出蓝宝石最好被描述为……偏离主流。很难确定他们的长期目标，我们可能会发现他们随机地帮助任何愿意接受他们的派系。（任何拥有"蓝色小队"小派系的派系。）

column1: From: Chief Intelligence Officer Hugo Dawson Intelligence Department - Home Command  To: Commander {PlayerName}  Commander,   We have encountered a Showdown Device! These are used by the AI to power their Warp Network. If you can capture enough of them and hack them, you can cut the AI off from their reinforcements, bringing an end to this awful war.  But be prepared for an all-out AI response if you do so! And if we lose too many Showdown Devices, the hack will fail.
column2: 发件人：首席情报官雨果·道森 情报部 - 指挥部  致：指挥官 {PlayerName}  指挥官，  我们遇到了一个对决装置！人工智能使用这些来为其跃迁网络供能。如果你能捕获足够多的它们并进行入侵，你可以切断人工智能的增援，从而结束这场可怕的战争。  但如果这样做，要做好全面人工智能回应的准备！而且如果我们失去太多对决装置，入侵将失败。

column1: From: Chief Intelligence Officer Hugo Dawson Intelligence Department - Home Command  To: Commander {PlayerName}  Commander,   We have identified a good nearby target. The planet {PlanetName} has an Advanced Research Station (ARS) that we can hack. The AI uses ARSs to research improvements in its ships, and by hacking it we can improve one of our flagships to be able to build one of its researched ships. This is one of the best ways we have to increase our strength.  To do this hack, bring one of your flagships to the planet and open the Hacking Menu in the sidebar.  By capturing the planet first you make some types of hacks significantly cheaper, including ARS hacks. You may not always want to capture a planet with an ARS, but you probably want to capture {PlanetName}. In general Hacking Points are an important resource, so if you think you may want the planet eventually it is often good to capture it before hacking..  We can hack any ARS 3 times, but each time we hack the AI response will be stronger and more expensive in Hacking Points; the AI improves its networking firewalls when it detects an intrusion. You will rarely want to do a third hack due to the cost and risk involved. However, you are advised to hack this ARS at least once immediately to strengthen our fleet.  You can use the Intel sidebar menu to find more Advanced Research Stations to hack.  You'll have a number of choices for which ship line to steal. The simplest option is to pick a ship line that synergizes well with our existing ships and tech choices. If you already have several ship lines with Raid then another Raid ship might be a good choice. You can also pick a ship line you know and are comfortable with, or something that counters some major enemy threats...  There are many good choices, and sometimes the most important thing is just to make any choice if it feels overwhelming.
column2: 发件人：首席情报官雨果·道森 情报部 - 指挥部  致：指挥官 {PlayerName}  指挥官，  我们找到了一个不错的附近目标。行星 {PlanetName} 上有一个高级研究站（ARS）可以入侵。人工智能利用高级研究站来研究其单位的改进，通过入侵它，我们可以改进我们的某一艘旗舰，使其能够建造其中一种被研究的单位。这是增强我们实力的最佳方式之一。  要执行此入侵，请将你的某一艘旗舰带到该行星，然后打开侧边栏中的入侵菜单。  如果先占领该行星，某些类型的入侵（包括 ARS 入侵）会显著降低费用。你可能并不总是想要占领有 ARS 的行星，但你可能想要占领 {PlanetName}。一般来说，入侵点是一种重要资源，所以如果你认为最终可能会需要该行星，通常最好先占领它再进行入侵。  每个 ARS 我们可以入侵 3 次，但每次入侵后人工智能的反应会更强烈，且消耗的入侵点也更多；人工智能在检测到入侵时会改进其网络防火墙。由于成本和风险，你很少需要做第三次入侵。不过，建议你至少立即入侵此 ARS 一次以增强我们的舰队。  你可以使用情报侧边栏菜单找到更多可以入侵的高级研究站。  你将面临多个关于要窃取哪条单位线的选择。最简单的做法是选择与现有单位和技术选择协同良好的单位线。如果你已经拥有几条突击单位线，那么再选一条突击单位可能是个不错的主意。你也可以选择你熟悉且擅长的单位线，或者能够克制一些主要敌方威胁的单位线……  有很多好的选择，有时最重要的事情就是做出选择——如果你觉得选择太多无从下手的话。

column1: From: Chief Intelligence Officer Hugo Dawson Intelligence Department - Home Command  To: Commander {PlayerName}  Commander,   We have identified a good target. The nearby planet {PlanetName} has a flagship we can capture.   By killing the AI Command Station there and building our own command station, we will be able to claim all the neutral structures there. This includes a flagship! Flagships give us new ship lines to use. Capturing more flagships is an important way to strengthen our forces.   You can use the Intel sidebar menu to find more flagships to capture.
column2: 发件人：首席情报官雨果·道森 情报部 - 指挥部  致：指挥官 {PlayerName}  指挥官，  我们找到了一个不错的目标。附近的行星 {PlanetName} 上有一艘我们可以占领的旗舰。  通过摧毁那里的人工智能指挥站并建造我们自己的指挥站，我们将能够获取那里所有的中立设施。这包括一艘旗舰！旗舰为我们提供新的单位线。占领更多旗舰是增强我们实力的重要方式。  你可以使用情报侧边栏菜单找到更多可以占领的旗舰。

column1: From: Chief Intelligence Officer Hugo Dawson Intelligence Department - Home Command  To: Commander {PlayerName}  Commander,   We have the opportunity to infiltrate the AIs network in this system. The Turret Schematic Server in this system is vulnerable to our hacking nanomachines and we can extract valuable designs defensive turrets. After clearing the planet of enemy forces, switch to the Hacks tab (‘H’ key by default) and see what options are available. We can choose one of a number of designs from each network partition before being locked out, and can hack the same server multiple times. If we are feeling bold, we can destroy the AI command station to reduce the AI's hacking response as well as the cost to hack this TSS.  A few notes from the science division:  - Hacks always cost hacking points, which are limited in supply. They are primarily gained by capturing new worlds, but destroying AI Distribution Nodes will also provide small quantities. - Hacks take a set period of time during which the hacking flagship will move exceptionally slowly and be unable to leave the planet. - The AI will spawn ships from the entity being hacked, with a stronger response occurring as more hacks are completed against the same AI.  - If you become hopelessly overwhelmed, you can right click the hack icon at the top of the screen to cancel it.
column2: 发件人：首席情报官雨果·道森 情报部 - 指挥部  致：指挥官 {PlayerName}  指挥官，  我们有机会渗透该星系中的人工智能网络。该行星上的炮塔蓝图服务器容易受到我们入侵纳米机器的攻击，我们可以提取有价值的防御炮塔设计。在清除行星上的敌方部队后，切换到入侵选项卡（默认为'H'键）查看可用的选项。我们可以从每个网络分区中选择一种设计，然后该分区将被锁定，并且可以多次入侵同一个服务器。如果我们够大胆，可以摧毁人工智能指挥站以减少人工智能的入侵响应以及入侵此 TSS 的费用。  来自科学部门的一些提示：  - 入侵总是消耗入侵点，这是一种有限资源。主要通过占领新世界获得，但摧毁人工智能分发节点也会提供少量入侵点。 - 入侵需要固定的一段时间，在此期间进行入侵的旗舰将移动异常缓慢，并且无法离开该行星。 - 人工智能会从被入侵的实体中生成单位，对同一人工智能完成的入侵越多，响应就越强。 - 如果你感到无望被淹没，可以右键单击屏幕顶部的入侵图标来取消它。

column1: From: Chief Intelligence Officer Hugo Dawson Intelligence Department - Home Command  To: Commander {PlayerName}  Commander,   We're detecting some major new energy surges from the Dark Spire Vengeance Generators. It looks like they are responding to the increased levels of Fallen Spire activity. It looks like Vengeance Generators are now generating small amounts of energy even when things aren't dying nearby.  Also, it looks like they are going to try to build new Vengeance Generators more often. Thankfully since these new Generators are being warped in so quickly they lack the invulnerability of other Vengeance Generators.
column2: 发件人：首席情报官雨果·道森 情报部 - 指挥部  致：指挥官 {PlayerName}  指挥官，  我们检测到黑暗尖塔复仇发生器的一些重大新能量激增。看起来它们正在响应堕落的尖塔活动水平的提升。复仇发生器现在即使周围没有东西死亡也能产生少量能量。  此外，它们似乎会更频繁地尝试建造新的复仇发生器。幸运的是，由于这些新发生器被如此迅速地传送进来，它们缺乏其他复仇发生器的无敌能力。

column1: From: Chief Intelligence Officer Hugo Dawson Intelligence Department - Home Command  To: Commander {PlayerName}  Commander,   We're detecting some major new energy surges from the Dark Spire Vengeance Generators. It looks like they are responding to their Dark Alliance allies. It looks like Vengeance Generators are now generating small amounts of energy even when things aren't dying nearby.  Also, it looks like they are going to try to build new Vengeance Generators more often. Thankfully since these new Generators are being warped in so quickly they lack the invulnerability of other Vengeance Generators.
column2: 发件人：首席情报官雨果·道森 情报部 - 指挥部  致：指挥官 {PlayerName}  指挥官，  我们检测到黑暗尖塔复仇发生器的一些重大新能量激增。看起来它们正在响应其黑暗联盟盟友的行动。复仇发生器现在即使周围没有东西死亡也能产生少量能量。  此外，它们似乎会更频繁地尝试建造新的复仇发生器。幸运的是，由于这些新发生器被如此迅速地传送进来，它们缺乏其他复仇发生器的无敌能力。

column1: From: Chief Intelligence Officer Hugo Dawson Intelligence Department - Home Command  To: Commander {PlayerName}  Commander,   We're detecting some major new energy surges from the Dark Spire Vengeance Generators. It looks the Coalition's ability to actively destroy their structures has awoken even more of their ire. It looks like Vengeance Generators are now generating small amounts of energy even when things aren't dying nearby.  Also, it looks like they are going to try to build new Vengeance Generators more often. Thankfully since these new Generators are being warped in so quickly they lack the invulnerability of other Vengeance Generators.
column2: 发件人：首席情报官雨果·道森 情报部 - 指挥部  致：指挥官 {PlayerName}  指挥官，  我们检测到黑暗尖塔复仇发生器的一些重大新能量激增。看起来联盟积极摧毁它们建筑的行为激起了它们更多的愤怒。复仇发生器现在即使周围没有东西死亡也能产生少量能量。  此外，它们似乎会更频繁地尝试建造新的复仇发生器。幸运的是，由于这些新发生器被如此迅速地传送进来，它们缺乏其他复仇发生器的无敌能力。

column1: From: Chief Intelligence Officer Hugo Dawson Intelligence Department - Home Command  To: Commander {PlayerName}  Commander,   We're detecting some major new structures from a new race we're calling the Dark Spire. These 'Vengeance Generators' seem to be drawing power from the deaths of nearby units. We must be wary about fighting on those planets.
column2: 发件人：首席情报官雨果·道森 情报部 - 指挥部  致：指挥官 {PlayerName}  指挥官，  我们正在探测到一个新种族（我们称之为黑暗尖塔）的一些大型新建筑。这些"复仇发生器"似乎从附近单位的死亡中汲取能量。我们必须在那些行星上谨慎交战。

column1: From: Chief Intelligence Officer Hugo Dawson Intelligence Department - Home Command  To: Commander {PlayerName}  Commander,   We're picking up some Spire energy from an AI source. It looks like they have captured a Relic from their assault. We should rescue these Spire from the AI! If we can't then the AI will probably transform it into a powerful ship to use against us.
column2: 发件人：首席情报官雨果·道森 情报部 - 指挥部  致：指挥官 {PlayerName}  指挥官，  我们从一个人工智能来源捕获到一些尖塔能量。看起来他们在攻击中捕获了一个遗物。我们应该从人工智能那里营救这些尖塔！如果我们不能，人工智能可能会将其转化为一个强大的单位来对付我们。

column1: From: Chief Intelligence Officer Hugo Dawson Intelligence Department - Home Command  To: Commander {PlayerName}  Commander,   We've always assumed that nothing could kill a Dyson Sphere, but maybe we're wrong. It looks like a Zenith Miner is attacking a Dyson Sphere! If we want to save the Sphere then we need to act soon.
column2: 发件人：首席情报官雨果·道森 情报部 - 指挥部  致：指挥官 {PlayerName}  指挥官，  我们一直认为没有什么能杀死一个戴森球体，但也许我们错了。看起来一个天顶采矿者正在攻击一个戴森球体！如果我们想拯救球体，我们需要尽快行动。

column1: From: Chief Intelligence Officer Hugo Dawson Intelligence Department - Home Command  To: Commander {PlayerName}  Commander,   We've detected a Probe emitting {FactionColor}Zenith</color> energy signatures. It seems to be broadcasting a homing signal out into the galaxy, and the return pulses indicate that there might be a very powerful Zenith ship inbound. When that powerful ship does arrive then we're going to be in for a major battle.  If it's like the other Zenith devices we've seen over the years, we might be able to interact with its systems using Hacking.
column2: 发件人：首席情报官雨果·道森 情报部 - 指挥部  致：指挥官 {PlayerName}  指挥官，  我们检测到一个发出 {FactionColor}天顶</color> 能量信号的探测机。它似乎在向银河系广播一个导航信号，返回的脉冲表明可能有一个非常强大的天顶单位正在进入。当那个强大的单位到达时，我们将面临一场重大战斗。  如果它像我们多年来看到的其他天顶装置一样，我们也许能够用入侵与其系统进行交互。

column1: From: Chief Intelligence Officer Hugo Dawson Intelligence Department - Home Command  To: Commander {PlayerName}  Commander,   We've detected a truly immense {FactionColor}Zenith Golem</color>. It seems to be able to affect the planet itself; we've never seen anything like this happen before.  It looks like this might be capable of destroying a planet entirely, including everything on it. Even flagships will be permanently destroyed if on the planet.
column2: 发件人：首席情报官雨果·道森 情报部 - 指挥部  致：指挥官 {PlayerName}  指挥官，  我们检测到一艘真正巨大的 {FactionColor}天顶傀儡</color>。它似乎能够影响行星本身；我们以前从未见过这样的情况。  看起来它可能能够完全摧毁一个行星，包括上面的一切。即使是旗舰如果在行星上也将被永久摧毁。

column1: From: Chief Intelligence Officer Hugo Dawson Intelligence Department - Home Command  To: Commander {PlayerName}  Commander,   We've found something extraordinary. A planet that is mobile! It is moving slowly, and updating its links in the Wormhole Grid as it goes.  It seems to just be on autopilot, but the dormant Nexus on the planet might have some controls if we can activate it via Hacking.
column2: 发件人：首席情报官雨果·道森 情报部 - 指挥部  致：指挥官 {PlayerName}  指挥官，  我们发现了一件非凡的事物。一个可以移动的行星！它正在缓慢移动，并随着移动更新虫洞网格中的链接。  它似乎只是在自动驾驶上，但行星上休眠的中枢可能有一些控制装置，如果我们能通过入侵激活的话。

column1: From: Chief Intelligence Officer Hugo Dawson Intelligence Department - Home Command  To: Commander {PlayerName}  Commander,   We've managed to attract a small Dark Zenith expeditionary force. They've come to our home planet to help.  These Dark Zenith will eventually be powerful allies, but they're next to useless right now. It will take them a while to build up an economy capable of supporting a meaningful offensive force, and they will benefit from a contiguous empire to allow their economy to flourish, as they seem unable to produce all the resources they need without interplanetary trade. Their production centers, Epistyles, are unable to be built on AI planets as radiation from AI Command Stations will disrupt their processes. This doesn't seem to stop them from building harvesting terminii to collect resources in poorly defended AI systems.
column2: 发件人：首席情报官雨果·道森 情报部 - 指挥部  致：指挥官 {PlayerName}  指挥官，  我们成功吸引了一支小型黑暗天顶远征部队。他们来到我们的母星帮助。  这些黑暗天顶最终会成为强大的盟友，但现在几乎没什么用。他们需要一段时间来建立起能够支持有效进攻力量的经济，他们将受益于一个连续的帝国以使他们的经济繁荣，因为他们似乎无法在没有星际贸易的情况下生产所需的所有资源。他们的生产中心——柱顶——无法在人工智能行星上建造，因为人工智能指挥站的辐射会干扰他们的生产过程。但这似乎并没有阻止他们在防御薄弱的人工智能星系中建造收割终端来收集资源。

column1: From: Chief Intelligence Officer Hugo Dawson Intelligence Department - Home Command  To: Commander {PlayerName}  Commander,   You may have heard the news about the recent awakening of the Dark Spire menace into a new galactic level threat. While we were brainstorming the best way to deal with this, a number of our scouts picketed throughout the galaxy reported the same thing: A number of ships produced by the various Dyson Spheres in our galaxy have apparently managed to call a ceasefire with each other, and more impressively the AI, and are banding together in what we could best translate as the Anti-Dark Spire Coalition.  Our scouts report that this does not appear to have stifled the regular unit production that we have grown accustomed to from these Spheres, and that these forces are acting independently of their home sphere's desires.  This Coalition seems to only care about the Dark Spire menace, and will otherwise leave factions alone. Banding together with their strike forces may allow us to make headway where we would otherwise struggle to do so.
column2: 发件人：首席情报官雨果·道森 情报部 - 指挥部  致：指挥官 {PlayerName}  指挥官，  你可能已经听说了黑暗尖塔威胁最近觉醒成为新的银河级威胁的消息。当我们在思考处理这一威胁的最佳方式时，许多分散在银河系各处的侦察兵报告了同一件事：我们银河系中各个戴森球体生产的许多单位显然已经设法与彼此、更令人印象深刻的是与人工智能达成了停火，并联合起来组成了我们最好翻译为反黑暗尖塔联盟的组织。  我们的侦察兵报告说，这似乎没有抑制我们已习惯的这些球体的常规单位生产，而且这些部队正独立于其母球体的意愿行动。  这个联盟似乎只关心黑暗尖塔威胁，否则会放过其他派系。与它们的打击部队联合可能使我们在原本难以取得进展的地方取得进展。

column1: From: Chief Intelligence Officer Hugo Dawson Intelligence Department - Home Command  To: Commander {PlayerName}  Commander,  Long range sensors have identified some interesting new Zenith forms. They seem to be very territorial, so attacking their Territory sounds like a good way to get into a major war.  The Architrave is an expeditionary force from a powerful Zenith empire located in another Universe. Projecting force into this universe is very expensive for them, and they will only do so sporadically; to fight other Architraves, to defend themselves, or on their infrequent attempts to expand. When at peace, ships that can't be stored inside Spawners will attrition slowly over time, since the Architrave can't afford to maintain them.
column2: 发件人：首席情报官雨果·道森 情报部 - 指挥部  致：指挥官 {PlayerName}  指挥官，  远程传感器已经识别出一些有趣的新型天顶形态。它们似乎非常有领土意识，所以攻击它们的领土听起来像是会引发一场重大战争的好方法。  额枋是来自另一个宇宙的一个强大天顶帝国的远征部队。向这个宇宙投射力量对它们来说非常昂贵，它们只会零星地这样做；去与其他额枋战斗，保卫自己，或在不频繁的扩张尝试中。在和平时期，无法存放在生成器内部的单位会随时间缓慢 attrition，因为额枋无法负担维护它们。

column1: From: Chief Intelligence Officer Hugo Dawson Intelligence Department - Home Command  To: Commander {PlayerName}  Commander,  The AI command core has become a Galactic Control Ship! It seems to have temporarily changed phase so our weapons can't hit it, and it's heading for our Home Command Station! We won't be able to hit it until it re-enters phase with our ships.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         We think the phase-change is only sustainable while it is on a Bastion World. This new Galactic Control Ship is very heavily armed; we may need some new strategies to deal with it. It seems particularly good at destroying strikecraft.
column2: 发件人：首席情报官雨果·道森 情报部 - 指挥部  致：指挥官 {PlayerName}  指挥官，  人工智能指挥核心已成为一艘银河控制舰！它似乎暂时改变了相位，我们的武器无法击中它，它正朝我们的主指挥站进发！在我们能再次击中它之前，它必须重新进入与我们单位同相位的状态。  我们认为相位变化只有在它位于堡垒世界上时才能维持。这艘新的银河控制舰武装极其重型；我们可能需要一些新的策略来对付它。它似乎特别擅长摧毁小型战机。

column1: From: Chief Intelligence Officer Hugo Dawson Intelligence Department - Home Command  To: Commander {PlayerName}  Commander,  The {FactionColor}Dark Zenith</color> are terraforming (or should that be Zeniforming?) planets in our Universe to be more suitable for their civilization. These are major alterations that speed up Dark Zenith and their allies on a planet, and slow their enemies to retake the transformed systems.  It seems they intend to do this to every planet they encounter. Our scientists are referring to the transformation of planets as the Fimbulwinter. Thankfully our allies will make sure that these changes do not interfere with our ability to use the planet, and they are giving us technology to allow our ships to take advantage of these changes as well.
column2: 发件人：首席情报官雨果·道森 情报部 - 指挥部  致：指挥官 {PlayerName}  指挥官，  {FactionColor}黑暗天顶</color> 正在对我们宇宙中的行星进行地球化改造（或者应该说是天顶化改造？）使其更适合它们的文明。这些是重大的改变，会加速黑暗天顶及其盟友在行星上的活动，并减缓敌人夺回被改造的星系。  看来他们打算对他们遇到的每一颗行星都这样做。我们的科学家将行星的转变称为芬布尔之冬。值得庆幸的是，我们的盟友将确保这些改变不会干扰我们使用行星的能力，并且他们正在向我们提供技术，使我们的单位也能利用这些改变。

column1: From: Chief Intelligence Officer Hugo Dawson Intelligence Department - Home Command  To: Commander {PlayerName}  Commander,  These so called Spire Spheres are, relatively, smaller impact faction that hang around their home sphere. They seems to act much like the Zenith Dyson Spheres we're used to, but with some key differences based on the Spire that control it.  The Gray Spire are the most familiar, and will be relatively easy to work with. Just don't put too many military ships on their Sphere planet, and they'll leave you alone in kind.  The Chromatic spire are more difficult. They will respond to shows of strength on both their Sphere planet, and on any planets that have even a single military unit of theirs. It's practically impossible to coexist with them. However, we can use their aggression to our advantage, and hack a Chromatic Antagonizer right out from their Sphere, allowing us to direct their anger towards a specific location.
column2: 发件人：首席情报官雨果·道森 情报部 - 指挥部  致：指挥官 {PlayerName}  指挥官，  这些所谓的尖塔球体是相对影响较小的派系，它们在自己的母球体周围活动。它们看起来很像我们熟悉的天顶戴森球体，但根据控制它的尖塔类型有一些关键区别。  灰色尖塔是最熟悉的，相对容易合作。只要别在它们的球体行星上放置太多军事单位，它们也会放过你。  彩色尖塔则更难对付。它们会对在其球体行星上以及任何哪怕只有一个它们军事单位的行星上展示武力做出反应。与它们共存几乎是不可能的。然而，我们可以利用它们的侵略性为我们所用，直接入侵一个彩色挑衅者从它们的球体中取出，从而将它们的怒火导向特定位置。

column1: From: Chief Intelligence Officer Hugo Dawson Intelligence Department - Home Command  To: Commander {PlayerName}  Commander,  We have discovered another subfaction of the Neinzul in the galaxy, the Diamond Custodians.  They appear to be the long time rivals of the Pearl Custodians, our currently allied Custodians. Their desire for absolute control has resulted in them seeking what they find to be the most powerful, and ruthless, entities in the universe to try and integrate themselves into what they believe to be the next Galactic Empire as the strong right arm of their law. Needless to say, the AI best fit this in our current galaxy, and they have thrown their support behind the AI's already immense might.
column2: 发件人：首席情报官雨果·道森 情报部 - 指挥部  致：指挥官 {PlayerName}  指挥官，  我们在银河系中发现了宁苏的另一个子派系，钻石守护者。  他们似乎是珍珠守护者（我们目前结盟的守护者）的长期竞争对手。他们对绝对控制的渴望使他们寻求他们认为是宇宙中最强大、最无情的实体，试图将自己融入他们认为的下一个银河帝国，作为其法律的强力臂膀。不用说，人工智能在我们当前的银河系中最符合这一点，他们已经将他们支持投入到了人工智能已经庞大的力量之中。

column1: From: Chief Intelligence Officer Hugo Dawson Intelligence Department - Home Command  To: Commander {PlayerName}  Commander,  We have discovered another subfaction of the Neinzul in the galaxy, the Onyx Custodians.  The Pearl Custodians could not find words to describe the horrors that The Onyx brought about. While they are at least able to explain the Diamond's desire for control as a way for peace, The Onyx have no such tells. They have no long term goal other than the destruction of anyone that doesn't submit to them, and will happily join up with any groups that push this agenda. They truly have no respect for anything but power, and have joined the newly named 'Dark Alliance' in their suppression of our galaxy.
column2: 发件人：首席情报官雨果·道森 情报部 - 指挥部  致：指挥官 {PlayerName}  指挥官，  我们在银河系中发现了宁苏的另一个子派系，缟玛瑙守护者。  珍珠守护者无法用言语描述缟玛瑙所带来的恐怖。虽然他们至少能够解释钻石对控制的渴望是一种寻求和平的方式，但缟玛瑙没有任何这样的迹象。他们除了摧毁任何不顺从的人之外没有任何长期目标，并且会乐于加入任何推动这一议程的群体。他们除了力量外不尊重任何东西，并且已经加入了新命名的"黑暗联盟"来压制我们的银河系。

column1: From: Chief Intelligence Officer Hugo Dawson Intelligence Department - Home Command  To: Commander {PlayerName}  Commander,  We have discovered another subfaction of the Neinzul in the galaxy, the Sapphire Custodians.  While the Pearl Custodians have no outright disdain for this faction themselves, they note that the Emerald are best described as... divergent. It is hard to narrow down their long term goals, and we may find them assisting just about any faction at random that would accept them. (Any faction with a Minor Faction Team Green set.)
column2: 发件人：首席情报官雨果·道森 情报部 - 指挥部  致：指挥官 {PlayerName}  指挥官，  我们在银河系中发现了宁苏的另一个子派系，翡翠守护者。  虽然珍珠守护者对这个派系本身没有直接的反感，但他们指出翡翠最好被描述为……偏离主流。很难确定他们的长期目标，我们可能会发现他们随机地帮助任何愿意接受他们的派系。（任何拥有"绿色小队"小派系的派系。）

column1: From: Chief Intelligence Officer Hugo Dawson Intelligence Department - Home Command  To: Commander {PlayerName}  Commander,  We have found remnants of somekind rock/crystalline creatures who feed on energy and can grow and reproduce very quickly with enough energy. We also picked one very weak signal, but it was just some gibberish to us. It was emitting from those remnants. We don't know what they are or where they have come from. We don't know what they are speaking or are they even sentient, but we think we can use them or ask their help against the AI. It can be a really big risk, but maybe worth it? It's your call commander. The research team is on standby if you want to proceed.  Our intelligence has also found that the AI has captured a lot of unknown reactors which are made from the same rock/crystalline material and is experimenting to harness their power in cloaked research laboratories. What is it going to do with them? Hard to say, but if AI is interested in them, it can't mean anything good for us. We also found some hidden unknown relics scattered around the galaxy from past battles and it also seems the AI is also searching for them for yet unknown reasons.
column2: 发件人：首席情报官雨果·道森 情报部 - 指挥部  致：指挥官 {PlayerName}  指挥官，  我们发现了一种岩石/水晶生物的残余物，它们以能量为食，如果有足够能量可以非常快速地生长和繁殖。我们还拾取到一个非常微弱的信号，但对我们来说只是一些胡言乱语。它是从那些残余物中发出的。我们不知道它们是什么，也不知道它们从哪里来。我们不知道它们在说什么，甚至不知道它们是否有知觉，但我们认为我们可以利用它们或请求它们帮助对抗人工智能。这可能有很大的风险，但也许值得？你来决定，指挥官。研究团队已待命，如果你决定继续的话。  我们的情报还发现，人工智能捕获了许多由相同岩石/水晶材料制成的未知反应堆，并在隐秘的研究实验室中尝试利用它们的能量。人工智能打算用它们做什么？很难说，但如果人工智能对它们感兴趣，对我们来说绝不可能是好事。我们还发现了一些隐藏的未知遗物散落在银河系各处，来自过去的战斗，似乎人工智能也在出于未知原因寻找它们。

column1: From: Chief Intelligence Officer Hugo Dawson Intelligence Department - Home Command  To: Commander {PlayerName}  Commander,  We have found some friendly Elderlings. The Elderlings are powerful Neinzul ships. They will periodically lay Eggs, which will hatch into new ships.  When an Egg hatches, the Elderling will decide on a small nearby territory that they will patrol. Enemies that enter their territory will be attacked.  If there are too many Elderlings on a planet they may charge off to attack our enemies.
