column1: From: Chief Intelligence Officer Hugo Dawson Intelligence Department - Home Command  To: Commander {PlayerName}  Commander,  We've uncovered a wealth of information about the Spire from the wreckage of this AI base.  Sometime in the last few hundred years, the AI detected the Spire, who had already colonized several nearby galaxies. After much preparation, the AI launched a devastating surprise attack against the Spire homeworld. The Spire attempted to use their TransWarp technology to warp their full Imperial Fleet home to defend the center of their civilization. However, while the jump was happening the AI sabotaged the Transceiver on the homeworld. Instead of arriving in a blaze of vengeance, the Spire Fleet was trapped in inter-dimensional space. The Spire’s local defenses were no match for the AI.  In desperation, the Spire launched a number of Relics in an attempt to escape and find new places to rebuild their empire. One of those who escaped was Exaron the Seventh, Sovereign of the Imperial Spire, much to the consternation of the AI. The AI is also very worried that Exaron may now be allied to us.  If we can make the Spire Cities strong enough, we might be able to construct a new transwarp Transceiver that would allow the main Imperial Fleet to escape the interdimensional rift they've been trapped in. This would allow us to end the AI once and for all. If the AI picks up transwarp energy signatures, we should expect a truly massive AI assault.
column2: 发件人：首席情报官雨果·道森 情报部 - 指挥部  致：指挥官 {PlayerName}  指挥官，  我们从这个人造基地的残骸中发现了一大量关于尖塔的信息。  在过去几百年中的某个时候，人工智能发现了尖塔，他们已经殖民了几个附近的星系。经过大量准备，人工智能对尖塔母星发动了毁灭性的突袭。尖塔试图使用他们的超跃迁技术将他们的完整帝国舰队跃迁回家以保卫他们的文明中心。然而，在跃迁进行时，人工智能破坏了母星上的收发器。尖塔舰队没有在复仇的烈焰中抵达，而是被困在了跨维空间。尖塔的本地防御不是人工智能的对手。  在绝望中，尖塔发射了一些遗物试图逃脱并找到新的地方重建帝国。逃脱者之一就是帝国尖塔的统治者埃克萨隆七世，这让人工智能非常烦恼。人工智能也非常担心埃克萨隆现在可能已经与我们结盟。  如果我们能让尖塔城市足够强大，我们也许能够建造一个新的超跃迁收发器，使主力帝国舰队能够逃离被困的跨维裂缝。这将使我们能够一劳永逸地终结人工智能。如果人工智能检测到超跃迁能量信号，我们应该预计会有一场真正大规模的人工智能攻击。

column1: From: Commander Trainer Officer Alan Bullwark Commander Training Department - Home Command  To: Commander {PlayerName}  Commander,  It's probably good to review the command instructions and operating principles before entering active service. Stasis shouldn't impair your memory, but 'repetition is the mother of studies', as they say and after all the whole future of humanity is at stake. So here is a direct quote from the manual:  Challenger mode is intended for commanders who are looking for a more strategic experience than Humanity Ascendant, but don't want the full Expert package and all the guardrails it entails. If you have any questions about the various modes, please visit the Arcen Games discord where there is a dedicated expert_challenger_deathwish channel and feel free to ping Strategic Sage with your inquiries. As always, the Mantis website awaits your feedback and/or bug reports as well. Both are readily accessible from the main menu.  In a Challenger a handful of settings are always turned on as compared to Humanity Ascendant.  Distributed Economy. The asteroids on a planet, not the command stations you build, contribute most of the metal and energy. This lends additional strategic variety and weight decisions about what planets to capture, and what types of command stations to build there.   Enforced Balance. Engineering tech costs are increased, as well as those for direct upgrades of battlestations and command stations. Turret costs are increased and ranges decreased on non-human planets. Brutal Guardians are on, and some other lobby options that are available to be changed on HA are now locked in place.  Limited 'Cheese'. A couple of starting fleet options are removed, as skilled use of them confers a fairly extreme advantage.  Increased AI Response. There is a modest multiplier to the resources the AI has for items like hacking exostrike response, Dire CPAs (if turned on), etc.  AI Reserves grace period is turned off, and so on.  Reduced Resources. At the start of the game you have lowered available Hacking Points and Knowledge. Additional planets acquired will give a slightly reduced amount of Hacking Points as well.
column2: 发件人：指挥官训练官艾伦·布尔沃克 指挥官训练部 - 指挥部  致：指挥官 {PlayerName}  指挥官，  在进入现役之前，最好回顾一下指挥指令和操作原则。低温休眠不应损害你的记忆，但俗话说"重复乃学习之母"，毕竟人类的整个未来都危在旦夕。以下直接引用手册内容：  挑战者模式旨在为那些寻求比人类崛起更具战略体验、但又不需要完整专家包及其所有限制的指挥官设计。如果你对各种模式有任何疑问，请访问 Arcen Games Discord，那里有专门的 expert_challenger_deathwish 频道，并随时可以联系 Strategic Sage 提问。一如既往，Mantis 网站也期待你的反馈和/或错误报告。两者均可从主菜单轻松访问。  与人类崛起相比，挑战者模式始终开启以下设置：  分布式经济。行星上的小行星（而非你建造的指挥站）贡献大部分金属和能量。这增加了额外的战略多样性，并使关于占领哪些行星以及在那里建造何种类型指挥站的决定更具分量。  强制平衡。工程科技成本增加，战斗空间站和指挥站直接升级的成本也增加。炮塔成本增加，非人类行星上的射程减少。残酷守卫开启，一些在 HA 上可更改的大厅选项现在被锁定。  有限"取巧"。取消了几个起始舰队选项，因为对它们的熟练使用会带来相当极端的优势。  增强的人工智能响应。人工智能在入侵外来打击响应、恐怖 CPA（如果开启）等项目上的资源有适度倍数。人工智能储备的宽限期关闭，等等。  资源减少。游戏开始时你可用的入侵点和知识较少。额外获取的行星也将提供略少的入侵点。

column1: From: Commander Trainer Officer Alan Bullwark Commander Training Department - Home Command  To: Commander {PlayerName}  Commander,  It's probably good to review the command instructions and operating principles before entering active service. Stasis shouldn't impair your memory, but 'repetition is the mother of studies', as they say and after all the whole future of humanity is at stake. So here is a direct quote from the manual:  Congratulations! You've made the considerably wise choice to try out AI War 2 Logistician Mode. The goal of Logistician is to present experienced AI War 2 commanders with a more challenging and interesting strategic experience. Note that it is highly recommended to play on fairly 'open' maps, i.e. those without a large amount of chokepoints. The more 'closed' arrangements will render some of Logistician's features ineffective, but are left up to your discretion as a commander.  If at any time you find Logistician too overwhelming, you may wish to consider Expert Mode, which removes Fuel as a requirement. Or you might go for Challenger Mode, which allows you to turn off most Logistician/Expert features you don't particularly enjoy. On the other hand, if you want to turn the dial up further, Deathwish has some additional challenges available. If you have questions about these modes, please visit the Arcen Games discord where there is a dedicated expert_challenger_deathwish channel and feel free to ping Strategic Sage with your inquiries. As always, the Mantis website awaits your feedback and/or bug reports. Both are readily accessible from the main menu.  Playing on Logistician enforces a number of features, the most significant ones are described below. Other Tips are available for a more detailed explanation for these where appropriate.  Fuel Stations. Along with energy, your military now requires Fuel to function.  Selective Asset Acquisition. ARS, TSS, and ODSS will offer a lower number of choices each; the pool they select those choices from remains unaffected.  Multiple AIs. At least two AIs are mandatory for any Expert-or-higher game.  Limited Battlestations. A variety of changes to limit and balance excessive use of battlestations and beachheading.  Take It Or Leave It. When capturing a planet, you must take all of the capturables available. You can delay claiming Officers if you wish, but you will be charged the AIP price immediately. All other capturables such as Major Data Centers, Zenith Power Generators, etc. are automatically claimed.  Distributed Economy. The asteroids on a planet, not the command stations you build, contribute most of the metal and energy. This lends additional strategic variety and weight decisions about what planets to capture, and what types of command stations to build there.   Dire Cross-Planet Attacks. CPA Bunkers will periodically spawn, housing additional ships for deployment during CPAs.  Dialed-Up AI Defenses. 'NastyPicks', AI structures such as Mass Drivers, Eyes, etc. will be more dangerous and difficult to handle.  FRS Rebalancing. The special Fleet Research Station ships no longer provide bonuses to other ship lines, Officers, etc. in their fleets. This bonus is impossible to balance sensibly with the other options available to the commander.  Crippling Bail-Out. When crippled, fleet centerpieces will 'bail-out' to a friendly system automatically.  Increased AI Response. There is a modest multiplier to the resources the AI has for items like hacking exostrike response, Dire CPAs (if turned on), etc. AI Reserves grace period is turned off, and so on.  Beacons and Communication Nodes are not present in the galaxy.
column2: 发件人：指挥官训练官艾伦·布尔沃克 指挥官训练部 - 指挥部  致：指挥官 {PlayerName}  指挥官，  在进入现役之前，最好回顾一下指挥指令和操作原则。低温休眠不应损害你的记忆，但俗话说"重复乃学习之母"，毕竟人类的整个未来都危在旦夕。以下直接引用手册内容：  恭喜！你做出了相当明智的选择，尝试 AI War 2 后勤官模式。后勤官的目标是为经验丰富的 AI War 2 指挥官提供更具挑战性和趣味性的战略体验。请注意，强烈建议在相当"开放"的地图上游戏，即没有大量扼要点的地图。越"封闭"的布局将使后勤官的一些功能失效，但这由你作为指挥官自行决定。  如果你在任何时候发现后勤官过于困难，你可以考虑专家模式，该模式取消了燃料需求。或者你可以选择挑战者模式，该模式允许你关闭大多数你不喜欢的后勤官/专家功能。另一方面，如果你想进一步加大难度，求死模式则提供一些额外的挑战。如果你对这些模式有疑问，请访问 Arcen Games Discord，那里有专门的 expert_challenger_deathwish 频道，并随时可以联系 Strategic Sage 提问。一如既往，Mantis 网站期待你的反馈和/或错误报告。两者均可从主菜单轻松访问。  在后勤官模式下游戏强制执行许多功能，最重要的功能描述如下。其他提示中有更详细的解释。  燃料站。除了能量之外，你的军队现在还需要燃料才能运行。  选择性资产获取。ARS、TSS 和 ODSS 提供的选择数量会减少；它们从中选择这些选项的池保持不变。  多个人工智能。任何专家或以上级别的游戏中至少要求有两个人人工智能。  有限战斗空间站。各种更改以限制和平衡过度使用战斗空间站和滩头阵地。  要么接受要么放弃。在占领行星时，你必须接受所有可用的可占领物。如果你愿意，可以延迟要求军官，但将立即收取 AIP 代价。所有其他可占领物，如主要数据中心、天顶发电机等，将自动被要求。  分布式经济。行星上的小行星（而非你建造的指挥站）贡献大部分金属和能量。这增加了额外的战略多样性，并使关于占领哪些行星以及在那里建造何种类型指挥站的决定更具分量。  恐怖跨行星攻击。CPA 掩体将定期生成，为 CPA 期间部署额外的单位。  加强版人工智能防御。'NastyPicks'，人工智能建筑如质量驱动器、之眼等将更加危险且难以处理。  FRS 重新平衡。特殊的舰队研究站单位不再为其舰队中的其他单位线、军官等提供加成。这种加成无法与其他可用选项合理平衡。  受重创时的紧急撤离。当舰队核心受重创时，将自动"撤离"到友方星系。  增强的人工智能响应。人工智能在入侵外来打击响应、恐怖 CPA（如果开启）等项目上的资源有适度倍数。人工智能储备的宽限期关闭，等等。  信标和通信节点不在此星系中。

column1: From: Commander Trainer Officer Alan Bullwark Commander Training Department - Home Command  To: Commander {PlayerName}  Commander,  It's probably good to review the command instructions and operating principles before entering active service. Stasis shouldn't impair your memory, but 'repetition is the mother of studies', as they say and after all the whole future of humanity is at stake. So here is a direct quote from the manual:  In standard play on the default Humanity Ascendant mode, skilled and experienced AI War 2 commanderss have found beachheading - building turrets on enemy planets - to be far more effective than relying primarily on mobile fleets and ships. Expert Mode aims to achieve a more balanced approach in which beachheading can still be used but is not as overpowered as a strategy.  As you've probably noticed, you are restricted to a single battleship selection instead of the default two. Additionally, hacking TSS for additional turrets will only grant them to the battlestation if you use the 3X option for just the battlestation. When using the 1X option, those turrets will only be granted to your command stations, and the battlestation's complement will remain unchanged.  Beachheading is now more expensive; turrets on planets that are not commander-owned costs 150% more to build, and have reduced range as well to limit the effectiveness of a variety of cheese tactics. The range reductions are as follows; infinite-range turrets reduced to 15k; turrets with over 11k range have a 30% reduction; those from 6k-11k are reduced 15%; below 6k are not reduced at all. Note that losing a command station during a battle can be a major blow, since it could reduce the range of your turrets.  Finally, the amount of time that AI opponents must wait to utilize their full reinforcement cap has been reduced significantly, to counteract 'speed assassinations' in which the commander could knock out a high-level AI before they had enough resources to truly fight back effectively.  This approach was arrived at in no small part due to the much-appreciated brainstorming and expertise of balance guru CRCGamer, and is a compromise solution that was the result of much debate and discussion. Feedback is appreciated as always and tweaks are possible. The goal is to continue allowing as many playstyles are possible, while not leaving a clear and major imbalanced strategy open to easy exploitation.
column2: 发件人：指挥官训练官艾伦·布尔沃克 指挥官训练部 - 指挥部  致：指挥官 {PlayerName}  指挥官，  在进入现役之前，最好回顾一下指挥指令和操作原则。低温休眠不应损害你的记忆，但俗话说"重复乃学习之母"，毕竟人类的整个未来都危在旦夕。以下直接引用手册内容：  在默认人类崛起模式的常规游戏中，经验丰富的 AI War 2 指挥官发现滩头阵地——在敌人行星上建造炮塔——比主要依赖移动舰队和单位要有效得多。专家模式旨在实现一种更平衡的方法，其中滩头阵地仍然可以使用，但不会作为一种压倒性的策略。  你可能已经注意到，你被限制只能选择一个战斗空间站，而不是默认的两个。此外，入侵 TSS 获取额外炮塔时，只有在你为战斗空间站使用 3 倍选项时，这些炮塔才会授予给战斗空间站。当使用 1 倍选项时，这些炮塔只会授予给你的指挥站，而战斗空间站的配置将保持不变。  滩头阵地现在更加昂贵；在非指挥官拥有的行星上建造炮塔的成本增加 150%，并且射程也减少，以限制各种取巧战术的有效性。射程减少如下：无限射程的炮塔减少到 15k；射程超过 11k 的炮塔减少 30%；6k-11k 之间的减少 15%；低于 6k 的不减少。 请注意，在战斗中失去指挥站可能是一个重大打击，因为它可能会减少你的炮塔射程。  最后，人工智能对手等待利用其全部增援上限的时间已显著减少，以对抗"快速刺杀"——指挥官可以在高级人工智能拥有足够资源有效反击之前将其击倒。  这种方法在很大程度上归功于平衡大师 CRCGamer 备受赞赏的头脑风暴和专业知识，是经过大量辩论和讨论后达成的折中方案。一如既往地欢迎反馈，并可能进行调整。目标是继续允许尽可能多的游戏风格，同时不给清晰且重大的不平衡策略留下易于利用的空间。

column1: From: Commander Trainer Officer Alan Bullwark Commander Training Department - Home Command  To: Commander {PlayerName}  Commander,  It's probably good to review the command instructions and operating principles before entering active service. Stasis shouldn't impair your memory, but 'repetition is the mother of studies', as they say and after all the whole future of humanity is at stake. So here is a direct quote from the manual:  Wow, you're a brave soul aren't you! Deathwish is the most restrictive and punishing mode that AI War 2 offers. If you've made your way here, you probably know what you're in for already to a large extent. If you have any questions about the various modes, please visit the Arcen Games discord where there is a dedicated expert_challenger_deathwish channel and feel free to ping Strategic Sage with your inquiries. As always, the Mantis website awaits your feedback and/or bug reports as well. Both are readily accessible from the main menu.  Deathwish has been amusingly called 'Full Sage' mode. Fairness to the commander is pretty much thrown out the window in some respects, with sadistic laughter following it on it's way. It includes everything that comes with Logistician: fuel, distributed economy, limited battlestations, etc. You will also be greeted with the following additional insults by the AI, to which more may be added in the future:  Extreme AI Response. Multipliers for Dire CPAs, Hacking exostrike responses, AI structures resistance to damage, etc. have been dialed up even further.  Dangerous Waves. Wave warnings are completely off. Believe me they're still coming, you just won't know about it until they show up.  Devastating Crippling. Crippled flagships cost twice the metal to repair and also incur a notable HaP penalty.  Further Cheese Limitations. Reverse beachheading - tractoring enemies through wormholes - is no longer possible for the commander. Beachheading on planets with Dire Guard Posts is also strictly forbidden.
column2: 发件人：指挥官训练官艾伦·布尔沃克 指挥官训练部 - 指挥部  致：指挥官 {PlayerName}  指挥官，  在进入现役之前，最好回顾一下指挥指令和操作原则。低温休眠不应损害你的记忆，但俗话说"重复乃学习之母"，毕竟人类的整个未来都危在旦夕。以下直接引用手册内容：  哇，你真是个勇敢的灵魂！求死模式是 AI War 2 提供的最具限制性和惩罚性的模式。如果你来到这里，你可能在很大程度上已经知道自己将面临什么。如果你对各种模式有任何疑问，请访问 Arcen Games Discord，那里有专门的 expert_challenger_deathwish 频道，并随时可以联系 Strategic Sage 提问。一如既往，Mantis 网站也期待你的反馈和/或错误报告。两者均可从主菜单轻松访问。  求死模式被有趣地称为"完全 Sage"模式。在某些方面，对指挥官的公平性基本上被抛到了窗外，伴随着恶意的笑声。它包括后勤官模式的一切：燃料、分布式经济、有限战斗空间站等。你还将面临人工智能带来的以下额外侮辱，未来可能还会增加更多：  极端人工智能响应。恐怖 CPA、入侵外来打击响应、人工智能建筑对伤害的抵抗等倍数被进一步提高。  危险波次。波次警告完全关闭。相信我，它们仍然会来，只是你不会知道直到它们出现。  毁灭性的重创。受重创的旗舰修复需要两倍的金属，并且还会产生显著的 HaP 惩罚。  进一步限制取巧。反向滩头阵地——通过虫洞牵引敌人——对指挥官不再可用。在有恐怖守卫哨站的行星上进行滩头阵地也严格禁止。

So here is a direct quote from the manual:  Congratulations! You've made the considerably wise choice to try out AI War 2 Expert Mode. The goal of Expert is to present experienced AI War 2 commanders with a more challenging and interesting strategic experience. Note that it is highly recommended to play on fairly 'open' maps, i.e., those without a large amount of chokepoints. The more 'closed' arrangements will render some of Expert's features ineffective, but are left up to your discretion as a commander.  If at any time you find Expert too overwhelming, you may wish to consider Challenger Mode which allows you to turn off most Expert features you don't particularly enjoy. On the other hand, if you want to turn the dial up further, Logistician requires you to manage fuel, and Deathwish has some additional challenges available. If you have questions about these modes, please visit the Arcen Games discord where there is a dedicated expert_challenger_deathwish channel and feel free to ping Strategic Sage with your inquiries. As always, the Mantis website awaits your feedback and/or bug reports. Both are readily accessible from the main menu.  Playing on Expert enforces a number of features, the most significant ones are described below. Other Tips are available for a more detailed explanation for these where appropriate.  Selective Asset Acquisition. ARS, TSS, and ODSS will offer a lower number of choices each; the pool they select those choices from remains unaffected.  Multiple AIs. At least two AIs are mandatory for any Expert game.  Limited Battlestations. A variety of changes to limit and balance excessive use of battlestations and beachheading.  Take It Or Leave It. When capturing a planet, you must take all of the capturables available. You can delay claiming Officers if you wish, but you will be charged the AIP price immediately. All other capturables such as Major Data Centers, Zenith Power Generators, etc. are automatically claimed.  Distributed Economy. The asteroids on a planet, not the command stations you build, contribute most of the metal and energy. This lends additional strategic variety and weight decisions about what planets to capture, and what types of command stations to build there.   Dire Cross-Planet Attacks. CPA Bunkers will periodically spawn, housing additional ships for deployment during CPAs.  Dialed-Up AI Defenses. 'NastyPicks', AI structures such as Mass Drivers, Eyes, etc. will be more dangerous and difficult to handle.  FRS Rebalancing. The special Fleet Research Station ships no longer provide bonuses to other ship lines, Officers, etc. in their fleets. This bonus is impossible to balance sensibly with the other options available to the commander.  Crippling Bail-Out. When crippled, fleet centerpieces will 'bail-out' to a friendly system automatically.  Increased AI Response. There is a modest multiplier to the resources the AI has for items like hacking exostrike response, Dire CPAs (if turned on), etc. AI Reserves grace period is turned off, and so on.
column2: 发件人：指挥官训练官艾伦·布尔沃克 指挥官训练部 - 指挥部  致：指挥官 {PlayerName}  指挥官，  在进入现役之前，最好回顾一下指挥指令和操作原则。低温休眠不应损害你的记忆，但俗话说"重复乃学习之母"，毕竟人类的整个未来都危在旦夕。以下直接引用手册内容：  恭喜！你做出了相当明智的选择，尝试 AI War 2 专家模式。专家的目标是为经验丰富的 AI War 2 指挥官提供更具挑战性和趣味性的战略体验。请注意，强烈建议在相当"开放"的地图上游戏，即没有大量扼要点的地图。越"封闭"的布局将使专家的一些功能失效，但这由你作为指挥官自行决定。  如果你在任何时候发现专家过于困难，你可以考虑挑战者模式，该模式允许你关闭大多数你不太喜欢的专家功能。另一方面，如果你想进一步加大难度，后勤官模式要求你管理燃料，而求死模式则提供一些额外的挑战。如果你对这些模式有疑问，请访问 Arcen Games Discord，那里有专门的 expert_challenger_deathwish 频道，并随时可以联系 Strategic Sage 提问。一如既往，Mantis 网站期待你的反馈和/或错误报告。两者均可从主菜单轻松访问。  在专家模式下游戏强制执行许多功能，最重要的功能描述如下。其他提示中有更详细的解释。  选择性资产获取。ARS、TSS 和 ODSS 提供的选择数量会减少；它们从中选择这些选项的池保持不变。  多个人工智能。任何专家游戏中至少要求有两个人人工智能。  有限战斗空间站。各种更改以限制和平衡过度使用战斗空间站和滩头阵地。  要么接受要么放弃。在占领行星时，你必须接受所有可用的可占领物。如果你愿意，可以延迟要求军官，但将立即收取 AIP 代价。所有其他可占领物，如主要数据中心、天顶发电机等，将自动被要求。  分布式经济。行星上的小行星（而非你建造的指挥站）贡献大部分金属和能量。这增加了额外的战略多样性，并使关于占领哪些行星以及在那里建造何种类型指挥站的决定更具分量。  恐怖跨行星攻击。CPA 掩体将定期生成，为 CPA 期间部署额外的单位。  加强版人工智能防御。'NastyPicks'，人工智能建筑如质量驱动器、之眼等将更加危险且难以处理。  FRS 重新平衡。特殊的舰队研究站单位不再为其舰队中的其他单位线、军官等提供加成。这种加成无法与其他可用选项合理平衡。  受重创时的紧急撤离。当舰队核心受重创时，将自动"撤离"到友方星系。  增强的人工智能响应。人工智能在入侵外来打击响应、恐怖 CPA（如果开启）等项目上的资源有适度倍数。人工智能储备的宽限期关闭，等等。

column1: From: Dr. Leszek Bednorz Spire Research and Communication Department - Home Command  To: Commander {PlayerName}  Commander!  The Exogalactic Transceiver on {PlanetName} is complete! I've been watching the skies for a long time, commander, and I have never seen radiation like that. From what the Spire tell me, it will take some time to re-establish the intergalactic channels of communication and transit. During this time, we are in grave peril, as there is simply no way the AI does not know what we are doing. This is a flare-lit tip-off, commander, and the AI is not stupid. At this stage, if it truly comes down to it, we need only protect Home Command and the transceiver itself. One way or the other, this war should be over soon.
column2: 发件人：莱谢克·贝德诺兹博士 尖塔研究与通信部 - 指挥部  致：指挥官 {PlayerName}  指挥官！  {PlanetName} 上的河外收发器已经完成！指挥官，我观察天空已经很长时间了，从未见过这样的辐射。 据尖塔所说，重新建立星际间的通信和运输渠道需要一些时间。在这段时间里，我们处于巨大的危险中，因为人工智能不可能不知道我们在做什么。指挥官，这是一个像火炬一样明显的告密，而人工智能并不愚蠢。  在这个阶段，如果真的到了那一步，我们只需要保护指挥部和收发器本身。无论如何，这场战争应该很快就会结束。

column1: From: Dr. Leszek Bednorz Spire Research and Communication Department - Home Command  To: Commander {PlayerName}  Commander,   The Spire have built their first Destroyer Neural Net. The city's flagship will now be able to build Destroyers when it is near a Spire Shipyard.  These ships pack devastating armaments against large single targets, but require significantly more resources to build.
column2: 发件人：莱谢克·贝德诺兹博士 尖塔研究与通信部 - 指挥部  致：指挥官 {PlayerName}  指挥官，  尖塔建造了他们的第一个驱逐舰神经网。该城市的旗舰现在将能够在靠近尖塔造船厂时建造驱逐舰。  这些单位配备了对大型单个目标的毁灭性武器，但需要显著更多的资源来建造。

column1: From: Dr. Leszek Bednorz Spire Research and Communication Department - Home Command  To: Commander {PlayerName}  Commander,   The Spire have built their first Frigate Neural Net. The flagship attached to this city core will now be able to build Frigates when it is near a Spire Shipyard, even one belonging to another city.   While the Spire call these 'toy' ships, these are still very intimidating warships. Lets see what they can do!
column2: 发件人：莱谢克·贝德诺兹博士 尖塔研究与通信部 - 指挥部  致：指挥官 {PlayerName}  指挥官，  尖塔建造了他们的第一个护卫舰神经网。附属于这个城市核心的旗舰现在将能够在靠近尖塔造船厂时建造护卫舰，即使是属于另一座城市的造船厂。  虽然尖塔称这些为"玩具"单位，但这仍然是令人望而生畏的战舰。让我们看看它们能做什么！

column1: From: Dr. Leszek Bednorz Spire Research and Communication Department - Home Command  To: Commander {PlayerName}  Commander,  It's hard to read feelings from a rock, but the refugees are rejoicing. Also, there's a fascinating resonance being set up between this city and the Capitol; it's like this new city is Bolstering the energies of the previous capitol.
column2: 发件人：莱谢克·贝德诺兹博士 尖塔研究与通信部 - 指挥部  致：指挥官 {PlayerName}  指挥官，  很难从一块石头上读出情绪，但难民们正在欢庆。另外，这座城市和首都之间正在建立一种迷人的共鸣；就像这座新城市在增援之前首都的能量一样。

column1: From: Dr. Leszek Bednorz Spire Research and Communication Department - Home Command  To: Commander {PlayerName}  Commander,  Our new spire allies are truly amazing. Apparently, they grow their ships rather than manufacturing them! That's not all, though. They are even able to modify their ships in the field! As our allies have decided to defer to your command, they are permitting you to make modifications to their ship lines. You'll find an interface in your fleet menu entitled 'modules' next to any ship line which can be modified. If you select that option, you'll be presented with a menu of modules to apply to the line.  Each spire ship line from each planet can be assigned a template (so all the frigates from their capital will be identical, etc.). As the spire cities grow in complexity, the ships grown from them become capable of handling additional and/or more complicated modules. You'll see a reminder at the top of your display if any ships have the capacity for additional modules.  Please be aware that changing modules is quite taxing, and the ships will be disabled during the reconfiguration process. I strongly recommend against changing modules in the middle of a firefight.
column2: 发件人：莱谢克·贝德诺兹博士 尖塔研究与通信部 - 指挥部  致：指挥官 {PlayerName}  指挥官，  我们新的尖塔盟友真是太惊人了。显然，它们是在"生长"而不是制造它们的单位！但这还不是全部。它们甚至能够在战场上修改它们的单位！由于我们的盟友已决定听从你的指挥，他们允许你对其单位线进行修改。你会在舰队菜单中找到名为"模块"的界面，位于任何可以被修改的单位线旁边。如果你选择该选项，你将看到一个模块菜单，可应用于该单位线。  来自每个行星的每条尖塔单位线都可以分配一个模板（因此来自他们首都的所有护卫舰将是相同的，等等）。随着尖塔城市的复杂性增长，从它们那里生长出来的单位能够处理额外和/或更复杂的模块。如果任何单位有能力安装额外模块，你会在屏幕顶部看到提醒。  请注意，更改模块是非常消耗资源的，单位在重新配置期间将被禁用。我强烈建议不要在交火中更改模块。

column1: From: Dr. Leszek Bednorz Spire Research and Communication Department - Home Command  To: Commander {PlayerName}  Commander,  The Spire have built their second Flagship, and it's a beauty. They seem to be radiating pride. This will give our forces a lot more flexibility defending our Empire.
column2: 发件人：莱谢克·贝德诺兹博士 尖塔研究与通信部 - 指挥部  致：指挥官 {PlayerName}  指挥官，  尖塔已经建造了他们的第二艘旗舰，真是一个美丽的单位。他们似乎散发着骄傲。这将为我们的部队在保卫帝国方面提供更大的灵活性。

column1: From: Dr. Leszek Bednorz Spire Research and Communication Department - Home Command  To: Commander {PlayerName}  Commander,  The Spire have managed to construct their third Flagship and final flagship. They seem to be radiating determination.
column2: 发件人：莱谢克·贝德诺兹博士 尖塔研究与通信部 - 指挥部  致：指挥官 {PlayerName}  指挥官，  尖塔成功建造了他们的第三艘也是最后一艘旗舰。他们似乎散发着决心。

column1: From: Dr. Leszek Bednorz Spire Research and Communication Department - Home Command To: Commander {PlayerName} Commander, We found fleet of alien refugees calling themselves Spire as we were trying to escape and hide from hunting AI forces. Even with our previous contact with the Zenith and others has made the linguistic situation at least possible, we're still working on getting these translators to do something other than spit out hard to understand one word sentences. Linquistic situaton aside, we have been able to determine that they were also on the run from the AI. After some awkward diplomatic attempts we came to an agreement to form an alliance. We merged our systems together to form what they liked to call Infused Empire. They builded a massive Spire Galactic Capitol close to our Home Command station and gave us access to command their Spire Fleet. They told us that every 3 planets we capture gives us the ability to build a new Spire City. The 3rd and 5th Spire City we build will also give us a new Spire Fleet for a total of 3. When we asked them why so specific rules, they addressed something about radiation, energies and something we have no clue what they meant. They also told us that Spire Cities that don't have Fleets of their own can instead Bolster the Spire Fleets of other Cities to increase the strength of those Fleets. This means we will have up to 3 fleets, but each with the power of several cities behind them. Practically, this means that the buildings in the Bolstering City will grant their bonuses to the Bolstered Fleet. We can change which Fleet a city is bolstering in the Fleets menu. We are afraid that every so often the AI will send large Exogalactic Strikeforces against our 'infused empire'. They will maybe also send vicious Exogalactic Strikeforces whenever we build a new city. Or at least our intelligence department thinks so. When we build a new city, Spire will scan the galaxy for a few minutes in hopes of finding some of their 'Spire Debris' near our Empire. We can then hack them for resources if AI doesn't get them first. Finally, one more thing. Spire Cities can't be too close to each other; you must build them at least one hop apart. We don't know why, but that's what they instructed us to do. I believe they have their reasons. They also don't want to be adjacent to on AI Bastion or Homeworlds which I completely understand.
column2: 发件人：莱谢克·贝德诺兹博士 尖塔研究与通信部 - 指挥部 致：指挥官 {PlayerName} 指挥官， 当我们在试图逃避和躲藏追捕的人工智能部队时，发现了一群自称尖塔的外星难民。即使我们之前与天顶及其他种族的接触使语言处理至少成为可能，我们仍在努力让这些翻译器做除了吐出难以理解的单字句子之外的事情。撇开语言问题不谈，我们已经能够确定他们也在逃离人工智能。 经过一些尴尬的外交尝试，我们达成协议组建了一个联盟。我们将我们的系统合并在一起，形成了他们喜欢称之为灌注帝国的联盟。他们在靠近我们指挥部的地方建造了一个巨大的尖塔银河首都，并授予我们指挥他们的尖塔舰队的权限。 他们告诉我们，每占领 3 个行星就能让我们建造一座新的尖塔城市。我们建造的第三和第五座尖塔城市也将为我们提供一个新的尖塔舰队，总共 3 个。当我们问他们为什么有如此具体的规则时，他们提到了关于辐射、能量以及一些我们完全不懂的东西。 他们还告诉我们，没有自己舰队的尖塔城市可以转而增援其他城市的尖塔舰队，以增强那些舰队的力量。这意味着我们将拥有最多 3 个舰队，但每个舰队背后都有多个城市的力量。实际上，这意味着增援城市中的建筑将将其加成授予被增援的舰队。我们可以在舰队菜单中更改一个城市增援哪个舰队。 我们担心，每隔一段时间，人工智能会向我们的"灌注帝国"派遣大型河外打击力量。每当我们建造新城市时，它们可能还会派遣凶残的河外打击力量。至少我们的情报部门是这么认为的。 当我们建造新城市时，尖塔会扫描银河系几分钟，希望能找到一些靠近我们帝国的"尖塔残骸"。如果人工智能没有抢先，我们可以入侵它们以获取资源。 最后，还有一件事。尖塔城市不能靠得太近；你必须将它们建在至少相隔一跳的位置。我们不知道原因，但这是他们指示我们做的。我相信他们有他们的理由。他们也不想与人工智能堡垒或母星相邻，这我完全理解。

column1: From: Dr. Leszek Bednorz Spire Research and Communication Department - Home Command  To: Commander {PlayerName}  Commander,  We've begun to understand how a Spire City works. Each city comes with several 'Casings' that support building additional Spire structures. There are a variety of these structures; some have a military purpose, others seem like they function similarly to our own metal extractors and generators. We're still working out what they all do.  It's important to note that the Spire must build a Shipyard in a city to allow for the production of their offensive ships at that city. A Shipyard can build ships for any nearby Spire fleets, even those without a shipyard at their own home city.  Their cities seem to have resonance generators that work more effectively when more of them exist. This suggests that if we can help create more Spire Cities, their existing cities might 'mark up'. Higher-Mark cities would allow for more casings and more powerful ships and structures.  Hovering over a Spire City will tell you what requirements must be met to upgrade that city's mark level. When a city is ready to upgrade you will see a Notification; interacting with that Notification will allow the city to mark up.  The Spire starts with a Flagship from it's Galactic Capitol, and gets an additional Flagship from their 3rd and 5th cities. All other cities will Bolster those fleets. When a Fleet is bolstered by a city, structures built in the bolstering city will affect the Fleet. This gives you 3 fleets, and each fleet can now be made very powerful. The Spire can choose which Fleet to bolster (See the Fleets Menu).  Finally, one more thing. Spire Cities can't be too close to each other; you must build them at least one hop apart. We don't know why, but that's what they instructed us to do. I believe they have their reasons. They also don't want to be adjacent to on AI Bastion or Homeworlds which I completely understand.
column2: 发件人：莱谢克·贝德诺兹博士 尖塔研究与通信部 - 指挥部  致：指挥官 {PlayerName}  指挥官，  我们开始理解尖塔城市的工作原理了。每座城市都有几个"外壳"来支持建造额外的尖塔建筑。这些建筑种类繁多；有些具有军事用途，另一些的功能似乎类似于我们自己的金属提取器和发电机。我们仍在研究它们各自的功能。  需要注意的是，尖塔必须在城市中建造造船厂，才能在该城市生产其进攻性单位。造船厂可以为任何附近的尖塔舰队建造单位，即使那些舰队在它们自己的母城没有造船厂。  它们的城市似乎拥有共鸣发生器，当更多此类发生器存在时工作效率更高。这表明如果我们能帮助建造更多的尖塔城市，它们现有的城市可能会"升级"。更高级的城市将允许更多的外壳和更强大的单位和建筑。  悬停在尖塔城市上将告诉你需要满足哪些要求才能升级该城市的等级。当城市准备好升级时，你会看到通知；与通知交互将使城市升级。  尖塔从其银河首都开始拥有一艘旗舰，并在其第三和第五座城市时获得额外的旗舰。所有其他城市将增援那些舰队。当一个舰队被城市增援时，在增援城市中建造的建筑将影响该舰队。这给你提供了 3 个舰队，每个舰队都可以变得非常强大。尖塔可以选择增援哪个舰队（参见舰队菜单）。  最后，还有一件事。尖塔城市不能靠得太近；你必须将它们建在至少相隔一跳的位置。我们不知道原因，但这是他们指示我们做的。我相信他们有他们的理由。他们也不想与人工智能堡垒或母星相邻，这我完全理解。

column1: From: Dr. Leszek Bednorz Spire Research and Communication Department - Home Command  To: Commander {PlayerName}  Commander,  We've made some progress in understanding the Spire. Here is an attempted transliteration:  From: (attempted transliteration) Entelemaren Exaron {FactionColor} Gratitude. Surprise. Suspicion. Patience. Rebuilding. Can Help. Small. Looking. For others. </color>  We have made some progress understanding the Spire's communications; it seems like Exaron is their leader or spokesbeing. As far as we can tell they were not counting on help from humans. We may know nothing of them, but they've apparently heard a lot about us. And not in a positive way. Regardless, they are willing to set our recent actions in rescuing them against our dubious reputation, and are also very grateful for our allowing them to settle their small number of refugees in this system.  It seems they have detected a new Relic in the galaxy with more refugees, and have requested that we dispatch one of our fleets to recover the object. We pressed them for some details. Given the circumstances, they were not reluctant.  It seems these Relics are powerful shards of energy that can each power a city.  We're not quite sure what these shards were powering before, but the Spire can clearly build cities around them now.  Do we want them to expand? That's a decision for you, Commander. But they have conducted themselves honorably thus far.  One final note: they caution us that the AI is aware of their presence, and that the Spire and the AI have a... complicated history. If we continue to pursue this path, we should be prepared for powerful attacks.
column2: 发件人：莱谢克·贝德诺兹博士 尖塔研究与通信部 - 指挥部  致：指挥官 {PlayerName}  指挥官，  我们在理解尖塔方面取得了一些进展。以下是尝试转写的信息：  发件人：（尝试转写）恩特尔玛伦·埃克萨隆 {FactionColor} 感激。 惊讶。 怀疑。 耐心。 重建。 可以帮忙。很小。 在寻找。其他的。 </color>  我们在理解尖塔的通信方面取得了一些进展；似乎埃克萨隆是他们的领袖或发言人。据我们所知，他们原本没有指望人类的帮助。我们可能对他们一无所知，但他们显然听说过很多关于我们的事。而且不是正面意义上的。尽管如此，他们愿意将我们最近营救他们的行为与我们可疑的声誉进行权衡，并且非常感激我们允许他们的一小批难民在这个星系定居。  看来他们在银河系中检测到了一个新的遗物，里面有更多的难民，并请求我们派遣一支舰队去回收该物体。我们向他们询问了一些细节。鉴于目前的情况，他们并不避讳。  这些遗物似乎是强大的能量碎片，每个都可以为一座城市提供能量。我们不太确定这些碎片以前是为什提供能量的，但尖塔显然现在可以围绕它们建造城市。  我们想要他们扩张吗？指挥官，这由你来决定。但到目前为止，他们的行为是光荣的。  最后一点：他们警告我们，人工智能已经意识到他们的存在，而且尖塔和人工智能有着……复杂的历史。如果我们继续走这条路，我们应该为强大的攻击做好准备。

column1: From: Dr. Leszek Bednorz Spire Research and Communication Department - Home Command  To: Commander {PlayerName}  Commander,  We've worked through most of the basic communication barriers with the alien refugees. They call themselves the Spire. They aren't very talkative, but they are grateful to have a place for them to rebuild their Galactic Capitol on {PlanetName}.  They are also rocks.  Er, that's perhaps not very diplomatic. To put it another way: their bodies are crystalline formations. Exact composition unknown, for reasons you can deduce. They have constructed a new home base in our Galaxy and have offered to build a small number of what they called 'tiny craft' to help us. We don't know if the translators are still on the fritz or what, but the design they transmitted is far from tiny.    We're not sure if they've been studying us before now, but they've managed to build something similar in function to, though vastly more powerful than our own flagships.  We believe that the 'tiny craft' will associate with this flagship similarly to how our own strikecraft and frigates do with ours, though they seem more tightly linked to their city core and associated flagship.  We won't have the same flexibility to move ships between these fleets, but the sheer firepower they possess makes up for at least part of this inconvenience.  Finally, it seems they are scanning subspace to try to locate other refugees. Or perhaps other artifacts. We couldn't really figure out which. Either way, it seems they are our best lead to finding out what's going on... if we want to know.
column2: 发件人：莱谢克·贝德诺兹博士 尖塔研究与通信部 - 指挥部  致：指挥官 {PlayerName}  指挥官，  我们已经克服了与外星难民的大部分基本交流障碍。他们自称尖塔。他们不太爱说话，但他们很感激有一个地方可以在 {PlanetName} 上重建他们的银河首都。  另外，他们是石头。  呃，这样说也许不太外交。换种说法：他们的身体是水晶结构。成分未知，原因你可以推断。他们在我们的银河系建造了一个新的基地，并主动提出要建造一些他们称之为"小型飞行器"的东西来帮助我们。我们不确定翻译器是否仍然有问题，但他们传输的设计远非小型。  我们不确定他们之前是否一直在研究我们，但他们已经建造了一些功能类似但远比我们的旗舰强大的东西。我们相信这些"小型飞行器"将与这个旗舰关联，类似于我们自己的小型战机和护卫舰与我们的旗舰关联，尽管它们似乎与自己的城市核心及相关旗舰联系更紧密。我们不会像在这些舰队之间转移单位那样灵活，但它们拥有的纯粹火力至少弥补了这一不便的一部分。  最后，他们似乎正在扫描亚空间以寻找其他难民。或者也许是其他神器。我们真的搞不清楚是哪个。无论如何，他们似乎是我们找出正在发生的事情的最佳线索……如果我们想知道的话。

column1: From: Dr. Samantha Wegman Zenith historian - Home Command  To: Commander {PlayerName}  Commander,  As you know, the Zenith have long been thought to be a civilization entirely in ruins. Their war machines and automatons litter our galaxy, but the few remaining living sentient citizens have long been thought to be either solitary, or almost-feral fragments.             But now something new is happening. I don't know what it is, but Citizens from multiple Zenith civilizations in their prime are being discovered. Where did they come from, or where have they been?  The theory that Frans Beckett presented some years ago seems most likely to be true -- as odd as this is to say -- is that these specimens are from adjacent universes in the multiverse.  The existence of the multiverse itself has been incontrovertibly established by scientists for centuries at this point, but this would be the first observed instance of anything passing between universes.  It's possible that there is another explanation, and that these new Zenith have been hiding in plain sight in our galaxy for some unknown reason. But these seem to be small parts of far grander empires that still exist, and so the simplest explanation is -- oddly -- to look to the multiverse.
column2: 发件人：萨曼莎·韦格曼博士 天顶历史学家 - 指挥部  致：指挥官 {PlayerName}  指挥官，  如你所知，天顶长期以来一直被认为是一个完全沦为废墟的文明。他们的战争机器和自动机散布在我们的银河系，但少数幸存的活着的知觉公民一直被认为是孤独的或几乎野性的碎片。  但现在有新的情况发生了。我不知道是什么，但来自多个处于全盛时期的天顶文明的公民正在被发现。他们从哪里来，或者一直在哪里？  几年前弗兰斯·贝克特提出的理论似乎最可能是真的——尽管这说起来很奇怪——这些个体来自多元宇宙中的相邻宇宙。多元宇宙本身的存在几个世纪以来已经被科学家们无可辩驳地证实，但这将是第一次观察到任何事物在宇宙之间穿行。  可能有另一种解释，这些新的天顶人由于某种未知原因一直隐藏在我们银河系中显而易见的地方。但这些似乎只是仍然存在的更宏大帝国的一小部分，因此最简单的解释是——奇怪的是——要看向多元宇宙。

column1: From: Dr. Samantha Wegman Zenith historian - Home Command  To: Commander {PlayerName}  Commander,  I belive a quick recap on the extinct Zenith race will have some useful information to you to use in our fight against the AI.   The Zenith Aliens are a truly ancient race, who were the undisputed masters of most of our galaxy as recently as a few million years ago. Hundreds of thousands of years ago, however, their civilization crumbled, leaving a galaxy littered with the remnants of their past glory.  The exact cause of the destruction of the Zenith empire is not known to us at this time, but what is clear is that it did not completely obliterate all specimens of that race. Instead, it fragmented them and scattered them to the stars. Some ply trade with other species, organic or otherwise. Some simply roam around in an amoral state, Devouring things.  Most of what is left of the race are broken derelicts that we have taken to calling 'golems,' which are largely... to the Zenith what an Android is to a us. These golems share the shapes of their old masters, but not the independent thinking and free will.  All Zenith automatons include both mechanical and organic parts, and they do include something that is bordering on sentience, but they were never meant to be independent actors. They were not citizens. They have no culture, no goals beyond the tasks that were assigned to them all those millennia ago.  Pockets of living Zenith are much more rare, but do exist.  Untangling the history of the Zenith, if any remains, would likely be the work of generations. For now we know a few things, but the sheer scope of what was lost -- and what remains but is hidden -- is almost unthinkable.  We do know that their citizens started out no larger than a large land vehicle, and then would grow over the course of decades to the bulk of a midsize starship.  Thanks to a unique biology that they constantly augmented with mechanical parts, they seem to be able to move in and out of atmosphere, and exist in vacuum, without issue.  Depending on what functions they wished to take on, citizens could shape themselves for many different purposes ranging from war to science or philosophy.
column2: 发件人：萨曼莎·韦格曼博士 天顶历史学家 - 指挥部  致：指挥官 {PlayerName}  指挥官，  我相信对已灭绝的天顶种族进行快速回顾将为你对抗人工智能的战斗提供一些有用的信息。  天顶外星人是一个真正古老的种族，直到几百万年前，他们还是我们银河系大部分地区无可争议的主人。然而，数十万年前，他们的文明崩溃了，银河系中散落着他们昔日辉煌的遗迹。  天顶帝国毁灭的确切原因我们目前尚不清楚，但可以确定的是，它并未完全消灭该种族的所有个体。相反，它使他们分裂并散落到群星之中。有些与其他物种进行贸易，无论有机物还是其他。有些只是毫无道德地游荡，吞噬着一切。  该种族留下的大部分是破碎的残骸，我们称之为"傀儡"，它们在很大程度上……对于天顶来说，就像机器人对于我们一样。这些傀儡拥有其旧主人的形状，但没有独立的思维和自由意志。  所有天顶自动机都包含机械和有机部分，并且它们确实包含接近知觉的东西，但它们从未被设计为独立行动者。它们不是公民。它们没有文化，没有超越那些千年前分配给它们的任务的目标。  存活的零星天顶个体要罕见得多，但确实存在。  解开天顶的历史（如果有任何残留的话）可能需要几代人的工作。目前我们知道一些事情，但失去的东西——以及仍然存在但被隐藏的东西——的范围几乎是不可想象的。  我们确实知道，他们的公民从不超过一辆大型陆地车辆的大小开始，然后在几十年的时间里长到一艘中型星际飞船的体积。由于一种独特的生物学特性——他们不断用机械部件增强自己——他们似乎能够在没有障碍的情况下进出大气层，并在真空中生存。根据他们希望承担的功能，公民可以将自己塑造成许多不同的用途，从战争到科学或哲学。

column1: From: Dr. Timothy Copperfield Artificial Intelligence RnD - Home Command  To: Commander {PlayerName}  Commander,       We've detected an AI subroutine, currently called the 'Warden Fleet', due to the almost entirely defensive behaviour.  Current data seems to suggest it is a constantly active force, perpetually being replenished up to some unseen amount. It seems reasonable to expect this amount to increase as we alert the AI more.  Due to the strong defensive behaviour, it appears unlikely this 'Warden Fleet' will ever attack us directly, and may even entirely avoid our worlds, which may be something we can use, by preventing it from ever gathering in full force in one location.
column2: 发件人: 蒂莫西·科波菲尔博士 人工智能研发部 - 总部指挥部  收件人: {PlayerName}指挥官  指挥官，       我们检测到一个人工智能子程序，由于它几乎完全是防御性的行为，目前被称为“守卫舰队”。  目前的数据似乎表明，这是一支持续活跃的部队，会不断补充到一个未知的数量。我们有理由预计，随着我们对人工智能的警惕性提高，这个数量会增加。  由于其强烈的防御行为，这个“守卫舰队”似乎不太可能直接攻击我们，甚至可能完全避开我们的行星，我们可以利用这一点，防止它在一个地方集结全部力量。

column1: From: Dr. Timothy Copperfield Artificial Intelligence RnD - Home Command  To: Commander {PlayerName}  Commander,  At some point after we lost the first war, The AI felt a need for a subsidiary force to wipe out small annoyances (like us), and not need to bother its main Processors with petty things. It seems to have took various races it has conquered from (possibly) other galaxies and twisted them by genetic engineering, fused them into a new and powerful force to crush its foes. This could be a bad news.  We dubbed it as the Scourge, it uses 'Spawners' to produce 'Neophytes' which evolve into 'Warriors' and 'Builders'. Scourge can upgrade its units at Armories. As those structures level up over time they get more powerful, so being proactive to destroy an enemy scourge's infrastructure (or protect an ally's infrastructure) is critical to our survival.
column2: 发件人：蒂莫西·科波菲尔博士 人工智能研发部 - 指挥部  致：指挥官 {PlayerName}  指挥官，  在我们输掉第一次战争后的某个时候，人工智能感到需要一支附属部队来消灭小的麻烦（比如我们），而不必用它的主要处理器来处理琐事。它似乎将从（可能来自）其他星系征服的各种种族进行了基因工程改造，将它们融合成一支新的强大力量来粉碎其敌人。这可能是个坏消息。  我们将其称为天灾，它使用"生成器"生产"新信徒"，新信徒进化成"战士"和"建造者"。天灾可以在军械库升级其单位。随着这些建筑的等级随时间提升，它们变得更强大，因此主动摧毁敌方天灾的基础设施（或保护盟友的基础设施）对我们的生存至关重要。

column1: From: Dr. Timothy Copperfield Artificial Intelligence RnD - Home Command  To: Commander {PlayerName}  Commander,  It appears that our deep strike (attacking the AI far away from any of our worlds) is triggering an AI defensive response. We're detecting multiple Wormholes being opened, as well as ship signatures approaching.  Currently, it seems moving closer to our own territory will cause the response to retreat back through those same Wormholes. However, if we continue to deep strike farther, we suspect the response will only increase.

column1: From: Dr. Timothy Copperfield Artificial Intelligence RnD - Home Command  To: Commander {PlayerName}  Commander,  We noticed Risk Analyzers are AI devices that allow them to periodically scan the galaxy for enemy forces, and raise AIP when they find enemies. We have theories that destroying a Risk Analyzer will cause a one-time boost in AIP but no increase over time. However, capturing a Risk Analyzer should allow us to feed the AI bad data about how peaceful and nonthreatening we are, so reducing AIP.  Risk Analyzers will also allow the AI to send infrequent Exogalactic Strikeforces against its enemies here. Capturing Risk Analyzers makes those strikeforces more frequent, and they will prioritize any captured Risk Analyzers.
column2: 发件人：蒂莫西·科波菲尔博士 人工智能研发部 - 指挥部  致：指挥官 {PlayerName}  指挥官，  我们注意到风险分析器是人工智能的设备，允许它们定期扫描银河系寻找敌方部队，并在发现敌人时提高 AIP。我们有理论认为摧毁风险分析器会导致一次性 AIP 提升，但不会随时间增加。然而，捕获风险分析器应该能让我们向人工智能提供关于我们有多和平和无威胁的错误数据，从而降低 AIP。  风险分析器还将允许人工智能向其在此处的敌人发送不频繁的河外打击力量。捕获风险分析器会使这些打击力量更频繁，并且它们会优先攻击任何被捕获的风险分析器。

column1: From: Dr. Timothy Copperfield Artificial Intelligence RnD - Home Command  To: Commander {PlayerName}  Commander,  We're detecting some new AI ships and Infrastructure, named 'Astro Trains'.  These robotic couriers seem to travel around the galaxy from Station to Station, until they reach their destination Depot and unload their cargo. What that cargo is exactly we don't know, but we may gain Science and Hacking knowledge if we destroy one.  They are likely contributing to large construction efforts, which may include Fortresses, Dire Guardians, replicas of Golems, or worse. When enough Trains have arrived, we suspect the project will launch.
column2: 发件人: 蒂莫西·科波菲尔博士 人工智能研发部 - 总部指挥部  收件人: 指挥官 {PlayerName}  指挥官，  我们检测到一些名为“星际列车”的新型人工智能飞船和基础设施。  这些机器人运输工具似乎在星系中从一个空间站前往另一个空间站，直到抵达目的地仓库并卸载货物。我们尚不清楚货物具体是什么，但如果摧毁一艘列车，我们可能会获得科学和入侵技术知识。  它们可能正在为大型建造项目做出贡献，这些项目可能包括堡垒、恐怖守护者、魔像复制品，甚至更糟糕的东西。我们推测，当足够多的列车抵达后，该项目就会启动。

column1: From: Dr. Timothy Copperfield Artificial Intelligence RnD - Home Command  To: Commander {PlayerName}  Commander,  We've spotted what appears to be an AI subroutine, which we have currently termed the 'Hunter Fleet,' due to the predator-like aggressive behaviour it exhibits.  Our theory so far is that AI units currently not on guard duty and have been inactive for a while are slaved to this subroutine, and are used much more proactively and intelligently than the units would act on their own, assuming they are not already slaved.  It would appear beneficial for us to destroy as many ships as we can, before they potentially escape, join this 'Hunter Fleet,' and become bigger problems later on.
column2: 发件人: 蒂莫西·科波菲尔博士 人工智能研发部 - 总部指挥部  收件人: {PlayerName}指挥官  指挥官，  我们发现了一个疑似人工智能子程序，由于它表现出类似捕食者的攻击性行为，我们目前将其命名为“猎手舰队”。  到目前为止，我们的理论是，目前未执行警戒任务且已闲置一段时间的人工智能单位会被编入这个子程序，并且它们会比单独行动时更加主动和智能，前提是它们还没有被编入其他程序。  在这些单位有可能逃脱、加入这个“猎手舰队”并在日后造成更大麻烦之前，尽可能多地摧毁它们对我们似乎是有利的。

column1: From: Dr. Timothy Copperfield Artificial Intelligence RnD - Home Command  To: Commander {PlayerName}  Okay, this is something new and somehow beautiful to look at. The AIs all seem to hate one another now, but can we take advantage of this and make it out alive? Even the thought of being caught in the crossfire of AIs main fleets gives me sleepless nights...
column2: 发件人：蒂莫西·科波菲尔博士 人工智能研发部 - 指挥部  致：指挥官 {PlayerName}  好吧，这真是前所未见，而且看起来还挺壮观的。所有人工智能似乎现在都互相憎恨，但我们能利用这一点并活下来吗？即使只是想到被人工智能主力舰队的交火波及也让我夜不能寐……

column1: From: Dr. Yuanna Pinehill Neinzul Research Department - Home Command  To: Commander {PlayerName}  Commander,   A Neinzul Worker ship on {PlanetName} has started to decay. Our scientists believe this to be due to its inability to leave the planet, for one reason or another. Should it be unable to escape for much longer, it will soon trigger a defensive response from all Wild Hives on the planet.
column2: 发件人：尤安娜·派恩希尔博士 宁苏研究部 - 指挥部  致：指挥官 {PlayerName}  指挥官，  {PlanetName} 上的一个宁苏工人单位已经开始衰败。我们的科学家认为这是由于某种原因无法离开该行星。如果它在更长的时间内无法逃脱，它将很快触发该行星上所有野生蜂巢的防御响应。

column1: From: Dr. Yuanna Pinehill Neinzul Research Department - Home Command  To: Commander {PlayerName}  Commander,   By one reason or another, we now have access to a Wild Hive on {PlanetName}.  While our local ships and structure are still reporting degradation in their abilities, our command station seems to at least somewhat offset the effect for now. The station commander does note his worry about how well they will be able to perform if more Metal Generators were to be infected, however.  Our scientists, giddy to finally be able to study them further in depth, are in various states of excitement. Their initial findings confirm most of what we already know, but more interestingly there appears to be an odd mutation that they have not yet seen before. A number of the small Neinzul appear to be using powerful sensors of their own on our scientists in kind, and they are hopeful.  Curiously, one of our scientists notice that they are no longer broadcasting on a wavelength that the believe is used to detect hostile Hives. They theorize that the Wild Hives weren't naturally hostile to each other, and this was a countermeasure put in place by the AI to stop them from propagating out of control.
column2: 发件人：尤安娜·派恩希尔博士 宁苏研究部 - 指挥部  致：指挥官 {PlayerName}  指挥官，  出于某种原因，我们现在可以访问 {PlanetName} 上的一个野生蜂巢。  虽然我们当地的单位和建筑仍然报告能力的下降，但我们的指挥站似乎至少在某种程度上抵消了这种效果。不过，空间站指挥官注意到他担心如果更多的金属发生器被感染，他们将能发挥出多好的性能。  我们的科学家们兴奋不已，终于能够深入研究它们了，他们处于各种兴奋状态。他们的初步发现证实了我们已知的大部分情况，但更有趣的是，似乎有一种他们以前从未见过的奇怪变异。一些小型宁苏似乎也在使用强大的传感器反过来研究我们的科学家，这让科学家们充满了希望。  奇怪的是，我们的一位科学家注意到它们不再使用他们认为用于探测敌对蜂巢的波长进行广播。他们的理论是野生蜂巢并不天然地对彼此敌对，这是人工智能为了防止它们失控扩散而设置的反制措施。

column1: From: Dr. Yuanna Pinehill Neinzul Research Department - Home Command  To: Commander {PlayerName}  Commander,   For a while now one of the Migrant Neinzul has made itself at home on our planets, even assisting in some small scale fighting. However, it appears to have opened another wormhole to leave this galaxy, and has already made its way through.  Before it left however, two things of great note occurred. The most practical thing we noticed was it left a structure behind that our scientists have dubbed a 'Neinzul Chamber'. From what we can tell, a brand new type of Neinzul is currently being created within, and they urge us to protect it as best we can.  The other thing of note was the message it left behind. Due to its relatively short stay on our planets, we were unable to perfect our understanding of its language, but the intent was received.  Message: We thank you creatures of bone. Though we... your uses of me... required. We will re... and bring more of our kind with us. Please ke... safe.
column2: 发件人：尤安娜·派恩希尔博士 宁苏研究部 - 指挥部  致：指挥官 {PlayerName}  指挥官，  有一段时间，一个移民宁苏在我们的行星上安了家，甚至协助了一些小规模战斗。然而，它似乎打开了另一个虫洞要离开这个银河系，并且已经穿了过去。  但在它离开之前，发生了两件非常重要的事情。我们注意到最实际的事情是它留下了一个结构，我们的科学家称之为"宁苏房间"。据我们所知，一种全新的宁苏正在里面被创造，他们敦促我们尽可能保护它。  另一件值得注意的事情是它留下的信息。由于它在我们的行星上停留时间相对较短，我们无法完善对其语言的理解，但意图是清楚的。  信息：我们感谢你们这些骨之生灵。尽管我们……你们对我的使用……是必需的。我们将返……并带着更多我们的同类回来。请保……安全。

column1: From: Dr. Yuanna Pinehill Neinzul Research Department - Home Command  To: Commander {PlayerName}  Commander,   One of the longer lived Neinzul ships has left its home hive space and begun moving towards our forces. It seems to be beelining for a singular ship, and the transmissions we have been able to translate from it seem to imply that it is unwilling to be parted from it, and is exerting what we believe to be a desire to protect. More interestingly, it looks like this 'Clanling' as some of our people have been calling them are capable of creating Younglings of their own to assist in combat.
column2: 发件人：尤安娜·派恩希尔博士 宁苏研究部 - 指挥部  致：指挥官 {PlayerName}  指挥官，  一个寿命较长的宁苏单位离开了它的巢穴空间并开始向我们的部队移动。它似乎径直朝着一个单位飞去，我们能翻译的来自它的传输似乎表明它不愿与之分离，并且表现出我们认为的想要保护的意愿。更有趣的是，看起来这个我们一些人称之为"族人"的单位能够制造自己的幼崽来协助战斗。

column1: From: Dr. Yuanna Pinehill Neinzul Research Department - Home Command  To: Commander {PlayerName}  Commander,   One of the longer lived Neinzul ships has started following one of our fleet leaders around. It seems unwilling to be parted from it, and is exerting what we believe to be a desire to protect. More interestingly, it looks like this 'Clanling' as some of our people have been calling them are capable of creating Younglings of their own to assist in combat.
column2: 发件人：尤安娜·派恩希尔博士 宁苏研究部 - 指挥部  致：指挥官 {PlayerName}  指挥官，  一个寿命较长的宁苏单位开始跟随我们的一个舰队领袖四处移动。它似乎不愿与其分离，并表现出我们认为的想要保护的意愿。更有趣的是，看起来这个我们一些人称之为"族人"的单位能够制造自己的幼崽来协助战斗。

column1: From: Dr. Yuanna Pinehill Neinzul Research Department - Home Command  To: Commander {PlayerName}  Commander,   The familiar Roaming Enclave has safely arrived into our territory.  It seems, as best as our scientists can tell, happy to be back. While its young Clanling charges are still sticking close, many of our ships and structures on the planet are detecting incoming scans from the smaller ships.  It looks like the Enclave is preparing to leave again, due to the detected power sources rising once more, but it seems to be... preparing its young charges for its leave, almost pushing them towards our ships to get them attached.      Translation: These are the boned ones, the... the Bone Nest. Stick near... aid them, for they... flourishing after the great collapse.
column2: 发件人：尤安娜·派恩希尔博士 宁苏研究部 - 指挥部  致：指挥官 {PlayerName}  指挥官，  那个熟悉的游荡飞地已安全抵达我们的领土。  据我们的科学家所说，它似乎很高兴回来。虽然它年轻的族人护卫仍然紧贴着它，我们在行星上的许多单位和建筑都检测到来自小单位的扫描信号。  看起来飞地正准备再次离开，因为检测到的能量源再次上升，但它似乎在……为离开准备它的年轻护卫，几乎是将它们推向我们的单位以建立联系。  翻译：这些是骨之生灵，是……骨之巢。靠近它们……帮助它们，因为它们……在大崩溃后繁荣。

column1: From: Dr. Yuanna Pinehill Neinzul Research Department - Home Command  To: Commander {PlayerName}  Commander,   We are sad to report that the Migrant we had recognized had once again left our galaxy. Many of our people were growing accustom to the many tricks they could be seen doing while in peaceful space.  It is not without good reason, however. While it did indeed bring some of its Clanlings along with it this time, it reports it has many more that it needed to assist in braving warp space. It truly believes we're one of the safe havens of the universe, and deems the traversal there and back worth it. We must continue to improve our own standing to prove ourselves worthy of its trust.  Especially if the rumors abound of the AI's ever increasing pressure on them is to be believed.
column2: 发件人：尤安娜·派恩希尔博士 宁苏研究部 - 指挥部  致：指挥官 {PlayerName}  指挥官，  我们遗憾地报告，我们认识的那个移民者再次离开了我们的银河系。我们许多人都已经习惯了它们在和平空间中能看到的各种把戏。  然而，这是有充分理由的。虽然这次它确实带来了一些族人，但它报告说还有更多族人需要它帮助穿越跃迁空间。它真正相信我们是宇宙的安全港之一，并认为往返旅程是值得的。我们必须继续提升自己的地位，以证明我们值得它的信任。  尤其是如果关于人工智能对它们不断增加压力的传言属实的话。

column1: From: Dr. Yuanna Pinehill Neinzul Research Department - Home Command  To: Commander {PlayerName}  Commander,   We've learned of a most curious development. It appears that the 'Wild Hives' are not as unified as they appear. Upon closer examination, there are actually several different subspecies of Wild Hive, with each subspecies or 'faction' having distinct features and markings. What is interesting to note here is that when two or more different factions meet on a planet's gravity well, they will attempt to contest the territory, fighting each other.  The reason we are notifying you is because this contested territory is causing the Wild Hive factions to lash out. While they were previously a 'don't bother us and we won't bother you' type of deal, now they are aggressively attacking anything and everything. This can be quite the wildcard. They may end up destroying AI forces for us, or we could end up in the crossfire ourselves. Should one faction achieve dominance over the contested territory, it should return to the 'Be and let be' behavior.   Your Military Advisor has noted that this is a 'prime opportunity to wipe those bugs out', and they're not wrong. While they're busy shooting one another, we can swoop in when one side is about to achieve dominance to mop them all up and sterilize any infestations. Your Science Advisor however suggests either letting it play out to avoid risking unnecessary losses, or helping out one side to end this free for all brawl. The choice is yours to make Commander.
column2: 发件人：尤安娜·派恩希尔博士 宁苏研究部 - 指挥部  致：指挥官 {PlayerName}  指挥官，  我们了解到了一个最有趣的发展。看来"野生蜂巢"并不像它们看起来那样统一。经过更仔细的检查，实际上有几种不同的野生蜂巢亚种，每个亚种或"派系"都有独特的特征和标记。值得注意的是，当两个或更多不同的派系在一个行星的引力井相遇时，它们会试图争夺领土，相互战斗。  我们通知你的原因是这种争夺中的领土正在导致野生蜂巢派系猛烈攻击。虽然它们之前是一种"你不惹我我就不惹你"的交易，现在它们正在侵略性地攻击一切事物。这可能会是一张相当难以预料的牌。它们可能最终为我们摧毁人工智能部队，或者我们自己可能被卷入交火。如果一个派系在争夺中的领土取得统治地位，它应该会恢复到"和平共处"的行为。  你的军事顾问指出这是"彻底消灭那些虫子的绝佳机会"，她说得没错。当它们忙着互相射击时，我们可以在一方即将取得统治地位时突袭，将它们全部清理并清除所有侵扰。然而，你的科学顾问建议要么静观其变以避免不必要的损失，要么帮助一方结束这场混战。选择权在你，指挥官。

column1: From: Dr. Yuanna Pinehill Neinzul Research Department - Home Command  To: Commander {PlayerName}  Commander,  A Roaming Enclave has managed to safely arrive in our territory.  Once it arrived and seemed to realize it was no longer being fired at, it began slowly moving around the planet, almost as though its looking for something...  Our scientists have been preparing for this for a long time now, and they were not disappointed. The moment that the Roaming Enclave arrived, scanners picked up huge energy reading within it.  As best we can tell, there are two large power sources within the Roaming Enclave, one situated towards the center of the ship, and another towards its engines.  We have managed to translate even more of its language, but it is still quite rough.  Translation: Curious, the m... warted by the cr... erhaps. Yes, ye... a good nest indeed.
column2: 发件人：尤安娜·派恩希尔博士 宁苏研究部 - 指挥部  致：指挥官 {PlayerName}  指挥官，  一个游荡飞地已安全抵达我们的领土。  当它抵达并似乎意识到自己不再被攻击时，它开始慢慢地绕着行星移动，几乎好像是在寻找什么东西……  我们的科学家为此准备了很长时间，他们没有失望。游荡飞地抵达的那一刻，扫描仪就探测到了其内部巨大的能量读数。  据我们所知，游荡飞地内有两个大型能量源，一个位于单位中心附近，另一个靠近其引擎。  我们已经翻译了更多它的语言，但仍然相当粗糙。  翻译：好奇，金属……被……守护。也许，是的……确实是个好巢穴。

column1: From: Dr. Yuanna Pinehill Neinzul Research Department - Home Command  To: Commander {PlayerName}  Commander,  One of the Wild Hives in the galaxy have been attacked, and have responded in force. A number of Clanlings, dubbed 'Soldiers,' have emerged from the Hive and have been engaging their aggressors.  Interestingly, our scientists have noticed that while in this aggravated state, their normal targeting scramblers that prevent most ships from attacking them go haywire, and even the smallest of strikecraft are now able to attack them. While this does not affect our ability to direct our forces' ability to manually target them, this may create openings for other factions to punch a hole in their power on the planet.  Lastly, it looks as though swarms of smaller repair ships, too small for our scanners to accurately detect, are waiting to repair the damages dealt to the Hive. Based on the quantity of them near the hive, our scientists believe them to be capable of rapid repair when given the chance.
column2: 发件人：尤安娜·派恩希尔博士 宁苏研究部 - 指挥部  致：指挥官 {PlayerName}  指挥官，  银河系中的一个野生蜂巢遭到了攻击，并进行了强力反击。一些被称为"士兵"的族人从蜂巢中出现，并与它们的侵略者交战。  有趣的是，我们的科学家注意到，在这种被激怒的状态下，它们通常阻止大多数单位攻击它们的瞄准干扰器会失灵，即使是最小的战机现在也能够攻击它们。虽然这不影响我们指挥部队手动瞄准它们的能力，但这可能为其他派系在其行星上打开突破口。  最后，大量太小的修理单位（我们的扫描仪无法准确探测）正在等待修复蜂巢所受到的损害。基于蜂巢附近的数量，我们的科学家相信它们有能力在有机会时进行快速修复。

column1: From: Dr. Yuanna Pinehill Neinzul Research Department - Home Command  To: Commander {PlayerName}  Commander,  We have confirmed the signal's origin, and it is more assuredly a Migrant we have seen before. They had kept their word, and appear to be enroute to our territory post haste. More excitingly, it looks to have brought along some ships of middle size.  Our recently established Neinzul Culture division notes that these may be more of what they have labeled 'Clanlings', and that there is a much more uplifting tone in its message. They are looking forward to interacting with Clanlings that were not born of our galaxy.  Message: We return, creatures of bone! We are most pleased to detect your ever... fortitude in these times of great strife and... migration into your voidlands.  Considering its smaller charges, our Culture heads are strongly suggesting we send assistance to guarantee their arrival.
column2: 发件人：尤安娜·派恩希尔博士 宁苏研究部 - 指挥部  致：指挥官 {PlayerName}  指挥官，  我们已经确认了信号的来源，确实是我们以前见过的一个移民者。他们遵守了诺言，似乎正在全速前往我们的领土。更令人兴奋的是，看起来它带来了一些中型单位。  我们最近成立的宁苏文化部门指出，这些可能更多是他们称为"族人"的单位，而它的信息中有一种更加振奋人心的语调。他们期待着与并非诞生于我们银河系的族人互动。  信息：我们回来了，骨之生灵！我们非常高兴地探测到你们在如此巨大战乱和……向你们虚空之地迁移中的永恒……坚韧。  考虑到它的较小护卫，我们的文化负责人强烈建议我们派遣援助以确保他们的到达。

column1: From: Dr. Yuanna Pinehill Neinzul Research Department - Home Command  To: Commander {PlayerName}  Commander,  We have wonderful news! Our scientists believe that one of the Migrants that had previously made contact with us is returning. The signal emanating from the wormhole matches one of our prior recordings in tone. More excitingly, it looks like it is bringing more than just Younglings with it this time.  It is broadcasting what appears to be a description of its destination in our previously decrypted channel, and said destination appears to be on one of our planets! Its safe to assume it knows how to reach us and will make its way upon arrival, but it may still be worth sending an escort to assist.
column2: 发件人：尤安娜·派恩希尔博士 宁苏研究部 - 指挥部  致：指挥官 {PlayerName}  指挥官，  我们有好消息！我们的科学家相信，之前与我们联系过的一个移民者正在返回。虫洞发出的信号与我们之前录制的一个信号音调相符。更令人兴奋的是，看起来这次它带来的不仅仅是幼崽。  它正在用我们之前解密的频道广播一个似乎是目的地描述的信息，而该目的地似乎在我们的一个行星上！可以安全地认为它知道如何到达我们这里，并会在抵达后前往，但派遣护航队协助可能仍然是值得的。

column1: From: Dr. Yuri Hamil Zenith Research Department - Home Command  To: Commander {PlayerName}  Commander,   After more time analyzing this Architrave, it looks like we may be able to communicate with them via Hacking. There is a Portal on {PlanetName} that seems to be how they are maintaining presence in our galaxy.  While it doesn't look like we can destroy the portal, perhaps we could communicate with it? Having some sort of temporary truce might be worth the battle it would take to achieve the truce.  Since the ZA will get more and more powerful the longer their planets are under attack, it would be easiest to strike when they are at peace, since this will be a long fight.
column2: 发件人：尤里·哈米尔博士 天顶研究部 - 指挥部  致：指挥官 {PlayerName}  指挥官，  在花更多时间分析这个额枋之后，看起来我们也许可以通过入侵与它们通信。{PlanetName} 上有一个传送门，似乎是它们维持在银河系中存在的途径。  虽然看起来我们无法摧毁这个传送门，但也许我们可以与它通信？某种临时休战可能值得为实现休战而进行的战斗。  由于 ZA 的行星受到攻击的时间越长，它们会变得越强大，最容打击它们的时候是在它们处于和平状态时，因为这将是一场漫长的战斗。

column1: From: Dr. Yuri Hamil Zenith Research Department - Home Command  To: Commander {PlayerName}  Commander,   It looks like the Zenith Architraves have started a major local war. Seems like they have stopped caring about the AI and are just trying to attack each other.  Perhaps one of them has gotten too strong and the others are allying against them. Regardless of the cause, we should try to keep out of their way.
column2: 发件人：尤里·哈米尔博士 天顶研究部 - 指挥部  致：指挥官 {PlayerName}  指挥官，  看起来天顶额枋们已经开始了一场重大的本地战争。似乎它们已经不再关心人工智能，而只是试图互相攻击。  也许是其中一个变得太强大了，其他几个联合起来对付它。无论原因如何，我们应该尽量远离它们。

column1: From: Dr. Yuri Hamil Zenith Research Department - Home Command  To: Commander {PlayerName}  Commander,   It seems that our Dark Zenith allies have had enough of the AI command stations impairing their production capacity. They've decided to take matters into their own giant appendages and start claiming territory from the AI. While we're glad that our allies are powerful enough to start making real offensive efforts against the AI, the AI doesn't seem inclined to limit retaliation to just our allies. If we're not ready to see this war to its end, we should get ready to do so. Quickly.
column2: 发件人：尤里·哈米尔博士 天顶研究部 - 指挥部  致：指挥官 {PlayerName}  指挥官，  看来我们的黑暗天顶盟友已经受够了人工智能指挥站削弱它们生产能力的状况。他们决定自己动手，开始从人工智能手中夺取领土。虽然我们很高兴我们的盟友足够强大，能够开始对人工智能进行真正的进攻努力，但人工智能似乎并不打算将报复仅限于我们的盟友。如果我们还没准备好将这场战争进行到底，我们应该赶紧做好准备。

column1: From: Dr. Yuri Hamil Zenith Research Department - Home Command  To: Commander {PlayerName}  Commander,   We're getting some new energy signatures from this {FactionColor}Zenith Architrave</color>. Looks like some major new ships called Pioneers.  While the Architrave ordinarily seems content to just hold their home Territory around their Portal, it looks like sometimes they gather enough energy to try to expand their control. Hopefully once the Pioneers are dealt with, they'll go back to quiescence. Attacking their newly conquered planets will hopefully provoke less of a response than attacking their home Territory.
column2: 发件人：尤里·哈米尔博士 天顶研究部 - 指挥部  致：指挥官 {PlayerName}  指挥官，  我们从 {FactionColor}天顶额枋</color> 获取到一些新的能量信号。看起来是一些叫做先驱者的重要新单位。  虽然额枋通常似乎满足于仅保持其传送门周围的母星领土，但看起来有时它们会聚集足够的能量来尝试扩张。希望一旦先驱者被处理掉，它们会恢复平静。攻击它们新征服的行星有望比攻击它们的母星领土引起的反应要小。

column1: From: Dr. Yuri Hamil Zenith Research Department - Home Command  To: Commander {PlayerName}  Commander,   We've just discovered a terrifying new {FactionColor}Dark Zenith</color> ship. Our ever-creative scientists have deemed it the Jormugandr. We thought the golems were the worst threat the Dark Zenith were capable of creating, but it seems we underestimated them.  This ship is almost unmatched in its power, but that power comes at a cost. The ship seems to require auxiliary power from the Zenith 'homeworlds' in our universe. If these homeworlds are attacked, the Jormugandr will leave the homeworlds to counterattack any factions foolish enough to get in its way. Thankfully, this rampage is temporary, and they will retreat back to the homeworlds once their energy stores reach a critical level.
column2: 发件人：尤里·哈米尔博士 天顶研究部 - 指挥部  致：指挥官 {PlayerName}  指挥官，  我们刚刚发现了一艘可怕的 {FactionColor}黑暗天顶</color> 新单位。我们创意无限的科学家将其命名为约尔穆刚德。我们原以为傀儡是黑暗天顶能够创造的最可怕的威胁，但看来我们低估了他们。  这个单位的力量几乎无与伦比，但这种力量是有代价的。这个单位似乎需要来自我们宇宙中天顶"母星"的辅助能量。如果这些母星受到攻击，约尔穆刚德将离开母星去反击任何愚蠢到阻挡它的派系。幸运的是，这种狂暴是暂时的，一旦其能量储备达到临界水平，它们将撤退回母星。

column1: From: Dr. Yuri Hamil Zenith Research Department - Home Command  To: Commander {PlayerName}  Commander,  As you're aware, the AI command stations have a distinctive radiation signature to them. We've just noticed that signature dissipate from a system near the Dark Zenith presence. Our scientists believe that the Dark Zenith have started directly attacking AI strongholds. While we're glad to have the AI focus on a new threat, it does seem to react to threats with an increasing allocation of resources. Given that we're also fighting the AI, those 'resources' might become problematic for us as well.    If the Dark Zenith are claiming systems for their own, we must assume that they won't stop with the AI. I strongly recommend building defenses before the Dark Zenith reach our territory. Strong defenses.
column2: 发件人：尤里·哈米尔博士 天顶研究部 - 指挥部  致：指挥官 {PlayerName}  指挥官，  如你所知，人工智能指挥站具有独特辐射信号。我们刚刚注意到从黑暗天顶存在附近的一个星系中该信号消失了。我们的科学家认为黑暗天顶已经开始直接攻击人工智能据点。虽然我们很高兴有人工智能关注一个新威胁，但人工智能似乎会以增加的资源分配来应对威胁。考虑到我们也在与人工智能作战，那些"资源"对我们来说也可能成为问题。  如果黑暗天顶在为自己夺取星系，我们必须假设他们不会止步于人工智能。我强烈建议在黑暗天顶到达我们的领土之前建立防御。强大的防御。

column1: From: Dr. Yuri Hamil Zenith Research Department - Home Command  To: Commander {PlayerName}  Commander,  Our scientists have done an analysis of the {FactionColor}Dark Zenith</color> economy.   They use a variety of resources to build their units. To create these resources, they use a series of Terminii. Each resource is associated with one type of Terminus. The base of their economy is a string of Octiron Terminii that harvest the metal. To create more advanced resources they use Transports to move resources around. They have three lower-tier resources (Thaumite, Chelonium, and Alkahest) which are created by manipulating Octiron. Then two advanced resources, (Izumite and Scrith) which are made from the other resources.  They can then use these resources to build mobile forces and constructor units at their Epistyles. With enough resources, these Epistyles can construct a wide variety of new structures and defenses, as well as a very wide variety of powerful ships.  The Dark Zenith ships range from small fleetships to some truly terrifying Golems like the Ymir. As if the base forms weren't terrifying enough, they will sometimes infuse their ships with extra resources. This exotic infusion allows their ships to have additional abilities beyond the norm. Each type of resource infusion imparts different attributes: Thaumite: Stout ships; these ships are more durable. Chelonium: Fortified ships; these ships have an additional defensive system. Alkahest: Spirited Ships, these are cloaked and faster.  Izumite: Enraged; these ships have an additional weapon to take on single, strong adversaries. Skrith: Sinister; these ships have an additional weapon for crowd control.
column2: 发件人：尤里·哈米尔博士 天顶研究部 - 指挥部  致：指挥官 {PlayerName}  指挥官，  我们的科学家对 {FactionColor}黑暗天顶</color> 的经济进行了分析。  他们使用各种资源来建造他们的单位。为了创造这些资源，他们使用一系列终端。每种资源与一种终端相关联。他们经济的基础是一连串开采金属的奥克提隆终端。  为了创造更高级的资源，他们使用运输船来运输资源。他们有三种低层资源（萨乌迈特、凯隆尼姆和阿尔卡赫斯特），通过操纵奥克提隆产生。然后有两种高级资源（伊祖迈特和斯克瑞斯），由其他资源制成。  然后他们可以使用这些资源在柱顶建造移动部队和建造者单位。有了足够的资源，这些柱顶可以建造各种各样的新建筑和防御设施，以及非常多类型的强大单位。  黑暗天顶的单位范围从小型舰队单位到一些真正可怕的傀儡，如伊米尔。仿佛基础形态还不够可怕，他们有时会用额外资源注入他们的单位。这种异域注入使他们的单位具有超出常规的额外能力。 每种类型的资源注入赋予不同的属性： 萨乌迈特：坚固单位；这些单位更耐久。 凯隆尼姆：强化单位；这些单位有额外的防御系统。 阿尔卡赫斯特：灵动单位；这些是隐形的，速度更快。 伊祖迈特：狂怒；这些单位有额外的武器来对付单个强敌。 斯克瑞斯：阴险；这些单位有额外的武器用于群体控制。

column1: From: Dr. Yuri Hamil Zenith Research Department - Home Command  To: Commander {PlayerName}  Commander,  We've found derelict golems in the galaxy, and even figured out how to get them moving again, but we've never figured out how to build something with that much power behind it. We still haven't.    Fortunately, our Dark Zenith allies don't have that problem. They've just built a new golem. Apparently, the Zenith-modified metals are the key ingredient that our engineers couldn't reproduce. We still can't, but if we can hold enough territory, I don't think they're going to stop building golems any time soon. Something tells me the AI's not going to like trying to attack systems defended by Dark Zenith golems. Now that they've had enough time to build up, they may just turn the tide against the relentless AI onslaught.
column2: 发件人：尤里·哈米尔博士 天顶研究部 - 指挥部  致：指挥官 {PlayerName}  指挥官，  我们在银河系中发现了废弃的傀儡，甚至想出了如何让它们重新动起来，但我们从未想出如何建造具有如此强大力量的东西。我们仍然没有。  幸运的是，我们的黑暗天顶盟友没有这个问题。他们刚刚建造了一个新的傀儡。显然，天顶改良的金属是我们的工程师无法复制的关键成分。我们仍然不能，但我认为如果他们能守住足够多的领土，他们不会很快停止建造傀儡。我有种感觉，人工智能不会喜欢尝试攻击由黑暗天顶傀儡防守的星系。既然他们有足够的时间来建设，他们可能能够扭转对抗人工智能无情猛攻的战局。

column1: From: Economy Advisor Frank Johnson Fleet Command - Home Command  To: Commander {PlayerName}  Commander,   It looks like we are running low on metal!  There are 2 easy ways of increasing metal production. The first is to upgrade home command station via the Fleets menu. The second is to upgrade Metal Generation via the Tech menu. Finally you can always capture more planets and build Economic or Logistical command stations there.
column2: 发件人：经济顾问弗兰克·约翰逊 舰队指挥部 - 指挥部  致：指挥官 {PlayerName}  指挥官，  我们的金属似乎快要耗尽了！  有两种简单的方法可以提高金属产量。第一种是通过舰队菜单升级主指挥站。第二种是通过科技菜单升级金属生成。最后，你还可以占领更多行星并在那里建造经济或后勤指挥站。

column1: From: Entelemaren Exaron  To: Commander {PlayerName}  {FactionColor} Enselle-illumin, child of Terra. May we both survive. Still hampered. Bad oscillations. Perhaps the stories... No matter. We must work with what we have. Another Relic. Stronger Cities. But indebted to you. You say fight, we fight. You say stay, we stay. The machine. Not yet fully (translation failed, best guess: 'Awake'). </color>  From: Dr. Leszek Bednorz Spire Research and Communication Department - Home Command  To: Commander {PlayerName}  Commander,   These stronger Spire cities are allowing them to create some devastating weapons. These Battleships are marvels of engineering, and give us a real chance against the AI.
column2: 发件人：恩特尔玛伦·埃克萨隆  致：指挥官 {PlayerName}  {FactionColor} 恩塞尔-伊鲁明，大地之子。愿我们都能幸存。 仍然受阻。糟糕的振荡。也许那些故事…… 没关系。我们必须用现有资源工作。 另一个遗物。更强的城市。 但受恩于你。你说打，我们就打。你说留，我们就留。机器。还未完全（翻译失败，最佳猜测：'觉醒'）。 </color>  发件人：莱谢克·贝德诺兹博士 尖塔研究与通信部 - 指挥部  致：指挥官 {PlayerName}  指挥官，  这些更强的尖塔城市使他们能够创造一些毁灭性的武器。这些战列舰是工程学的奇迹，给了我们对抗人工智能的真正机会。

column1: From: Entelemaren Exaron  To: Commander {PlayerName}  {FactionColor} Enselle-immumin, child of Terra. Your (translator-failure: nearest word 'princess') of Xenobiology. Has labored. Improving communications. Our gratitude. Undying. One day. Perhaps. Debt repaid. Cannot face machines. Yet. They come. You know this. They come. For us both. Need expand. More. Cannot build. Here. Have found another. Can build with that. We. At your service. </color>  From: Dr. Leszek Bednorz Spire Research and Communication Department - Home Command  To: Commander {PlayerName}  Commander,  While basic communication has been possible since very early on, it has been... difficult. While the previous messages from the Spire may seem appropriate for the mannerisms of a rock, I have found that they actually have a much smoother thought process and manner of speaking to one another. I hope that my efforts will continue to improve the... rapport.  In any event, they have successfully located another Relic which they believe will power another city. This recovery mission is likely to be extremely dangerous, and the AI continues to attack, but hopefully the growing Spire fleet will offset these additional challenges.  But remember, the AI is after us both now. We have learned to hide from the AI, to avoid antagonizing it and bringing down its wrath. The Spire do not seem to have learned this lesson. They are obedient to our desires to not unnecessarily provoke the AI, but I do not believe that we can both continue to assist the Spire expansion while maintaining a low profile.  I do not have to tell you how absurdly dangerous that could be.
column2: 发件人：恩特尔玛伦·埃克萨隆  致：指挥官 {PlayerName}  {FactionColor} 恩塞尔-伊缪敏，大地之子。你的（翻译失败：最近似词'公主'）外星生物学。辛勤工作。改善通信。 我们的感激。不朽。总有一天。或许。债务偿还。 无法面对机器。还不行。 它们来了。你知道的。它们来了。为了我们两个。 需要扩张。更多。 无法建造。在这里。 已找到另一个。可以用那个建造。 我们。听候你的差遣。 </color>  发件人：莱谢克·贝德诺兹博士 尖塔研究与通信部 - 指挥部  致：指挥官 {PlayerName}  指挥官，  虽然基本通信从一开始就成为可能，但这一直……很困难。虽然尖塔之前的信息可能看起来适合一块石头的举止，但我发现他们实际上有着更流畅的思维过程和相互交谈的方式。希望我的努力能继续改善……融洽关系。  无论如何，他们成功找到了另一个遗物，他们认为这将为另一座城市提供能量。这次回收任务可能极其危险，人工智能继续攻击，但希望不断壮大的尖塔舰队能抵消这些额外的挑战。  但请记住，人工智能现在在追捕我们两个。我们学会了如何躲避人工智能，避免激怒它并招致它的愤怒。尖塔似乎没有学到这一课。他们听从我们不必要地挑衅人工智能的意愿，但我不认为我们可以在继续协助尖塔扩张的同时保持低调。  我不必告诉你这可能是多么荒谬地危险。

column1: From: Entelemaren Exaron  To: Commander {PlayerName}  {FactionColor} Gratitude. Have Grown. Can Fight. Little. Must Grow. More. Menace. Is Coming. Apologies. Restitution. </color>  From: Dr. Leszek Bednorz Spire Research and Communication Department - Home Command  To: Commander {PlayerName}  Commander,  Now that the city on {PlanetName} has begun to draw on the resonance energy of the other cities, it has begun to grow again. They have constructed some advanced subspace scanning equipment within the Hub, and are looking for... from what I could understand, another Relic. I'm not certain, but I believe they have found that our galaxy's background radiation is interfering with their ability to construct new cities. They can build what they need for facilities and ships, but they can't actually construct the kind of power source needed by another city hub without a new Relic.  Which, incidentally, is exactly what they want to build next.  To be clear, they aren't demanding anything. We can simply go about our business and forget about pursuing these signals. And if we intend to stop, now would be a good time. The AI's aggressions against the Spire are significant, but have stabilized somewhat. If the Spire continue to grow, we may find ourselves in the middle of an all-out war.
column2: 发件人：恩特尔玛伦·埃克萨隆  致：指挥官 {PlayerName}  {FactionColor} 感激。 已经成长。 可以战斗。一点点。 必须成长。更多。 威胁。正在到来。 道歉。补偿。 </color>  发件人：莱谢克·贝德诺兹博士 尖塔研究与通信部 - 指挥部  致：指挥官 {PlayerName}  指挥官，  自从 {PlanetName} 上的城市开始汲取其他城市的共鸣能量以来，它又开始成长了。他们在枢纽内建造了一些先进的亚空间扫描设备，正在寻找……从我能理解的来看，另一个遗物。我不太确定，但我相信他们发现我们银河系的背景辐射正在干扰他们建造新城市的能力。他们可以建造设施和单位所需的东西，但他们没有新的遗物就无法实际建造另一个城市枢纽所需的那种能源。  顺便说一句，这正是他们接下来想建造的东西。  明确地说，他们并没有要求任何东西。我们可以继续我们的事务，忘记追踪这些信号。如果我们打算停下来，现在是个好时机。人工智能对尖塔的侵略是显著的，但已经有所稳定。如果尖塔继续成长，我们可能会发现自己陷入一场全面战争的漩涡。

column1: From: Entelemaren Exaron {FactionColor} Enselle-illumin, child of Terra. May we both survive. Still hampered. Bad oscillations. Perhaps the stories... No matter. We must work with what we have. Another Relic. Stronger Cities. But indebted to you. You say fight, we fight. You say stay, we stay. The machine. Not yet fully (translation failed, best guess: 'Awake'). </color> Commander, these stronger Spire cities are allowing them to create some devastating weapons. These Battleships are marvels of engineering, and give us a real chance against the AI.
column2: 来自：恩特勒马伦·埃克萨隆 {FactionColor} 恩塞尔-伊卢明，泰拉之子。愿我们都能幸存。 仍然受阻。糟糕的振荡。也许那些故事... 没关系。我们必须利用现有的东西。 另一个遗迹。更强大的城市。 但欠你的情。你说战斗，我们就战斗。你说留下，我们就留下。机器。还没有完全（翻译失败，最佳猜测：'苏醒'）。 </color> 指挥官，这些更强大的尖塔族城市使他们能够创造一些毁灭性的武器。这些战舰是工程学的奇迹，给了我们对抗人工智能的真正机会。

column1: From: Entelemaren Exaron {FactionColor} Enselle-immumin, child of Terra. Your (translator-failure: nearest word 'princess') of Xenobiology. Has labored. Improving communications. Our gratitude. Undying. One day. Perhaps. Debt repaid. Cannot face machines. Yet. They come. You know this. They come. For us both. Need expand. More. Cannot build. Here. Have found another. Can build with that. We. At your service. </color> While basic communication has been possible since very early on, it has been... difficult. While the previous messages from the Spire may seem appropriate for the mannerisms of a rock, I have found that they actually have a much smoother thought process and manner of speaking to one another. I hope that my efforts will continue to improve the... rapport.  In any event, they have successfully located another Relic which they believe will power another city. This recovery mission is likely to be extremely dangerous, and the AI continues to attack, but hopefully the growing Spire fleet will offset these additional challenges.  But remember, the AI is after us both now. We have learned to hide from the AI, to avoid antagonizing it and bringing down its wrath. The Spire do not seem to have learned this lesson. They are obedient to our desires to not unnecessarily provoke the AI, but I do not believe that we can both continue to assist the Spire expansion while maintaining a low profile.  I do not have to tell you how absurdly dangerous that could be.
column2: 来自：恩特勒马伦·埃克萨隆 {FactionColor} 恩塞尔-伊卢明，泰拉之子。你的（翻译失败：最接近的词'公主'）外星生物学。已经努力。改善交流。 我们的感激。永恒。有一天。也许。债务偿还。 无法面对机器。还没有。 他们来了。你知道的。他们来了。为了我们两个。 需要扩张。更多。 无法建造。在这里。 找到了另一个。可以用那个建造。 我们。听候差遣。 </color> 虽然基本交流从很早就成为可能，但一直...很困难。虽然尖塔族之前的信息可能看起来符合一块石头的行为方式，但我发现他们实际上有更流畅的思维过程和彼此交谈的方式。我希望我的努力将继续改善...融洽关系。  无论如何，他们已经成功定位了另一个遗迹，他们相信这将为另一个城市提供动力。这次回收任务可能极其危险，人工智能继续攻击，但希望不断壮大的尖塔族舰队将抵消这些额外的挑战。  但要记住，人工智能现在也在追捕我们两个。我们已经学会躲避人工智能，避免激怒它并招致它的愤怒。尖塔族似乎没有学到这一课。他们服从我们不必要地挑衅人工智能的愿望，但我相信我们不能在继续协助尖塔族扩张的同时保持低调。  我不必告诉你那可能有多么危险。

column1: From: Entelemaren Exaron {FactionColor} Gratitude. Have Grown. Can Fight. Little. Must Grow. More. Menace. Is Coming. Apologies. Restitution. </color> Now that the city on {PlanetName} has begun to draw on the resonance energy of the other cities, it has begun to grow again. They have constructed some advanced subspace scanning equipment within the Hub, and are looking for... from what I could understand, another Relic. I'm not certain, but I believe they have found that our galaxy's background radiation is interfering with their ability to construct new cities. They can build what they need for facilities and ships, but they can't actually construct the kind of power source needed by another city hub without a new Relic.  Which, incidentally, is exactly what they want to build next.  To be clear, they aren't demanding anything. We can simply go about our business and forget about pursuing these signals. And if we intend to stop, now would be a good time. The AI's aggressions against the Spire are significant, but have stabilized somewhat. If the Spire continue to grow, we may find ourselves in the middle of an all-out war.
