column1: From: GeorgeMurphy@Human-RnD.com To: RemnantCommander@Human-Command.com Subject: Devourer Chrysalis Form  Commander, our sensors are picking up the remains of the once great {FactionColor}{UnitTypeName}</color>. But it seems the thing isn't dead yet, apparently it's shifted into an alternate planet of existence and is rebuilding itself - better and stronger than ever before.  This may represent an opportunity to us. Our scientific and hacker staff would like to poke around in the Devourer's semi-dormant state. We may be able to analyze some of its technology, or influence its evolution.  Head of RnD George Murphy
column2: 发件人：GeorgeMurphy@Human-RnD.com 收件人：RemnantCommander@Human-Command.com 主题：吞噬者蛹形态  指挥官， 我们的传感器正在捕捉曾经强大的 {FactionColor}{UnitTypeName}</color> 的残骸。但这个东西似乎还没有死，它显然已经转移到了一个替代存在位面，正在重建自己——比以前更好、更强。  这或许对我们来说是一个机会。我们的科学和入侵员工希望趁吞噬者半休眠状态时进行探索。我们也许能够分析其部分技术，或影响其进化。  研发主管 George Murphy

column1: From: GeorgeMurphy@Human-RnD.com To: RemnantCommander@Human-Command.com Subject: {FactionColor}{UnitTypeName}</color> arrived  Commander, the AI has finished warping in its {FactionColor}{UnitTypeName}</color> and immediately the Devourer Golem has changed its behavior. It now views the AI as a neutral faction, and as its protocol dictates will attack all remaining enemies - including us. In addition the AI has also bestowed some of its technology upon the Devourer, increasing its tech level.  We should expect the Golem to target anyone not allied to the AI until the Antagonizer is destroyed, which should be a priority if the Devourer is indeed heading our way.  Head of RnD George Murphy
column2: 发件人：GeorgeMurphy@Human-RnD.com 收件人：RemnantCommander@Human-Command.com 主题：{FactionColor}{UnitTypeName}</color> 已抵达  指挥官， AI 已经完成了其 {FactionColor}{UnitTypeName}</color> 的曲速传送，吞噬者傀儡立即改变了行为。它现在将 AI 视为中立派系，并根据其协议，将攻击所有剩余敌人——包括我们在内。此外，AI 还将其部分技术赋予了吞噬者，提升了其技术等级。  我们应该预期傀儡会 targeting 任何不与 AI 结盟的人，直到对抗装置被摧毁，如果吞噬者确实在朝我们而来，这应该是优先事项。  研发主管 George Murphy

column1: From: GeorgeMurphy@Human-RnD.com To: RemnantCommander@Human-Command.com Subject: {FactionColor}{UnitTypeName}</color> arrived on {PlanetName}  Commander, after analyzing the beacon it seems to have fired some kind of emergency signal, and now we have detected one of the biggest Zenith entities ever entered into our database on {PlanetName}. It amounts to an entire planetoid, armed and ready to attack. For reasons we have yet to understand it seems to only target hostile ships, never structures, and feeds itself with the metal acquired. Its attack profile indicates an intelligence akin to an animal - focusing on the closest, biggest ball of attackable ships, but if outmatched and injured smart enough to retreat to another planet. Our hackers also suggest we may be able to communicate in some form or another.  Engaging this '{FactionColor}{UnitTypeName}</color>' in combat could be difficult. It's covered in some kind of living, self-regenerating reactionary armor that analyzes the ship types on a planet, even if cloaked, and when attacked matches the incoming shot to the ship design in question to morph the projected point of impact into a shape or structure to counter the shot and reduce all damage received by a staggering 90%. The only way we can think of to deal full damage would be to attack with ships that its scanners cannot fully analyze.  In addition the AI's warp grid is spiking whenever the Devourer is on AI planets. Given the size and strength of the Golem we can only assume the AI will attack with significant force. We should do our utmost not to be caught in the crossfire.  On the other hand, analyzing the remains of such a marvel of Zenith technology would certainly help our scientific efforts, and if the AI can weaken the Golem for us, even the better.  Finally, note that this is not a dead and reanimated Zenith like all the ones we've encountered before. It is a living and still evolving Golem that is just waiting for new data to modify itself into becoming stronger and stronger. We should assume that with any hack we do the Devourer also learns more about us, our technology, methods and tactics, and will use that knowledge to enhance itself.   After reviewing the data with our tactical officers we suggest the following:  -> Fighting the Devourer Golem without significant power will only cause great losses. We should avoid it. -> Big fleet balls of factions hostile to it will attract its attention, acting almost like a lure. -> If it's on our planets we should evacuate our ships, but since it won't attack our structures there's no need to fear for the safety of our command stations or stationary defenses. -> If we are on the same planet any flagship can initiate various hacks to manipulate the Devourer Golem's targeting. column2: 发件人：GeorgeMurphy@Human-RnD.com 收件人：RemnantCommander@Human-Command.com 主题：{FactionColor}{UnitTypeName}</color> 已抵达 {PlanetName}  指挥官， 分析信标后，它似乎发射了某种紧急信号，现在我们已在 {PlanetName} 上探测到有史以来录入我们数据库的最大 Zenith 实体之一。它相当于一整颗小行星，全副武装，随时准备攻击。 出于我们尚不了解的原因，它似乎只攻击敌对单位，从不攻击建筑，并以获取的金属为食。其攻击模式显示出类似动物的智能——专注于最近、最大的可攻击单位集群，但如果处于劣势并受伤，它会足够聪明地撤退到另一颗行星。我们的入侵者也表示，我们或许能够以某种形式与之沟通。  与此 '{FactionColor}{UnitTypeName}</color>' 交战可能会很困难。它覆盖着某种活的、自我再生的反应装甲，能够分析行星上的单位类型（即使处于隐形状态），当受到攻击时，它会将来袭的射击与相应的单位设计相匹配，从而改变预计的命中点形状或结构来反击射击，并将所有受到的伤害减少惊人的 90%。我们能想到造成全额伤害的唯一方法是使用其扫描仪无法完全分析的单位进行攻击。  此外，每当吞噬者出现在 AI 行星上时，AI 的曲速网格就会发生波动。考虑到这个傀儡的体型和力量，我们只能假设 AI 会以强大的力量进行攻击。我们应尽最大努力不被卷入交火之中。  另一方面，分析如此卓越的 Zenith 技术遗骸无疑将有助于我们的科研工作，如果 AI 能为我们削弱这个傀儡，那就更好了。  最后，请注意，这并非像我们之前遇到的所有那些已死亡并复活的 Zenith。它是一个活着的、仍在进化的傀儡，只是在等待新的数据来改造自己，变得愈发强大。我们应该假设，我们进行的每一次入侵行为，吞噬者也会更多地了解我们、我们的技术、方法和战术，并会利用这些知识来强化自身。  经过与我们的战术军官审查数据后，我们提出以下建议：  -> 在没有强大力量的情况下与吞噬者傀儡作战只会造成巨大损失。我们应该避免这样做。 -> 对其怀有敌意的派系的大型舰队集群会吸引它的注意，几乎就像诱饵一样。 -> 如果它在我们的行星上，我们应该撤离我们的单位，但由于它不会攻击我们的建筑，因此无需担心我们的指挥站或固定防御设施的安全。 -> 如果我们与它在同一行星上，任何旗舰都可以发起各种入侵来操纵吞噬者傀儡的 targeting。这通常需要消耗入侵点和金属，并可能导致吞噬者记住我们的所作所为。 -> 我们可以预期，如果吞噬者傀儡在 AI 领土停留太久，AI 会尝试攻击它。此后不久，它可能会变得脆弱易攻。  研发主管 George Murphy

column1: From: GeorgeMurphy@Human-RnD.com To: RemnantCommander@Human-Command.com Subject: {FactionColor}{UnitTypeName}</color> arrived on {PlanetName}  Commander, after analyzing the beacon it seems to have fired some kind of emergency signal, and now we have detected one of the biggest Zenith entities ever entered into our database {PlanetName}. It amounts to an entire planetoid, armed and ready to attack. And worse yet: It's allied to the AI. For reasons we have yet to understand it seems to only target hostile ships, never structures, and feeds itself with the metal acquired. Its attack profile indicates an intelligence akin to an animal - focusing on the closest, biggest ball of attackable ships, but if outmatched and injured smart enough to retreat to another planet. Our hackers also suggest we may be able to communicate in some form or another.  Engaging this '{FactionColor}{UnitTypeName}</color>' in combat could be difficult. It's covered in some kind of living, self-regenerating reactionary armor that analyzes the ship types on a planet, even if cloaked, and when attacked matches the incoming shot to the ship design in question to morph the projected point of impact into a shape or structure to counter the shot and reduce all damage received by a staggering 90%. The only way we can think of to deal full damage would be to attack with ships that its scanners cannot fully analyze.  On the other hand, analyzing the remains of such a marvel of Zenith technology would certainly help our scientific efforts.  Finally, note that this is not a dead and reanimated Zenith like all the ones we've encountered before. It is a living and still evolving Golem that is just waiting for new data to modify itself into becoming stronger and stronger. We should assume that with any hack we do the Devourer also learns more about us, our technology, methods and tactics, and will use that knowledge to enhance itself.   After reviewing the data with our tactical officers we suggest the following:  -> Fighting the Devourer Golem without significant power will only cause great losses. We should avoid it. -> Big fleet balls of factions hostile to it will attract its attention, acting almost like a lure. -> If it's on our planets we should evacuate our ships, but since it won't attack our structures there's no need to fear for the safety of our command stations or stationary defenses. -> If we are on the same planet any flagship can initiate various hacks to manipulate the Devourer Golem's targeting. This usually comes at the cost of Hacking Points and Metal, and may cause the Devourer to remember what we've done.  Head of RnD George Murphy

column2: 发件人：GeorgeMurphy@Human-RnD.com 收件人：RemnantCommander@Human-Command.com 主题：{FactionColor}{UnitTypeName}</color> 已抵达 {PlanetName}  指挥官， 分析信标后，它似乎发射了某种紧急信号，现在我们已在 {PlanetName} 上探测到有史以来录入我们数据库的最大 Zenith 实体。它相当于一整颗小行星，全副武装，随时准备攻击。 它几乎攻击一切，并以获取的金属为食。其攻击模式显示出类似动物的智能——专注于最近、最大的可攻击单位集群，但如果处于劣势并受伤，它会足够聪明地撤退到另一颗行星。我们的入侵者也表示，我们或许能够以某种形式与之沟通，如果这个东西靠近我们的行星之一，我们最好做好准备……  与此 '{FactionColor}{UnitTypeName}</color>' 交战几乎是不可能的。除了它本身已经极其强大之外，它还覆盖着某种活的、自我再生的反应装甲，能够分析行星上的单位类型（即使处于隐形状态），当受到攻击时，它会将来袭的射击与相应的单位设计相匹配，从而改变预计的命中点形状或结构来反击射击，并将所有受到的伤害减少惊人的 90%。我们能想到造成全额伤害的唯一方法是使用其扫描仪无法完全分析的单位进行攻击。  每当吞噬者出现在 AI 行星上时，AI 的曲速网格就会剧烈波动。考虑到这个傀儡的体型和力量，我们只能假设 AI 会以疯狂的力量进行攻击。我们应尽最大努力不被卷入交火之中。  另一方面，分析如此卓越的 Zenith 技术遗骸将极大地扩展我们的科学知识，如果 AI 能为我们削弱这个傀儡，那就更好了。  经过与我们的战术军官审查数据后，我们提出以下建议：  -> 在没有强大力量的情况下与吞噬者傀儡作战只会造成巨大损失。我们应该避免这样做。如果它来到我们的行星之一，我们应该发起入侵来转移它的注意力。 -> 对其怀有敌意的派系的大型舰队集群会吸引它的注意，几乎就像诱饵一样。 -> 如果我们与它在同一行星上，任何旗舰都可以发起各种入侵来操纵吞噬者傀儡的 targeting。这通常需要消耗入侵点和金属，并可能导致吞噬者记住我们的所作所为。 -> 我们可以预期，如果吞噬者傀儡在 AI 领土停留太久，AI 会尝试攻击它。此后不久，它可能会稍微变得脆弱易攻。  研发主管 George Murphy

column1: From: GeorgeMurphy@Human-RnD.com To: RemnantCommander@Human-Command.com Subject: {FactionColor}{UnitTypeName}</color> destroyed  Commander, the {FactionColor}{UnitTypeName}</color> has been destroyed, and the Devourer Golem seems angry. We can expect it to have a very specific hunger for the ships of the AI and its allies for the next few minutes which could potentially give us opportunities to attack alongside it. column2: 发件人：GeorgeMurphy@Human-RnD.com 收件人：RemnantCommander@Human-Command.com 主题：{FactionColor}{UnitTypeName}</color> 已被摧毁  指挥官， {FactionColor}{UnitTypeName}</color> 已被摧毁，吞噬者傀儡似乎很愤怒。我们可以预期它在接下来的几分钟内会对 AI 及其盟友的单位有非常特定的饥饿感，这可能为我们提供与其并肩作战的机会。有了如此强大——尽管是暂时的——盟友，即使是设防严密的系统也应成为轻松的目标。  研发主管 George Murphy

column1: From: GeorgeMurphy@Human-RnD.com To: RemnantCommander@Human-Command.com Subject: {FactionColor}{UnitTypeName}</color> detected on {PlanetName}  Commander, we have detected one of the biggest Zenith entities ever entered into our database on {PlanetName}. It amounts to an entire planetoid, armed and ready to attack. For reasons we have yet to understand it seems to only target hostile ships, never structures, and feeds itself with the metal acquired. Its attack profile indicates an intelligence akin to an animal - focusing on the closest, biggest ball of attackable ships, but if outmatched and injured smart enough to retreat to another planet. Our hackers also suggest we may be able to communicate in some form or another.  Engaging this '{FactionColor}{UnitTypeName}</color>' in combat could be difficult. It's covered in some kind of living, self-regenerating reactionary armor that analyzes the ship types on a planet, even if cloaked, and when attacked matches the incoming shot to the ship design in question to morph the projected point of impact into a shape or structure to counter the shot and reduce all damage received by a staggering 90%. The only way we can think of to deal full damage would be to attack with ships that its scanners cannot fully analyze.  In addition the AI's warp grid is spiking whenever the Devourer is on AI planets. Given the size and strength of the Golem we can only assume the AI will attack with significant force. We should do our utmost not to be caught in the crossfire.  On the other hand, analyzing the remains of such a marvel of Zenith technology would certainly help our scientific efforts, and if the AI can weaken the Golem for us, even the better.  Finally, note that this is not a dead and reanimated Zenith like all the ones we've encountered before. It is a living and still evolving Golem that is just waiting for new data to modify itself into becoming stronger and stronger. We should assume that with any hack we do the Devourer also learns more about us, our technology, methods and tactics, and will use that knowledge to enhance itself.   After reviewing the data with our tactical officers we suggest the following:  -> Fighting the Devourer Golem without significant power will only cause great losses. We should avoid it. -> Big fleet balls of factions hostile to it will attract its attention, acting almost like a lure. -> If it's on our planets we should evacuate our ships, but since it won't attack our structures there's no need to fear for the safety of our command stations or stationary defenses. -> If we are on the same planet any flagship can initiate various hacks to manipulate the Devourer Golem's targeting. This usually comes at the cost of Hacking Points and Metal, and may cause the Devourer to remember what we've done. -> We can expect the AI to try and attack the Devourer Golem if it's in AI territory for too long. Immediately afterwards it may be vulnerable to attack.  Head of RnD George Murphy

It amounts to an entire planetoid, armed and ready to attack. But it somehow seems to like us. It attacks almost anything and feeds itself with the metal acquired. Its attack profile indicates an intelligence akin to an animal - focusing on the closest, biggest ball of attackable ships, but if outmatched and injured smart enough to retreat to another planet. Our hackers also suggest we may be able to communicate in some form or another.  Our enemies will have a difficult time fighting this '{FactionColor}{UnitTypeName}</color>'. In addition to it already being incredibly powerful it's covered in some kind of living, self-regenerating reactionary armor that analyzes the ship types on a planet, even if cloaked, and when attacked matches the incoming shot to the ship design in question to morph the projected point of impact into a shape or structure to counter the shot and reduce all damage received by a staggering 90%. The only way we can think of to deal full damage would be to attack with ships that its scanners cannot fully analyze.  The AI's warp grid is going off the scale whenever the Devourer is on AI planets. Given the size and strength of the Golem we can only assume the AI will attack with an insane force. We should do our utmost not to be caught in the crossfire.   After reviewing the data with our tactical officers we suggest the following:  -> Big fleet balls of factions hostile to it will attract its attention, acting almost like a lure. -> If we are on the same planet any flagship can initiate various hacks to manipulate the Devourer Golem's targeting. This usually comes at the cost of Hacking Points and Metal, and may cause the Devourer to remember what we've done. -> We can expect the AI to try and attack the Devourer Golem if it's in AI territory for too long. Immediately afterwards it may be somewhat vulnerable to attack.  Head of RnD George Murphy
column2: 发件人：GeorgeMurphy@Human-RnD.com 收件人：RemnantCommander@Human-Command.com 主题：{FactionColor}{UnitTypeName}</color> 在 {PlanetName} 上被探测到  指挥官， 我们在 {PlanetName} 上探测到有史以来录入我们数据库的最大 Zenith 实体。它相当于一整颗小行星，全副武装，随时准备攻击。但不知为何，它似乎喜欢我们。 它几乎攻击一切，并以获取的金属为食。其攻击模式显示出类似动物的智能——专注于最近、最大的可攻击单位集群，但如果处于劣势并受伤，它会足够聪明地撤退到另一颗行星。我们的入侵者也表示，我们或许能够以某种形式与之沟通。  我们的敌人将与这个 '{FactionColor}{UnitTypeName}</color>' 交战会很困难。除了它本身已经极其强大之外，它还覆盖着某种活的、自我再生的反应装甲，能够分析行星上的单位类型（即使处于隐形状态），当受到攻击时，它会将来袭的射击与相应的单位设计相匹配，从而改变预计的命中点形状或结构来反击射击，并将所有受到的伤害减少惊人的 90%。我们能想到造成全额伤害的唯一方法是使用其扫描仪无法完全分析的单位进行攻击。  AI 的曲速网格每当吞噬者出现在 AI 行星上时就会剧烈波动。考虑到这个傀儡的体型和力量，我们只能假设 AI 会以疯狂的力量进行攻击。我们应尽最大努力不被卷入交火之中。  经过与我们的战术军官审查数据后，我们提出以下建议：  -> 对其怀有敌意的派系的大型舰队集群会吸引它的注意，几乎就像诱饵一样。 -> 如果我们与它在同一行星上，任何旗舰都可以发起各种入侵来操纵吞噬者傀儡的 targeting。这通常需要消耗入侵点和金属，并可能导致吞噬者记住我们的所作所为。 -> 我们可以预期，如果吞噬者傀儡在 AI 领土停留太久，AI 会尝试攻击它。此后不久，它可能会稍微变得脆弱易攻。  研发主管 George Murphy

column1: From: GeorgeMurphy@Human-RnD.com To: RemnantCommander@Human-Command.com Subject: {FactionColor}{UnitTypeName}</color> detected on {PlanetName}  Commander, we have detected the biggest Zenith entity ever entered into our database {PlanetName}. It amounts to an entire planetoid, armed and ready to attack. It attacks almost anything and feeds itself with the metal acquired. Its attack profile indicates an intelligence akin to an animal - focusing on the closest, biggest ball of attackable ships, but if outmatched and injured smart enough to retreat to another planet. Our hackers also suggest we may be able to communicate in some form or another, and if this thing approaches one of our planets we better be ready to...  Engaging this '{FactionColor}{UnitTypeName}</color>' in combat could be next to impossible. In addition to it already being incredibly powerful it's covered in some kind of living, self-regenerating reactionary armor that analyzes the ship types on a planet, even if cloaked, and when attacked matches the incoming shot to the ship design in question to morph the projected point of impact into a shape or structure to counter the shot and reduce all damage received by a staggering 90%. The only way we can think of to deal full damage would be to attack with ships that its scanners cannot fully analyze.  The AI's warp grid is going off the scale whenever the Devourer is on AI planets. Given the size and strength of the Golem we can only assume the AI will attack with an insane force. We should do our utmost not to be caught in the crossfire.  On the other hand, analyzing the remains of such a marvel of Zenith technology would vastly expand our scientific knowledge, and if the AI can weaken the Golem for us, even the better.   After reviewing the data with our tactical officers we suggest the following:  -> Fighting the Devourer Golem without significant power will only cause great losses. We should avoid it. If it comes to one of our planets we should initiate a hack to divert its attention. -> Big fleet balls of factions hostile to it will attract its attention, acting almost like a lure. -> If we are on the same planet any flagship can initiate various hacks to manipulate the Devourer Golem's targeting. This usually comes at the cost of Hacking Points and Metal, and may cause the Devourer to remember what we've done. -> We can expect the AI to try and attack the Devourer Golem if it's in AI territory for too long. column1: From: GeorgeMurphy@Human-RnD.com To: RemnantCommander@Human-Command.com Subject: {FactionColor}{UnitTypeName}</color> enraged  Commander, something happened to the {FactionColor}{UnitTypeName}</color> on {PlanetName}. It's internal reactors have suddenly gone into overdrive, increasing its weapon power by 50% and also targeting structures now.  We assume that once it regenerates enough it'll go back to normal, but in the meantime we should seriously consider the increased threat this represents to us or our enemies.  Head of RnD George Murphy

column1: From: GeorgeMurphy@Human-RnD.com To: RemnantCommander@Human-Command.com Subject: {FactionColor}{UnitTypeName}</color> found  Commander, our scans on {PlanetName} indicate a beacon aged at least 9 million years. Based on the technology we are confident this it is of Zenith origin, but we don't exactly know what it connects to. We can try and hack into the system to analyze its advanced technology, but that may very well attract the attention of its owner.  Head of RnD George Murphy
column2: 发件人：GeorgeMurphy@Human-RnD.com 收件人：RemnantCommander@Human-Command.com 主题：{FactionColor}{UnitTypeName}</color> 已发现  指挥官， 我们在 {PlanetName} 上的扫描显示一个信标至少有 900 万年的历史。根据技术分析，我们确信它源自 Zenith，但我们并不确切知道它连接着什么。 我们可以尝试入侵该系统以分析其先进技术，但这很可能会引起其所有者的注意。  研发主管 George Murphy

column1: From: GeorgeMurphy@Human-RnD.com To: RemnantCommander@Human-Command.com Subject: {FactionColor}{UnitTypeName}</color> spawned  Commander, it seems the AI has deployed a new device in order to subvert the Devourer Golem. According to our analysis it is designed to stream a constant signal directly into the main processor of the Golem. We're not yet sure what information or instructions the AI will send, but it will most likely aim to divert the Devourer Golem to its enemies instead of having to waste resources defending against it.  If we can spare the time we should destroy it before the AI can use it.  Head of RnD George Murphy
column2: 发件人：GeorgeMurphy@Human-RnD.com 收件人：RemnantCommander@Human-Command.com 主题：{FactionColor}{UnitTypeName}</color> 已生成  指挥官， 似乎 AI 已经部署了一种新设备来策反吞噬者傀儡。根据我们的分析，它旨在将一种持续信号直接传入傀儡的主处理器。我们还不确定 AI 将发送什么信息或指令，但它很可能旨在将吞噬者傀儡引向它的敌人，而不必浪费资源来防御它。  如果我们能抽出时间，应该在 AI 能够使用它之前将其摧毁。  研发主管 George Murphy

column1: From: Military Advisor Anna Snow Fleet Command - Home Command  To: Commander {PlayerName}  Commander!  The AI command core is escaping! It seems to have temporarily changed phase so our weapons can't hit it, and it's heading for our Home Command Station! We won't be able to hit it until it re-enters phase with our ships.  We think the phase-change is only sustainable while it is on a Bastion World. This new command core is very heavily armed; we may need some new strategies to deal with it. It seems particularly good at destroying strikecraft.
column2: 发件人：军事顾问安娜·斯诺 舰队指挥部 - 指挥部  致：指挥官 {PlayerName}  指挥官！  人工智能指挥核心正在逃跑！它似乎暂时改变了相位，我们的武器无法击中它，它正朝我们的主指挥站进发！在我们能再次击中它之前，它必须重新进入与我们单位同相位的状态。  我们认为相位变化只有在它位于堡垒世界上时才能维持。这个新的指挥核心装备了非常重型的武器；我们可能需要一些新的策略来对付它。它似乎特别擅长摧毁小型战机。

column1: From: Military Advisor Anna Snow Fleet Command - Home Command  To: Commander {PlayerName}  Commander!  {FactionName} has been defeated! That was the last of the AIs  command cores, which means we have won! This is a day to remember! I never thought this day would come, but we did it! Especially you commander! Without you, this would certainly not have been possible.
column2: 发件人：军事顾问安娜·斯诺 舰队指挥部 - 指挥部  致：指挥官 {PlayerName}  指挥官！  {FactionName} 已被击败！那是人工智能最后一个指挥核心，这意味着我们胜利了！这是值得纪念的一天！我从没想过这一天会到来，但我们做到了！尤其是你，指挥官！没有你，这绝对是无法实现的。

column1: From: Military Advisor Anna Snow Fleet Command - Home Command  To: Commander {PlayerName}  Commander!  {FactionName} has been defeated! That was the last of the AIs command cores, but we have not yet won! There is still enemies that must be destroyed so we can begin to rebuild our civilization in peace.
column2: 发件人：军事顾问安娜·斯诺 舰队指挥部 - 指挥部  致：指挥官 {PlayerName}  指挥官！  {FactionName} 已被击败！那是人工智能最后一个指挥核心，但我们还没有胜利！仍有敌人必须被消灭，这样我们才能开始和平地重建我们的文明。

column1: From: Military Advisor Anna Snow Fleet Command - Home Command  To: Commander {PlayerName}  Commander!  {FactionName} has been defeated! Well done! It has lost its coordination with the other AI command cores and is now rogue.  This will at least give us a moment to catch our breath, and repair the fleet before next offensive, but don't wait too long. When the AI starts a full on civil war with itself after the initial confusion I don't think we want to be caught in the crossfire.
column2: 发件人：军事顾问安娜·斯诺 舰队指挥部 - 指挥部  致：指挥官 {PlayerName}  指挥官！  {FactionName} 已被击败！干得好！它已与其他人工智能指挥核心失去协调，现已失控。 这将至少给我们片刻喘息的机会，并在下一次进攻前修复舰队，但不要等太久。当人工智能在最初的混乱之后开始全面内战时，我想我们可不想被卷入交火中。

column1: From: Military Advisor Anna Snow Fleet Command - Home Command  To: Commander {PlayerName}  Commander,   Be careful of AI warp gates.  Warp Gates are used by the AI to warp in Waves of units against our planets. Sniping warp gates except for those next to heavily defended planets will let you control AI aggression, albeit at a small AIP cost. This technique is called 'Gate Raiding'.  Right now, our homeworld is open to AI Waves since there are Warp Gates alive on plants adjacent to our Homeworld. We either need to very heavily defend our Homeworld, or we should consider killing the Warp Gates to better protect ourselves from AI Aggression.  Killing Warp Gates will prevent waves from being launched, but the AI can still send conventional forces through those planets (like Hunter ships).
column2: 发件人：军事顾问安娜·斯诺 舰队指挥部 - 指挥部  致：指挥官 {PlayerName}  指挥官，  小心人工智能的星际之门。  人工智能利用星际之门向我们的行星传送波次部队。狙杀星际之门（除了那些靠近重兵防守行星的）可以让你控制人工智能的侵略程度，不过会付出少量 AIP 的代价。这种技术称为"门袭"。  目前，我们的母星暴露在人工智能波次的威胁之下，因为与母星相邻的行星上仍有活跃的星际之门。我们要么需要全力防守母星，要么考虑摧毁星际之门以更好地保护自己免受人工智能的侵略。  摧毁星际之门可以防止波次被发射，但人工智能仍然可以通过那些行星派遣常规部队（如猎手舰）。

column1: From: Military Advisor Anna Snow Fleet Command - Home Command  To: Commander {PlayerName}  Commander,   If you need to load ships into a flagship and then immediately move the flagship, it can be frustrating if the flagship leaves the planet before the ships finish loading. You can use the Wait For Stragglers option in the Automation Settings to ask your flagships to wait for nearby ships to load before leaving the planet; this setting applies on friendly planets or neutral planets without enemies.
column2: 发件人：军事顾问安娜·斯诺 舰队指挥部 - 指挥部  致：指挥官 {PlayerName}  指挥官，  如果你需要将单位装载到旗舰中然后立即移动旗舰，旗舰在单位完成装载之前就离开了行星可能会令人沮丧。你可以在自动化设置中使用"等待掉队者"选项，要求旗舰在离开行星前等待附近的单位完成装载；此设置适用于友方行星或没有敌人的中立行星。

column1: From: Military Advisor Anna Snow Fleet Command - Home Command  To: Commander {PlayerName}  Commander,   It looks like some of flagships are being crippled during battles.  It may be worthwhile to upgrade fleet centerpieces with science at least once or twice to make them more durable and less prone to being crippled. You can do that via the Fleets menu by clicking on the fleet in question.
column2: 发件人：军事顾问安娜·斯诺 舰队指挥部 - 指挥部  致：指挥官 {PlayerName}  指挥官，  有些旗舰似乎在战斗中受到了重创。  用科学点数升级舰队核心至少一到两次可能是值得的，这能使其更加耐用，不易受重创。你可以通过舰队菜单点击相关舰队来进行升级。

column1: From: Military Advisor Anna Snow Fleet Command - Home Command  To: Commander {PlayerName}  Commander,   Now that we're expanded beyond our home system, there are many other possibilities available to us. If you get stuck at any point and aren't sure what to do, the Intel tab is a good way to find goals and targets to work on. You may also find the following ideas to be useful:  Don't neglect defense of our systems, especially our homeworld. If home command station is destroyed... well maybe someone in distant future will research our species history and culture like we researched Zenith.   Hack TSS (Turret Schematic Servers) for additional turret defenses or ODSS (Other Defensive Schematic Servers) for supplemental defenses and scale up defenses to keep up with the strength of incoming AI waves.  Battlestations and their turrets are powerful assets, both in attack and defense. Don't forget to make use of them.  Capturing a system with an ARS, TSS, or ODSS will cut the hacking cost for those structures in half, but AIP will continue to rise for every system you acquire. Consider carefully what planets you need to take, and what planets you can do without.  Make sure you have long-term and short-term plans for defending any system you take, before you take it. If a planet cannot be effectively defended, it can at times be useful to just capture it long enough to take any fleets or other capturables and extract the hacking and science, then fall back to a more defensible location.  Read tooltips on any ships or structures you are not familiar with. Knowledge is power; some units are more hazardous than they may initially appear. Hold C and click on any tech upgrade, ARS, etc. to see more details on what you are about to acquire.  Use science; you can get a refund for a modest hacking points cost for anything you wish to reinvest later. Ships and turrets that use the same weapons techs as those you already have are particularly valuable. Direct upgrades of command stations can be very helpful if you need an economic boost or some additional firepower in a particular location.
column2: 发件人：军事顾问安娜·斯诺 舰队指挥部 - 指挥部  致：指挥官 {PlayerName}  指挥官，  既然我们已经扩张到了母星系之外，我们面前还有许多其他可能性。如果你在任何时候卡住了，不确定该做什么，情报选项卡是寻找目标和任务的好方法。你可能会发现以下建议也很有用：  不要忽视对我们星系的防御，尤其是母星。如果主指挥站被摧毁……嗯，也许遥远的未来会有某个文明研究我们物种的历史和文化，就像我们研究天顶一样。  入侵 TSS（炮塔蓝图服务器）以获得额外的炮塔防御，或 ODSS（其他防御蓝图服务器）以获得补充防御，并扩大防御规模以跟上人工智能波次的强度。  战斗空间站及其炮塔是强大的资产，无论是进攻还是防守。别忘了加以利用。  占领一个有 ARS、TSS 或 ODSS 的星系可以将这些建筑的入侵成本减半，但你每获得一个星系，AIP 就会继续上升。仔细考虑你需要占领哪些行星，以及哪些行星可以放弃。  确保你在占领任何星系之前都有长期和短期的防守计划。如果一个行星无法有效防守，有时可以先占领它足够长的时间，以夺取任何舰队或其他可占领物，提取入侵点和科学点数，然后撤退到更有防御价值的位置。  阅读任何你不熟悉的单位或结构的工具提示。知识就是力量；有些单位可能比它们最初看起来更危险。按住 C 键并点击任何科技升级、ARS 等，可以查看你即将获得的东西的更多细节。  使用科学点数；你可以以适中的入侵点成本退还任何你之后想要重新投资的东西。与你已有的武器技术相同的单位和炮塔尤其有价值。如果你需要经济提振或某个特定位置的火力增强，直接升级指挥站可能非常有帮助。

column1: From: Military Advisor Anna Snow Fleet Command - Home Command  To: Commander {PlayerName}  Commander,   One important trick is to put flagships in 'Load Mode'. This lets them operate as Transports to move ships around the map very quickly. Flagships in Load Mode are very useful for bypassing AI defenses to hit critical targets.  The default hotkey to enter Load Mode is 'L' and to then unload, hit 'U'. You can override this in the Controls menu.
column2: 发件人：军事顾问安娜·斯诺 舰队指挥部 - 指挥部  致：指挥官 {PlayerName}  指挥官，  一个重要技巧是将旗舰设置为"装载模式"。这使它们能够作为运输舰在地图上快速移动单位。处于装载模式的旗舰对于绕过人工智能防御打击关键目标非常有用。  进入装载模式的默认热键是'L'，卸载按'U'。你可以在控制菜单中修改此设置。

column1: From: Military Advisor Anna Snow Fleet Command - Home Command  To: Commander {PlayerName}  Commander,   Our Intelligence Department has detected a swarm of Nanobots invading the galaxy. We're calling it the Nanocaust. They seem to be willing to aid us against the AI. Their weapons can assimilate ships they destroy into their fleet, making them a truly terrifying foe.
column2: 发件人：军事顾问安娜·斯诺 舰队指挥部 - 指挥部  致：指挥官 {PlayerName}  指挥官，  我们的情报部门检测到一群纳米机器人入侵了银河系。我们称之为纳米浩劫。它们似乎愿意帮助我们对抗人工智能。它们的武器可以同化它们摧毁的单位加入它们的舰队，使它们成为真正可怕的敌人。

column1: From: Military Advisor Anna Snow Fleet Command - Home Command  To: Commander {PlayerName}  Commander,   Our ships and turrets needs Fuel to operative at full power, so we can shift all our energy power to our computers to calculate our fleets and turrets battle logics and targeting systems. Energy is still an important resource, because the more ships and turrets we have, we also need more computers to calculate their logics and thus using more energy. This of course also increase strategic depth by adding infrastructure we must defend in order to continue fielding an effective military force. This impacts what planets you will want to take, and how you will deploy your military to ensure vital assets are not destroyed.  To that end, our Fleet Command interface developers have added three types of fuel to the FCI-UI resource bar: Argon for mobile fleets, Radon for turrets and other stationary defenses, and Xenon for Officers, Outguard, Citadels, etc. We have a basic starting supply of these resources sufficient to fund our first few planets, but eventually we will need to acquire and defend new Fuel Stations to properly supply our units. You can build new units beyond our fuel capacity, but they will rapidly lose effectiveness; any unit with effectiveness below 100% will see proportional penalties applied to their durability and damage output.  I cannot stress this enough, but defend our Fuel Stations well, or face the consequences.
column2: 发件人：军事顾问安娜·斯诺 舰队指挥部 - 指挥部  致：指挥官 {PlayerName}  指挥官，  我们的单位和炮塔需要燃料才能满功率运行，这样我们才能将所有能量转移到计算机上，用于计算舰队和炮塔的战斗逻辑及目标系统。能量仍然是一种重要资源，因为我们拥有的单位和炮塔越多，我们就需要更多的计算机来计算它们的逻辑，从而消耗更多能量。这当然也增加了战略深度，增加了我们必须保卫的基础设施，以便继续维持有效的军事力量。这会影响你想占领哪些行星，以及如何部署你的军队以确保重要资产不被摧毁。  为此，我们的舰队指挥部界面开发人员在 FCI-UI 资源栏中添加了三种燃料：氩气用于移动舰队，氡气用于炮塔和其他固定防御设施，氙气用于军官、外卫部队、堡垒等。我们有基本的初始供应，足以支持我们最初的几个行星，但最终我们将需要获取和保卫新的燃料站来适当供应我们的单位。你可以建造超出燃料容量的新单位，但它们会迅速失去效能；任何效能低于 100% 的单位将看到其耐久度和伤害输出受到比例惩罚。  我怎么强调都不为过：保护好我们的燃料站，否则后果自负。

column1: From: Military Advisor Anna Snow Fleet Command - Home Command  To: Commander {PlayerName}  Commander,   The ability to queue fleet unload is very useful! If you have a loaded fleet you can give it a move order on the galaxy map, then hold Shift and press 'U' to queue the unload after the move completes.  You can queue other sorts of commands with Shift as well, but being able to tell a fleet 'Go to this battle and unload ships when you arrive' is extremely useful.
column2: 发件人：军事顾问安娜·斯诺 舰队指挥部 - 指挥部  致：指挥官 {PlayerName}  指挥官，  排队卸载舰队的功能非常有用！如果你有一支已装载的舰队，你可以在银河地图上给它一个移动指令，然后按住 Shift 并按'U'键来排队在移动完成后执行卸载。  你也可以用 Shift 键排队其他类型的指令，但能够告诉舰队"前往这个战场并在到达时卸载单位"是极其有用的。

column1: From: Military Advisor Anna Snow Fleet Command - Home Command  To: Commander {PlayerName}  Commander,   Using Science to upgrade ships is a key way to make fleets more powerful. Sitting on huge amounts of science can make our war against the machine unnecessarily hard.  Also! Early on, the power of spending science for a direct planetary upgrade cannot be beat in terms of providing additional defensive strength and economic value for our initial few planets. This directly upgrades all units the planet controls from the protective forcefields, the metal extractors, the station-keeping vessels, all the turrets owned by the planet, and lets not forget it also improves the planet wide bonuses provided by the command station itself!
column2: 发件人：军事顾问安娜·斯诺 舰队指挥部 - 指挥部  致：指挥官 {PlayerName}  指挥官，  使用科学点数升级单位是让舰队更强大的关键方式。囤积大量科学点数会使我们对机器的战争变得不必要地困难。  另外！早期阶段，将科学点数用于直接的行星升级，在为我们最初的几个行星提供额外防御力量和经济价值方面是无可匹敌的。这直接升级了该行星控制的所有单位，从防护力场、金属提取器、空间站保持器，到行星拥有的所有炮塔，更别忘了这也提升了指挥站本身提供的行星范围加成！

column1: From: Military Advisor Anna Snow Fleet Command - Home Command  To: Commander {PlayerName}  Commander,   We need to be careful about increasing the AIP too much. Remember, we are running a Guerrilla campaign!  It's a good idea to neuter planets (aka defeat all the AI defenses without blowing up the command station or warp gate); this allows our ships to strike deeper against the AI with safely, but without generating more AIP.  Capturing too many planets will cause the AI to get very strong very quickly.
column2: 发件人：军事顾问安娜·斯诺 舰队指挥部 - 指挥部  致：指挥官 {PlayerName}  指挥官，  我们需要小心不要过度增加 AIP。记住，我们正在进行一场游击战！  建议对行星进行中立化处理（即在不炸毁指挥站或星际之门的情况下击败所有人工智能防御）；这样我们的单位就能更深入地对人工智能进行打击，同时不会产生更多的 AIP。  占领太多行星会导致人工智能迅速变得非常强大。

column1: From: Military Advisor Anna Snow Fleet Command - Home Command  To: Commander {PlayerName}  Commander,   We should consider building some turrets to defend our planets. Turrets are a very strong mechanism of stationary defense, and you want them on planets that might be attacked.
column2: 发件人：军事顾问安娜·斯诺 舰队指挥部 - 指挥部  致：指挥官 {PlayerName}  指挥官，  我们应该考虑建造一些炮塔来防御我们的行星。炮塔是一种非常强大的固定防御机制，你应该在可能受到攻击的行星上部署它们。

column1: From: Military Advisor Anna Snow Fleet Command - Home Command  To: Commander {PlayerName}  Commander,   We've captured what research has named an 'Officer' class ship.  These specialized ships can be the core of our main fleet or specialized support depending on their specialty.  You can transfer ships from other fleets using the detailed fleet view (Hold 'C' and click flagship by default). This can include the elite ships from Fleet Research Stations, which will provide their bonus to the officer ship.  Just like other flagships, officer ships don't improve by spending science unlocking technology. However you can directly spend science in the detailed fleet view (Hold 'C' and click flagship by default) to level up its direct strength.   Many officer ships can be significantly improved with our hacking nanomachines as well. Move the ship to a friendly planet and check out the Hacks tab for details.   Be aware that this power doesn't come cheap. Officer class ships can have significant power usage and if they are crippled during battle will cost a massive amount of metal to repair.
column2: 发件人：军事顾问安娜·斯诺 舰队指挥部 - 指挥部  致：指挥官 {PlayerName}  指挥官，  我们捕获了研究中称为"军官"级的单位。  这些专门的单位可以成为我们主力舰队的核心，或者根据其专长提供专业支援。  你可以使用详细舰队视图（默认为按住'C'键点击旗舰）从其他舰队转移单位。这可以包括来自舰队研究站的精英单位，它们会将其加成提供给军官单位。  与其他旗舰一样，军官单位不能通过花费科学点数解锁技术来改进。但是，你可以在详细舰队视图（默认为按住'C'键点击旗舰）中直接花费科学点数来提升其直接强度。  许多军官单位也可以通过我们的入侵纳米机器进行显著改进。将单位移动到友方行星并查看入侵选项卡以获取详细信息。  请注意，这种力量并非廉价。军官级单位可能有显著的能耗，如果在战斗中受重创，修复将需要大量的金属。

column1: From: Military Advisor Anna Snow Fleet Command - Home Command  To: Commander {PlayerName}  Commander,   We've never imagined being able to control a planet before. The Zenith truly were an amazing race.  We could direct it to crash into another planet, even an AI homeworld! This would provoke a very strong AI response; we suspect they would attack both this nomad and the rest of our empire with massive forces.  Do remember that if we crash the planet, everything on either planet would be permanently destroyed, even our Flagships. You should remember to get the flagships off the planet before it's too late.
column2: 发件人：军事顾问安娜·斯诺 舰队指挥部 - 指挥部  致：指挥官 {PlayerName}  指挥官，  我们从未想象过能够控制一个行星。天顶真是一个令人惊叹的种族。  我们可以指挥它撞向另一个行星，甚至是一个人工智能母星！这会引起非常强烈的人工智能反应；我们怀疑他们会用巨大的部队攻击这个游牧者和我们帝国的其余部分。  请记住，如果我们让行星撞击，撞击行星上的所有东西都将被永久摧毁，包括我们的旗舰。你应该记得在来不及之前把旗舰从行星上撤走。

column1: From: Military Advisor Anna Snow Fleet Command - Home Command  To: Commander {PlayerName}  Commander,   Well done! This should allow us to use the ZA territory without fighting. But be careful; this is an uneasy alliance at best.  It seems likely that while they are Expanding or in Civil War, they will forget about the truce until they have quiesced again.
column2: 发件人：军事顾问安娜·斯诺 舰队指挥部 - 指挥部  致：指挥官 {PlayerName}  指挥官，  干得好！这应该允许我们使用 ZA 的领土而无需战斗。但要小心；这最多只是一个脆弱的联盟。  看起来当它们正在扩张或处于内战中时，它们会忘记休战，直到它们再次恢复平静。

column1: From: Military Advisor Anna Snow Fleet Command - Home Command  To: Commander {PlayerName}  Commander,   You should consider automating some of building options. In the Settings menu under Automation are settings to automate the building of some common defensive ships on our planets.
column2: 发件人：军事顾问安娜·斯诺 舰队指挥部 - 指挥部  致：指挥官 {PlayerName}  指挥官，  你应该考虑自动化一些建造选项。在设置菜单的自动化选项下，有一些设置可以自动化在我们行星上建造一些常见的防御单位。

column1: From: Military Advisor Anna Snow Fleet Command - Home Command  To: Commander {PlayerName}  Commander,   Your Science Advisor brings disturbing news... It seems like Metal Generators aren't the only viable hosts for these 'Wild Hive' infestations. We have detected a Capturable on planet {PlanetName} has undergone a similar infestation as Metal Generators, however it appears that the larger internal space combined with 'Wild Hive' organisms shuttling a constant stream of supplies to the infested Capturable has turned it into a 'greater' hive, so to speak. Activity within is noted to be greater than that of a Metal Generator. We can expect a greater quantity of forces to emerge from that infested Capturable.  While we can expect this infested Capturable to put up a greater resistance to hostiles, we cannot capture it ourselves. However, after a thorough analysis of the infestation by your Science Advisor's team, and some weapon adjustments and calibrations directed by your Military Advisor, weakpoints in the Capturable's structural integrity have been identified and are able to be exploited to damage and sterilize the infestation without causing the Capturable's destruction. Targeting the infested Capturable should free it from the 'Wild Hive's grasp, should we desire to claim it for ourselves.  The implications of this development is rather concerning. While we currently have no reason to believe that the 'Wild Hives' are using this Capturable as anything but a reproductive hive, this may mean that other capturables are susceptible to a Wild Hive infestation. We'll keep tabs on other capturables and calibrate weapons accordingly for minimum damage to them.
column2: 发件人：军事顾问安娜·斯诺 舰队指挥部 - 指挥部  致：指挥官 {PlayerName}  指挥官，  你的科学顾问带来了令人不安的消息……金属发生器似乎不是这些"野生蜂巢"侵扰的唯一可行宿主。我们检测到行星 {PlanetName} 上的一个可占领物经历了与金属发生器类似的侵扰，然而更大的内部空间加上"野生蜂巢"生物不断运送物资到被侵扰的可占领物，使其变成了一个"更大"的蜂巢。其中的活动被注意到比金属发生器中的更加活跃。我们可以期望从那个被侵扰的可占领物中出现更多数量的部队。  虽然我们可以预料到被侵扰的可占领物会对敌对者进行更强的抵抗，但我们自己无法占领它。然而，经过你的科学顾问团队对侵扰的彻底分析，以及你的军事顾问指导的一些武器调整和校准，可占领物结构完整性的弱点已被识别，可以在不造成可占领物毁灭的情况下加以利用来破坏和清除侵扰。瞄准被侵扰的可占领物应该能将其从"野生蜂巢"的控制中解放出来，如果我们想要自己占领它的话。  这一发展的影响相当令人担忧。虽然我们目前没有理由相信"野生蜂巢"除了将这个可占领物用作繁殖巢穴外还有其他用途，但这可能意味着其他可占领物也容易受到野生蜂巢的侵扰。我们将密切关注其他可占领物，并相应调整武器以对其造成最小伤害。

column1: From: Military Advisor Anna Snow Fleet Command - Home Command  To: Commander {PlayerName}  Commander,  It looks like we've grown powerful enough that the AI might start to divert the units it is using to fight Exogalactic wars to deal with us.  These are extremely large and powerful ships that will appear infrequently but pack a major punch when they show up.
column2: 发件人：军事顾问安娜·斯诺 舰队指挥部 - 指挥部  致：指挥官 {PlayerName}  指挥官，  看来我们已经变得足够强大，人工智能可能会开始将用于对抗河外战争的单位转向对付我们。  这些是极其巨大而强大的单位，出现频率不高，但出现时会带来重大打击。

column1: From: Military Advisor Anna Snow Fleet Command - Home Command  To: Commander {PlayerName}  Commander,  Our Intelligence Department has detected a swarm of Nanobots invading the galaxy. We're calling it the Nanocaust. Their weapons can assimilate ships they destroy into their fleet, making them a truly terrifying foe. We must be wary.
column2: 发件人：军事顾问安娜·斯诺 舰队指挥部 - 指挥部  致：指挥官 {PlayerName}  指挥官，  我们的情报部门检测到一群纳米机器人入侵了银河系。我们称之为纳米浩劫。它们的武器可以同化它们摧毁的单位加入它们的舰队，使它们成为真正可怕的敌人。我们必须保持警惕。

column1: From: Military Advisor Anna Snow Fleet Command - Home Command  To: Commander {PlayerName}  Commander,  We can improve our defenses by hacking one or more Defense Schematic Servers (TSSes). Once we own enough planets, it can be hard to defend them all. Hacking DSSes allow us to power up ALL of our command stations, battlestations, and citadels. Some types benefit more than others from the improvements, but in general we want more turrets, minefields, and other defensive features to be available to us.
column2: 发件人：军事顾问安娜·斯诺 舰队指挥部 - 指挥部  致：指挥官 {PlayerName}  指挥官，  我们可以通过入侵一个或多个其他防御蓝图服务器（TSS）来改善防御。一旦我们拥有足够多的行星，要全部防守起来可能会很困难。入侵 DSS 可以让我们增强所有指挥站、战斗空间站和堡垒的威力。某些类型的增幅效果比其他类型更为显著，但总的来说，我们希望获得更多的炮塔、雷场和其他防御设施。

column1: From: Military Advisor Anna Snow Fleet Command - Home Command  To: Commander {PlayerName}  Commander,  We can use the Planet menu to Watch fleets so we can see their health and strength even when they are on remote planets. This allows you to efficiently monitor multiple battles at once It can be a good idea to watch your most important fleets (note that Command Stations count as fleets as well!).   There are a number of ways to customize how you do this; check the bottom of the Planet sidebar for the Options there. Some officers would like to put Watched Fleets above the Ships in the planet sidebar, for example.
column2: 发件人：军事顾问安娜·斯诺 舰队指挥部 - 指挥部  致：指挥官 {PlayerName}  指挥官，  我们可以使用行星菜单来关注舰队，这样即使它们在遥远的行星上，我们也能看到它们的生命值和强度。这使你能有效监控多场同时进行的战斗。关注你最重要的舰队是个好主意（注意指挥站也算作舰队！）。  有很多方法可以自定义操作方式；请在行星侧边栏底部查看相关选项。例如，有些军官喜欢将关注的舰队放在行星侧边栏中单位列表的上方。

column1: From: Military Advisor Anna Snow Fleet Command - Home Command  To: Commander {PlayerName}  Commander,  We have a powerful ally in the Nanocaust. We've requested them not to destroy any AI command stations so as to not increase AIP, but that leaves their Hive open to powerful AI waves. We should try to help them deal with the dangerous warp gates.
column2: 发件人：军事顾问安娜·斯诺 舰队指挥部 - 指挥部  致：指挥官 {PlayerName}  指挥官，  我们在纳米浩劫中有一个强大的盟友。我们已经请求他们不要摧毁任何人工智能指挥站以免增加 AIP，但这使他们的巢群容易受到强大的人工智能波次攻击。我们应该尝试帮助他们处理危险的星际之门。

column1: From: Military Advisor Anna Snow Fleet Command - Home Command To: Commander {PlayerName} Commander, We have captured a 'citadel' class defensive structure. These mobile defensive stations are similar to the Battlestations we’ve developed, but are more specialized and directly powerful. The station itself is a slow but powerful defender in its own right, but its primary role is building an exclusive compliment of turrets on any planet. Upgrades Our RnD department has developed a wide range of loadouts that affect the Citadel's weapon systems that you can change with Hacking Points (hold 'C' when selecting a citadel). Just like other flagships, science can be spent (hold 'C' when selecting a citadel) to improve both the station itself and its constructed turrets.
column2: 发件人：军事顾问安娜·斯诺 舰队指挥部 - 指挥部 致：指挥官 {PlayerName} 指挥官， 我们捕获了一座"堡垒"级防御结构。这些移动防御空间站类似于我们开发的战斗空间站，但更加专业和直接强大。空间站本身是一个缓慢但强大的防御者，但其主要作用是在任何行星上建造专属的炮台组。 升级 我们的研发部门已经开发出多种影响堡垒武器系统的配置，你可以用入侵点进行更改（在选择堡垒时按住'C'键）。 与其他旗舰一样，可以花费科学点数（在选择堡垒时按住'C'键）来改进空间站本身及其建造的炮塔。

column1: From: Military Advisor John Cornwood Fleet Command - Home Command  To: Commander {PlayerName}  Commander!   Our military simulations suggest the enemy in this system is much stronger than our current forces. I would consider regrouping and gaining strength.  - Given the difference in strength in this system, our attack is unlikely to succeed right now. - One option is to capture fleets and ships elsewhere in the galaxy. - Another is to spend our science to improve our fleet strength before attacking again.  I want also remind you that not every planet needs to be captured. If planet is not near our borders and has little strategic value, then bypassing it, is a viable option. Loading ships into our transports ('L' with the fleet selected) and flying through the system to planets behind them before unloading ('U' with fleet selected to unload; note you can queue the unload by holding Shift and pressing 'U') might be an option.  If you want review the source of strength, use the planet view ('P' by default) and look for the source of the AI strength in this system.  Is there an active Eye, Ion Cannon, or fortress that needed to be raided ahead of the main fleet?  Strength doesn't necessarily indicate how a unit will fare in combat. If our units effectively counter the AI's forces at a planet, you may have an easier time than our simulation numbers suggest.
column2: 发件人：军事顾问约翰·康伍德 舰队指挥部 - 指挥部  致：指挥官 {PlayerName}  指挥官！  我们的军事模拟显示，该星系中的敌人比我们目前的部队强大得多。我建议重新集结并增强实力。  - 鉴于该星系的力量差距，我们的攻击现在不太可能成功。 - 一个选择是在银河系其他地方夺取舰队和单位。 - 另一个选择是花费我们的科学点数来提高舰队实力，然后再发动攻击。  我还想提醒你，并非每个行星都需要占领。如果一个行星不在我们边境附近且战略价值不大，那么绕过它是一个可行的选择。 将单位装载到运输舰中（选择舰队后按'L'键）飞越星系到后面的行星，然后卸载（选择舰队后按'U'键卸载；注意你可以按住 Shift 并按'U'来排队卸载）可能是一个选择。  如果你想分析力量来源，请使用行星视图（默认为 P 键）并查看该星系中人工智能力量的来源。 是否存在活跃之眼、离子炮或要塞，需要在主力舰队到达之前进行突袭？  力量并不一定表示一个单位在战斗中的表现如何。如果我们的单位有效克制该行星上的人工智能部队，你的战斗可能会比模拟数字显示的要轻松。

column1: From: Military Advisor John Cornwood Fleet Command - Home Command To: Commander {PlayerName} Commander, Eyes are a particularly deadly AI weapon that you should examine carefully before you bring our forces onto the planet. If the strength of AI-hostile attacker is greater than the strength of the AI's defenders, then the Eye will activate, and something ranging from Very Bad to Extremely Bad will happen to our ships. Raiding the Inactive Eye The general strategy on a planet with an Eye is to send in a small elite force first, and destroy the Eye before bringing in rest of the fleet. Unfortunately, some Eyes are protected by guard posts on these planets! To render these Eyes vulnerable to attack, a number of guard posts will first need to be destroyed, but our strike strength needs to be small enough to not active the eye but strong enough to handle each guard post. Hit-and-run strikes or suicide attacks may be necessary to accomplish this task. Fortunately, our fleet ships are all unmanned, so these tactics don’t put any human lives in jeopardy. TIP: If you're dealing with the forces freed during the attempt to get at an Eye, you can set up other forces of your own on an adjacent planet to 'catch' the newly-free threat.
column2: 发件人：军事顾问约翰·康伍德 舰队指挥部 - 指挥部 致：指挥官 {PlayerName} 指挥官， 之眼是一种特别致命的人工智能武器，在将我们的部队带到这个行星上之前，你应该仔细检查。如果人工智能敌对攻击者的力量大于人工智能守军的力量，那么之眼将被激活，某些从非常糟糕到极其糟糕的事情将会发生在我们的单位上。 突袭未激活之眼 对于有之眼的行星，一般策略是先派遣一支小型精英部队，在主力舰队到达之前摧毁之眼。不幸的是，有些之眼受到这些行星上的守卫哨站的保护！要使这些之眼变得脆弱可攻击，首先需要摧毁一定数量的守卫哨站，但我们的突击力量需要足够小以避免激活之眼，同时又要足够强大以应对每个守卫哨站。打带跑攻击或自杀式攻击可能是完成此任务的必要手段。幸运的是，我们的舰队单位都是无人驾驶的，所以这些战术不会危及任何人类生命。 提示： 如果你正在处理在试图接近之眼时释放出来的部队，你可以在相邻行星上设置你自己的部队来"捕捉"新解放的威胁。

column1: From: Officer Herman Wade Fleet Command - Home Command  To: Commander {PlayerName}  Let me be frank with you, commander.   We've lost a war you didn't even know we were fighting. You're the best military mind humanity has ever produced, and because of that you've been called out of stasis as a matter of our last resort.  What you may not know due to your time in the freeze is that our scientists and engineers have been hard at work creating automated war machines. Over the last century, we've moved to pilot-less ships that are both created and operated using highly computerized technology. With the ability to command these mechanical fleets from a distance came the idea to use Artificial Intelligence. These decisions were not undertaken lightly, and we thought all of the appropriate safety checks were in place, but I think you can guess what has happened.  We created AI commander so fast, so organized, that none of our contemporary human commanders could match them. There was even a great debate as to whether to remove the lot of commanders like you from stasis and let you go on with your lives. Thank God we decided to keep you in reserve. After the AI decided to turn against us, it eradicated us in a matter of days.  That was three weeks ago, and already it view us as beneath its contempt, not even worth stamping completely out. The AI is focused its attention elsewhere, on something outside the galaxy. We don't know what it is doing, what it is that it have found out there, but this may provide us with our one chance to strike back at it.  You're in the last tiny corner of the galaxy that is left to us, though we think there may be some captive settlements that yet survive. When I say this is our last chance, do not think I exaggerate. The AI is disinterested in our pitiful remaining forces at the moment, but it doesn't know about you -- when it see our fleets are growing, and are guided by competent, intelligent commander, it will react. The more you infringe on its territory, the more you demonstrate your power, the more likely it's going to crush us.  The AI forces outnumber us ten thousand to one, so a direct assault would be suicide. We have no resources, we have hardly any ships, and the schematics for our most advanced hardware are lost to the AI. Your mission is to take what little we have, and turn it into victory in whatever way you can. Take back our resources from the AI, steal knowledge of the ships we once built with ease, and destroy its data centers whenever you find one. Most importantly, find and destroy its core command station to wipe it out.  We've been beaten to our knees, but we're not going to sit by and watch our species die. You're the best military mind we've ever been able to produce, and so if you can't prevail we really are lost. Use your head out there, and make sure not to let emotion or aggression cloud your better judgment. Fight smart. Remember your tactical training as well as the bigger picture. Win where all others have failed.
column2: 发件人：军官赫尔曼·韦德 舰队指挥部 - 指挥部  致：指挥官 {PlayerName}  指挥官，让我跟你直说吧。  我们输掉了一场你甚至不知道我们一直在打的战争。你是人类有史以来最杰出的军事头脑，正因如此，你被从低温休眠中唤醒，作为我们的最后手段。  由于你在冷冻期间，你可能不知道的是，我们的科学家和工程师一直在努力制造自动化战争机器。在过去的一个世纪里，我们已经转向使用高度计算机化技术创建和操作的无人驾驶单位。随着从远处指挥这些机械舰队的能力，使用人工智能的想法应运而生。这些决定并非轻率做出，我们认为所有适当的安全检查都已到位，但我想你能猜到发生了什么。  我们创造的人工智能指挥官如此迅速、如此有条理，以至于我们当代的人类指挥官中没有谁能够匹敌。当时甚至就有关于是否要将像你这样的指挥官从休眠中移除并让你们继续生活的激烈辩论。谢天谢地，我们决定将你们作为后备保留。当人工智能决定背叛我们时，它在几天之内就将我们消灭了。  那是三周前的事了，而它已经视我们为不屑一顾，甚至不值得彻底铲除。人工智能将其注意力转向别处，转向银河系之外的某样东西。我们不知道它在做什么，不知道它在那里发现了什么，但这可能为我们提供了反击的唯一机会。  你现在处于留给我们人类的最后一个微小的银河角落，尽管我们认为可能还有一些被囚禁的定居点仍然幸存。我说这是我们最后的机会，绝非夸张。人工智能目前对我们可怜的最后部队不感兴趣，但它不知道你的存在——当它看到我们的舰队不断壮大，并由能干、聪明的指挥官指挥时，它将会做出反应。你越是侵犯它的领土，越是展示你的力量，它就越有可能碾压我们。  人工智能的部队数量是我们的万倍以上，所以直接突击就是自杀。我们没有资源，几乎没有单位，而我们最先进硬件的蓝图已落入人工智能之手。你的任务是利用我们仅有的一点资源，以你所能的方式将其转化为胜利。从人工智能手中夺回我们的资源，窃取我们曾经轻松建造的单位的知识，并在找到数据中心时将其摧毁。最重要的是，找到并摧毁其核心指挥站以彻底消灭它。  我们已经被打得跪地求饶，但我们不会坐视我们的物种灭亡。你是我们所能培养出的最杰出的军事头脑，所以如果你不能获胜，我们就真的完了。在外面要用脑子，确保不让情绪或侵略性蒙蔽你的良好判断。聪明地战斗。记住你的战术训练以及大局观。在所有人都失败过的地方取得胜利。

column1: Go through the custom lobby and set things up just the way you want. Start the game, then immediately save (at 0 seconds elapsed).  Now quit the game and find your save file. It will be in ~/AIWar2/PlayerData/Save/Your_campaign_name (assuming you've installed the game in ~/AIWar2; otherwise find where the game is installed). Rename the file from Save_Game_File.save (or whatever name you used to save it) to 'YourQuickStartName.save'  Copy the file into ~/AIWar2/GameData/QuickStarts2/Community  Now you'll want to create a tooltip file so people will know what sort of game they're getting into. The tooltip file is named YourQuickStartName.tooltip.  So at the end of this you have a file called YourQuickStartName.save and YourQuickStartName.tooltip in ~/AIWar2/GameData/QuickStarts2/Community. Now you'll be able to find that quick start under the 'Community' section of the Quick Starts menu  If you have one you really like then upload the save and tooltip to the forums and they might get added to the base game!  Note also that you could make 'Quick Starts' that are some time into a campaign. For example, you might want to see if anyone can survive a bad situation, so you could make a Quick Start called 'Last Stand' where the tooltip tells the player 'I lasted 10 minutes; can you last longer?' column1: Hacking points are a non-renewable, finite resource.  Like science!  The only way to get more is by capturing more planets.  That said, one difference between science and hacking is that there's never any way to retrieve spent hacking points, unlike how you can spend hacking points to re-spec your techs and retrieve spent science.          One extremely profitable way to get more hacking points is by finding distribution nodes around the galaxy map.  By destroying these, you'll get several planets' worth of hacking points all at once.        Hacking points are absolutely critical to your ability to fully upgrade your empire over time, and sometimes very important for bypassing (or outright stealing) a tough enemy blockade, so having a good number on hand is a good idea.  Since you can re-spec your science costs (at the cost of some hacking points), there is not a need to 'float' science that you have but just don't use for long stretches of the game.  It's usually better to spend it, and re-spec minorly as the situation evolves.  But with hacking points, since there is no re-spec or refund of any kind, it's absolutely a good idea to keep some extra hacking points on hand (or know where you'll get your next batch of hacking points, if you do need to spend all of your hacking points right now).  You should definitely not be afraid to spend your HaP, because they are something that are integral to your upgrading over time, and there are usually more pockets of HaP waiting for you to capture out there in one fashion or another.  So if you use 90% of the HaP you find close to when you find it, you're not going to hit a crisis point unless you're really playing on a very high level.  In multiplayer, in multi-empire games, it's worth noting that hacking points (unlike science points!) can be traded between empires.  Simply go into the View/Edit Factions menu in the escape menu, or hit F2 as the default hotkey to open it immediately.
column2: 入侵点数是一种不可再生的有限资源，就像科技点数一样！获取更多入侵点数的唯一方法是占领更多行星。不过，入侵点数与科技点数的一个不同之处在于：你永远无法回收已花费的入侵点数，不像你可以花费入侵点数来重新分配科技并回收已用的科技点数。          一个极其高效的获取方式是寻找银河地图上的分配节点。摧毁这些节点可以一次性获得相当于多个行星的入侵点数。  入侵点数对于长期全面升级你的帝国至关重要，有时对于绕过(或直接窃取)敌方坚固封锁也非常重要，因此保持一定储备是明智之举。  由于你可以重新分配科技消耗(花费一些入侵点数)，所以不需要长期'闲置'未使用的科技点数。通常最好是先使用它们，然后根据局势发展进行小幅重新分配。  但对于入侵点数，由于没有任何重新分配或返还机制，保持一些额外储备绝对是个好主意(或者知道当你需要立即花费所有入侵点数时，下一批入侵点数的来源)。  你完全不必害怕花费HaP，因为它们是长期升级的关键，而且通常还有更多HaP等待你去以各种方式获取。所以如果你在发现时就使用掉90%的HaP，除非你在玩非常高难度的游戏，否则不会遇到危机。  在多玩家、多帝国游戏中，值得注意的是入侵点数(与科技点数不同！)可以在帝国之间交易。只需进入Esc菜单中的查看/编辑派系菜单，或按默认快捷键F2立即打开。

column2: 入侵此堡垒将使执行入侵的舰队获得一些可怕巨噬细胞单位。并摧毁该堡垒。

column1: Hacking this Facility will give the Fleet that did it a few of the Azar Empire ships. And destroy the Facility.
column2: 入侵此设施将使执行入侵的舰队获得几个阿扎兰帝国单位，并摧毁该设施。

column1: Hacking this Spire Archive will grant you a large amount of Science, but it takes a long time. Be prepared for an extreme AI response against your units.
column2: 破解这个尖塔档案将为您提供大量科学点数，但这需要很长时间。请做好应对 AI 对您的单位发起极端反击的准备。

column1: Hacking this Vengeance Generator will give the Fleet that did it a few of the Dark Spire ships, but it might have devastating consequences; are you willing to set a fire upon the deep?
column2: 破解这个复仇发生器将为执行破解的舰队提供一些黑暗尖塔单位，但这可能会带来毁灭性的后果；你是否愿意在深渊中点燃一把火？

column1: Hacking this Vengeance Generator will make it vulnerable to conventional weaponry. This is likely to provoke an extremely strong Dark Spire response
column2: 破解这个复仇发生器将使其易受常规武器攻击。这很可能会引发黑暗尖塔极其强烈的反击。

column1: Hacking this beacon will allow you to contact some of the Outguard -- remnant anti-AI forces that can come to your aid.  Since this is going to be routed through the AI communication channels, expect heavy AI response to this. However, once contacted, the Outguard will be at your disposal as-needed for the rest of your campaign.  They can be called directly to planets far from your territory, they don't incur deepstrike or counterstrike penalties, and they can often reach places you may have trouble directly going yourself.            Many outguard can also turn the tide of a conventional battle, if you need them to.  Some others have other functions that are more utilitarian or economic in nature.
column2: 破解这个信标将允许你与一些外层守卫取得联系，他们是残余的反 AI 势力，可以为你提供援助。由于这将通过 AI 通信渠道进行，预计会引发 AI 的强烈反击。然而，一旦取得联系，外层守卫将在你的整个战役中根据需要供你调遣。他们可以直接被召唤到远离你领地的行星，不会产生跨星系打击或反击惩罚，而且他们通常能够到达你自己可能难以直接到达的地方。            许多外层守卫还可以扭转常规战斗的局势，如果你需要的话。还有一些外层守卫具有更实用或经济性质的其他功能。

column1: Hacking this beacon will invite someone into the galaxy...
column2: 破解这个信标将邀请某人进入星系……

column1: Hacking this structure grants one of the following high-starting-mark strikecraft types with a fleet-wide bonus to the fleet you choose to put them in (only works with small fleets).  Hacking does also incur a moderate AI Progress penalty, since these are quite powerful.
column2: 入侵该建筑可获得以下一种高初始等级的攻击机类型，并为你选择放入的舰队提供全舰队加成（仅适用于小型舰队）。由于这些攻击机非常强大，入侵也会导致中等程度的 AI 进度惩罚。

column1: Hacking this structure grants one of the following mid-starting-mark powerful cruiser types, which fills the elite slot of one of your fleets.  Hacking does also incur a moderate AI Progress penalty, since these are quite powerful.
column2: 入侵该建筑可获得以下一种中等初始等级的强大巡洋舰类型，它将填补你某支舰队的精英席位。由于这些巡洋舰非常强大，入侵也会导致中等程度的 AI 进度惩罚。

column1: Hacking this structure grants one of the following mid-starting-mark powerful destroyer types, which fills the elite slot of one of your fleets.  Hacking does also incur a moderate AI Progress penalty, since these are quite powerful.
column2: 入侵该建筑可获得以下一种中等初始等级的强大驱逐舰类型，它将填补你某支舰队的精英席位。由于这些驱逐舰非常强大，入侵也会导致中等程度的 AI 进度惩罚。

column1: Hacking this structure will cause a bunch of enemies to appear. There is no upside to this.
column2: 入侵此结构会导致大量敌人出现。这没有任何好处。

column1: Hacking this will bring this galaxy into congruence with a Dark galaxy. You might get invaded. Scary invaded.  Note that if this beacon is destroyed (perhaps by the Zenith Miners eating a planet) then the DZ will invade. Exciting!  <color=#f25e1c>HIGH IMPACT:</color> This faction drastically changes how the game will play, by introducing another extremely powerful race into the game.
column2: 入侵此信标将使这个星系与一个黑暗星系保持一致。你可能会遭到入侵。非常可怕的入侵。  请注意，如果这个信标被摧毁（可能是被天顶矿工吞噬了一颗行星），那么黑暗天顶将会入侵。这可太刺激了！  <color=#f25e1c>高影响力：</color>这个派系通过引入另一个极其强大的种族，极大地改变了游戏的玩法。
以黑客为主题的名字。由ZeroTheHero创建。

column1: Hammers away at the hull of healthy ships from any range.
column2: 从任意距离猛烈轰击高血量单位的船体。

column1: Hard to fight a war without any ships.
column2: 没有战舰可怎么打仗啊。

column1: Hardened hull technology is still young and was first incorporated into known ship designs, such as the old Assault Frigate. As generals began to fully use the near immunity to sabot weaponry the Assault Frigate II was cancelled and instead a larger, even more sturdy version with more advanced technologies found its way into the tip of the spearhead of attack fleets.
column2: 硬化舰体技术仍然年轻，并首次被纳入已知的单位设计中，例如旧的突击星舰。随着将军们开始充分利用近乎免疫破坏武器的能力，突击星舰II被取消，取而代之的是更大、更坚固的版本，采用更先进的技术，进入了攻击舰队的先锋尖端。

column1: Hardly recognizable.  Much of the map is in pieces.
column2: 几乎无法辨认。地图的大部分都已破碎。

column1: Has Alarm Posts everywhere, watch your step.
column2: 各处都是警报岗哨，小心脚下。

column1: Has a higher priority than it should
column2: 拥有超出其本应有价值的优先度。

column1: Has a powerful but very slow bomb attack, but can slow down enemies trying to escape it.
column2: 拥有强大但非常缓慢的炸弹攻击，但可以减慢试图逃离它的敌人。

column1: Has a small amount of tractor beams, and does more damage to units held in one.
column2: 配备少量牵引光束，对被牵引的单位造成更高伤害。

column1: Has a tractor beam that allows it to immobilise or drag ships around with it.
column2: 拥有牵引光束，可固定或拖拽周围的单位。

column1: Has access to Dark Alliance units (Dark Zenith and Dark Spire) as well as regular AI units.
column2: 可使用黑暗联盟单位（黑暗天顶和黑暗尖塔）以及常规AI单位。

column1: Has access to Fallen Spire and Dark Spire units as well as regular AI units.
column2: 可使用堕落尖塔和黑暗尖塔单位，以及常规AI单位。

column1: Has access to Nanocaust units as well as regular AI units. This AI is incredibly dangerous, since it can take control of your units after killing them..
column2: 可使用纳米灾厄单位以及常规AI单位。这个AI极其危险，因为它能在击杀你的单位后夺取控制权。

column1: Has access to Scourge units as well as regular AI units. Very dangerous.
column2: 可使用灾厄单位以及常规AI单位。非常危险。

column1: Has access to Templar and Elderling units as well as regular AI units. Dangerous.   Most of the Heroic AI's ships will not have any special interactions with the Necromancer.
column2: 可以使用圣殿骑士和远古族单位，以及常规的AI单位。非常危险。  英勇型AI的大多数舰船不会与死灵法师产生任何特殊互动。

column1: Has access to Venators from the start. Venators are very powerful Guardian and Dire Guardian ships designed to be strong counters to certain ship types or factions.  Also has powerful border aggression.
column2: 从游戏开始就可以使用追猎者战舰。追猎者是非常强大的守护者战舰和恐怖守护者战舰，旨在有效克制某些战舰类型或阵营。  同时也具备强大的边境侵略能力。

column1: Has access to Zenith Architrave units as well as regular AI units.
column2: 可使用天顶拱梁单位以及常规 AI 单位。

column1: Has access to ships from a large variety of factions, from the base game and any expansions you are using. These can include Nanocaust, Scourge, Spire, Dark Zenith and Zenith Architrave. Possibly more.  This may be the hardest AI type in the game.
column2: 可以使用来自多种势力的舰船，包括基础游戏和你正在使用的任何扩展包中的舰船。这些势力可能包括纳米灾变、天灾、尖塔、黑暗天顶和天顶拱璧。可能还有更多。  这可能是游戏中最难的 AI 类型。

column1: Has an AI Eye on almost every planet, forcing careful raids with small forces.
column2: 几乎在每颗行星上都部署了AI监视眼，迫使玩家只能用小股部队进行谨慎突袭。

column1: Has been driven mad by the elder forces the AI has allied itself too. Wields a deadly paralyzing beam.
column2: 已被AI所结盟的古老力量逼疯。挥舞致命的麻痹光束。

column1: Has far more Orbital Mass Drivers and a few more Ion Cannons than normal guarding their planets, alongside additional normal defenses.
column2: 拥有远超正常数量的轨道质量驱动器和更多离子炮守卫其行星，同时配备额外的常规防御设施。

column1: Has guns of its own but primarily attacks by spawning small tractor-equipped drones at the rate of 1 every 4 seconds.
column2: 虽然自身配备有武器，但主要通过每4秒发射一个装备牵引光束的小型无人机进行攻击。

column1: Has low durability in exchange for life stealing and high damage output to match. Dispatched to fight the Dyson Sidekick. Equipped with Engine Stunners to trap your transports.
column2: 以低耐久换取生命偷取和高伤害输出。被派遣来对抗戴森盟友。配备引擎眩晕器来困住你的运输船。

column1: Has many Black Hole Machines on its planets, which prevent most ships from leaving while intact.
column2: 在其行星上拥有许多黑洞机器，这些机器会阻止大多数完好无损的单位离开。

column1: Has modest firepower in its own right, but is able to stun enemies using missiles tipped with EMP warheads strong enough to affect even small frigates. Spawns 10 every 12 seconds, 2 more for every mark beyond 1.
column2: 本身拥有适度的火力，但能使用配备电磁脉冲飞弹的导弹眩晕敌人，其强度足以影响小型护卫舰。每12秒生成10枚，1级以上每级多2枚。

column1: Has modest firepower in its own right, but primarily attacks by spawning miniaturized warheads at the rate of 1 every 4 seconds.
column2: 自身具有一定火力，但主要攻击手段是以每4秒1发的速度生成微型飞弹。

column1: Has modest firepower in its own right, but primarily attacks by spawning miniaturized warheads at the rate of 1 every 5 seconds.
column2: 虽然自身火力有限，但主要通过每5秒生成一个微型鱼雷进行攻击。

column1: Haters gotta hate! This AI type extensively features players least favourite AI ships, along with other nasty surprises.  You will hate this AI type or your money back.  Thanks to a number of Discord folks for ideas, including Lord of Nothing, CRCGamer and The Grand Mugwump
column2: 恨就对了！该AI类型大量使用玩家最讨厌的AI单位，以及其它恶心惊喜。  你一定会恨这个AI类型，否则包退钱。  感谢Discord上的许多朋友提供想法，包括 Lord of Nothing、CRCGamer 和 The Grand Mugwump

column1: Have you ever wondered what's beyond our galaxy?  Keep distracting us, and you might find out.
column2: 你有没有想过我们星系之外是什么？继续分散我们的注意力，你可能就会知道了。

column1: Having disentangled itself from the now-defunct Warp Grid, this monstrosity may now put all of its starkly incomprehensible power towards one goal:                               Your destruction.
column2: 从现已失效的曲速网络中解脱出来后，这个庞然大物现在可以将其所有难以理解的强大力量集中于一个目标：                               毁灭你。

column1: Having disentangled itself from the now-defunct Warp Grid, this monstrosity may now put all of its starkly incomprehensible power towards one goal:  Your destruction.
column2: 从现已失效的曲速网络中解脱出来后，这个庞然大物现在可以将其所有难以理解的强大力量集中于一个目标：  毁灭你。

column1: Heals itself whenever it does damage to a target.
column2: 每当对目标造成伤害时，它都会自我修复。

column1: Heavily Fortified bomber craft with increased damage to most slightly larger targets.
column2: 重甲轰炸机，对大多数稍大的目标造成更高伤害。

column1: Heavily defends its planets, but sends minimal waves against the player. Has large CPAs to turn its defense to offense.
column2: 重点防御其行星，但只向玩家发送最小规模的波次攻击。拥有大型CPA(行星反击)能力，可将防御转为进攻。

column1: Heavily focused on Guardians instead of strikecraft. Similar to the Royal, but it only gets regular Guardians, not Royal Guardians.
column2: 主要专注于守护者战舰，而非突击舰。类似于皇家战舰，但它只能获得普通的守护者战舰，而非皇家守护者战舰。

column1: Heavy frigate that deals incredible damage with a beam cannon to multiple targets in a line.
column2: 重型护卫舰，使用光束炮对一条直线上的多个目标造成惊人伤害。

column1: Heavy hitter Frigate that hammers more armored targets, while also bypassing some personal shields.
column2: 重型打击星舰，能重创装甲更厚的目标，同时还能绕过一些个人护盾。

column1: Heavy hitter station-keeping Frigate that hammers more armoured targets, while also bypassing some personal shields.
column2: 重型打击驻留星舰，能重创装甲更厚的目标，同时还能绕过一些个人护盾。

column1: Heavy hitter, especially good at neutralizing defensive fortifications. Its phasion interference bombs are designed to phase out defensive fortifications and jam their weapons. While it is phased, trades its armaments for a vorpal beam to finish off weakened prey.
column2: 强力攻击者，尤其擅长压制防御工事。其相位干扰炸弹旨在使防御工事进入相位状态并干扰其武器。当它进入相位状态时，会将武器换成锋锐光束，以消灭虚弱的目标。

column1: Heavy ships come in all sizes and capabilities, but tend to have large to VERY large amounts of armor.  High amounts of armor does not confer any natural bonuses, but tends to coincide with high amounts of hull health.  There are some specialist high-armor-killer units out there, but beyond that fewer ships get bonuses against them.
column2: 重型单位有各种尺寸和能力，但通常装甲量从大到非常大。高装甲量不会带来任何自然加成，但往往与高船体生命值同时存在。有一些专门的高装甲杀手单位，但除此之外很少有单位对它们有加成。
调试: 发送完整元数据(高负载)

column1: Heavyweight brawler interested in snagging smaller enemies and repeatedly frying their electrical systems.
column2: 重型近战舰，擅长缠住较小的敌人并反复烧毁其电气系统。

column1: Height of the screen when in windowed mode ONLY.  Can be any number between 400 and 7000.  Defaults to 600.  You probably want it larger.
column2: 窗口模式下的屏幕高度。可设置为400-7000之间的任意数值，默认为600。建议设置为更大的值。

column1: Helpful tips specifically for new commanders.
column2: 专门为新指挥官提供的实用建议。

column1: Helpful tips specifically for new commanders.
column2: 专门为新指挥官提供的实用提示。

column1: Helpful: Show Network Sync Details In Escape Menu
column2: 实用: 在ESC菜单显示网络同步详情

column1: Hephaestus Recycling Industries, once a lucrative reprocessing plant, has pivoted towards the war effort. They will lend a fortress-sized crusher turret with a complement of modified acid and jammer turrets to defend one of our planets.
column2: 赫菲斯托斯回收工业原本是一家利润丰厚的再加工工厂，现已转向战争用途。他们将借出一座堡垒大小的破碎机炮塔，以及一组经过改装的酸液炮塔和干扰炮塔，用于保卫我们的一颗行星。

column1: Hide IP Address In Lobby And Esc Menu
column2: 隐藏大厅和ESC菜单中的IP地址
隐藏未发现的随机阵营

column1: Hide Unexplored Planets Outside of Game Lobby
column2: 在游戏大厅外隐藏未探索的行星

column1: Hides the Ship Gimbals, useful for screenshots. Press again to un-hide the Gimbals.
column2: 隐藏单位万向节，适用于截图。再次按下以显示万向节。

column1: Hides the UI, useful for screenshots. Press again to uh-hide the GUI.
column2: 隐藏用户界面，适用于截图。再次按下以显示GUI。

column1: High damage to high-energy targets and even more so with active shields, but also boosts up to 3 other select ship lines to have triple shield power. Relies greatly on its shields to survive.
column2: 对高能量目标和有活跃护盾的目标造成高伤害，并可提升最多3条其他选定单位线至三倍护盾功率。高度依赖自身护盾生存。

column1: High defensive capability, with almost no economy. Grants a damage bonus to allies on this planet (Mark II+), and has the most Turrets.
column2: 高防御能力，几乎没有经济。为行星上的盟友提供伤害加成（Mark II+），并拥有最多的炮塔。

column1: High defensive capability, with almost no economy. Grants a damage bonus to allies on this planet at higher mark and has the most Turrets.
column2: 防御能力强，几乎没有经济产出。等级提升时，为该行星上的友军提供伤害加成，并且拥有最多的炮塔。

column1: High short-range damage to either small numbers of big targets or large numbers of swarmers.
column2: 高短程伤害，对少量大型目标或大量蜂群目标。

column1: High-tech raider with slow but planetary decloaking and anti-albedo weaponry, useful for defense against waves of cloaked enemies.
column2: 高科技突击者，具备缓慢但覆盖全行星的破隐能力和反反照率武器，适用于防御一波波隐形敌人。

column1: High-tech raider with slow but planetary decloaking and anti-albedo weaponry, useful for defense against waves of cloaked enemies. This one has Moonstone woven ito its hull, making it immune to phasing effects and highly reisistant to exotic damage and acid, Necromancy.
column2: 高科技突击者，具备缓慢但覆盖全行星的破隐能力和反反照率武器，适用于防御一波波隐形敌人。此型号将月长石织入船体，使其免疫相位效果，并高度抵抗异类伤害、酸蚀和死灵术。

column1: High-tech raider with slow but planetary decloaking and anti-albedo weaponry, useful for defense against waves of cloaked enemies. This one has been made from refractive material, making it overall tougher and harder to disrupt the hull.
column2: 高科技突击者，具备缓慢但覆盖全行星的破隐能力和反反照率武器，适用于防御一波波隐形敌人。此型号采用折射材料制造，使其整体更坚韧，更难干扰船体。

column1: Higher intensity means the Xu forces are that much bigger.
column2: 强度越高，旭道军队规模越大。

column1: Higher values have more links on average.
column2: 较高的值平均有更多的连接。

column1: Highly durable frigate which supports Kaizers Marauders fleets with tachyon radiation and tractor beams. This one has a higher shield capacity and bubble forcefield.
column2: 高耐久护卫舰，以快子辐射和牵引光束支援凯泽掠夺者舰队。此型号拥有更高的护盾容量和泡泡力场。

column1: Highly durable frigate which supports Kaizers Marauders fleets with tachyon radiation and tractor beams. This one has a higher shield capacity with bubble forcefield, and is fortified using Chelonium.
column2: 高耐久护卫舰，以快子辐射和牵引光束支援凯泽掠夺者舰队。此型号拥有更高的护盾容量和泡泡力场，并使用Chelonium进行了堡垒化强化。

column1: Highly durable frigate which supports Kaizers Marauders with tachyon radiation and tractor beams.
column2: 高耐久护卫舰，用快子辐射和牵引光束支援凯泽掠夺者。

column1: Hits multiple enemies, causing them to take more damage temporarily.
column2: 攻击多个敌人，使其暂时承受更多伤害。

column1: Hold To Adjust Game Speed Style
column2: 按住以调整游戏速度样式

column1: Hold To Give Orders To Stationary Flagships
column2: 按住以向固定旗舰下达命令

column1: Hold To See Ship Strengths And Weaknesses
Hold this button to suppress the tech upgrade 'Are you sure?' prompt, without needing to disable it altogether.
column2: 按住此按钮可抑制科技升级的“确认”提示，而无需完全禁用该提示。

column1: Hold this key down when clicking a button or a ship in order to view the details of any ships contained within that clicked item (ships in a wave, ships in a transport, ships in a fleet, ships improved by a tech).        This is SUPER important for finding out what the actual stats are of ships that otherwise would just be a list of names.
column2: 按住此键并点击按钮或单位，可以查看被点击项目内包含的任何单位的详细信息（波次中的单位、运输舰中的单位、舰队中的单位、被科技改进的单位）。  这对于查看那些原本只显示名称列表的单位的实际数据非常重要。

column1: Hold this key down when you're viewing a ship tooltip, and the regular tooltip will be replaced with what this ship is strong against or weak against.

column1: How much energy should AJEA provide if at all possible? Usually this should be the most expensive ship to build, and then some. 5,000 energy is a good default value that should work for almost any scenario. If you ever find that a big (possibly modded) ship is not being built check whether AJEA is providing enough energy and adjust this value accordingly.  If Auto-Determine Energy Count is enabled it is added to the Target Energy count. Then this is simply a buffer value to not immediately block all ship building if something has been constructed. If Auto-Determine Energy Count is not enabled the value should be a bit higher than the most energy-expensive ship the player can currently build, otherwise there is a chance it will never construct due to not having enough power.
column2: 如果可能的话，AJEA应该提供多少能源？通常这应该是最贵的建造单位所需的能源，再加一些。5,000能源是一个好的默认值，适用于几乎所有场景。 如果你发现某个大型（可能是模组）单位无法建造，请检查AJEA是否提供足够的能源并相应调整此值。  如果启用了「自动确定能源数量」，它会加到目标能源数值上。此时这只是为了防止刚一建造就立即阻塞所有单位建造的缓冲值。 如果未启用「自动确定能源数量」，该值应略高于玩家当前可建造的最耗能单位，否则该单位可能因电力不足而永远无法建造。

column1: How much of an impact are they likely to have on gameplay? When adding an AI-allied scourge, it's roughly equivalent in difficulty to adding a new AI of that strength. At Strength 6 the scourge have access to all their intelligence.  To increase difficulty, either increase AI main difficulty OR(!) Scourge intensity. Doing both makes them much more fearsome, as harder AI makes traveling to Scourge buildings far more difficult. Thus it's harder to cripple them.  Setting this equal to AI main difficulty is good.

column1: Humanity Ascendant (HA) is the default campaign type for AI War 2. column1: Humans don't even control a single homeworld, but rather exist only in a single Ark that must claim a starting world and begin construction from there.          A far more challenging experience than the normal human empire, because while you do start with a powerful ark and a single fleet to go with it, you lack the usual support of dual battlestations.  It is not all negatives, however. This Ark came with maps of a number of systems around its spawn location, and the first planet you capture will cost no AIP, so long as you do it before you go above 20 AIP from other sources. (This does not include any capturables on said planet.)  This mode is based on the earliest test versions of the game, and the Kickstarter design for the game.  Back in 2017, we ultimately decided that this style felt too different from classic AI War, but in 2021 this returned as a challenging and interesting new mode.  STATUS: this mode is largely functional, but I think it's missing some intended bonus defensive structures.

column1: Hypothetical: your fleets rebuild themselves in a fairly automated fashion, and your economy is going well (hopefully), so why not just try to attack that mark 6 planet 30 times in a row and get a little bit more whittled down each time, even though you're far outclassed with your mark 3 fleets?          Answer: Counter Attacks. If you keep attacking and failing, you're leaving a bunch of salvage (wreckage from your ships) on that enemy planet.  The AI will build a messload of ships out of that, and send a counter attack that will seriously hurt and potentially lose you the game if you keep up at it long enough.  Trying and failing to attack a planet is part of the game, and often you will want to take 3-4 passes to go in and destroy a planet that is just slightly out of reach.  So all of that should be quite okay.  But if you try to push that too far -- basically trying to use wall-clock time to get an advantage over the AI -- that could actually be a game-ending situation you place yourself in.  You'll notice the counter attacks getting more intense and hopefully stop that folly in time, but basically the AI is wise to that trick.
column2: 假设：你的舰队可以自动重建，经济状况也不错(希望如此)，那么为什么不尝试连续攻击那个6级行星30次，每次削弱一点点呢？尽管你的3级舰队实力悬殊。          答案：反击。如果你持续攻击失败，你会在敌方行星上留下大量残骸(你单位的残骸)。AI会用这些残骸建造大量单位，并发动反击，如果你持续太久，这可能会严重伤害甚至导致你输掉游戏。  尝试攻击行星失败是游戏的一部分，通常你需要3-4次尝试才能摧毁一个勉强够得上的行星。这些都是可以接受的。  但如果你做得太过火——基本上试图用现实时间来获得对AI的优势——这实际上可能导致游戏结束。你会注意到反击越来越猛烈，希望你能及时停止这种愚蠢行为，因为AI识破了这个把戏。

column1: If enabled AJEA will make its calculations and potential adjustments for each sim step. Note that only the host's setting here matters. Executing AJEA once per sim step increases the CPU use, but makes it more responsive. However, since the values for energy consumption and production aren't instantly updated it may lead to converters being built or destroyed by mistake.  In AIW2 sim steps are attempted to be executed 10x per second. This does not change if the player speeds up or slows down the game speed, but naturally if the CPU unable to keep up it will slow down.
column2: 如果启用，AJEA将在每个模拟步中进行计算和可能的调整。注意此处只有主机的设置生效。 每模拟步执行一次AJEA会增加CPU使用，但使其更灵敏。然而，由于能源消耗和生产的数值并非即时更新，可能导致转换器被错误建造或拆除。  AIW2中模拟步尝试每秒执行10次。这不会因玩家加速或减速游戏速度而改变，但如果CPU无法跟上自然会变慢。

As an item of note: This will not clear the Devourer if it's actively coming after us but only kick the problem down the road. It will, however, take priority.
column2: 如果我们无法与吞噬者傀儡作战甚至无法容忍它，我们也许可以……喂饱它。如果半智能的 Zenith 杀戮机器的行为方式与动物相同，我们可以喂食并"请求"它暂时远离我们的行星。 它的食物是金属，这次入侵对我们的目标帮助不大，但总比被吃掉要好。 需要注意的是：这不会在吞噬者积极追击我们时清除它，而只是将问题推迟。然而，它会获得优先权。

You can use the galaxy map search bar (at the bottom center) to show which planets would trigger a deepstrike.
column2: 如果你在远离自己行星的地方与 AI 作战（即“深度打击”），AI 会生成数量越来越多的单位，看似无穷无尽。它们会赶走你所有进行深度打击的单位，但一旦你撤离，它们的单位就会全部撤回。  你可以使用星系地图底部中央的搜索栏，查看哪些行星会触发深度打击。

column1: If you are constantly surrounded by a ton of AI planets, you may never know exactly where the Hunter Fleet will strike from, or where a CPA will come in, or even where waves might come from with full certainty.          It can be costly in terms of AI Progress (AIP) increases, but a popular strategy is to carve out a small corner of the galaxy to be the main heart of your empire, and have only one or two wormholes leading into or out of that section.  You can then make more of the command stations away from the bottleneck into economic command stations and thus boost your economy, but having taken all those planets will also mean the AI is stronger.  But on the flip side, you're free to focus a lot more of your forces on that bottleneck planet, and then planet-hop (deep-striking) out into the galaxy and take fewer planets outside of your core empire.  As with any strategy that involves increasing AIP, there are pros and cons.  But it definitely can be a boon for new players or players on lower difficulty levels in particular.
column2: 狭窄通道是星系中只有少数虫洞连接不同行星的区域。这些区域对防御非常有用，因为你可以将防御力量集中在小范围内。如果你能控制一个狭窄通道，就能阻止 AI 派遣大型舰队通过该区域。            你应该尝试找出星系中的狭窄通道，并将防御力量集中在这些区域。你可以使用炮塔和力场来防御狭窄通道，也可以使用运输舰在受到攻击时迅速增援防御力量。            不过，你要注意不要过度扩张。如果你试图控制太多狭窄通道，可能会分散兵力，导致已占领的行星失守。你还应该确保狭窄通道的防御协调一致。如果敌方舰队攻击狭窄通道，你需要能够迅速响应并进行防御。
