column1: If you are playing across the Internet, the host will need to give you their Public IP Address, which they can find in the game (in the lobby, or in the escape menu).  If you are playing across a LAN or VPN, they will need to give you one of their Local IP Addresses, which they can also find in the same places.  Both you and the host need to make sure any software firewalls have given permission to AI War 2 to connect through them.
column2: 如果您在互联网上玩游戏，主机需要给您他们的公共IP地址，他们可以在游戏中（在大厅或退出菜单中）找到该地址。  如果您在局域网或VPN中玩游戏，他们需要给您他们的本地IP地址之一，他们也可以在相同的位置找到该地址。  您和主机都需要确保任何软件防火墙都已允许《AI战争2》通过它们进行连接。

column1: If you are playing via GOG, and you're playing across the internet, then this is almost definitely the way to go.  GOG handles NAT punch through for you, and if that fails it provides relay servers.      The downside is mainly that you can only play with other GOG and Steam users, and you need to be on the internet -- if you're on a private LAN with no internet access at a woodland cabin, then using a LAN solution of course is going to be your preferred option.
column2: 如果您通过GOG进行游戏，并且是在互联网上进行游戏，那么这几乎肯定是您的首选方式。GOG会为您处理NAT穿透，如果失败，它会提供中继服务器。      缺点主要是您只能与其他GOG和Steam用户一起玩，并且需要连接互联网 —— 如果您在没有互联网接入的私人局域网（如林间小屋）中，那么使用局域网解决方案当然是您的首选。

column1: If you are streaming multiplayer, you may wish to hide certain info for privacy.  There's a limit to just how much we can hide while still having it be functional, though.  So that's the amount we hide.
column2: 如果您在进行多人游戏直播，可能希望隐藏某些信息以保护隐私。不过功能完整性会限制我们能隐藏的内容。

column1: If you aren't sure what to do next in a game, check the Intel tab of the sidebar.  It aggregates and organizes all the information you've discovered about the galaxy to provide you with a high-level list of targets and goals.    You can get more info by hovering your mouse cursor over a piece of intel, and (in most cases) can view the target by clicking on it.  You can also set Priorities on different objectives which will be reflected on the Galaxy Map.
column2: 如果不确定下一步该做什么，可以查看侧边栏的情报选项卡。它会汇总并整理你发现的关于银河系的所有信息，提供高层次的目标列表。    将鼠标悬停在情报条目上可获取更多信息，大多数情况下点击可查看目标。你还可以为不同目标设置优先级，这会在银河地图上显示。

column1: If you choose to play with fuel, a number of capturable fuel stations throughout the galaxy and the player will be given a starting complement of fuel as well. There are three kinds of fuel; Radon for turrets and other fixed defenses, Argon for mobile ships, and Xenon for Outguard, Arks, and Golems. If the player runs low on fuel, all units in that category will have their Effectiveness reduced. This penalty will be applied to hull, shields, and damage. It is advised to deactivate/destroy units if needed to stay within the current amount of fuel reserves you have available.  Fuel is mandatory only when playing the Logistician or Deathwish campaign types, but is available to be activated in any of the others as well. Fuel is never used by other factions, who will completely ignore it.  -Strategic Sage
column2: 如果你选择启用燃料系统，星系中会分布着一些可夺取的燃料站，玩家也会获得一定数量的起始燃料。燃料分为三种：氡气用于炮塔和其他固定防御设施，氩气用于移动单位，氙气用于前哨、方舟和巨像。如果玩家某种燃料储备不足，该类别的所有单位的效能都会降低。这种惩罚会影响船体、护盾和伤害。建议在必要时停用/摧毁部分单位，以确保当前燃料储备足够使用。  燃料系统仅在后勤官或死亡之愿战役类型中是强制性的，但在其他类型中也可以选择启用。其他势力从不使用燃料系统，他们会完全忽略它。  -Strategic Sage

column1: If you control 3 showdown devices then you can trigger the Final Showdown with the AI by hacking any showdown device. The AI will launch massive assaults on you; you must keep at least 3 showdown devices alive throughout.  For a human empire, you claim a showdown device by capturing the planet. The Necromancer must hack the showdown device to claim it.
column2: 如果你控制了3个决战装置，就可以通过骇入任意一个决战装置来触发与AI的最终决战。AI会对你发起大规模攻击；你必须在整个过程中至少保留3个决战装置存活。  对于人类帝国来说，你可以通过占领行星来夺取决战装置。死灵法师则必须骇入决战装置才能夺取它。

column1: If you have units really far away from any planet you control, 5 hops minimum, there's a chance the AI Reserves will warp in to their location.  This is essentially a large AI force that aims to stop whatever sneaky shenanigans you're up to, being that far away from your territory. It gets larger as you move beyond that 5 hop minimum.  If you want to do such 'deepstrike' operations without them interrupting, you'll have to capture the occasional planet farther out, which extends the safe area.  The reserves spawn a seemingly endless flood of ships in greater and greater numbers the longer you deepstrike. Once you retreat though, they will all pull back to their wormholes and vanish.  You can use the galaxy map search bar (at the bottom center) to show which planets would trigger a deepstrike.

column1: If you lose a planet deep in AI territory, how many seconds will you have to recapture the planet before the AI Reserves start anti-deepstriking attacks against you?        The default is 60 seconds (1 minute), to give you a moment to collect yourself, but still probably have the deepstriking attacks kick in at least a bit if the AI snipes you off a forward planet base.  If the highest-level AI is difficulty 8, it will give you half this time.   If the highest-level AI is difficulty 9 or above, this grace period does not apply at all.
column2: 如果你在AI领土深处失去一个行星，在AI预备队开始反深入突袭攻击你之前，你有多少秒的时间夺回该行星？        默认为60秒（1分钟），给你一点时间收拾自己，但如果AI狙击你的前线行星基地，深入突袭攻击可能还是会至少有点启动。  如果最高级AI的难度为8，它将给你一半的时间。如果最高级AI的难度为9或以上，此宽限期根本不适用。

column1: If you need to skip past a few enemy planets (a very valid thing to do, when it's not worth the AI Progress -- AIP -- increase of taking those intermediate worlds), then you need a way to get there with speed and safety.          Many of the fleets have centerpieces (fleet leaders) that are specifically called transports.  But actually, ALL of your offensive fleets (officer types included, with Arks and Golems and similar at their core) can act as transports for the smaller members of their fleet.  Select any units of the fleet that you wish to have get into their own fleet centerpiece, and hit the L key to have them all load into their respective proper places.  Then you can fly to your destination with just the big centerpieces.  You can put those fleet leaders into 'hold fire' mode (N key) to make it even less likely they will aggro enemies along the way, and then when you reach the destination both turn them out of hold fire mode (N again), and unload all their ships (U key) to wreak havoc.
column2: 如果你需要跳过几个敌方行星(当占领这些中间行星带来的AI进度-AIP-增长不值得时，这是很合理的做法)，那么你需要一种快速安全的到达方式。          许多舰队的核心(舰队领袖)是专门的运输舰。但实际上，你所有的进攻舰队(包括以方舟、戈仑等为核心的军官类型)都可以作为舰队小型成员的运输工具。  选择你想装入舰队核心的任何单位，按L键让它们全部装载到各自的位置。然后你就可以只带着大型核心单位飞往目的地。  你可以将这些舰队领袖设为'停火'模式(N键)来降低途中吸引敌人的概率，到达目的地后同时取消停火模式(再按N键)并卸载所有单位(U键)来制造混乱。

column1: If you want to turn this on, the host or a client can do so at will, and the game will adjust automatically.              This setting causes a vast increase (about 50x) in the amount of data being sent across the network (you can see the amounts in the escape menu), because it will send the metadata about each piece of data, and not just the data itself.  This is not normally a setting you'd want to turn on, but if you get any sort of network send errors, or in particular a 'canary' is hit, then you can have everyone disconnect, turn this setting on, and reconnect.  Shortly you should get a much more informative (to us) error about what data was malformed.  Canaries are our way of finding that there is an error in a general area, but this metadata setting is the way to pinpoint an exact problematic line so that we can fix it.  If a client is getting errors on their end, then the host needs to turn this on so that their data being sent out has the metadata in it.  If a host is getting errors on their end, then the client sending the errors needs to turn on this field so that their data has metadata inside it.  NOTA BENE: Once your game gets 'sufficiently complicated', clients may experience timeouts/connection failures due to the volume of data that needs to be transmitted.
column2: 如需启用此选项，主机或客户端可随时开启，游戏会自动调整。              此设置会显著增加网络传输数据量(约50倍，可在ESC菜单中查看)，因为它会发送每条数据的元数据，而不仅是数据本身。  通常不建议开启此选项，但如果出现网络发送错误，特别是触发'canary'检测时，可让所有玩家断开连接，开启此设置后重新连接。不久后就能获得更详细的错误信息(对我们开发人员很有帮助)，准确定位数据格式问题。  'canary'是我们的错误检测机制，用于发现大致问题区域，而这个元数据设置可以精确定位具体问题代码行。  如果是客户端报错，需要主机开启此选项；如果是主机报错，则需要报错的客户端开启此选项。  注意：当游戏复杂度达到一定程度时，客户端可能会因数据量过大而出现超时/连接失败。

column1: In some far flung corner of the galaxy, a plague of nanobots has arisen.  Some say they were a last ditch effort to destroy the AI from renegade human scientists; others say they were a forgotten weapon from a long dead race.  But wherever they came from, these nanobots are an insatiable plague.  They will conquer planet after planet with their zombification weapons, and once they conquer a planet they will continue to build more of their race.  If you've ever wondered what the AI were dealing with when it wasn't fighting you, well...          This faction can be one of the biggest competitors to the AI in terms of outright territory capture if you raise their Strength high enough in the lobby.  This can be both good and bad for you, but at least makes it so that it's now a three-sided war.  As with all the factions, you still only have to defeat the AI itself in order to win.  And if you're feeling like you want an alien buddy to play with, you can make the Nanocaust outright allied to you from the start using the lobby settings.
column2: 在星系某个遥远角落，一场纳米机器人瘟疫已经兴起。有人说它们是叛变人类科学家消灭AI的最后努力；也有人说它们是早已灭绝种族的遗忘武器。无论来源如何，这些纳米机器人都是永不满足的瘟疫。它们会用僵尸化武器征服一个又一个行星，并在征服后继续繁衍。如果你曾好奇AI不与你作战时在忙什么，嗯...          如果在游戏大厅将强度设得足够高，这个派系可能是AI在领土争夺上最大的竞争对手之一。这对你既有利也有弊，但至少让战争变成了三方博弈。  与其他派系一样，你只需击败AI本身就能获胜。如果想找个外星伙伴，可以在游戏大厅设置中让纳米浩劫一开始就与你结盟。

column1: In standard play on the default Humanity Ascendant mode, skilled and experienced AI War 2 players have found beachheading - building turrets on enemy planets - to be far more effective than relying primarily on mobile fleets and ships.  Expert Mode aims to achieve a more balanced approach in which beachheading can still be used but is not as overpowered as a strategy.  As you've probably noticed, you are restricted to a single battleship selection instead of the default two.  Additionally, hacking TSS for additional turrets will only grant them to the battlestation if you use the 3X option for just the battlestation.  When using the 1X option, those turrets will only be granted to your command stations, and the battlestation's complement will remain unchanged.  Beachheading is now more expensive; turrets on planets that are not player-owned costs 150% more to build, and have reduced range as well to limit the effectiveness of a variety of cheese tactics. The range reductions are as follows; infinite-range turrets reduced to 15k; turrets with over 11k range have a 30% reduction; those from 6k-11k are reduced 15%; below 6k are not reduced at all. Note that losing a command station during a battle can be a major blow, since it could reduce the range of your turrets.  Finally, the amount of time that AI opponents must wait to utilize their full reinforcement cap has been reduced significantly, to counteract 'speed assassinations' in which the player could knock out a high-level AI before they had enough resources to truly fight back effectively.  This approach was arrived at in no small part due to the much-appreciated brainstorming and expertise of balance guru CRCGamer, and is a compromise solution that was the result of much debate and discussion.  Feedback is appreciated as always and tweaks are possible.  The goal is to continue allowing as many playstyles are possible, while not leaving a clear and major imbalanced strategy open to easy exploitation.
column2: 在默认的“人类崛起”模式的标准玩法中，有经验的《AI 战争 2》玩家发现，在敌方行星上建造炮塔的滩头推进策略比主要依靠机动舰队和单位更为有效。专家模式旨在实现一种更平衡的玩法，让滩头推进策略仍可使用，但不会过于强大。  正如你可能已经注意到的，你只能选择一艘战列舰，而不是默认的两艘。此外，通过入侵技术从 TSS 获取额外炮塔时，只有在为战列舰单独使用 3 倍选项时，这些炮塔才会分配给战列舰。使用 1 倍选项时，这些炮塔只会分配给你的指挥站，战列舰的炮塔配置不会改变。  滩头推进现在成本更高；在非玩家控制的行星上建造炮塔的成本增加 150%，射程也会缩短，以限制各种投机取巧策略的效果。射程缩短规则如下：无限射程的炮塔缩短至 15000；射程超过 11000 的炮塔缩短 30%；射程在 6000 - 11000 之间的炮塔缩短 15%；射程低于 6000 的炮塔不受影响。 请注意，在战斗中失去指挥站可能会造成重大打击，因为这可能会缩短你的炮塔射程。  最后，AI 对手使用全部增援上限所需等待的时间大幅缩短，以应对“速杀”策略，即玩家在高级 AI 有足够资源有效反击之前将其击败。  这一方案在很大程度上得益于平衡大师 CRCGamer 的集思广益和专业知识，是经过大量讨论和辩论后得出的折衷方案。一如既往，欢迎提供反馈，也有可能进行调整。目标是在不留下明显且严重失衡的策略供玩家轻易利用的前提下，尽可能支持更多的游戏风格。

column1: In the first game, unlocking a tech would give you a smaller ship cap of the higher-mark ships in addition to the lower-mark ships you already had.  That had many benefits, but also led to certain kinds of micromanagement that was unpleasant.        In this sequel, if you upgrade (for instance) Fusion Bombers by one mark level, then ALL of them become the higher mark immediately, and the ship cap increases a bit.  They don't become more expensive, so you don't have to worry about that tanking your economy.  It is possible to have Engineers (or some other ship types) of multiple mark levels in your empire, because if they gained marks from some techs and also from some fleet-specific science-based direct upgrades, then one fleet might have stronger Engineers than another.  But beyond that, you're looking at the same max level at all times.
column2: 前作中解锁科技会在已有低等级单位基础上给你少量高等级单位上限。这有诸多好处，但也导致了一些令人不快的微操管理。        本作中，如果你升级某种单位(比如聚变轰炸机)的等级，所有该类型单位会立即提升到更高等级，同时单位上限略微增加。它们不会变得更昂贵，所以不用担心影响经济。  你的帝国可能会有多个等级的工程师(或其他单位类型)，因为如果它们同时从科技和舰队特定的科研直接升级获得等级提升，那么一支舰队的工程师可能比另一支更强。但除此之外，你看到的都是相同的最高等级。

column1: In the first game, you could unlock new ship lines via techs, and you could also upgrade individual ship types via techs.  This was... problematic once you started having too many ship types to choose from.  A lot of things just never got upgraded.        Instead, now there are a variety of themed techs, and individual ship types subscribe to one or more of them.  Upgrading one of your techs potentially causes a bunch of your ship lines to gain a mark all at once.  Note that many of the techs can only be researched 2-4 times, not the full 7.  You'll have to either take advantage of ships that subscribe to multiple techs (those are additive), and some science-based direct leveling up of your fleets.  You have many more types of ships now, although only a few types might come with each fleet.  So looking for synergies is definitely a smart thing to do.
column2: 前作中可以通过科技解锁新单位系列，也能升级特定单位类型。但随着可选单位类型增多，这变得问题重重，很多单位从未被升级过。        现在改为多种主题科技，每种单位类型关联一个或多个科技。升级某项科技可能同时提升多个关联单位系列的等级。  注意许多科技只能研究2-4次，而非完整的7次。你需要利用关联多个科技的单位(效果叠加)，以及基于科研的舰队直接升级。  现在单位类型更多，但每支舰队只包含少数几种。因此寻找协同效应绝对是明智之举。

column1: In the first game, you had per-planet caps of turrets and other defenses.  You got more by unlocking new ship lines.        In this sequel, you get relatively little for defending yourself at the start of the game.  You can use battlestations and citadels, but there are very few of them in the galaxy.  Instead, what you want to do is hack Turret Schematic Servers (TSS) and Other Defensive Schematic Servers (ODSS).  TSS hacks grant additional turret lines, while ODSS hacks give you non-turret defensive structures such as mines, tractor arrays and gravity generators.  Keep in mind that hacking these servers requires twice as many hacking points if you don't own the planets where they are located.  This is basically the same sort of per-planet cap system as before, but it's driven by hacking AI servers rather than spending science.  You also have the option of adding these defensive options to your battlestations and citadels.  Doing this grants you three times the number of turrets or other structures, but as a global cap instead of a per-planet one.  Even beyond this, however, the type of command station you use gives you a bonus to per-planet caps:  Logistical get the default amount, Military get 2x the default amount, and Economic get half the normal amount.
column2: 前作中每个行星都有炮塔和其他防御设施的上限，通过解锁新单位系列来获得更多。        本作开局时防御能力相对较弱。你可以使用战斗空间站和要塞，但星系中这类设施很少。  相反，你需要黑入炮塔蓝图服务器(TSS)和其他防御蓝图服务器(ODSS)。TSS入侵操作可获得额外炮塔系列，而ODSS入侵操作则提供地雷、牵引阵列和重力发生器等非炮塔防御设施。注意，如果你不拥有这些服务器所在的行星，入侵操作需要双倍入侵点数。  这基本上与之前的单行星上限系统类似，但改为通过黑入AI服务器而非消耗科技点数来实现。你还可以将这些防御选项添加到战斗空间站和要塞。这样做会让炮塔或其他设施数量增加三倍，但变成全局上限而非单行星上限。  此外，指挥站类型也会影响单行星上限：后勤型获得默认数量，军事型获得默认两倍，经济型获得正常数量的一半。

column1: In the lobby and during gameplay, there are messages sent by the network as frequently as every 100ms, but more often some sporadic multiple of that.  This is how factions tell everyone what they want their ships to do, and how human players say the same.  There's very little that we can say about this in a meaningful way in the networking log level, and again this will tend to crowd out the other messages that happen.  So by default these are disabled, but bear in mind that most things that players actually cause to happen are being caused through these batch messages.
column2: 在大厅和游戏过程中，网络大约每100ms发送一次消息(有时更频繁)。这是派系告诉所有人他们想让单位做什么的方式，也是人类玩家的操作方式。在网络日志级别上我们很难有意义地描述这些内容，而且这些消息往往会挤占其他消息的空间。因此默认禁用，但请注意玩家实际导致的大多数操作都是通过这些批次消息触发的。

column1: In the lobby and during gameplay, there are messages sent by the network every 100ms or so to keep themselves in sync, and if you have them included they will tend to crowd out the rest of the messages that are sent.  So by default these are disabled.

Recent upgrades also include the ability to link sensory data between ships for increased precision and thus attack range.

column1: Information management is a big part of this game, and if you reveal the entire map from the start, you get flooded with information overload.  Also it makes certain things a bit too easy to plan.  If you go a step further, and set all the planets to Watched, then you can see all enemy movements all the time, which completely negates any need for Spies and other core mechanics like how Logistical command stations can watch a large area around them.  For most people, therefore, using those sorts of tools is clearly a cheat that circumvents a nontrivial part of the game.  On the other hand, there is a subset of players who simply prefers to focus on other things in the game, and who view this as a lifestyle choice: they get up to plenty-complicated games without this on.  Below the Expert campaign type, we thus leave it to you to decide if you feel like this is a cheat or not for your purposes (that mainly impacts ability to get achievements).  On Expert and above, you'll have to manage your intel fully.
column2: 信息管理是这个游戏的重要部分，如果你一开始就揭示整个地图，你会被信息过载淹没。同时，这也会让某些事情变得太容易规划。  如果你更进一步，将所有行星设为监视状态，那么你可以一直看到所有敌人的动向，这完全否定了对间谍和其他核心机制的需求，比如后勤指挥站如何能监视周围大面积区域。  因此，对大多数人来说，使用这类工具显然是一种作弊行为，规避了游戏的重要部分。另一方面，有一部分玩家只是更喜欢专注于游戏中的其他方面，他们将此视为一种生活方式选择：即使没有这些信息，他们的游戏也足够复杂。  在专家战役类型以下，我们让你自己决定是否认为这是一种作弊（这主要影响获取成就的能力）。在专家及以上难度，你将必须完全管理你的情报。

column1: Is the game mysteriously stuck?  This will kill all of the threads the game has started, which may corrupt the game or make it crash.  However, it will give us stack traces (locations in code) of exactly where the game is stuck  So that's highly useful to us, and you can find the results in ArcenDebuggingLog.txt.  The game may crash, or may continue running perfectly after this, but either way we'd love the logs.  If it resumes running properly, then saving your game, exiting, and restarting the game from the OS is probably a good idea.

column1: It's tempting to just use as many economic command stations as possible, to maximize your economy.          But consider: your military command stations get more and often stronger turrets, and so are very useful when they are planets out on their own, or planets on your border.  You can always switch command station types later on if you need to, but these are often useful when you're in new and dangerous territory.  Even when it comes to the turrets and structures granted by Turret Schematic Servers and Other Defensive Structure Servers (TSSs and ODSSs -- those new things that give you more turrets or other defenses if you hack them), military command stations get 2x what logistical command stations get, and 4x what economic command stations get.

column1: Lead by Dread Pirate Kaizer these deep-space Marauders return from their involuntary intergalactic journey to the Human home galaxy. When they arrive they will begin harvesting metal and using it to heavily fortify planets with advanced turrets - then spawn highly effective ship designs in order to conquer more territory.  Using Parametrium-based drive technology their ability to appear anywhere and everywhere in the blink of an eye makes them only predictable in that they are likely to be anywhere in the galaxy where there's no resistance to thwart them. Expect to see them frequently near your planets if they border on neutral or neutered worlds.  As their technology is similar to the Human Remnant large parts of it can be... Assimilated via hacks. Be it outnumbered Raiders becoming defectors, allowing the player to acquire new centerpieces and fleet lines, or hacking turrets from outposts and the Marauder Capital for battlestations, citadels and command stations: Merging these human technologies can greatly increase the power of the Human Remnant.  In Kaizer the game receives another alternate victory condition. If this powerful boss is defeated in combat and derelict hacked the player can gain an incredibly powerful centerpiece that can easily break open a path to the AI's bastion and home worlds, taking on entire fleets by itself in the process and win the game - before the AI's response overwhelms the player's planets. Note that Kaizer is barred from spawning by default and must be enabled.  <color=#f25e1c>HIGHLY VARIABLE IMPACT:</color> This faction expands, and can do irreparable damage. If allowed to expand enough, they can be an enormous threat or powerful ally.

column1: Let's try to explain everything, concisely, in one entry.          First the main idea of the game. You start out with one planet, and some starting forces.  The AI holds everything else.  You'll see a symbol at the top with the number 10 next to it. That's 'AI Progress,' and is essentially how aware of you it is, and how powerful it is.         You want to go about the galaxy, keeping that as low as possible, while making sure to capture and destroy the right things.  If you try to capture every planet without regard as to what benefits it'd give, you'll most likely lose quickly.  You need to make sure what you pay the AIP for is worth it, essentially.  Eventually, you'll become strong enough to attack the AI(s) Homeworld and win.  You lose if the AI is able to destroy yours.  ---  For units and structures, everything is pre-organised into 'Fleets.'  They all have a flagship of some kind, as well as units that are part of it.  When you start a game there should be three hopefully-visible things: a Transport Flagship (mobile offensive units), a Battlestation (think turrets, minefields), and a Combat Factory (rebuilds any losses of your mobile offensive stuff). If you hover the mouse over each one, you'll see at the bottom of the tooltip what things are in it (40 V-Wings, 30 Concussion Turrets, things like this).  Fleets are like Control Groups, mostly?  A selection of units that you can order around together, but it's a pre-made composition with a specific Leader unit tied to it (the flagship).  On the left side of the screen, in the sidebar, you should see a 'FLEETS' Tab.  In there will be every single Fleet you have.  If you click on one, you can see some more information and change the name (by default they're randomised).  Some Fleets operate differently, such as the defensive turret ones compared to the mobile combat units:  For mobile combat fleets, units aren't built via a sidebar tab, or ordered from an interface menu or anything.  You'll see a robotic arm or crane icon on your starting planet - that's a Factory.  When the flagship of such a fleet is currently missing units (i.e., 10/40 V-Wings), and is on the same planet or a planet next to a Factory, said Factory will automatically build replacements for the fleet and warp it to the flagship.  When you start a game you'll see this occurring.  For the fleets with Turrets for instance, granted via the Battlestation you start with or the Command Station of a planet, those are built via the sidebar, like a lot of RTS games like Command and Conquer 3 in the 'BUILD' Tab.  You can only build Turrets from such a Fleet if the Flagship is on that planet.  Battlestations can move, and so can put their turrets anywhere (even attacking the enemy with them), but Command Stations can only build on their own planet.  Those rules apply to other support structures, like Factories and Energy Collectors, as well.  ---  Command Stations are how you or the AI controls a planet.  If you destroy the AI Station, the planet goes to neutral.  If you then build your own, you take control of it and can capture anything on it, like a new fleet (this is the main way of getting new ships or ship types).  To build a new Station, you need a Flagship there, like the Transport Flagship mentioned earlier.  Then the options appear in the 'BUILD' Tab.  Capturing planets are the main way you get resources: Metal (credits, Tyderian, so on), Energy (kind of an upkeep? it's like a total popcap deal), Science (points you spend on Tech upgrades), and Hacking (points to spend on doing sneaky things, like weakening an AI planet or having the effects of something permanently, or to mess with a Dyson Sphere).  When you capture a planet, all the resource structures (Metal Harvesters and Energy Collectors) are built automatically, and the Station collects all Science and Hacking by itself too.  ---  Some other random quick notes:  If you double click on a Flagship icon on a planet, it'll select everything part of that Fleet there.  If you hold C and click various ships/structures that contain other ships, OR click things like tech or enemy-wave buttons, then you can get a lot of extra information on the ships contained inside or otherwise contextually relevant.  It makes planning so much easier!   If you right-click on a Fleet in the 'FLEETS' Tab, it'll do the same behaviour above if you're viewing a planet, or if you're looking at the Galaxy Map, select everything in the Galaxy.  Both of these let you move and rally them easier.  If units of a Mobile Fleet are selected, and their Flagship is present, pressing 'L' will load those units into it.  'U' to unload.  Only mobile units can be loaded.  You can scout new worlds by hacking them.  Hacking is one of the tabs on the left sidebar of the UI.  However, a better way to scout is simply to capture new planets.  As you do so, planets near your borders are automatically revealed.  You may want to save your hacking points for something more juicy.  Lastly, you might've noticed some 'Modes' in the bottom right corner, like Attack Move, Pursuit Mode and so on.  If you put a Flagship in one of these modes, any replacement units for it will inherit that mode.
column2: 让我们试着用一段内容简洁地解释所有内容。          首先是游戏的主要概念。你从一个行星和一些初始部队开始。AI 控制着其他所有行星。你会在屏幕顶部看到一个符号，旁边有数字 10。那是“AI 进度值”，本质上代表 AI 对你的关注程度以及它的实力。         你要在星系中行动，尽可能降低这个值，同时确保占领和摧毁正确的目标。如果你不加考虑地试图占领每一个行星，很可能很快就会输掉游戏。本质上，你需要确保为 AIP 付出的代价是值得的。  最终，你会变得足够强大，能够攻击 AI 的母星并取得胜利。如果 AI 摧毁了你的母星，你就输了。  ---  关于单位和建筑，一切都预先组织成“舰队”。每个舰队都有某种旗舰，以及隶属于它的单位。游戏开始时，应该会看到三个可见的东西：一艘运输旗舰（移动进攻单位）、一个战斗空间站（想想炮塔、雷区）和一个机动兵工厂（重建你的移动进攻单位的损失）。如果你将鼠标悬停在每个单位上，会在工具提示的底部看到其中包含的单位（40 架 V 翼战机、30 座震荡炮塔之类的）。  舰队大致类似于编队？它是一组你可以一起指挥的单位，但它是一个预先设定好的组合，与一个特定的领袖单位（旗舰）相关联。在屏幕左侧的侧边栏中，你应该会看到一个“舰队”选项卡。里面会显示你拥有的每一支舰队。如果你点击其中一个，你可以看到更多信息并更改名称（默认情况下是随机的）。  有些舰队的运作方式不同，比如防御炮塔舰队与移动战斗单位舰队：  对于移动战斗舰队，单位不是通过侧边栏选项卡建造，也不是从界面菜单中订购。你会在起始行星上看到一个机械臂或起重机图标——那是一个工厂。当这样一支舰队的旗舰当前缺少单位时（例如，40 架 V 翼战机中只剩 10 架），并且它所在的行星或相邻行星有工厂，该工厂会自动为舰队建造替换单位并将它们传送到旗舰。游戏开始时你会看到这种情况发生。  例如，通过你起始时拥有的战斗空间站或行星的指挥站获得的炮塔舰队，这些炮塔是通过侧边栏建造的，就像很多即时战略游戏（如《命令与征服 3》）中的“建造”选项卡一样。只有当旗舰在该行星上时，你才能从这样的舰队中建造炮塔。战斗空间站可以移动，因此可以将炮塔放置在任何地方（甚至用它们攻击敌人），但指挥站只能在自己的行星上建造。这些规则也适用于其他支援建筑，如工厂和能量收集器。  ---  指挥站是你或 AI 控制行星的方式。如果你摧毁了 AI 的指挥站，行星将变为中立状态。如果你随后建造自己的指挥站，你就控制了该行星，并可以占领上面的任何东西，比如一支新的舰队（这是获得新单位或单位类型的主要方式）。要建造一个新的指挥站，你需要在那里有一艘旗舰，比如前面提到的运输旗舰。然后“建造”选项卡中会出现相应选项。  占领行星是你获取资源的主要方式：金属（信用点、泰伯利亚矿等）、能量（有点像维护费用？类似于总人口上限机制）、科研（用于科技升级的点数）和入侵（用于做一些秘密事情的点数，比如削弱 AI 行星、永久获得某些效果或干扰戴森球）。当你占领一个行星时，所有资源建筑（金属采集器和能量收集器）会自动建造，指挥站也会自行收集所有科研和入侵点数。  ---  其他一些随机的快速提示：  如果你双击行星上的旗舰图标，它会选中该行星上属于该舰队的所有单位。  如果你按住 C 键并点击包含其他单位的各种单位/建筑，或者点击科技或敌人波次按钮，你可以获得很多关于内部包含的单位或其他相关信息。这让规划变得容易多了！   如果你在“舰队”选项卡中右键单击一支舰队，如果你正在查看一个行星，它会执行上述相同的操作，或者如果你正在查看星系地图，它会选中星系中的所有单位。这两种方式都能让你更轻松地移动和集结它们。  如果你选中了一支移动舰队的单位，并且它们的旗舰在场，按“L”键会将这些单位装载到旗舰中。按“U”键卸载。只有移动单位可以被装载。  你可以通过入侵侦察新的行星。入侵是界面左侧侧边栏中的选项卡之一。然而，更好的侦察方法只是占领新的行星。当你这样做时，你边境附近的行星会自动被揭示。你可能想把你的入侵点数留作更重要的用途。  最后，你可能注意到右下角有一些“模式”，比如攻击移动、追击模式等等。如果你将一艘旗舰设置为其中一种模式，它的任何替换单位都会继承该模式。

column1: Lets you adjust the effective range of all of the ships in the galaxy -- yours and enemies.  Does not affect 'infinite' sniper ranges, naturally.  Also does impact tractor beams.  The default is 0.8x in order to avoid the 'small world' problem where all the enemies are fighting you at once on a planet.             This does make it so that you need to be slightly more strategic with placements of your own turrets, of course.  Your turrets naturally have more range than their AI counterparts, though.
column2: 允许你调整星系中所有单位(包括你的和敌人的)的有效攻击范围。当然不会影响'无限'狙击范围。也会影响牵引光束。默认值为0.8倍，以避免'小世界'问题(即所有敌人同时在行星上攻击你)。  这确实意味着你需要更策略性地布置自己的炮塔。不过，你的炮塔自然比AI的炮塔有更远的射程。

column1: Logistician Mode aims to increase strategic depth by adding infrastructure the player must defend in order to continue fielding an effective military force.  This impacts what planets you will want to take, and how you will deploy your military to ensure vital assets are not destroyed.  To that end, three types of fuel have been added to the resource bar:  Argon for mobile fleets, Radon for turrets and other stationary defenses, and Xenon for Officers, Outguard, Citadels, etc.  You have a basic starting supply of these resources sufficient to fund your first few planets, but eventually you will need to acquire and defend new Fuel Stations to properly supply your units.  You can build new units beyond your fuel capacity, but they will rapidly lose effectiveness;  any unit with effectiveness below 100% will see proportional penalties applied to their durability and damage output.  Defend your Fuel Stations well, or face the consequences.
column2: 后勤专家模式旨在通过增加玩家必须保护的基础设施来提升战略深度，以维持一支有效的军事力量。这会影响你想要占领的行星，以及你部署军队以确保重要资产不被摧毁的方式。  为此，资源栏中新增了三种燃料：供机动舰队使用的氩气，供炮塔和其他固定防御设施使用的氡气，以及供军官、外层警卫、堡垒等使用的氙气。你初始拥有基本的燃料储备，足以支撑你最初占领的几个行星，但最终你需要获取并保护新的燃料站，才能为你的部队提供充足的补给。你可以建造超出燃料容量的新单位，但它们的效能会迅速下降；任何效能低于 100% 的单位，其耐久度和伤害输出都会受到相应的惩罚。  好好保护你的燃料站，否则后果自负。

column1: Logistician mode is a step up from the 'normal' advanced player meta, and one that divides opinion.  This adds in concepts like fuel as a required component, which makes the game substantially more complex to manage, and makes you have many fronts that you must defend.              Overall, Expert mode is meant to be where the advanced players move if they want a more challenging version of the normal game.  Logistician and higher changes the nature of the game in ways that many players enjoy, but others may find off-putting.  Details: In addition to everything that Expert mode adds, this mode forces on fuel, which require you to think differently about how you take and hold territory.  There are some other features that are only forced on for Logistician and higher, but you can enable most of those features in lower modes as well.
column2: 后勤专家模式比“常规”高级玩家的玩法更上一层楼，且存在争议。此模式添加了燃料等必要元素，这使得游戏管理变得更加复杂，你必须防守多个战线。              总的来说，如果高级玩家想要更具挑战性的常规游戏版本，他们会选择专家模式。后勤专家及更高难度模式会以许多玩家喜欢但也有玩家反感的方式改变游戏的本质。  详情：除了专家模式添加的所有内容外，此模式还强制启用燃料机制，这要求你以不同的方式思考如何占领和守住领土。还有一些功能仅在后勤专家及更高难度模式下强制启用，但你也可以在较低难度模式下启用其中大部分功能。

column1: Make sure that you've already read about AI Progress, or this won't make any sense.          The key conceit of the game is essentially that planets all cost you AIP when you capture them, and that you need to therefore choose targets wisely.  So if, for example, you see a super weak planet that has no real capturables on it (no fleets, etc), then capturing that is... questionable.  Generally speaking, you want to only capture planets that give you some interesting capturables (new fleets, etc), and then you'll want to mine the science and hacking points off them.   If you want, you can also try to keep any planet you capture as a long-term holding and thus have an increased metal flow and more places to build energy reactors.  But depending on the positioning of the planet, that can be hard.  Losing the planet won't cost you anything permanent, though, so you may as well try for it -- heck, sometimes that can provide an excellent distraction for the AI, where they attack your planet in the middle of nowhere and take it back rather than attacking something you feel is more critical to your empire.  Capturing ANY planet will give you the same amount of science and hacking points (if you then hold the planet for a while), so that's a benefit no matter what.  And some are richer in metal than others.  So there's always SOME benefit to any planet.  Some planets also have value simply because of their position.  A super uninteresting planet that is next to your homeworld might be something that you decide to go snuff out because you want to guard your back door, so to speak.  Or another planet might be out in the middle of nowhere near the AI's homeworld and you're choosing to take that so that you have a convenient staging area from which to launch attacks against the AI.  There are goodies everywhere for you to capture, so the main thing is to just look at them and see what fits with your playstyle and strategy, and to then go for those.  If you need to fill in with less-valuable planets to give yourself extra buffer or staging area, you'll likely start to feel that need increasingly acutely as you play a given campaign.  Both the galaxy map screen (Tab to get to that), and the Intel tab of the sidebar, give you a ton of info on interesting things to capture.  One in a spatial map format, and the other in a list format.
column2: 确保你已经了解过 AI 进度值，否则下面的内容可能会让你摸不着头脑。  游戏的核心概念是，占领每个行星都会让你的 AI 进度值（AIP）上升，因此你需要明智地选择攻击目标。  例如，如果你看到一个超级弱小的行星，上面没有什么值得占领的东西（没有舰队等），那么占领这个行星就……值得商榷了。  一般来说，你应该只占领那些能给你带来有趣战利品（新舰队等）的行星，然后从中获取科研点数和入侵点数。  如果你愿意，你也可以尝试长期占领你所征服的行星，这样就能增加金属资源的收入，并获得更多建造能量反应堆的地点。不过，这取决于行星的位置，可能会有一定难度。  不过，失去行星并不会让你有永久性的损失，所以你不妨一试——嘿，有时候这还能很好地分散 AI 的注意力，让它们去攻打你偏远地区的行星，而不是你认为对帝国更关键的地方。  占领任何行星（只要你能守住一段时间）都能获得相同数量的科研点数和入侵点数，所以这总归是有益的。而且有些行星的金属资源比其他行星更丰富。所以，每个行星都有一定的价值。  有些行星的价值仅仅体现在它们的位置上。比如，一个紧挨着你母星的不起眼行星，你可能会决定将其拿下，也可以说是为了保护你的后方。或者，另一个位于 AI 母星附近偏远地区的行星，你可能会选择占领它，以便有一个方便的攻击 AI 的出发基地。  到处都有值得你占领的好东西，所以关键是看看哪些符合你的游戏风格和策略，然后去争取它们。如果你需要占领一些价值较低的行星来为自己提供额外的缓冲地带或出发基地，那么在玩某个战役时，你可能会越来越强烈地感觉到这种需求。  星系地图屏幕（按 Tab 键切换）和侧边栏的情报选项卡都能为你提供大量关于值得占领目标的信息。一个以空间地图的形式呈现，另一个则以列表的形式呈现。

column1: Metal Harvesters are one of your most major sources of metal, and normally can be rebuilt if you lose them.  Turning on permadeath for them (not the default!) makes the game vastly harder.
column2: 金属采集器是你最主要的金属来源之一，通常在被摧毁后可以重建。为它们启用永久死亡(非默认设置！)会使游戏难度大幅增加。

column1: Metal-rich asteroid with attached mine and refinery, plus an onboard energy powerplant.  High stakes to defend, as these are expensive and slow to rebuild, as well as being the bulk of your economic output on a planet.  The type of command station you place on a planet has an enormous impact on how much each of these asteroids generates for you.
column2: 富含金属的小行星，附带矿场、精炼厂以及一个机载能源发电厂。防御风险较高，因为它们重建成本高昂且耗时，同时也是您在一个行星上经济产出的主要部分。您在行星上放置的指挥站类型对这些小行星为您带来的收益有巨大影响。

column1: Metal-rich asteroid with attached mine and refinery.  Low stakes to defend, as they can be rebuilt quickly and cheaply and are a small-ish part of your economy.
column2: 富含金属的小行星，附带矿场和精炼厂。防御风险较低，因为它们可以快速且低成本地重建，并且在您的经济体系中占比较小。

column1: Metal-rich asteroid with attached mine and refinery. This has been infested by the Macrophage, causing it to act as a host of Histiocytes. Can be destroyed to cleanse it, reverting it back to its neutral form.
column2: 富含金属的小行星，附有采矿和冶炼设施。已被巨噬细胞感染，使其成为组织细胞的宿主。可以被摧毁以净化它，恢复其中立形态。

column1: Mid sized fast vessel, feeds on enemies converting them to its side, while bringing back fallen allies.
column2: 中型快速单位，吞噬敌人并将其转化为己方力量，同时复活倒下的盟友。

column1: Militarized sentry post that deals more damage when protected by a bubbleshield and can only be built through command stations. Produces trailblazers that lays mines as it get in melee range of enemies, drawing fire in order to release deadly ambush drones in the midst of battle. The number of trailblazers launched increase with mark level of the garrison, maxing at mark V. <color=#FF5454>MAX CAP of 1 PER PLANET!</color>
column2: 军事化岗哨站，在泡泡护盾的保护下能造成更多伤害，且只能通过指挥站建造。它会生产开拓者无人机，这些无人机在接近敌人近战范围时会布设地雷，并在战斗中吸引火力，释放致命的伏击无人机。卫戍站的等级越高，发射的开拓者无人机数量越多，最高五级。<color=#FF5454>每个行星最多建造1座！</color>

column1: Military command center. If destroyed, you lose control of the planet. Extremely powerful combatant, ideal for dangerous border planets. Expensive to build. Its economic output is pathetic, especially in term of energy, so don't rely too much on them. From Mark II onward, it gains a planet-wide damage amplification effect on all friendly units.
column2: 军事指挥中心。如果被摧毁，您将失去对该行星的控制。极其强大的战斗单位，非常适合危险的边境行星。建造费用高昂。其经济产出可怜，尤其是在能量方面，所以不要太依赖它们。从 Mark II 开始，获得对行星上所有友方单位的全行星伤害放大效果。

column1: Military command center. If destroyed, you lose control of the planet. Fairly decent combatant, and ideal for dangerous border planets, although not as good at keeping enemies from slipping past to inner worlds unless paired with something with more tractors and tachyons. Economic output is pathetic, especially in terms of energy, so don't rely too much on them. Gain planetary damage amplification each mark.
column2: 军事指挥中心。若被摧毁，你将失去对该行星的控制权。战斗能力相当不错，非常适合危险的边境行星，不过，除非与更多牵引器和超光速粒子武器配合使用，否则在阻止敌人潜入内部行星方面效果不佳。经济产出很低，尤其是能源产出，因此不要过度依赖它们。每提升一级，可获得行星伤害增幅。

column1: Moderate impact, by default. Changing settings can cause this to potentially reach Extreme impact.  Enables Lost Human Rogues to appear. These humans traverse the galaxy, attempting to hijack fleet designs from the AI. The AI will build up defenses against their meddling over time, but as these Rogues are incredibly sneaky, this will simply result in more hostiles for YOU to deal with.  It is not all downsides, however, for Rogues on your planets will contact you and request the construction of a Rogue Guild. If built, Rogues that wander onto that planet will deposit their ill gotten goods in order to give you a constant stream of zombies of types they've stolen.  Disabling this mid game will ONLY disable the spawning of new Rogues. It will not halt any other logic.
column2: 默认中等影响。更改设置可能导致影响达到极高。  启用失落人类浪客出现。这些人类穿梭银河系，试图劫持AI的舰队设计。 AI会随时间推移建立防御来应对他们的干扰，但由于这些浪客极其狡猾，这只会导致更多敌对力量需要您来处理。  不过并非全是坏处——您行星上的浪客会联系您并要求建造浪客公会。 建成后，游荡到该行星的浪客会存入他们偷来的物资，为您提供持续不断的外星单位僵尸流。  在游戏中途禁用只会禁止新浪客生成。不会停止任何其他逻辑。

column1: Moderate impact.  Human colonies are hidden throughout the galaxy. They will occasionally request aid. These colonies will spawn into the galaxy with random fleetlines.  If you capture their planet before their aid request expires, the planet will cost you 5 less AIP than it normally would. (Cannot give you AIP this way.) You can than transfer the shiplines out of the colony, while the colony itself will continue to provide resources for as long as you protect it.  If you fail to capture their planet before they are captured, the AI will force them to send attacks against you, consisting of waves of their fleetlines. The only way to stop this is to destroy the colony, and it will cost 5 AIP to do so.  Disabling this mid game will disable the spawning of new Lost Colonies, and stop hostile Lost Colonies from spawning units. It will NOT stop any logic around neutral Lost Colonies that are in the process of being lost, or remove any Lost Colonies under your control.
column2: 中等影响。  人类殖民地隐藏在整个银河系中。它们偶尔会请求援助。这些殖民地会带着随机舰队线生成到银河系中。  如果您在援助请求过期前占领其所在行星，该行星的AIP消耗将比正常少5点。（无法通过此方式获得AIP。） 您可以将单位产线从殖民地转移出来，而殖民地本身只要您保护就会持续提供资源。  如果您未能在殖民地被占领前夺取其行星，AI将迫使他们向您发动攻击，包括其舰队线的波次进攻。 唯一阻止的方法是摧毁殖民地，这将消耗5点AIP。  在游戏中途禁用只会禁止新失落殖民地生成，并停止敌对失落殖民地生产单位。 不会停止正在失联过程中的中立失落殖民地的任何逻辑，也不会移除您控制下的任何失落殖民地。

column1: Moderate impact.  Occasionally, fleets of neutral ships may arrive in the galaxy, and begin a slow journey through space. Said journey follows a fixed path, and can be seen via the Construction Convoy galaxy map mode.  These neutral ships build a number of structures for the owner of planets they visist, such as Mines, Tractor Beams, Gravity Generators, and Turrets.  Disabling this mid game will ONLY disable the spawning of new Construction Convoys. It will not halt any other logic.
column2: 中等影响。  偶尔中立单位舰队会抵达银河系，开始一段穿越星空的缓慢旅程。该旅程遵循固定路线，可通过建造护航队星图模式查看。  这些中立单位会为所访问行星的所有者建造多种建筑，如地雷、牵引光束、引力发生器和炮塔。  在游戏中途禁用只会禁止新建造护航队生成。不会停止任何其他逻辑。

column1: Moderate impact. Requires The Spire Rises expansion.  The AI has a number of labs dedicated to the studying of various alien races hidden throughout the galaxy, crewed by some of the brightest scientific minds that they have yet to purge. Due to the nature of these studies, these 'labs' would be better described as Fortresses, built to defend themselves and withstand any attempts of rescue.  Rarely, human ingenuity can defeat AI's sheer processing power, and the humans on board the lab will manage to remove ai influence on the station. In doing so, however, they will be splitting the lab off from the AI's power grid, leaving it defenseless.  Should we take a planet during this weak point, we will be able to repair and gain full control over the lab, including the vastly increased Science and HaP from the various data packets on the planet's local AI grid, but the capture of the Lab itself costs 20 more AIP. Should we not claim it in time, it will still cost 20 AIP, in order to destroy it.  Regardless of if we win or fail, the Lab will than be put into military use, producing powerful 'Scourge' units for whomever owns it. Better make sure it's yours.
column2: 中等影响。需要「尖塔崛起」扩展。  AI拥有若干个专门研究隐藏在银河系各处的各种外星种族的实验室，配备了一些尚未被清洗的最聪明科学家。鉴于这些研究的性质，这些'实验室'更应该被称为要塞——为自我防卫和抵御任何救援尝试而建。  极少数情况下，人类智慧能够战胜AI的纯粹处理能力，实验室上的人类将成功消除AI对该站的影响。然而在此过程中，他们会使实验室脱离AI的电网，使其失去防御能力。  如果我们在此弱点期间夺取该行星，我们将能够修复并完全控制实验室，包括行星本地AI网格上各种数据包带来的大幅增加的科学和入侵点数，但占领实验室本身会多消耗20点AIP。如果我们未能及时占领，仍需消耗20点AIP才能摧毁它。  无论成功与否，实验室随后都将投入军事用途，为拥有它的一方生产强大的「天灾」单位。最好确保它是您的。

column1: Most tiny strike craft, often nicknamed 'bots', do not have the size to carry both long-range and destructive weapons. To remedy this scientists often make sacrifices to speed, durability and rate of fire, and still require exceedingly expensive components. Another way was to transmit the charged particles that form the ammunition via bubble forcefields, increasing the damage yield when under one.
column2: 大多数小型攻击机，通常被称为'机器人'，没有足够的尺寸同时携带远程和破坏性武器。为了解决这个问题，科学家们经常在速度、耐用性和射速方面做出牺牲，并且仍然需要极其昂贵的组件。另一种方法是通过泡力场传输形成弹药的带电粒子，在力场下增加伤害产量。

column1: Most wormhole links are the same thickness, but sometimes they can be thinner or thicker.   If there is an AI planet next to a non-AI planet and the AI planet has a Warp Gate (which means the AI planet can send Waves against the non-AI planet), the link is shown extra thick.   If there is an AI planet next to a non-AI planet and the AI planet does not have a warp gate (which means the AI can't send waves) then the link is shown extra thin.  If you have units selected and are hovering a planet, the links that your ships would use are shown extra thick and in your player colour.
column2: 大多数虫洞连接线的粗细都是一样的，但有时它们会变得更细或更粗。  如果一个AI行星与非AI行星相邻，且AI行星拥有跃迁门（这意味着AI行星可以向非AI行星发动攻击波），连接线会显示得特别粗。  如果一个AI行星与非AI行星相邻，但AI行星没有跃迁门（这意味着AI无法发动攻击波），连接线会显示得特别细。  如果你选中了单位并将鼠标悬停在某个行星上，你的单位将要使用的连接线会显示得特别粗，并使用你的玩家颜色。

column1: Moving around the galaxy at a slow pace the huge Devourer Golem destroys any mobile unit in its path, aiming for the biggest amount of ships to eat. Armed with advanced hull, shield and weapon technology it is a powerful force in its own right, with multiple hacking options for the player to manipulate its behavior. But what makes it unique is the way it can evolve on death, growing more powerful and while in chrysalis, transforming, offering hacks to manipulate the outcome of its metamorphosis, siphon metal or even gain advanced, extremely powerful ship lines.  Expect the AI to chase it off its own planets - but for efficiency sake it will not try to slay the beast, that would only trigger its continued evolution, requiring more resources to ward against it. And while the Devourer Hunters aren't interested in fighting anything else they may retaliate. Once they have chased the Devourer Golem off this may represent an opportunity to attack the weakened prey, push it into chrysalis and benefit from it.  But beware: Not only does it grow more powerful with each transformation, its strength in general goes up as it is hacked, reverse-analyzing Human and AI technology to improve itself even further. The balance between gaining strength by hacking the monster and trying not to unleash one so powerful it becomes too much to handle can prove challenging, but also rewarding.  Additionally, if there are any ceasefires on a given planet it visits, the ceasefire is nullified so long as the Devourer is present.  <color=#f25e1c>LOW IMPACT:</color> This faction does not expand, and will can only attack structures if enraged. Can sometimes create massive shifts in a fight. The latter two are out of the window if it reaches or is spawned at Tier 4, at which point it can attack structures even if not enraged and should be effectively unbeatable to anything but nomad planets, rendering any other hostile factions fighting on the same planet defeated immediately.
column2: 巨大的吞噬者傀儡以缓慢的速度在银河系中移动，摧毁沿途的任何移动单位，瞄准最大数量的单位来吞噬。配备先进的船体、护盾和武器技术，它是一股强大的力量，玩家有多种入侵选项来操纵其行为。 但真正让它与众不同的是它在死亡时进化的方式，变得更加强大，在蛹形态中变形，提供入侵选项来操纵其蜕变结果、虹吸金属，甚至获得先进、极其强大的单位系列。  预期 AI 会将其赶出自己的行星——但为了效率起见，它不会试图杀死这头野兽，那样只会触发其持续进化，需要更多资源来防范。虽然吞噬者猎手对与任何其他东西交战不感兴趣，但它们可能会进行报复。一旦它们赶走了吞噬者傀儡，这可能代表着攻击削弱后的猎物、将其推入蛹形态并从中获益的机会。  但请注意：它不仅每次变形都会变得更强大，其总体力量也会随着被入侵而增强，反向分析人类和 AI 技术以进一步改进自身。通过入侵这只怪物来获取力量与试图不释放出强大到无法控制的怪物之间的平衡可能具有挑战性，但也同样具有回报。  此外，如果它访问的行星上存在任何停火协议，那么只要吞噬者在场，该停火协议就会失效。  <color=#f25e1c>低影响：</color> 此派系不会扩张，只有在被激怒时才能攻击建筑。有时能在战斗中造成巨大的局势转变。 如果它达到或在第 4 级生成，则上述两点不再适用，届时即使未被激怒也能攻击建筑，并且除了游牧行星外几乎无法被击败，会立即击败同一行星上的任何其他敌对派系。

column1: My Liege, clicking on the <color=#E16CFF>Essence</color> symbol in the resource bar at the top of the screen will show you how you have acquired resources over the course of the game. This can be very helpful in learning what ships will grant resources.  For example, if you need more <color=#3DE799>Hacking</color> points then seeing which ship types have given <color=#3DE799>Hacking</color> points in the past will give you ideas of what you need to do.  Also, hovering the 'combat on planet' notification will tell you how many resources you have earned and how many ships you have raised via necromancer in that battle.  Consult the <color=#473004>Necromancer Resources</color> Galaxy Map filter to identify planets rich in <color=#E16CFF>Essence</color>, <color=#7ce9ff>Science</color>, and <color=#3DE799>Hacking</color>. This filter is a powerful tool for determining where to strike for the resources we lack.
column2: 吾主，点击屏幕顶部资源栏中的 <color=#E16CFF>精华</color> 符号将显示你在游戏过程中获取资源的方式。这对于了解哪些单位会授予资源非常有帮助。  例如，如果你需要更多 <color=#3DE799>入侵</color> 点，查看哪些单位类型过去曾提供过 <color=#3DE799>入侵</color> 点会让你知道需要做什么。  此外，悬停在"行星上的战斗"通知上会告诉你在该战斗中通过亡灵法师获得了多少资源以及复活了多少单位。  查阅 <color=#473004>亡灵法师资源</color> 银河地图过滤器，以识别富含 <color=#E16CFF>精华</color>、<color=#7ce9ff>科学</color> 和 <color=#3DE799>入侵</color> 的行星。这个过滤器是决定攻击何处以获取我们所缺资源的有力工具。

column1: My Liege, in order to take control of a planet and increase our strength, we will build a Necropolis. There are several kinds of Necropolis.  The Major Necropolis comes with a new Flagship. They are more expensive, but have more <color=#FFDEAD>Hexes</color>. Our home Necropolis is a type of Major Necropolis. There's a cap for how many Major Necropoleis you can build based on the number of total planets you own; see the Major Necropolis full tooltip for details.  The Minor Necropolis does not come with a new flagship, but it can {FactionColor}Bolster</color> a Major Necropolis to make its fleet more powerful. Building unit-granting structures at a Minor Necropolis will grant those units to the flagship of the Major Necropolis we are Bolstering.  The Defensive Necropolis does not get a flagship or assist with flagships. Instead it allows for building defensive structures, and are a primary source of scouting information since they Watch nearby planets.  Each Necropolis comes with a number of <color=#FFDEAD>Hexes</color>; these <color=#FFDEAD>Hexes</color> allow you to build new structures to benefit that Necropolis. Increasing the Mark Level of a Necropolis will grant you more <color=#FFDEAD>Hexes</color>. Choosing what structures to build is an important part of Necromancer strategy.  You cannot build a Necropolis on an enemy-owned planet. Once built you can't transform or destroy a Necropolis, but you can swap the location of two Necropoleis by hacking.
column2: 吾主，为了控制一个行星并增强我们的实力，我们将建造一座死灵城。有几种死灵城。  主死灵城附带一艘新的旗舰。它们更昂贵，但拥有更多 <color=#FFDEAD>格子</color>。我们的主死灵城是一种主死灵城。主死灵城的建造上限基于你拥有的总行星数；详情请参阅主死灵城的完整工具提示。  次级死灵城不附带新的旗舰，但它可以 {FactionColor}增援</color> 主死灵城以使其舰队更强大。在次级死灵城建造授予单位的建筑将把这些单位授予给我们正在增援的主死灵城的旗舰。  防御死灵城不会获得旗舰或协助旗舰。相反，它允许建造防御建筑，并且是侦察信息的主要来源，因为它们关注附近的恒星。  每座死灵城都有一定数量的 <color=#FFDEAD>格子</color>；这些 <color=#FFDEAD>格子</color> 允许你建造新的建筑以造福该死灵城。提高死灵城的等级将为你提供更多 <color=#FFDEAD>格子</color>。选择建造什么建筑是亡灵法师策略的重要组成部分。  你不能在敌方拥有的行星上建造死灵城。一旦建造，你不能转化或摧毁死灵城，但你可以通过入侵交换两个死灵城的位置。

column1: My Liege, it is important to remember that our primary strength is in our mobile fleets for both offense and defense. We have some static defenses, but not as many as the Human Empire. It might be wise to get more flagships early to allow you to use some for defense.
column2: 吾主，重要的是要记住，我们的主要优势在于我们的移动舰队，无论进攻还是防御。我们有一些固定防御，但不如人类帝国那么多。尽早获得更多旗舰可能是明智之举，以便你可以用一些来防御。

column1: My Liege, one important way to strengthen our forces is by spending <color=#E16CFF>Essence</color> to mark up your Flagships and Necropoleis.   As your flagships are levelled up they become more powerful and can Transform into stronger forms.   As your Necropoleis are levelled up they get more <color=#FFDEAD>Hexes</color> and can build more structures. Some structures require higher mark level Necropoleis.  You will get access to more powerful Upgrades in Rifts as your flagships and structures get to higher mark levels.
column2: 吾主，增强我们部队的一个重要方式是通过花费 <color=#E16CFF>精华</color> 来升级你的旗舰和死灵城。  当你的旗舰升级时，它们会变得更强大，并且可以转化为更强的形态。  当你的死灵城升级时，它们会获得更多 <color=#FFDEAD>格子</color> 并且可以建造更多建筑。有些建筑需要更高等级的死灵城。  随着你的旗舰和建筑达到更高级别，你将在裂缝中获得更强大的升级。

column1: My Liege, there is a Templar force inbound! Templar are powerful and immune to our Necromancy, but we can harvest them for resources to grow our kingdom! They will build strong defensive structures that can launch ships to defend nearby planets, and they will also launch periodic assault waves against us from their Castles.  Be wary of these assault waves; whenever the wave leaders encounter a Templar defensive structure, they will rally more units to their cause. This makes it very important to destroy their defenses quickly.

column1: My Liege, we have discovered a plentiful source of Rifts in this region of the galaxy. With the power you can gain there we can revive the fortunes of our outcast Neinzul race. Others do not understand the true power we can gain from harvesting the life forces from these Rifts, but we will show them all. The Templar scum have allied themselves with the powerful AI here, and must be ruthlessly crushed. We've also detected some Elderlings, whose life force we can harvest as well.  We have established a Phylactery with its flagship here. You can build useful structures at your Phylactery (using the Build menu in the sidebar); these can grant us new, more powerful ships that will allow us to defeat and reanimate our enemies.   You will want to destroy some command stations to build Necropoleis and strengthen your forces.  The Necromancer uses three resources for various upgrades; <color=#3DE799>Hacking</color>, <color=#7ce9ff>Science</color> and <color=#E16CFF>Essence</color>. You will use <color=#7ce9ff>Science</color> to upgrade your shiplines, <color=#3DE799>Hacking</color> to acquire things from the Rifts and <color=#E16CFF>Essence</color> to improve your flagships or Necropoleis. See the Tips entry on Resources for more details.  We have two classes of ships; capital ships we can build at our Necropolis, and the weaker ships we summon with our Necromancy. We can get more types of ships from the Rifts.  We can raise our defeated enemies' ships by Necromancy as long as we have a flagship on the planet with the slain foe, or an adjacent planet.  The first step is to deal with the nearby Rift. You'll want to kill the command station first, then hack the Rift and build a Necropolis there. Then we should look to find more Rifts and to hunt Elderlings for <color=#E16CFF>Essence</color>.

column1: My Liege, we have discovered a plentiful source of Rifts in this region of the galaxy. With the power you can gain there we can revive the fortunes of our outcast Neinzul race. See the Tips entry on Resources for more details.  We have two classes of ships; capital ships we can build at our Necropolis, and the weaker ships we summon with our Necromancy. column1: My Liege, we have observed an Elderling incursion. The Elderlings are powerful Neinzul ships. They will periodically lay Eggs, which will hatch into new ships.  When an Egg hatches, the Elderling will decide on a small nearby territory that they will patrol. Enemies that enter their territory will be attacked.  Killing Elderlings will grant <color=#E16CFF>Essence</color> for the Necromancer. Higher mark level Elderlings will grant more <color=#E16CFF>Essence</color>.  You can also transform an Elderling through hacking into a form that can be sacrificed for its power, granting a new flagship blueprint. Be warned that we will not be able to harvest these for <color=#E16CFF>Essence</color>, and once done, we gain nothing for transforming the same kind of Elderling again.  The Elderlings seem to be very territorial; they emit a radiation that seems to provoke other Elderlings that get too close. This will drive Elderlings mad when they spend too much time around each other. When this happens, it looks like the Elderling will either become hostile to everything in range, or it will seek out enemies on other planets and fight to the death.
column2: 吾主，我们观察到一次远古者入侵。远古者是强大的宁苏单位。它们会定期产卵，卵将孵化成新的单位。  当卵孵化时，远古者会决定一个附近的小范围领土进行巡逻。进入其领土的敌人将受到攻击。  击杀远古者将为亡灵法师提供 <color=#E16CFF>精华</color>。更高级别的远古者将提供更多 <color=#E16CFF>精华</color>。  你也可以通过入侵将远古者转化为一种可以牺牲以获取其力量的形态，从而获得新的旗舰蓝图。请注意，我们将无法从这些转化中收获 <color=#E16CFF>精华</color>，而且一旦完成，转化同种远古者将不会再有收益。  远古者似乎非常具有领土意识；它们会散发一种辐射，似乎会激怒靠得太近的其他远古者。当远古者彼此待在一起时间过长时，这会使它们发疯。当这种情况发生时，远古者要么会对范围内的一切变得敌对，要么会寻找其他行星上的敌人并战斗至死。

column1: My Liege, we have several resources available to us; <color=#7ce9ff>Science</color>, <color=#3DE799>Hacking</color> and <color=#E16CFF>Essence</color>.  <color=#7ce9ff>Science</color> is obtained from fighting the Templar; many Templar ships or structures will grant us <color=#7ce9ff>Science</color> on their death. It is used to upgrade our ships via the Tech menu, just like the Human Empire.   <color=#3DE799>Hacking</color> is obtained from fighting the Templar. The ships leading periodic attack waves against us (the waves not related to hacking a rift) and many of the Templar's strong defensive structures are a good source. Templar Constructors are also an excellent source of <color=#3DE799>Hacking</color>, and should be prioritized to also prevent the Templar from expanding. <color=#3DE799>Hacking</color> is used to hack Rifts for various sorts of upgrades, and some Elderling-related hacks as well.  <color=#E16CFF>Essence</color> is obtained from Rift Hacks and fighting Elderlings; many Elderlings will grant us <color=#E16CFF>Essence</color> on their death. <color=#E16CFF>Essence</color> is used for building new Necropoleis, and also flagship- and Necropolis-related upgrades. <color=#E16CFF>Essence</color> is the most precious of your resources.  For ships or structures that grant resources/upgrades on death, you need to have at least 1 strength of ships on the planet; you don't need to actually deliver the killing blow. If you have non-Necromancer allied factions who are fighting on planets without you, you will get a small fraction of the resources (but at least 1) for these remote kills.
column2: 吾主，我们有几种资源可用；<color=#7ce9ff>科学</color>、<color=#3DE799>入侵</color> 和 <color=#E16CFF>精华</color>。  <color=#7ce9ff>科学</color> 通过与圣殿骑士战斗获得；许多圣殿骑士单位或建筑在死亡时会给予我们 <color=#7ce9ff>科学</color>。它用于通过科技菜单升级我们的单位，就像人类帝国一样。  <color=#3DE799>入侵</color> 通过与圣殿骑士战斗获得。领导定期攻击波次（与入侵裂缝无关的波次）的单位以及许多圣殿骑士的强力防御建筑是很好的来源。圣殿骑士建造者也是 <color=#3DE799>入侵</color> 的绝佳来源，应优先处理以防止圣殿骑士扩张。<color=#3DE799>入侵</color> 用于入侵裂缝以进行各种升级，以及一些与远古者相关的入侵。  <color=#E16CFF>精华</color> 通过裂缝入侵和与远古者战斗获得；许多远古者在死亡时会给予我们 <color=#E16CFF>精华</color>。<color=#E16CFF>精华</color> 用于建造新的死灵城，以及与旗舰和死灵城相关的升级。<color=#E16CFF>精华</color> 是你最宝贵的资源。  对于死亡时给予资源/升级的单位或建筑，你需要在行星上至少有 1 点强度的单位；你不需要亲自进行致命一击。如果你有非亡灵法师的盟军派系在没有你的行星上战斗，你将获得这些远程击杀的一小部分资源（但至少 1 点）。

column1: My Liege, we've discovered how to track Elderlings. This lets us figure out which planets are in their Territory, as well as some other details about the Elderling.  This can be very useful for understanding when and where an Elderling can be hunted. Consult the galaxy menu and select the <color=#6718c7>Elderling Information</color> filter for important intel about the Elderlings.  Once tracked, we can lure an Elderling to a planet within its territory to battle it on our terms. This technique is best used when we need <color=#E16CFF>Essence</color> more than <color=#3DE799>Hacking</color> points. column1: My Liege, we've just detected a Rift on {PlanetName}! This is the first new Rift we've found in this region of the galaxy, and our sensors suggest that Rifts will open steadily over time; this truly is a fruitful hunting area for us!  This Rift contains an immense amount of life force, and we can extract it by hacking it with our Nanobots. Once extracted, we can use this power to upgrade our forces.  There are a wide variety of upgrades available from Rifts. These range from unlocking new unit types, strengthening your fleets, building a new Necropolis, and so on. Each Rift has its own unique upgrade options. Finding rifts to harvest is the best way to increase your power.  Destroying the command station on a planet will make hacking a Rift much cheaper.  New Upgrades will be unlocked as your flagships and Necropoleis get to higher mark levels; Rifts will prioritize giving you upgrades you can use.  After you hack a Rift, expect a powerful Templar wave in response, so be ready to defend.  You can look at the Intel menu to see where all the Rifts you can see in the galaxy are.
column2: 吾主，我们刚刚在 {PlanetName} 上检测到一个裂缝！这是我们在银河系这个区域发现的第一个新裂缝，我们的传感器表明裂缝会随时间稳定地打开；这对我们来说确实是一个富饶的狩猎区！  这个裂缝包含巨量的生命力量，我们可以通过用纳米机器人入侵它来提取。一旦提取，我们可以用这种力量升级我们的部队。  裂缝提供各种各样的升级。范围从解锁新的单位类型、加强你的舰队、建造新的死灵城等等。每个裂缝都有其独特的升级选项。寻找裂缝进行收割是增加你力量的最佳方式。  摧毁行星上的指挥站将使入侵裂缝变得便宜得多。  随着你的旗舰和死灵城达到更高级别，新的升级将被解锁；裂缝会优先提供你可以使用的升级。  在你入侵一个裂缝后，预期会有一波强大的圣殿骑士波次作为回应，所以要做好防御准备。  你可以查看情报菜单，了解银河系中所有你能看到的裂缝位置。

column1: My Liege, whenever your forces with Necromancy resurrect a Dire Guardian-tier unit, it returns as a Mummy. These are among the most powerful ships that can be acquired.  By default, all Dire Guardians are reanimated to be regular Mummies, but you can unlock stronger Mummy variants by hacking rifts.  You can find the following Mummy variants available through Rifts. Each variant structure comes with some Variant Bodyguards, stronger versions of the variant that can be built at Necropoleis and shipyards.  Royal Mummies: Much stronger and faster than ordinary Mummies but do not have other special features.  Decaying Mummies: Creates an attrition field that slowly degenerates hostile ships. Withered Mummies: Identical to a normal Mummy but splits into four Mummy Minions on death.
column2: 吾主，当你的拥有亡灵术的部队复活一个恐怖守卫级单位时，它会作为木乃伊归来。这些是可获得的最强大的单位之一。  默认情况下，所有恐怖守卫都被复活为普通木乃伊，但你可以通过入侵裂缝解锁更强的木乃伊变体。  你可以通过裂缝找到以下木乃伊变体。每个变体建筑都附带一些变体护卫，这些是变体的更强版本，可以在死灵城和造船厂建造。  皇家木乃伊：比普通木乃伊更强更快，但没有其他特殊功能。 腐烂木乃伊：创建一个 attrition 场，缓慢退化敌舰。 枯萎木乃伊：与普通木乃伊相同，但在死亡时分裂成四个木乃伊仆从。

column1: My Liege, whenever your forces with Necromancy resurrect a Guardian-tier unit, it returns as a Wight. They are typically a critical part of your forces.  By default, all Guardians are reanimated to be regular Wights. However, by building certain structures at your Necropoleis you can instead summon more powerful Wight variants, or more than one Wight for every Guardian killed.  Each Flagship has a cap for the number of wights it can summon at a time, influenced by the mark level of its home Necropolis and the number of wight variant structures you have in bolstering Necropoleis.  There is a soft cap for the number of Wights you can raise; any non-bodyguard Wight counts toward this cap. Wights you would raise over the cap are 'Weak Wights'; these attrition very quickly, but can still be helpful in battle.  You can find the following Wight variants available through Rifts. Each variant structure comes with some Variant Bodyguards, stronger versions of the variant that can be built at Necropoleis and shipyards.  Ravenous Wight: More fragile than the other Wights but can heal itself with vampiric attacks. Possessed Wight: Long range artillery that is exceptional at destroying high mass targets, but takes a long time to reload. Infectious Wight: Lobs grenades that hit in a small area of effect, splitting damage between targets. Spectral Wight: Cloaked and equipped with tractors, this Wight fires a Tesla-like weapon that charges up its self-destruct sequence. Vengeful Wight: Protect allies by attracting weapon fire to itself and reflects damage back to enemies that shoot it.
column2: 吾主，当你的拥有亡灵术的部队复活一个守卫级单位时，它会作为怨灵归来。它们通常是你部队的关键部分。  默认情况下，所有守卫都被复活为普通怨灵。然而，通过在死灵城建造某些建筑，你可以召唤更强大的怨灵变体，或者为每个被击杀的守卫召唤多个怨灵。  每艘旗舰一次可以召唤的怨灵数量有上限，这受其主死灵城等级和你在增援死灵城中拥有的怨灵变体建筑数量的影响。  你可以复活的怨灵数量有一个软上限；任何非护卫怨灵都计入此上限。超过上限复活的怨灵是"弱怨灵"；这些 attrition 非常快，但在战斗中仍然有用。  你可以通过裂缝找到以下怨灵变体。每个变体建筑都附带一些变体护卫，这些是变体的更强版本，可以在死灵城和造船厂建造。  贪婪怨灵：比其他怨灵更脆弱，但可以通过吸血攻击自我治疗。 附体怨灵：远程火炮，擅长摧毁高质量目标，但装填时间很长。 传染怨灵：投掷手榴弹，在小范围内命中，在目标之间分摊伤害。 幽灵怨灵：隐形并配备牵引器，发射类似特斯拉的武器，为其自毁序列充能。 复仇怨灵：通过吸引武器火力来保护盟友，并将伤害反弹回攻击它的敌人。

column1: My Liege, whenever your forces with Necromancy resurrect a Strikecraft, it returns as a Skeleton. They are typically a critical part of your forces.  By default, all strikecraft are reanimated to be regular Skeletons. However, by building certain structures at your Necropoleis you can instead summon more powerful variants of Skeletons, or more than one Skeleton for every strikecraft killed.  These skeleton variant Homes also grant that Necropolis new 'Bodyguard' skeletons that can be built efficiently by shipyards.  Each Flagship has a cap for the number of skeletons it can summon at a time, influenced by the mark level of its home Necropolis and the number of skeleton variant structures you have in bolstering Necropoleis.  Skeletons are inherently unstable. Some skeletons will decay from more complex forms to simpler forms. Some will literally fall apart, taking attrition damage over time. Sometimes both processes are happening at once.  There is a soft cap for the number of Skeletons you can raise; any non-bodyguard skeleton counts toward this cap. Skeletons you would raise over the cap are 'Weak Skeletons', which will attrition very quickly; these can be helpful in a single battle though.  You can find the following skeleton variants available through Rifts. Each variant structure comes with some Variant Bodyguards, stronger versions of the variant that can be built at Necropoleis and shipyards.  Skeleton Warrior: Melee brawler that jams weapons and deals increasing damage the more heavily armored its target is. Skeleton Archer: Long range but fragile, adept at destroying forcefields. Skeleton Rogue: Cloaked, nimble ship that uses fusion damage to bypass personal shields.  Excellent for taking out static defenses. Skeleton Mage: Has a powerful chain-lightning weapon Skeleton Lord: Strongest of the Skeletons. A medium-range brawler deadly to massive enemies and revives itself once after taking fatal damage.
column2: 吾主，当你的拥有亡灵术的部队复活一架小型战机时，它会作为骷髅归来。它们通常是你部队的关键部分。  默认情况下，所有小型战机都被复活为普通骷髅。然而，通过在死灵城建造某些建筑，你可以召唤更强大的骷髅变体，或者为每架被击杀的小型战机召唤多个骷髅。  这些骷髅变体之家还为该死灵城授予新的"护卫"骷髅，可以高效地在造船厂建造。  每艘旗舰一次可以召唤的骷髅数量有上限，这受其主死灵城等级和你在增援死灵城中拥有的骷髅变体建筑数量的影响。  骷髅天生不稳定。一些骷髅会从更复杂的形态退化到更简单的形态。一些会直接散架，随时间受到 attrition 伤害。有时这两个过程同时发生。  你可以复活的骷髅数量有一个软上限；任何非护卫骷髅都计入此上限。超过上限复活的骷髅是"弱骷髅"，它们会非常快速地 attrition；尽管如此，它们仍可能在单场战斗中有用。  你可以通过裂缝找到以下骷髅变体。每个变体建筑都附带一些变体护卫，这些是变体的更强版本，可以在死灵城和造船厂建造。  骷髅战士：近战格斗者，可以干扰武器，对装甲越重的目标造成越高的伤害。 骷髅弓箭手：远程但脆弱，擅长摧毁力场。 骷髅盗贼：隐形、灵活的单位，使用融合伤害绕过个人护盾。擅长摧毁固定防御。 骷髅法师：拥有强大的连锁闪电武器。 骷髅领主：骷髅中最强者。中程格斗者，对大型敌人致命，并在受到致命伤害后自我复活一次。

column1: My Liege, while are strength primarily lies in our offensive capabilities, we have access to powerful defenses as well.  Totems combine utility with defensive features. They all feature an ‘Orb’ of some type that orbits the Totem and offers a unique bonus. These are the Totems we can create:  Protective Totem: These create Orbs of Attraction, which defend nearby allies by drawing weaponfire to themselves. These are almost always worth getting one per Necropolis in close proximity.  Tachyon Totem: These provide wide Tachyon coverage to decloak ships. Their Orbs of Sight excel at taking out cloaked ships as well as others with high albedo.  Lifeforce Totem: These are powerful defenders as they fire vampiric beams to replenish their lifeforce. But their Orbs of Mending are their primary utility, as these offer faster repairs than even a Shipyard. These require 2 <color=#FFDEAD>Hexes</color> to function, so these are best used situationally and are better suited in forward-facing planets.  Treacherous Totem: These powerful Totems can only be built by Defensive Necropoleis and cost three <color=#FFDEAD>Hexes</color>, but they are exceptionally powerful. At a basic level, these act like Blackhole Machines, preventing most ships from leaving through wormholes. But their true value derives from their Orbs of Entropy which act like orbiting minefields, tractoring ships to be blown up by orbital Necrobombs.
column2: 吾主，虽然我们的主要优势在于进攻能力，但我们也有强大的防御可用。  图腾将实用功能与防御特性相结合。它们都拥有某种类型的"球体"，围绕图腾运行并提供独特的加成。以下是我们能创造的图腾：  保护图腾：这些创造引力球体，通过吸引武器火力到自身来保护附近的盟友。几乎总是值得为每个死灵城配备一个近距离的。  超光速粒子图腾：这些提供广泛的超光速粒子覆盖以解除单位隐形。它们的视界球体擅长消灭隐形单位以及其他具有高反照率的单位。  生命力量图腾：这些是强大的防御者，发射吸血光束来补充生命力量。但它们的修复球体是其主要实用功能，提供比造船厂更快的修复。这些需要 2 个 <color=#FFDEAD>格子</color> 才能运行，因此最适合在前沿行星上视情况使用。  背信图腾：这些强大的图腾只能由防御死灵城建造，消耗三个 <color=#FFDEAD>格子</color>，但它们异常强大。在基础层面上，它们像黑洞机器一样运作，阻止大多数单位通过虫洞离开。但它们的真正价值来自熵之球体，它们像轨道雷场一样运作，牵引单位被轨道死灵炸弹炸毁。

column1: My Liege, while are strength primarily lies in our offensive capabilities, we have access to powerful defenses as well. Non-Totem defenses fall under our ‘Tower Defense’ technology.  Guardposts: AI Guardposts that are taken over through our Necromancy benefit from our Tower Defense Technology.  Lightning Tower: These midrange defenses are heavily fortified and can paralyze low-mass ships while dealing more damage to those with intensive energy usage. Moreover, Lightning Towers gain harmonic damage based on how many other Lightning Towers are present.  Catapult: This sniper-ranged defense orbits around the gravity well, dealing extra damage the farther away it is from its target. Therefore, these are strongest when placed along the perimeter of the gravity well.  Skull Pile: These structures can only be built by Defensive Necropoleis and require 2 <color=#FFDEAD>Hexes</color> to function, but they can spawn huge swarms of skeletons. While these are quite pathetic at mark 1, each additional mark grants an additional type of skeleton-variant summons. For this reason, we humbly recommend only building these when you have already invested in Tower Defense tech.
column2: 吾主，虽然我们的主要优势在于进攻能力，但我们也有强大的防御可用。非图腾防御属于我们的"塔防"技术。  守卫哨站：通过我们的亡灵术接管的人工智能守卫哨站受益于我们的塔防技术。  闪电塔：这些中程防御工事坚固，可以麻痹低质量单位，同时对能量消耗密集的单位造成更多伤害。此外，闪电塔根据附近其他闪电塔的数量获得谐波伤害。  投石机：这种狙击射程的防御围绕引力井运行，距离目标越远造成额外伤害。因此，放置在引力井外围时最强。  颅骨堆：这些建筑只能由防御死灵城建造，需要 2 个 <color=#FFDEAD>格子</color> 才能运行，但可以生成大量的骷髅群。虽然 1 级时相当可怜，但每增加一级都会授予额外一种骷髅变体召唤。因此，我们谦卑地建议只在你已经投入了塔防科技的情况下建造这些。

column1: My Liege, your empire is powered by this Phylactery that contains your Life Force; if it is destroyed then your empire will end.  You can swap the planet with your Phylactery and any other Necropolis. This ritual costs <color=#E16CFF>Essence</color>, and will destroy all the other stationary structures associated with both the Necropolis and your Phylactery, so it should not be done lightly.  If your phylactery would die and you have enough <color=#E16CFF>Essence</color>, the ritual will automatically be cast with a randomly chosen non-crippled Necropolis. In general you want to move your Phylactery before this would happens, since you might lose the structures on a critical Necropolis due to the random choice.
column2: 吾主，你的帝国由这个包含你生命力量的命匣驱动；如果被摧毁，你的帝国将终结。  你可以交换你的命匣行星和任何其他死灵城。这个仪式消耗 <color=#E16CFF>精华</color>，并且会摧毁与死灵城和命匣相关的所有其他固定建筑，因此不应轻易进行。  如果你的命匣即将被摧毁，并且你有足够的 <color=#E16CFF>精华</color>，该仪式将自动以随机选择的非受重创死灵城施放。 一般来说，你希望在此之前移动你的命匣，因为你可能会因为随机选择而失去关键死灵城上的建筑。

column1: Nah.  We think exploration and discovery is fun.  Tooltips, the Intel tab, and other mechanics also go out of their way to teach you about most things as they come up.  Going in blind, you can expect... well, to lose.  Hopefully you have a grand time doing that, and each loss illuminates a clever new idea that you come up with yourself.  This is meant to be more of a reference guide than something you just sit down and read, anyway.  If you're stumped by how to deal with some situation or some mechanic, here you go.  Some mechanics, like AI Progress (AIP) are more likely to bite you than others if you're coming from other strategy games.  So those are covered in the 'Getting Started' section to give you a bit of a boost.  If you're planning on spending dozens or hundreds of hours with the game, you might find all these tips to be a bit of a treasure trove.  It all depends on what you want to get out of the game, but our goal is for most people to just be able to sit down and have a good time learning through experimentation.
column2: 不用。我们认为探索和发现很有趣。工具提示、情报选项卡和其他机制也会在相关内容出现时特意教你。  盲目上手的话，你可能会……嗯，输掉游戏。希望你在这个过程中玩得开心，每一次失败都能启发你想出一个巧妙的新点子。  不管怎样，这更像是一份参考指南，而不是让你坐下来通读的东西。如果你在处理某些情况或机制时遇到困难，这里就是你的答案。  如果你之前玩过其他策略游戏，像 AI 进度值（AIP）这样的机制可能比其他机制更容易给你带来麻烦。所以在“新手入门”部分介绍了这些内容，帮你快速上手。  如果你打算花几十甚至几百个小时玩这款游戏，你可能会发现这些提示就像一座宝藏。  这完全取决于你想从游戏中获得什么，但我们的目标是让大多数人都能坐下来，通过尝试来愉快地学习。

column1: Normal people when hearing 'spider' think of an 8-legged creature sitting in the center of a net. Fewer know there are more types of nets, one of them carried between the legs of the critter, literally a bug net used to actively catch instead of wait for prey. Based on this concept a new type of Corvette was designed, able to draw in smaller ships, then capture and destroy them.
column2: 普通人听到"蜘蛛"会想到坐在网中央的八腿生物。但很少有人知道还有更多类型的网，其中一种是携带在生物腿之间的，实际上是一种用于主动捕捉而非等待猎物的虫网。基于这一概念设计了新型护卫舰，能够拉入小型单位，然后捕获并摧毁它们。

column1: Normally Outguard Beacons are found several hops from your starting planet. If this setting is on, instead you will get an Outguard Beacon on your homeworld.
column2: 通常，前哨信标位于距离你起始行星几跳远的地方。如果此设置开启，你将在母星上获得一个前哨信标。

column1: Normally Outguard Beacons are found several hops from your starting planet. If this settings is on, instead you will get a specific Outguard Beacon with the Outguard chosen in the dropdown below.
column2: 通常，前哨信标位于距离你起始行星几跳远的地方。如果此设置开启，你将在母星上获得一个特定的前哨信标，前哨类型由下拉菜单选择。

column1: Normally Outguard Party adds a notification timer showing time till currently summoned Outguard will warp out. This setting allows you to instead disable that.
column2: 通常外卫派对会添加一个通知计时器，显示当前召唤的外卫将跃迁离开的时间。此设置允许你禁用它。

column1: Normally clicking on or near a wormhole does nothing, because you'd accidentally send your units or camera through all the time.  However, holding down this button lets you interact with the wormhole to send units through (by default right-click) or your camera through (by default left-click).  Holding this also makes the name of the planet on the other side appear.
column2: 通常情况下，点击虫洞或其附近区域不会有任何反应，因为您可能会不小心将单位或相机传送过去。但是，按住此按钮可以与虫洞交互，以传送单位（默认右键点击）或相机（默认左键点击）。按住此按钮还会显示另一侧行星的名称。

column1: Normally escape opens the paused/escape menu, even if a sidebar is shown, and the sidebar will still be open when leaving the pause/escape menu. But if you like not having the sidebar open, its much easier to close by enabling this setting.
column2: 通常情况下，ESC键会打开暂停/退出菜单，即使侧边栏已显示，退出菜单后侧边栏仍保持打开。如果您希望ESC键能直接关闭侧边栏，可以启用此设置。

column1: Normally flagships that are unarmed will not listen to any orders that you give them.  This is because usually you select their entire fleet, and you mean 'everybody but you.'        However, there are times when you definitely DO want to give them orders to move somewhere, perhaps transport some ships for you, and holding down this key while giving those orders will make them listen to you.  The alternative is to take them out of stationary mode, but this is far simpler.
column2: 通常情况下，未武装的旗舰不会听从你的任何命令。这是因为你通常会选择他们的整个舰队，而你的意思是'除了你之外的所有人'。  然而，有时你确实想要给他们下达移动命令，也许是让他们为你运输一些单位，按住这个键的同时下达命令就能让他们听从你的指挥。  另一种方法是让他们退出固定模式，但这种方法要简单得多。

column1: Normally more important ships have their icons moved slightly closer to the camera to make seeing things like your flagships and selecting them easier. There is a slight expense to doing this, and if your performance is low in very busy planet scenes you can try disabling it.
column2: 通常情况下，更重要的单位(如旗舰)图标会稍微靠近镜头，便于查看和选择。这样做会轻微增加性能开销，如果在繁忙的行星场景中性能较低，可以尝试禁用此选项。

column1: Normally officers can be repaired after they have been crippled. If this option is on, they are instead lost forever and the fleet gets a basic transport as a flagship for the fleet instead.
column2: 通常情况下，军官在被重创后可以修复。如果启用此选项，军官将永久损失，舰队将获得一个基本运输舰作为旗舰替代。

column1: Normally on, and is based around the visual effects of AOE explosion/lightning attacks. Turning this off can slightly improve performance, or make the screen look less busy
column2: 默认开启，显示范围爆炸/闪电攻击的视觉效果。关闭此选项可以轻微提升性能，或减少屏幕上的视觉干扰。

column1: Normally on, and is based around the visual effects of bullets and other weapon effects. Turning this off can slightly improve performance, or make the screen look less busy
column2: 默认开启，显示子弹和其他武器效果的视觉效果。关闭此选项可以轻微提升性能，或减少屏幕上的视觉干扰。

column1: Normally pressing the key to open a sidebar panel does nothing if it is already open.  Enable this if you would prefer it to close the sidebar entirely.
column2: 正常情况下，当侧边栏面板已打开时，按打开键不会执行任何操作。启用此选项后，按打开键将完全关闭侧边栏。

column1: Normally ships and planets show a very condensed amount of information about themselves in their tooltips.  However, you can hold a key (shown at the bottom of those tooltips) to make them show a little more info or a whole lot more info.  If you prefer to see the complete info by default, then you can enable this option.
column2: 通常单位和行星在工具提示中显示非常简化的信息。您可以按住一个键(显示在工具提示底部)来查看更多或全部信息。如果您希望默认显示完整信息，可以启用此选项。

column1: Normally ships and planets show a very condensed amount of information about themselves in their tooltips.  However, you can hold a key (shown at the bottom of those tooltips) to make them show a little more info or a whole lot more info.
