column2: 通常单位和行星在工具提示中显示非常简化的信息。您可以按住一个键(显示在工具提示底部)来查看更多或全部信息。如果您希望默认显示中等程度的信息，可以启用此选项。

column1: Normally the Nanocaust only spawn one hive ever. If this setting is changed, they will instead reinvade with a new hive after some time without one in the galaxy.
column2: 通常纳米灾变只会生成一个巢穴。如果更改此设置，它们会在银河系中没有巢穴一段时间后重新入侵并生成新巢穴。

column1: Normally the Nanocaust spawn on an existing planet in the galaxy. If this is set true they instead get a new homeworld planet for their hive which is linked into the galaxy.
column2: 通常纳米灾变会在银河系现有行星上生成。如果设为true，它们会获得一个连接至银河系的新母星作为巢穴。

column1: Normally the game sorts the build sidebar by fleet type, then fleet, then by unit type.  Enable this if you would prefer it sort by unit type first (aka grouping all turrets of a specific sort together).
column2: 正常情况下，游戏按舰队类型、舰队、单位类型的顺序排序建造侧边栏。启用此选项将改为优先按单位类型排序(例如将所有特定类型的炮塔分组在一起)。

column1: Normally the selected ships and fleets list only shows directly-selected ships, and fleets which are selected as a whole.  With this setting on, if you select a fleet as a whole, it will still include all of the full list of ships from it down in the big list under the rest.
column2: 通常情况下，选中的单位和舰队列表只显示直接选中的单位和整体选中的舰队。启用此选项后，选中整个舰队时，仍会在下方列表中显示该舰队的所有单位。

column1: Normally the starting planet for player factions is either completely random, or picked by the player in the map tab of the lobby. If you have Improved Generator selected though, you can use this option to guide the random algorithm to prefer starting planets either more or less centered in the galaxy.
column2: 通常情况下玩家派系的起始行星要么完全随机，要么由玩家在大厅的地图选项卡中选择。但如果启用了改进生成器，您可以使用此选项引导随机算法，使其偏好更中心或更边缘的起始行星。

column1: Normally the starting planet for player factions is either completely random, or picked by the player in the map tab of the lobby. If you have Improved Generator selected though, you can use this option to guide the random algorithm to prefer starting planets with either more or less links.
column2: 通常情况下玩家派系的起始行星要么完全随机，要么由玩家在大厅的地图选项卡中选择。但如果启用了改进生成器，您可以使用此选项引导随机算法，使其偏好连接数更多或更少的起始行星。

column1: Normally the starting planet for player factions is picked and shown in the map tab of the lobby. If you have Improved Generator selected though, you can use this option to always re-random starting planets before the game begins.
column2: 通常情况下玩家派系的起始行星在大厅的地图选项卡中被选定并显示。但如果启用了改进生成器，您可以使用此选项在游戏开始前始终重新随机化起始行星。

column1: Normally there's a pretty sensible distribution of planets and mark levels, but this can cause a feeling of sameness in a lot of galaxies.                 If you're ready to spice things up, and willing to have some potentially very challenging map designs, then this feature will go in and randomly swap the mark levels of planets that are marks 2 through 6.  It will make however many swaps you ask for, up to 300, and will overlap itself as it does the swaps without any hesitation.  It will not swap any homeworlds, or what ships are on these planets.  To keep things interesting, the default is 6.
column2: 通常，行星和级别的分布相当合理，但这可能会导致许多星系感觉相似。               如果你准备增加趣味性，并愿意接受一些潜在的非常具有挑战性的地图设计，那么这个功能将随机交换2至6级行星的级别。  它将按照你要求的交换次数进行，最多300次，并且在交换时会毫不犹豫地重叠自己。它不会交换任何母星，或这些行星上的单位。  为了保持趣味性，默认值为6。

column1: Normally there's a pretty sensible distribution of planets and mark levels, but this can cause a feeling of sameness in a lot of galaxies.               If you're ready to spice things up, and willing to have some potentially very challenging map designs, then this feature will go in and randomly swap the mark levels of planets that are marks 1 through 4.  It will make however many swaps you ask for, up to 300, and will overlap itself as it does the swaps without any hesitation.  It will not swap any homeworlds, or what ships are on these planets.  This can lead to mark 4 planets next to a player homeworld, which can actually be an interesting opportunity.  To keep things interesting, the default is 2.
column2: 通常，行星和级别的分布相当合理，但这可能会导致许多星系感觉相似。               如果你准备增加趣味性，并愿意接受一些潜在的非常具有挑战性的地图设计，那么这个功能将随机交换1至4级行星的级别。  它将按照你要求的交换次数进行，最多300次，并且在交换时会毫不犹豫地重叠自己。它不会交换任何母星，或这些行星上的单位。这可能导致4级行星出现在玩家母星旁边，这实际上可能是一个有趣的机会。  为了保持趣味性，默认值为2。

column1: Normally we show your IP Address in those windows in case you need them.  However, if you are planning to stream the game, this is not information you would want visible in your stream, so this lets you turn it off.              Please note that you would still need to obscure the actual connection screen with your streaming software, because we can't really hide that IP while still making the screen useful to you.
column2: 正常情况下，我们会在这些窗口中显示您的IP地址以备不时之需。但如果您计划直播游戏，可能不希望这些信息在直播中显示，此选项可将其关闭。              请注意：您仍需要使用直播软件遮挡实际的连接界面，因为我们无法在保持界面实用的同时隐藏IP地址。

column1: Normally when a Necromancer unlocks a new transformation, that allows any number of flagships of that type. If this setting is enabled, then instead there is a maximum of one flagship of any single type.
column2: 通常情况下，死灵法师解锁新的变形后，可以拥有任意数量的该类型旗舰。启用此设置后，每种类型的旗舰最多只能拥有一艘。

column1: Normally when you click to place a turret or similar, it just builds the one unit there.  Hold down this key, and it will instead build a cluster of 10 (assuming you have the cap free for that).        Hold this AND the 'Build 5x' button to build 50 at a time.
column2: 通常情况下，当您点击放置炮塔或类似建筑时，只会在那里建造一个单位。按住此键，将改为建造一组10个单位（假设您有足够的建造上限）。        同时按住此键和“建造5倍单位数量”按钮，可一次性建造50个单位。

column1: Normally when you click to place a turret or similar, it just builds the one unit there.  Hold down this key, and it will instead build a cluster of 5 (assuming you have the cap free for that).        Hold this AND the 'Build 10x' button to build 50 at a time.
column2: 通常情况下，当您点击放置炮塔或类似建筑时，只会在那里建造一个单位。按住此键，将改为建造一组5个单位（假设您有足够的建造上限）。        同时按住此键和“建造10倍单位数量”按钮，可一次性建造50个单位。

column1: Normally when you click to place a turret or similar, it just builds the one unit there.  Hold down this key, and it will instead build a cluster of one-half the total available (assuming you have the cap free for that).
column2: 通常情况下，当您点击放置炮塔或类似建筑时，只会在那里建造一个单位。按住此键，将改为建造总可用数量一半的单位群（假设您有足够的建造上限）。

column1: Normally when you click to place a turret or similar, it just builds the one unit there.  Hold down this key, and it will instead build a cluster of one-third the total available (assuming you have the cap free for that).
column2: 通常情况下，当您点击放置炮塔或类似建筑时，只会在那里建造一个单位。按住此键，将改为建造总可用数量三分之一的单位群（假设您有足够的建造上限）。

column1: Normally when you destroy an ai structure via sabotoge this circumvents any AIP normally caused by its destruction. This option lets you change that, which affects the overal value of HaP quite a bit.
column2: 通常，当你通过破坏摧毁AI结构时，这会规避通常由其破坏引起的任何AIP。此选项允许你更改这一点，这会显著影响HaP的整体价值。

column1: Normally when you drag a selection box around ships, if there are any military ships under the box then only military ships will be selected.  This is generally best, but in cases where you want to select all ships under the selection box regardless of military status, just hold the Ctrl key!
column2: 通常情况下，当你拖动选择框选择单位时，如果框内有任何军事单位，那么只会选中军事单位。这通常是最好的做法，但如果你想不管军事状态如何，都选中选择框内的所有单位，只需按住 Ctrl 键即可！

column1: Normally when you left-click a planet on the galaxy map the game selects that planet, but does not immediately switch to planet view. Holding this keybind will make it not only select the planet, but also 'switch to planet view' in one step for you.
column2: 通常情况下，在星系地图上左键点击一个行星时，游戏只会选中该行星，而不会立即切换到行星视图。按住这个快捷键将使其不仅选中行星，还会一步到位地为你'切换到行星视图'。

column1: Normally when you reach the 'aip never reduces below' amount of aip, the actual aip floor is still below you and you can stay at this exact aip value for quite a while. Instead if this is set true the floor starts at that same value, so any aip increase will unavoidably cause some effective increase.
column2: 通常当你达到'AIP永不低于'的AIP数量时，实际AIP底线仍在你之下，你可以在这个确切的AIP值保持相当长一段时间。如果设置为true，底线将从该相同值开始，因此任何AIP增加都会不可避免地导致一些有效增加。

column1: Normally when you unload a flagship or it spawns a new ship in some other way (like necromancy, normal fleet production, etc)--the spawned ship is assigned the same orders as the ship spawning it. However, that is often inappropriate for flagships that require micro (ie. you pull back your officer as it gets low and the auto-bomb line being produced from it charge away from the battle, to the clicked point).  Enabling this setting will disable this behavior and instead leave the spawned ships to choose their own targets. Selecting the whole fleet and issuing an order will still go to all living ships, of course.   In multiplayer situations, this setting applies to the player with it on.
column2: 通常情况下，当旗舰卸载或通过其他方式生成新船只(如亡灵法术、常规舰队生产等)时，新生成的船只会继承母舰的指令。但对于需要微操的旗舰来说，这通常不太合适(例如当你的军官血量较低时撤退，而自动生产的轰炸机线却冲向战场)。  启用此设置将禁用此行为，让新生成的船只自行选择目标。当然，选中整个舰队下达指令仍然会作用于所有存活船只。  在多人游戏中，此设置仅对启用的玩家有效。

column1: Normally, command station upgrades cost 500, 1000, 1500, 2500, 2500, and then 3000.  So the total cost of upgrading to mark 7 is a whopping 10,100, but the early marks are extraordinarily cheap.             With this option on, the first two direct upgrades to command stations cost 1500, and then the rest cost 2500.  So to get to mark 7 costs more -- 13,000 science -- but the first couple of marks is not quite as severe a jump as the rest.  This setting defaults to off in the simpler campaign types, but then becomes mandatory.
column2: 通常，指挥站升级费用为500、1000、1500、2500、2500和3000。因此，升级到7级的总成本高达10,100，但早期等级非常便宜。             开启此选项后，指挥站的前两次直接升级费用为1500，之后的费用为2500。因此，升级到7级的成本更高——13,000科学点——但前几个等级的跳跃不像其余等级那么剧烈。  此设置在较简单的战役类型中默认关闭，但在更高难度下变为强制开启。

column1: Normally, engineering upgrades cost 1000, 1500, 2000.  So the total cost of upgrading to mark 4 is 4,500, but the early marks are fairly cheap.  With this option on, the upgrades to engineers cost 1500, 2500, 4000.  So to get to mark 4 costs more -- 8,000 science -- but the first couple of marks is not quite as severe a jump as the final one.  This setting defaults to off in the simpler campaign types, but then becomes mandatory.
column2: 通常，工程升级费用为1000、1500、2000。因此，升级到4级的总成本为4,500，但早期等级相对便宜。  开启此选项后，工程师的升级费用为1500、2500、4000。因此，升级到4级的成本更高——8,000科学点——但前几个等级的跳跃不像最后一个那么剧烈。  此设置在较简单的战役类型中默认关闭，但在更高难度下变为强制开启。

column1: Normally, most UI windows only update their contents every 50-100 milliseconds.  If your framerate is much higher than this, however, you may prefer that the UI update at whatever your actual framerate is.             This will likely reduce your framerate, potentially substantially, but it leads to the ultimate in responsiveness.  Prior to version 2.633, and since sometime in the game's alpha, the UIs were all running on unrestricted update speeds.
column2: 通常情况下，大多数UI窗口每50-100毫秒更新一次内容。如果您的帧率远高于此，您可能希望UI以实际帧率更新。  这可能会降低您的帧率(可能显著降低)，但会带来极致的响应速度。在2.633版本之前，以及从游戏alpha版本开始，所有UI都是以无限制更新速度运行的。

column1: Normally, when ships grant their owners and all their allies bonus speed on a planet the bonuses scale exponentially. Three ships with 1.5x planetary speed modifier will put the speed all the way up to 1.5 x 1.5 x 1.5 = 3.375 times. If this setting is enabled, instead of exponential scaling the speed modifiers are added up, in the upper case (since every ship grants no longer 1.5x but a +0.5x planetary speed bonus) being only 1 + ( 0.5 + 0.5 + 0.5 ) = 2.5 times normal speed. This avoids ridiculous speeds when fighting planets with a great number of units buffing speed.
column2: 通常情况下，当单位为所有者及其盟友提供行星速度加成时，加成是按指数级缩放的。3个具有1.5倍行星速度加成的单位会将速度提升至1.5 x 1.5 x 1.5 = 3.375倍。 如果启用此设置，速度加成将改为线性叠加，在上述例子中(每个单位不再提供1.5倍而是+0.5倍行星速度加成)速度仅为1 + (0.5 + 0.5 + 0.5) = 2.5倍正常速度。 这可以避免在有大量单位提供速度加成的行星上出现荒谬的速度值。

column1: Off by default, but forced on if the highest AI difficulty is at least 8 or if you are in Expert mode. Enabling this makes it so that the AI will spawn 3 Brutal Guardian Lairs somewhere in the galaxy, at least 5 hops from the player homeworld(s). Currently they may not even spawn on maps such as X if the player is in the center.   Once the 5-minute time has run out a Brutal Guardian will spawn for the Hunter Fleet of the AI owning the Lair.  Once this has happened every 30 minutes another one will spawn until either all players have been destroyed - or the Lair.  Once the spawning has started, it will not stop until the Lair is destroyed.  Killing it will inflict AIP, but also grant a small amount of  science and hacking points.  The Lair will also self-destruct if the AI command station of its planet dies.  If the Lair spawns for a Royal AI it will be transformed into a Royal Brutal Guardian Lair.
column2: 默认情况下处于关闭状态，但如果AI最高难度至少为8或你处于专家模式，则会强制开启。启用此选项后，AI将在星系中的某个位置生成3个残暴守护者巢穴，距离玩家母星至少5跳。目前，如果玩家位于地图中心，它们可能不会在诸如X的地图上生成。   5分钟时间结束后，拥有该巢穴的AI猎人舰队将生成一名残暴守护者。之后，每30分钟将再生成一名，直到所有玩家被摧毁或巢穴被摧毁。  一旦开始生成，在巢穴被摧毁之前不会停止。摧毁巢穴会增加AIP，但也会获得少量科学和黑客点数。如果巢穴所在行星的AI指挥站被摧毁，巢穴也会自毁。  如果巢穴为皇家AI生成，它将转变为皇家残暴守护者巢穴。

column1: Off by default, but forced on if the highest AI difficulty is at least 8 or if you are in Expert mode. column1: On a regular basis, the AI will try to 'Reinforce' planets.    Essentially what this means is, any AI planet that is currently next to a non-AI one, or has enemies on it, will start to gain more defenses over time. More Turrets will appear, more guards in the Posts, and more Guardians patrolling.  Higher Mark worlds will be much nastier with this, if you let one grow uncontested for a while.  However, you can influence this to some degree. Destroying things such as the Guard Posts will lower the maximum amount of defenses that planet can have, and spreading out your planets can cause the AI to spread the reinforcements out much more in turn.  You can also intentionally leave some planets alone if you don't intend to ever go there, so it starts to drain the Reinforcement Budget from places where it'd be dangerous to you.
column2: AI 会定期尝试对行星进行“增援”。  本质上，任何与非 AI 行星相邻或有敌人存在的 AI 行星，随着时间的推移都会获得更多防御设施。会出现更多的炮塔，岗哨里会有更多守卫，还有更多守护者巡逻。  如果让高等级行星不受干扰地发展一段时间，情况会变得更加棘手。  不过，你在一定程度上可以影响这一过程。摧毁岗哨等设施会降低该行星可拥有的最大防御量，分散你的行星布局会使 AI 更广泛地分散增援力量。  如果你不打算前往某些行星，也可以故意不去管它们，这样可以从对你构成威胁的地方抽走增援预算。

column1: On a regular basis, the AI will try to send a 'Wave' of units at you. Each AI planet has a specific set of units it'll try to use, and you are always warned of these attacks a few minutes before they hit (unless you disable Wave Warnings).    If you have multiple AIs, each AI will be sending Waves of their own, and do not necessarily need to be on the same target.  Only AI worlds that have an intact Warp Gate can initiate Waves, and Waves can only target planets directly adjacent to such a world. Raiding particular planets to destroy their gates can be helpful in defending certain areas of your territory, but note that <color=#ffa1a1>the AI's wave budget is never reduced by this</color>: waves it cannot send are saved up, making future waves stronger.
column2: AI 会定期尝试向你派遣一波单位。每个 AI 行星都有一套特定的单位用于攻击，而且你总会在这些攻击到达前几分钟收到警告（除非你禁用波次攻击警告）。  如果你面对多个 AI，每个 AI 都会各自发起波次攻击，且攻击目标不一定相同。  只有拥有完整虫洞门的 AI 行星才能发起波次攻击。摧毁特定的虫洞门有助于保卫你的部分领地。

Where you fall on the risk/reward spectrum and how confident you are in defending your homeworld is really going to determine if you want the default 4 of these, or more of them, or none at all.

column1: Once the AIP is high enough, the AI can send 'Reconquest Waves'.    These are sent in an identical manner to normal Waves, but are not on a regular basis. Instead, they are only ever sent if it would be strong enough to defeat the defenses on that planet.  Each of these contains a single Usurper unit. If the planet is cleared of hostiles, the Usurper will then be consumed to start reconstructing all of the AIs defenses there, including the Command Station and Warp Gate.  However, if you already paid the AIP for destroying the Station or Warp Gate previously, it won't increase it if you destroy them again.
column2: 一旦 AI 进度值（AIP）足够高，AI 就可以发起“重新征服波次”。  这些攻击的发起方式与常规波次攻击相同，但并非定期进行。相反，只有在攻击强度足以击败目标行星的防御时才会发起。  每次攻击都会包含一个篡权者单位。如果行星上的敌对势力被清除，篡权者单位将被消耗，用于重建该行星上 AI 的所有防御设施，包括指挥站和虫洞门。  不过，如果你之前已经为摧毁指挥站或虫洞门支付过 AIP，再次摧毁它们时 AIP 不会增加。

column1: Once you've destroyed the enemy command station on a planet, you can build your own and it will automatically gather the science for you. You can also use hacks to gain science, but that uses up valuable hacking points.

column1: Only applies when you are in multiplayer, and has different outputs on the host versus clients.  Gives statistics on how far the client is behind the host from each point of view, and how many turns the client is running behind.              This also shows a network round trip time from the client to the host, which is sort of like a ping time but does include software decoding time, so it's a bit more accurate than a ping (for telling effective time to transmit something and get a response that is fully decoded, not just transit time between the two network cards), as well as being networking-agnostic.  Just note that the effective round trip time would potentially be larger than the ping, if you separately measure that somewhere, and that's not a bug.
column2: 仅适用于多人游戏，主机和客户端有不同的输出。提供从各自角度看客户端落后主机多远以及客户端运行落后多少回合的统计信息。              这还会显示从客户端到主机的网络往返时间，类似于ping时间但包括软件解码时间，因此比ping更准确(用于判断传输某些内容并获得完全解码响应所需的有效时间，而不仅仅是两个网卡之间的传输时间)，并且与网络无关。请注意，如果您在其他地方单独测量，有效往返时间可能会大于ping时间，这不是错误。

column1: Only applies when you are in multiplayer, and has different outputs on the host versus clients.  Gives statistics on how much the game has had to correct in terms of divergent data between the client and the host.              Note: The PKIDs and squads are actually checked for divergences, and those are shown in more detail on the client than the host.  All the other things are sent in a periodic overwriting fashion, without checking for divergences, as the bandwidth used (which you can see with this setting on) is less disruptive than the CPU cycles required to do divergence checks.
column2: 仅适用于多人游戏，主机和客户端有不同的输出。提供游戏需要纠正客户端和主机之间数据差异的统计信息。              注意：PKID和小队实际上会检查差异，这些在客户端上显示得比主机更详细。其他所有内容都以定期覆盖的方式发送，不检查差异，因为使用的带宽(启用此设置后可以看到)比进行差异检查所需的CPU周期干扰更小。

column1: Originally created by humanity, the AIs became sentient in a muddled cluster of singularities over a few hundred years of civil war.  Their civilization is complex and largely opaque to us.  Most of their effort is going into a war with an unknown foe outside the galaxy.  Only the dregs and remnants have been left to guard the parts of space where they kicked humanity's teeth in.  Interestingly, they spared trillions of human lives -- all those living on planet surfaces.  The garrison forces simply refuse to allow anyone into space, and terminate any humans they find in space.  Many humans wonder if they see us as pets, or some sort of museum piece, or perhaps even as intellectual children.
column2: 人工智能最初由人类创造，在几百年的内战中，它们在一系列混乱的奇点中获得了意识。它们的文明复杂且对我们来说大多是神秘的。它们的大部分精力都投入到与银河系外一个未知敌人的战争中。只有残渣和残余力量被留下来守卫那些它们击败人类的空间区域。有趣的是，它们放过了数万亿人类的生命——所有生活在行星表面的人类。驻守部队只是简单地拒绝让任何人进入太空，并会消灭任何在太空中发现的人类。许多人类想知道它们是否把我们视为宠物、某种博物馆展品，或者甚至是智力上的孩子。

column1: Other defensive structure designs are under research in two isolated sectors. column1: Please note that this is NOT the same as setting a refresh rate on your monitor.  Mostly.  <size=9>        If you set VSync or Half-VSync, then indeed it will limit to those and you will likely see terrible performance.  Using vsync is a really bad idea, in that it really causes issues with variable-length frames, and will make your game choppier.  Assuming that you are using any other options in this list, it is telling the game to 'try to run at about that framerate.'  That won't actually mean the game runs at that framerate, but it will mean that the game tries to not run on average MORE than that framerate.  For one example, you don't need the game running at 300fps for no reason and having your GPU fan going nuts.  On the other hand, if the game gets choppy when above 60fps for you on an older machine, you might want to cap it at 60fps.  If you wish to set this to match your monitor refresh rate, that is fine, but please bear in mind that the non-vsync versions of this are very very much 'weak suggestions for maximum framerate,' and not any sort of hard limiter.  <size=10>      Looking for excellent technology to eliminate screen tearing without eliminating game performance?  The things to look into are GSync and FreeSync.
column2: 请注意：这与设置显示器刷新率不同。  <size=9>        如果设置垂直同步或半垂直同步，确实会限制帧率，但可能导致性能问题。垂直同步会导致帧时间不一致，使游戏显得卡顿。  使用列表中其他选项时，游戏会'尝试以大约该帧率运行'。这并不意味着游戏实际会以该帧率运行，而是尝试平均不超过该帧率。例如，您不需要游戏无故以300fps运行导致GPU风扇狂转。另一方面，如果在老旧机器上高于60fps时游戏卡顿，您可能希望限制在60fps。如果想匹配显示器刷新率也可以，但请注意非垂直同步版本只是'最大帧率的弱建议'，而非硬性限制。  <size=10>      寻找消除屏幕撕裂又不影响游戏性能的优秀技术？可以了解GSync和FreeSync。

column1: Pressing this button will enter or exit 'ping mode', in which you can leave colored markers strewn across one or more planets.  These markers fade over 6 seconds, and are mainly for communicating in multiplayer.
column2: 按下这个按钮将进入或退出'标记模式'，在这种模式下你可以在一个或多个行星上留下彩色标记。这些标记会在6秒后消失，主要用于多人游戏中的交流。

column1: Pressing this button will pop open the 'View /Edit Factions' window without pausing the game.  This is extremely useful for in multiplayer, where you may wish to use the controls in there to set up rules for how you interact with other players, gift them metal, or to even switch which faction you are controlling.
column2: 按下这个按钮将打开'查看/编辑派系'窗口而不暂停游戏。这在多人游戏中非常有用，你可以在那里设置与其他玩家互动的规则，赠送金属，甚至切换你控制的派系。

column1: Pressing this button will switch your control from the current human empire (or Solo Ark or Necromancer or whatever) to the next one.  This is useful to quickly help out allies in multiplayer, or if you want to play multiple factions by yourself (for instance, a regular human empire plus a Necromancer).
column2: 按下这个按钮将把你的控制权从当前的人类帝国（或独立方舟或死灵法师等）切换到下一个。这在多人游戏中快速帮助盟友时很有用，或者如果你想自己同时控制多个派系（例如，一个普通人类帝国加上一个死灵法师）。
普雷索林 舰队名称。 (由 FACC007 创建)

column1: Prevents enemy fleets from constructing new ships on this planet.
column2: 阻止敌方舰队在此行星上建造新单位。

column1: Previously an Outpost, now improved, this structure possesses new weapons and is able to make better ships at a faster pace.
column2: 先前只是一个哨站，现已升级，该结构配备了新武器，并能以更快的速度建造更优秀的单位。

column1: Produces Builders for the owning AI. Every 20 minutes. Also produces some Imperial Guardians periodically based on AIP.
column2: 为所属AI生产建造者。每20分钟。还根据AIP定期生产一些帝国守卫。

column1: Produces a fair amount of energy. Build these somewhere safe.
column2: 产生相当数量的能量。请将其建造在安全的地方。

column1: Produces and also uses metal to repair ships from an Engineering Transport Flagship, able to sustain the attack longer and fight bigger wars of attrition compared to other fleets.
column2: 生产并使用金属通过工程运输旗舰修理单位，能够比其他舰队更持久地维持攻击并进行更大规模的消耗战。

column1: Produces gravitic links to accelerate ships within the fleet and moves in close to slow down enemies.
column2: 产生引力链接以加速舰队内的单位，并接近以减速敌人。

column1: Produces refurbished ships from wreckage and its own metal supply.
column2: 从残骸和自身金属供应中生产翻新单位。

column1: Projectile-size teleportation beacons are a relatively new technology only developed in the last days of the Human Civil War. That did not stop engineers from already using them for war: On impact these do not simply deal damage, they teleport parts off the enemy structure, allowing the quick reshaping of suitable materials into copies of itself. While lasting only a short time these provide enough additional firepower to make the scientific investment worth it.
column2: 弹丸大小的传送信标是一种相对较新的技术，只在人类内战的最后几天才开发出来。但这并没有阻止工程师们已经将它们用于战争：在撞击时，它们不仅仅是造成伤害，还会传送敌人建筑的部分结构，允许快速将合适的材料重塑为其自身的副本。虽然持续时间很短，但它们提供了足够的额外火力，使科学投资物有所值。
保护者 放大器 战列舰
保护者 堡垒重型护卫舰
保护者 迫击炮重型护卫舰

column1: Protector turret, intended to be placed near important structures, and reduce incoming enemy fire. Also has a few tractor beams.
column2: 保护者炮塔，用于放置在重要建筑附近减少来袭敌人火力。还配备有少量牵引光束。

column1: Protector turret, intended to be placed near important structures, and reduce incoming enemy fire. This is built by the Sappers specifically for beachheading.
column2: 防御型炮塔，旨在放置在重要建筑附近，减少敌人的火力。这是工兵专门为滩头作战建造的。

column1: Protector turret, intended to be placed near important structures, and reduce incoming enemy fire. This is built by the Sappers.
column2: 防御型炮塔，旨在放置在重要建筑附近，减少敌人的火力。由工兵建造。

column1: Protects nearby allies and repairs the frontline.
column2: 保护附近的友军并修复前线。
保护附近的单位和建筑。

column1: Protects nearby ships and structures. Completely immobile, thus unable to be pushed by the Norris Effect.
column2: 保护附近的单位和建筑。完全无法移动，因此不会被诺里斯效应推动。

column1: Protects nearby ships and structures. Units protected by this will deal half the usual damage.  Completely immobile, thus unable to be pushed by the Norris Effect.
column2: 保护附近的单位和建筑。受其保护的单位将造成一半的常规伤害。完全不可移动，因此无法被诺里斯效应推动。

column1: Protects nearby ships and structures. Units protected by this will deal half the usual damage.  Completely immobile, thus unable to be pushed by the Norris Effect.
column2: 保护附近的单位和建筑。受此保护的单位造成的伤害将减半。完全无法移动，因此不会被诺里斯效应推动。

column1: Protects nearby ships and structures. Units protected by this will deal half the usual damage.  Slightly mobile, and thus vulnerable to being moved by ships with the Norris Effect.
column2: 保护附近的单位和建筑。受其保护的单位造成的伤害减半。略有移动性，因此容易被具有诺里斯效应的单位推动。

column1: Protects nearby ships and structures. Units protected by this will deal half the usual damage.  Slightly mobile, and thus vulnerable to being moved by ships with the Norris Effect.
column2: 保护附近的单位和建筑。受此保护的单位造成的伤害将减半。有轻微移动能力，因此可能会被具有诺里斯效应的单位推动。

column1: Protects nearby ships and structures. Units protected by this will deal half the usual damage.  Slightly mobile, and thus vulnerable to being moved by ships with the Norris Effect. Only given to command stations.
column2: 保护附近的单位和建筑。受其保护的单位将造成一半的常规伤害。略微可移动，因此易受具有诺里斯效应的单位推动。仅提供给指挥站。

column1: Protects the local command station from all harm while living (does not work on home command stations), slows most enemies anywhere on the planet and also traps them here.  Uses a massive amount of energy.
column2: 存在时保护当地指挥站免受一切伤害（对主指挥站无效），减缓行星上大多数敌人的行动并将其困在此处。消耗大量能量。

column1: Protects the local command station from all harm while living (does not work on home command stations), slows most enemies anywhere on the planet and also traps them here.  Uses a massive amount of energy.
column2: 存活时保护本地指挥站免受一切伤害（对母星指挥站无效），减缓行星上大多数敌人的速度并将其困在此处。消耗大量能量。

column1: Protects the vulnerable structures of Kaizers Marauders with a shield which absorbs the first few hits almost entirely.
column2: 保护凯泽掠夺者脆弱建筑，护盾可几乎完全吸收前几次攻击。

column1: Protects the vulnerable structures of Kaizers Marauders with a shield which absorbs the first few hits almost entirely. This one has Moonstone woven ito its hull, making it immune to phasing effects and highly reisistant to exotic damage and acid, Necromancy.
column2: 保护凯泽掠夺者脆弱建筑，护盾可几乎完全吸收前几次攻击。此型号将月长石织入船体，使其免疫相位效果，并高度抵抗异类伤害、酸蚀和死灵术。

column1: Protects the vulnerable structures of Kaizers Marauders with a shield which absorbs the first few hits almost entirely. This one has been made from refractive material, making it overall tougher and harder to disrupt the hull.
column2: 保护凯泽掠夺者脆弱建筑，护盾可几乎完全吸收前几次攻击。此型号采用折射材料制造，使其整体更坚韧，更难干扰船体。

column1: Provides mid-ranged tachyon and a Plinker Cannon to offer some offensive use.
column2: 提供中程快子和碰碰加农炮，以提供进攻用途。

column1: Provides supporting fire to the Nuclear Destroyer, its attacks bypassing most shielding.
column2: 为核弹驱逐舰提供支援火力，其攻击可绕过大多数护盾。

column1: Provides visibility on an enemy planet with a very low chance of being detected.  Able to cross through wormholes, unlike the rest of a command fleet.
column2: 在敌方行星上提供视野，极低的被发现概率。与指挥舰队的其他单位不同，能够穿越虫洞。

column1: Provides visibility on an enemy planet with a very low chance of being detected. These particular spies were gifted by the Spymaster Outguard
column2: 能在极低被发现概率下提供敌方行星的视野。这些特殊的间谍由间谍大师前哨站派遣。

column1: Prufrock is an expert at distracting the AI with swarms of decoy drones.
column2: 普鲁弗洛克擅长用成群的诱饵无人机分散 AI 的注意力。
普鲁弗洛克的游击队员

column1: Purchase a group of War Harvester bots from a fellow resistance group. These bots harvest metal from their targets and grant it to you using their scrap cannons. These are put under your command permanently.
column2: 从一个抵抗组织购买一组战争收割者机器人。这些机器人会从目标身上收集金属，并通过它们的废料加农炮将其交给你。这些机器人将永久受你指挥。

column1: Purchase a group of War Sieger bots from a fellow resistance group. These bots wield a rapid fire plasma cannon for long range devastation. These are put under your command permanently.
column2: 从一个抵抗组织购买一组战争攻城者机器人。这些机器人配备了速射等离子炮，用于远程破坏。这些机器人将永久受你指挥。

column1: Pursuit mode defaults to having your units concentrate firepower on a few targets at a time, and being grouped up more. Disabling this setting causes units in pursuit mode to spread out and engage more targets, but can lead to units between two targets unable to choose and just sitting there.
column2: 追击模式默认让你的单位集中火力攻击少数目标，并更加紧密地编组。禁用此设置会导致处于追击模式的单位分散并攻击更多目标，但可能导致位于两个目标之间的单位无法选择而只是呆在那里。

column1: Push the Zenith Architrave back from the planet. They are allowed to reclaim it, but prefer not to claim heavily defended planets. You can probably prevent them from reclaiming this planet by fortifying it heavily.
column2: 将天顶拱门使团从该行星推回去。他们被允许重新占领，但倾向于不占领重兵防守的行星。你可以通过大量筑防来防止他们重新占领这个行星。

column1: Pushes hostile non-stationary bubble forcefields and can implode shields quickly. Highly vulnerable to fusion weapons.
column2: 推移敌方非固定泡泡力场并可快速内爆护盾。极易受到聚变武器攻击。

column1: Puts focus on the on-screen search box to begin typing (the 'search for...' field in the Galaxy Map and the Encyclopedia).
column2: 将焦点放在屏幕上的搜索框以开始输入（星系地图和百科全书中的'搜索...'字段）。

column1: Puts your selection in Stand Down mode, or takes them out of it. While standing down, ships will not attack.  This is very useful for ships that are cloaked that you want to keep stealthy.         When disabled, you can also save metal: engineers will not spend metal doing work, and factories will not run, under-construction ships and structures won't build, etc.
column2: 让你的选择进入或退出待命模式。在待命状态下，单位不会攻击。这对于你想保持隐蔽的隐形单位非常有用。  当禁用时，你还可以节省金属：工程师不会花费金属工作，工厂不会运转，在建的单位和建筑不会继续建造等。

column1: Quick swarmer type that deals greatly increased damage to bubble forcefields, and spawns copies of itself on death.
column2: 快速的蜂群类型，对泡泡力场造成极大伤害，并在死亡时生成自身的复制体。

column1: Quick to collect, paralyze and then demolish enemies. Fast, at least for a medium-sized Frigate, but durable enough to survive attacks even from the enemies caught. Fortified against long-range attacks to protect against sniper and even occasional Sabot fire. Human ship designers and military officers alike refer to the Black Widow Frigate as the 'Cleaner'. Tidying up space tens of strike craft at a time.
column2: 快速收集、麻痹然后摧毁敌人。速度很快，至少对中型护卫舰而言，但足够耐用，即使在被捕获的敌人攻击下也能生存。强化防御远程攻击以防止狙击手甚至偶尔的破坏者火力。人类单位设计师和军官都称黑寡妇护卫舰为"清洁工"。一次清理数十艘攻击艇的太空。

column1: Quick-response ships with an Agile Transport Flagship. It has both raid and ambush capabilities.
column2: 快速反应单位，配备灵活运输旗舰。兼具突袭和伏击能力。

column1: Quickly transports AI Strikecraft to engagements.
column2: 快速运输AI打击机投入战斗。

column1: Quickly transports huge amounts of AI Strikecraft to engagements.
column2: 快速运输大量AI打击机投入战斗。

column1: Quite often the game needs to re-link the centerpieces of fleets, and it might be useful to see what is happening there under the hood in some limited cases.  For the most part this is all just happening as expected, though, so we don't need to clutter up the debug log with this info.  If something seems awry, we can turn this on to check it out more.
column2: 游戏经常需要重新链接舰队的核心部分，在某些情况下查看底层运行情况可能有用。大多数情况下这些操作都按预期进行，因此默认不启用以避免调试日志混乱。如果发现问题，可以启用此选项进行检查。

column1: Quite powerful and expensive ship with almost-melee range, but excellent damage per second against wounded enemies.
column2: 相当强大且昂贵的单位，射程近战级别，但对受伤敌人具有出色的每秒伤害。

column1: Quite powerful and expensive ship with almost-melee range, but excellent damage per second against wounded enemies. This one is cloaked as well.
column2: 相当强大且昂贵的单位，射程近战级别，但对受伤敌人具有出色的每秒伤害。 此型号还具备隐形能力。

column1: Quite powerful and expensive ship with almost-melee range, but excellent damage per second against wounded enemies. This one is cloaked, can fire while cloaked and phases between normal and multiphase state of matter using Skrith.
column2: 相当强大且昂贵的单位，射程近战级别，但对受伤敌人具有出色的每秒伤害。 此型号具备隐形能力，可在隐形状态下开火，并使用Skrith在正常态和多相态之间切换。

column1: Quite random bits of trivia and helpful advice that gets shown at random on the main menu as the 'tip of the day' each time you open the main menu.
column2: 相当随机的琐事和有用建议，每次打开主菜单时会随机显示为“每日提示”。

column1: REQUIRES the Leere to be enabled.  Allows two more Leere subfactions to spawn into the galaxy allied to both Player Zombies and AI Zombies respectively.  They act much like the regular Leere, with a few key differences: These Leere subfactions will never spawn more Leere if they already match or outnumber the Hostile to All Leere. They will ALWAYS spawn on a Human/AI Homeworld. The Zombification Aura is active for the most influencial Zombie faction near that planet. (The Zombie Infestation Map Mode may help.)
column2: REQUIRES the Leere to be enabled.  Allows two more Leere subfactions to spawn into the galaxy allied to both Player Zombies and AI Zombies respectively.  They act much like the regular Leere, with a few key differences: These Leere subfactions will never spawn more Leere if they already match or outnumber the Hostile to All Leere. column1: Raid Frigates and Apparitions for days.
column2: 突袭星舰和魅影持续作战。

column1: Raid and invasion strikecraft with a weapon that is increasingly effective against higher armor totals.
column2: 突袭和入侵用打击机，其武器对更高装甲总值越来越有效。

column1: Raid and invasion strikecraft with a weapon that is increasingly effective against higher armor totals. Boosts the speed and attack power of a small number of ship lines.
column2: 突袭和入侵用打击机，其武器对更高装甲总值越来越有效。提升少量单位生产线的速度和攻击力。

column1: Raid ships usually trade hull integrity for speed and attack power.  These are not the units you want to use in a stand-up fight, but they're great for raiding and for hit-and-run attacks.  When it comes to turrets, most of them are cheap and lightly defended for their size, but quick to build and pack a punch.
column2: 突袭型单位通常牺牲船体完整性换取速度和攻击力。这些单位不适合正面战斗，但非常适合突袭和打了就跑的战术。就炮塔而言，大多数突袭型炮塔造价低廉且防御薄弱，但建造迅速且威力强大。
掠夺者无人机舰队旗舰

column1: Raiders augmented with a pair of lightweight Shrike missile tubes. Does bonus damage on planet entry.
column2: 突击者，加装了一对轻型伯劳导弹发射管。进入行星时有额外伤害加成。

column1: Raise a ship type to Tier VII.
column2: 将一种单位类型提升到 VII 级。

column1: Rampaging, overcharged version of a Barbiel, born from the ashes of an Unstable Barbiel. Whatever exotic technologies are involved are not exactly healthy for the ship, however.
column2: 横冲直撞、过载的Barbiel版本，从不稳定Barbiel的灰烬中诞生。无论涉及何种外来技术，对单位来说都不太健康。

column1: Rampaging, overcharged version of a Phoenix, born from the ashes of an Unstable Phoenix. Whatever exotic technologies are involved are not exactly healthy for the ship, however.
column2: 狂暴的过载版凤凰，从不稳定凤凰的灰烬中诞生。然而，其中涉及的奇异技术对单位本身并不完全健康。
随机,中央,较中央,较边缘,最边缘

column1: Random,Farthest Deadend,Prefer Deadends,Fewer Links,Average Links,More Links,Always Most Links
column2: 随机,最远死角,偏好死角,较少连接,平均连接,较多连接,始终最多连接

column1: Randomize the Hydral's spawn timer, between 50% and 100% of the above value.
column2: 随机化海德拉的生成计时器，介于上述值的 50% 到 100% 之间。

column1: Rapid firing, deals tremendous damage to personal shielding but pitiful outside of this. Great support turret.
column2: 射速快，对个人护盾造成巨大伤害，但对护盾外的伤害很低。是很棒的支援炮台。

column1: Rapid response ship that engine stuns enemies at range and then collects them with tractor beams.
column2: 快速反应单位，能在远距离使敌人引擎瘫痪，然后用牵引光束捕获敌人。

column1: Rare Heavy frigate that is equipped with ballistic cannons and C3 equipment. This flagship boosts the attack power of all allied ship on this planet.
column2: 稀有重型护卫舰，配备弹道炮和 C3 设备。这艘旗舰可提升该行星上所有盟军单位的攻击力。

column1: Rather fast, and surprising durability and powerful (but also very expensive to make) and able to grab victims with a tractor beam and cause them to become allied zombies upon death.
column2: 速度快且耐久性高，能牵引目标并在其死亡时将其转化为友方僵尸

column1: Rather fond of having lots of swarmer type units, as well as those which spawn more on death.
column2: 非常喜欢拥有大量蜂群类型单位，以及那些死亡时会生成更多单位的单位。

column1: Rather mobile, advanced and expensive marksman support unit, with decent ability to reveal cloaked units, and is cloaked itself.
column2: 机动性强的高级狙击支援单位，具有反隐能力且自身隐形

column1: Rather mobile, advanced and expensive support unit, able to contribute modest damage with some vampirism, but the real benefit is the repair beam.
column2: 机动性强的高级支援单位，具有修复光束和吸血能力

column1: Rather than attacking you aggressively and causing potential devastating losses on your end, the Hunter Fleet acts almost like a second Warden Fleet -- things get very hairy for you when you are attacking the AI, then.
column2: 不会主动进攻并给你造成毁灭性损失，而是几乎像第二支守卫舰队一样行动 —— 当你进攻AI时，情况会变得非常棘手。

column1: Ravaged planets grant access to this universe to a powerful, evil Necromancer.  They will send dangerous attacks through. This is not visible in the game lobby, and is only exposed in game.
column2: 被掠夺的行星会为一位强大邪恶的死灵法师打开通往这个宇宙的大门。他们会发动危险的攻击。这在大厅中不可见，仅在游戏中暴露。

column1: Reach a game time of 10 hours in a single game.
column2: 在单局游戏中达到10小时游戏时长。

column1: Reach a game time of 15 hours in a single game.
column2: 在单局游戏中达到15小时游戏时长。

column1: Reach a game time of 5 hours in a single game.

column1: Selects what happens when a Devourer Golem is destroyed: Chrysalis No Loop: Will go through Chrysalis until it reaches a Tier 4 Devourer, if this final one dies it will be gone for good. Chrysalis Loop: Will go through Chrysalis until it reaches a Tier 4 Devourer, if this final one dies the Tier 1 Devourer will respawn. Respawn As Itself: Will respawn as the current type indefinitely. Respawn As Random Devourer Of Tier: Will respawn as a random Devourer of its tier.
column2: 选择吞噬者傀儡被摧毁时会发生什么： 蛹无循环：将经历蛹形态，直到达到第 4 级吞噬者，如果这最终形态死亡，它将永久消失。 蛹循环：将经历蛹形态，直到达到第 4 级吞噬者，如果这最终形态死亡，第 1 级吞噬者将重生。 自身重生：将无限期地以当前类型重生。 以同级随机吞噬者重生：将以该等级的随机吞噬者重生。

column1: Several mysterious, ancient structures exist on AI Planets throughout the galaxy. What happens when they absorb too much?       <color=#f25e1c>HIGH IMPACT:</color> This faction plays very differently, and is generally reactive. They can range from essentially doing near nothing, to dominating the galaxy depending on events.
column2: 银河系中AI行星上存在几个神秘古老的结构。它们无法被伤害也没有任何武器，但当同行星上有飞船死亡时会吸收能量。当它们吸收过多能量时会发生什么？       <color=#f25e1c>高影响:</color> 这个派系玩法非常不同，通常是反应性的。根据事件不同，它们可能几乎什么都不做，也可能主宰整个银河系。

column1: Several mysterious, ancient structures exist on AI Planets throughout the galaxy. They can range from essentially doing near nothing, to dominating the galaxy depending on events.   Having multiple members of the Dark Alliance enabled simultaneously is a massive difficulty increase
column2: 银河系中的AI行星上存在着几座神秘而古老的建筑。它们无法被伤害，也没有武器，但当有飞船在同一行星上被摧毁时，它们会吸收能量。当它们吸收过多能量时会发生什么呢？  <color=#f25e1c>影响重大：</color> 这个派系的玩法截然不同，通常是被动反应型的。根据事件的发展，它们可能几乎无所作为，也可能主宰整个银河系。   同时启用多个黑暗联盟成员会极大地增加游戏难度

column1: Several mysterious, ancient structures exist on AI planets throughout the galaxy. They cannot be harmed, and do not have any weapons, but they absorb energy when a ship dies on the same planet. What happens when they absorb too much?  When enough units die on planets with Dark Spire Vengeance Generators, the Vengeance Generator will unleash a powerful force to attack everything in sight.
column2: 一些神秘古老的结构存在于整个星系的AI行星上。它们无法被伤害，也没有武器，但会吸收同行星上单位死亡时的能量。吸收过多会发生什么？  当有黑暗尖塔复仇发生器的行星上死亡足够多单位时，复仇发生器会释放强大力量攻击视线内一切目标。

column1: So, you're curious about Hacking Points, Commander?  As you may have guessed, the concept of these 'HaP'/'Hacking Points' is an over-simplification that we've provided for your HUD.    The first thing we should say is: please don't freak out.  Yes, this is incredibly illegal by modern standards, but we have our very best minds on this, and it's all under control.  Next, some context.  As we assume you know, there are manufacturing nanobots that are required for building most sorts of things in all our factories.  We use them, the AI uses them, everybody uses them.  If you need an analogy from the 21st century for some reason, it's kind of like how 3D printing back then was able to make 'impossible to manufacture' shapes by building them layer by layer.  Back in the 20th century and prior, in older types of moulding or casting techniques for metalwork, there were many things we couldn't do that 3D printing opened the door on.  Move forward to the present, and with these manufacturing nanobots, you can see the analogue.  There are certain molecules and micro-and-nano structures that just can't be created in any fashion other than by nanobots.  So these are not exactly a rare commodity.  But just like the 20th and 21st centuries often had robots on an assembly lines that were extremely task-specific (think automobile manufacture), that's again analogous to what most of our manufacturing nanobots are like.  In terms of our run-of-the-mill nanobots, they're expensive to make and a challenge to acquire, but we make do.  And partly for safety reasons, partly for cost reasons, these are not general-purpose nanobots.  Oh, uh, also for legal reasons.  Not that there's any spacefaring government left to enforce that.    Why no general-purpose nanobots?  For the same reason that humans no longer use general-purpose AI: these both tend to lead to apocalypses.  That said, and I apologize that this turned into a history lesson, but obviously this was clearly not always so in either case.  Exhibit A is the AI running wild around the galaxy and even outside it, that we have to somehow kill.  That's general purpose AI from the old times.  Exhibit B are some old-style general-purpose manufacturing nanobots that we can still locate around the various planets on the wormhole network.  You won't find those around just any random planet in the universe, but all of the planets on the wormhole network were human worlds, used for commerce or manufacturing or just living life.  All of them had a several hundred year history of construction in space.  And back before the general-purpose AI was truly out of hand, there were general-purpose nanobots being used to construct spacecraft.  These nanobots are generally dormant, and not something to worry about.  They would be all kinds of illegal in the current society if current society still existed, but we can be scoop them up and use them for various military purposes.  Desperate times, and all that.  Uh, as a side note.  Exhibit B.1: there were some industrial accidents a long time ago, and there are pockets of non-dormant general-purpose nanobots out there.  It's possible they may even have some basic general-purpose AI running on them.  That's what we refer to as a nanocaust, and let's hope we don't actually come face to face with one.  Though if we do, it's at least as bad for the AI as it is for us.
column2: 指挥官，你对入侵点数感到好奇吗？正如你可能猜到的，这些'HaP'/'入侵点数'的概念是我们为你的HUD提供的过度简化版本。  首先我们要说的是：请不要惊慌。是的，按照现代标准这绝对是违法的，但我们有最优秀的人才在处理这件事，一切都在控制之中。  接下来是背景说明。如你所知，制造用纳米机器人是我们所有工厂生产大多数物品的必需品。我们用它们，AI用它们，每个人都在用它们。  如果需要21世纪的类比，这有点像当时的3D打印技术通过逐层构建能够制造'无法生产'的形状。在20世纪及更早的金属加工铸造技术中，有许多事情是我们做不到的，而3D打印打开了这扇门。  回到现在，通过这些制造用纳米机器人，你可以看到类似的进步。有些分子和微纳结构只能通过纳米机器人制造。所以它们并非稀有商品。但就像20和21世纪流水线上的机器人通常专用于特定任务(比如汽车制造)，我们大多数制造用纳米机器人也是如此。  就我们普通的纳米机器人而言，制造成本高且获取困难，但我们还是设法解决了。部分出于安全原因，部分出于成本考虑，这些都不是通用纳米机器人。哦，呃，还有法律原因。虽然现在也没有星际政府来执行这些法律了。  为什么没有通用纳米机器人？和人类不再使用通用AI的原因一样：这两者都容易导致末日灾难。  虽然这变成了一堂历史课，但显然这两种情况并非一直如此。  证据A是肆虐银河系甚至更远处的AI，我们必须想办法消灭它。那是旧时代的通用AI。  证据B是一些旧式的通用制造用纳米机器人，我们仍然可以在虫洞网络各行星上找到它们。你不会在宇宙中随便哪个行星发现它们，但虫洞网络上的所有行星都曾是人类的居住地，用于商业、制造或日常生活。它们都有数百年的太空建设历史。在通用AI真正失控之前，通用纳米机器人曾被用于建造航天器。  这些纳米机器人通常处于休眠状态，无需担心。在当前社会(如果还存在的话)它们会是各种违法，但我们可以收集它们用于军事目的。非常时期行非常之事。  呃，顺便说一下。证据B.1：很久以前发生过一些工业事故，导致一些非休眠的通用纳米机器人散布在外。它们甚至可能运行着一些基本的通用AI。这就是我们所说的纳米灾变，希望我们不会真的遇到一个。不过如果真的遇到，对AI的伤害至少和我们一样大。

column1: Some factions, such as the Marauders and Nanocaust, will destroy AI Command Stations in the process of capturing planets for themselves. column1: Some planets can be fairly scary, their strength value far beyond everything you have combined. But! Most of that won't immediately attack you if you go in, and with a bit of thought, you can still win.    Instead, a good part of that is in stationary defenses such as Guard Posts and Turrets, then another large chunk are in guards stored inside those Posts.  If you're careful, you can move from area to area and clear them out, avoiding being in the range of any Guard Posts and Turrets, and not waking up the stored guards until ready. Even the Guardians, which like to patrol, you can intercept and fight on your own terms individually.  Lastly, take a look at the planet you're thinking of attacking. You might notice things such as the Guardians all have similar weaknesses or strengths, or every guard unit is something really fast, or is cloaked, etc. This can help you plan what to bring, and what to leave home.
column2: 有些行星可能相当可怕，它们的实力值远超你所有部队的总和。但是！大部分敌人不会在你进入时立即攻击，只要稍加思考，你仍然可以获胜。    实际上，很大一部分防御是固定的警戒站和炮塔，另一大部分是储存在这些站内的守卫部队。  如果小心行事，你可以逐个区域清理，避开任何警戒站和炮塔的范围，在准备好之前不惊动储存的守卫。即使是喜欢巡逻的守护者，你也可以拦截并在有利条件下单独对付。  最后，观察你想攻击的行星。你可能会注意到所有守护者有相似的弱点或优势，或者每个守卫单位都非常快速，或是隐形的等等。这可以帮助你规划带什么部队，留什么在家。

column1: Sometimes you're going to find a planet that is enticing, but you just aren't strong enough to take it with your current forces.          If you try to attack that planet, and fail, then expect for the AI to make a strong counterattack.  That's absolutely okay if it happens every so often, but the catch comes when you see a planet that you are just nowhere close to being able to take, and you figure you might just want to attack it 30 times in a row and that ought to do the trick.  Expect the AI's response to that to be... far more extreme, to the point it might cost you the game.  Trying to attack a target and only taking out part of it is absolutely core to the game, to be sure.  But that's more along the lines of taking 3-5 passes against something that's too big for you but not insanely overpowered.  Expect some reprisal waves from this back-and-forth, and that's absolutely okay.  In general if you see something that just absolutely outclasses you, then you should focus on getting stronger and come back.
column2: 有时候你会发现某个行星很诱人，但以你当前的兵力还不足以拿下它。  如果你试图进攻那个行星但失败了，那就准备好迎接 AI 的猛烈反击吧。  偶尔发生这种情况完全没问题，但问题在于，当你看到一个你根本无力拿下的行星，还想着连续进攻它 30 次就能成功时，就要小心了。AI 对此的反应可能会……极端得多，甚至可能让你输掉游戏。  尝试攻击一个目标并只摧毁它的一部分，这绝对是游戏的核心玩法。但这更多是指对那些对你来说太大但又不是超强的目标进行 3 - 5 次攻击。这种反复攻击会引发一些报复波次，这完全没问题。  一般来说，如果你看到某个明显比你强大的目标，那你应该专注于提升实力，然后再回来。

column1: Spire Spheres are, relatively, smaller impact factions that hang around their home sphere. The Spire Spheres act much like the Zenith Dyson Spheres you're used to, but with some key differences based on the Spire that control it.  The Gray Spire are the most familiar, and will be relatively easy to work with. Just don't put too many military ships on their Sphere planet, and they'll leave you alone in kind.  The Chromatic spire are more difficult. They will respond to shows of strength on both their Sphere planet, and on any planets that have even a single military unit of theirs. It is practically impossible to coexist with them. However, you can use their aggression to your advantage, and hack a Chromatic Antagonizer right out from their Sphere, allowing you to direct their anger towards a specific location.
column2: 尖塔族球体是相对较小的影响派系，围绕它们的母球体活动。尖塔族球体的作用很像你熟悉的泽尼斯戴森球，但根据控制它的尖塔族有一些关键差异。  灰色尖塔族是最熟悉的，相对容易合作。只要不在他们的球体行星上放置太多军事舰船，他们就会以同样的方式对待你。  彩色尖塔族更困难。他们会对在他们的球体行星上以及任何甚至只有一个他们军事单位的行星上的武力展示做出反应。与他们共存几乎不可能。然而，你可以利用他们的攻击性为你的优势，入侵一个彩色挑衅者，直接从他们的球体中出来，让你可以将他们的愤怒引导到特定位置。

column1: Stolen for humanity, the Crupellarii is A slow and very tanky ship used by the Architrave as a damage sink in battle. column1: Studying the Tank Devourer's armor allows for a new approach to structuring our ships: Dimension-reactive armor, when incoming damage reaches a certain threshold, self-distorts into another dimension takes the bullet with it, sacrificing itself for the rest of the ship. In return a Tremor Fusion Bomb strikes armor plates to resonate with them, the more armor the worse, inflicting vibrational damage to the hull below.

column1: Superior firepower has always been the way to go. Back in the day weapons big enough to destroy entire planets were common to see, but luckily rare to fire. The AI's Planet Crackers do not have such hesitation, so why should we? It is time to unseal the full firepower of the Human Race and unleash it in one vast beam array of destruction, blowing away all our enemies in a single shot. Important: This ship needs a lot of time to charge its weapon. It must be kept outside of a transport. When enabling the 'Show Weapon Activity Details' setting under Personal Settings -> Display the cooldown until the next shot is ready is displayed.
column2: 超级火力一直是制胜之道。在过去，足以摧毁整个行星的武器很常见，但幸运的是很少发射。AI的行星粉碎者没有这样的犹豫，那我们为何要有？是时候解封人类种族的全部火力，以一道巨大的毁灭性光束阵列将其释放，一举消灭我们所有的敌人。 重要提示：这个单位需要大量时间充能其武器。必须将其保持在运输船外。在启用"显示武器活动详情"设置（个人设置 -> 显示）下，可看到下一次射击的冷却时间。

column1: The A-DBS-17 is one of the most sturdy designs Kaizers Marauders ever built. It was designed as the fleet leader for a bulky and comparably slow fighting force, but with the ability to constantly and quickly produce drones which can reinforce both offensively and defensively. In addition it uses long-range fusion bomb weapons, makig it deadly when attacking structures. The Armored variant is not only equipped with a even more powerful armor than the Plated hull, but also adds a hardened hull which prevents the ship from taking too much damage from too powerful shots. The upgrade was created from... 'acquired' Dark Zenith Thaumite.
column2: A-DBS-17是凯泽掠夺者有史以来建造的最坚固的设计之一。它被设计为一支笨重且相对缓慢的战斗力量的舰队领袖，但具有持续快速生产无人机的能力，可从攻防两面进行增援。此外它使用远程核聚变炸弹武器，在攻击建筑时具有致命效果。装甲变体不仅配备了比镀层船体更强大的装甲，还增加了硬化船体，防止单位受到过于强大攻击的过度伤害。此升级源自……「获取」的暗天顶Thaumite。

column1: The A-DC-21 Armored Disrupter Corvette is a support craft that tips the scales of combat in favor of Kaizers Marauders as long as it has a fleet to back up. Using their Disloger-Goo technology to disassemble enemy ships, impairing engines and weapons and turning them into packets of metal, as well as amplifying allied damage these ships should be a primary target. The Armored variant is not only equipped with a even more powerful armor than the Plated hull, but also adds a hardened hull which prevents the ship from taking too much damage from too powerful shots. The upgrade was created from... 'acquired' Dark Zenith Thaumite.
column2: A-DC-21装甲干扰者护卫舰是一艘支援舰艇，只要后方有舰队支持，就能使战斗天平向凯泽掠夺者倾斜。使用其分解-粘液技术废弃敌舰、削弱引擎和武器并将其转化为金属包，同时放大友军伤害，因此这些单位应为首要目标。装甲变体不仅配备了比镀层船体更强大的装甲，还增加了硬化船体，防止单位受到过于强大攻击的过度伤害。此升级源自……「获取」的暗天顶Thaumite。

The Armored variant is not only equipped with a even more powerful armor than the Plated hull, but also adds a hardened hull which prevents the ship from taking too much damage from too powerful shots. The upgrade was created from... 'acquired' Dark Zenith Thaumite.

column1: The ABS-18 improves upon quite ancient Human technology, namely the Military Command Station. It wasn't commissioned until recently though, but breakthroughs in Parametrium Radiation shielding now allow both FTL travel and planet-wide ship amplification to work on the same ship. The power draw strains the ship, and its weapons aren't particularly strong for a vessel its size, but its durability prevents an important fleet booster from being lost in fights.
column2: ABS-18改进了相当古老的人类技术，即军事指挥站。不过直到最近才被启用，Paramerium辐射屏蔽的突破使超光速旅行和全行星单位放大能在同一个单位上工作。电力消耗使单位紧张，其武器对如此尺寸的单位来说并不特别强大，但其耐久度可防止重要的舰队增强器在战斗中损失。

column1: The AI felt a need for a subsidiary force to wipe out small annoyances, and not need to bother its main Processors with petty things. The AI took various races they have conquered in the Arcenverse, twisted them by genetic engineering, and fused them into a new and powerful force to crush its foes.  The Scourge use Spawners to produce Neophytes which evolve into Warriors and Builders. Scourge units can be upgraded at Armories. As those structures level up over time they get more powerful, so being proactive to destroy an enemy scourge's infrastructure (or protect an ally's infrastructure) is critical.
column2: 人工智能觉得需要一支辅助部队来清除小麻烦，而不必让其主处理器为琐事操心。人工智能将他们在阿尔森宇宙中征服的各种种族，通过基因工程进行改造，并将它们融合成一支新的强大力量来击溃敌人。  天灾军团使用孵化器生产新兵，新兵会进化成战士和建造者。天灾军团的单位可以在军械库进行升级。随着这些建筑随着时间升级，它们会变得更强大，因此主动摧毁敌人天灾军团的基础设施（或保护盟友的基础设施）至关重要。

column1: The AI gets periodic Wormhole Invasions to attack you. There are several different types of Wormhole Invasions.   Planet Linking: creates a Wormhole Projector that links two planets, then spawns an attack force. Destroying the projector removes the wormhole. Exogalactic Wormhole: The AI creates a temporary wormhole on one of your planets, and launches attacks through it. Send As Waves: The AI will instead use this budget as a number of simultaneous attacks from Relentless Waves.
column2: AI会定期通过虫洞入侵来攻击你。有几种不同类型的虫洞入侵。  行星连接：创建一个连接两个行星的虫洞投影器，然后生成攻击部队。摧毁投影器会移除虫洞。 外星系虫洞：AI在你的一个行星上创建一个临时虫洞，并通过它发起攻击。 作为波次发送：AI将改为使用这个预算作为来自无情波次的多次同时攻击。

column1: The AI had been using this structure to eavesdrop on long range Spire communications prior to their invasion of the Spire's galaxy. Hacking this beacon will allow you to detect Spire signals as well.  Doing this hack will allow you to start finding Spire Relics and transition to open warfare against the AI. Actual gameplay will not be changed until you rescue the first Spire Relic.  <color=#f25e1c>HIGH IMPACT:</color> This drastically changes how the game will play, if it is embarked upon.  Not recommended for someone who just picked up the game until they have some experience playing normally.
column2: 在人工智能入侵尖塔星系之前，它一直利用这个结构窃听尖塔的远程通讯。破解这个信标后，你也能探测到尖塔的信号。  破解此信标将让你开始寻找尖塔遗物，并转入与人工智能的公开战争。在你找到第一件尖塔遗物之前，实际游戏玩法不会改变。  <color=#f25e1c>高影响：</color> 一旦开启此行动，游戏玩法将发生巨大变化。  不建议刚上手游戏的玩家尝试，最好先积累一些常规游戏经验。

column1: The AI has a number of subfleets that it uses for various different purposes in the game. Each subfleet has its own budget, strengths and weaknesses.
column2: AI 在游戏中有多个分舰队，用于各种不同的目的。每个分舰队都有自己的预算、优势和劣势。

column1: The AI has adapted this drill to help them extract Cuendillar from targets. It will periodically send off Transports which the AI can use to build powerful ships.
column2: AI改造了此钻机来帮助从目标中提取坤迪亚。它会定期派出运输船，AI可利用它建造强大的单位。

column1: The AI has allied itself with Lovecraftian horrors intent on shattering reality, alongside many other factions.  They focus on on cross planet attacks through normal space. Be prepared for a horrifying battle!
column2: 该AI与意图粉碎现实的洛夫克拉夫特式恐怖存在结盟，同时还联合了许多其他派系。  他们专注于通过常规空间进行跨行星攻击。准备迎接一场恐怖的战斗吧！

column1: The AI has been possessed by the Bubbling Madness at the center of the universe.
column2: AI已被宇宙中心的沸腾疯狂所附身。

column1: The AI has constructed a device that is radiating energy that resonates with the Dyson Sphere. The subspace waves emanating from the device appear to be responsible for the recent erratic signals from the Dyson Sphere. The higher Mark this structure is, the more ships the Antagonized Dyson Sphere will spawn.
column2: AI建造了一个能发射与戴森球共振能量的装置。从该装置发出的子空间波似乎是导致戴森球近期异常信号的原因。这个结构的Mark等级越高，敌对戴森球生成的飞船就越多。

column1: The AI has constructed a device that radiates energy resonating with the Devourer Golem. It appears to be a constant stream of data, manipulating the sensory systems of the Golem and preventing it from going after the AI thus aiming it at its enemies. If we do not want to face a giant monster gobbling up all our ships we should destroy this device. It is also very likely that the Devourer will see previous 'master' as the primary enemy for a while once this is destroyed.
column2: AI 建造了一个设备，辐射出与吞噬者傀儡共振的能量。它似乎是一个持续的数据流，操纵着傀儡的传感系统，阻止其追击 AI，从而将其引向 AI 的敌人。 如果我们不想面对一个吞掉我们所有单位的巨型怪物，就应该摧毁这个设备。一旦被摧毁，吞噬者很可能会在接下来的一段时间内将之前的"主人"视为主要敌人。

column1: The AI has figured out a way to disrupt Dark Spire energy using these devices. As long as this Ward remains on the planet, the Dark Spire's ships will explode when they enter the planet.
column2: AI已找到使用这些装置干扰黑暗尖塔能量的方法。只要这个守卫留在行星上，黑暗尖塔的飞船进入该行星时就会爆炸。

column1: The AI has set up Turret Schematic Servers (TSS) and Other Defensive Schematic Servers (ODSS) in order to conduct research and development on various defenses. You can hack these structures in order to obtain the blueprints they house, in order to build defenses on your world. Additionally, both the TSS and ODSS have a unique dynamic where if you destroy the AI Command Station on the planet that they are on, both the hack price and hack response are decreased. This opens up a decision for you: Pay a greater amount of hack points and increase the AI's hack response to you? Or eat the AIP and greatly reduce the cost of hacking it? Either way, hacking a TSS or ODSS is the only way to get dedicated defenses for your planets, freeing up fleets to go on the attack.  Turret Schematic Servers--as their name implies--give you turrets to work with. Turrets are divided into Big and Small turrets, with Big turrets costing more energy and metal, and having a lower cap, but are exceptionally strong on their own, while Small turrets are much more numerous in cap and cost less metal and energy, but are weaker.  Other Defensive Schematic Servers give you various other knickknacks and doodads to defend your planets with, such as various types of minefields, or tractor beam arrays and stationkeepers. Additionally, hacking an ODSS is cheaper than a TSS.  Another facet of TSS and ODSS Hacking is that you can choose between giving all your command stations, Battlestations and Citadels the defensive structures, or giving a single Battlestation or Citadel 3x the number of the same hacked structure. The latter hack can be very useful for beachheading, and is cheaper to boot!
column2: 炮塔蓝图服务器（TSS）和其他防御建筑蓝图服务器（ODSS）是为你的行星获取防御设施的好方法。这些服务器能为你提供炮塔和其他防御建筑的蓝图，你可以在行星上建造这些设施。            你可以通过黑入这些服务器来获取 TSS 和 ODSS。不过，它们通常位于敌方行星，所以你需要派遣舰队前往这些行星进行入侵操作。一旦黑入 TSS 或 ODSS，你就可以使用蓝图在行星上建造炮塔和其他防御建筑。            你应该尽可能多地获取 TSS 和 ODSS。不过，你要注意不要过度扩张。如果你向不同行星派遣太多舰队去黑入 TSS 和 ODSS，可能会分散兵力，导致已占领的行星失守。            但如果策略得当，获取 TSS 和 ODSS 能非常有效地为你的行星获取防御设施，让你在游戏中占据显著优势。

column1: The AI has tamed this Accursed Elderling. Paralyzes even massive ships and reflects damage back to its source.
column2: AI已驯服这只受诅长者。它能使巨大的舰船瘫痪，并将伤害反射回来源。

column1: The AI has tamed this Blasphemous Elderling. Focus five beams at a point that deal more damage to ships of lower Mark compared to itself.
column2: AI已驯服这只亵渎长者。它会将五道光束集中在一点，对印记等级低于自身的舰船造成更多伤害。

column1: The AI has tamed this Cyclopean Elderling. Fires a beam that bypasses shields.
column2: AI已驯服这只独眼长者。它发射的光束可以绕过护盾。

column1: The AI has tamed this Decadent Elderling. Pulls ships close so they can be devoured, healing itself in the process.
column2: AI已驯服这只堕落长者。它会将舰船拉向自己并吞噬，在此过程中恢复生命值。

column1: The AI has tamed this Envious Elderling. Has advanced tractor beams that can restrain ships up to its own size.
column2: AI已驯服这只嫉妒长者。它拥有先进的牵引光束，可以束缚与其自身大小相当的舰船。

column1: The AI has tamed this Feeble Elderling.
The AI has tamed this Nether Drake Elderling. Breathes fire ... and fireballs.
column2: 人工智能已驯服这只冥河幼龙长者。它会喷火……还有火球。

column1: The AI has tamed this Plagueswarm Elderling. Spawns encircling Plaguehosts that create viralswarms as they deal damage.
column2: 人工智能已驯服这只疫潮长者。它会召唤环绕自身的疫源体，这些疫源体在造成伤害时会生成病毒潮。

column1: The AI has tamed this Slothful Elderling. It fires in bursts, specializing against enemies with strong engines.
column2: AI已驯服这只懒惰长者。它会进行爆发式射击，擅长对付引擎强大的敌人。

column1: The AI has tamed this Wrathful Elderling. It gets stronger as it or its prey takes damage.
column2: AI已驯服这只愤怒长者。当它或它的猎物受到伤害时，会变得更强。

column1: The AI is building a structure that will cause all the Dyson Spheres in the galaxy to come after you. Kill it before it can finish warping in!
column2: AI正在建造一个会导致银河系中所有戴森球攻击你的结构。在它完成跃迁前摧毁它！

column1: The AI is conscious, but will operate primarily in a reactive capacity. Most of your opposition will be in the form of defensive AI forces in enemy territory.
column2: AI 处于活跃状态，但主要以被动方式行动。你遇到的大部分对抗将是敌方领土上的 AI 防御部队。

column1: The AI is constructing a strange new device. Most of it appears to be a subspace signaling antenna aimed directly at the Devourer Golem. We would be wise to destroy it as soon as possible.
column2: AI 正在建造一个奇怪的新设备。它的大部分似乎是一个直接对准吞噬者傀儡的子空间信号天线。我们明智的做法是尽快摧毁它。

column1: The AI is effectively dormant; this difficulty is good for practicing the game without any real opposition.
column2: AI 实际上处于休眠状态；此难度适合在没有真正对抗的情况下练习游戏。

column1: The AI is in the center

The AI is researching a Spire Relic here. Their investigations have damaged the relic; after you rescue the relic, it can't leave the planet and must build a Spire City here. Cities spawned in this way override adjacency rules, though you still can't place two cities on a single planet.
column2: 人工智能正在这里研究一件尖塔遗物。他们的研究已经损坏了遗物；你回收遗物后，它无法离开这颗行星，必须在这里建造一座尖塔城市。以这种方式生成的城市会覆盖相邻规则，但你仍然不能在同一颗行星上放置两座城市。

column1: The AI is using a Spire Relic to power the defenses on this citadel. If you destroy it then you can recover the Relic; the burst of AI energy when the Citadel is destroyed should obscure the Relic's energy signature, leading to reduced AI response after you take the relic.
column2: 人工智能正在使用尖塔遗物为这座堡垒的防御系统供能。如果你摧毁它，就能回收遗物；堡垒被摧毁时释放的人工智能能量会掩盖遗物的能量信号，从而减少你拿走遗物后人工智能的反应。

column1: The AI is weak economically (around a 5), but will climb through the mark levels very quickly. They really hate command stations.
column2: 该AI经济上很弱（大约5左右），但会非常迅速地攀升标记等级。它们极其厌恶指挥站。

column1: The AI periodically spawns Depots that are the focal points of various AI anti-human countermeasures. Trains will spawn and travel between Stations on the way to the Depot to increase the power of these attacks. Intercept and destroy the trains to weaken these attacks.       <color=#f25e1c>MEDIUM IMPACT:</color> This is a notable boost to the AI, boosting it and creating new unique units to fight you, the types of both depending on the selected Intensity. However, you can perform some robberies on the Trains for some usually limited resources, so if done right they can be a net boost to you.
column2: AI会定期生成仓库，作为各种反人类对策的焦点。列车会在前往仓库的路上生成并在站点间行驶，以增强这些攻击的力量。拦截并摧毁列车可以削弱这些攻击。       <color=#f25e1c>中等影响:</color> 这显著增强了AI，既提升了AI实力又创造了新的独特单位来对抗你，两者的类型都取决于所选强度。不过你可以抢劫列车获取通常有限的资源，如果操作得当，它们可以成为你的净收益。

column1: The AI takes your presence a bit more seriously. You may find your attention split from time to time and will have to more carefully consider the repercussions of your choices and how the enemy will react to them. Ongoing reckless expansion on your part has the potential to incite a deadly response from AI.
column2: AI 会更加重视你的存在。你可能会发现自己的注意力不时被分散，并且需要更谨慎地考虑你的选择所带来的后果，以及敌人会如何反应。你持续的鲁莽扩张有可能引发 AI 的致命反击。

column1: The AI used these terrifying ships to harvest other races to join the Scourge. Let's see if it makes you the next trophy...
column2: AI使用这些可怕的舰船收割其他种族加入Scourge。让我们看看它是否会让你成为下一个战利品...

column1: The AI uses Risk Analyzers to detect threats; for each Risk Analyzer the AI controls, AI Progress will go up each hour. If you capture them then you can feed the AI bad intel and reduce AIP instead.  The AI uses the information from Risk Analyzers to justify sending periodic Exostrikes (aka Exogalactic Strikeforces) against you.
column2: AI使用风险分析仪检测威胁；AI控制的每个分析仪每小时都会增加AI进度(AIP)。如果你占领它们，反而可以向AI提供假情报降低AIP。  AI利用分析仪的信息来证明定期发动外银河打击部队(Exostrikes)攻击你的合理性。

column1: The AI uses these structures to spawn Waves and Exogalactic Strikeforces. Destroy to prevent the AI from initiating new Waves against your planets. If this is destroyed while the AI is planning to send a Wave through it, the Wave will come through a different Warp Gate and the next Wave and Wormhole Invasion after this that the AI sends will be stronger.  The AI can still path through this planet to attack you, or spawn reinforcements here, even if you destroy the warp gate.
column2: AI 使用这些结构生成波次和星系外打击力量。摧毁它可以阻止 AI 从该行星发起新的波次攻击。如果在 AI 计划通过它发送波次时摧毁它，波次将通过其他跃迁门，并且 AI 发送的下一个波次和虫洞入侵将更强大。

column1: The AI uses these wormholes to transport its Reserves around its empire.
column2: AI使用这些虫洞在其帝国内部运输储备部队。

column1: The AI will only utilize its most basic subroutines. Retaliation will be minimal in response to your efforts.
column2: AI 只会使用其最基本的子程序。对你的行动，它的反击将微乎其微。

column1: The AI will periodically spawn Instigator Bases that will help the AI defeat you. If the AI isn't allowed to spawn Instigator Bases then the game becomes much easier.
column2: AI将定期生成煽动者基地，帮助AI击败你。如果不允许AI生成煽动者基地，那么游戏会变得容易得多。

column1: The AI will send trains to this Depot and then Something Impressive will happen.
column2: AI会将列车派往这个车库，然后一些令人印象深刻的事情将会发生。

column1: The AI.       Adding more AIs has a large impact on the game. More AIs mean more Waves and other things to deal with at once. And of course, more AI Overlords to defeat.   Each AI gets its own income, but we reduce it a bit with more AIs in the game.  x1 AIs = 100% x2 AIs =  90% x3 AIs =  80% 4+ AIs =  70%  But if the AIs are not friendly with one another, they don't count. So after defeating the first of two AIs the one left would go up from 90% to 100%. Similarly if you have AI Civil War on they all would be 100%.
column2: AI阵营。       增加更多AI会对游戏产生重大影响。更多AI意味着同时要应对更多波次攻击和其他威胁。当然，也需要击败更多AI霸主。  每个AI都有独立收入，但我们会随AI数量增加而略微降低： x1 AI = 100% x2 AI = 90%  x3 AI = 80% 4+ AI = 70%  但如果AI彼此不友好则不计入。例如击败两个AI中的第一个后，剩下的会从90%提升到100%。同样如果开启AI内战则全部按100%计算。

column1: The ALC-49 Acidic Light Corvette was created as an alternative to the DC-21 Disrupter Corvette. Whereas the DC-21 protects its allies by impairing enemies, the ALC-49 can aid in destroying enemies by increasing ally damage.
column2: ALC-49酸性轻型护卫舰是作为DC-21干扰者护卫舰的替代方案而创建的。DC-21通过削弱敌人保护盟友，而ALC-49则通过增加友军伤害来协助摧毁敌人。

column1: The AR-68 Adaptor Raider was designed not long after the Adaptor Turret, with the same concept in mind, but much cheaper and simpler. Its targeting systems and multi-angle turret setup allow for its firepower to be spread across many smaller targets, focused on single large enemies and everything in between. It's been mounted onto a hull with average protection and velocity.
column2: AR-68适配者突击者是在适配者炮塔之后不久设计的，秉承相同理念，但更廉价和简单。其瞄准系统和多角度炮塔配置使其火力可分散到众多小目标、聚焦到单个大敌人或介于两者之间。它搭载在拥有平均防护和速度的船体上。

column1: The AT-90 Adaptor Turret is not a fancy superweapon like some of the Tier 3 Marauder structures. It's fairly simple in both design and design philosophy, but has gone through many iterations over the decades and became very complex. Slightly above average in nearly every department - damage, durability, range, cost efficiency - and the ability to either focus its damage onto single big enemies, or spread it against large amounts of enemies it this turret completes Kaizers Marauders defensive capabilities.
column2: AT-90适配者炮塔不像某些三级掠夺者建筑那样是花哨的超级武器。它在设计和理念上相对简单，但经过数十年的多次迭代已变得非常复杂。在几乎所有方面——伤害、耐久度、射程、成本效率——都略高于平均水平，并能将其伤害聚焦到单个大型敌人或分散对付大量敌人，这种炮塔完善了凯泽掠夺者的防御能力。

column1: The Acquisitive Rangers defend planets near their Starbase, fighting fiercely. Wields a metabolizing gun.
column2: 贪婪游骑兵保卫其星站附近的行星，英勇作战，使用代谢炮。

column1: The Acutian Lesser Locust carries on the battle, though they are much weaker
column2: 阿库提安小型蝗虫继续战斗，但实力弱得多。

column1: The Acutian Locusts swarm against the enemy! They have metabolization. When a locust is killed, it spawns a lesser locust.
column2: 阿库提安蝗虫蜂拥攻击敌人！它们拥有代谢能力。蝗虫被击杀时会生成一只小型蝗虫。

column1: The Anticipatory Warden, but slipperier.  <color=#f25e1c>Warden Rallying:</color> Positions itself like the Anticipatory Warden, and its ships use the same kiting behavior that yours are able to us; constantly backing away while firing.  <color=#f25e1c>Strategy:</color> <color=#ffa1a1>Very tricky to chase down with short-ranged ships</color>; bring long range or superior speed. It has no Warden Fleet Bases to raid.
column2: 在大多数方面与预测型监守舰队相同，但其单位开始使用你也能使用的风筝战术。这使得它们更难被追击！

column1: The Aprahanti Lesser Locust carries onf the battle, though they are much weaker.
column2: 阿普拉汉提次级蝗虫继续战斗，但实力弱得多。

column1: The Aprahanti Locusts swarm against the enemy! They use a vampiric weapon to steal the health of their enemies. When a locust is killed, it spawns a lesser locust.
column2: 阿普拉汉提蝗虫蜂拥攻击敌人！它们使用吸血武器偷取敌人的生命。蝗虫被击杀时会生成一只小型蝗虫。

column1: The Architrave are a warlike bunch of Zenith. They will claim a small part of the galaxy as their Territory, and defend it ruthlessly. Periodically, they will attempt to expand further.  This is a complex faction, and reading the Journals will definitely help you understand how they work. <color=#f25e1c>PHASING:</color> This faction makes heavy use of phasing technology. Ships out-of-phase with each other are unable to interact at all. Architrave ships can phase out themselves or enemy ships, creating an independent battlefield.   <color=#f25e1c>MEDIUM IMPACT:</color> This faction will essentially prevent you from accessing a region of the galaxy unless you want some major battles (for example, it might make some Data Centers, ARSs or other valuable capturables much harder to take).  For a <color=#f25e1c>HIGH IMPACT:</color> version, you can enable the Civil War. If there are 2 or more Architraves with Civil War enabled, then they will wage war against each other when any Civil War Enabled Architrave gets too powerful (even if they are on the same minor faction team). You can get caught in the crossfire, so be wary. Taking a central position can mean you have giant Architrave armadas pathing through your planets. Since Civil Wars are so impactful, these ZAs will expand more slowly. Note that this means you can put a single Architrave into Civil War Enabled mode to make it a bit weaker but without triggering the Civil War.
column2: 拱壁派是一群好战的天顶势力。他们会宣称星系的一小部分区域为自己的领地，并无情地捍卫它。他们还会定期尝试进一步扩张。  这是一个复杂的派系，阅读日志肯定有助于你了解他们的运作方式。 <color=#f25e1c>相位技术:</color> 该派系大量使用相位技术。处于不同相位的舰船之间完全无法互动。拱壁派的舰船可以让自己或敌方舰船进入相位状态，从而创造一个独立的战场。   <color=#f25e1c>中等影响:</color> 这个派系基本上会阻止你进入星系的某个区域，除非你想进行一些大规模的战斗（例如，这可能会使一些数据中心、自动资源站或其他有价值的可占领目标更难夺取）。  若要体验 <color=#f25e1c>高影响</color> 版本，你可以启用内战模式。 如果有两个或更多开启内战模式的拱壁派势力，那么当任何一个开启内战模式的拱壁派变得过于强大时，他们就会相互开战（即使他们属于同一个次要派系阵营）。你可能会陷入交火之中，所以要小心。占据中心位置可能意味着会有庞大的拱壁派舰队穿过你的行星。由于内战的影响很大，这些拱壁派势力的扩张速度会更慢。请注意，这意味着你可以让单个拱壁派进入内战模式，使其稍微变弱，但不会触发内战。

column1: The Architrave did not appreciate the attack on the Castra and have phased it out completely. It now appears to have devoted its resources to building very strong Architrave ships comparable to Dire Guardians. Three varieties will release at a time, but it will take five minutes before it can release more. Upon death, it releases three Golem-tiered Bustuarius.
column2: 拱心石势力对堡垒遭到攻击十分不满，将其完全转化为相位状态。现在它似乎将资源投入到建造与恐怖守卫相当的强大拱心石舰船中。每次会释放三种舰船，但需要五分钟后才能再次释放。在被摧毁时，它会释放三艘魔像级的布斯图阿里乌斯舰船。

column1: The Architrave only creates these terrifying Golems to send against major threats such as other hostile Architrave. Avoiding getting stuck in the middle of these civil wars is highly recommended. This Hastati golem fires a concentrated disintegration beam, dealing devastating damage to its target and phasing it. It also retaliates by returning a portion of the damage it receives back to the sender. Fortunately, this golem mostly resides in multiphase, only entering realspace for a short time after traversing a wormhole.
column2: 天顶拱心石仅在应对重大威胁（如其他敌对的天顶拱心石势力）时才会制造这些恐怖的魔像。强烈建议避免卷入这些内战之中。这台哈斯塔提魔像能够发射集中式分解光束，对目标造成毁灭性伤害并使其进入多相状态。它还会将所受伤害的一部分返还给攻击者以进行反击。幸运的是，这台魔像大部分时间处于多相状态，仅在穿越虫洞后短暂进入现实空间。

column1: The Architrave only creates these terrifying Golems to send against major threats such as other hostile Architrave. Avoiding getting stuck in the middle of these civil wars is highly recommended. This Principes golem embodies a demonic spider, phasing and pulling ships towards its weblike starburst beam. Fortunately, this golem mostly resides in multiphase, only entering realspace for a short time after traversing a wormhole.
column2: 拱心石只会制造这些恐怖的巨像来对抗重大威胁，例如其他敌对的拱心石势力。强烈建议避免卷入这些内战之中。这尊军团巨像形似一只恶魔蜘蛛，能够进入相位状态，并将舰船拉向它那蛛网般的星爆光束。幸运的是，这尊巨像大部分时间都处于多相位状态，只有在穿越虫洞后才会短暂进入现实空间。

column1: The Architrave only creates these terrifying Golems to send against major threats such as other hostile Architrave. Avoiding getting stuck in the middle of these civil wars is highly recommended. This Triari golem has three powerful weapons, the phasion bomb only enabled in realspace but bypasses the shield restriction to phase out foes. The remaining two weapons are designed for long-range siege. Fortunately, this golem mostly resides in multiphase, only entering realspace for a short time after traversing a wormhole.
column2: 天顶拱心石只会制造这些可怕的魔像来对抗诸如其他敌对拱心石之类的重大威胁。强烈建议避免陷入这些内战之中。这台三列兵魔像拥有三种强大的武器，相位炸弹仅在现实空间中启用，但可以绕过护盾限制使敌人进入多相位状态。其余两种武器则是为远程攻城而设计的。幸运的是，这台魔像大部分时间都处于多相位状态，仅在穿越虫洞后短时间进入现实空间。

column1: The Armada Empire has two main races, the Terran and the Kilrathi. You can build their Starbases, which allow you to build more combat ships. There are also other starbases on the map you can claim from other races that can be claimed with Hacking.  You can build Ranger Outposts to defend the region around their planets.  You can build Swarm Launchers. Swarm Launchers produce Locusts when you build a Swarm Lure; the locusts will then attack the planet with the Lure. They provide additional attack power. When the Lure is destroyed, the remaining locusts will attack nearby enemy planets.  You can get more Metal, Science or Hacking Points by building and defending Mines on hostile planets. These mines will automatically become transports and fly back to a Starbase to drop off their resources. Click the Tyderian region of the resource bar to see more details about your mining.   The Armada must battle the AI strengthened by Veins of Tyderian; these generate additional powerful AI ships and defenses. These can be farmed for Tyderian that is used for upgrades and building new Starbases.  You can also hack the Tyderian Veins in a number of ways; you can for example generate additional resources for them at the cost of fighting powerful enemies.
column2: 无敌舰队帝国有两个主要种族：人类和基拉西。你可以建造他们的星站，从而建造更多战斗单位。地图上还有来自其他种族的星站，可以通过入侵技术占领。  你可以建造游侠前哨站来防御其行星周边区域。  你可以建造蜂群发射器。当你建造蜂群诱饵时，蜂群发射器会生产蝗虫；蝗虫将攻击有诱饵的行星。它们提供额外的攻击力。当诱饵被摧毁后，剩余的蝗虫将攻击附近的敌方行星。  你可以通过在敌方行星上建造和防御矿场来获得更多金属、科技或入侵点数。这些矿场会自动变成运输船飞回星站交付资源。点击资源栏的泰德瑞安区域查看采矿详情。   无敌舰队必须与由泰德瑞安矿脉增强的AI作战；这些矿脉会产生额外的强大AI单位和防御。可以从中开采泰德瑞安，用于升级和建造新的星站。  你还可以通过多种方式入侵泰德瑞安矿脉；例如，你可以为它们生成额外资源，但代价是与强大敌人作战。

column1: The Armada Empire is a group of races, led by the Terran and Kilrathi, who have banded together to fight the AI.  The Kilrathi provide tanky ships but less damage, and the Terran provide damage but are less tanky. The Armada can further compliment its ships by finding additional starbases on the map. Having a good variety of ships is generally a good idea for the Armada!  With the Armada enabled, there will also be a significant infestation of Tyderian Veins on the map. These structures can cause a variety of negative things (building extra AI ships in particular), and destroying them will give you resources you will need. You can do a variety different hacks on the Veins to get more resources.
column2: 无敌舰队帝国是一个由人类和基拉西领导的种族联盟，团结起来对抗AI。  基拉西提供耐打的单位但伤害较低，而人类提供伤害但较不耐打。无敌舰队可以通过在地图上找到额外的星站来进一步增强其单位。拥有多样化的单位通常对无敌舰队来说是个好主意！  启用无敌舰队后，地图上还会出现大量的泰德瑞安矿脉感染。这些建筑可能导致各种负面情况（特别是建造额外的AI单位），摧毁它们将为你提供所需的资源。你可以对矿脉进行各种入侵操作以获取更多资源。

column1: The Armada infused their Metal Mine with Tyderian to make it extra effective. Like a Metal Mine, it can only be built on an AI-owned planet. When completed it will transform into a Transport and fly to a Starbase for processing.
column2: 无敌舰队向其金属矿场注入了泰德瑞安，使其效率大幅提升。与普通金属矿场一样，只能建在AI拥有的行星上。完成后将转变为运输船飞往星站进行加工。

column1: The Armada uses this structure to generate Hacking Points by researching the AI; as a result, it can only be built on an AI-owned planet. When completed it will transform into a Transport and fly to a Starbase for processing.
column2: 无敌舰队通过从AI提取能量建造此建筑来生产入侵点数；因此只能建在AI拥有的行星上。完成后将转变为运输船飞往星站进行加工。

column1: The Armada uses this structure to generate Metal by pulling energy from the AI; as a result, it can only be built on an AI-owned planet. When completed it will transform into a Transport and fly to a Starbase for processing.
column2: 无敌舰队通过从AI提取能量建造此建筑来生产金属；因此只能建在AI拥有的行星上。完成后将转变为运输船飞往星站进行加工。

column1: The Armada uses this structure to generate Science by researching the AI; as a result, it can only be built on an AI-owned planet. When completed it will transform into a Transport and fly to a Starbase for processing.
column2: 无敌舰队通过研究AI建造此建筑来生产科技；因此只能建在AI拥有的行星上。完成后将转变为运输船飞往星站进行加工。

column1: The Avaricious Rangers defend planets near their Starbase, wielding a powerful Bolt weapon. Much more powerful than the Acquisitive Ranger.
column2: 饕餮游骑兵保卫其星站附近的行星，使用强大的闪电武器。比贪婪游骑兵强大得多。

column1: The Azaran Empire can be set to invade the galaxy at some unknown time during the game, or immediately. An immediate spawn is the scariest, and can sometimes make the game extraordinarily hard.
column2: 阿扎兰帝国可以设定在游戏中的某个未知时间入侵银河，或立即入侵。立即生成是最可怕的选项，有时会使游戏极其困难。

column1: The B-ALC-49 Blitz Acidic Light Corvette was created as an alternative to the DC-21 Disrupter Corvette. Whereas the DC-21 protects its allies by impairing enemies, the ALC-49 can aid in destroying enemies by increasing ally damage. The Blitz variant has the same engines as the Strike variant, but they and their weapons are boosted by a wormhole energy siphon. When built, unloaded and after traveling through a wormhole the additional power supercharges the craft, making it exceptionally fast and deadly. To accomplish this large amounts of... 'obtained' Dark Zenith Alkahest was used.
column2: B-ALC-49闪击酸性轻型护卫舰是作为DC-21干扰者护卫舰的替代方案而创建的。DC-21通过削弱敌人保护盟友，而ALC-49则通过增加友军伤害来协助摧毁敌人。闪击变体拥有与突击变体相同的引擎，但引擎和武器受到虫洞能量虹吸的增强。建造、卸载后及穿越虫洞后，额外能量为飞船增压，使其异常快速和致命。为此使用了大量……「获得」的暗天顶Alkahest。

column1: The B-AR-68 Blitz Adaptor Raider was designed not long after the Adaptor Turret, with the same concept in mind, but much cheaper and simpler. Its targeting systems and multi-angle turret setup allow for its firepower to be spread across many smaller targets, focused on single large enemies and everything in between. It's been mounted onto a hull with average protection and velocity. The Blitz variant has the same engines as the Strike variant, but they and their weapons are boosted by a wormhole energy siphon. When built, unloaded and after traveling through a wormhole the additional power supercharges the craft, making it exceptionally fast and deadly. To accomplish this large amounts of... 'obtained' Dark Zenith Alkahest was used.
column2: B-AR-68闪击适配者突击者是在适配者炮塔之后不久设计的，秉承相同理念，但更廉价和简单。其瞄准系统和多角度炮塔配置使其火力可分散到众多小目标、聚焦到单个大敌人或介于两者之间。它搭载在拥有平均防护和速度的船体上。闪击变体拥有与突击变体相同的引擎，但引擎和武器受到虫洞能量虹吸的增强。建造、卸载后及穿越虫洞后，额外能量为飞船增压，使其异常快速和致命。为此使用了大量……「获得」的暗天顶Alkahest。

column1: The B-TB-4 Torpedo Bomber is the Kaizers Marauders answer to anything the size of a heavy corvette or above. Their torpedoes are slow and short-ranged, but the seismic warhead resonates with the target structure and thus the larger the resonating body, the greater the damage. The Blitz variant has the same engines as the Strike variant, but they and their weapons are boosted by a wormhole energy siphon. When built, unloaded and after traveling through a wormhole the additional power supercharges the craft, making it exceptionally fast and deadly. To accomplish this large amounts of... 'obtained' Dark Zenith Alkahest was used.
column2: B-TB-4鱼雷轰炸机是凯泽掠夺者对重型护卫舰及以上尺寸所有物体的答案。其鱼雷缓慢且射程短，但地震飞弹与目标结构发生共振，共振体越大，伤害越大。闪击变体拥有与突击变体相同的引擎，但引擎和武器受到虫洞能量虹吸的增强。建造、卸载后及穿越虫洞后，额外能量为飞船增压，使其异常快速和致命。为此使用了大量……「获得」的暗天顶Alkahest。

column1: The BD-1 Beam Dreadnought is without a doubt the biggest and most powerful ship Kaizers Marauders can produce at any larger quantity than 1. Filled to the brim with adapted Spire technology, using their advanced weapons, shields and structural design fused with the already impressive engineering of Kaizers Marauders it is advised to only engage this vessel in... 'underhanded' combat, using its size, mass, armor and limited range against it.
column2: BD-1光束无畏舰无疑是凯泽掠夺者能以超过1的数量生产的最大最强单位。充满了改造的尖塔技术，使用他们的先进武器、护盾和结构设计，与凯泽掠夺者已有的强大工程能力融合，建议只在……「不光彩」的战斗中与这个单位交战，利用其尺寸、质量、装甲和有限射程来对抗它。

column1: The BHF-2 Bulk Heavy Frigate is a prototype designed to carry extremely powerful support equipment. Itself more a support than a combat ship the BHF's purpose is to prevent large and well-shielded enemies from escaping the assault of Kaizers Marauders.
