Cloaked ships in range will be revealed very quickly and many larger ships such as frigates and even transports may be ensnared by its tractor beams.
column2: BHF-2堡垒重型护卫舰是一种旨在携带极其强大支援装备的原型舰。其本身更像是支援舰而非战斗舰，BHF的目的是阻止大型和拥有强力护盾的敌人逃脱凯泽掠夺者的攻击。射程内的隐形单位将被迅速揭示，许多大型单位如护卫舰甚至运输船可能被其牵引光束捕获。

column1: The BLST-1 Blockade Station is a newly-introduced prototype Marauder defensive installation which relies less on direct firepower but on durability and inhibiting enemies with tractor beams and sticking goo onto enemies in range. The station's goo tanks are rigged to explode on death, dealing significant damage to all enemies in range and readying them for rapid recycling.
column2: BLST-1封锁站是一种新引入的原型掠夺者防御设施，较少依赖直接火力，而更多依赖耐久度和用牵引光束抑制敌人，并将粘液附着到射程内的敌人身上。该站的粘液储罐在死亡时会爆炸，对射程内所有敌人造成显著伤害，并为快速回收做好准备。

column1: The BM-7 Blast Mine is designed to channel the shockwave of a detonation into a single target. The fraction of the force that isn't channeled can still damage enemies in range.
column2: BM-7爆破雷旨在将爆炸的冲击波引导至单个目标。未被引导的那部分力量仍可对射程内的敌人造成伤害。

column1: The BMF-12 Blast Mine Factory has only one purpose: Constantly generate more and more and more Blast Mines. The Factory itself is also just a drone, built by the Mine Destroyer.
column2: BMF-12爆破雷工厂只有一个目的：持续生成越来越多的爆破雷。工厂本身也只是一架由雷区驱逐舰建造的无人机。

column1: The BST-9 Beam Sniper Turret is the result of decades of FTL weapon technology development by Kaizers Marauders. Its extremely powerful tachyon beam emitter projects damage at speeds faster than light, and while a higher albedo of the target reduces the damage these turrets have the numbers and power to obliterate almost any foe extremely quickly.
column2: BST-9光束狙击手炮塔是凯泽掠夺者数十年超光速武器技术发展的成果。其极其强大的快子光束发射器以超光速投射伤害，虽然目标更高的反照率会减少伤害，但这些炮塔的数量和力量足以极快速消灭几乎所有敌人。

column1: The BTC-39 Breach Torpedo Turret was designed as a cheap deterrant against large ships. The warhead generates a seismic shockwave throughout larger hulls which becomes much more devestating once the breakpoint of 5tx has been achieved. The result is catastrophic hull failures along all major fault lines, and ships will fall apart quickly in the face of it.
column2: BTC-39突破鱼雷炮塔是作为一种廉价的威慑手段对抗大型单位而设计的。飞弹在大型船体中产生地震冲击波，一旦达到5tx的临界点将变得更加毁灭性。结果是沿所有主要断层线发生灾难性船体破裂，单位将在其面前迅速瓦解。

column1: The Bloodfang Rangers defend planets near their Starbase, wielding an AOE attack. They also take less damage from remote enemies
column2: 血牙游骑兵保卫其星站附近的行星，使用范围攻击。 它们受到远程敌人的伤害也较少

column1: The Bloom-class heavy frigate is an advanced guard vessel used by the Chromatic Spire. When one of its plasma projectiles explodes, it also damages several nearby units for reduced damage.
column2: 绽放级重型护卫舰是彩色尖塔使用的先进护卫舰船。当它的等离子炮弹爆炸时，还会对附近的多个单位造成一定程度的伤害。

column1: The Bokrug once lived in the land of Mnar until they were cruelly driven forth by humans. Now they return with vengeance, wielding corrosive beams.
column2: 博克鲁格曾居住在姆纳尔之地，直到被人类残酷地驱赶出去。如今它们带着复仇归来，使用腐蚀光束。

column1: The Breaking Rangers defend planets near their Starbase, wielding vampiric weapons.
column2: 撕裂游骑兵保卫其星站附近的行星，使用吸血武器。

column1: The Brute Rangers defend planets near their Starbase, wielding a powerful Bolt weapon. Much more powerful than the Cannibal Ranger.
column2: 蛮力游骑兵保卫其星站附近的行星，使用强大的闪电武器。比食人游骑兵强大得多。

column1: The C-BD-1 Charged Beam Dreadnought is without a doubt the biggest and most powerful ship Kaizers Marauders can produce at any larger quantity than 1. Filled to the brim with adapted Spire technology, using their advanced weapons, shields and structural design fused with the already impressive engineering of Kaizers Marauders it is advised to only engage this vessel in... 'underhanded' combat, using its size, mass, armor and limited range against it. The Charged variant has upgraded reactors and sensors onboard, giving it the ability to shoot further and deal more damage.
column2: C-BD-1充能光束无畏舰无疑是凯泽掠夺者能以超过1的数量生产的最大最强单位。充满了改造的尖塔技术，使用他们的先进武器、护盾和结构设计，与凯泽掠夺者已有的强大工程能力融合，建议只在……「不光彩」的战斗中与这个单位交战，利用其尺寸、质量、装甲和有限射程来对抗它。充能变体升级了舰载反应堆和传感器，赋予其更远射击和更高伤害的能力。

column1: The C-BTC-39 Charged Breach Torpedo Turret was designed as a cheap deterrant against large ships. The warhead generates a seismic shockwave throughout larger hulls which becomes much more devestating once the breakpoint of 5tx has been achieved. The result is catastrophic hull failures along all major fault lines, and ships will fall apart quickly in the face of it. The Charged variant has upgraded reactors and sensors onboard, giving it the ability to shoot further and deal more damage.
column2: C-BTC-39充能突破鱼雷炮塔是作为一种廉价的威慑手段对抗大型单位而设计的。飞弹在大型船体中产生地震冲击波，一旦达到5tx的临界点将变得更加毁灭性。结果是沿所有主要断层线发生灾难性船体破裂，单位将在其面前迅速瓦解。充能变体升级了舰载反应堆和传感器，赋予其更远射击和更高伤害的能力。

column1: The C-CBT-1 Charged Coil Beam Turret is a brand-new addition to Kaizers Marauders arsenal of defenses. From gathered debris their scientists were able to duplicate the spire's most iconic weapon system. The turret does, however, have not only a single coil beam but multiple arrays: The main emitter focuses on high-mass targets in order to destroy them quickly, while the point defense coil beams take out strike craft trying to destroy the turret up close. The Charged variant has upgraded reactors and sensors onboard, giving it the ability to shoot further and deal more damage.
column2: C-CBT-1充能线圈光束炮塔是凯泽掠夺者防御武器库的最新成员。通过收集到的残骸，他们的科学家成功复制了尖塔最具标志性的武器系统。然而这种炮塔不只有单一线圈光束，而是多个阵列：主发射器聚焦于高质量目标以快速摧毁它们，而点防御线圈光束清除试图近距离破坏炮塔的星战。充能变体升级了舰载反应堆和传感器，赋予其更远射击和更高伤害的能力。

column1: The C-CM-22 Charged Chain Minefield is a very large amount of very small mines. They take basically no 'space' in space. The mines themselves are so small that they effectively exist between all other objects, but are linked together so that for each minefield, each network of mines, they will explode all at once, doing massive damage in a large. The Charged variant has upgraded reactors and sensors onboard, giving it the ability to shoot further and deal more damage.
column2: C-CM-22充能链式雷场由大量极其微小的雷构成。它们在太空中基本不占用「空间」。雷本身非常微小，实际上存在于所有其他物体之间，但通过链式连接，每个雷场、每个雷网络的所有雷都会同时爆炸，在大范围内造成巨额伤害。充能变体升级了舰载反应堆和传感器，赋予其更远射击和更高伤害的能力。

column1: The C-GM-3 Charged Goo Minefield was created as a preventative measure against raids. Once hit an enemy ship will be covered in what Kaizers Marauders call 'black snot', a sticky and errosive chemical concoction consisting out of various substances which bind to metals. Not only does it reduce the operating efficiency of ships, once the construct breaks apart the adhesive nature prevents the metal from dispersing, keeping it in one place for rapid recycling. The Charged variant has upgraded reactors and sensors onboard, giving it the ability to shoot further and deal more damage.
column2: C-GM-3充能粘液雷场是作为预防袭击措施而创建的。一旦被触发，敌舰将被涂上凯泽掠夺者所谓的「黑鼻涕」，这是一种粘稠且具侵蚀性的化学混合物，由各种与金属结合的物质组成。它不仅降低单位的运行效率，一旦结构解体，其粘合性质还阻止金属散逸，使其留在原地以便快速回收。充能变体升级了舰载反应堆和传感器，赋予其更远射击和更高伤害的能力。

column1: The C-HF-17 Hunter-Fighter is designed to tear apart enemies already damaged by other foes. They are fast, tough, resilient to debuffs and can deal massive damage to damaged enemies, but are expensive and depend on enemies being weakened beforehand. The Cloaked variant has a cloaking device, but will reveal itself when attacking.
column2: C-HF-17猎人战斗机旨在撕碎已被其他友军伤害的敌人。它们快速、坚韧、对减益效果有抵抗力，并能对已受伤敌人造成巨额伤害，但成本高昂且依赖敌人先被削弱。隐形变体配备隐形装置，但攻击时会暴露自身。

column1: The C-LR-54 Light Raider is the default offensive fleet carrier for Kaizers Marauders. Its fast, can deal decent amounts of damage and may be produced cheaply and en masse. The weapons are designed to deal with both standard frigates and strike craft efficiently. While it can be a quick lance in the flank of any stellar empire, its main weakness is the cheap material which limits its durability. The Cloaked variant has a cloaking device, but will reveal itself when attacking.
column2: C-LR-54轻型突击者是凯泽掠夺者默认的进攻舰队航母。它速度快，可造成可观伤害，且可廉价批量生产。武器旨在高效处理标准护卫舰和星战。虽然它可以成为任何星际帝国侧翼的快速突击矛头，但主要弱点在于廉价材料限制了其耐久度。隐形变体配备隐形装置，但攻击时会暴露自身。

column1: The C-PC-12 Charged Phase Cannon fires volleys of the same particles Kaizers Marauders use for their jump drives. Upon exiting they teleport parts of ships somewhere randomly within 2 million lightyears, effectively disappearing them forever. The effect is strongest so long as the hull is sealed, any breaches cause the majority of particles to disappate in the face of exposed electical and plasma conduits. Additionally the particles interact with those that make up bubble forcefields. However, the particles need to prime mid-flight which means the weapon cannot hit up close. The Charged variant has upgraded reactors and sensors onboard, giving it the ability to shoot at lower minimum range and deal more damage.
column2: C-PC-12充能相位加农炮发射凯泽掠夺者用于跳跃驱动的相同粒子齐射。出膛后这些粒子将单位的部分随机传送到200万光年内的某处，实际上使其永远消失。只要船体密封，效果最强，任何破口都会导致大部分粒子在面对暴露的电流和等离子管道时消散。此外这些粒子与构成泡泡力场的粒子相互作用。然而粒子需要在飞行中充能，这意味着该武器无法近距离命中。充能变体升级了舰载反应堆和传感器，赋予其在更低最小射程射击和造成更高伤害的能力。

column1: The C-SLF-11 Sting Light Frigate has served for quite a long time as a the backbone of Kaizers Marauders bunker buster fleets. It's cheap, balanced and especially when accompanied by interceptors deadly to fortifications and larger frigates. Alone, however it is severely lacking in anti-strike craft capabilities. The Cloaked variant has a cloaking device, but will reveal itself when attacking.
column2: C-SLF-11螫刺轻型护卫舰长期作为凯泽掠夺者地堡破坏舰队的骨干服役。它廉价、平衡，尤其配合拦截机时对防御工事和大型护卫舰致命。但单独作战时严重缺乏反星战能力。隐形变体配备隐形装置，但攻击时会暴露自身。

column1: The CBT-1 Coil Beam Turret is a brand-new addition to Kaizers Marauders arsenal of defenses. From gathered debris their scientists were able to duplicate the spire's most iconic weapon system. The turret does, however, have not only a single coil beam but multiple arrays: The main emitter focuses on high-mass targets in order to destroy them quickly, while the point defense coil beams take out strike craft trying to destroy the turret up close.
column2: CBT-1线圈光束炮塔是凯泽掠夺者防御武器库的最新成员。通过收集到的残骸，他们的科学家成功复制了尖塔最具标志性的武器系统。然而这种炮塔不只有单一线圈光束，而是多个阵列：主发射器聚焦于高质量目标以快速摧毁它们，而点防御线圈光束清除试图近距离破坏炮塔的星战。

column1: The CM-22 Chain Minefield is a very large amount of very small mines. They take basically no 'space' in space. The mines themselves are so small that they effectively exist between all other objects, but are linked together so that for each minefield, each network of mines, they will explode all at once, doing massive damage in a large.
column2: CM-22链式雷场由大量极其微小的雷构成。它们在太空中基本不占用「空间」。雷本身非常微小，实际上存在于所有其他物体之间，但通过链式连接，每个雷场、每个雷网络的所有雷都会同时爆炸，在大范围内造成巨额伤害。

column1: The CT-58 Consumer Turret is one of the oldest turret designs for Kaizers Marauders. Over the years its prime purpose hasn't changed much, it remains a rather tanky short-range turret which excels at turning enemies into metal upon being destroyed, but it has constanly become better and more efficient doing so.
column2: CT-58消耗者炮塔是凯泽掠夺者最古老的炮塔设计之一。多年来其主要用途变化不大，仍是一种相当坚韧的短程炮塔，擅长在摧毁敌人时将其转化为金属，但效率和效果不断变得更好。

column1: The CT-8 Corrosive Turret is a new design, which applies a much more hazardous version of the already devestating Goo Kaizers Marauders use to great effect. It continues 'eating' enemies alive for a while, until nothing is left but a husk of a ship, one mean look away from being destroyed.
column2: CT-8腐蚀炮塔是一种新设计，它应用了凯泽掠夺者已在使用且效果极佳的毁灭性粘液的更危险版本。它会持续「啃食」活着的敌人一段时间，直到只剩下一具船壳，差最后一口气就会被摧毁。

column1: The Cannibal Rangers defend planets near their Starbase, fighting fiercely. Wields a zombifying gun.
column2: 食人游骑兵保卫其星站附近的行星，英勇作战，使用僵尸化炮。

column1: The Cestus is a melee range ship valued by the Architrave for phasing out groups of low energy ships along with itself. Its phased form is a tenacious fighter.
column2: 拳剑战机（Cestus）是一种近战舰艇，天顶拱心石（Architrave）看重它能与低能量舰艇同归于尽的能力。它的相位形态是个顽强的战斗者。

column1: The Citadel is a defensive structure made to protect the surrounding planets. Do not approach if you are not permitted to do so.
column2: 堡垒是为保护周边行星而建的防御结构。如果您未经许可，请勿靠近。

column1: The Civil Authorities are given any metal that you gather while at metal cap.  They are willing to pay back some of that metal if you are later having metal troubles, but will only do so at a limited rate.  This multiplier determines just how limited the rate is.  By default it is 0.25x, which is already quite stingy, but on Expert and above it is 0.1x.
column2: 当你达到金属上限时，你收集的任何金属都会给予民政当局。如果你后来遇到金属问题，他们愿意偿还一些金属，但只会以有限的速率进行。此倍数决定了这个速率有多有限。默认是0.25倍，已经相当吝啬，但在专家及以上难度下为0.1倍。

column1: The Command Center from which units are produced, war plans are reviewed so that the Azaran Empire may expand. Has an attrition field, dealing minimal damage and preventing shield regenration, making sieging it difficult.
column2: 阿扎兰帝国生产单位、审阅战争计划以便扩张的指挥中心。拥有消耗场，造成少量伤害并阻止护盾再生，使其难以被围攻。

column1: The Crawling Chaos will rend your forces with long-range weapon jamming and a short range corrosive cannon.
column2: 匍匐之混沌将用远程武器干扰和近距离腐蚀加农炮撕裂你的部队。

column1: The Crystilline Wardens defend planets near their city, wielding a powerful photon lance. Also has metabolization to improve your income.
column2: 水晶守护者保卫其城市附近的行星，使用强大的光子长矛。还具有代谢能力以增加您的收入。

column1: The Cyborg Council for Galactic Peace is a fringe movement that seeks the ultimate integration of biological and artificial intelligence. While their pacificism would seem to make them a poor choice as allies, they have an uncanny ability to subdue the AI's aggression and they can maintain a ceasefire on a gravity well for a short duration. Perhaps we can use this temporary pause of fighting to gain some advantage we couldn't obtain through ordinary means.
column2: 赛博银河和平委员会是一个边缘组织，致力于实现生物智能与人工智能的终极融合。尽管他们的和平主义理念似乎使他们不太适合作为盟友，但他们有一种不可思议的能力，可以压制AI的攻击性，并能在引力井处维持短暂的停火。也许我们可以利用这段暂时的停火时间，获得一些通过常规手段无法得到的优势。

column1: The D-IR-9 Death Ionosphere Raider was developed as a way to deal with waves and waves of fighters. The long-range ion cannon obliterates not sufficiently developed technology with incredible speed. To accomplish this the energy required to power this vessel is immense and the structure vulnerable, though a powerful shield generator makes up for it. Additionally, once this ship hits Mk7 the weapon is upgraded to no longer be an ion cannon, but an imploder which ruptures enemy hulls and overdrives shields regardless of mark level. The Death variant has more range and damage, and is especially vicious against low-health targets. If it gets destroyed in turn the reactor overloads, dealing damage to all enemies in the blast radius. This was accomplished using lots of... 'lost and found' Dark Zenith Izumite.
column2: D-IR-9死亡电离层突击者是作为应对一波波战斗机的方式而开发的。远程离子加农炮以惊人速度消灭技术不够发达的敌人。为此这个单位所需的能量是巨大的，结构也脆弱，但强大的护盾发生器弥补了这一点。此外一旦这个单位达到Mk7，武器升级为不再是离子加农炮，而是一个内爆器，可撕裂敌船体并使护盾过载，无论等级。死亡变体拥有更远的射程和更高的伤害，对低生命值目标尤其凶残。如果自身被摧毁，反应堆过载，对爆炸半径内所有敌人造成伤害。这使用了大量……「失物招领」的暗天顶Izumite。

column1: The D-LC-9 Death Lightshow Cruiser uses the extremely potent beam weaponry, with an added twist: The crystal matrices can be set to focus single powerful beams onto a target or disperse against multiple enemies. This and the high damage potential make the cruiser dangerous against many enemies. The Death variant has more range and damage, and is especially vicious against low-health targets. If it gets destroyed in turn the reactor overloads, dealing damage to all enemies in the blast radius. This was accomplished using lots of... 'lost and found' Dark Zenith Izumite.
column2: D-LC-9死亡光秀巡洋舰使用极其强大的光束武器，并有一个额外特色：水晶矩阵可以设置为将单个强力光束聚焦到目标上，或分散对付多个敌人。这一点加上高伤害潜力，使巡洋舰对许多敌人都构成危险。死亡变体拥有更远的射程和更高的伤害，对低生命值目标尤其凶残。如果自身被摧毁，反应堆过载，对爆炸半径内所有敌人造成伤害。这使用了大量……「失物招领」的暗天顶Izumite。

column1: The D-RF-57 Death Rampage Frigate was one of the earliest designs of Kaizers Marauders, and follows a slightly different design philosophy compared to their current ships even after many, many iter- and alterations. It's slow, tough, and armed to the teeth, the heart of a fleet that is designed to deal with anything and everything. The Death variant has more range and damage, and is especially vicious against low-health targets. If it gets destroyed in turn the reactor overloads, dealing damage to all enemies in the blast radius. This was accomplished using lots of... 'lost and found' Dark Zenith Izumite.
column2: D-RF-57死亡狂怒护卫舰是凯泽掠夺者最早的设计之一，即使经过无数次迭代和改动，其设计理念与当前单位也略有不同。它缓慢、坚韧、武装到牙齿，是旨在应对一切挑战的舰队核心。死亡变体拥有更远的射程和更高的伤害，对低生命值目标尤其凶残。如果自身被摧毁，反应堆过载，对爆炸半径内所有敌人造成伤害。这使用了大量……「失物招领」的暗天顶Izumite。

column1: The DBS-17 is one of the most sturdy designs Kaizers Marauders ever built. It was designed as the fleet leader for a bulky and comparably slow fighting force, but with the ability to constantly and quickly produce drones which can reinforce both offensively and defensively. In addition it uses long-range fusion bomb weapons, makig it deadly when attacking structures.
column2: DBS-17是凯泽掠夺者有史以来建造的最坚固的设计之一。它被设计为一支笨重且相对缓慢的战斗力量的舰队领袖，但具有持续快速生产无人机的能力，可从攻防两面进行增援。此外它使用远程核聚变炸弹武器，在攻击建筑时具有致命效果。

column1: The DC-21 Disrupter Corvette is a support craft that tips the scales of combat in favor of Kaizers Marauders as long as it has a fleet to back up. Using their Disloger-Goo technology to disassemble enemy ships, impairing engines and weapons and turning them into packets of metal, as well as amplifying allied damage these ships should be a primary target.
column2: DC-21干扰者护卫舰是一艘支援舰艇，只要后方有舰队支持，就能使战斗天平向凯泽掠夺者倾斜。使用其分解-粘液技术废弃敌舰、削弱引擎和武器并将其转化为金属包，同时放大友军伤害，因此这些单位应为首要目标。

column1: The DO-189 Drone Outpost houses various facilities for shuttles, transports and other civilian craft which allow for metal to be harvested even without harvester stations. Additionally construction facilities provide all the equipment for building defenses and ships alike. On top it is equipped with additional construction yards and launch bays specifically designed to release produce and release large amounts of cheap, independent drones.
column2: DO-189无人机前哨容纳了穿梭机、运输船及其他民用舰艇的各种设施，即使没有采矿站也能收集金属。此外建造设施提供建造防御工事和单位的全部设备。此外还配备了额外的建造船坞和发射舱，专门用于生产和释放大量廉价独立的无人机。

column1: The Dark Sphere is an intelligent mega-structure, seeking the universal end of suffering - through eradication.
column2: 黑暗球体是一个智能巨型结构，寻求通过灭绝来终结宇宙万物的苦难。

column1: The Dark Spire has entered Conquest Mode
The Dark Spire has entered Conquest Mode
column2: 黑暗尖塔已进入征服模式

column1: The Dark Zenith Empire is a mod allowing the player to play as the Dark Zenith. You can control all their military units, though you have no control over their economy.  Restriction: You'll need to specify some planet as your starting planet for the DZ Empire; this has no effect on gameplay; your planets will link into the galaxy 'as usual'. Most sidekicks will not work if the Dark Zenith Empire is the only Empire; Spire Sidekick will work.  Written by Badger. This is only a mod, and has no official Arcen support.
column2: 暗天顶帝国是一个模组，允许玩家扮演暗天顶。你可以控制他们的所有军事单位，尽管你无法控制他们的经济。  限制：你需要为DZ帝国指定某个行星作为起始行星；这对游戏玩法没有影响；你的行星将「一如既往」地连接到银河。 大多数Sidekick在暗天顶帝国是唯一帝国时将无法运作；尖塔Sidekick可以运作。  Written by Badger。这只是一个模组，没有Arcen的官方支持。

column1: The Dark Zenith Sidekick is a mod allowing the player to play as the Dark Zenith. You can control all their military units, though you have no control over their economy.  Restrictions: You cannot actually lose the game, so you must play with another player type; this is the same restriction as the Necromancer Sidekick.  For solo play, you'll control both this empire and your chosen other Empire simultaneously; hitting F4 will swap control between the two empires. I would suggest using the Ark Infused empire (if you own DLC1) to move your King to join the Dark Zenith. Note you can set the DZ to use its usual logic, so it can take care of itself if you request. Restriction: You'll need to specify some planet as your starting planet for the DZ Sidekick; this will not affect anything.  Written by Badger. This is only a mod, and has no official Arcen support.
column2: 暗天顶Sidekick是一个模组，允许玩家扮演暗天顶。你可以控制他们的所有军事单位，尽管你无法控制他们的经济。  限制：你实际上无法输掉游戏，因此你必须配合其他玩家类型游玩；这与死灵法师Sidekick的限制相同。  对于单人游戏，你将同时控制这个帝国和你选择的其他帝国；按F4将在两个帝国之间切换控制。我建议使用方舟注入帝国（如果你拥有DLC1）将你的王移动到暗天顶的位置。请注意你可以将DZ设置为使用其通常逻辑，这样如果你要求，它可以自行打理。 限制：你需要为DZ Sidekick指定某个行星作为起始行星；这不会有任何影响。  Written by Badger。这只是一个模组，没有Arcen的官方支持。

column1: The Dawn-class light cruiser is an advanced command-and-control-vessel developed by the Gray Spire. When one of its plasma projectiles explodes, it also damages several nearby units for reduced damage.
column2: 黎明号轻型巡洋舰是灰色尖塔开发的一种先进指挥控制舰艇。 当它的等离子体投射物爆炸时，还会对附近多个单位造成减弱的伤害。

column1: The Demolitionist is an excellent anti-structure ship with its shield bypassing fusion attack and cloaking.
column2: 爆破者是一艘出色的反建筑舰船，拥有可绕过护盾的聚变攻击与隐形能力。

column1: The Dessau flagship is a more powerful Rocroi, specializes in single target damage with a powerful coil beam.
column2: 德绍旗舰是更强大的罗克鲁瓦，专精于使用强大的线圈光束造成单体伤害。

column1: The Destroyer flagship specializes in in single target zombifying damage. Can enter Multi-Phase to allow it to hunt Tyderian Summoners.
column2: 驱逐舰旗舰专攻单体僵尸化伤害。可以进入多重相位以追猎泰德瑞安召唤者。

column1: The Devil Flower! Yothga uses its vines to paralyze and drain the life from its foes. It will also regenerate health as it damages its enemies.
column2: 恶魔花朵！约斯加用藤蔓麻痹并吸取敌人的生命。它还会在伤害敌人的同时再生自身生命。

column1: The Devourer (unless forced to leave a faction alone) will only consider planets within a certain range.
column2: 吞噬者（除非被迫离开某个派系）只会考虑一定范围内的行星。

column1: The Devourer Golem has grown so incredibly powerful that its 'blood' cells (or should we say 'liquid metal' cells?) themselves have grown to become so large they are full-power Golems. Its primary function is to keep the veins clean and ward off any possible intruders, as such the ship is able to quickly deal with intruders new to the planet.
column2: 吞噬者傀儡已经变得如此强大，以至于其"血液"细胞（或者我们应该说"液态金属"细胞？）本身已经长到如此之大，以至于它们本身就成了全功率的傀儡。其主要功能是保持血管清洁并抵御任何可能的入侵者，因此该单位能够快速处理新到达行星的入侵者。

column1: The Devourer Golem, once it 'dies' phases into another dimension, self-repairs and self-enhances. While producing a spatial distortion so large that we can simply enter and exit other dimensions at will is out of our reach for now we can use leave wormholes not through either of its ends, but cross into hyperspace within this rift. This allows us to briefly stay invoidable, perfect for positioning a powerful raid ship.
column2: 吞噬者傀儡在"死亡"后会相位进入另一个维度，自我修复并自我增强。虽然产生如此巨大的空间扭曲以便我们随意进出其他维度目前遥不可及，但我们可以利用这个裂缝中的超空间穿越虫洞，不是通过其两端，而是穿过其中。这使我们能够短暂地保持不可触及的状态，非常适合定位一艘强大的突袭舰。

column1: The Devourer adapts to our attacks. Anything that does not have 0.9 or higher albedo (at which point the Devourer can't fully grasp the target) almost entirely 'bounces off' because its living armor expects and counters the shot. By supplementing this technology with our own we can direct energy pulses back at our enemies.
column2: 吞噬者会适应我们的攻击。任何不具有 0.9 或更高反照率（此时吞噬者无法完全理解目标）的东西几乎完全"弹开"，因为其活体装甲会预期并反击射击。通过将此技术与我们自己的技术相结合，我们可以将能量脉冲直接引向我们的敌人。

column1: The Devourer is growing to such a size and complexity it's own internal bio-organic systems have started to produce an equivalent of Human white blood cells the size of an actual Golem. With enough metal, hacking and time we can try to extract and command one, though the retribution would most likely be severe.
column2: 吞噬者已经成长到如此之大和复杂，其自身的内部生物有机系统已开始产生相当于人类白细胞的产物，其大小相当于一个真正的傀儡。 有了足够的金属、入侵点和时间，我们可以尝试提取并指挥一个，尽管报复很可能极其严重。

column1: The Devourer may rank up through certain actions such as hacks or Antagonizers spawning. This setting controls the tech level spawned at. Note that if the tech level is higher than the maximum mark level of the current Devourer Golem it will instantly begin to evolve, if lower it will not spawn below the minimum mark level but allow for more tech-ups before actually increasing in mark.  Tier 1: Marks 1 - 3 Tier 2: Marks 2 - 4 Tier 3: Marks 3 - 5 Tier 4: Marks 4 - 7
column2: 吞噬者可能通过某些行动（如入侵或对抗装置生成）提升等级。此设置控制生成时的技术等级。 请注意，如果技术等级高于当前吞噬者傀儡的最高标记等级，它将立即开始进化；如果较低，则不会生成低于最低标记等级，但允许在实际上提升标记之前进行更多的技术升级。  第 1 级：标记 1 - 3 第 2 级：标记 2 - 4 第 3 级：标记 3 - 5 第 4 级：标记 4 - 7

column1: The Devourer's hull is made up of hyper-reflective, living multi-adjusting alloy that reflects almost all energy directed at it. By creating a hull with similar properties out of Human-known metals and adding a cloaking device we have created a virtually un-decloakeable ship. On top of that we can copy some of its weapon technology for terrifying attack power.
column2: 吞噬者的船体由超反射、活的、多调节合金制成，几乎可以反射所有射向它的能量。通过使用人类已知的金属制造具有类似特性的船体，并添加隐形装置，我们创造了一个几乎无法被解除隐形的单位。最重要的是，我们可以复制其部分武器技术，以获得可怕的攻击力。

column1: The Dire Macrophage Carrier harvests metal from other ships and structures and feeds its associated Telium. A mutation of the Macrophage unleashing swarms upon its ennemies.Gets ignored by almost everything in favor of its drones, but you probably shouldn't.
column2: 可怕巨噬细胞航母从其他单位和建筑中收获金属并喂养其相关的 Telium。巨噬细胞的突变体，向其敌人释放蜂群。几乎所有东西都会忽略它而关注其无人机，但您可能不应该这样做。

column1: The Dire Macrophage can be set to invade the galaxy at some unknown time during the game, or immediately. An immediate spawn is typical for this faction, while a delayed spawn can greatly weaken them.
column2: 设置可怕巨噬细胞入侵银河系的时间点（游戏中的未知时刻，或立即）。立即生成是该派系的典型设置，而延迟生成会极大削弱它们。

column1: The Dire Macrophage harvests metal from other ships and structures and feeds its associated Telium. A mutation of the Macrophage fit to predate on its brethren, it is faster, and equipped with a sabot weapon.
column2: 可怕巨噬细胞从其他单位和建筑中收获金属并喂养其关联的 Telium。它是巨噬细胞的一种突变体，能够捕食同类，速度更快且配备了破坏弹药。

column1: The Dusk-class light cruiser is an advanced command-and-control vessel used by the Dark Sphere.
column2: 黄昏级轻型巡洋舰是黑暗球体使用的高级指挥控制单位。

column1: The Dyson Coalition is a union of a number of races allied to humanity. Each race has their own ships and unique benefits.  You can build Strongholds; Major Strongholds grant access to flagships, Minor Strongholds bolster flagships (similar to the Necromancer). Each of the four races use Districts to increase their tech level. Each race starts with access to Tier One units, and you can build Districts to get access to higher tier ships and defenses. Your strongholds need to be at higher mark levels for access to the strongest units. You can dismantle a stronghold using the Hacking menu; when you do this you will get back the base build cost of the structure.  They can build and upgrade Dyson Spheres; a Dyson Sphere will power a flagship to automatically assist you in defense. Spheres can only be built on Ravaged planets, and when you drill, transports will return to the nearest Sphere. Upgrading spheres to Mark 7 will trigger an endgame battle as it produces a vast army of Golems.   To build a Dyson Sphere or to get your most powerful upgrades, you must use Cuendillar. Cuendillar is primarily obtained by using powerful drills to harvest planets or asteroids.  You get access to a lot of information about the Dyson Sidekick economy/state by clicking on the Cuendillar section of the resource menu.
column2: 戴森联盟是多个与人类结盟的种族的联合体。每个种族都有自己独特的单位和优势。  你可以建造要塞；主要要塞提供旗舰，次级要塞强化旗舰（类似于死灵法师）。 四个种族各使用区域来提升其科技等级。每个种族最初可以使用第一级单位，你可以建造区域来解锁更高级的单位和防御。你的要塞需要达到更高的标记等级才能使用最强单位。 你可以通过入侵菜单拆除要塞；这样做将返还建筑的基础建造成本。  他们可以建造和升级戴森球；戴森球将为旗舰供能，使其自动协助你防御。 戴森球只能建造在被掠夺过的行星上，钻探时运输船将返回最近的戴森球。 将戴森球升级到标记7将触发终局战斗，因为它会产出一支庞大的魔像大军。  要建造戴森球或获得最强大的升级，你必须使用坤迪亚。坤迪亚主要通过使用强力钻机收获行星或小行星获得。  点击资源菜单中的坤迪亚部分，你可以查看有关戴森助手经济/状态的大量信息。

column1: The Dyson Empire works just like the Dyson Sidekick except you get an immobile 'King' unit on your home planet. Also, it is recommended to turn the Reaper Difficulty down as an empire.  The Dyson Sidekick allows the player to play as Coalition of races trying to build a Dyson Sphere. You will control Zenith, Spire, Neinzul and Templar ships. You will build major and minor Strongholds for each of the races, giving you access to different ships.  Like the Necromancer, Major Strongholds grant flagships, Minor Strongholds will allow for bolstering. Unlike the Necromancer, You can dismantle a Stronghold using the hacking menu, getting back some of the resources invested. This allows you to respec your fleets.  In order to build the Dyson Sphere, you will need to ravage a number of planets to get the raw materials by constructing vast Drills. Since planets are used up in this way, small maps make the game harder for the Dyson Sidekick.  Enabling the Dyson Sidekick also adds the 'Reapers' faction to the game to add additional challenge; use the Difficulty slider to change how much impact the Reapers will have. The Zenith Miners can also add an interesting challenge.  The Dyson Sidekick is not recommended for players who have not played the Fallen Spire campaign, or played as the Necromancer. The Dyson Empire is better with some reasonably strong allied factions (Scourge, Svikari, etc), since it is lacking in defensive structures.  Designed and Coded by Badger. Dyson Sidekick Unit Design assistance from Zeusalmighty. This is only a mod, and has no official Arcen support.
column2: 戴森帝国的运作方式与戴森Sidekick相同，除了你在母星上有一个不可移动的「王」单位。此外，建议将收割者难度调低，因为你是帝国。  戴森Sidekick允许玩家扮演一个试图建造戴森球的种族联盟。你将控制天顶、尖塔、奈祖尔和圣殿骑士的单位。你将建造每个种族的大小要塞，从而获得不同的单位。 与死灵法师一样，大型要塞授予旗舰，小型要塞允许增强。与死灵法师不同的是，你可以通过入侵菜单拆除要塞，收回部分投入的资源。这允许你重新配置你的舰队。  为了建造戴森球，你需要掠夺一些行星，通过建造巨大的钻机来获取原材料。由于行星会以这种方式被消耗，小型地图会让戴森Sidekick更加困难。  启用戴森Sidekick还会在游戏中添加「收割者」派系以增加额外挑战；使用难度滑块来改变收割者带来的影响程度。 天顶矿工也能增加有趣的挑战。  戴森Sidekick不推荐给未玩过堕落尖塔战役或扮演过死灵法师的玩家。戴森帝国如果有一些较强的盟友派系（天灾、斯维卡里等）会更好，因为它缺乏防御建筑。  设计与编码 by Badger。 戴森Sidekick单位设计 with assistance from Zeusalmighty。 这只是一个模组，没有Arcen的官方支持。

column1: The Dyson Sidekick allows the player to play as Coalition of races trying to build a Dyson Sphere. You will control Zenith, Spire, Neinzul and Templar ships. You will build major and minor Strongholds for each of the races, giving you access to different ships. Like the Necromancer, Major Strongholds grant flagships, Minor Strongholds will allow for bolstering. Unlike the Necromancer, you can dismantle a Stronghold using the hacking menu, getting back some of the resources invested. This allows you to respec your fleets.  In order to build the Dyson Sphere, you will need to ravage a number of planets to get the raw materials by constructing vast Drills. Since planets are used up in this way, small maps make the game harder for the Dyson Sidekick.  Enabling the Dyson Sidekick also adds the 'Reapers' faction to the game to add additional challenge; use the Difficulty slider to change how much impact the Reapers will have. The Zenith Miners can also add an interesting challenge.  This faction comes with an 'auto-defend-my-allies' setting, which means a novice could just focus on building infrastructure and letting their ships fight automatically.  Restrictions: You cannot actually lose the game, so you must play with another player type; this is the same restriction as the Necromancer Sidekick.  Designed and Coded by Badger. Dyson Sidekick Unit Design by Zeusalmighty. This is only a mod, and has no official Arcen support.
column2: 戴森Sidekick允许玩家扮演一个试图建造戴森球的种族联盟。你将控制天顶、尖塔、奈祖尔和圣殿骑士的单位。你将建造每个种族的大小要塞，从而获得不同的单位。 与死灵法师一样，大型要塞授予旗舰，小型要塞允许增强。与死灵法师不同的是，你可以通过入侵菜单拆除要塞，收回部分投入的资源。这允许你重新配置你的舰队。  为了建造戴森球，你需要掠夺一些行星，通过建造巨大的钻机来获取原材料。由于行星会以这种方式被消耗，小型地图会让戴森Sidekick更加困难。  启用戴森Sidekick还会在游戏中添加「收割者」派系以增加额外挑战；使用难度滑块来改变收割者带来的影响程度。 天顶矿工也能增加有趣的挑战。  这个派系自带「自动防御盟友」设置，意味着新手可以只专注于建造基础设施，让他们的单位自动战斗。  限制：你实际上无法输掉游戏，因此你必须配合其他玩家类型游玩；这与死灵法师Sidekick的限制相同。  设计与编码 by Badger。 戴森Sidekick单位设计 by Zeusalmighty。 这只是一个模组，没有Arcen的官方支持。

column1: The Dyson Sphere is not even worth our time.
column2: 戴森球甚至不值得我们浪费时间。

column1: The Dyson gets access to powerful Hybrid ships; to get hybrids for a given race you must get that race to district 3; each other race at district 2 or above will allow you to build hybrids from a stronghold of the first race at level 4 or above.
column2: 戴森可以使用强大的混合体单位；要获得某个种族的混合体，你需要将该种族提升到区域3；其他每个种族达到区域2或以上，你才能从第一个种族等级4或以上的要塞建造混合体。

column1: The E-BM-7 Efficient Blast Mine is designed to channel the shockwave of a detonation into a single target. The fraction of the force that isn't channeled can still damage enemies in range. The Efficient variant has an optimized design, providing no improved stats other than reduced production costs in metal.
column2: E-BM-7高效爆破雷旨在将爆炸的冲击波引导至单个目标。未被引导的那部分力量仍可对射程内的敌人造成伤害。高效变体采用优化设计，除了降低金属生产成本外，不提供其他属性提升。

column1: The E-BMF-12 Efficient Blast Mine Factory has only one purpose: Constantly generate more and more and more Blast Mines. The Factory itself is also just produced, by the Mine Destroyer. The Efficient variant has an optimized design, providing no improved stats other than reduced production and operating costs in metal, energy and (if enabled) fuel.
column2: E-BMF-12高效爆破雷工厂只有一个目的：持续生成越来越多的爆破雷。工厂本身也是由雷区驱逐舰生产的。高效变体采用优化设计，除了降低金属、能量和燃料（如启用）的生产与运营成本外，不提供其他属性提升。

column1: The E-CT-8 Efficient Corrosive Turret is a new design, which applies a much more hazardous version of the already devestating Goo Kaizers Marauders use to great effect. It continues 'eating' enemies alive for a while, until nothing is left but a husk of a ship, one mean look away from being destroyed. The Efficient variant has an optimized design, providing no improved stats other than reduced production and operating costs in metal, energy and (if enabled) fuel. The Goo has also been improved, allowing for more metal output.
column2: E-CT-8高效腐蚀炮塔是一种新设计，它应用了凯泽掠夺者已在使用且效果极佳的毁灭性粘液的更危险版本。它会持续「啃食」活着的敌人一段时间，直到只剩下一具船壳，差最后一口气就会被摧毁。高效变体采用优化设计，除了降低金属、能量和燃料（如启用）的生产与运营成本外，不提供其他属性提升。粘液也得到了改良，可产出更多金属。

column1: The E-MD-67 Efficient Mine Destroyer is an upgrade to the Minelayer series of Frigates, combining their power with the larger chassis and orbit capabilities of a cruiser. The result is a ship which constantly spews out immobile mines, and is much better suited in fights that go back and forth or are defensive to begin with. A powerful gravity generator draws in enemies to be hit by the generated mine fields. The Efficient variant has an optimized design, providing no improved stats other than reduced production and operating costs in metal, energy and (if enabled) fuel.
column2: E-MD-67高效雷区驱逐舰是布雷舰系列护卫舰的升级版，将其力量与巡洋舰更大的底盘和轨道能力相结合。结果是一个不断喷出固定雷区的单位，更适合来回拉锯或偏防御的战斗。强大的重力发生器吸引敌人，使其被生成的雷区打击。高效变体采用优化设计，除了降低金属、能量和燃料（如启用）的生产与运营成本外，不提供其他属性提升。

column1: The E-TS-3 Efficient Torpedo Submarine was used studying Zenith technologies of changing state of matter. The result was a ship capable of 'diving' into multiphase to reload the magazines of an incredibly powerful torpedo launcher which can annihilate bigger targets at long range along with processing it using Goo. Its weakspot is when it dives into multiphase, as it can only use its point defense in this space and is vulnerable to any ship with similar capabilities. The Efficient variant has an optimized design, providing no improved stats other than reduced production and operating costs in metal, energy and (if enabled) fuel. The Goo has also been improved, allowing for more metal output.
column2: E-TS-3高效鱼雷潜艇用于研究天顶的物质状态变化技术。结果是一艘能够「潜入」多相态以重新装填极其强大鱼雷发射器弹舱的单位，可在远距离歼灭大型目标并用粘液进行处理。其弱点是当潜入多相态时，此时只能使用点防御，并对任何具有类似能力的单位脆弱。高效变体采用优化设计，除了降低金属、能量和燃料（如启用）的生产与运营成本外，不提供其他属性提升。粘液也得到了改良，可产出更多金属。

column1: The Elderlings patrol the galaxy against the Necromancer.
column2: 古灵族会在星系中巡逻以对抗死灵法师。

column1: The Eradicator does immense amounts of short-range damage with its massive cannon.
column2: 灭绝者用其巨型加农炮造成大量近距离伤害。

column1: The Evolved Dire Macrophage Carrier harvests metal from other ships and structures and feeds its associated Telium. A mutation of the Macrophage unleashing swarms upon its ennemies. Gets ignored by almost everything in favor of its drones, but you probably shouldn't. Due to evolving past the limits of a normal carrier, it is able to release more drones faster, and gained an extra type. Very aggressive.
column2: 进化的可怕巨噬细胞航母从其他单位和建筑中收获金属并喂养其相关的 Telium。巨噬细胞的突变体，向其敌人释放蜂群。几乎所有东西都会忽略它而关注其无人机，但您可能不应该这样做。由于进化超越了普通航母的限制，它能够更快地释放更多无人机，并获得了一种额外类型。非常具有攻击性。

column1: The Evolved Dire Macrophage is the final form of the Dire Macrophage, evolving a jamming weapon, replacing its sabot with a railgun tailored for single targets, agglomerates its two main weapons into one, and finally regenerates outside of battle. Has a tendancy to go on planets with hostiles to aggressively gather metal.
column2: 进化可怕巨噬细胞是可怕巨噬细胞的最终形态，进化出了干扰武器，将其破坏弹替换为针对单一目标的轨道炮，将两种主要武器合并为一，并能在战斗外再生。倾向于前往有敌人的行星以积极收集金属。

column1: The FO-148 Forcefield Outpost houses various facilities for shuttles, transports and other civilian craft which allow for metal to be harvested even without harvester stations. Additionally construction facilities provide all the equipment for building defenses and ships alike. On top it is equipped with a powerful forcefield projector, shielding nearby structures and ships effectively.
column2: FO-148力场前哨容纳了穿梭机、运输船及其他民用舰艇的各种设施，即使没有采矿站也能收集金属。此外建造设施提供建造防御工事和单位的全部设备。此外还配备了强大的力场投影器，有效保护附近建筑和单位。

column1: The FSG-9 Forceshield Generator is similar in nature to the forcefields also used by the Human Remnant, but Kaizers Marauders have made their own changes. While the actual shield strength is lower, it no longer loses range under fire. Additionally at almost full integrity, the shield can almost entirely negate damage, which makes it very powerful against single powerful attacks.
column2: FSG-9力场盾发生器本质上类似于人类残余使用的力场，但凯泽掠夺者做出了自己的改变。虽然实际护盾强度较低，但遭受火力时不再失去范围。此外在几乎满完整度时，护盾几乎可以完全抵消伤害，使其对单次强力攻击极为有效。

column1: The Fimbulwinter descends upon this planet. When completed, this will grant Science and allow your ships to move more quickly on the planet.
column2: 芬布尔之冬降临这个行星。完成后，这将授予科技，并允许你的单位在行星上移动得更快。

column1: The Fleuris flagship specializes in single target damage with a powerful coil beam.
column2: 弗勒里斯旗舰专精于使用强大的线圈光束造成单体伤害。

column1: The FwSen light cruiser is excellent at attacing shields. This is an AI ship enhanced with Tyderian.
column2: 弗森轻巡洋舰擅长攻击护盾。这是一个被泰德瑞安增强的AI单位。

column1: The G-ABS-18 improves upon quite ancient Human technology, namely the Military Command Station. It wasn't commissioned until recently though, but breakthroughs in Parametrium Radiation shielding now allow both FTL travel and planet-wide ship amplification to work on the same ship. The power draw strains the ship, and its weapons aren't particularly strong for a vessel its size, but its durability prevents an important fleet booster from being lost in fights. The Guard variant has a significantly higher amount of shield at the cost of hull, and protects allies with a bubble forcefield.
column2: G-ABS-18改进了相当古老的人类技术，即军事指挥站。不过直到最近才被启用，Paramerium辐射屏蔽的突破使超光速旅行和全行星单位放大能在同一个单位上工作。电力消耗使单位紧张，其武器对如此尺寸的单位来说并不特别强大，但其耐久度可防止重要的舰队增强器在战斗中损失。守卫变体以牺牲船体为代价拥有显著更多的护盾，并用泡泡力场保护盟友。

column1: The G-BHF-2 Guard Bulk Heavy Frigate is a prototype designed to carry extremely powerful support equipment. Itself more a support than a combat ship the BHF's purpose is to prevent large and well-shielded enemies from escaping the assault of Kaizers Marauders. Cloaked ships in range will be revealed very quickly and many larger ships such as frigates and even transports may be ensnared by its tractor beams. The Guard variant has a significantly higher amount of shield at the cost of hull, and protects allies with a bubble forcefield.
column2: G-BHF-2守卫堡垒重型护卫舰是一种旨在携带极其强大支援装备的原型舰。其本身更像是支援舰而非战斗舰，BHF的目的是阻止大型和拥有强力护盾的敌人逃脱凯泽掠夺者的攻击。射程内的隐形单位将被迅速揭示，许多大型单位如护卫舰甚至运输船可能被其牵引光束捕获。守卫变体以牺牲船体为代价拥有显著更多的护盾，并用泡泡力场保护盟友。

column1: The G-MHK-8 Mortar Heavy Corvette was designed to counter big fleet balls of strike craft by means of stopping them before they can even get into range. Its weapon is slow, but will deal with large amounts of strike craft efficiently like few other ships. The Guard variant has a significantly higher amount of shield at the cost of hull, and protects allies with a bubble forcefield.
column2: G-MHK-8迫击炮重型护卫舰旨在通过在其进入射程之前阻止大量星战舰队来对抗它们。其武器缓慢但能像极少数其他单位一样高效处理大规模星战。守卫变体以牺牲船体为代价拥有显著更多的护盾，并用泡泡力场保护盟友。

column1: The GM-3 Goo Minefield was created as a preventative measure against raids. Once hit an enemy ship will be covered in what Kaizers Marauders call 'black snot', a sticky and errosive chemical concoction consisting out of various substances which bind to metals. Not only does it reduce the operating efficiency of ships, once the construct breaks apart the adhesive nature prevents the metal from dispersing, keeping it in one place for rapid recycling.
column2: GM-3粘液雷场是作为预防袭击措施而创建的。一旦被触发，敌舰将被涂上凯泽掠夺者所谓的「黑鼻涕」，这是一种粘稠且具侵蚀性的化学混合物，由各种与金属结合的物质组成。它不仅降低单位的运行效率，一旦结构解体，其粘合性质还阻止金属散逸，使其留在原地以便快速回收。

column1: The GO-7 Generator Outpost houses various facilities for shuttles, transports and other civilian craft which allow for metal to be harvested even without harvester stations. Additionally construction facilities provide all the equipment for building defenses and ships alike. On top it is made from more durable spire-tech-infused materials, which also allow it to produce extra energy to power more ships.
column2: GO-7发电前哨容纳了穿梭机、运输船及其他民用舰艇的各种设施，即使没有采矿站也能收集金属。此外建造设施提供建造防御工事和单位的全部设备。此外它由更耐久的尖塔科技灌注材料制成，使其能产生额外能量以为更多单位供电。

column1: The Gateway allows the Reapers to project their true strength into this galaxy. The Reapers can use this to maintain a powerful, ongoing army. Destroying these should be a high priority.
column2: 传送门使收割者能够将其真正的力量投射到这个银河中。收割者可借此维持一支强大且持续的军队。摧毁它们应该是首要任务。

column1: The Godshatter Rangers defend planets near their Starbase, wielding corrosive beams. Much more powerful than the Breaking Ranger, and also has a cloaking device.
column2: 碎神游骑兵保卫其星站附近的行星，使用腐蚀光束。比破袭游骑兵强大得多，并且还拥有隐形装置。

column1: The Gungnir Cruiser was made possible only through a bold mission to the Dark Zenith homeworlds and wresting their technology for benefit of humanity. This cruiser has a weaker version of the Jormugander's annihilator beam, but still incredibly powerful. It is also equipped with a harpoon launcher and a seeker bomb launcher, the former that can immobilize even the most massive of ships and the latter that sends slow accelerating projectiles that do devastating damage if not shot down in flight. The hull is made of an electrotoxic substance favored by the Dark Zenith that will instantly return feedback to the Gungnir's attackers, causing attackers to take damage proportional to the damage taken by the Gungnir. Cruisers are an elite category of ships limited to one per fleet; they do not count as a standard shipline but they are eligible for fleetwide bonuses granted by FRS ships.
column2: 冈格尼尔巡洋舰的诞生，得益于一项大胆的任务——前往黯之天顶的母星，夺取他们的技术并造福人类。这艘巡洋舰装备了弱化版的尤蒙刚德湮灭光束，但威力依然惊人。它还配备了鱼叉发射器和寻的炸弹发射器，前者能让最庞大的舰船也动弹不得，后者发射的炮弹加速缓慢，若在飞行途中未被击落，将造成毁灭性伤害。该巡洋舰的船体由黯之天顶钟爱的电毒物质制成，当冈格尼尔巡洋舰受到攻击时，会立即向攻击者反馈伤害，使攻击者承受与冈格尼尔所受伤害成比例的损伤。巡洋舰是一种精英级别的舰船，每个舰队限拥有一艘；它们不属于标准舰船序列，但有资格获得快速反应支援（FRS）舰船提供的全舰队增益。

column1: The HF-17 Hunter-Fighter is designed to tear apart enemies already damaged by other foes. They are fast, tough, resilient to debuffs and can deal massive damage to damaged enemies, but are expensive and depend on enemies being weakened beforehand.
column2: HF-17猎人战斗机旨在撕碎已被其他友军伤害的敌人。它们快速、坚韧、对减益效果有抵抗力，并能对已受伤敌人造成巨额伤害，但成本高昂且依赖敌人先被削弱。

column1: The Hades Flagship paralyzes and them zombifies their victims. Can enter Multi-Phase to allow it to hunt Tyderian Summoners.
column2: 哈迪斯旗舰先麻痹再僵尸化其受害者。可以进入多重相位来猎杀泰德瑞安召唤者。

column1: The Heavenly Realm can be set to invade the galaxy at some unknown time during the game, or immediately. An immediate spawn is the scariest, and can sometimes make the game extraordinarily hard.
column2: 设置天堂领域入侵银河系的时间点（游戏中的未知时刻，或立即入侵）。立即生成是最可怕的，有时会使游戏异常困难。

column1: The Heavenly Realm has decreed this galaxy as requiring purification. Under the guise of purging all evil, they will periodically launch strikes on planets in order to establish a defensive position, before invading in full force later on. Then, they will issue tasks to all members of the galaxy that, so long they are not completed, allow them to warp in ships to complete them themselves. <color=#f25e1c>HIGH/EXTREME IMPACT:</color> The Heavenly Realm is a slower faction than most, with their mechanics relying on a temporary state of activity during which they will attack their enemies, and otherwise mostly remains defensive.
column2: 天堂领域已裁定该银河系需要净化。在清除所有邪恶的幌子下，它们将定期对行星发动打击以建立防御阵地，然后全力入侵。之后，它们将向银河系所有成员发布任务，只要这些任务未完成，它们就可以跃迁单位来亲自完成。 <color=#f25e1c>高/极高影响：</color>天堂领域是一个比大多数派系都慢的派系，其机制依赖于临时的活动状态，在此期间它们会攻击敌人，其他时候则主要保持防御。

column1: The Home planet of the Nanobot Infestation.
column2: 纳米机器人感染的母星。

column1: The Human Resistance Fighters say 'Hope this helps!'
column2: 人类抵抗战士说：“希望这能帮到你！”

column1: The Human Resistance, also called the HRF, are allies to humanity still living in deep space around AI planets; When they see you fighting the AI, sometimes they will reveal themselves and join you.       <color=#f25e1c>LOW IMPACT:</color> This faction does not expand, and doesn't do any irreparable damage. They are a nice boost to your power, but they won't win games for you on their own.
column2: 人类抵抗军(HRF)是仍然生活在AI行星周围深空的人类的盟友；当他们看到你与AI战斗时，有时会现身加入你。       <color=#f25e1c>低影响:</color> 这个派系不会扩张，也不会造成任何不可修复的损害。他们能增强你的力量，但不会为你赢得游戏。

column1: The Hunter Fleet is a primarily offensive fleet used by the AI to find weaknesses in your defenses and attack. It can also be used for defense in an emergency. The Hunter is a very powerful and cunning foe.  There are a number of ways the AI gets Hunter Fleet ships. These include the following: - When the AI's guarding ships flee from you, they will join the Threat Fleet. The Threat Fleet is a poorly organized group of AI ships looking to counterattack against you. If they don't find a good place to attack in a few minutes, those will join the Hunter Fleet.  - The AI may also direct some of its resources directly into Hunter Fleet ships on higher difficulties. - The AI will get a sudden burst of Hunter Fleet ships whenever their forces kill a Command Station. - The AI will spawn additional Hunter Fleet ships when you are playing with powerful minor faction allies; those ships can spawn from some unexpected places to go after your allies. They can also attack you.  The AI will also send Hunter Fleet ships against powerful factions, non-player-allied factions like the Nanocaust or Marauders. These ships will not go out of their way to attack you, but will fight you if you get in their way. This can make some planets very hard to hold if they are between the AI and its enemies.
column2: 猎手舰队是 AI 主要用于进攻的舰队，用于寻找你的防御弱点并发起攻击。在紧急情况下，它也可用于防御。猎手舰队是非常强大且狡猾的对手。  AI 获取猎手舰队单位有多种方式，包括以下几种： - 当 AI 的守卫单位逃离你时，它们会加入威胁舰队。威胁舰队是一群组织混乱的 AI 单位，试图对你进行反击。如果它们在几分钟内找不到合适的攻击地点，就会加入猎手舰队。 - 在更高难度下，AI 可能会直接将部分资源投入到猎手舰队的单位建造中。 - 每当 AI 的部队摧毁一个指挥站时，AI 会突然获得一批猎手舰队的单位。 - 当你与强大的次要派系盟友并肩作战时，AI 会生成额外的猎手舰队单位；这些单位可能会从一些意想不到的地方出现，攻击你的盟友，也可能会攻击你。  AI 还会派遣猎手舰队单位对抗强大的派系，如非玩家盟友的纳米浩劫或掠夺者等派系。这些单位不会特意攻击你，但如果你挡了它们的路，就会与你交战。如果某些行星位于 AI 与其敌人之间，那么控制这些行星会变得非常困难。

column1: The Hunter Fleet looks for weaknesses in your defenses and attacks.
column2: 猎手舰队会寻找你防御体系的弱点并发起攻击。

column1: The Hunter Fleet looks for weaknesses in your defenses and attacks.
column2: 猎手舰队会寻找你防御体系的弱点并发起攻击。

column1: The Hurricane Rangers defend planets near their Starbase, wielding corrosive beams. Much more powerful than the Storm Ranger, and uses hacking to control enemy ships.
column2: 飓风游骑兵保卫其星站附近的行星，使用腐蚀光束。比风暴游骑兵强大得多，并且使用入侵技术来控制敌方单位。

column1: The Hyperion Citadel is the home to the last survivors of the Vexian Massacre. They have pledged never to settle on a new world until the AI is defeated. The Hyperion boasts a powerful starburst beam cannon that shoots in 10 directions at once.
column2: 亥伯龙神要塞是维克斯安大屠杀最后幸存者的家园。他们发誓在AI被击败之前绝不定居新行星。亥伯龙神配备了一门强大的星爆光束炮，可同时向十个方向射击。

column1: The I-BM-7 Infused Blast Mine is designed to channel the shockwave of a detonation into a single target. The fraction of the force that isn't channeled can still damage enemies in range. The Infused variant uses hybrid materials to make the unit even cheaper to build and maintain, can sustain more child units and produce them even faster.
column2: I-BM-7灌注爆破雷旨在将爆炸的冲击波引导至单个目标。未被引导的那部分力量仍可对射程内的敌人造成伤害。灌注变体使用混合材料使单位建造和维护更加便宜，可维持更多子单位并以更快速度生产它们。

column1: The I-BMF-12 Infused Blast Mine Factory has only one purpose: Constantly generate more and more and more Blast Mines. The Factory itself is also just produced, by the Mine Destroyer. The Efficient variant has an optimized design, providing no improved stats other than reduced production and operating costs in metal, energy and (if enabled) fuel.
column2: I-BMF-12灌注爆破雷工厂只有一个目的：持续生成越来越多的爆破雷。工厂本身也是由雷区驱逐舰生产的。高效变体采用优化设计，除了降低金属、能量和燃料（如启用）的生产与运营成本外，不提供其他属性提升。

column1: The I-CT-8 Infused Corrosive Turret is a new design, which applies a much more hazardous version of the already devestating Goo Kaizers Marauders use to great effect. It continues 'eating' enemies alive for a while, until nothing is left but a husk of a ship, one mean look away from being destroyed. The Infused variant uses hybrid materials to make the unit even cheaper to build and maintain, and improves the efficiency of Goo to its absolute maximum.
column2: I-CT-8灌注腐蚀炮塔是一种新设计，它应用了凯泽掠夺者已在使用且效果极佳的毁灭性粘液的更危险版本。它会持续「啃食」活着的敌人一段时间，直到只剩下一具船壳，差最后一口气就会被摧毁。灌注变体使用混合材料使单位建造和维护更加便宜，并将粘液效率提升到绝对极限。

column1: The I-MD-67 Infused Mine Destroyer is an upgrade to the Minelayer series of Frigates, combining their power with the larger chassis and orbit capabilities of a cruiser. The result is a ship which constantly spews out immobile mines, and is much better suited in fights that go back and forth or are defensive to begin with. A powerful gravity generator draws in enemies to be hit by the generated mine fields. The Infused variant uses hybrid materials to make the unit even cheaper to build and maintain, can sustain more child units and produce them even faster.
column2: I-MD-67灌注雷区驱逐舰是布雷舰系列护卫舰的升级版，将其力量与巡洋舰更大的底盘和轨道能力相结合。结果是一个不断喷出固定雷区的单位，更适合来回拉锯或偏防御的战斗。强大的重力发生器吸引敌人，使其被生成的雷区打击。灌注变体使用混合材料使单位建造和维护更加便宜，可维持更多子单位并以更快的速度生产它们。

column1: The I-TS-3 Infused Torpedo Submarine was used studying Zenith technologies of changing state of matter. The result was a ship capable of 'diving' into multiphase to reload the magazines of an incredibly powerful torpedo launcher which can annihilate bigger targets at long range along with processing it using Goo. Its weakspot is when it dives into multiphase, as it can only use its point defense in this space and is vulnerable to any ship with similar capabilities. The Infused variant uses hybrid materials to make the unit even cheaper to build and maintain, and improves the efficiency of Goo to its absolute maximum.
column2: I-TS-3灌注鱼雷潜艇用于研究天顶的物质状态变化技术。结果是一艘能够「潜入」多相态以重新装填极其强大鱼雷发射器弹舱的单位，可在远距离歼灭大型目标并用粘液进行处理。其弱点是当潜入多相态时，此时只能使用点防御，并对任何具有类似能力的单位脆弱。灌注变体使用混合材料使单位建造和维护更加便宜，并将粘液效率提升到绝对极限。

column1: The IR-9 Ionosphere Raider was developed as a way to deal with waves and waves of fighters. The long-range ion cannon obliterates not sufficiently developed technology with incredible speed. To accomplish this the energy required to power this vessel is immense and the structure vulnerable, though a powerful shield generator makes up for it. Additionally, once this ship hits Mk7 the weapon is upgraded to no longer be an ion cannon, but an imploder which ruptures enemy hulls and overdrives shields regardless of mark level.
column2: IR-9电离层突击者是作为应对一波波战斗机的方式而开发的。远程离子加农炮以惊人速度消灭技术不够发达的敌人。为此这个单位所需的能量是巨大的，结构也脆弱，但强大的护盾发生器弥补了这一点。此外一旦这个单位达到Mk7，武器升级为不再是离子加农炮，而是一个内爆器，可撕裂敌船体并使护盾过载，无论等级。

column1: The Illumin-class frigate is a guard vessel commonly used by the Gray Spire.
column2: 照明者级护卫舰是灰色尖塔常用的一种警戒舰艇。

column1: The Imperator has a metal generating ray.
column2: 统治者拥有产金属射线。

column1: The Imperial AI brought forth these ships to help it build a galaxy spanning empire. They will build various things ranging from mere guardians to fearsome golems, as well as ion cannons and mass drivers, to be sent after you in order to complete its hold on this galaxy.
column2: 帝国AI带来了这些单位，帮助它建立一个横跨银河的帝国。它们会建造各种东西，从普通的守卫到可怕的傀儡，以及离子炮和质量驱动器，在您身后派出，以完成对这个银河系的控制。

column1: The K-IR-9 Killer Ionosphere Raider was developed as a way to deal with waves and waves of fighters. The long-range ion cannon obliterates not sufficiently developed technology with incredible speed. To accomplish this the energy required to power this vessel is immense and the structure vulnerable, though a powerful shield generator makes up for it. Additionally, once this ship hits Mk7 the weapon is upgraded to no longer be an ion cannon, but an imploder which ruptures enemy hulls and overdrives shields regardless of mark level. The 'Killer' variant boasts higher damage and longer weapon range.
column2: K-IR-9杀手电离层突击者是作为应对一波波战斗机的方式而开发的。远程离子加农炮以惊人速度消灭技术不够发达的敌人。为此这个单位所需的能量是巨大的，结构也脆弱，但强大的护盾发生器弥补了这一点。此外一旦这个单位达到Mk7，武器升级为不再是离子加农炮，而是一个内爆器，可撕裂敌船体并使护盾过载，无论等级。「杀手」变体以更高的伤害和更远的武器射程为特色。

column1: The K-LC-9 Killer Lightshow Cruiser uses the extremely potent beam weaponry, with an added twist: The crystal matrices can be set to focus single powerful beams onto a target or disperse against multiple enemies. This and the high damage potential make the cruiser dangerous against many enemies. The 'Killer' variant boasts higher damage and longer weapon range.
column2: K-LC-9杀手光秀巡洋舰使用极其强大的光束武器，并有一个额外特色：水晶矩阵可以设置为将单个强力光束聚焦到目标上，或分散对付多个敌人。这一点加上高伤害潜力，使巡洋舰对许多敌人都构成危险。「杀手」变体以更高的伤害和更远的武器射程为特色。

column1: The K-RF-57 Killer Rampage Frigate was one of the earliest designs of Kaizers Marauders, and follows a slightly different design philosophy compared to their current ships even after many, many iter- and alterations. It's slow, tough, and armed to the teeth, the heart of a fleet that is designed to deal with anything and everything. The 'Killer' variant boasts higher damage and longer weapon range.
column2: K-RF-57杀手狂怒护卫舰是凯泽掠夺者最早的设计之一，即使经过无数次迭代和改动，其设计理念与当前单位也略有不同。它缓慢、坚韧、武装到牙齿，是旨在应对一切挑战的舰队核心。「杀手」变体以更高的伤害和更远的武器射程为特色。

column1: The Kilrathi Lesser Locust carries onf the battle, though they are much weaker.
column2: 基拉西次级蝗虫继续战斗，但实力弱得多。

column1: The Kilrathi Locusts swarm against the enemy! They use a powerful AOE blast that slows the weapons of their enemies, and are extra tanky. When a locust is killed, it spawns a lesser locust.
column2: 基拉西蝗虫蜂拥攻击敌人！它们使用强力的范围爆炸来减缓敌人武器装填速度，且额外坚固。蝗虫被击杀时会生成一只小型蝗虫。

column1: The Knallen Bomb is, by itself, a very minor threat. It brings immense firepower at the cost of nearly no durability and heavy self damage after firing.  The Leere's ability to endlessly revive this bomb with an engine strapped to it however... make it a much more sticky and credible threat.
column2: 克纳伦炸弹本身威胁极低。它以几乎零耐久和开火后严重自伤的代价换来了巨大火力。  然而，利尔能够无限复活这枚绑着引擎的炸弹……使其成为一个更加棘手且不容忽视的威胁。

column1: The Krant Dire Rangers defend planets near their Starbase, wielding an AOE weapon-slowing attack. They also take less damage from remote enemies.
column2: 克兰特恐狼游骑兵保卫其星站附近的行星，使用范围武器减速攻击。 它们受到远程敌人的伤害也较少。

column1: The L-AT-90 Lucent Adaptor Turret is not a fancy superweapon like some of the Tier 3 Marauder structures. It's fairly simple in both design and design philosophy, but has gone through many iterations over the decades and became very complex. Slightly above average in nearly every department - damage, durability, range, cost efficiency - and the ability to either focus its damage onto single big enemies, or spread it against large amounts of enemies it this turret completes Kaizers Marauders defensive capabilities. The Lucent variant is coated with LPSC, a crystal-ceramic hybrid which greatly resists acid and exotic damages, on top of higher durability. It makes the turret is difficult to detect, lessening damage further until enemy targeting systems adjust. This upgrade is made possible by using a lot of... 'salvaged' Neinzul Sappers Moonstone.

The Lucent variant is coated with LPSC, a crystal-ceramic hybrid which greatly resists acid and exotic damages, on top of higher durability. While the actual shield strength is lower, it no longer loses range under fire. Additionally at almost full integrity, the shield can almost entirely negate damage, which makes it very powerful against single powerful attacks. The Lucent variant is coated with LPSC, a crystal-ceramic hybrid which greatly resists acid and exotic damages, on top of higher durability. Development is under way for increasing its power, and that of the ablative weaponry brought to bear against the once cloaked enemies. column1: The LC-9 Lightshow Cruiser uses the extremely potent beam weaponry, with an added twist: The crystal matrices can be set to focus single powerful beams onto a target or disperse against multiple enemies. This and the high damage potential make the cruiser dangerous against many enemies.
column2: LC-9光秀巡洋舰使用极其强大的光束武器，并有一个额外特色：水晶矩阵可以设置为将单个强力光束聚焦到目标上，或分散对付多个敌人。这一点加上高伤害潜力，使巡洋舰对许多敌人都构成危险。

column1: The LR-54 Light Raider is the default offensive fleet carrier for Kaizers Marauders. Its fast, can deal decent amounts of damage and may be produced cheaply and en masse. The weapons are designed to deal with both standard frigates and strike craft efficiently. While it can be a quick lance in the flank of any stellar empire, its main weakness is the cheap material which limits its durability.
column2: LR-54轻型突击者是凯泽掠夺者默认的进攻舰队航母。它速度快，可造成可观伤害，且可廉价批量生产。武器旨在高效处理标准护卫舰和星战。虽然它可以成为任何星际帝国侧翼的快速突击矛头，但主要弱点在于廉价材料限制了其耐久度。

column1: The Lesser Angel is an elite unit protected mostly by advanced shielding, with a very fragile hull and armor, but that is immune to weapon jamming. Deployed by the Heavenly realm to destroy all evil in the galaxy.
column2: 下级天使是主要由先进护盾保护的精英单位，船体和装甲非常脆弱，但免疫武器干扰。由天堂领域部署，以消灭银河系中的所有邪恶。

column1: The Lightseeker-class heavy frigate is an advanced guard vessel used by the Gray Spire.
column2: 寻光者级重型护卫舰是灰色尖塔使用的一种先进警戒舰艇。

column1: The Lutter flagship adds metabolization, allowing you to earn metal as you fight.
column2: 卢特旗舰增加了代谢能力，使你在战斗中获得金属。

column1: The M-HF-17 Hunter-Fighter is designed to tear apart enemies already damaged by other foes. column2: M-HF-17猎人战斗机旨在撕碎已被其他友军伤害的敌人。它们快速、坚韧、对减益效果有抵抗力，并能对已受伤敌人造成巨额伤害，但成本高昂且依赖敌人先被削弱。汞变变体拥有高级隐形装置，可在开火数次时保持隐藏，并在普通态和多相态之间切换。其隐形效果在此期间可能刷新。为此使用了大量……「获取」的暗天顶Skrith。

column1: The MC-418 Marauder Capital is the oldest design stil in use by Kaizers Marauders. Through its many, many iterations the design was improved on several levels: The Railcannon shoots goo, the Electron Pulses can focus fire onto a single target and its missiles deal area damage against smaller targets. In addition the several times reinforced structure and improved shielding allows the capital to endure much more harsh punishment than normal outposts, making it a small fortress to defeat.
column2: MC-418掠夺者首都是凯泽掠夺者仍在服役的最古老设计。经过无数次迭代，设计在多个层面得到改进：轨道炮发射粘液，电子脉冲可对单个目标聚焦火力，导弹对小目标造成溅射伤害。此外多次加固的结构和改良的护盾使首都能够承受比普通前哨站更严酷的打击，使其成为需要击破的小型堡垒。

column1: The MD-67 Mine Destroyer is an upgrade to the Minelayer series of Frigates, combining their power with the larger chassis and orbit capabilities of a cruiser. The result is a ship which constantly spews out immobile mines, and is much better suited in fights that go back and forth or are defensive to begin with. A powerful gravity generator draws in enemies to be hit by the generated mine fields.
column2: MD-67雷区驱逐舰是布雷舰系列护卫舰的升级版，将其力量与巡洋舰更大的底盘和轨道能力相结合。结果是一个不断喷出固定雷区的单位，更适合来回拉锯或偏防御的战斗。强大的重力发生器吸引敌人，使其被生成的雷区打击。

column1: The MHK-8 Mortar Heavy Corvette was designed to counter big fleet balls of strike craft by means of stopping them before they can even get into range. Its weapon is slow, but will deal with large amounts of strike craft efficiently like few other ships.
column2: MH-8迫击炮重型护卫舰旨在通过在其进入射程之前阻止大量星战舰队来对抗它们。其武器缓慢但能像极少数其他单位一样高效处理大规模星战。

column2: 突变体是一个用于转化为可怕巨噬细胞防御结构的单位。

column1: The NI-5 Needle Interceptor is a very cheap and basic design from Kaizers Marauders. It is able to deal with a large amount of enemy types that are either not moving or moving at slow speed, such as cargo vessels but also planetary defenses.
column2: NI-5飞针拦截机是凯泽掠夺者一种非常廉价基础的设计。它能够应对大量静止或低速移动的敌方类型，如货船以及行星防御设施。

column1: The Nanocaust is a horde of nanobots that take over other ships. Hates the Humans and AI alike.       <color=#f25e1c>EXTREMELY HIGH IMPACT:</color> This faction expands, and can do irreparable damage. It is also one of the strongest, capable of steamrolling most enemies due to being able to capture their ships. Even a low Intensity will be dangerous. They will likely dominate any game they appear in, and require specialized strategies to deal with.
column2: 纳米灾变是一群能够接管其他飞船的纳米机器人集群。它们同时憎恨人类和AI。       <color=#f25e1c>极高影响:</color> 这个派系会扩张，并能造成不可修复的损害。它也是最强大的派系之一，由于能够捕获敌方飞船，可以碾压大多数敌人。即使是低强度设置也很危险。它们可能会主宰任何出现的游戏，需要专门策略来应对。

column1: The Nanocaust is creating a construction center to build ships.

column1: The Necromancer Empire is a powerful, non-traditional, empire-based player faction. Using the Necromancer Empire is not conducive to overly low-AIP playstyles.  The Necromancer is a Neinzul Technomancer who can resurrect destroyed ships to serve it. It has come to this region of the galaxy to harvest life force from Rifts, powerful energy sources, in order to make itself stronger. Generally, a Necromancer must defeat their most powerful foes in order to become more powerful.  Playing as the Necromancer Empire will cause an additional copy of AI-Allied Elderlings to be spawned, as well as a unique faction called the Templar.  The Necromancer Empire has powerful offensive and defensive mechanics, but its static defenses are not as strong as a Human Empire. Using your fleets for both offense and defense is important. Neinzul Sappers synergize excellently with the Necromancer to help cover the lack of static defenses. A Necromancer Empire is quite capable of standing on its own toe-to-toe with any enemies that a normal Human Empire could face, but is more complex to master.  The Necromancer is only intended for use with the default Humanity Ascendant campaign type; Challenger and up are not officially supported.  Please see the in-game Tips for more detailed instructions.
column2: 死灵法师帝国是一个强大的、非传统的基于帝国的玩家阵营。使用死灵法师帝国不利于极低AIP的游戏风格。  死灵法师是一名奈因祖尔科技法师，能够复活被摧毁的舰船为其效力。它来到这片星系区域，从强大的能量源——裂隙中汲取生命之力，以变得更强大。一般来说，死灵法师必须击败其最强大的敌人才能变得更强。  选择死灵法师帝国作为阵营，将会额外生成一批与AI结盟的远古之民，以及一个名为圣殿骑士的独特阵营。  死灵法师帝国拥有强大的进攻和防御机制，但其静态防御不如人类帝国。同时运用舰队进行进攻和防御至关重要。奈因祖尔工兵与死灵法师能完美配合，弥补静态防御的不足。死灵法师帝国完全有能力与普通人类帝国所能面对的任何敌人正面抗衡，但掌握起来更为复杂。  死灵法师仅适用于默认的“人类崛起”战役类型；“挑战者”及更高难度官方并不支持。  请查看游戏内提示以获取更详细的说明。

column1: The Necromancer Sidekick is a powerful, player controllable faction -- that cannot lose. It can only be used in tandem when allied with another player faction, typically in multiplayer.          The Necromancer is a Neinzul Technomancer who can resurrect destroyed ships to serve it. It has come to this region of the galaxy to harvest life force from Rifts, powerful energy sources, in order to make itself stronger. Generally, a Necromancer must defeat their most powerful foes in order to become more powerful.  Playing as the Necromancer Sidekick will cause an additional copy of AI-Allied Elderlings to be spawn, as well as a unique faction called the Templar.  Using the Necromancer Sidekick is compatible with any playstyle, assuming that the sidekick isn't doing much. But if the sidekick is playing fully, then generally the AIP is going to be driven up a fair bit.  The Sidekick plays just like the Necromancer Empire, but with these differences. First, it must start on the same planet as an Empire faction (human empire, ark empire, necromancer empire, etc). Second, it can't lose by itself; the Sidekick wins or loses with its Empire ally or allies.  The Sidekick has an experimental Auto-Defend mode (available through the Necromancer Galaxy Settings) that will make its ships automatically help out their allies.  The Necromancer is only intended for use with the default Humanity Ascendant campaign type; Challenger and up are not officially supported.  Please see the in-game Tips for how the Necromancer faction works.
column2: 死灵法师副手是一个强大的、可由玩家操控的阵营——且不会失败。它只能在与其他玩家阵营结盟时使用，通常用于多人游戏。  死灵法师是一名奈因祖尔科技法师，能够复活被摧毁的舰船为其效力。它来到这片星系区域，从强大的能量源——裂隙中汲取生命之力，以变得更强大。一般来说，死灵法师必须击败其最强大的敌人才能变得更强。  选择死灵法师副手作为阵营，将会额外生成一批与AI结盟的远古之民，以及一个名为圣殿骑士的独特阵营。  如果死灵法师副手不采取太多行动，那么它适用于任何游戏风格。但如果副手全力参与游戏，通常会使AIP大幅上升。  副手的玩法与死灵法师帝国相似，但有以下区别。首先，它必须与一个帝国阵营（人类帝国、方舟帝国、死灵法师帝国等）在同一行星上起始。其次，它本身不会失败；副手与它的帝国盟友同胜同负。  副手有一个实验性的自动防御模式（可通过死灵法师星系设置启用），能让其舰船自动协助盟友。  死灵法师仅适用于默认的“人类崛起”战役类型；“挑战者”及更高难度官方并不支持。  请查看游戏内提示以了解死灵法师阵营的运作方式。

column1: The Necromancer can hack these rifts to steal powerful technology from the Templar. Expect a Templar assault afterward.
column2: 死灵法师可以破解这些裂隙，从圣殿窃取强大的技术。之后会有圣殿的攻击。

column1: The Necromancer gets this many additional hexes to all of its Necropoleis.  This is only for sandbox play, and will make the game much easier.
column2: 亡灵巫师的所有亡者都市将获得这么多额外的六边形格子。  这仅适用于沙盒模式，会使游戏变得容易很多。

column1: The Necromancer gets this many bonus rift hacking choices.  This is only for sandbox play, and will make the game much easier.
column2: 亡灵巫师将获得这么多额外的裂隙破解选择。  这仅适用于沙盒模式，会使游戏变得容易很多。

column1: The Necromancer is a powerful Neinzul Technomancer that harvests Life <color=#E16CFF>Essence</color> and uses it to power its empire.  It has two major classes of ships; the most powerful are built at its dreadful Necropoleis, but it can also raise fallen ships to its side. These fallen ships are more far more numerous but less powerful.  The Necromancer can drain <color=#E16CFF>Essence</color> from Rifts; this is drawing energy from other dimensions, devastating vast swathes of them. The Templar have come to this part of the galaxy to defend the Rifts from the Necromancer's assaults, and the Necromancer will get <color=#7ce9ff>Science</color> and <color=#3DE799>Hacking</color> by fighting the Templar. Enormous Neinzul Elderlings can be hunted for <color=#E16CFF>Essence</color>, or killed and studied to allow for powerful Necromancer Transformations. <color=#E16CFF>Essence</color> is used to empower your Necropoleis and flagships.  See the Tips section of the sidebar for an overview of Necromancer gameplay, and the Intel menu to see useful objectives to target.
column2: 亡灵法师是一位强大的宁苏科技法师，它收割生命 <color=#E16CFF>精华</color> 并用其驱动自己的帝国。  它有两类主要的单位；最强大的单位在其可怕的死灵城中建造，但它也可以将坠落的单位召唤到己方。这些坠落的单位数量更多但威力较小。  亡灵法师可以从裂缝中汲取 <color=#E16CFF>精华</color>；这是从其他维度汲取能量，对其大片区域造成毁灭性打击。圣殿骑士来到银河系的这一部分是为了保护裂缝免受亡灵法师的攻击，亡灵法师将通过与圣殿骑士战斗获得 <color=#7ce9ff>科学</color> 和 <color=#3DE799>入侵</color>。 巨大的宁苏远古者可以被猎杀以获取 <color=#E16CFF>精华</color>，或者被击杀并研究以解锁强大的亡灵法师转化。<color=#E16CFF>精华</color> 用于增强你的死灵城和旗舰。  请参阅侧边栏的提示部分以获取亡灵法师游戏玩法概述，以及情报菜单以查看有用的目标。
