column1: The Necromancer's most dangerous pet, the bone dragon is a force to be reckoned with. It breathes both fire and lightning.
column2: 死灵法师最危险的宠物，骨龙战舰是一股不可小觑的力量。它既能喷吐火焰，也能释放闪电。

column1: The Necromancer's most dangerous pet, the bone dragon is a force to be reckoned with. It breathes both fire and lightning. This ship is controlled by the Reaper invasion forces, making it more intelligent.
column2: 死灵法师最危险的宠物——骨龙是一股不可忽视的力量。它同时喷吐火焰和闪电。此单位由收割者入侵部队控制，使其更加智能。

column1: The Necromancer's most powerful totem, only available to the Defensive Necropolis. It has a blackhole generator effect, preventing most ships from fleeing through wormholes, and slows down ships in a wide area. Its primary weapon deals extra damage to ships stuck in tractor beams. It creates orbs of entropy that orbit the totem, trapping ships in its tractor beams. These orbs create their own minefields, wreaking havoc to ships caught in the tractor beams.
column2: 死灵法师最强大的图腾，仅防御型亡者都市可用。它具有黑洞发生器效果，阻止大多数舰船通过虫洞逃离，并在广阔区域内减缓舰船速度。其主要武器对被困在牵引光束中的舰船造成额外伤害。它会创造熵之球环绕图腾，将舰船困在牵引光束中。这些球体还会制造自己的雷区，对被困在牵引光束中的舰船造成严重破坏。

column1: The Necromancer's primary method of protecting its assets. Orbs of Absorption encircle the totem, attracting weapon fire within their zone of protection. Produces one orb every 30 seconds, to a max of three. All orbs will perish if the Totem is destroyed.
column2: 死灵法师保护其资产的主要手段。吸收之球环绕图腾，在其保护范围内吸引火力。每30秒生成一个吸收之球，最多生成三个。如果图腾被摧毁，所有吸收之球都会消失。

column1: The Necromancer's primary method of revealing cloaked enemies. Orbs of Sight encircle the totem, dealing devastating damage to high albedo ships (like those with cloaking fields).
column2: 死灵法师揭露隐形敌人的主要手段。洞察之球环绕图腾，对高反照率的舰船（如带有隐形场的舰船）造成毁灭性伤害。

column1: The Neinzul Moon is equipped with harmonic turrets to ravage poorly armored ships and convert foes into useful zombies.
column2: 奈祖尔之月配备有谐波炮塔，用于掠夺装甲薄弱的单位并将敌人转化为有用的僵尸。

column1: The Neinzul are a collection of hive minds.  Their individuals, as we see them, tend to be extremely short-lived (about one standard day).  Multiple hive minds exist, and their interests are not always aligned.  Contrary to prior belief, there are more than just the rapidly-dying younglings -- Elderlings have been found who somehow bypass the nature aging cycle.
column2: 奈因祖尔族是一群蜂巢思维体。我们所看到的它们的个体，寿命往往极短（大约一天）。存在多个蜂巢思维体，它们的利益并不总是一致的。与之前的认知相反，除了迅速死亡的幼体之外，还发现了一些不知何故绕过了自然衰老周期的长者。

column1: The Neinzul are migrating through the galaxy. Should you assist them in their journey, you may find your nation home to a new alien life.  <color=#f25e1c>MEDIUM IMPACT:</color> This faction acts as a sort of never ending quest for whatever team they're aligned with. Due to their constant appearance at random on the map, they may either open up new holes in your enemies' defenses or aggravate them and leave you to pick up the pieces.  On higher intensities, you may find yourself overwhelmed due to their sheer number, so be warned.
column2: 内因祖尔人正在穿越银河系进行迁徙。如果你协助他们的旅程，你的国家可能会迎来新的外星生命。  <color=#f25e1c>中等影响：</color> 这个派系对于与之结盟的阵营来说，就像是一场永无止境的任务。由于他们会不断随机出现在地图上，他们可能会为你的敌人的防线打开新的缺口，也可能会激怒敌人，让你收拾残局。  在更高的难度强度下，你可能会因他们的庞大数量而不堪重负，请注意。

column1: The Neinzul are migrating through the galaxy. Should you assist them in their journey, you may find your nation home to a new alien life.  <color=#f25e1c>MEDIUM IMPACT:</color> This faction acts as a sort of never ending quest for whatever team they're aligned with. Due to their constant appearance at random on the map, they may either open up new holes in your enemies' defenses or aggravate them and leave you to pick up the pieces.  On higher intensities, you may find yourself overwhelmed due to their sheer number, so be warned.
column2: 奈因祖尔正在星系中迁徙。如果你在它们的旅途中提供帮助，你的国家可能会迎来新的外星生命。  <color=#f25e1c>中等影响：</color>这个派系对它们所加入的任何队伍来说都像是一个永无止境的任务。由于它们会在地图上随机不断出现，可能会在敌人的防御中打开新的缺口，也可能激怒敌人，让你收拾残局。  在较高强度下，你可能会因为它们的数量过多而应接不暇，请注意。

column1: The Neinzul have generally found the concept of arming strikecraft with missiles to be counter-intuitive, preferring to use strikecraft as missiles instead.  However, when the rise in popularity of the Youngling Firefly in intra-Neinzul wars drove the need for an armor-piercing strikecraft, they found a solution in rocket-propelled spikes.  The aftermath led to the resulting craft being dubbed 'Shrikes', for a Terran bird known for impaling its prey on thorns.
column2: 内因祖尔通常认为给突击艇装备导弹的概念违反直觉，他们更喜欢将突击艇用作导弹。然而，当幼体萤火虫在内部战争中的流行促使需要一种穿甲突击艇时，他们在火箭推进的尖刺中找到了解决方案。结果导致这种飞行器被称为“伯劳鸟”，以一种以将猎物钉在荆棘上而闻名的地球鸟类命名。

column1: The Neinzul send out Protective Seeds, attracting weapon fire within their zone of protection. Produces one orb every Seed seconds, to a max of three. All orbs will perish if the Totem is destroyed.
column2: 奈祖尔释放保护种子，吸引保护区域内的武器火力。每隔一定时间产生一个球体，最多三个。如果图腾被摧毁，所有球体将会消散。

column1: The Nomad AI Overlord roams the galaxy in its powerful Phase-Two form. It has no bastions, homeworld, or dire guardposts.
column2: 游牧者AI霸主以其强大的第二阶段形态漫游银河系。它没有堡垒、母星或可怕岗哨。

column1: The OCD allows (with middle mouse click) to add and remove a value to the OSD. The OSD itself can be shown and hidden with this hotkey. The combination of OCD / OSD can be used to monitor certain important values ingame at one glance.
column2: OCD允许（通过中键点击）向OSD添加和移除数值。OSD本身可用此快捷键显示和隐藏。 OCD / OSD的组合可用于在游戏中一目了然地监控某些重要数值。

column1: The Opalescence-class heavy cruiser is an advanced command-and-control-vessel developed by the Dyson Sidekick.
column2: 乳光级重型巡洋舰是戴森盟友开发的先进指挥控制舰。

column1: The Opalescence-class light cruiser is an advanced command-and-control-vessel developed by the Chromatic Spire.
column2: 乳光级轻型巡洋舰是彩色尖塔开发的先进指挥控制舰船。

column1: The Overtone-class frigate is a guard vessel commonly used by the Chromatic Spire.
column2: 泛音级护卫舰是彩色尖塔常用的护卫舰船。

column1: The P-ABS-18 improves upon quite ancient Human technology, namely the Military Command Station. It wasn't commissioned until recently though, but breakthroughs in Parametrium Radiation shielding now allow both FTL travel and planet-wide ship amplification to work on the same ship. The power draw strains the ship, and its weapons aren't particularly strong for a vessel its size, but its durability prevents an important fleet booster from being lost in fights. The Protector variant not only has the same forcefield technology used in the Guard variant, but is also fortified against more distant attacks - no matter if they were intended for other ships. To accomplish this large amounts of... 'donated' Dark Zenith Thaumite was used.
column2: P-ABS-18改进了相当古老的人类技术，即军事指挥站。不过直到最近才被启用，Paramerium辐射屏蔽的突破使超光速旅行和全行星单位放大能在同一个单位上工作。电力消耗使单位紧张，其武器对如此尺寸的单位来说并不特别强大，但其耐久度可防止重要的舰队增强器在战斗中损失。保护者变体不仅拥有守卫变体使用的相同力场技术，还能抵御更远距离的攻击——无论这些攻击是否针对其他单位。为此使用了大量……「捐献」的暗天顶Thaumite。

column1: The P-BHF-2 Guard Bulk Heavy Frigate is a prototype designed to carry extremely powerful support equipment. Itself more a support than a combat ship the BHF's purpose is to prevent large and well-shielded enemies from escaping the assault of Kaizers Marauders. Cloaked ships in range will be revealed very quickly and many larger ships such as frigates and even transports may be ensnared by its tractor beams. The Protector variant not only has the same forcefield technology used in the Guard variant, but is also fortified against more distant attacks - no matter if they were intended for other ships. To accomplish this large amounts of... 'donated' Dark Zenith Thaumite was used.
column2: P-BHF-2保护者堡垒重型护卫舰是一种旨在携带极其强大支援装备的原型舰。其本身更像是支援舰而非战斗舰，BHF的目的是阻止大型和拥有强力护盾的敌人逃脱凯泽掠夺者的攻击。射程内的隐形单位将被迅速揭示，许多大型单位如护卫舰甚至运输船可能被其牵引光束捕获。保护者变体不仅拥有守卫变体使用的相同力场技术，还能抵御更远距离的攻击——无论这些攻击是否针对其他单位。为此使用了大量……「捐献」的暗天顶Thaumite。

column1: The P-DBS-17 is one of the most sturdy designs Kaizers Marauders ever built. It was designed as the fleet leader for a bulky and comparably slow fighting force, but with the ability to constantly and quickly produce drones which can reinforce both offensively and defensively. In addition it uses long-range fusion bomb weapons, makig it deadly when attacking structures. The Plated variant is able to not only absorb some incoming damage entirely, but endure more alltogether and resist a number of debuffs, though ion damage once again becomes viable.
column2: P-DBS-17是凯泽掠夺者有史以来建造的最坚固的设计之一。它被设计为一支笨重且相对缓慢的战斗力量的舰队领袖，但具有持续快速生产无人机的能力，可从攻防两面进行增援。此外它使用远程核聚变炸弹武器，在攻击建筑时具有致命效果。镀层变体不仅能完全吸收部分来袭伤害，还能承受更多攻击并抵抗多种减益效果，但离子伤害再次变得有效。

column1: The P-DC-21 Plated Disrupter Corvette is a support craft that tips the scales of combat in favor of Kaizers Marauders as long as it has a fleet to back up. Using their Disloger-Goo technology to disassemble enemy ships, impairing engines and weapons and turning them into packets of metal, as well as amplifying allied damage these ships should be a primary target. The Plated variant is able to not only absorb some incoming damage entirely, but endure more alltogether and resist a number of debuffs, though ion damage once again becomes viable.
column2: P-DC-21镀层干扰者护卫舰是一艘支援舰艇，只要后方有舰队支持，就能使战斗天平向凯泽掠夺者倾斜。使用其分解-粘液技术废弃敌舰、削弱引擎和武器并将其转化为金属包，同时放大友军伤害，因此这些单位应为首要目标。镀层变体不仅能完全吸收部分来袭伤害，还能承受更多攻击并抵抗多种减益效果，但离子伤害再次变得有效。

column1: The P-MHK-8 Mortar Heavy Corvette was designed to counter big fleet balls of strike craft by means of stopping them before they can even get into range. Its weapon is slow, but will deal with large amounts of strike craft efficiently like few other ships. The Protector variant not only has the same forcefield technology used in the Guard variant, but is also fortified against more distant attacks - no matter if they were intended for other ships. To accomplish this large amounts of... 'donated' Dark Zenith Thaumite was used.
column2: P-MHK-8迫击炮重型护卫舰旨在通过在其进入射程之前阻止大量星战舰队来对抗它们。其武器缓慢但能像极少数其他单位一样高效处理大规模星战。保护者变体不仅拥有守卫变体使用的相同力场技术，还能抵御更远距离的攻击——无论这些攻击是否针对其他单位。为此使用了大量……「捐献」的暗天顶Thaumite。

column1: The P-NI-5 Plated Needle Interceptor is a very cheap and basic design from Kaizers Marauders. It is able to deal with a large amount of enemy types that are either not moving or moving at slow speed, such as cargo vessels but also planetary defenses. The Plated variant is able to not only absorb some incoming damage entirely, but endure more alltogether and resist a number of debuffs, though ion damage once again becomes viable.
column2: P-NI-5镀层飞针拦截机是凯泽掠夺者一种非常廉价基础的设计。它能够应对大量静止或低速移动的敌方类型，如货船以及行星防御设施。镀层变体不仅能完全吸收部分来袭伤害，还能承受更多攻击并抵抗多种减益效果，但离子伤害再次变得有效。

column1: The PC-12 Phase Cannon fires volleys of the same particles Kaizers Marauders use for their jump drives. Upon exiting they teleport parts of ships somewhere randomly within 2 million lightyears, effectively disappearing them forever. The effect is strongest so long as the hull is sealed, any breaches cause the majority of particles to disappate in the face of exposed electical and plasma conduits. Additionally the particles interact with those that make up bubble forcefields. However, the particles need to prime mid-flight which means the weapon cannot hit up close.
column2: PC-12相位加农炮发射凯泽掠夺者用于跳跃驱动的相同粒子齐射。出膛后这些粒子将单位的部分随机传送到200万光年内的某处，实际上使其永远消失。只要船体密封，效果最强，任何破口都会导致大部分粒子在面对暴露的电流和等离子管道时消散。此外这些粒子与构成泡泡力场的粒子相互作用。然而粒子需要在飞行中充能，这意味着该武器无法近距离命中。

column1: The Phoenix has been defeated, for now. It will return obedient to its new master.
column2: 凤凰已被击败，暂时。它将顺从地回到新主人身边。

column1: The Planet Sidebar has a number of ways it can display its data, and finding a style you prefer can make your gameplay experience much more comfortable. You can modify the display format with the Options menu at the very bottom of the planet sidebar.  When you open the Planet Menu it can show either the ships as Text (with names and icons) or as just icons.     You can also choose how the ships are sorted when being displayed. You can sort them by faction, where each faction is listed individually (you can also have the per-faction view broken out by Mobile vs Stationary). You can also have it group the factions by their relationship with you (are they your allies? Your enemies?).  Finally, you can choose to show some of your Fleet information here. There are two types of Fleets for this sidebar; local fleets and Watched fleets. Local fleets are fleets whose centerpieces are on the planet you are currently looking at. Watched Fleets always appear regardless of which planet you are on. Watching important fleets is a great way to keep track of remote battles.   When a fleet is displayed it will show its hotkey on the left. In the center is the name of the fleet and the flagship's current health (if it has taken damage). On the top right are the current strength of the fleet and what % of that fleet is still alive. And in the bottom right are the strengths of enemy and friendly forces on the flagship's current planet (if there are any enemies).  Hovering over a fleet in the sidebar will give you additional, more detailed information.
column2: The Planet Sidebar has a number of ways it can display its data, and finding a style you prefer can make your gameplay experience much more comfortable. You can modify the display format with the Options menu at the very bottom of the planet sidebar.  当你打开行星菜单时，它可以以文本形式（包含名称和图标）显示单位，也可以仅显示图标。     你还可以选择单位显示时的排序方式。你可以按阵营对它们进行排序，每个阵营会单独列出（你也可以将每个阵营的视图按移动单位和固定单位进行细分）。 你还可以根据阵营与你的关系对它们进行分组（它们是你的盟友还是敌人？）。  最后，你可以选择在此处显示部分舰队信息。此侧边栏有两种类型的舰队：本地舰队和关注舰队。本地舰队是指其核心单位位于你当前查看行星上的舰队。无论你查看哪个行星，关注舰队都会显示。关注重要的舰队是跟踪远程战斗的好方法。   舰队显示时，其快捷键会显示在左侧。中间是舰队名称和旗舰当前的生命值（如果受到过伤害）。右上角是舰队的当前实力以及该舰队仍存活的百分比。右下角是旗舰当前所在行星上敌军和友军的实力（如果有敌军的话）。  将鼠标悬停在侧边栏中的舰队上，会显示更多详细信息。

column1: The Praetorian Guard is an elite force that defends AI homeworlds.
column2: 禁卫军是保卫AI母星的精英部队。

column1: The Praetorian Guard is an elite force that defends AI homeworlds.
column2: 禁卫军是保卫AI母星的精英部队。

column1: The Praetorian Guard is the bodyguard of the AI Overlord. It is limited to planets near the AI Overlord, though they have no restriction on who owns the planets. So if you capture a planet near the AI Homeworld you can expect the Praetorians to have something to say about it.
column2: 禁卫军是 AI 霸主的护卫队。它局限于 AI 霸主附近的行星，不过这些行星的归属没有限制。所以，如果你占领了 AI 母星附近的行星，就可以预料到禁卫军会有所行动。

column1: The Praetorian launches powerful zombifying rockets that do more damage to low health enemies.
column2: 执政官发射强大的僵尸化火箭，对低生命值敌人造成更高伤害。

column1: The R-AT-90 Refracting Adaptor Turret is not a fancy superweapon like some of the Tier 3 Marauder structures. It's fairly simple in both design and design philosophy, but has gone through many iterations over the decades and became very complex. Slightly above average in nearly every department - damage, durability, range, cost efficiency - and the ability to either focus its damage onto single big enemies, or spread it against large amounts of enemies it this turret completes Kaizers Marauders defensive capabilities. The Refracting variant is coated with RPSC, a new material which resists acid and exotic damage, on top of higher durability.
column2: R-AT-90折射适配者炮塔不像某些三级掠夺者建筑那样是花哨的超级武器。它在设计和理念上相对简单，但经过数十年的多次迭代已变得非常复杂。在几乎所有方面——伤害、耐久度、射程、成本效率——都略高于平均水平，并能将其伤害聚焦到单个大型敌人或分散对付大量敌人，这种炮塔完善了凯泽掠夺者的防御能力。折射变体涂有RPSC材料，这是一种能抵抗酸蚀和异类伤害的新材料，同时拥有更高的耐久度。

column1: The R-BD-1 Radiant Beam Dreadnought is without a doubt the biggest and most powerful ship Kaizers Marauders can produce at any larger quantity than 1. Filled to the brim with adapted Spire technology, using their advanced weapons, shields and structural design fused with the already impressive engineering of Kaizers Marauders it is advised to only engage this vessel in... 'underhanded' combat, using its size, mass, armor and limited range against it. The Radiant variant has crystalline circuitry, making weapon and tareting systems more efficient, plus allowing it to target enemy sensors before enemies can react, stunning them and dealing more damage until they adjust. It also employs crystalline growth for the Disloger-Goo gel, making it even more powerful. To accomplish this a lot of... 'harvested' Sappers Bloodstone was used.
column2: R-BD-1光辉光束无畏舰无疑是凯泽掠夺者能以超过1的数量生产的最大最强单位。充满了改造的尖塔技术，使用他们的先进武器、护盾和结构设计，与凯泽掠夺者已有的强大工程能力融合，建议只在……「不光彩」的战斗中与这个单位交战，利用其尺寸、质量、装甲和有限射程来对抗它。光辉变体拥有晶体电路，使武器和瞄准系统更加高效，并能在敌人反应前击中敌方传感器，使其眩晕并在调整前造成更多伤害。它还采用晶体生长技术增强分解粘液凝胶，使其威力更甚。为此使用了大量……「采集」的工兵血石。

column1: The R-BLST-1 Refracting Blockade Station is a newly-introduced prototype Marauder defensive installation which relies less on direct firepower but on durability and inhibiting enemies with tractor beams and sticking goo onto enemies in range. The station's goo tanks are rigged to explode on death, dealing significant damage to all enemies in range and readying them for rapid recycling. The Refracting variant is coated with RPSC, a new material which resists acid and exotic damage, on top of higher durability.
column2: R-BLST-1折射封锁站是一种新引入的原型掠夺者防御设施，较少依赖直接火力，而更多依赖耐久度和用牵引光束抑制敌人，并将粘液附着到射程内的敌人身上。该站的粘液储罐在死亡时会爆炸，对射程内所有敌人造成显著伤害，并为快速回收做好准备。折射变体涂有RPSC材料，这是一种能抵抗酸蚀和异类伤害的新材料，同时拥有更高的耐久度。

column1: The R-BST-9 Refracting Beam Sniper Turret is the result of decades of FTL weapon technology development by Kaizers Marauders. Its extremely powerful tachyon beam emitter projects damage at speeds faster than light, and while a higher albedo of the target reduces the damage these turrets have the numbers and power to obliterate almost any foe extremely quickly. The Refracting variant is coated with RPSC, a new material which resists acid and exotic damage, on top of higher durability.
column2: R-BST-9折射光束狙击手炮塔是凯泽掠夺者数十年超光速武器技术发展的成果。其极其强大的快子光束发射器以超光速投射伤害，虽然目标更高的反照率会减少伤害，但这些炮塔的数量和力量足以极快速消灭几乎所有敌人。折射变体涂有RPSC材料，这是一种能抵抗酸蚀和异类伤害的新材料，同时拥有更高的耐久度。

column1: The R-BTC-39 Radiant Breach Torpedo Turret was designed as a cheap deterrant against large ships. The warhead generates a seismic shockwave throughout larger hulls which becomes much more devestating once the breakpoint of 5tx has been achieved. The result is catastrophic hull failures along all major fault lines, and ships will fall apart quickly in the face of it. The Radiant variant has crystalline circuitry, making weapon and tareting systems more efficient, plus allowing it to target enemy sensors before enemies can react, stunning them and dealing more damage until they adjust. It also employs crystalline growth for the Disloger-Goo gel, making it even more powerful. To accomplish this a lot of... 'harvested' Sappers Bloodstone was used.
column2: R-BTC-39光辉突破鱼雷炮塔是作为一种廉价的威慑手段对抗大型单位而设计的。飞弹在大型船体中产生地震冲击波，一旦达到5tx的临界点将变得更加毁灭性。结果是沿所有主要断层线发生灾难性船体破裂，单位将在其面前迅速瓦解。光辉变体拥有晶体电路，使武器和瞄准系统更加高效，并能在敌人反应前击中敌方传感器，使其眩晕并在调整前造成更多伤害。它还采用晶体生长技术增强分解粘液凝胶，使其威力更甚。为此使用了大量……「采集」的工兵血石。

column1: The R-CBT-1 Radiant Coil Beam Turret is a brand-new addition to Kaizers Marauders arsenal of defenses. From gathered debris their scientists were able to duplicate the spire's most iconic weapon system. The turret does, however, have not only a single coil beam but multiple arrays: The main emitter focuses on high-mass targets in order to destroy them quickly, while the point defense coil beams take out strike craft trying to destroy the turret up close. The Radiant variant has crystalline circuitry, making weapon and tareting systems more efficient, plus allowing it to target enemy sensors before enemies can react, stunning them and dealing more damage until they adjust. It also employs crystalline growth for the Disloger-Goo gel, making it even more powerful. To accomplish this a lot of... 'harvested' Sappers Bloodstone was used.
column2: R-CBT-1光辉线圈光束炮塔是凯泽掠夺者防御武器库的最新成员。通过收集到的残骸，他们的科学家成功复制了尖塔最具标志性的武器系统。然而这种炮塔不只有单一线圈光束，而是多个阵列：主发射器聚焦于高质量目标以快速摧毁它们，而点防御线圈光束清除试图近距离破坏炮塔的星战。光辉变体拥有晶体电路，使武器和瞄准系统更加高效，并能在敌人反应前击中敌方传感器，使其眩晕并在调整前造成更多伤害。它还采用晶体生长技术增强分解粘液凝胶，使其威力更甚。为此使用了大量……「采集」的工兵血石。

column1: The R-CM-22 Radiant Chain Minefield is a very large amount of very small mines. They take basically no 'space' in space. The mines themselves are so small that they effectively exist between all other objects, but are linked together so that for each minefield, each network of mines, they will explode all at once, doing massive damage in a large. The Radiant variant has crystalline circuitry, making weapon and tareting systems more efficient, plus allowing it to target enemy sensors before enemies can react, stunning them and dealing more damage until they adjust. It also employs crystalline growth for the Disloger-Goo gel, making it even more powerful. To accomplish this a lot of... 'harvested' Sappers Bloodstone was used.
column2: R-CM-22光辉链式雷场由大量极其微小的雷构成。它们在太空中基本不占用「空间」。雷本身非常微小，实际上存在于所有其他物体之间，但通过链式连接，每个雷场、每个雷网络的所有雷都会同时爆炸，在大范围内造成巨额伤害。光辉变体拥有晶体电路，使武器和瞄准系统更加高效，并能在敌人反应前击中敌方传感器，使其眩晕并在调整前造成更多伤害。它还采用晶体生长技术增强分解粘液凝胶，使其威力更甚。为此使用了大量……「采集」的工兵血石。

column1: The R-CT-58 Refracting Consumer Turret is one of the oldest turret designs for Kaizers Marauders. Over the years its prime purpose hasn't changed much, it remains a rather tanky short-range turret which excels at turning enemies into metal upon being destroyed, but it has constanly become better and more efficient doing so. The Refracting variant is coated with RPSC, a new material which resists acid and exotic damage, on top of higher durability.
column2: R-CT-58折射消耗者炮塔是凯泽掠夺者最古老的炮塔设计之一。多年来其主要用途变化不大，仍是一种相当坚韧的短程炮塔，擅长在摧毁敌人时将其转化为金属，但效率和效果不断变得更好。折射变体涂有RPSC材料，这是一种能抵抗酸蚀和异类伤害的新材料，同时拥有更高的耐久度。

column1: The R-FSG-9 Refracting  Generator is similar in nature to the forcefields also used by the Human Remnant, but Kaizers Marauders have made their own changes. While the actual shield strength is lower, it no longer loses range under fire. Additionally at almost full integrity, the shield can almost entirely negate damage, which makes it very powerful against single powerful attacks. The Refracting variant is coated with RPSC, a new material which resists acid and exotic damage, on top of higher durability.
column2: R-FSG-9折射力场盾发生器本质上类似于人类残余使用的力场，但凯泽掠夺者做出了自己的改变。虽然实际护盾强度较低，但遭受火力时不再失去范围。此外在几乎满完整度时，护盾几乎可以完全抵消伤害，使其对单次强力攻击极为有效。折射变体涂有RPSC材料，这是一种能抵抗酸蚀和异类伤害的新材料，同时拥有更高的耐久度。

column1: The R-GM-3 Radiant Goo Minefield was created as a preventative measure against raids. Once hit an enemy ship will be covered in what Kaizers Marauders call 'black snot', a sticky and errosive chemical concoction consisting out of various substances which bind to metals. Not only does it reduce the operating efficiency of ships, once the construct breaks apart the adhesive nature prevents the metal from dispersing, keeping it in one place for rapid recycling. The Radiant variant has crystalline circuitry, making weapon and tareting systems more efficient, plus allowing it to target enemy sensors before enemies can react, stunning them and dealing more damage until they adjust. It also employs crystalline growth for the Disloger-Goo gel, making it even more powerful. To accomplish this a lot of... 'harvested' Sappers Bloodstone was used.
column2: R-GM-3光辉粘液雷场是作为预防袭击措施而创建的。一旦被触发，敌舰将被涂上凯泽掠夺者所谓的「黑鼻涕」，这是一种粘稠且具侵蚀性的化学混合物，由各种与金属结合的物质组成。它不仅降低单位的运行效率，一旦结构解体，其粘合性质还阻止金属散逸，使其留在原地以便快速回收。光辉变体拥有晶体电路，使武器和瞄准系统更加高效，并能在敌人反应前击中敌方传感器，使其眩晕并在调整前造成更多伤害。它还采用晶体生长技术增强分解粘液凝胶，使其威力更甚。为此使用了大量……「采集」的工兵血石。

column1: The R-PC-12 Radiant Phase Cannon fires volleys of the same particles Kaizers Marauders use for their jump drives. Upon exiting they teleport parts of ships somewhere randomly within 2 million lightyears, effectively disappearing them forever. The effect is strongest so long as the hull is sealed, any breaches cause the majority of particles to disappate in the face of exposed electical and plasma conduits. Additionally the particles interact with those that make up bubble forcefields. However, the particles need to prime mid-flight which means the weapon cannot hit up close. The Radiant variant has crystalline circuitry, making weapon and tareting systems more efficient, plus allowing it to target enemy sensors before enemies can react, stunning them and dealing more damage until they adjust. It also employs crystalline growth for the Disloger-Goo gel, making it even more powerful. To accomplish this a lot of... 'harvested' Sappers Bloodstone was used.
column2: R-PC-12光辉相位加农炮发射凯泽掠夺者用于跳跃驱动的相同粒子齐射。出膛后这些粒子将单位的部分随机传送到200万光年内的某处，实际上使其永远消失。只要船体密封，效果最强，任何破口都会导致大部分粒子在面对暴露的电流和等离子管道时消散。此外这些粒子与构成泡泡力场的粒子相互作用。然而粒子需要在飞行中充能，这意味着该武器无法近距离命中。光辉变体拥有晶体电路，使武器和瞄准系统更加高效，并能在敌人反应前击中敌方传感器，使其眩晕并在调整前造成更多伤害。它还采用晶体生长技术增强分解粘液凝胶，使其威力更甚。为此使用了大量……「采集」的工兵血石。

column1: The R-TR-89 Refracting Tachyon Raider has, despite its relatively recent addition to Kaizers Marauders forces, undergone a lot of design changes. Especially the tachyon array is top-secret in-development technology which allows this raider to saturate the entire planet with tachyon radiation, although at a slow rate. Development is under way for increasing its power, and that of the ablative weaponry brought to bear against the once cloaked enemies. The Refracting variant is coated with RPSC, a new material which resists acid and exotic damage, on top of higher durability.
column2: R-TR-89折射快子突击者尽管相对较晚才加入凯泽掠夺者部队，但经历了大量设计变更。特别是快子阵列是绝密的在研技术，允许这艘突击者用快子辐射饱和整个行星，尽管速率较慢。正在开发以提升其功率，以及那些用于对抗曾经隐形敌人的烧蚀武器的威力。折射变体涂有RPSC材料，这是一种能抵抗酸蚀和异类伤害的新材料，同时拥有更高的耐久度。

column1: The RF-57 Rampage Frigate was one of the earliest designs of Kaizers Marauders, and follows a slightly different design philosophy compared to their current ships even after many, many iter- and alterations. It's slow, tough, and armed to the teeth, the heart of a fleet that is designed to deal with anything and everything.
column2: RF-57狂怒护卫舰是凯泽掠夺者最早的设计之一，即使经过无数次迭代和改动，其设计理念与当前单位也略有不同。它缓慢、坚韧、武装到牙齿，是旨在应对一切挑战的舰队核心。

column1: The Reaper Lesser Locust carries onf the battle, though they are much weaker.
column2: 收割者次级蝗虫继续战斗，但实力弱得多。

column1: The Reaper Locusts swarm against the enemy! They have zombification. When a locust is killed, it spawns a lesser locust.
column2: 收割者蝗虫蜂拥攻击敌人！它们拥有僵尸化能力。蝗虫被击杀时会生成一只小型蝗虫。

column1: The Reaper Scion is an attrition specialist. Its Entropic Infection steadily paralyzes and decays targets, while its Death Rattle delivers heavy punishment against anything already weakened — hitting harder the more a target has been worn down.
column2: 收割者后裔是一名消耗战专家。其熵蚀感染会持续麻痹并腐朽目标，而其死亡哀鸣会对已被削弱的目标施以沉重惩罚——目标磨损得越严重，伤害越高。

column1: The Reapers are a powerful force of Necromancers seeking to conquer the galaxy. They will seize planets, or ravage them to fuel their war machine.  The Reapers exist normally to counter the Dyson Sidekick, but this version does not require a Dyson Sidekick.  Badger doesn't have much balance data for this, so if you have problems please give feedback on discord.  Adding this faction alongside a dyson sidekick is not supported (instead just use the dyson sidekick and the Reapers will be added automatically)
column2: 收割者是一支强大的死灵法师力量，试图征服银河。他们会夺取行星，或掠夺它们来为其战争机器提供燃料。  收割者通常是为了对抗戴森Sidekick而存在，但此版本不需要戴森Sidekick。  Badger对此没有太多平衡数据，所以如果有问题请在discord上反馈。  同时添加该派系和戴森Sidekick不受支持（只需使用戴森Sidekick，收割者会自动添加）

column1: The Reapers have gotten an entire moon to our universe; this is a powerful mobile weapons platform that also heals its allies. When killed, the Dyson Sidekick will be able to rebuild it as a Moon for them.  That's no moon. It's a space station!
column2: 收割者已在我们的宇宙中占据了一整颗卫星；这是一个强大的机动武器平台，还能治疗其盟友。被摧毁后，戴森伙伴能够将其重建为他们的卫星。    那不是卫星，是空间站！

column1: The Reapers will attack much more often. You will die quickly, this is for debugging/testing.
column2: 收割者将更频繁地发动攻击。你会很快死亡，这仅用于调试/测试。

column1: The Reclaimers have collected an assortment of alien ship schematics sometimes available at their outposts.
column2: 回收者收集了各种外星单位蓝图，有时可在其前哨站获得。

column1: The Reclaimers have made a discovery! By some combination of Alien remnants and human ingenuity, they can produce a defense schematic for your stations.
column2: 回收者有了新发现！通过外星残骸与人类智慧的某种结合，他们可以为你的空间站生产防御蓝图。

column1: The Reclaimers have made a discovery! By some combination of Alien remnants and human ingenuity, they can produce a schematic for your Battlestations.
column2: 回收者有了新发现！通过外星残骸与人类智慧的某种结合，他们可以为你的战斗空间站生产蓝图。

column1: The Reclaimers have made a discovery! By some combination of Alien remnants and human ingenuity, they can produce a schematic for your galactic infrastructure.
column2: 回收者有了新发现！通过外星残骸与人类智慧的某种结合，他们可以为你的银河基础设施生产蓝图。

column1: The Reclaimers have made a discovery! By some combination of Alien remnants and human ingenuity, they can produce an actual craft for your fleet.
column2: 回收者有了新发现！通过外星残骸与人类智慧的某种结合，他们可以为你的舰队生产实际的可造单位。

column1: The Rocroi flagship specializes in single target damage with a powerful coil beam.
column2: 罗克鲁瓦旗舰专精于使用强大的线圈光束造成单体伤害。

column1: The S-ALC-49 Strike Acidic Light Corvette was created as an alternative to the DC-21 Disrupter Corvette. Whereas the DC-21 protects its allies by impairing enemies, the ALC-49 can aid in destroying enemies by increasing ally damage. The Strike variant was eqipped with superior engines, granting it higher engine power and speed.
column2: S-ALC-49突击酸性轻型护卫舰是作为DC-21干扰者护卫舰的替代方案而创建的。DC-21通过削弱敌人保护盟友，而ALC-49则通过增加友军伤害来协助摧毁敌人。突击变体配备了卓越引擎，赋予其更高的引擎功率和速度。

column1: The S-AR-68 Strike Adaptor Raider was designed not long after the Adaptor Turret, with the same concept in mind, but much cheaper and simpler. Its targeting systems and multi-angle turret setup allow for its firepower to be spread across many smaller targets, focused on single large enemies and everything in between. It's been mounted onto a hull with average protection and velocity. The Strike variant was eqipped with superior engines, granting it higher engine power and speed.
column2: S-AR-68突击适配者突击者是在适配者炮塔之后不久设计的，秉承相同理念，但更廉价和简单。其瞄准系统和多角度炮塔配置使其火力可分散到众多小目标、聚焦到单个大敌人或介于两者之间。它搭载在拥有平均防护和速度的船体上。突击变体配备了卓越引擎，赋予其更高的引擎功率和速度。

column1: The S-TB-4 Torpedo Bomber is the Kaizers Marauders answer to anything the size of a heavy corvette or above. Their torpedoes are slow and short-ranged, but the seismic warhead resonates with the target structure and thus the larger the resonating body, the greater the damage. The Strike variant was eqipped with superior engines, granting it higher engine power and speed.
column2: S-TB-4鱼雷轰炸机是凯泽掠夺者对重型护卫舰及以上尺寸所有物体的答案。其鱼雷缓慢且射程短，但地震飞弹与目标结构发生共振，共振体越大，伤害越大。突击变体配备了卓越引擎，赋予其更高的引擎功率和速度。

column1: The SLF-11 Sting Light Frigate has served for quite a long time as a the backbone of Kaizers Marauders bunker buster fleets. It's cheap, balanced and especially when accompanied by interceptors deadly to fortifications and larger frigates. Alone, however it is severely lacking in anti-strike craft capabilities.
column2: SLF-11螫刺轻型护卫舰长期作为凯泽掠夺者地堡破坏舰队的骨干服役。它廉价、平衡，尤其配合拦截机时对防御工事和大型护卫舰致命。但单独作战时严重缺乏反星战能力。

column1: The SO-297 Sabot Outpost houses various facilities for shuttles, transports and other civilian craft which allow for metal to be harvested even without harvester stations. Additionally construction facilities provide all the equipment for building defenses and ships alike. On top it is equipped with a long-range sabot weapon, which is able to rupture most larger ships with only a few rounds.
column2: SO-297穿甲弹前哨容纳了穿梭机、运输船及其他民用舰艇的各种设施，即使没有采矿站也能收集金属。此外建造设施提供建造防御工事和单位的全部设备。此外还配备了一门远程穿甲弹武器，仅需几发就能撕裂大多数大型单位。

column1: The Scourge Infused Empire can build and manage their Scourge allies. To strengthen your main scourge forces, you need to build lots of Spawners; these generate scourge ships. Scourge ships will upgrade themselves at Armories; building an Armory allows ships to evolve into that race's ships. Higher mark armories allow your ships to reach higher marks.  Fortresses produce ships to defend the region around their planet, as do Bestiaries. Bestiaries produce a single very powerful Ship, Fortresses produce lots of small ships.  You can summon all your scourge forces by building a Summoner on a given planet; the Scourge will then fly to that planet to attack.  You will need to upgrade your Scourge Structures; there is a notification that will tell you what structures are eligible to upgrade. You upgrade using the hacking menu.  You will need Corbomite to build Scourge structures; Corbomite is grown from Flowers into Crystals when they can be harvested by attacking them. The AI will attempt to destroy your flowers. You can planet additional flowers.
column2: 天灾灌注帝国可以建造和管理其天灾盟友。要增强你的主力天灾部队，你需要建造大量生成器；这些生成器产生天灾单位。天灾单位会在军械库中自我升级；建造军械库允许单位进化为该种族的单位。更高标记的军械库允许你的单位达到更高标记。  要塞生产单位防御其行星周围区域，兽栏也是如此。兽栏生产一个非常强大的单位，要塞生产大量小型单位。  你可以通过在特定行星上建造召唤者来召唤你的所有天灾部队；天灾将飞往该行星进行攻击。  你需要升级你的天灾建筑；会有通知告诉你哪些建筑可以升级。你使用入侵菜单进行升级。  你需要科波麦特来建造天灾建筑；科波麦特由花朵生长为水晶，通过攻击它们即可收获。AI会试图摧毁你的花朵。你可以种植额外的花朵。

column1: The Scourge are the outcome of an AI genetic manipulation project. The AI has twisted a number of other races in the galaxy to serve as a strike force to crush their enemies.  The Scourge use Spawners to build ships, and Armories to upgrade ships into more powerful versions. They like to lurk on planets you don't have vision on and then strike your most critical structures. They are skilled at breaking force fields, so you might need to rethink how you protect important structures like Zenith Power Generators and Major Data Centers.  Scourge units evolve to get more powerful over time.  The Scourge have limitations on where they can build Spawners and Armories; no spawner or armory can be built adjacent to another spawner.  (Higher intensity allows the Scourge to grow and recover faster. Intensity 4/7/10 is 2x/3x/4x harder than intensity 1. Raising AI difficulty, making moving through AI's planets to curb the Scourge much harder, will make the Scourge much more threatening even at lower intensity.)
column2: 天灾是AI基因操纵项目的产物。AI扭曲了银河系中的多个种族，将它们作为打击敌人的突击部队。  天灾使用孵化器建造舰船，使用军械库将舰船升级为更强大的版本。它们喜欢潜伏在你无法观察到的行星上，然后突袭你最重要的建筑。它们擅长突破力场，所以你可能需要重新考虑如何保护天顶发电机和主要数据中心等重要建筑。  天灾单位会随时间进化变得更强大。  天灾在建造孵化器和军械库时有位置限制；任何孵化器或军械库都不能建在另一个孵化器旁边。  （更高的强度允许天灾更快地成长和恢复。强度4/7/10比强度1分别难2/3/4倍。提高AI难度会使穿越AI行星以遏制天灾变得更加困难，这会使天灾即使在较低强度下也更具威胁性。）

column1: The Scourge remain loyal to the AI, but different Hives of Scourge no longer trust one another. The chaos of their civil war will prevent them from focusing on you.  <color=#f25e1c>HIGH IMPACT:</color> Each AI will get its own faction of the Scourge. Each scourge faction is an ally to the AI, and enemy to all the other scourge factions and to you.
column2: 天灾仍然忠于AI，但不同的天灾虫巢已不再相互信任。它们内战的混乱将阻止它们集中对付你。  <color=#f25e1c>高影响：</color>每个AI将获得自己的天灾派系。每个天灾派系是AI的盟友，并与其他所有天灾派系以及你为敌。

column1: The Shade-class frigate is a guard vessel commonly used by the Dark Spire Sphere.
column2: 暗影级护卫舰是黑暗尖塔球体常用的守卫单位。

column1: The Shades of Hades are an elite and elusive raiding strikeforce, comprising a team of Shades, elite Apparition frigates, and a battalion of enhanced Mirages. They prefer hit-and-run tactics and won't stick around long.
column2: 冥河魅影是一支精锐且神秘的突袭部队，由一群魅影战机、精英幻影护卫舰和一队强化型幻影战机组成。他们偏好打了就跑的战术，不会停留太久。

column1: The Shadowseeker-class heavy frigate is an advanced guard vessel used by the Dark Sphere.
column2: 暗影探索者级重型护卫舰是黑暗球体使用的高级守卫单位。

column1: The Shree Battle Cruiser wields tyderian-enhanced zombifying weapons to convert our ships.
column2: 希瑞战列巡洋舰装备有泰德瑞安强化的僵尸化武器，可将我方单位转化。

column1: The Skeleton Captain is far stronger than most of its kind, and leads all undead into battle. Uses its own health to rejuvenate fallen allies, and gains higher damage the lower its health is.
column2: 骷髅领主比大多数同类强大得多，带领所有亡灵投入战斗。使用自身生命值来恢复倒下的盟友，生命值越低伤害越高。

column1: The Skeleton Lord revived from a fatal blow, but weaker than its former form.
column2: 从致命一击下复活的骷髅领主，但比之前的形态更弱。

column1: The Skrin Lesser Locust carries onf the battle, though they are much weaker.
column2: 斯克林次级蝗虫继续战斗，但实力弱得多。

column1: The Spartacus Cruiser was made possible only through a bold mission to the Zenith Architrave homeworld and wresting their technology for benefit of humanity. This cruiser integrates the mysterious phasing properties common to the Architrave periodically phases to and from Multi-phase. In realspace, it is equipped with three phaser weapons, which all phase targets with no shields and low energy usage. Its spiderweb phaser has planetary range and only hits mobile targets, stunning their engines and reeling targets towards itself. Its ionized phaser is short range and designed to quickly wear down shields to enable the phasing effect. The phasion bombs it launches completely bypass the shield prevention but can be destroyed in flight. While in Multi-Phase, the Spartacus Cruiser switches to its vorpal beams that wreak havoc on weakened ships and launches phased Cestus drones that are permanently in Multi-phase. Cruisers are an elite category of ships limited to one per fleet; they do not count as a standard shipline but they are eligible for fleetwide bonuses granted by FRS ships.
column2: 只有通过一次大胆的前往天顶拱道主星的任务，并夺取他们的技术造福人类，才得以制造出斯巴达克斯巡洋舰。这艘巡洋舰融合了拱道族常见的神秘相位转换特性，会周期性地在正常相位和多相位之间转换。在现实空间中，它配备了三门相位武器，这些武器都能对没有护盾且能量消耗较低的目标进行相位转换。它的蛛网相位器拥有行星级射程，仅攻击移动目标，能使目标引擎瘫痪并将其拉向自身。它的电离相位器射程较短，旨在迅速消耗目标护盾以触发相位转换效果。它发射的相位炸弹可以完全绕过护盾防御，但在飞行过程中可能被击落。处于多相位状态时，斯巴达克斯巡洋舰会切换到它的锋刃光束，对受损舰船造成巨大破坏，并发射永久处于多相位状态的拳剑无人机。巡洋舰是一种精英级别的舰船，每个舰队限拥有一艘；它们不属于标准舰船序列，但有资格获得快速反应支援（FRS）舰船提供的全舰队增益。

column1: The Spire Infused Empire is similar to the Human Empire/Fallen Spire faction combinations, but there are some specific differences. Here is a quick overview of how this faction plays.  You will begin the game with a Spire Galactic Capitol and a Spire Fleet. Every 4 planets you capture gives you the ability to build a Spire City. The 3rd and 5th Spire City you build will also give you a new Spire Fleet for a total of 3.  Spire Cities that do not have Fleets of their own can instead Bolster the Spire Fleets of other Cities to increase the strength of those Fleets. This means you will have up to 3 fleets, but each with the power of several cities behind them. Practically, this means that the buildings in the Bolstering City will grant their bonuses to the Bolstered Fleet. You can change which Fleet a city is bolstering in the Fleets menu.  Every so often the AI will send large Exogalactic Strikeforces against your empire. They will send smaller Exogalactic Strikeforces whenever you build a city.  When you build a city, in a few minutes some Spire Debris will appear in some planets near your Empire. You can hack them for resources.  <color=#a1ffa1>Every 3 planets you capture grants you the ability to build a new Spire City. This is a significant difference from the fallen Spire campaign. For more information, hover the Spire City in the build menu with full tooltips.</color>  Spire Cities can't be too close to each other; you must build them at least one hop apart.
column2: 尖塔族融合帝国与人类帝国/堕落尖塔族派系组合类似，但有一些具体的区别。以下是这个派系玩法的快速概述。  你将从一个尖塔族银河首都和一支尖塔族舰队开始游戏。每占领4个行星，你就可以建造一座尖塔族城市。你建造的第3和第5座尖塔族城市还将给你一支新的尖塔族舰队，总共3支。  没有自己舰队的尖塔族城市可以增强其他城市的尖塔族舰队，以增加这些舰队的力量。这意味着你将有多达3支舰队，但每支舰队背后都有几个城市的力量。实际上，这意味着增强城市中的建筑将为其增强的舰队提供加成。你可以在舰队菜单中更改城市增强的舰队。  每隔一段时间，人工智能将向你的帝国派遣大规模的星系外打击部队。每当你建造一座城市时，他们会派遣较小的星系外打击部队。  当你建造一座城市时，几分钟后，一些尖塔族残骸将出现在你帝国附近的行星上。你可以入侵它们获取资源。  <color=#a1ffa1>每占领3个行星，你就可以建造一座新的尖塔族城市。这与堕落尖塔族战役有显著差异。 更多信息，请将鼠标悬停在建造菜单中的尖塔族城市上查看完整提示。</color>  尖塔族城市不能彼此太近；你必须至少间隔一个跳跃点建造它们。

column1: The Spire Moon is equipped with various long range turrets.
column2: 尖塔之月配备有各种远程炮塔。

column1: The Spire Shiver is a very powerful ship with a pair of railcannons.
column2: 尖塔寒颤舰是一个配备双联磁轨炮的非常强大的单位。

column1: The Spire Sidekick is a mod allowing the player to play as the Fallen Spire. This works just like the regular Fallen Spire campaign (from the Spire's POV), but this version has more structures and sockets. As a result, it is also more powerful.  Restrictions: You cannot actually lose the game, so you must play with another player type; this is the same restriction as the Necromancer Sidekick. You will be pretty limited until you get your first Relic.  Written by Badger. This is only a mod, and has no official Arcen support.
column2: 尖塔Sidekick是一个模组，允许玩家扮演堕落尖塔。这与常规的堕落尖塔战役（从尖塔的视角）运作方式相同，但此版本有更多的建筑和插槽。因此，它也更为强大。  限制：你实际上无法输掉游戏，因此你必须配合其他玩家类型游玩；这与死灵法师Sidekick的限制相同。 在获得第一个遗物之前，你会相当受限。  Written by Badger。这只是一个模组，没有Arcen的官方支持。

column1: The Spire Sidekick works essentially like the Fallen Spire campaign, but you control only the spire ships.  You do get access to additional structure types, and more Casings. The Spire Sidekick is significantly more powerful than the Fallen Spire, so you may want to turn the difficulty up.  You get Hacking Points by fighting the AI; destroying their Command Stations is the primary source, as well as killing certain types of AI ships.
column2: 尖塔助手的工作方式与陨落尖塔战役基本相同，但你只控制尖塔单位。  你可以使用额外的建筑类型和更多外壳。尖塔助手比陨落尖塔强大得多，因此你可能需要调高难度。  通过与AI战斗获得入侵点数；摧毁其指挥站是主要来源，以及击杀特定类型的AI单位。

column1: The Spire are a true apex organism.  They are not more dominant in the galaxy because they rarely organize.  These giant crystalline space creatures tend to be wandering thinkers and philosophers.  However, there are some truly terrifying warriors among them.
column2: 尖塔族是真正的顶级生物。它们在银河系中并不占据主导地位，因为它们很少组织起来。这些巨大的水晶状太空生物往往是四处漂泊的思想家和哲学家。然而，它们当中也有一些真正可怕的战士。

column1: The Spire are rock/crystalline creatures who feed on energy and can grow and reproduce very quickly with enough energy, so freeing those reactors will allow them to create cities and warships quickly. Each structure or warship IS a living spire -- like Zenith Golems, the spire are macroscopic life to an almost absurd degree.  It seems that the AI has attacked the Spire in their home galaxy; they might make powerful allies against the AI!  The AI has captured a lot of Spire reactors and is experimenting to harness their power in cloaked research laboratories. There are also some hidden spire relics scattered about the galaxy from past battles. If you assist the Fallen Spire in their vengeance, it will lead to an epic confrontation with the AI.
column2: 尖塔族是岩石/晶体生物，它们以能量为食，在有足够能量的情况下能够快速生长和繁殖，因此解放那些反应堆将使它们能够迅速建造城市和战舰。每个建筑或战舰都是一个活生生的尖塔族个体——就像泽尼斯人的傀儡一样，尖塔族是一种极其宏观的生命形式。  看来人工智能已经在他们的母星系攻击了尖塔族；他们可能会成为对抗人工智能的强大盟友！  人工智能已经捕获了大量尖塔族的反应堆，并正在秘密研究实验室中试验利用它们的能量。星系中还散落着一些过去战斗留下的尖塔族遗物。如果你帮助堕落的尖塔族复仇，将会引发与人工智能的一场史诗对决。

column1: The Spire themed units usually encountered during the Fallen Spire campaign, but also potentially as a foe.
column2: 通常在堕落尖塔战役中遇到的尖塔主题单位，也可能成为敌人。

column1: The Spymaster is an espionage expert and can provide recon of planets as far as four links away from its location. It has a powerful tachyon beam for decloaking hostiles on the gravity well it is summoned on. The Spymaster can only stay for a few minutes at a time, but it is accompanied by a handful of spies that will persist and can be given direct orders to relocate.
column2: 间谍大师是一位间谍专家，能够提供距离其所在位置多达四个链路远的行星的侦察情报。它拥有一门强大的超光速粒子束，可在其被召唤的引力井处揭露敌方隐形单位。间谍大师每次只能停留几分钟，但会有一群间谍随行，这些间谍会持续存在，并可以接受直接命令进行转移。

column1: The Srin Locusts swarm against the enemy! They do more damage as they get lower on health. When a locust is killed, it spawns a lesser locust.
column2: 斯克林蝗虫蜂拥攻击敌人！它们的生命值越低造成的伤害越高。蝗虫被击杀时会生成一只小型蝗虫。

column1: The Storm Rangers defend planets near their Starbase, wielding corrosive beams.
column2: 风暴游骑兵保卫其星站附近的行星，使用腐蚀光束。

column1: The TB-4 Torpedo Bomber is the Kaizers Marauders answer to anything the size of a heavy corvette or above. Their torpedoes are slow and short-ranged, but the seismic warhead resonates with the target structure and thus the larger the resonating body, the greater the damage.
column2: TB-4鱼雷轰炸机是凯泽掠夺者对重型护卫舰及以上尺寸所有物体的答案。其鱼雷缓慢且射程短，但地震飞弹与目标结构发生共振，共振体越大，伤害越大。

column1: The TR-89 Tachyon Raider has, despite its relatively recent addition to Kaizers Marauders forces, undergone a lot of design changes. Especially the tachyon array is top-secret in-development technology which allows this raider to saturate the entire planet with tachyon radiation, although at a slow rate. Development is under way for increasing its power, and that of the ablative weaponry brought to bear against the once cloaked enemies.
column2: TR-89快子突击者尽管相对较晚才加入凯泽掠夺者部队，但经历了大量设计变更。特别是快子阵列是绝密的在研技术，允许这艘突击者用快子辐射饱和整个行星，尽管速率较慢。正在开发以提升其功率，以及那些用于对抗曾经隐形敌人的烧蚀武器的威力。

column1: The TS-3 Torpedo Submarine was used studying Zenith technologies of changing state of matter. The result was a ship capable of 'diving' into multiphase to reload the magazines of an incredibly powerful torpedo launcher which can annihilate bigger targets at long range along with processing it using Goo. Its weakspot is when it dives into multiphase, as it can only use its point defense in this space and is vulnerable to any ship with similar capabilities.
column2: TS-3鱼雷潜艇用于研究天顶的物质状态变化技术。结果是一艘能够「潜入」多相态以重新装填极其强大鱼雷发射器弹舱的单位，可在远距离歼灭大型目标并用粘液进行处理。其弱点是当潜入多相态时，此时只能使用点防御，并对任何具有类似能力的单位脆弱。

column1: The Templar Burlust Dire Guardians defend planets near their Stronghold, doing more damage as its health decreases.
column2: 圣殿骑士布尔勒斯特恐狼守护者保卫其要塞附近的行星，生命值越低造成的伤害越高。

column1: The Templar Burlust Guardians defend planets near their Stronghold, doing more damage as their health decreases.
column2: 圣殿骑士布尔勒斯特守护者保卫其要塞附近的行星，生命值越低造成的伤害越高。

column1: The Templar Moon is equipped with various long range turrets.
column2: 圣殿骑士之月配备有各种远程炮塔。

column1: The Templar Star Dire Guardians defend planets near their Stronghold, wielding corrosive and paralyzing beams. They are fast, and take less damage when they arrive on a planet, letting them serve as your shock troops.

column1: The Zenith Aliens are a truly ancient race, who were the undisputed masters of most of our galaxy as recently as a few million years ago. Hundreds of thousands of years ago, however, their civilization crumbled, leaving a galaxy littered with the remnants of their past glory.  The exact cause of the destruction of the Zenith empire is not known to humanity at this time, but what is clear is that it did not completely obliterate all specimens of that race. Instead, it fragmented them and scattered them to the stars. Some ply trade with other species, organic or otherwise. Some simply roam around in an amoral state, Devouring things.  Most of what is left of the race are broken derelicts that humans have taken to calling 'golems,' which are largely... to the Zenith what an Android is to a human.  These golems share the shapes of their old masters, but not the independent thinking and free will.  There are occasional Dyson spheres left behind by the Zenith, but these are also more machine than organism.  All Zenith automatons include both mechanical and organic parts, and the Dyson spheres do include something that is bordering on sentience, but they were never meant to be independent actors.  They were not citizens.  They have no culture, no goals beyond the tasks that were assigned to them all those millennia ago.  Pockets of living Zenith are much more rare, but do exist.  The Zenith Trader offers no communication, but travels the cosmos plying wares for unknown reasons.  It is speculated to be sentient, but intensely private.  For now, it's impossible to know for sure.  The Dark Zenith are much more clearly sentient, and have also very evidently had a rough time of it.  They also seem disinclined for conversation, but their weaponry and construction and tactics is not the work of automatons.  The Zenith built some Nomad Planets, and the Zenith Miners devour planets to power their remorseless engines.  Untangling the history of the Zenith, if any remains, would likely be the work of generations.  For now we know a few things, but the sheer scope of what was lost -- and what remains but is hidden -- is almost unthinkable.  We do know that their citizens started out no larger than a large land vehicle, and then would grow over the course of decades to the bulk of a midsize starship.  Thanks to a unique biology that they constantly augmented with mechanical parts, they seem to be able to move in and out of atmosphere, and exist in vacuum, without issue.  Depending on what functions they wished to take on, citizens could shape themselves for many different purposes ranging from war to science or philosophy.
column2: 泽尼斯外星人是一个真正古老的种族，就在几百万年前，他们还是我们银河系大部分地区无可争议的主宰。然而，几十万年前，他们的文明崩溃了，只留下一个布满他们昔日辉煌遗迹的星系。  目前人类还不知道泽尼斯帝国毁灭的确切原因，但可以肯定的是，它并没有完全消灭这个种族的所有成员。相反，它将他们分散并散布到了各个行星。一些泽尼斯人与其他物种（有机或无机）进行贸易。一些则处于一种非道德的状态下四处游荡，吞噬一切。  这个种族剩下的大部分是被人类称为“傀儡”的废弃残骸，对泽尼斯人来说，这些“傀儡”在很大程度上就像人类的机器人一样。这些“傀儡”与他们的旧主人外形相似，但没有独立思考和自由意志。  泽尼斯人还留下了一些偶尔可见的戴森球，但这些也更像是机器而非生物体。所有泽尼斯人的自动装置都包含机械和有机部分，戴森球也包含一些接近有感知能力的东西，但它们从来都不是独立的行为体。它们不是公民。除了几千年前分配给它们的任务之外，它们没有文化，没有目标。  活着的泽尼斯人个体更为罕见，但确实存在。  泽尼斯商人不与外界交流，但却出于未知原因在宇宙中四处兜售商品。据推测它具有感知能力，但极其神秘。目前还无法确定。  黑暗泽尼斯人显然更具感知能力，而且显然经历了艰难的时期。他们似乎也不愿意交谈，但他们的武器装备、构造和战术并非自动装置所为。  泽尼斯人建造了一些游牧行星，泽尼斯矿工吞噬行星来为他们无情的引擎提供动力。  如果泽尼斯人的历史还有留存，解开它可能需要几代人的努力。目前我们只知道一些事情，但失去的——以及仍然存在但隐藏着的——的规模几乎难以想象。  我们确实知道，他们的公民最初并不比一辆大型陆地车辆大，然后在几十年的时间里会成长到中型星际飞船的规模。由于他们独特的生物学特性，并不断用机械部件进行强化，他们似乎能够在大气层内外移动，并且在真空中生存而不受影响。根据他们想要承担的功能，公民可以将自己塑造成从战争到科学或哲学等多种不同用途。

column1: The Zenith have long been thought to be a civilization entirely in ruins.  Their war machines and automatons litter our galaxy, but the few remaining living sentient citizens have long been thought to be either solitary, or almost-feral fragments.             Now something new is happening.  Citizens from multiple Zenith civilizations in their prime are being discovered.  Where did they come from, or where have they been?  The theory that seems most likely to be true -- as odd as this is to say -- is that these specimens are from adjacent universes in the multiverse.  The existence of the multiverse itself has been incontrovertibly established by scientists for centuries at this point, but this would be the first observed instance of anything passing between universes.  It is possible that there is another explanation, and that these new Zenith have been hiding in plain sight in our galaxy for some unknown reason.  But these seem to be small parts of far grander empires that still exist, and so the simplest explanation is -- oddly -- to look to the multiverse.
column2: 长期以来，人们一直认为泽尼斯文明已完全毁灭。他们的战争机器和自动装置遍布我们的星系，但为数不多的幸存的有感知能力的公民长期以来被认为要么是独居的，要么是近乎野蛮的零散个体。             现在有新的情况发生了。来自多个鼎盛时期的泽尼斯文明的公民被发现了。他们从哪里来，或者他们一直藏在哪里？  最有可能正确的理论——尽管说出来很奇怪——是这些个体来自多元宇宙中的相邻宇宙。到目前为止，科学家们已经无可争议地证实了多元宇宙的存在，但这将是首次观察到有东西在不同宇宙之间穿梭。  也有可能存在另一种解释，这些新出现的泽尼斯人出于某种未知原因一直隐藏在我们星系的眼皮底下。但这些似乎只是仍然存在的更庞大帝国的一小部分，所以最简单的解释——奇怪的是——就是将目光投向多元宇宙。

column1: The Zenith represent the absolute height of galactic civilizations... but unfortunately for them, they died out a few billion years before humanity came to exist.  In the multiverse, there are no universes where the active Zenith Empire exists and humanity still exists; we only were able to evolve in universes where their empire fell.
column2: 天顶族代表了银河系文明的巅峰……但不幸的是，在人类出现的几十亿年前，他们就已经灭绝了。在多元宇宙中，不存在天顶帝国仍然活跃且人类也存在的宇宙；我们只能在他们的帝国衰落的宇宙中进化。

column1: The ability to log all sorts of things about the network to your disk if there are problems happening.
column2: 记录网络相关的各种日志，用于排查问题。

column1: The ability to manipulate gravity is as old as the mid-21st century, but application has changed drastically over time. Recently the technology was successfully miniaturized enough to fit on Corvette-sized ships. Best used to cut off escapes, spreading out to cover as much area as possible these ships can be instrumental to stop enemy fleets from moving around.
column2: 操控引力的能力与21世纪中期一样古老，但其应用随着时间的推移发生了巨大变化。最近该技术成功小型化到足以安装在护卫舰级单位上。最适合用于切断退路，分散覆盖尽可能大的区域，这些单位对于阻止敌方舰队移动至关重要。

column1: The all-sniper mix of choice for a siege enthusiast who wants to kill everything without moving from where they stand. Just don't expect the gravitic station to single-handedly stop attempts to blow up or snipe your artillery site. Picking the same starting battlestation twice will randomize the second one.
column2: 对于想要在原地消灭一切的攻城爱好者来说，这是全狙击组合的首选。不过别指望引力空间站能单枪匹马阻止敌人炸毁或狙击你的火炮阵地。 如果两次选择相同的起始战斗空间站，第二个将随机化。

column2: 升级单位线时对玩家造成的AIP数量。升级始终消耗指挥频率带宽以及AIP、科技或入侵点数之一。

column2: 对抗死灵法师的奈因祖尔长老始终与AI结盟。

column1: The antimatter particle to hydrogen, consiting out of a positron (anti-electron) orbiting anti-proton. Completely annihilates into pure energy when combined with normal hydrogen, perfect for energy production and weapons.
column2: 氢的反物质粒子，由正电子（反电子）绕反质子构成。与普通氢结合时完全湮灭为纯能量，极适合用于能源生产和武器。

column1: The aptly named Trojan Horse is a captured and retrofitted astrotrain, able to hide in plain sight in AI territory while gathering scout intel of neighboring planets. After five minutes, the Trojan Horse draws attention to itself. Upon destruction it releases special 'Hoplite Drones' that have exceptional ambush bonuses, masterfully seizing the element of surprise.
column2: 名副其实的特洛伊木马是一艘被俘获并改装过的星际列车，能够在AI领土上明目张胆地隐藏起来，同时收集邻近行星的侦察情报。五分钟后，特洛伊木马会吸引敌人的注意。在被摧毁时，它会释放出特殊的“重甲步兵无人机”，这些无人机拥有出色的伏击加成，能巧妙地抓住突袭时机。

column1: The archetypal Youngling, the Hornet has always been the mainstay of Neinzul Youngling combat swarms.  Designed for relentless mass production, the Hornet is barely more than an ultra-capacitor with an engine and kinetic weapon strapped on.  Cheap, fast, and effective against most targets.  Totally unarmored, however, and the kinetic weaponry lacks the penetrating power for large targets.
column2: 作为典型的幼体，黄蜂一直是内因祖尔幼体战斗群的主力。它专为大规模生产而设计，不过是一个绑着引擎和动能武器的超电容器。廉价、快速，对大多数目标都有效。然而，它完全没有装甲，而且动能武器对大型目标缺乏穿透力。

column2: 联邦的支柱，减缓其行星上的敌人并提供宝贵的反隐形能力，但本身较脆弱。

column1: The bloom effect during battle is what makes shots and engines look like shots and engines, or a Dyson sphere look like it truly has a sun inside it. column1: The compositions of waves that the AI sends against you is based on the planet that is the source of the wave. Each AI planet has a preferred set of units it likes to use.
column2: AI 向你发动的波次攻击的构成取决于波次来源行星。每个 AI 行星都有自己喜欢使用的一组单位。例如，有些行星可能更喜欢派出大量炮塔，而其他行星可能更喜欢派出大量单位。理解波次构成有助于你更好地抵御 AI 的攻击。            你可以通过观察 AI 向你发动的波次来了解波次构成。你也可以使用侧边栏的情报选项卡获取更多关于 AI 行星及其可能派出的单位的信息。一旦你了解了波次构成，就可以相应地调整防御。例如，如果你知道某个行星可能会派出大量炮塔，你就可以在自己的行星上建造更多反炮塔防御设施。

column1: The eldritch Chromatic Horror spire wanders the galaxy seemingly at random, knocking anything it shoots with its Spacetime Lens to a random spot in the gravity well and burning up smaller craft.  It can be killed... but it will simply return, motives as inscrutable as ever.  Additionally, if there are any ceasefires on a given planet it visits, the ceasefire is nullified so long as the Horror is present.  <color=#f25e1c>MEDIUM IMPACT:</color> This faction does not expand, and does not do irreparable damage... unless it happens to move something critical into a vulnerable spot.  It can cause wild swings in defensibility when it comes through a planet. Having all of your turrets on planet moved around can be a major challenge.
column2: 神秘的多彩恐惧尖塔似乎在银河系中随机游荡，用时空透镜将射击到的任何东西传送到引力井中的随机位置，并烧毁较小的飞船。它可以被消灭……但它会再次出现，动机一如既往地难以捉摸。  此外，如果它访问的行星上存在停火协议，只要恐惧尖塔存在，停火协议就会失效。  <color=#f25e1c>中等影响:</color> 这个派系不会扩张，也不会造成无法挽回的破坏……除非它碰巧将关键的东西移动到易受攻击的位置。当它经过一个行星时，可能会导致该行星的防御能力发生巨大变化。将你行星上的所有炮塔都移动位置可能是一个巨大的挑战。

column2: 这座神秘的彩色恐怖尖塔似乎在银河系中随机游荡，用它的时空透镜将射击到的任何东西传送到引力井中的随机位置，并烧毁较小的飞船。它可以被摧毁……但它会再次出现，动机一如既往地难以捉摸。  此外，如果它访问的行星上存在停火协议，只要恐怖尖塔存在，停火协议就会失效。  <color=#f25e1c>中度影响：</color> 这个派系不会扩张，也不会造成不可挽回的破坏……除非它碰巧将关键物品移动到易受攻击的位置。当它经过一个行星时，可能会导致该行星的防御能力发生巨大变化。让你行星上的所有炮塔都被移动可能是一个重大挑战。

column1: The elementary structure of Saronite is unknown even today. It can only be transmuted by someone with enough wrath, and any projectile forged with it will seek out the target of said wrath even over incredible distance. The Civilian Industry can use this material to create Artillery-tech ships and turrets.
column2: 萨罗奈特的基本结构至今未知。它只能被怀有足够愤怒之人转化，任何用其锻造的弹丸都会寻找愤怒所指的目标，即使跨越不可思议的距离。民用工业可用此材料制造炮兵科技单位和炮塔。

column1: The elite of the elite. The Thoraxian Hunter/Killer chases down singular targets to their death, dragging them and any ships unfortunate enough to be near them out of formation to be destroyed in isolation.
column2: 精英中的精英。索拉克斯猎杀者追杀单个目标至死，将目标及任何不幸靠近它们的单位拖出阵型，在孤立中摧毁。

column1: The exposed core of Exodian Blade... It's completely useless and beyond saving now; can't be repaired, scrapped, or damaged; but the shattered core created a giant Gravitic Vortex, slowing all passing enemy ships down, creating powerful Tachyon emissions that reveal all cloaked enemies, while it's still working sensors give us vision of the system it's at.     'I'm sorry... That was all I could do...'
column2: 灭世之刃裸露的核心……现已完全无用且无法挽救；无法修复、废弃或损坏；但破碎的核心形成了一个巨大的引力漩涡，减缓所有经过的敌舰速度，产生强大的超子发射揭示所有隐形敌人，同时仍在工作的传感器为我们提供所在系统的视野。     "对不起……我只能做到这些了……"

column1: The fearsome Orgesh wields a powerful knockback weapon.
column2: 可怕的奥格什使用强力击退武器。
