column1: The first game ALWAYS had two AIs for you to face off against.  This gave you two homeworlds to assault, and also gave you some variance in how the two AIs each acted.  There were a lot of different AI types.          The sequel is... well, it's different in general.  Each individual AI now already makes each of its planets way more specialized than the first game ever did.  So expect each planet to have a bunch of surprises.  There are still a lot of AI types, but not so many focused around using specialized ship types.  They're more behavior-oriented only, because ALL the AI types now use more ships in more ways throughout the galaxy.  With that in mind, you don't really have to have two AIs to have a good time.  If you want two homeworld assaults, then sure you need that (and can easily add that).  If you want three or five or 10 AIs, you can also set that up, too.  The default is just one AI, using the 'Full Ensemble' AI type, which uses the default AI tactics and strategy but a huge variety of ships and their attendant sub-strategies.  That's a good place to start on your first few campaigns.
column2: 前作总是让你对抗2个AI，这意味着需要进攻2个母星，同时2个AI的行为方式也有所不同。前作有多种AI类型。          本作则完全不同。现在每个AI都会让它的每个行星比前作更加专业化。所以每个行星都可能带来各种意外。  虽然仍有多种AI类型，但不再专注于使用特定单位类型。它们更偏向行为导向，因为所有AI类型现在都会在整个星系中以更多方式使用更多单位。  因此，你不必非要设置2个AI才能获得良好体验。如果想要进攻2个母星，当然可以轻松添加(第二个AI)。如果想设置3个、5个甚至10个AI也都可以。  默认设置是1个AI，使用'完整编队'AI类型，它采用默认AI战术和策略，但会使用大量不同单位及其配套子策略。这是开始前几次战役的好选择。

column1: The first game basically had scouting as a minigame of sorts, but it wasn't a particularly fun one.  Most people automated it with just sending lots of scouts out on paths that they defined, and they hoped for the best and tried again later with higher-level scouts or more scouts if they couldn't get through some part.          It was possible, and in some ways optimal, to dawdle around at the start of the game and just focus on scouting everything, and then start really going out into the galaxy only after you had perfect knowledge of it.  This was really suboptimal for a lot of reasons (including it not being fun, and including it kind of ruining any sense of discovery as you go).  We tried a number of different methods for scouting in this sequel, but what we settled on was basically the intended flow: as you capture planets, it auto-scouts a certain number around the periphery of your known space.  This makes it so that you're constantly learning more about the map as you play, and so that you have to make decisions based on incomplete information early in the game.  You can't just grind the scouting in an un-fun way to play more optimally.  There is a way to send spy nanites (via hacking) to any planet if you just absolutely want to see what is there, and/or have permanent vision of that planet (like placing a scout picket in the prior game).  But now that's all handled through the Hacking tab of the sidebar when you click around planets on the galaxy map, versus you having to fiddle with units in a really micro-manage-y sort of way.
column2: 前作将侦察设计为一种小游戏，但并不有趣。大多数人只是自动派出大量侦察兵沿预定路线探索，如果某些区域无法通过，就稍后用更高级或更多侦察兵再试。          理论上可以在游戏初期专注于侦察一切，获得完整星系情报后再行动，但这既无趣又破坏了探索感，从多方面看都不是最优策略。  我们在本作尝试了多种侦察方案，最终确定了理想流程：占领行星时会自动侦察周边一定数量的未知区域。这样你会在游戏过程中不断了解地图，早期必须基于不完整信息做决策。无法再通过枯燥的侦察来优化游戏体验。  如果确实需要查看某个行星或获得永久视野(类似前作的侦察哨站)，可以通过入侵手段发送间谍纳米虫。现在这些操作都在银河地图的行星入侵标签页中完成，不再需要繁琐的单位微操。

column1: The first game had a variety of 'minor factions' that you could turn on for some interesting extra flavor and extra activity.  But the engine wasn't really built around that sort of thing, so they were kind of limited in what they could do.          This sequel has no such restriction, and the factions in this game are fully-fledged and in some cases just as capable of taking over the galaxy as the AI or you are.  If you were always wanting more of a battle royale type situation, where many independent alien groups are all trying to meet their own agenda and causing chaos as they go, then turning on the Nanocaust and the Macrophage is a good place to start.  The game flow can be absolutely completely different from what you're used to.
column2: 前作有多种'次要阵营'可以开启，增加趣味性和活动性。但由于引擎限制，它们的功能相当有限。          本作没有这种限制，游戏中的派系都是完全成熟的，有些甚至和AI或玩家一样有能力接管整个星系。  如果你一直想要更接近'大逃杀'的体验，让多个独立外星派系各自为政并制造混乱，那么开启纳米浩劫和巨噬体是个好开始。游戏流程可能与你习惯的完全不同。

column1: The first game had just a global ship cap (for most ships) and a per-planet ship cap (for turrets) that you could build from.  Those are gone.          Now there are various fleets, which might be 'the fleet for a planet' (equivalent to the old per-planet ship cap), or which might be offensive strike groups with either a strong (officer) flagship or a transport at the center.  This helps organizationally, but also has many other benefits that you'll notice as you play.  Essentially this lets you manage multiple fronts far more easily, and has a number of ways of discouraging 'fleetballing.'  It also lets you have interesting forces that you choose where to deploy as a unit, versus trying to micro all the small things.  This actually cuts out a lot of the small logistical wrangling that the first game had, where you had things like rally points and whatnot.  Now your factories (formerly space docks) simply build ships that appear at fleets that are near them.  You have a lot more choice in terms of where you deploy things, and you have far more ships than in the first game as well as a larger variety of ships, but the basics are far more streamlined to let you focus on the big picture.
column2: 前作只有全局单位上限(大多数单位)和单行星单位上限(炮塔)，这些现在都已取消。          现在有各种舰队，可能是'行星舰队'(相当于旧的单行星上限)，也可能是以强力(军官)旗舰或运输舰为核心的进攻打击群。  这不仅有助于组织管理，玩的时候你还会发现许多其他好处。本质上它让你更容易管理多战线作战，并有多种方式避免'舰队抱团'。还能让你以编队形式部署有趣的力量，而不用微操每个小单位。  这实际上消除了前作中许多繁琐的后勤操作，比如设置集结点等。现在你的工厂(原太空船坞)建造的单位会直接出现在附近的舰队中。  你在部署位置上有更多选择，单位数量和种类也远超前作，但基础操作更加精简，让你能专注于大局。

column1: The first game let you make arbitrary groups of units called 'control groups,' which is pretty common in strategy games, and was really important because you otherwise just had one big lump of ships.          This game has all of your units already organized into fleets, and your offensive-oriented ones are assigned to hotkeys (like control groups were) as you capture them.  However, you can go into the fleet management screen (Fleets tab on the sidebar) and change which fleet(s) use which of the 10 number keys.  Multiple fleets can share a single number, so that you automatically select multiple fleets just by hitting one key.  Very useful if you always use those ones together.  Fleets are meant to be used as a group, and choosing the right fleet for the location is a big part of the sequel.  Partly because of all these changes, you get access to a lot more fleets, so you can afford to let some hang back and do less during certain offensives.  You shouldn't have to 'fleetball' every time you attack an enemy planet (and in fact, the Hunter Fleet of the AI may exploit your distraction if you do so and come destroy you).  The first game was smaller and had more of an emphasis on individual ships, while the sequel is larger and has an emphasis on how to use larger groups of ships over a wider area than before.
column2: 前作允许你创建称为'控制组'的任意单位编组，这在策略游戏中很常见，也很重要，因为否则你只能操作一大群单位。          本作中所有单位都已编入舰队，进攻型舰队在占领时会自动分配热键(就像控制组一样)。  不过你可以进入舰队管理界面(边栏的舰队标签页)更改哪些舰队使用哪个数字键(1-10)。多个舰队可以共享同一个数字键，这样按一个键就能自动选择多支舰队。如果你经常一起使用某些舰队，这会非常方便。  舰队设计为编队使用，为不同战场选择合适的舰队是本作的重要战术。由于这些变化，你现在可以指挥更多舰队，因此某些攻势中可以保留部分舰队按兵不动。不必每次攻击敌方行星都'舰队抱团'(事实上，如果你这样做，AI的猎人舰队可能会趁虚而入摧毁你)。  前作规模较小，更注重单舰操作，而本作规模更大，更注重如何在更广阔区域运用大规模舰队作战。

column1: The first game made it really hard for you to get mark 4 and mark 5 ships, making you get things like advanced factories, core fabricators, etc.          In this sequel, those sorts of capturables don't exist.  Instead you capture fleets, and those have a variety of new ships in them, which you can upgrade through a combination of spending science (at the Tech sidebar tab), and having fleets level up by spending direct science on their fleet sidebar tab.  In other words, it's far easier for you to get all the way to mark 7, although diversifying your research has its benefits as ship lines above mark 4 have diminishing returns.  There are loads of capturables, but the highest marks aren't gated off like they were in the first game.  That just didn't feel right in our testing in this game.  The AI itself uses mark 7 homeworlds instead of mark 5, and you'll need to upgrade yourself far more in order to take them on.  Basically, the way that you upgrade yourself is different in this game, but you have just as many things to capture and upgrade -- more, really, considering the procedural nature of fleets you capture and some of the other goodies out there...
column2: 前作中要获得4级和5级单位非常困难，需要获取高级工厂、核心制造机等设施。          在本作中，这类可占领设施已不存在。取而代之的是占领舰队，这些舰队包含各种新型单位，你可以通过两种方式升级：在科技边栏标签花费科技点数，或直接在舰队边栏标签花费科技点数提升舰队等级。  换句话说，现在更容易将单位提升到7级，尽管4级以上单位的研究收益会递减。虽然仍有大量可占领物，但最高等级不再像前作那样设限。我们在测试中发现那样的设定不适合本作。  AI本身使用7级母星而非5级，你需要更多升级才能与之对抗。基本上，本作中的升级方式不同了，但可占领和升级的内容一样多——考虑到占领舰队的程序化生成和其他好东西，实际上可能更多...

column1: The first game required you to manage build queues to get specific numbers of units at specific parts of the galaxy.          Now that things are organized by fleets, each fleet has a specific cap of each type of ship in the fleet, and if it's within 1 planet of a factory, then any factories will automatically simultaneously build for that fleet, all at once (no queue, it's all just divided out evenly).  The idea is to make it vastly quicker for you to 're-fleet' and in general to just get your fleets up to full strength, but you can also turn off specific units from building, or an entire fleet, from the fleet management screen (on the Fleets tab on the sidebar).
column2: 前作需要你管理建造队列，在星系特定位置生产特定数量的单位。          现在所有单位都按舰队组织，每个舰队有各类单位的特定上限，如果舰队在工厂1个行星范围内，所有工厂会自动同时为该舰队建造单位(无需队列，所有建造任务会平均分配)。  这样设计的目的是让你能更快'重建舰队'，快速恢复舰队满编状态。你也可以在舰队管理界面(边栏的舰队标签页)中关闭特定单位或整个舰队的自动建造功能。

column1: The first unmanned trips to other dimensions were less than encouraging. Space and often time became imprecise and blurred, leaving scientists wondering whether their probe was destroyed or would simply reappear at some point in the future (though only the future, never the past). Now that it's been perfected the experimental interdimensional bomber can strike beyond most lines of defense, directly at the target.
column2: 第一次前往其他维度的无人旅行并不令人鼓舞。空间和时间变得不精确和模糊，使科学家们想知道他们的探测器是被摧毁了还是仅仅会在未来的某个时间点重新出现（尽管只有未来，永远不会是过去）。现在它已经完善，实验性跨维度轰炸机可以打击大多数防御线之外，直接攻击目标。

column1: The following options are available for fullscreen resolutions, based on a combination of what your monitor reports as possible and what are common resolutions.
column2: 根据显示器支持的常见分辨率组合提供的全屏分辨率选项。

column1: The galaxy has two large clusters, separated by a single connection.
column2: 银河有两个大的星团，由一条单独的连接分开。

column1: The galaxy is being invaded by a stronger variant of enormous biological Macrophages. They prey on the AI alongside regular Macrophages for metal, and will try to eat your ships, too.  <color=#f25e1c> HIGH IMPACT:</color> This faction expands, although in a different manner than their original counterparts, and typically doesn't do irreparable damage early on. Although a bit slow in the beginning, it becomes stronger over time, and can become very impactful. The more fighting there is the stronger you can expect this faction to become, so long the scales aren't completely overwhelming. Playstyle wise, they are a defensive juggernaut, whereas their offensive capabilities remain limited due to their unintelligent wandering.
column2: 银河系正被一种更强大的巨大生物巨噬细胞变体入侵。它们与普通巨噬细胞一样以 AI 为食获取金属，也会试图吞噬您的单位。  <color=#f25e1c>高影响：</color>该派系会扩张，尽管方式与原始版本不同，并且通常不会在早期造成不可挽回的损害。虽然一开始有点慢，但随着时间的推移会变得更强，并且可能变得非常有影响力。战斗越多，该派系就会变得越强大，只要局势不完全一边倒。 从游戏风格来看，它们是防御型巨兽，而它们的进攻能力由于无智能的游荡而仍然有限。

column1: The galaxy is being invaded by enormous biological Macrophages. They prey on the AI for metal, and will try to eat your ships, too.       <color=#f25e1c>LOW IMPACT:</color> This faction plays differently; being capable of expanding, but not in a traditional manner. Depending on their start, they can be extremely strong, or a bit more low impact. Setting this equal to AI main difficulty plus between 0 and 2 is good.
column2: 银河系正被巨大的生物巨噬细胞入侵。它们以AI的金属为食，也会试图吞噬你的飞船。       <color=#f25e1c>低影响:</color> 这个派系玩法不同；能够扩张，但不是传统方式。根据初始条件，它们可能极其强大，也可能影响较小。 设置为AI主要难度加0到2比较合适。

column1: The galaxy is being invaded by the Azaran Empire. They are a highly centralized empire bringing their own planet into the galaxy from which they will produce ships to take over planets and build structures to bolster their production.  <color=#f25e1c>VARIABLE IMPACT:</color> Depending on the intensity and invasion time the impact of the faction will be vary greatly. For example an immediate invasion, intensity 10 will be around the realms of High Impact to Extremely High impact, while a having the invasion later could turn it into a complete flop. Here's what you can expect overall : They will be relativaly weak at the beginning, and struggle to expand but given enough time their facilities will provide ample production to take over the galaxy. Their homeworld will be a vast planet able to house countless facilities, even without much territory they could still be a menace!
column2: 阿扎兰帝国正在入侵银河系。它们是一个高度集权的帝国，将自己的行星带入银河系，从那里生产单位来占领行星并建造建筑以增强其生产能力。  <color=#f25e1c>影响可变：</color>根据强度和入侵时间，该派系的影响将大不相同。例如，立即入侵、强度10将在高影响到极高影响之间，而较晚入侵则可能使其完全失败。以下是总体预期： 它们一开始相对较弱，扩张困难，但只要有足够的时间，它们的设施将提供充足的生产力来接管银河系。它们的母星将是一个巨大的行星，能够容纳无数设施，即使没有太多领土，它们仍可能构成威胁！

column1: The game automatically pauses at certain points.  How would you like that to behave?
column2: 游戏会在特定情况下自动暂停。您可以调整此行为。

column1: The game autosaves on various intervals, and keeps a certain number of them, etc.
column2: 游戏会定期自动保存，并保留一定数量的存档。

column1: The game can only be won if all hostile AIs are defeated by killing all Overlords.
column2: 只有当所有敌对AI通过消灭所有霸主被击败时，游戏才能获胜。

column1: The game can only be won when all hostile minor factions have been defeated. The individual conditions that must be met so a faction is classified as 'defeated' or 'suppressed', i.e. Marauders must own no more ships and structures at all. Note that some factions such as the Devourer Golem are by their very nature not considered at all because they cannot truly be defeated by anyone and thus do not ever count.
column2: 只有当所有敌对小派系被击败时，游戏才能获胜。必须满足将派系归类为'被击败'或'被压制'的各项条件，例如掠夺者必须不再拥有任何船只和结构。 请注意，某些派系如吞噬者巨像由于其本质无法被任何人真正击败，因此不被考虑在内。

column1: The game can only be won when the homeworlds of all players are free of enemies.
column2: 只有当所有玩家的母星世界都没有敌人时，游戏才能获胜。

column1: The game gives you various tips in the sidebar as you play.  These really are a good idea to keep on unless you are quite good at the game.
column2: 游戏会在侧边栏显示各种提示。除非您已经很熟悉游戏，否则建议保持开启。

column1: The game has a few features in place to make sure that you don't accidentally expend resources in cases where that might be likely.  This section allows you to turn those safeties off.
column2: 游戏提供了一些防止意外消耗资源的安全措施。您可以在此关闭这些保护。

column1: The game is completely playable in an icon-only format, if you wish to do so.  For ultra low-specs machines, turning off ship models is a way to take most of the load off the GPU.  You can also gain some performance by turning off certain models but not others.             If you are below the minimum system requirements, this can actually let you play the game at full speed.  If you restart the program with this enabled, then it won't even bother loading these ships into RAM, thus even further lowering the requirements (and making loading faster if you're on a really old machine).
column2: 游戏可以完全以图标模式运行。对于低配机器，关闭单位模型可以大幅降低GPU负载。您也可以选择性地关闭某些模型来提升性能。             如果您的配置低于最低系统要求，启用此选项可以让游戏全速运行。如果重启游戏时启用此选项，游戏甚至不会将这些单位加载到内存中，从而进一步降低需求(在老旧机器上也能加快加载速度)。

column1: The game is going to normally restrict you to 120 planets.  If you want to use a higher count, you can enable this option.  However, the performance is likely to be quite poor, even on very strong machines.               There are some throughput limitations that make this simulation run badly in the midgame at 180 planets even on the latest hardware as of 2021.  It's possible that you're running this much further into the future, in which case... see what happens?  Honestly, the primary game experience is based around 80-100 planets anyhow, and there should be enough room even if you have quite a number of factions or a lot of people in multiplayer.
column2: 游戏通常会限制您使用120个行星。如果想使用更多行星，可以启用此选项。但即使是在非常强大的机器上，性能也可能相当糟糕。  由于一些吞吐量限制，即使在2021年的最新硬件上，180个行星的模拟在游戏中期也会运行不佳。如果您运行的游戏规模更大...那就只能看情况了。  说实话，主要游戏体验是基于80-100个行星设计的，即使您有很多派系或多人在线，这个范围也足够使用。

column1: The game sometimes gives you warnings about situations.  This lets you adjust those
column2: 调整游戏在特定情况下显示的警告信息。

column1: The game will attempt to play more exciting, up-tempo tracks when you are in a battle, and more peaceful tracks otherwise. This is best used when also playing Classic tracks, since otherwise you may wind up with a limited set of music.
column2: 游戏会根据战斗状态播放更激动人心的快节奏曲目，非战斗状态则播放更平和的曲目。最好与经典曲目选项一起使用，否则可能会限制可用的音乐种类。

column1: The home ground of the terrifying Necromancer. If this structure is destroyed, one of your other Necropoleis will turn into your Phylactery at the cost of some Essence.  If this is not possible, then you are defeated.
column2: 恐怖的死灵法师的大本营。如果这个建筑被摧毁，你的其他墓地之一将以消耗一些精华的代价变成你的魂匣。如果无法做到这一点，那么你就失败了。

column1: The home ground of the terrifying Necromancer. If this structure is destroyed, one of your other Necropoleis will turn into your Phylactery at the cost of some Essence.  If this is not possible, then you are defeated.   The Necromancer commands armies of undead ships, and can build even more powerful ships here. Undead minions attrition more slowly at a Necropolis.  A Necropolis builds ships its major ships slowly; to build them more quickly you'll need a shipyard. As you mark up the Necropolis you will be able to build some new structures.
column2: 恐怖的死灵法师的大本营。如果这个建筑被摧毁，你的其他墓地之一将以消耗一些精华的代价变成你的魂匣。如果无法做到这一点，那么你就失败了。  死灵法师指挥着不死战舰大军，并且可以在这里建造更强大的战舰。不死爪牙在墓地的损耗速度会更慢。  墓地建造主要战舰的速度较慢；若要更快地建造它们，你需要一个造船厂。随着你提升墓地的等级，你将能够建造一些新的建筑。

column1: The home ground of the terrifying Necromancer. This structure will be crippled if it takes fatal damage, but the Necromancer lives and dies with their allies.  The Necromancer commands armies of undead ships, and can build even more powerful ships here. Undead minions attrition more slowly at a Necropolis or Phylactery.  A phylactery builds ships its major ships slowly; to build them more quickly you'll need a shipyard. As you mark up the phylactery you will be able to build some new structures.
column2: 恐怖的死灵法师的大本营。如果这个建筑受到致命伤害，它将陷入瘫痪，但死灵法师与他们的盟友共存亡。  死灵法师指挥着不死战舰大军，并且可以在这里建造更强大的战舰。不死爪牙在墓地或魂匣处的损耗速度会更慢。魂匣建造主要战舰的速度较慢；若要更快地建造它们，你需要一个造船厂。随着你提升魂匣的等级，你将能够建造一些新的建筑。

column1: The home of the Heavenly Realms' invasion in this galaxy.
column2: 天堂领域在此银河系中入侵的大本营。

column1: The host will need to give you their Public IP Address, which they can find in the game (in the lobby, or in the escape menu).  If you are playing across a LAN or VPN, they will need to give you one of their Local IP Addresses, which they can also find in the same places.  It's fine if some clients connect via Local IP and others connect via public IP.
column2: 主机需要给您他们的公共IP地址，他们可以在游戏中（在大厅或退出菜单中）找到该地址。  如果您在局域网或VPN中玩游戏，他们需要给您他们的本地IP地址之一，他们也可以在相同的位置找到该地址。  一些客户端通过本地IP连接，而其他客户端通过公共IP连接是可以的。

column1: The hull points of a standard sized line of this ship.
column2: 该单位标准队列的船体点数。

column1: The intensity for your scourge allies.

The larger the number, the more of a break the network host takes between giving bulk data about updated planets, factions, fleets, etc to clients.  This can dramatically lower the bandwidth requirements of the game, but can also make it take longer for errors to self-correct.             This doesn't really have an effect on units themselves, which are synced in a parallel process, so the bulk of things will be fine.  Default is 2, but you can push it a bit higher without many issues if your bandwidth is that high.
column2: 数值越大，主机在向客户端批量发送更新数据(行星、派系、舰队等)之间的间隔越长。这可以显著降低游戏带宽需求，但也会使错误自我纠正所需时间更长。  这不会影响单位本身的同步(它们是并行处理的)，所以主要内容不会有问题。默认值为2，但如果您的带宽允许，可以适当提高这个数值。

column1: The larger the number, the more of a break the network host takes between giving every-sim-frame sync data about things like faction data.  This can moderately lower the bandwidth requirements of the game, but can also make the client see a slightly delayed view of certain central numbers.             This doesn't really have an effect on units themselves, which are synced in a parallel process, so the bulk of things will be fine.  Default is 4, and it's probably okay to go a bit higher if you must.  When it 'skips' one of these cycles, it still sends the human-player faction info, so that critical part happens no matter what.
column2: 数值越大，主机在每个模拟帧之间同步核心数据(如派系数据)的间隔越长。这可以适度降低游戏带宽需求，但也会使客户端看到某些核心数据的延迟视图。  这不会影响单位本身的同步(它们是并行处理的)，所以主要内容不会有问题。默认值为4，必要时可以适当提高。即使跳过某些同步周期，仍会发送人类玩家派系信息，确保这部分关键内容始终同步。

column1: The largest vessels the AI will even send to the Milky Way in response to large threats. Some will be difficult to ever see.
column2: 人工智能为应对重大威胁而派往银河系的最大型战舰。有些战舰可能很难见到。

column1: The last Hydral has arrived in the galaxy, and is not pleased by what they have seen. They will attempt to slowly take over the galaxy in an attempt to shut down all wormhole connections and bring about a forced peace.  The Hydral has no desire for diplomatic relations with either Humanity or the AI due to their bloodthirsty past, and will stop at nothing to bring their so called 'peace' to this galaxy.  The Hydral cannot ever truly be stopped. By means our scientists have best described as 'Time Travel Bullshit,' any attempts to kill their Flagship simply result in it respawning elsewhere.  <color=#f25e1c>HIGH IMPACT:</color> This faction is a sort of ticking time bomb. It is capable of converting practically everything it kills to its own use, and will rapidly spiral out of control if left unattended. Its end goal? Shutting down the galaxy, and stopping all war. It will bring its tremendous powers to slowly shut down the galaxy, one planet at a time, by PERMANENTLY destroying wormholes.  As the Hydral Federation takes over AI planets, they will convert any and all AI Structures into factories to produce Federation units. They additionally passively construct these factories around metal generators on their planets.
column2: 最后的海德拉已抵达银河系，并对所见所闻感到不悦。他们将试图慢慢接管银河系以关闭所有虫洞连接，带来强制和平。  海德拉因人类和AI嗜血的过去而对两者毫无外交兴趣，将不惜一切代价将他们所谓的'peace'带到这个银河系。  海德拉永远无法被真正阻止。通过我们科学家最好描述为'Time Travel Bullshit,'的方式，任何杀死其旗舰的尝试都只会导致它在别处重生。  <color=#f25e1c>高影响：</color> 这个派系就像一颗定时炸弹。它能够将几乎一切它杀死的转化为己用，如果放任不管将迅速失控。它的最终目标？关闭银河系，停止所有战争。它将用其巨大力量通过永久摧毁虫洞来慢慢关闭银河系，一次一个行星。  当海德拉联邦接管AI行星时，他们会将所有AI建筑转化为工厂以生产联邦单位。此外，他们还会在其行星上的金属发生器周围被动建造这些工厂。

column1: The leader of this group was stuck with nothing but grenade launcher ship and turret schematics. He took the only logical conclusion and built hundreds of them.
column2: 这个团体的领袖手头只有榴弹发射器飞船和炮塔的设计图。他得出了唯一合理的结论，制造了数百个这样的装备。

column1: The local HQ of Kaizers Marauders. Destroying it will briefly throw their forces into turmoil, it is however armed and armored quite well.
column2: 凯泽掠夺者的当地总部。摧毁它将短暂使他们的部队陷入混乱，但该建筑装备精良且装甲厚重。

column1: The local galaxy seems of little interest to the AI but it is not forgotten. In its place the Overlord sends these greater AI minds, Lieutenant Officers, the executors of its war and sword of the Overlord.
column2: 本地银河似乎不太引起AI的兴趣，但它并未被遗忘。取而代之的是，霸主派遣这些更高级的AI思维——副官级军官——作为其战争的执行者和霸主的利剑。

column1: The longer you hold on, the more you'll reduce (AIP), but you'll also cause a massive incursion of AI forces while doing it, some of which will head directly to your homeworld as an Exo-Galactic Strike. Careful not to kill yourself by holding on too long. You only get one shot at this hack before the AI adapts, so make it count.  The intensity of the response is increased by the number of human empires and Sidekicks present, so three human empires leads to 3x as strong a response.
column2: 您坚持的时间越长，减少的（AI 进度点数，AIP）就越多，但在此过程中也会引发 AI 部队的大规模入侵，其中一部分会以跨星系打击的形式直接前往您的母星。注意不要因坚持太久而自取灭亡。在 AI 适应之前，您只有一次尝试此破解的机会，所以要好好把握。响应的强度会随着人类帝国数量的增加而增强，因此三个人类帝国会导致三倍强度的反击。

column1: The longer you hold on, the more you'll reduce (AIP), but you'll also cause a massive incursion of AI forces while doing it, some of which will head directly to your homeworld as an Exo-Galactic Strike. Careful not to kill yourself by holding on too long. You only get one shot at this hack before the AI adapts, so make it count.  The intensity of the response is increased by the number of human empires present, so three human empires leads to 3x as strong a response.
column2: 你坚持得越久，就能减少越多的AIP，但同时也会引发AI部队的大规模入侵，其中一些会直接以河外打击的形式朝向你的母星。小心不要因为坚持太久而害死自己。你只有一次机会进行这次入侵，之后AI就会适应，所以要好好把握。响应的强度会随着人类帝国的数量增加而递增，因此三个人类帝国会导致3倍强度的响应。

column1: The loss scene will look very flat without this, but if you are having trouble with it, this is a way to disable it.
column2: 失败场景没有此效果会显得非常平淡，但如果您遇到问题，可以禁用此选项。

column1: The lower this is, the shorter a working list of targets each ship has; this keeps things moving more quickly, but if all their targets are exhausted, then they have to wait for a new targeting pass.  The higher this is, the more redundancy there is for if a lot of their targets die before the next targeting pass, but also the more CPU load there is.             The CPU load from calculating this negligible on any machine, but the CPU load of integrating the data into the main game exists on the host and all clients.  The default has been 25 for a super long time, but we have now lowered this to 15 as the default.
column2: 此值越低，每个单位的目标列表越短，这能保持处理速度，但如果所有目标都被消灭，单位需要等待新的目标计算周期。此值越高，在大量目标被消灭前提供更多冗余目标，但也会增加CPU负载。             在任何机器上计算此值的CPU负载都可以忽略不计，但将数据集成到主游戏的CPU负载存在于主机和所有客户端上。  默认值长期为25，但现在已降低到15作为新默认值。

column1: The lower this is, the slower ships are to react to firing at new targets that are in their range, but overall this is something that matters more in very huge games.  The higher this is, the faster the ships will react, but the more likely you are to have hitching in your gameplay if there are truly tons of ships all getting new orders all once.             The CPU load from calculating this is only on the host in multiplayer, but the CPU load of actually integrating the data into the main game exists on the host and all clients.  The default has been 500 for a super long time, but if you're in a very large game you might consider lowering this.
column2: 此值越低，单位对射程内新目标的反应越慢，但这在超大型游戏中更为重要。此值越高，单位反应越快，但如果大量单位同时获得新命令，游戏可能会出现卡顿。               在多玩家游戏中，计算负载仅由主机承担，但将数据集成到主游戏的负载由主机和所有客户端共同承担。    默认值500已经使用了很长时间，但在超大型游戏中你可能需要考虑降低此值。

column1: The main Reclaimers station, where ships are constructed.
column2: 回收者主站，单位在此建造。

column1: The main races are Human, Zenith, Spire, and Neinzul... but there are other aliens out there!
column2: 主要种族有人类、天顶星人、尖塔族和奈因祖尔族……但还有其他外星种族存在！

column1: The massive Dyson Sphere Golem exists at one of the AI planets, and is basically a massive fortress that will attack humans and AIs alike. However, if you free the planet from the AI, the sphere will realize your benign intent and will help you fight the AI on nearby planets. If you take the planet for yourself, the sphere will attack you until you give up the planet.       <color=#f25e1c>MEDIUM IMPACT:</color> This faction does not expand, and doesn't do any irreparable damage. It can be boosted to a level much higher than it starts, but can occasionally be a bit wimpy if it has a bad start.
column2: 巨大的戴森球傀儡存在于AI的一个行星上，本质上是一个巨大的堡垒，会同时攻击人类和AI。然而，如果你将行星从AI手中解放出来，戴森球会意识到你的善意，并会帮助你攻击附近行星上的AI。如果你自己占领了这个行星，戴森球会攻击你直到你放弃这个行星。       <color=#f25e1c>中等影响:</color> 这个派系不会扩张，也不会造成任何不可修复的损害。它可以被提升到比初始状态高得多的水平，但如果开局不利，有时可能会显得有点弱。

column1: The massive Dyson Sphere Golem has been antagonized by the AI and is going to attack you
column2: 巨大的戴森球傀儡已被AI激怒，将会攻击你

column1: The metal cost of a standard sized line of this ship.
column2: 该单位标准队列的金属成本。

column1: The most basic combat form. Does not yet exhibit the traits of the race used to construct it.
column2: 最基础的战斗形态。尚未展现出用于建造它的种族的特征。

column1: The most illustrious of mortals are promoted to be Prophets, and give counsel to the angels of various orders. Uses its own hull to regenerate allies and has a powerful paralysis beam, able to paralyse strikecraft alongside guardians.
column2: 最杰出的凡人被提升为先知，为各秩序的天使提供建议。使用自身船体再生盟友，并拥有强大的麻痹光束，能够麻痹打击飞行器和守护者。

column1: The most powerful of the skeletons. Raised from the grave by the skull pile, trapped on the planet to fight until death.
column2: 最强大的骷髅。由骷髅堆从坟墓中复活，被困在行星上战斗直至死亡。

column1: The nigh-indestructible Devourer Golem makes its way slowly around the galaxy, absorbing all of the mobile military forces it finds in order to power and repair itself.             Additionally, if there are any ceasefires on a given planet it visits, the ceasefire is nullified so long as the Devourer is present.       <color=#f25e1c>LOW IMPACT:</color> This faction does not expand, and doesn't do any irreparable damage. Can sometimes create massive shifts in a fight, however.
column2: 几乎不可摧毁的吞噬者傀儡在银河系中缓慢移动，吸收它发现的所有机动军事力量来为自己提供能量和修复。             此外，如果它访问的行星上有任何停火协议，只要吞噬者在场，停火协议就会失效。       <color=#f25e1c>低影响:</color> 这个派系不会扩张，也不会造成任何不可修复的损害。但有时会在战斗中造成巨大的局势转变。

column1: The normal stacking algorithm has a fixed number of squads per type per faction per planet that it aims for. With experimental stacking enabled, we instead count the number of ships of any type per faction per planet.
column2: 正常堆叠算法会为每个派系在每个行星上的每种单位类型设定固定数量的编队。启用实验性堆叠后，我们会改为计算每个派系在每个行星上的所有类型单位数量。

column1: The number of templar rifts to seed across the galaxy. If set to 0x rifts will instead spawn over time like vanilla necromancer.
column2: 在银河中预先分布的圣殿裂隙数量。若设为0x，裂隙将随时间生成（与原版死灵法师相同）。

column1: The payload of a Brutal EMP Guardian. There are only seconds to destroy it, once it's exploded it'll paralyze almost anything on the planet.
column2: 残暴EMP守护者的载荷。只有几秒时间来摧毁它，一旦爆炸，它将使行星上几乎所有东西瘫痪。

column1: The payload of a Royal Brutal EMP Guardian. There are only seconds to destroy it, once it's exploded it'll paralyze almost anything on the planet.
column2: 皇家残暴EMP守护者的有效载荷。只有几秒钟的时间来摧毁它，一旦爆炸，它将使行星上的几乎所有物体瘫痪。

column1: The perfect challenge for humanity. Tuned to scale better into mid and late game and maintain a close and challenging game.
column2: 人类的终极挑战。经过调整以更好地适应中后期游戏，保持紧张且富有挑战性的游戏体验。

column1: The personal flagship of a Burlust Warlord. Deals bonus damage to powerful targets while knocking away weaklings from their prey.
column2: 爆裂族Warlord的个人旗舰。对强大目标造成额外伤害，同时将弱者从猎物旁击飞。

column1: The phasion bomb takes several seconds to accelerate and is extra vulnerable until it reaches full speed. Foes hit by the bomb will phase out for an extended time. Because the damage bypasses personal shields, the phasion bomb is especially adept at phasing enemies.
column2: 相位炸弹需要几秒时间来加速，在达到全速之前格外脆弱。被炸弹击中的敌人将在很长一段时间内进入相位状态。由于这种伤害可以绕过个人护盾，相位炸弹在使敌人进入相位状态方面特别有效。

column1: The pinnacle of the Dark Zenith's fleet, the only rational response is to flee before its might. This is your King unit; losing this will lose the game.
column2: 暗天顶舰队的巅峰之作，面对其威势，唯一理智的反应便是在它面前逃离。这是你的王牌单位；失去它将输掉整局游戏。

column1: The pinnacle of the Dark Zenith's fleet, the only rational response is to flee before its might. This monstrosity will spend most of its time guarding the Dark Zenith homeworlds, but it will rampage through the galaxy if provoked. Jormugandr has devastating focused beams that obliterate anything unfortunate to be in the way. Periodically, it will unleash a volley of seekerbombs; if these aren't shot down while they charge up they will wreak havoc to whole armadas. If Jormugandr could somehow be defeated, its destruction would be a bounty for our scientists.
column2: 黑暗天顶舰队的巅峰之作，面对其强大力量，唯一明智的选择就是逃离。这个庞然大物大部分时间会守护黑暗天顶的母星，但一旦被激怒，它将在星系中横冲直撞。约尔曼冈德拥有毁灭性的聚焦光束，能将任何不幸挡在其路上的东西彻底摧毁。它还会定期发射一批追踪炸弹；如果这些炸弹在充能时未被击落，它们将对整个舰队造成巨大破坏。如果约尔曼冈德能以某种方式被击败，它的毁灭将是我们科学家的一大收获。

column1: The pinnacle of what lies in the Heavenly Realms, Archangels are powerful beyond measure and wield weapons as exotic as they are deadly. column1: The primary design goal of Fuel is to give the player specific infrastructure to defend, in order to facilitate more of a balance between defense and attack compared to the highly aggression-focused Humanity Ascendant experience. Secondarily, this also results in more interesting strategic decisions at the galactic level.  Over time, the majority of players have asked for a variety changes in how AI War 2 plays. These changes have largely resulted in more player choices, more powerful fleet alternatives, and fewer permadeath capturables that result in unpleasant negative consequences for the player if they are destroyed. The current Humanity Ascendant campaign type, the default way to play AI War 2, is the result of these changes. Humanity Ascendant has in general made the game significantly less difficult and the player much more powerful.  Another group of players preferred a more strategic and challenging experience. Strategic Sage in particular is primarily responsible for the design of the fuel feature, along with considerable assistance from many others, and earnestly solicits your constructive feedback about fuel on the Discord. This is intended to be in keeping with the tradition of structures such as GCAs and IGCs that existed in early versions of AI War 2, as well as AI War Classic capturable buildings like the Fabricators, Advanced Factories, and so on for those familiar with the original game. After many discussions, the idea came up to create different game modes so that those who enjoy the current way of playing can keep it, but a group of veteran players who felt the game was leaving them behind would also have a reason to continue playing. The current variety of Campaign Types in AI War 2 beyond Humanity Ascendant is a direct result of those discussions.  -Strategic Sage
column2: 燃料系统的主要设计目标是为玩家提供特定的基础设施来防御，以在防守和进攻之间取得更好的平衡，这与高度侵略性的人类飞升体验形成对比。其次，这也会在星系层面带来更有趣的战略决策。  随着时间推移，大多数玩家都要求对《AI战争2》的游戏方式进行各种改变。这些改变主要带来了更多的玩家选择、更强大的舰队替代方案，以及减少了那些一旦被摧毁就会给玩家带来不愉快负面后果的永久死亡可夺取目标。目前的人类飞升战役类型，也就是《AI战争2》的默认游戏方式，就是这些改变的结果。总的来说，人类飞升显著降低了游戏难度，使玩家变得更加强大。  另一群玩家则更喜欢更具战略性和挑战性的体验。特别是Strategic Sage主要负责燃料功能的设计，在许多其他人的大力协助下完成，并诚恳地在Discord上征求关于燃料系统的建设性反馈。这是为了延续《AI战争2》早期版本中GCA和IGC等结构的传统，以及《AI战争：经典版》中可夺取建筑如制造厂、高级工厂等（对熟悉原版游戏的玩家来说）。经过多次讨论，产生了创建不同游戏模式的想法，这样喜欢当前游戏方式的玩家可以继续保持，而感觉游戏正在抛弃他们的老玩家群体也有理由继续游戏。《AI战争2》中除人类飞升外的各种战役类型，就是这些讨论的直接结果。  -Strategic Sage

column1: The primary limitation on how ships many ships the human remnant can control is not resources, personal or any other matter. It is the highly encrypted control FTL transmission frequencies ships are controlled by. The bigger and more complex the ship, the more bandwidth controlling it takes. Currently we lack the capability to create them, but are able to salvage, hack for or repurpose frequencies, the latter only with diminishing efficiency.

column1: The way you can upgrade ships with science is by increasing them in mark level from 1 to 7.  This can be done in a few ways.               The most obvious way is via the Tech sidebar (press T).  Most ships are associated with two techs, so which techs you choose determines which ships get marked up.  For thematic and clarity reasons, the techs are often prefixed Hull or Weapon, but bear in mind that the label does not specifically affect your weapons or your hull health; ships upgrade identically no matter how you do it.  You can also upgrade command station fleets and battlestation/citadel fleets (all turrets and units within them!) from  the fleet details window for them.  Either select that from the Fleets tab (F key), or hold C and click the fleet leader.  Direct fleet upgrades on planets tend to be an incredibly good deal, when it comes to return on science spent.  These usually have major economic benefits, as well.  It is also possible to upgrade mobile fleet leaders, like transports (almost always a bad deal), or officers (Golems or Arks -- can go either way in terms of deal quality).  Balancing out where you invest your science, between direct fleet upgrades and tech upgrades, is something that plays out differently every game.  But a starting pair of upgrades to your home command station fleet is almost always wise.  It's also often very commonly a good idea to wait on hull upgrades until much later in the game, due to their expense.  They become a good deal when you have a lot of fleet lines that benefit from them.  If you change your mind, you can always refund science spent on fleets or techs by using the button at the very bottom of the tech tab.  It does have a cost in hacking points, but is something you can typically afford to do once or twice a game without being too short on hacking points.  Speaking of hacking points, you can also upgrade or even transform your fleet leaders from the fleet details screen by spending hacking points.  You can switch to a basic transport to a more advanced transport type, do the same for a combat factory, double the hull health of a golem, or various other things.
column2: 你可以通过将单位的等级从1提升到7来用科技值升级它们。 这可以通过几种方式实现。               最明显的方式是通过科技侧边栏（按T键）。 大多数单位与两项科技相关联，所以你选择的科技决定了哪些单位会升级。  出于主题和清晰度的原因，科技通常以前缀“船体”或“武器”开头，但请记住，标签并不会特别影响你的武器或船体生命值；无论你如何升级，单位的提升方式都是相同的。  你也可以从舰队详情窗口升级指挥站舰队和机动平台/堡垒舰队（包括其中的所有炮塔和单位！）。 你可以从舰队标签（F键）中选择，或者按住C键并点击舰队领袖。  在行星上直接升级舰队往往是非常划算的，就科技值的投入回报而言。 这些升级通常也会带来重大的经济收益。  也可以升级移动舰队领袖，如运输船（几乎总是不划算），或军官单位（巨像或方舟——划算程度不一）。  在直接舰队升级和科技升级之间平衡你的科技值投资，在每场游戏中的情况都不同。 但最初对母星指挥站舰队进行两次升级几乎总是明智的。  由于船体升级成本较高，通常在游戏后期再进行升级也是个好主意。 当你有很多舰队生产线能从中受益时，船体升级就会变得划算。  如果你改变主意，你总是可以使用科技标签最底部的按钮退还花费在舰队或科技上的科技值。 这确实需要花费一些入侵点数，但在一场游戏中你通常可以负担得起进行一两次这样的操作，而不会缺少入侵点数。  说到入侵点数，你也可以在舰队详情屏幕上通过花费入侵点数来升级甚至改造你的舰队领袖。 你可以将基本运输船升级为更高级的运输船类型，对机动兵工厂进行同样的操作，将巨像的船体生命值翻倍，或进行其他各种操作。

column1: There are a few hacks that are planet-targeting, and which usually don't require any local hackers on your part.  You can just select an unexplored planet on the galaxy map, and then deploy spy nanites from the hacking sidebar tab, for instance.  Most hacks are ship/structure-targeting, however: there's some enemy unit that you can disrupt, capture for yourself, weaken, extract a benefit from... the list goes on.  For these you need to bring a hacker -- aka any Flagship of any of your mobile fleets -- and usually you need to keep the hacker in place for a short while.  The harder the hack, the longer you have to stick around.  Another common type of hack is against your own ships, and these tend to happen instantly.  This lets you deploy some of our limited cache of general-purpose nanobots for either reconfiguring or upgrading ships that tend to be the centerpieces of fleets.  Check in the fleet management pop-out for a given fleet by C-clicking it on your interface, or by opening it from the fleet management sidebar tab.  Fourth, we can spend some hacking points to retrieve spent science points ('science points' being another term of art that is explained in detail on the science point retrieval part of your HUD if you are interested) so that you can reallocate them.         Lastly, there are a very few hacks that you can run for a while and then cancel when you're ready to stop.  The SuperTerminal is the main example of this: you gain more and more benefit the longer you hack it, but more and more enemy forces rain down on you.  So you hack for as long as you think you can manage it, then cancel the hack and deal with the enemy that is now VERY aware of you.
column2: 第一种是针对行星的入侵手段，通常不需要你在当地部署入侵者。例如，你只需在银河地图上选择一个未探索的行星，然后从入侵边栏标签部署侦察纳米虫。  然而，大多数入侵手段是针对单位/建筑的：你可以干扰、捕获、削弱敌方单位，或从中获取利益...可能性很多。这些操作需要你派出一名入侵者——即你任何机动舰队中的旗舰——通常还需要入侵者在原地停留一段时间。入侵难度越高，需要停留的时间越长。  第三种常见类型是针对己方单位的入侵操作，这些通常会立即生效。这让你可以部署我们有限的通用纳米机器人储备来重新配置或升级舰队核心单位。通过按住C键点击界面上的舰队，或从舰队管理边栏标签打开，可以查看特定舰队的弹出管理菜单。  第四种是花费入侵点数回收已用科技点数('科技点数'是另一个专业术语，如果你感兴趣可以在HUD的科技点数回收部分找到详细说明)，让你可以重新分配它们。  最后，有极少数入侵操作可以运行一段时间后在你准备停止时取消。超级终端是主要例子：你入侵的时间越长，获得的收益越多，但同时也会有越来越多的敌方部队袭来。所以你可以在自认为能应付的情况下尽可能长时间地入侵，然后取消操作并应对那些现在对你'非常'警觉的敌人。

column1: There are multiple reasons for this. One is that we didn't want to reinvent the wheel and make a major change in how players acquire ships and turrets. This would have been an even greater shock to the system and required a much larger amount of work to reinvent items like capturable fleets, ARS and TSS that are hackable, and so on. The goal was to change as little as necessary from the way AI War 2 usually works.  Another reason is that the balance of power in Humanity Ascendant is significantly tilted in favor the player compared to earlier versions of AI War 2 or AI War 1 (Classic). Fuel seeks to restore that balance, and the only way to do that is to put in place measures that are effectively player nerfs in comparison to Humanity Ascendant.  It is often suggested to boost the AI instead of nerfing the player, but there's a practical limit on how much that can be done and still allow the game to run reasonably on PCs that most players use. It also would have skewed the power of the AI compared to the other factions, resulting in a wide range of knock-on affects. Some AI boosting is present for campaign types from Challenger on up in other features such as Dire CPAs, hacking exostrikes, increased Exo War unit budget, etc.   Having said that, a major goal was to make the game more strategically interesting, not just more difficult. Player power is the element that was out of balance compared to the goals for Logistician and Deathwish campaigns, so that's where the effort primarily went on Fuel and other features of the new campaign types.  -Strategic Sage
column2: 这有多个原因。其一是我们不想重新发明轮子，对玩家获取单位和炮塔的方式做出重大改变。这会对系统造成更大的冲击，需要大量工作来重新设计可夺取舰队、可入侵的ARS和TSS等物品。我们的目标是尽可能少地改变《AI战争2》通常的运作方式。  另一个原因是，与《AI战争2》早期版本或《AI战争1》（经典版）相比，人类飞升中的力量平衡明显偏向于玩家。燃料系统试图恢复这种平衡，而实现这一目标的唯一方法就是采取相对于人类飞升来说实际上是削弱玩家的措施。  经常有人建议加强AI而不是削弱玩家，但这种做法在实践中有限制，因为还要确保游戏能在大多数玩家的电脑上正常运行。这也会扭曲AI与其他势力之间的力量对比，导致一系列连锁反应。在挑战者及更高难度的战役类型中，确实通过其他功能加强了AI，如可怕的CPA、入侵外星打击、增加外星战争单位预算等。  话虽如此，一个主要目标是让游戏在战略上更有趣，而不仅仅是更困难。与后勤官和死亡之愿战役的目标相比，玩家力量是失衡的元素，所以燃料系统和新战役类型的其他功能主要针对这一点。  -Strategic Sage

column1: There are options to do this in the lobby, under Options -> Extended. In general, it is advised to leave them on the defaults however. Testing determined that there is a pretty narrow range in which fuel is actually effective as a game mechanic. Too much fuel and the player will have excess at almost all times and be able to easily absorb the loss of multiple stations without harming their military efforts. Too little fuel and it becomes unreasonably difficult to expand.  The starting amount of fuel allows the player to claim three additional planets without concerning themselves with additional stations. Beyond that, you are expected to claim some planets with fuel, and some without it. It is *a* factor in expansion strategy, but not the only factor.  -Strategic Sage
column2: 在大厅中的选项->扩展选项下可以进行这些设置。不过一般建议保持默认设置。测试表明，燃料作为游戏机制真正有效的范围其实很窄。如果燃料太多，玩家几乎总是会有过剩的储备，即使失去多个燃料站也不会影响其军事行动。如果燃料太少，扩张就会变得不合理地困难。  起始燃料量允许玩家在不考虑额外燃料站的情况下占领三个额外的行星。超过这个数量后，你需要在有燃料和无燃料的行星之间做出选择。这是扩张战略中的一个因素，但不是唯一的因素。  -Strategic Sage

column1: There are seven mark levels in this game (I through VII), and the colors to them are broken up in a way that hints at their grouping, so to speak:  I is <color=#fbffbd>pale yellow</color> II is <color=#ffba00>orange</color>  These are the ones that are really weak, and so they wind up looking like it, and being kind of grouped together visually. You can tell the two of them apart, which is nice, but they also really stand out as being 'easy pickings' compared to everything else.  III is <color=#00deff>blue</color>, which is a really big shift.  This is where things start getting notably powerful, but the blue hints that things aren't really SUPER hard yet.  These are targets that in the game when looking at planets are often things that have good stuff on them that you can capture early even with weaker fleets, so highlighting them some makes sense.  IV is <color=#60ff00>green</color>, which is another really big shift.  These are pretty darn scary in the early game, but not abject terrifying.  So highlighting these again makes a certain amount of sense, as they're a thing to avoid.  But why green?  Well, the colors are the same when you're controlling your own units, and the 4th mark is typically about the highest you can get via one tech upgrade line.  It's also solidly a 'fully upgraded but not overpowered' level for mid to late game stuff. Something to feel happy about using, without it being 'overdriven for maximum success.'  V is <color=#ff3000>red</color> VI is <color=#ff0036>almost the same red</color> VII is <color=#ff00ea>scary purple</color>  These basically have the same late-game progression that the first game did, and they are rare enough (and V and VI have a different-enough shape) that they are easy to pick out.  They are ALL things to be very scared of early in the game, and to be very cautious of in the late game even.  The color shifts help you navigate the galaxy map, or should at least, even if it's not a traditional progression of slight color changes from one hue/darkness to a different hue/lightness.  Those sorts of progressions are somewhat more intuitive at a glance, but over extended play in particular give you a lot less info and are harder to distinguish.
column2: 游戏中有七个等级（从I到VII），它们的颜色划分暗示了它们的分组：  I级是<color=#fbffbd>淡黄色</color> II级是<color=#ffba00>橙色</color>  这些是真正弱小的等级，它们的外观也反映了这一点，在视觉上被归为一组。你可以区分这两个等级，而且与其他等级相比，它们确实突出显示为'容易对付'的目标。  III级是<color=#00deff>蓝色</color>，这是一个很大的变化。  从这里开始，单位变得明显强大，但蓝色暗示事情还没有变得特别困难。在游戏中查看行星时，这些目标通常带有一些好东西，即使使用较弱的舰队也可以在早期夺取，所以突出显示它们是有意义的。  IV级是<color=#60ff00>绿色</color>，这是另一个很大的变化。  这些在游戏早期相当可怕，但还不至于令人绝望。所以再次突出显示它们是有意义的，因为它们是需要避开的东西。  但为什么是绿色呢？因为当你控制自己的单位时颜色是一样的，而且通过一条科技升级线通常最高只能达到4级。对于中后期的内容来说，这也是一个'完全升级但不会过于强大'的水平。使用时会让人感到满意，但不会'为了最大成功而过度驱动'。  V级是<color=#ff3000>红色</color> VI级是<color=#ff0036>几乎相同的红色</color> VII级是<color=#ff00ea>可怕的紫色</color>  这些基本上延续了第一款游戏的后期发展路线，而且它们足够稀有（V级和VI级的形状也足够不同），很容易识别。在游戏早期，这些都是非常可怕的存在，即使在后期也需要非常谨慎对待。  这些颜色变化有助于你在星系地图上导航，即使它不是传统的从一种色调/暗度到另一种色调/亮度的渐变色变化。这种渐变在初看时可能更直观，但在长期游戏中提供的信息更少，也更难区分。

column1: There are three resources used by the Dyson Sidekick; Metal and Science work like a regular human empire. The most important resource is Cuendillar (KWEN-Dee-Arrr) that is used for stronghold and flagship related operations; very similar to essence for the Necromancer.   You have a base level of income for science and metal. You can increase this by building resource generators; Spire Strongholds let you build Science Generators, and Neinzul Strongholds let you build Metal Generators. Your enemies will get stronger the more generators you build.  You can see a lot of economic state by clicking on the Metal Section of the resource bar.  Higher-tier technologies are obtained by Cuendillar. There are a number of ways to obtain it: You can use an Minor Drill to get small amounts of Cuendillar from Asteroids or Reaper Chrysalises. You can drill a planet for Cuendillar. Drilling a planat will ravage it, destroying its other resources (like metal generators). You can't build Strongholds on Ravaged planets. You can only build Spheres on Ravaged planets. You cannot or drill any planet with a stronghold (you need to dismantle it first through the hacking menu). Some structures grant cuendillar on death, like AI Cuendillar Fortresses or Ravagers.  Deciding which planets to mine for cuendillar and which to build on is a key decision.  The Dyson Sidekick also has access to the powerful Overloader Drills. These can be used to remove a planet from the galaxy, but at a great AIP cost.
column2: 戴森助手使用三种资源；金属和科技与普通人类帝国类似。最重要的资源是坤迪亚（读音：坤迪亚尔），用于要塞和旗舰相关操作；与死灵法师的精华非常相似。  你有基础的科技和金属收入。你可以通过建造资源发生器来增加收入；尖塔要塞让你建造科技发生器，奈祖尔要塞让你建造金属发生器。 你建造的发生器越多，敌人就会越强大。  点击资源栏的金属部分可以查看大量经济状态信息。  更高级的技术通过坤迪亚获得。有多种获取方式： 你可以使用小型钻机从小行星或收割者之蛹中获取少量坤迪亚。 你可以钻探行星获取坤迪亚。钻探行星将掠夺它，摧毁其其他资源（如金属发生器）。你无法在被掠夺过的行星上建造要塞。你只能在被掠夺过的行星上建造戴森球。 你不能钻探任何有要塞的行星（你需要先通过入侵菜单拆除它）。 某些建筑在销毁时会提供坤迪亚，如AI坤迪亚要塞或劫掠者。  决定哪些行星开采坤迪亚、哪些行星进行建设是一个关键决策。  戴森助手还可以使用强大的过载钻机。这些钻机可以用于将行星从银河系中移除，但需要付出巨大的AIP代价。

column1: There are two main views in the game, and this toggles between them.  The galaxy map shows an overview of all the planets.  At different zoom levels, you can see various intel.  Paired with the objectives tab of your sidebar, all strategic decisions are at your fingertips.  The planet view, or 'main view,' shows the battlefield around a single planet.  This is where you do all your constructing, fighting, and so on.  You'll move your view between planets fairly often.
column2: 游戏中有两个主要视图，此功能可在它们之间切换。  星系地图显示所有行星的概览。在不同的缩放级别下，您可以查看各种情报。结合侧边栏的目标选项卡，所有战略决策尽在掌握。  行星视图，即“主视图”，显示单个行星周围的战场。您在这里进行所有的建造、战斗等操作。您会经常在行星之间切换视图。

column1: There are two overall kinds of ships: stuff that is able to travel between planets, and stuff that is not:          ----        Most of your ships that can travel between planets are Mobile Fleets of some sort, with a transport as their flagship, or an Ark or Golem or similar if it's later in the game.  The ships in these fleets appear directly at the flagship, BUT they are actually constructed by Factories -- not the flagships themselves.  Factories are built on your own planets (usually -- there are some special mobile factories you can find), and can be assisted by engineers to speed them up.  They divide their construction workload evenly among all the types of ships in all the fleets that belong to you on the same planet as the factory, or on adjacent planets of the factory.  Key note: the flagship of the fleet can't be crippled if it's going to receive construction help from factories.  But if a flagship is crippled, you don't lose progress on anything that was being built; it just pauses.  If you want to NOT have ships of a fleet build -- either all of them or some of them -- then you should go into the Fleets tab on the sidebar, select the fleet in question, and either turn off construction for the fleet or for specific ship lines.  This is usually not desirable, but helpful if your economy is in the toilet temporarily.  ----         The OTHER kind of ships are those that are locked to a single planet.  These are constructed manually by you, using the Build tab of the sidebar.  You can hold Shift to place 5 of these at a time, if it's something like turrets or minefields where you just want a big blob of them in a general area.  These planet-specific types of ships are usually the sort of thing that 'die to remains,' aka a Pike Turret will turn into Pike Turret Remains when it dies.  When the enemy presence is gone or it hasn't been shot at for a while, then the thing that created it will generally automatically start it rebuilding back where it was so that you don't have to think about that and constantly rebuild your defenses.  Most of these kinds of things are turrets or station-keeper ships, and are built by your command stations themselves.  However, there are Battlestations and Citadels that are able to move between planets and build things in addition to your command stations -- or on enemy or neutral planets.  You can basically take a Citadel and all its turrets and bring it over to some planet of yours that is a special chokepoint, and add its stuff to what the command station there is already doing.  Or you can use that same Citadel to set up a 'beachhead' on an enemy planet if need be.  The Battlestations and Citadels are able to move between planets specifically to give you flexibility in which planets they reinforce -- but the structures and ships that they construct are limited to not moving from whatever planet you build them on.  You'll need to scrap them (delete key) to put them in a new place, if you desire to.
column2: 单位总体上分为两类：能够在行星间航行的单位和不能在行星间航行的单位：  ----  你大部分能够在行星间航行的单位都属于某种移动舰队，旗舰可能是运输舰，或者在游戏后期可能是方舟舰、魔像舰之类的。这些舰队中的单位会直接出现在旗舰旁边，但实际上它们是由工厂建造的，而不是旗舰本身。  工厂通常建在你自己的行星上（不过你也能找到一些特殊的移动工厂），工程师可以协助工厂加快建造速度。工厂会将建造任务平均分配给所在行星或相邻行星上你所有舰队中的各种单位。  关键注意事项：如果舰队的旗舰想要得到工厂的建造支援，就不能受损。不过，如果旗舰受损，正在建造的单位进度不会丢失，只是会暂停。  如果你不想让某个舰队的单位建造（全部或部分），可以进入侧边栏的舰队选项卡，选择相关舰队，然后关闭该舰队或特定单位生产线的建造功能。通常情况下不建议这样做，但如果你的经济暂时陷入困境，这会很有帮助。  ----  另一类单位是只能在单个行星上活动的单位。这些单位需要你手动建造，通过侧边栏的建造选项卡进行操作。如果你想在某个区域放置大量炮塔或雷区等设施，可以按住 Shift 键一次性放置 5 个。  这些特定行星的单位通常在被摧毁后会留下残骸，例如长枪炮塔被摧毁后会变成长枪炮塔残骸。当敌人撤离或一段时间内没有受到攻击时，建造它们的设施通常会自动在原地重建，这样你就不用一直想着重建防御设施了。  这类单位大多是炮塔或驻守单位，由你的指挥站建造。  不过，还有战斗空间站和堡垒，它们不仅能在你的指挥站所在行星建造设施，还能在行星间移动，甚至可以在敌人或中立行星上建造。你可以把一个堡垒及其所有炮塔带到你某个具有战略意义的行星上，增强该行星指挥站的防御能力。如果需要，你也可以用同一个堡垒在敌人行星上建立一个“滩头阵地”。  战斗空间站和堡垒能够在行星间移动，让你可以灵活选择增援的行星——但它们建造的设施和单位只能留在建造它们的行星上。如果你想把它们移到新的地方，需要用删除键拆除它们。

column1: There are two ways to gain more ships: science and fleets.          By spending science to unlock a tech in the tech tab, you're not only strengthening a bunch of ships (increasing their mark level by 1), but you're also increasing their ship caps.  So your existing fleets get a bit bigger.  By capturing new fleets of whatever sort (citadels are defensive, and the rest are mostly offensive), those come with a massive amount of new ships (and often new ship types) right away.  Command stations have basic fleets, some larger than others (military command stations have the largest fleets, but the weakest income).  But in order to really defend a planet, you MUST go capture some battlestations or citadels, and then from there you can use them to build a bunch of turrets, minefields, and whatever else on your planets.  Your mobile fleets (officer or strike types) are typically used for offense, but they can also be used to defend your planets in a pinch.  It can be annoying to have to withdraw your offensive fleets to defend against every minor incursion, however, so battlestations/citadels are a big win.  Also?  Turrets are stronger than their equivalent mobile ship type (with the disadvantages of being immobile and more expensive).  There are certain major events that you may run into, like Cross Planet Attacks (CPAs) or Counter Attacks, or just an incursion by an overly-strong Hunter Fleet if you haven't been managing your threat (you don't know about these things just yet), and these are rare enough that you'll want to withdraw your offensive fleets to have all hands on deck as you defend yourself.
column2: 获取更多单位有两种方式：科研和占领舰队。  在科技选项卡中花费科研点数解锁一项科技，你不仅能增强一批单位的实力（将它们的等级提升 1 级），还能提高它们的数量上限。这样，你现有的舰队规模就会有所扩大。  占领各种新的舰队（堡垒舰队是防御性的，其他大多是进攻性的），就能立即获得大量新单位（而且往往是新的单位类型）。  指挥站拥有基础舰队，规模大小不一（军事指挥站的舰队规模最大，但收入最低）。不过，要真正保卫一个行星，你必须占领一些战斗空间站或堡垒，然后利用它们在你的行星上建造大量炮塔、雷区等防御设施。  你的移动舰队（军官型或突击型）通常用于进攻，但在紧急情况下也可用于保卫你的行星。不过，每次有小规模入侵都要撤回进攻舰队进行防御，这可能会很烦人，所以战斗空间站和堡垒是很好的防御手段。  另外，炮塔比同等类型的移动单位更强（缺点是无法移动且造价更高）。  你可能会遇到一些重大事件，比如跨行星攻击（CPA）、报复波次，或者如果你没有控制好自身威胁等级，就会遭到过于强大的猎人舰队入侵（你现在还不了解这些情况）。这些事件发生的频率较低，一旦发生，你就需要撤回进攻舰队，全员投入防御。

column1: These are attacks that the AI will only ever use in response to a few specific things.    It's something similar to a wave, but doesn't use a specific set of units. column1: These are only usable on the higher difficulties. When the AIP gets high enough, the AI can send 'Wormhole Invasions'.                    For these, the AI will spawn a Wormhole Projector on one of its planets, which will create a temporary wormhole from that planet to a planet behind your lines. AI forces will spawn at the projector to attack you. The wormhole is general purpose though, so you can send your forces back through the wormhole to attack. When the projector is destroyed the wormhole will vanish in 60 seconds.
column2: 这些攻击仅在较高难度下可用。当 AI 进度值（AIP）足够高时，AI 可以发起“虫洞入侵”。  这些攻击的时间尺度与跨行星攻击相似，但稍快一些。一旦发起，你的某个行星上会打开一个新的虫洞，通常是后方未设防的行星。  会有多次攻击从这个新虫洞涌出，直到一段时间后，虫洞关闭，入侵结束。

column1: These are something only triggered when you are taking losses on AI worlds.    Essentially, each unit you have lost on a planet is adding to the AIs 'Counter Attack Budget'. Once you have lost enough, a Counter Attack is prepared as the AI spends that budget on units, and a notification appears with a timer.  If you have enough strength on the planet compared to how strong the Counter Attack is, it can be 'stalled', and the timer won't count down. Once the timer hits 0 however, the units in the Counter Attack will appear on that planet, and be free to do whatever they wish, such as attacking your worlds.  Units in the Counter Attack are the same Mark level of the planet that spawned it, so higher Mark worlds generate much scarier Counter Attacks.  However, if every Guard Post on the planet is destroyed, the Counter Attack is completely canceled, and no more can be generated there.  As a last note, if the leader of a Fleet is crippled, they also add to the Counter Attack, particularly things such as Golems.
column2: 这些攻击只有在你在 AI 行星上遭受损失时才会触发。  本质上，你在某个行星上每损失一个单位，都会增加 AI 的“反击预算”。一旦你损失足够多，AI 就会用这笔预算组建反击部队，并出现一个带有计时器的通知。  如果你在该行星上的实力与反击部队的实力相当，反击就会“暂停”，计时器也不会倒计时。然而，一旦计时器归零，反击部队就会出现在该行星上，并可以自由行动，比如攻击你的行星。  反击部队的单位等级与发起反击的行星等级相同，因此高等级行星会发起更可怕的反击。  不过，如果行星上的所有岗哨都被摧毁，反击将被完全取消，且该行星上不会再发起反击。  最后要注意的是，如果舰队指挥官受损，也会增加反击的力度，特别是像巨像这样的单位。

column1: These are sudden Behind-Your-Lines assaults by the AI. They are intended to be scary, unpredictable and hard to defend against. They are also infrequent, perhaps once per hour.  The AI has a new budget type for Wormhole Invasions (to go with Waves, Reinforcements, etc). There are several ways the budget can be spent, which are changeable in the Galaxy Settings.   The first option is Planet Linking wormhole invasions. For these, the AI will spawn a Wormhole Projector on one of its planets, which will create a temporary wormhole from that planet to a planet behind your lines. AI forces will spawn at the projector to attack you. The wormhole is general purpose though, so you can send your forces back through the wormhole to attack. When the projector is destroyed the wormhole will vanish in 60 seconds.  The second option is Exogalactic Wormhole. For this, the AI will spawn an indestructible Exogalactic Wormhole that will appear on a player's planet. This wormhole is unstable and will disappear in a few minutes. The AI will launch a number of attacks through it. Sometimes it will launch lots of weaker attacks, other times fewer but larger attacks.  Even worse: Exogalactic Wormholes can also be used to spawn regular waves!  For both Planet Linking and Immediate invasions, you will get a Notification. Wormhole Invasions will prefer weakly defended planets behind your front lines, but won't ever spawn on your homeworld.  The final option is 'Spend this budget as additional waves'. This just causes the AI to get extra waves, but they will be 'normal' waves and use no additional mechanics.  Wormhole Invasions only start happening once the AI Progress (AIP) has reached a certain level (depending on the difficulty level, and only on difficulty 7+).  If the difficulty is less than 9, then they also can't spawn on planets adjacent to your homeworld.
column2: 在难度 5 及以上时，AI 会开始利用虫洞入侵你的行星。这可能是个重大威胁，因为 AI 可以通过虫洞派遣大型舰队，从后方攻击你。抵御虫洞入侵的最佳方法是在所有与虫洞相连的行星上建立强大的防御。            你还应该有办法在行星受到攻击时迅速增援。一种方法是使用运输舰。运输舰能通过虫洞运送舰队，让你迅速将舰队从一个行星转移到另一个行星。你也可以使用炮塔和力场来防御行星。炮塔可以攻击来袭的舰队，力场则能阻挡它们。            另一种抵御虫洞入侵的方法是尝试封锁虫洞。你可以在虫洞上放置力场，阻止 AI 通过虫洞派遣舰队。不过，这可能是个冒险的策略，因为 AI 可能会找到绕过力场的方法。

column1: These invincible world-eating planetoids are something to avoid including in your campaigns unless you are okay with a fair bit of luck influencing how things go.          If the Devourer wanders into your main planets, it could be game over with very little you can do about it -- although, arguably, you could be Devourer-proofing yourself by spreading your empire out a bit more.  They won't actually destroy your home command station, and they won't stay forever.  On the other hand, they can be SUPER helpful in that they might pass through a bunch of AI planets, cleaning them out for you and giving you a critical opening to make some inroads.  Heck, you might even be able to lure the Hunter or Warden fleets over to where the Devourer is, and get those chomped down without you having to directly do all that much work yourself.  This is basically playing with a very large and scary godlike amoral entity roaming around, and if you're not prepared for the fallout of that you might have a very bad time.  But if you're smart about things, then it can be one way to win on the higher difficulties by using the chaos sown to your advantage.
column2: 这些无敌的世界吞噬者行星体，除非你愿意让运气因素影响战局，否则最好避免在战役中包含它们。          如果吞噬者游荡到你的主要行星，可能直接导致游戏结束——尽管你可以通过分散帝国布局来'防吞噬'。它们不会摧毁你的母星指挥站，也不会永久停留。  另一方面，它们可能超级有用——穿过一系列AI行星为你清理道路，创造关键突破口。你甚至可以把猎人舰队引到吞噬者那里，让它们互相消耗而无需亲自动手。  这基本上是在与一个庞大可怕、神一般且毫无道德观念的实体共舞，如果你没准备好应对后果可能会很糟糕。但如果巧妙利用，可以成为高难度下利用混乱取胜的一种方式。

column2: 这些中型天顶单位利用强力腐蚀攻击逐步摧毁敌人，死亡时爆炸。

column1: These mods don't do anything directly.  They provide functionality for other mods to use.  Other mods will turn them on if they are needed.
column2: 这些模组本身不直接提供功能，而是为其他模组提供支持。其他模组会在需要时启用它们。

column1: These options will significantly impact gameplay to make it much harder.
column2: 这些选项将显著影响游戏玩法，使其变得更加困难。

column1: These powerful guardians are summoned to combat the AI's Enemies.  Periodic, high single target damage, especially very massive targets.
column2: 这些强大的守护者被召唤来对抗AI的敌人。周期性造成高额单体伤害，对大型目标尤为有效。

column1: These powerful guardians are summoned to combat the AI's Enemies.  They use acidic weapons to disintigrate the hulls of their enemies.
column2: 这些强大的守护者被召唤来对抗AI的敌人。它们使用酸性武器瓦解敌人的船体。

column1: These powerful guardians are summoned to combat the AI's Enemies. They charge up a powerful blast by firing their weaker weapon, and are resistant to far away enemies.
column2: 这些强大的守护者被召唤来对抗AI的敌人。它们通过发射较弱的武器来充能强力爆炸，并且对远处敌人有抗性。

column1: These raiders seem to be a cyborg-like infusion of AI technology with the Marauders.
column2: 这些掠夺者似乎是将人工智能技术与掠夺者融合的半机械人。

column1: These rifts to a highly energetic dimension are protected by the Templar. The Necromancer can siphon off its energy for its own purposes.
column2: 这些通往高能维度的裂隙由圣殿骑士守护。死灵法师可以汲取其能量为己所用。

column1: These robotic couriers are used by the AI only. They travel between train Stations at random, eventually heading to a Depot where they will assist in the AI's war effort.   There are a variety of different Depots with different effects; the higher the Intensity of this faction the more powerful of effects Depots can have. Killing Trains gives the player some resources and will delay the Depot's effect.
column2: 这些机器人信使仅供AI使用。它们随机往返于车站之间，最终前往车厂协助AI的战争行动。  有各种不同效果的车厂；该派系强度越高，车厂效果越强大。摧毁列车会给玩家一些资源并延迟车厂效果。

column1: These settings add in randomized features that make the experience more roguelike in nature.
column2: 这些设置添加了随机化特性，使体验更具类Roguelike性质。

column1: These settings add or remove extra things that are seeded around the map that may or may not normally be there.  These can have profound effects on game balance.
column2: 这些设置会在地图周围添加或删除额外的可能正常情况下不会出现的种子物品。这些可能对游戏平衡产生深远影响。
这些设置影响外卫的生成。

column1: These settings affect how factions are positioned relative to one another on the map.
column2: 这些设置影响派系在地图上相对彼此的位置。

column1: These settings affect how large the space is at various kinds of planets.
column2: 这些设置影响各种行星上的空间大小。

column1: These settings affect how the galaxy is populated in MAJOR ways, and may make things much easier or harder.
column2: 这些设置以重大方式影响银河系的填充方式，可能使事情变得更容易或更困难。

column1: These settings affect names and other non-gameplay bits.
column2: 这些设置影响名称和其他非游戏性内容。

column1: These settings affect the balance of how many capturables there are of various sorts, which can have a major effect on the balance of the game.
column2: 这些设置影响各种可捕获物体的数量平衡，这可能对游戏平衡产生重大影响。

column1: These settings affect the balance of how many destroyables there are of various sorts, which can have a major effect on the balance of the game.
column2: 这些设置影响各种可摧毁物体的数量平衡，这可能对游戏平衡产生重大影响。

column1: These settings allow you to make certain parts of the game far more intense by allowing permadeath for units that would otherwise die to remains that can be rebuilt.
column2: 这些设置允许你通过允许单位永久死亡来使游戏的某些部分更加紧张，而不是留下可以重建的残骸。

column1: These settings can only be edited during the lobby, prior to starting a new game.
column2: 这些设置只能在游戏大厅中、开始新游戏前编辑。

column1: These settings change all ships, but also wind up changing the feel and flow a lot.
column2: 这些设置改变所有船只，但也最终改变了游戏的感觉和流程。

column1: These settings change up some of the balance to Outguard.
column2: 这些设置改变了前哨守卫的一些平衡性。

column1: These settings change up some of the balance to human players in general, but not any one particular empire or type of human player in multiplayer.
column2: 这些设置改变了人类玩家的一些平衡性，但不是针对多人游戏中的任何特定帝国或类型的人类玩家。

column1: These settings change which unit groups are more or less powerful, to give the game various different flavors.
column2: 这些设置改变了哪些单位组更强或更弱，以赋予游戏各种不同的风格。

column1: These settings only apply when the game is running in fullscreen (not windowed!) mode.
column2: 这些设置仅在游戏全屏模式下生效(非窗口模式)。

column1: These settings only apply when the game is running in windowed (not fullscreen!) mode.
column2: 这些设置仅在游戏窗口模式下生效(非全屏模式)。

column1: These ships form the frontline of the Azaran Empire. Made by a Colonel or a Grand General, these ships bare little resemblance to their weaker variant, despite retaining the same key characteristics.
column2: 这些单位构成阿扎兰帝国的前线。由上校或大将制造，尽管保留了相同的关键特征，但这些单位与其较弱变种几乎没有相似之处。

column1: These ships form the frontline of the Azaran Empire. Weak but numerous, they try to swarm their enemy with the most basic weaponry possible, however can be greatly bolstered by commanders. Many weaknesses.
column2: 这些单位构成阿扎兰帝国的前线。弱小而众多，它们试图用最基本的武器淹没敌人，但可通过指挥官得到大幅增强。弱点众多。

column1: These small Zenith vessels are used in large numbers to collect usable metal for Zenith projects and efficiently convert hostile strikecraft into salvage.
column2: 这些小型天顶舰船被大量用于为天顶工程收集可用金属，并能高效将敌方攻击机转化为回收物。

column1: These small living ships are used as a first line of defense for the Dyson Sphere, adept against fortifications and bigger enemies. So trivial they are underestimated by the AI, their stated strength half of what it should be.
column2: 这些小型活体飞船是戴森球的第一道防线，擅长对抗防御工事和大型敌人。它们看似微不足道以至于被AI低估，其实际战斗力是标称值的两倍。

column1: These small living ships are used as a first line of defense for the Dyson Sphere, adept at finishing off injured invaders. So trivial they are underestimated by the AI, their stated strength half of what it should be.
column2: 这些小型活体飞船是戴森球的第一道防线，擅长消灭受伤的入侵者。它们看似微不足道以至于被AI低估，其实际战斗力是标称值的两倍。

column1: These structure gather ships for the next Cross Planet Attack. When a CPA starts, the bunker will release the ships inside to join the attack. If this structure is destroyed then the ships inside are destroyed as well.
column2: 该结构为下一次跨行星攻击收集单位。CPA 开始时，地堡会释放内部单位加入进攻。若该结构被摧毁，内部单位也会被摧毁。

column1: These tips are related to the Fuel mechanic, a mechanic that intends to add more challenge to the game. Fuel is mandatory for Logistician and Deathwish and optional for all other campaign types.
column2: 这些提示与燃料机制相关，该机制旨在为游戏增加更多挑战。燃料对于后勤专家和死亡愿望模式是必需的，对于其他所有战役类型是可选的。

column1: These two structures will form a wormhole between each other, if both are built. These are permanent once built so choose carefully, they cannot be scrapped.
column2: 如果两座建筑都建成，它们之间将形成一个虫洞。一旦建成就是永久性的，请谨慎选择，它们无法被拆除。

column1: These units are generally exclusively in the hands of the AI.
column2: 这些单位通常只由AI控制。

column1: These units are hidden, but they are a beacon.  This helps us search for them, though.
column2: 这些单位是隐藏的，但它们是信标。这有助于我们搜索它们。

column1: These units are hidden, due to either being a near exact duplicate of something else, deprecated, or something else.
column2: 这些单位被隐藏，可能是因为与其他单位几乎完全重复、已弃用或其他原因。

column1: These units are only available through cheat codes.
column2: 这些单位只能通过作弊码获得。

column1: These units are typically only in the hands of non-player factions, and often are specialized to some role in their faction's design.
column2: 这些单位通常只掌握在非玩家阵营手中，并且通常在其阵营设计中专门用于某些特定角色。

column1: These units have not yet been sorted into thematic groups.  Are they part of the main game?  A mod?  It would be nice if the author sorted these into actual groups for you, probably!
column2: 这些单位尚未被分类到主题组中。它们是主游戏的一部分吗？还是模组？如果作者能将它们分类到实际的组中就好了！

column1: These units may be in player hands or NPC hands, but these are particularly large or otherwise impressive.  The Exo-War giant units, and the various guardians, are in the AI category, however.
column2: 这些单位可能由玩家或NPC控制，但它们特别巨大或有其他令人印象深刻的特点。不过，外太空战争中的巨型单位和各种守护者属于AI类别。

column1: These unusual lifeforms shield the ship it is bonded to. Presumably this is part of its lifecycle, adapted for interstellar propagation.
column2: 这些不寻常的生命形式保护与其结合的单位。推测这是其生命周期的一部分，为星际传播而适应。

column1: These vast and deadly beings are exceptional at countering high armor ships.
column2: 这些庞大而致命的存在在对抗高装甲单位方面表现出色。

column1: These vast and deadly beings have an exceptionally powerful blast weapon, paralyzing and corroding their foes.
column2: 这些庞大而致命的存在拥有极强爆炸武器，麻痹并腐蚀敌人。

column1: These write logs to disk about various AI functions for purposes of balancing them or checking correctness.
column2: 记录各种AI功能的日志，用于平衡或检查正确性。

column1: These write logs to disk about various gameplay functions for purposes of balancing them or checking correctness.
column2: 记录各种游戏功能的日志，用于平衡或检查正确性。

column1: These write logs to disk about various pieces of data so that we can verify intended changes over time, or verify correctness after changes.
column2: 记录各种数据的日志，以便验证预期的更改或检查更改后的正确性。

column1: These write logs to disk when data is serialized or deserialized for purposes of writing save games.
column2: 在保存游戏时记录数据序列化或反序列化的日志。

column1: Things are breaking apart a bit more, leading to more chaos.
column2: 布局会更多地破碎，导致更混乱的局面。

column1: Things are definitely unraveling in many areas.

column2: 建造第三座尖塔族城市
第三座尖塔城市已建成
检测到第三个次空间信号
第三个亚空间信号已检测到

column1: Thirty extra connections at random, but not overlapping other lines or planets.
column2: 三十个随机额外连接，但不与其他连线或行星重叠。

column1: Thirty extra connections at random, but not overlapping other lines or planets.
column2: 随机添加三十个额外连接，但不与其他线路或行星重叠。

column1: This (relative to other Younglings) slow moving Youngling can attack targets anywhere on the planet.
column2: 这只（相对于其他幼体而言）移动缓慢的幼体可以攻击行星上的任何目标。

column1: This (relative to other Younglings) slow moving Youngling can attack up to 2 targets at a large range, dealing bonus damage to low armored targets.
column2: 这只（相对于其他幼体而言）移动缓慢的幼体可以在远距离攻击多达 2 个目标，对低装甲目标造成额外伤害。

column1: This (relative to other Younglings) slow moving Youngling deals damage to enemies near itself, and takes slightly reduced damage from hostiles away from itself.
column2: 这只（相对于其他幼体而言）移动缓慢的幼体可以对附近的敌人造成伤害，并且从远处的敌人那里受到的伤害略有减少。

column1: This (relative to other Younglings) slow moving Youngling has a thick outer hull to protect itself from distant fire as it approaches its target.
column2: 这只（相对于其他幼体而言）移动缓慢的幼体拥有厚实的外壳，在接近目标时可以保护自己免受远距离火力攻击。

column1: This AI Difficulty has a ton of income, but has a lot of its intelligence knobs turned down. Think of it as a Difficulty 10 AI that has had a few drinks.
column2: 该AI难度拥有大量收入，但许多智能控制被调低了。可以把它想象成一个喝了几杯的难度10 AI。

column1: This AI Difficulty is economomically around a 6, but it has some extra sneaky aspects, like early unlocking of wormhole invasions. Its ships will join the hunter more quickly, and be more cautious. They also really like killing metal generators.
column2: 该AI难度在经济上大约相当于6，但它有一些额外的狡猾特性，比如较早解锁虫洞入侵。它的单位会更快加入猎手，并且更加谨慎。它们也非常喜欢击杀金属发生器。

column1: This AI cannot make up its mind. Its waves have more ship types than normal and it builds ALL its defenses around the edge of its planets. A bit stronger waves than usual.
column2: 这个AI无法下定决心。其波次拥有比正常更多的单位类型，并将所有防御建在行星边缘。波次比通常稍强。

column1: This AI controller is involved in minor duties coordinating a small front in the AI's Exogalactic wars. It defends its core worlds heavily, including with exogalactic war units, and may choose to temporarily divert some minor fleet elements. Good luck.
column2: 该 AI 控制器参与协调 AI 系外战争中的一小部分前线。它重兵防守核心世界，包括使用系外战争单位，并可能选择临时抽调少量舰队元素。祝你好运。

column1: This AI difficulty has an extremely strong shark response, and larger border aggression and hacking response. Has half the income of a 7.
column2: 该AI难度拥有极强的鲨鱼响应，以及更强的边境侵略和入侵响应。收入仅为7级的一半。

column1: This AI faction generates bonus strength and power for the AI.
column2: 该AI派系为AI生成额外力量和能量。

column1: This AI faction handles Wormhole Invasions.
column2: 该AI派系负责处理虫洞入侵。

column1: This AI faction manages the logic for attacking Border Aggression, which do not really retreat or go over to the hunters.
column2: 该AI阵营管理边境侵略的攻击逻辑，这些部队不会撤退或转为猎手。

column1: This AI faction manages the logic for attacking Cross Planet Attacks
column2: 该AI阵营负责管理跨行星攻击的逻辑

column1: This AI faction manages the logic for attacking Relentless Waves, which do not really retreat or go over to the hunters.
column2: 该AI阵营管理无尽波次的攻击逻辑，这些部队不会撤退或转为猎手。

column1: This AI gets a Mothership in it's Praetorian Guard at game start, and also shares ships from the Flenserite. For those who find the Flenser a bit excessive.  It has exceptional border aggression, and also prefer CPAs to Waves (which are infrequent but strong). Overall a bit weaker than the Flenserite.
column2: 该AI在游戏开始时，其禁卫军中有一艘母舰，同时也共享剥皮者的单位。适合那些觉得剥皮者有点过强的玩家。  它具有极强的边境侵略性，并且相比波次（波次不频繁但强大）更倾向于CPA。总体比剥皮者弱一些。

column1: This AI has a Flenser in its Praetorian Guard at the beginning of the game, and some new ships designed to slice through your defenses.  It has exceptional border aggression, and also prefer CPAs to Waves (which are infrequent but strong).  <color=#ffa132>Not recommended without a Spire-Tier ally or two due to the strength of the Flenser.</color>
column2: 该AI在游戏开始时，其禁卫军中有一艘「剥皮者」，以及一些设计用于撕裂你的防御的新型单位。  它具有极强的边境侵略性，并且相比波次（波次不频繁但强大）更倾向于CPA。  <color=#ffa132>由于剥皮者的强度，不建议在没有一两个尖塔级盟友的情况下使用。</color>

column1: This AI has a Praetorian Guard with a bit of extra range and strength.
column2: 这个 AI 的禁卫军拥有额外的射程和强度。

column1: This AI has a Praetorian Guard with a lot of extra range and strength.   Can be almost impossible on small or very connected maps where you start too close to the AI homeworld.
column2: 这个 AI 的禁卫军拥有大量额外的射程和强度。   在小型地图或连接非常紧密的地图上，如果你起始位置离 AI 母星过近，可能几乎无法战胜它。

column1: This AI has a Ravenous Shadow in its Praetorian Guard at the beginning of the game, and a variety of other powerful Shadow Ships.  This AI focuses more on heavily defending its planets with turrets and guard posts.
column2: 该AI在游戏开始时，其禁卫军中有一艘「贪婪暗影」，以及各种其他强大的暗影单位。  该AI更侧重于用炮塔和哨站重兵防守其行星。

column1: This AI has all the intelligence knobs turned up but the income turned down. In addition, it leans heavily into exogalactic war ships
column2: 该AI将所有智能控制调到了最高但收入调低了。此外，它极大地偏向河外战争单位

column1: This AI has an especially powerful Hunter fleet. It is intended to be paired with the Hunter Difficulty 'Zerg Rush'; to use that, you will need to disable 'Universal Difficulty' and set the Warden and Hunter difficulties manually.
column2: 该AI拥有一支特别强大的猎手舰队。它旨在配合猎手难度「虫群冲锋」使用；要使用该难度，你需要禁用「统一难度」并手动设置守望者和猎手的难度。

column1: This AI is particularly smart, though much weaker economically. The goal is to allow for a still challenging game, while keeping fewer ships in the galaxy for better Multiplayer. My first guess is that this will turn out to be around a 6.5.
column2: 该AI特别聪明，但经济上弱得多。目标是让游戏仍然有挑战性，同时保持银河中更少的单位以便更好地进行多人游戏。我的初步估计是会大约在6.5左右。

column1: This AI is particularly smart, though much weaker economically. The goal is to allow for a still challenging game, while keeping fewer ships in the galaxy for better Multiplayer. This AI makes up for fewer ships overall by going to higher mark levels early, and by strong responses to hacks and counterattacks. My guess is this will turn out around a 7.5
column2: 该AI特别聪明，但经济上弱得多。目标是让游戏仍然有挑战性，同时保持银河中更少的单位以便更好地进行多人游戏。该AI通过较早到达更高标记等级以及对入侵和反击的强烈响应来弥补整体单位数量的不足。我的估计是会大约在7.5左右

column1: This AI is very defensive. They have extra reinforcements, and their AI Reserves will detect your deepstrikes earlier than usual.   This AI then uses its reinforcements for offense with particularly large Cross Planet Attacks.
column2: 这个 AI 非常注重防御。它拥有额外的增援部队，并且其 AI 预备役会比平时更早地发现你的深度打击。   然后，这个 AI 会利用其增援部队发起特别大规模的跨行星攻击。

column1: This AI ship is exceptionally dangerous to fleets of mixed albedo. If confronted by such a fleet, it will feed on some to destroy the rest.
column2: 这个 AI 单位对混合反照率的舰队特别危险。如果遇到这样的舰队，它会以部分舰队为食来摧毁其余部分。

column1: This AI ship is exceptionally dangerous to fleets of mixed size. Its massive maw contains a phased disassembly array that can reduce smaller ships to scrap, ready to fuel its powerful Scrap Blaster Cannon, which is extremely dangerous against larger craft. If there is no scrap avalible, the cannon can make do regardless, but it is far more powerful after... feeding.
column2: 这个 AI 单位对混合体型的舰队特别危险。其巨大的口中包含一个相位分解阵列，可以将较小的单位化为废料，为强大的废料冲击炮提供燃料。如果没有废料可用，火炮也能凑合，但在进食之后会强大得多。

column1: This AI structure stores critical scientific records from their experiments. If hacked, it would be a valuable source of Technology.
column2: 这个 AI 建筑存储着他们实验的关键科学记录。如果被入侵，将是宝贵的技术来源。

column1: This AI type has all its Bastion Worlds on Nomad Planets, and uses a wide variety of units.  Has an emphasis on waves in the early game especially.
column2: 该AI类型的所有要塞世界都位于流浪行星上，并使用各种各样的单位。  尤其在早期游戏中侧重于波次攻击。

column1: This AI type uses a variety of different ship types in their sub-fleets. They use Scourge in the Warden Fleet, Neinzul in the Border Aggression and Templar in the Praetorian Guard.  In addition, they have a particularly powerful Hunter fleet focused on cloaked ships.
column2: 该AI类型在其子舰队中使用了多种不同的单位类型。他们在守望者舰队中使用天灾，在边境侵略中使用奈祖尔，在禁卫军中使圣殿骑士。  此外，他们拥有一支特别强大的猎手舰队，专注于隐形单位。

column1: This AI uses ships from the Armada Empire. Has pretty powerful waves.  It's possibly that the Difficulty should be Brutal, some feedback would be great.
column2: 该AI使用来自无敌舰队帝国的单位。拥有相当强大的波次。  它的难度可能应该设为Brutal（残暴），欢迎大家提供反馈。

column1: This AI uses ships infused with Tyderian; they often spawn weaker ships when destroyed, leading to protracted battles. Has powerful waves
