column2: 这艘死灵法师旗舰拥有两种麻痹武器，一种针对小型舰船，另一种针对中型舰船。

column1: This Necromancer Flagship is extra tanky and has a powerful cannon. It is hardened to resist traumatic damage and regenerates outside of combat.
column2: 这艘死灵法师旗舰拥有极高的耐久度，并且配备一门强大的加农炮。它经过强化，能够抵抗重创，并且在非战斗状态下能够自我修复。

column1: This Necromancer Flagship reels ships toward itself to consume them; it was obtained from sacrificing a Decadent Elderling.
column2: 这艘死灵法师旗舰会将舰船拉向自身并吞噬它们；它是通过献祭一名堕落的古灵获得的。

column1: This Necromancer Flagship was obtained by sacrificing a Blasphemous Elderling. It has a Blaster that specializes in massive targets. For dealing with masses of ships it can focus six beams at a point, hitting intersecting targets and dealing damage based on how many Mark levels the Flagship is above its target.
column2: 这艘死灵法师旗舰是通过献祭一名渎神长者获得的。它配备一门专门针对大型目标的爆破炮。在对付大量舰船时，它可以将六道光束聚焦于一点，攻击相交的目标，并根据旗舰比目标高出的等级造成伤害。

column1: This Neinzul Ward is actually a Neinzul nest that has formed a symbiotic relationship with human flagships, providing Neinzul younglings as protection in exchange for interstellar transportation.
column2: 这个涅因祖尔守卫实际上是一个涅因祖尔巢穴，它与人类旗舰形成了共生关系，作为交换，它提供涅因祖尔幼体作为保护，并获得星际运输能力。

column1: This Neinzul Worker goes from planet to planet, gathering resources from Metal Generators and attempting to convert them into friendly Neinzul Wild Hives.
column2: 这名奈因祖尔工人会在各个行星间穿梭，从金属发生器收集资源，并试图将它们转化为友好的奈因祖尔野生蜂巢。

column1: This Neinzul/Spire hybrid uses powerful weapons.
column2: 此奈祖尔/尖塔混合体使用强力武器。

column1: This Nomad is en route to crash into an AI homeworld.
column2: 这艘游牧者飞船正朝着一个AI母星撞去。

column1: This Plagueswarm Elderling has been transformed. Surrounded in a cloud of Plaguehosts, siphoning victims in range to form Viral Swarmers.
column2: 这只瘟疫群长者已被转化。它周围环绕着一团瘟疫宿主，会吸取范围内的目标，形成病毒蜂群。

column1: This Ram variant is protected from damage when it first appears and moves faster.
column2: 这种撞击变体在首次出现时受到伤害保护，并且移动速度更快。

column1: This Reaper ship powers up a critical strike and does extra damage to bubble forcefields.
column2: 这个收割者单位充能暴击并对气泡力场造成额外伤害。

column1: This Reclaimers ship ventures into deep space to discover useful schematics.
column2: 这个回收者单位深入深空发现有用的蓝图。

column1: This Siren-class Clanling ship is weak individually but becomes a cacophony as a chorus, beckoning foes to the Siren's call.
column2: 这艘塞壬级氏族舰单独时很弱，但成群时形成刺耳合音，将敌人引向塞壬的召唤。

column1: This Slothful Elderling has been transformed. If it is killed by the Necromancer it will allow their flagships to transform into a more powerful one based on the Elderling's trait but will not grant essence.
column2: 这只懒惰长者已被转化。如果它被死灵法师消灭，死灵法师的旗舰将能够根据这只长者的特性转化为更强大的旗舰，但不会获得精华。

column1: This Spire Sphere was auto added alongside the Spire Wars faction.
column2: 这个尖塔戴森球是随分裂尖塔派系自动添加的。

column1: This Spire battleship was once a front line troop against the AI's incursion of the Andromeda galaxy. Now its shattered body serves the AI.
column2: 这艘尖塔战列舰曾经是抵御 AI 入侵仙女座星系的前线部队。现在它破碎的船体为 AI 服务。

column1: This Templar/Spire hybrid uses powerful weapons.
column2: 此圣殿骑士/尖塔混合体使用强力武器。

column1: This Templar/Zenith hybrid uses powerful weapons.
column2: 此圣殿骑士/天顶混合体使用强力武器。

column1: This Tower must be destroyed in order to make the Ultimate Fortress vulnerable.
column2: 必须摧毁该塔才能使终极堡垒变得可被攻击。

column1: This Tyderian-powered Battle Emplacement has a powerful chain lightning weapon.
column2: 这座由泰德瑞安供能的战斗炮台配备了强大的连锁闪电武器。

column1: This V-Wing variant still has engine stun weapons, but they are also fusion.
column2: 这种V翼变体仍有引擎眩晕武器，但它们同时也是聚变武器。

column1: This Venator is immune to zombification.
column2: 这艘复仇者免疫僵尸化。

column1: This Venator is specialized against bubble forcefields and turrets, but is countered by most mobile adversaries.
column2: 这艘复仇者专门针对泡泡力场和炮塔，但会被大多数移动对手克制。

column1: This Venator is specialized against cloaking.
column2: 这艘复仇者专门针对隐形单位。

column1: This Venator is specialized against large, high mass ships, using corrosive damage to bypass shields and cause damage over time.
column2: 这艘复仇者专门针对大型、高质量舰船，使用腐蚀伤害绕过护盾并造成持续伤害。

column1: This Venator is specialized against melee units.
column2: 这艘复仇者专门针对近战单位。

column1: This Venator is specialized against snipers.
column2: 这艘复仇者专门针对狙击手。

column1: This Wrathful Elderling has been transformed. If it is killed by the Necromancer it will allow their flagships to transform into a more powerful one based on the Elderling's trait but will not grant essence.
column2: 这只愤怒长者已被转化。如果它被死灵法师消灭，死灵法师的旗舰将能够根据这只长者的特性转化为更强大的旗舰，但不会获得精华。

column1: This Xodian base produces drones to repair damaged ships.
column2: 该克赛迪安基地制造无人机来修复受损单位。

column1: This Xodian drone circles and repairs damaged ships.
column2: 该克赛迪安无人机环绕受损单位进行维修。

column1: This Zenith/Spire hybrid uses powerful weapons.
column2: 此天顶/尖塔混合体使用强力武器。

column1: This a powerful Templar defensive structure. It is the home base of some defensive ships that will defend nearby planets.
column2: 这是一个强大的圣殿骑士防御建筑。它是一些防御舰船的基地，这些舰船会保卫附近的行星。

column1: This a powerful Templar defensive structure. It is the home base of some defensive ships that will defend nearby planets. This has been specially adapted for combat against the Necromancer
column2: 这是一个强大的圣殿骑士防御建筑。它是一些防御舰船的基地，这些舰船会保卫附近的行星。此建筑已针对对抗死灵法师进行了特殊改装。

column1: This a very powerful Templar defensive structure. It is the home base of some defensive ships that will defend nearby planets. This has been specially adapted for combat against the Necromancer
column2: 这是一个非常强大的圣殿骑士防御建筑。它是一些防御舰船的基地，这些舰船会保卫附近的行星。此建筑已针对对抗死灵法师进行了特殊改装。

column1: This a very powerful Templar defensive structures. It will launch some ships to defend nearby planets.
column2: 这是一个非常强大的圣殿骑士防御建筑。它会派出一些舰船来保卫附近的行星。

column1: This actually gets a bit longer with distance, instead!
column2: 实际上，随着距离增加，间距会稍微变长！

column1: This actually gets a substantially longer with distance, instead!
column2: 实际上，随着距离增加，间距会显著变长！

column1: This affects only Human players (Human Empire, Ark Empire, Spire-Infused Empire) as a multiplier to the final Power Level rating the AI assigns to them. This value affects how quickly the AI unlocks their exo-war ship budget and the subsequent tiers of them. The default and lowest value is 1 (2 on expert+) but can be raised.
column2: 这只影响人类玩家（人类帝国、方舟帝国、螺旋塔注入帝国）作为AI分配给他们的最终实力等级的乘数。该值影响AI解锁其外星战争单位预算和随后的层级的速度。默认和最低值为1（专家+级别为2），但可以提高。

column1: This alien artifact seems to be emitting an extraordinarily powerful suppression field, as if it were keeping something very dangerous from awakening.  Destroying it might have unexpected consequences, but would make for fascinating study.  Your chief science officer notes that opening it may be humanity-ending.  One of your military advisers believes that there's a chance humanity could hold this new threat at bay while it ravages the AI.  Either way, things are likely to be... lively.  <color=#f25e1c>EXTREMELY HIGH IMPACT:</color> This faction expands, and can do irreparable damage. It is also one of the strongest, capable of steamrolling most enemies due to being able to capture their ships. They will likely have a dominating effect on this game, and require specialized strategies to deal with.
column2: 这个外星神器似乎在发出一种超强力的抑制场，就像在阻止某种非常危险的东西苏醒一样。摧毁它可能会带来意想不到的后果，但研究它一定很有意思。  你的首席科学官指出，打开它可能会导致人类灭绝。而你的一位军事顾问认为，人类有机会在这个新威胁摧毁AI的同时幸存下来。无论如何，事情都会变得...很刺激。  <color=#f25e1c>极高影响力：</color>这个派系会不断扩张，并可能造成不可挽回的损害。由于能够捕获敌方单位，它也是最强大的派系之一。它很可能会主导整个游戏进程，需要特殊的策略来应对。

column1: This alien artifact seems to be emitting extraordinarily powerful beams of Phlebotonium radiation, as if it were disrupting an unknown form of propulsion. Destroying it might have unexpected consequences, but would make for fascinating study.  Your military advisors worry that destroying this might allow a powerful set of enemies to attack the galaxy.  <color=#f25e1c>VARIABLE IMPACT:</color> This faction expands, and can do irreparable damage. If allowed to expand enough, they can be an enormous threat, but can struggle to get going initially. Their first method of attack can force some different strategies on the player as well.
column2: 这个外星神器似乎在发出极其强大的虚构元素辐射，就像在干扰某种未知的推进系统。摧毁它可能会带来意想不到的后果，但研究它一定很有意思。  你的军事顾问担心，摧毁它可能会让一群强大的敌人得以进攻银河系。  <color=#f25e1c>可变影响力：</color>这个派系会扩张，并可能造成不可挽回的损害。如果让它扩张得足够大，它们会成为巨大的威胁，但在初期可能会难以发展。他们的首次攻击方式也可能迫使玩家采取不同的策略。

column1: This alien frigate spreads damage over any range with continuous salvos of photonic torpedos that stun engines.
column2: 这艘外星护卫舰通过连续齐射光子鱼雷在任何范围内散布伤害，并能瘫痪引擎。

column1: This alien turret shields and houses a set a powerful wards with planetary-ranged point-beam weapons
column2: 这座外星炮塔护盾并容纳一组强大的守卫，配备行星级射程的点光束武器

column1: This allows for editing the name, disabling or removing items from the OCD /OSD.
column2: 允许编辑OCD/OSD中条目的名称、禁用或移除条目。

column1: This anti-armor hydra can quickly devastate enemies with its acidic weapon.
column2: 这条反装甲九头蛇能用其酸性武器迅速摧毁敌人。

column1: This battlestation trades out turrets for field hangers that can be built off planet for combat.
column2: 这座战斗空间站用可建造到其他行星作战的野战机库替代了炮塔。

column1: This beacon has been hacked, and has granted you contact with its outguard groups.
column2: 此信标已被破解，你已与它的前哨团体取得联系。

column1: This broken beacon might let you contact unexpected allies if you can hack it to work again.  Your military advisors suspect that hacking this would allow for some other Anti-AI forces to join your fight.  <color=#f25e1c>LOW IMPACT:</color> This faction does not expand, and doesn't do any irreparable damage. They are a nice boost to your power, but they won't win games for you on their own.
column2: 如果你能破解这个损坏的信标，也许能联系到意想不到的盟友。  你的军事顾问推测，破解它将允许其他反AI力量加入你的战斗。  <color=#f25e1c>低影响力：</color>这个派系不会扩张，也不会造成不可挽回的损害。他们会给你带来不错的助力，但不会替你赢得游戏。

column1: This button opens the menu from which you can save, quit, etc.  It also acts as a cancel button on a lot of screens.
column2: 这个按钮打开可以保存、退出等操作的菜单。在许多界面中它也可以作为取消按钮。

column1: This chunk of wreckage can be drilled to produce Cuendillar
column2: 这块残骸可以钻探以产出坤迪亚

column1: This classic mix is good at stopping or slowing things as they come through your wormholes, and has good firepower against midsized foes. Picking the same starting battlestation twice will randomize the second one.
column2: 这种默认组合擅长在敌方单位通过虫洞时进行拦截或减速，并且对中型目标具有强大火力。\\n如果两次选择相同的起始防御站，第二个将随机生成。

column1: This classic mix isn't good at any one particular thing, but is well-rounded against any foe.  The forcefields just make things even better.
column2: 这种默认组合在任何特定方面都不算突出，但对任何敌人都能全面应对。护盾更是锦上添花。

column1: This cloaked drone lays mines as it approaches the enemy.
column2: 这架隐形无人机在接近敌人时布设地雷。

column1: This cloaked ship lurks in the outskirts of systems with its sniper weapon.
column2: 这个隐形单位潜伏在星系边缘，使用狙击武器。

column1: This command station just won't die. It now roams the galaxy.
column2: 这个指挥站就是死不了。它现在在银河系中漫游。

column1: This command station just won't die. It now roams the galaxy.
column2: 这个指挥站就是死不了。它现在在银河系中漫游。

column1: This corvette specializes in swarming massive enemies with its reverse tractor beam, siphoning health and hardened to resist damage that would otherwise kill it.
column2: 这艘护卫舰擅长用反向牵引光束群攻大型敌人，吸取敌人生命值，并强化自身以抵御原本可能致命的伤害。

column1: This defense contractor figured out the trick to quickly setting up defenses. Instead of offering his ten bulwark turrets he has reassembled them into a single super bulwark turret with the power of ten. But why stop there? He also brings Kinetic Buffers to mine around it.
column2: 这个防御承包商找到了快速设置防御的诀窍。他没有提供十个堡垒炮塔，而是将它们重新组装成一个拥有十倍力量的超级堡垒炮塔。但哪能止步于此？他还带来了动能缓冲器在其周围布雷。

column1: This determines how much impact the Elderlings will have.
column2: 这决定了奈因祖尔长老将产生多大的影响。

column1: This determines how much impact the Sappers will have.
column2: 这决定了工兵将产生多大的影响。

column1: This determines the AI response to the Spire Sidekick.
column2: 决定AI对尖塔Sidekick的响应程度。

column1: This determines the overall power budget of the Architrave; how quickly the Architrave can build ships, how often they will try to expand their territory (and how effective they'll be at expanding), etc...
column2: 这决定了拱壁派的整体实力预算；拱壁派建造舰船的速度有多快，他们尝试扩张领地的频率（以及扩张的效果如何）等等...

column1: This determines the overall power budget of the Dark Zenith
column2: 决定暗天顶的总战力预算

column1: This determines the strength of the AI response to your Armada forces; this includes both power of the Tyderian and the bonuses to the AI.
column2: 决定AI对你无敌舰队部队的响应强度；这包括泰德瑞安的强度和对AI的加成。

column1: This determines the strength of the AI response to your Scourge forces.
column2: 决定AI对你天灾部队的响应强度。

column1: This determines the strength of your Scourge forces.
column2: 决定你天灾部队的强度。

column1: This disabled beacon looks like it might be hackable. I wonder what it would attract? Probably something hungry...  Your chief science officer suggests that hacking this beacon will summon a giant Zenith Golem that will roam the galaxy, attacking everything in its path.  <color=#f25e1c>LOW IMPACT:</color> This faction does not expand, and doesn't do any irreparable damage. Can sometimes create massive shifts in a fight, however.
column2: 这个失效的信标看起来可以被黑入。不知道它会吸引什么？可能是某种饥饿的东西...  你的首席科学官表示，入侵这个信标会召唤出一个巨大的天顶巨像，它会在银河系中游荡，攻击所遇到的一切。  <color=#f25e1c>低影响力：</color>这个派系不会扩张，也不会造成不可挽回的损害。但有时可能会在战斗中产生巨大的影响。

column1: This disturbingly stealthy vessel exists to prey on smaller vessels and structures.
column2: 这个令人不安的隐形单位专为捕食小型单位和建筑而存在。

column1: This does nothing but lies in wait for the dev who needs to hack something in to happen on a configurable keypress.
column2: 此功能本身无作用，供需要通过可配置按键实现特定功能的开发人员使用。

column1: This doesn't act similar to the big warp gates where massive fleets can come though, it only transports a couple ships at a time, giving the AI an easier way to reinforce the planet it's placed on.
column2: 这不像可以容纳大规模舰队通过的大型跃迁门，它一次只运输几个单位，为 AI 提供了一种更简单的方式来增援其所在行星。

column1: This dreadful Tyderian monstrosity leads the AI's CPAs against the Armada. It has good range, and you must close with it to do real damage.  Upon death, it spawns additional Tyderian enhanced ships.
column2: 这头可怕的泰德瑞安怪物领导着AI的CPA进攻无敌舰队。它射程很广，你必须接近它才能造成真正的伤害。  死亡时会生成额外的泰德瑞安强化单位。

column1: This dreadful Tyderian monstrosity was summoned by unwise Armada forces.  It reels ships towards itself so it can devour them, replenishing health in the process.
column2: 这头可怕的泰德瑞安怪物是被不明智的无敌舰队势力召唤而来。  它会将单位吸向自己以便吞噬，在此过程中恢复生命值。

column1: This dreadful Tyderian monstrosity will be an invaluable subject for scientific research when killed. It wields a fire weapon, and is surrounded by acidic Tyderian Pustules.
column2: 这头可怕的泰德瑞安怪物被杀后将是科学研究的宝贵对象。它使用火焰武器，周围环绕着酸性的泰德瑞安脓疱。

column1: This eldritch spire wanders the galaxy seemingly at random, knocking anything it shoots with its Spacetime Lens to a random spot in the gravity well and burning up smaller craft.  It can be killed... but it will simply return, motives as inscrutable as ever.
column2: 这座神秘的尖塔似乎在银河系中随机游荡，用它的时空透镜将射击到的任何东西传送到引力井中的随机位置，并烧毁较小的飞船。它可以被摧毁……但它会再次出现，动机一如既往地难以捉摸。

column1: This enables the AI's Border Aggression mechanic, where they will send periodic unannounced strikes against your planets. If this is disabled then the AI will shift all of its Border Aggression resources into Waves.
column2: 这启用了AI的边境侵略机制，它们将对你的行星发动定期的未通知打击。如果禁用此功能，AI将把所有边境侵略资源转移到波次中。

column1: This extra-strong Draghkar is used by the AI to counter Dyson and Reaper forces. This prime has a powerful AOE zombifying weapon.
column2: 这个超强的德拉格卡被AI用来对抗戴森和收割者部队。此高级版本拥有强力的范围僵尸化武器。

column1: This extra-strong Draghkar is used by the AI to counter Dyson and Reaper forces. This prime is cloaked.
column2: 这个超强的德拉格卡被AI用来对抗戴森和收割者部队。此高级版本为隐形。

column1: This extremely quick and cloaked Youngling shreds ships slower moving ships.
column2: 这只速度极快且隐形的幼体可以摧毁移动较慢的舰船。

column1: This eye deals planet-wide attrition damage while active and explodes on death killing everything on planet.
column2: 此眼睛在激活时造成行星范围损耗伤害，死亡时爆炸杀死行星上的一切。

column1: This facility allows the City to build an extra Spire Destroyer.  If the facility is destroyed, the extra Destroyer will also be destroyed.  The City Center must be functional for the cap to increase, but a nonfunctional City Center won't decrease the cap. They are built via a Shipyard.

column1: This facility serves as the central seat of government for all Spire settlements in a galaxy. It always has two more sockets than other Cities of the same mark. column1: This faction is an invasion of giant organic Macrophage. They prey on Metal, devouring ships and structures they come across, and in particular they prey on the AI (since you haven't encountered them yet).          Macrophage live in colonies called Telium, which are hidden from the AI. A Telium sends out Macrophage to harvest metal by destroying human or AI ships. When a Colony has been fed enough metal it will create cloaked and harmless Spores which wander the galaxy. When spores encounter spores from other Telium they can reproduce to spawn a new Telium.  By default, they are hostile to humans and AI alike -- but thankfully they are not very intelligent.  If a Telium produces enough Macrophage, some of the Macrophage will be transformed into an Aggressive form and then go try to kill the human player. If a Telium is destroyed, all of the Macrophages associated with it will attack the player.  This faction is a bit like reimagining the Devourer Golem as a part of an ecosystem.  They are far easier to deal with than the Devourer since they are not so darn monolithic, but it's like the entire galaxy is infected... and mostly that is worse news for the AI than you if you play your cards right.
column2: 这个派系是由巨型有机巨噬体组成的入侵者。它们以金属为食，吞噬遇到的单位和建筑，尤其喜欢攻击AI(因为你还没遇到过它们)。          巨噬体生活在称为Telium的群落中，这些群落对AI是隐藏的。Telium会派出巨噬体通过摧毁人类或AI单位来收集金属。当群落获得足够金属后，会产生隐形无害的孢子游荡在星系中。当孢子遇到其他Telium的孢子时，可以繁殖产生新群落。  默认情况下，它们对人类和AI都怀有敌意——但幸运的是它们不太聪明。  如果Telium产生足够多巨噬体，其中一些会转变为攻击形态并试图杀死人类玩家。如果Telium被摧毁，所有相关巨噬体都会攻击玩家。  这个派系有点像将吞噬魔像重新构想为生态系统的一部分。它们比吞噬魔像容易对付得多，但就像整个星系都被感染了...如果策略得当，对AI的影响通常比对玩家更不利。

column1: This is a bad idea but it's possible and as Commander all options are to be brought to your notice. We do however expect the Devourer to react violently and, at least for a while, see us and our allies as its primary target. Beware the repercussions.
column2: 这是个坏主意，但它是可行的，作为指挥官，所有选项都应当呈报给您。 长话短说：吞噬者如此巨大，以至于它需要一个类似于 AI 的内部通信网络。我们的入侵者有信心，只需在其系统中摸索几秒钟，就能帮助我们理解其他庞大而广泛的 AI。 然而，我们确实预期吞噬者会暴力反应，并且至少在短时间内将我们及我们的盟友视为其主要目标。请注意后果。

column1: This is a feature with HUGE impact on the overall flow of the game.  It's required for Challenger mode and up, but you can use it at any level.             In this mode, your Metal Harvesters become Asteroid Mining Powerplants.  The bulk of your metal and energy will be generated via this mines, rather than your central command stations.  However, what kind of command station you choose will either give bonuses or penalties to asteroid mines.  A lot of fairly straightforward things happen as a result of this, but it makes the game more complex (and interesting).  High-asteroid planets are worth far more to your economy than low-asteroid ones.  Economic command stations suddenly aren't easy to just stick anywhere for maximum effect.  And perhaps most notably, the AI has a number of places at which to attack your economy now, on every planet.  The Metal Harvesters have a very low priority for the AI, because they are rebuilt quickly and you lose little from them being down.  Asteroid Mining Powerplants are slower and more expensive to rebuild, and can put a strain on your metal or energy generation while they are gone.  This gives the AI way more chances to be clever.
column2: 这是一个对游戏整体流程有巨大影响的功能。挑战者模式及以上必须启用，但你可以在任何难度下使用它。             在此模式下，你的金属采集器将变为小行星采矿发电厂。大部分金属和能量将通过这些矿场生成，而不是通过中央指挥站。不过，你选择的指挥站类型会给小行星矿场带来加成或惩罚。  这会导致许多直接的变化，使游戏更加复杂(也更有趣)。富含小行星的行星对你的经济价值远高于小行星少的行星。经济型指挥站不再能随意放置以获得最大效果。  最值得注意的是，AI现在可以在每个行星上攻击你的经济。金属采集器对AI的优先级很低，因为它们重建快且损失小。小行星采矿发电厂重建更慢、更昂贵，在它们被摧毁期间会给你的金属和能量生成带来压力。这给了AI更多施展策略的机会。

column1: This is a feature with HUGE impact on the overall flow of the game.  It's required for Logistician mode and up, but you can use it at any level.             This is probably the most-core feature of Logistician mode, and it essentially gives you a variety of permament-consequence weakspots that the AI can attack, as well as a bit more to think about when deciding how to expand your empire.             With fuel enabled, you not only have to think about Metal and Energy for your ships, but you also have to think about fuel.  Who uses fuel?  Most small and midsize military craft consume Argon, which is relatively common.  Officers (Arks and Golems) and Elites (destroyers and cruisers) use Xenon, which is harder to come by.  Turrets and forcefields and similar use Radon, which is about as common as Argon.  Where do you get fuel?  You start with a baseline of Argon and Radon.  You'll need to capture more by taking planets and holding these structures from them.  These structures are also where Xenon comes from.
column2: 这是一个对游戏整体流程有巨大影响的功能。后勤专家模式及以上必须启用，但你可以在任何难度下使用它。             这可能是后勤专家模式最核心的功能，它本质上为你提供了多种永久性弱点供AI攻击，同时在决定如何扩张帝国时也需要更多考虑。             启用燃料后，你不仅需要考虑单位的金属和能量，还需要考虑燃料。  哪些单位使用燃料？大多数小型和中型军用单位消耗氩气(Argon)，这种燃料相对常见。军官(方舟和魔像)和精英(驱逐舰和巡洋舰)使用氙气(Xenon)，这种燃料更难获得。炮塔、力场等使用氡气(Radon)，其常见程度与氩气相当。  从哪里获得燃料？你开始时有一定量的氩气和氡气。你需要通过占领行星并控制这些结构来获取更多燃料。这些结构也是氙气的来源。

column1: This is the most modern and reliable Steam networking framework, and it forms a direct connection between host and client, but it requires the host to share their IP address with the clients, which is a minor hassle.                If you find that you are unable to connect with this method, then you may need to use Valve's relay servers (Steam Sockets Relay).  If that is too laggy, then the fastest option is to use LiteNetLib for direct IP connection, and then configure port forwarding on the host if required.  If this networking method is non-responsive (connection timing out after a few moments), or has performance problems like the host or client freezing for a few moments at a time, then it's probably best to switch to LiteNet.  It's some sort of hopefully-rare permissions validation thing in Steam.  PLEASE NOTE!  Rather than just using the selected port (for example, 32300), it uses that port plus five more (so, 32300 to 32305).  This is because Steam does not support multi-channel data on a single port.
column2: 这是最现代、最可靠的Steam网络框架，它能在主机和客户端之间建立直接连接，但需要主机将其IP地址分享给客户端，这有点麻烦。                如果您发现无法通过此方法连接，可能需要使用Valve的中继服务器（Steam Sockets Relay）。如果延迟过高，最快的选择是使用LiteNetLib进行直接IP连接，必要时在主机上配置端口转发。  如果此网络方法无响应（连接在几分钟后超时），或者存在性能问题，如主机或客户端偶尔冻结几分钟，那么最好切换到LiteNet。这可能是Steam中某种罕见的权限验证问题。  请注意！它不仅使用选定的端口（例如32300），还会使用该端口及另外五个端口（即32300至32305）。这是因为Steam不支持在单个端口上传输多通道数据。

column1: This is the most modern and reliable Steam networking framework, but this particular version of it will route all data through Valve's network.                If you are experiencing a lot of lag, then you may wish to switch to the Steam Sockets Direct method, or better yet LiteNetLib.  This relayed method of playing is known for sometimes causing freezing of the game while it waits for the steam client to respond, and other un-fun things like that.  The other methods require connection by IP address, but does not go through Valve's servers and thus can be substantially faster depending on where you and your friends live relative to Valve datacenters and one another.  If this networking method is non-responsive (connection timing out after a few moments, freezing, etc), then please use a better framework.  We wish this worked better, but it is what it is.
column2: 这是最现代、最可靠的Steam网络框架，但此版本会将所有数据通过Valve的网络进行路由。                如果您遇到严重的延迟问题，您可能希望切换到Steam Sockets Direct方法，或者更好的选择是LiteNetLib。这种中继游戏方式有时会导致游戏在等待Steam客户端响应时冻结，以及其他类似的不愉快情况。  其他方法需要通过IP地址进行连接，但不经过Valve的服务器，因此根据您和朋友相对于Valve数据中心以及彼此的地理位置，可能会快得多。  如果此网络方法无响应（连接在几分钟后超时、冻结等），请使用更好的框架。我们希望它能更好地工作，但现实就是如此。

column1: This isn't like most strategy games, where if there's an enemy force that is weak, you should take what they have.  If you go around trying to conquer everything, YOU WILL LOSE -- or you're playing on too low of a difficulty setting for your skill level.  Various actions that you take -- primarily destroying AI command stations or warp gates, but also other things -- cause the AI Progress (AIP) to go up.  The AIP will go up by several hundred over the course of a normal multi-hour game, and that's basically the AI taking more notice of you and being more interested in snuffing you out.  At the start of the game you aren't really worthy of notice, and it's distracted with something else unseen.  As you capture planets -- which you must do to capture new fleets and citadels, get more science and hacking points, improve your economy, and so on -- the AI is basically starting to realize that you're more of a threat than it thought, and decides to allocate more of its attention and resources to you rather than the unseen distraction it starts out dealing with.  The game will get significantly harder whenever the AIP increases enough to grant the AI a new Mark Level. You can see when this will happen by hovering over the AIP section of the Resource Bar at the top of the screen.  AIP is, in a lot of very real ways, your most important resource.  By capturing a planet and incurring an AIP increase, you're essentially making the AI stronger... but you've also just gotten some new stuff for yourself.  If you choose your targets well, then your strength goes up by more than the equivalent AIP.  Aka, you made a net gain.  Let's talk about that in a separate topic, though.
column2: 这和大多数策略游戏不同，在那些游戏中，如果有一支弱小的敌军，你应该夺取他们的资源。  如果你四处试图征服一切，你将会输掉游戏——或者你的难度设置对于你的技能水平来说太低了。  你采取的各种行动——主要是摧毁 AI 的指挥站或虫洞门，但也包括其他行动——会导致 AI 进度值（AIP）上升。  在一场通常持续数小时的游戏过程中，AIP 会上升数百点，这基本上意味着 AI 开始更加关注你，并更有兴趣消灭你。游戏开始时，你其实并不值得关注，AI 正被其他看不见的事情分散注意力。  当你占领行星时——你必须这样做才能获得新的舰队和战斗空间站、获得更多的科研和入侵点数、改善你的经济等等——AI 基本上开始意识到你比它想象的更具威胁，于是决定将更多的注意力和资源分配给你，而不是一开始处理的看不见的事情。  每当 AIP 增加到足以让 AI 提升一个等级时，游戏难度就会显著增加。你可以将鼠标悬停在屏幕顶部资源栏的 AIP 部分，查看这种情况何时会发生。  从很多实际意义上来说，AIP 是你最重要的资源。通过占领一个行星并导致 AIP 增加，你本质上是让 AI 变得更强了……但你自己也获得了一些新东西。如果你选择的目标得当，那么你的实力提升会超过相应的 AIP 提升。也就是说，你获得了净收益。不过，我们会在另一个主题中讨论这个问题。

column1: This makes a direct connection from the clients to the host, and is likely the fastest solution.  Certainly if you are on a LAN, this is by far the fastest.                  Depending on the configuration of the host's router, NAT punch through may work, or the host might have to set up port forwarding (which is a hassle to most people).  Give this a shot and if it works without port forwarding (that's a host-only setting), then awesome.  This would be the fastest networking you can get, as it's direct.  If this doesn't work immediately, then you can either learn how to set up port forwarding for the host's router, or your can hop on a VPN together, or you can use a different networking framework.                If you have set up a VPN like Hamachi or Tunngle with a friend, then you can play over that as if it was a LAN, but it introduces significant slowdown compared to a direct connection (partly because of encryption, and partly because of potentially using relay servers).  All data is sent on the single UDP port you have requested (it uses multiple channels to make sure data does not clog up), so that is all you have to have open on your firewall.
column2: 这会在客户端和主机之间建立直接连接，可能是最快的解决方案。如果您在局域网中，这绝对是最快的方式。                根据主机路由器的配置，NAT穿透可能会生效，否则主机可能需要设置端口转发（这对大多数人来说很麻烦）。您可以尝试一下，如果无需端口转发（这是主机端的设置）就能正常工作，那就太好了。由于是直接连接，这将是您能获得的最快网络连接。  如果此方法不能立即生效，您可以学习如何为主机路由器设置端口转发，或者和朋友一起使用VPN，也可以选择其他网络框架。                如果您和朋友已经设置了像Hamachi或Tunngle这样的VPN，那么就可以像在局域网中一样进行游戏，但与直接连接相比，会引入明显的延迟（部分原因是加密，部分原因是可能使用中继服务器）。  所有数据都会通过您请求的单个UDP端口发送（它使用多个通道以确保数据不会堵塞），因此您只需在防火墙中开放该端口即可。

column1: This only happens above a certain AI Progress (AIP) depending on the difficulty level of the AI you have selected, but it's a major new behavior that was not in the first game.          This makes it so that you can't always just leave neutral planets sitting there empty as a buffer.  You might find yourself facing down a deadly Usurper and its attendant forces that are going to take that planet back.  They come in a wave that does give you some warning, so there is that.  If the AI does take a planet back, don't worry that it will cost you AIP again if you take it back from them a second time.  If you've captured it once before in the past, you don't have to pay the AIP penalty a second time.
column2: 这取决于所选AI难度和AI进度(AIP)是否达到阈值，是前作没有的重要新行为。          这意味着你不能总是把中立行星留作空置缓冲地带。可能会遭遇致命的篡夺者及其随从部队来夺回行星。它们会以波次形式出现，至少会给你一些预警。  如果AI确实夺回了行星，别担心第二次夺回会再次增加AIP。只要之前占领过一次，第二次就不会再支付AIP惩罚。

column1: This powerful hybrid grafts Neinzul tech onto a powerful Templar vessel with a tractor beam and a tachyon array. This hybrid has an anti-engine weapon
column2: 这个强大的混合体将奈祖尔科技嫁接到强大的圣殿骑士单位上，配备牵引光束和超光速粒子阵列。此混合体拥有反引擎武器。

column1: This powerful hybrid grafts Neinzul tech onto a powerful Zenith chassy. From its zenith roots, this hybrid is extra tanky and regenerates health over time. This hybrid has anti-engine weapons.
column2: 这个强大的混合体将奈祖尔科技嫁接到强大的天顶底盘上。从天顶根源来说，此混合体特别耐久且随时间恢复生命。此混合体拥有反引擎武器。

column1: This powerful hybrid grafts Neinzul tech onto a spire battleship chassy. From its spire roots, this hybrid does a lot of damage but is not as tanky. This hybrid has anti-engine weapons.
column2: 这个强大的混合体将奈祖尔科技嫁接到尖塔战列舰底盘上。从尖塔根源来说，此混合体输出极高但耐久较低。此混合体拥有反引擎武器。

column1: This powerful hybrid grafts Spire tech onto a powerful Neinzul vessel. From its neinzul roots, this hybrid has a cloaking device and gains health from its main gun. This hybrid has a powerful coilbeam.
column2: 这个强大的混合体将尖塔科技嫁接到强大的奈祖尔单位上。从奈祖尔根源来说，此混合体拥有隐形装置且主炮能吸取生命。此混合体拥有强大的线圈光束。

column2: 这个强大的混合体将圣殿骑士科技嫁接到强大的奈祖尔单位上。从奈祖尔根源来说，此混合体拥有隐形装置且主炮能吸取生命。此混合体可以将敌人转化为己方力量。

column1: This powerful hybrid grafts Templar tech onto a powerful Zenith chassy. From its zenith roots, this hybrid is extra tanky and regenerates health over time. This hybrid can purify its foes to convert them to your cause.
column2: 这个强大的混合体将圣殿骑士科技嫁接到强大的天顶底盘上。从天顶根源来说，此混合体特别耐久且随时间恢复生命。此混合体可以净化敌人将其转化为你方力量。

column1: This powerful hybrid grafts Templar tech onto a spire battleship chassy. From its spire roots, this hybrid does a lot of damage but is not as tanky. This hybrid can purify its foes to convert them to your cause.
column2: 这个强大的混合体将圣殿骑士科技嫁接到尖塔战列舰底盘上。从尖塔根源来说，此混合体输出极高但耐久较低。此混合体可以净化敌人将其转化为你方力量。

column2: 这个强大的混合体将天顶科技嫁接到强大的奈祖尔单位上。从奈祖尔根源来说，此混合体拥有隐形装置且主炮能吸取生命。此混合体拥有追踪炸弹。

column1: This powerful hybrid grafts Zenith tech onto a powerful Templar vessel with a tractor beam and a tachyon array. This hybrid has a seekerbomb
column2: 这个强大的混合体将天顶科技嫁接到强大的圣殿骑士单位上，配备牵引光束和超光速粒子阵列。此混合体拥有追踪炸弹。

column1: This powerful hybrid grafts Zenith tech onto a spire battleship chassy. From its spire roots, this hybrid does a lot of damage but is not as tanky. This hybrid has a powerful seekerbomb
column2: 这个强大的混合体将天顶科技嫁接到尖塔战列舰底盘上。从尖塔根源来说，此混合体输出极高但耐久较低。此混合体拥有强大的追踪炸弹。

column1: This powerful ship helps the AI fight off the Dyson and Reapers.
column2: 这个强大的单位帮助AI对抗戴森和收割者。

column1: This powerful ship is a prototype developed by the AI to combat the Scourge. When killed it can be claimed as a player flagship.
column2: 这个强大的单位是AI为对抗天灾而开发的原型。被击杀后可作为玩家旗舰认领。

column1: This powerful ship is able to fight the AI's Enemies very effectively from range.
column2: 这个强大的单位能够从远距离有效对抗AI的敌人。

column1: This powerful ship is used by the AI to counter Dyson and Reaper forces.
column2: 这个强大的单位被AI用来对抗戴森和收割者部队。

column1: This powerful ship is used to provide beachhead support for AI assault forces. The planetary attrition damage softens up defenses, while the bubble forcefield provides durability for the attack.
column2: 这个强大的单位用于为AI突击部队提供滩头阵支援。行星消耗伤害削弱了防御，而气泡力场为进攻提供了耐久度。

column1: This powerful ship relies on engine stunning and their speed to harass enemies.
column2: 这个强大的单位依靠引擎眩晕和速度来骚扰敌人。

column1: This projectile explodes for area damage if it gets in melee range of its primary target, turning into a barbed tractor net that punishes ships that try to escape its grasp by reflecting their damage.
column2: 如果该飞弹接近主要目标进入近战范围，就会爆炸造成范围伤害，并转变为带刺牵引网，通过反射伤害来惩罚试图挣脱的舰船。

column1: This projectile will hone towards a massive mobile enemy and attach itself with its reverse tractor beam. While tractored this way, the target's speed will grind to a halt. Only the strongest engines can resist this malus.
column2: 这种投射物会追踪大型移动敌人，并使用反向牵引光束附着在目标上。被牵引时，目标的速度将降为零。只有最强劲的引擎才能抵抗这种负面影响。

column1: This projectile will hone towards a massive mobile enemy and deal extreme damage, turning into an anchor tractor beam that can hold even a Golem in place but only for a few moments.
column2: 这种飞弹会锁定大型移动敌人并造成巨额伤害，随后转变为锚定牵引光束，即使是巨像级单位也能被短暂定身。

column1: This prototype merges a human strikecraft line with unstable alien weapondry. Only able to make a few shots, it then becomes a bomb itself. These attacks also give a lingering charge to enemies, which explode violently when destroyed.
column2: 这个原型将人类打击机系列与不稳定的外星武器融合。只能发射几发，然后自身变成炸弹。这些攻击还会给敌人留下持续电荷，在摧毁时剧烈爆炸。

column1: This reclaimed Zenith Bastion is 'too big to fail' but also too big to fit in a transport and gets outrun by Tortoids.
column2: 这个回收的天顶堡垒'大而不倒'，但也太大无法装入运输舰，而且跑得比龟族还慢。

column1: This relatively large Clanling ship boasts a powerful area of effect weapon to harass its foes, as well as a shorter range weapon for defense, and spawns Turtles and Puffins.
column2: 这艘相对较大的氏族舰船拥有一门强大的范围伤害武器来骚扰敌人，还有一门较短射程的防御武器，并能孵化乌龟和海雀幼体。

column1: This relatively large Clanling ship boasts a relatively powerful Lance and spawns Snakes and Apes.
column2: 这艘相对较大的氏族舰船拥有一门相当强大的长枪炮，并能孵化蛇和猿幼体。

column1: This relatively large Clanling ship boasts some very cost-effective durability and firepower and spawns Cheetah and Badgers.
column2: 这艘相对较大的氏族舰船拥有非常划算的耐久度和火力，并能孵化猎豹和獾幼体。

column1: This relatively large Clanling ship has powerful short ranged lightning shots and spawns Bees and Archerfish.
column2: 这艘相对较大的氏族舰船拥有强大的短程闪电射击能力，并能孵化蜜蜂和射水鱼幼体。

column1: This remotely operated drone is capable of hacking targets AND remaining invisible. After ~90 seconds it will burn itself out, so you might want to transfer any ship lines off it before then...Oh yea, and the target may not SEE this drone but it will be Extremely Aware of its activities and send an increased hacking response.
column2: 这架远程操作无人机能够入侵目标并保持隐形。约90秒后它会自毁，所以你最好在那之前转移任何单位生产线……哦对了，目标可能看不见这架无人机，但它会极度警觉其活动并发送更强的入侵响应。

column1: This sapper patrols the galaxy building things. They will either build economic structures for themselves or structures to empower their allies.  Not a powerful combatant. Relies on its engine paralyzing gun to escape foes.
column2: 这名工兵在星系中巡逻并建造设施。他们要么为自己建造经济建筑，要么为盟友建造增强实力的建筑。  并非强大的战斗单位。依靠其引擎瘫痪炮来摆脱敌人。

column1: This seed will become a Flower, that finally develops into a Corbomite Crystal. Flowers can only grow on on AI planets, as they draw on AI energy sources. The AI will attack them as they grow, so you'll want to neuter some nearby planets.  Corbomite Crystals can be harvested for resources.
column2: 这颗种子将长成一朵花，最终发育为一颗科波麦特水晶。花朵只能在AI行星上生长，因为它们汲取AI的能量源。AI会在其生长时发起攻击，因此你最好先肃清附近的一些行星。    科波麦特水晶可被采集以获取资源。

column1: This selects all engineers on the current planet
column2: 这会选择当前行星上的所有工程师

column1: This selects all non-flagship military forces.
column2: 这会选择所有非旗舰的军事力量。

column1: This serpent is a powerful flagship for the Dark Zenith. It uses a powerful lightning blasts, and has some modular upgrades.  Like all Dark Zenith Serpent-class Flagships, it will regenerate its health over time.
column2: 这条蛇是暗天顶的强大旗舰。它使用强力的闪电爆炸，并具有一些模块化升级。    与所有暗天顶巨蛇级旗舰一样，它会随时间恢复生命值。

column1: This setting controls the strength that each CPA Bunker will release.
column2: 此设置控制每个CPA碉堡将释放的强度。

column1: This shadow dissolves its enemies with corrosive weapons.
column2: 这暗影用腐蚀武器溶解敌人。

column1: This shadow drives its targets to madness by reflecting their damage back at them.
column2: 这暗影通过将伤害反射回目标将其逼疯。

column1: This shadow hungers for life, using deadly vampiric jaws.
column2: 这暗影渴望生命，使用致命的吸血颚。

column1: This shadow terrifies its enemies with jammed weapons.
column2: 这暗影通过干扰敌人的武器来恐吓它们。

column1: This shapeless monstrosity, faintly self-luminous, wields a deadly weapon.
column2: 这个无形的怪物，散发着微弱的光芒，装备着致命的武器。

column1: This ship does more damage as its health decreases, and on death it splits into copies of itself.
column2: 这个单位生命值越低造成的伤害越高，死亡时分裂为自身的复制体。

column1: This ship drains the life from its enemies, especially against weakly engined ships, and on death it splits into copies of itself.
column2: 这个单位吸取敌人的生命，对引擎较弱的单位尤为有效，死亡时分裂为自身的复制体。

column1: This ship enhances all other ships in the system allied to it. it increases speed slightly and adds 50% damage. WARNING this does stack for all targeting computers on the planet
column2: 这个单位增强系统中所有友方单位。它略微提高速度并增加 50% 伤害。警告：这会与行星上所有目标计算机叠加。

column1: This ship has powerful adaptive multishot guns, and on death it splits into copies of itself.
column2: 这个单位拥有强大的自适应多管炮，死亡时分裂为自身的复制体。

column1: This ship has powerful coilbeams, and on death it splits into copies of itself.
column2: 这个单位拥有强大的线圈光束，死亡时分裂为自身的复制体。

column1: This ship heals from feeding on weak enemies, and creates hostile-to-all zombies. On death it splits into copies of itself.
column2: 这个单位通过吞噬弱小敌人来治疗自己，并创造全敌对僵尸。死亡时分裂为自身的复制体。

column1: This ship is endlessly tormented by Tyderian; it uses powerful corrosive guns.  Upon death, it spawns additional Tyderian enhanced ships.
column2: 这个单位被泰德瑞安无尽地折磨；它使用强大的腐蚀炮。  死亡时会生成额外的泰德瑞安强化单位。

column1: This ship is harvesting metal from all destroyed enemies. this may improve the attack in future raids to.
column2: 该舰从所有被摧毁的敌人处回收金属。这可能会增强未来的突袭。

column1: This ship is the primary worker for the Reclaimers. It can construct outposts on contested systems for scouting and reinforcement suppression.
column2: 这艘船是回收者的主要工作者。它可以在争议星系建造前哨站用于侦察和增援压制。

column1: This ship is the vanguard of your Spire forces. It will help you survive until you can find some Relics
column2: 这个单位是您尖塔部队的先锋。它将帮助您在找到遗物之前存活下来

column1: This ship leads the forces of your Armada; the Kilrathi lead the coalition this war.
column2: 此单位领导你的无敌舰队；基拉西在此战争中领导联盟。

column1: This ship leads the forces of your Armada; the Terrans lead the coalition this war.
column2: 此单位领导你的无敌舰队；人类在此战争中领导联盟。

column1: This ship relies a weak cloaking device to get into position for a powerful AOE Lightning Blast.
column2: 这个单位依靠弱隐形装置来获取位置释放强力范围闪电爆炸。

column1: This ship relies on a Retribution Shot for defense, and uses a torpedo system that does more damage at high range for offense.
column2: 这艘舰船依靠报复射击进行防御，并使用鱼雷系统在高射程下造成更高伤害来进攻。

column1: This ship seems to be spawning in more ships over time. destroy it before there's too much enemies
column2: 这个单位似乎在随时间生成更多单位。在敌人太多之前摧毁它。

column1: This ship seems to run through a life cycle of spawning and, growing
column2: 这个单位似乎经历着生成和成长的生命周期。

column1: This ship suppresses the guns of its targets, and on death it splits into copies. The copies will explode on death suppressing the guns of nearby ships.
column2: 这个单位压制目标的武器，死亡时分裂为若干复制体。复制体死亡时爆炸并压制附近单位的武器。

column1: This should be overridden by different types for each minor faction that wants a beacon
column2: 该描述应当被每个想要信标的小派系覆盖

column1: This should never be seen in the UI, and is just used for helping with tutorials.
column2: 此选项不应在用户界面中显示，仅用于教程辅助。

column1: This should never be seen in the UI, and is just used for populating the test chamber.
column2: 此选项不应在用户界面中显示，仅用于填充测试室。

column1: This slow, massive anti-captial ship torpedo will destroy anything it impacts.
column2: 这种缓慢、巨大的反主力舰鱼雷将摧毁其撞击到的任何物体。

column1: This space features a cluster of micro singularities blocking safe travel.
column2: 此空间区域有一簇微型奇点，阻挡安全通行。

column1: This structure acts as a lure to all Militant Dyson factions. They will all just try to destroy it and everything along the way regardless of whose it is.
column2: 这个建筑会吸引所有激进戴森派系的注意。无论属于哪方，他们都会试图摧毁它及其路径上的一切。

column1: This structure appears to house a variety of Zenith materials and technology that we could study for future use. While we can destroy the structure to access the alien technology within, the Architrave will likely respond to this structure's destruction.
column2: 该建筑似乎存放着各种天顶星材料和技术，可供我们未来研究使用。虽然我们可以摧毁这座建筑以获取其中的外星技术，但拱心石势力很可能会对该建筑的损毁做出反应。

column1: This structure can be built near a wormhole to suppress it. This is permanent once built so choose carefully, it cannot be scrapped. Do to the nature of the galactic medium, this device is unable to completely isolate a planet from the galaxy and if that happens, a new wormhole will form soon thereafter.
column2: 此建筑可在虫洞附近建造以压制它。一旦建造就永久存在，请谨慎选择，无法拆除。由于银河介质的性质，该设备无法完全隔离行星与银河系，如果发生这种情况，不久后就会形成新的虫洞。

column1: This structure grants direct access to the core network of the AI, where you can greatly damage the AI's processing capabilities. By Hacking this unit you can significantly reduce AI Progress, but the AI will violently respond with many ships to stop your hack. Destroying the AI command station on the planet will prevent you from using the Super Terminal. You can only hack the Super Terminal one time before the AI locks down the firewall to prevent further access.  The intensity of the response is increased by the number of human empires and Sidekicks present, so three human empires leads to 3x as strong a response.
column2: 该结构可直接访问 AI 的核心网络，在此你可以极大地削弱 AI 的处理能力。通过黑入该单位可以显著降低 AI 进度，但 AI 会猛烈反击派遣大量舰队阻止你的黑入。摧毁该行星上的 AI 指挥站将阻止你使用超级终端。每局只能黑入一次，之后 AI 会锁定防火墙。反击强度随人类帝国数量增加而增强。

column1: This structure grants direct access to the core network of the AI, where you can greatly damage the AI's processing capabilities. By Hacking this unit you can significantly reduce AI Progress, but the AI will violently respond with many ships to stop your hack. Destroying the AI command station on the planet will prevent you from using the Super Terminal. You can only hack the Super Terminal one time before the AI locks down the firewall to prevent further access.  The intensity of the response is increased by the number of human empires present, so three human empires leads to 3x as strong a response.
column2: 该建筑提供对 AI 核心网络的直接访问，您可以在此严重损害 AI 的处理能力。通过入侵该单位，您可以大幅降低 AI 进程，但 AI 将使用大量单位猛烈回击以阻止您的入侵。摧毁该行星上的 AI 指挥站将使您无法使用超级终端。AI 锁定防火墙阻止进一步访问之前，您只能入侵超级终端一次。反击强度会因人类帝国的数量而增加，因此三个人类帝国将导致三倍强度的反击。

column1: This structure has been constructed around what once was a wormhole endpoint. While it exists it suppresses the wormhole and blocks travel.
column2: 此建筑建在曾经的虫洞端点周围。只要它存在，就能抑制虫洞并阻止穿行。

column1: This structure is a hub for the Dire Macrophage Infestation. Its Harvesters will harvest metal and return it here. When Dire Macrophages return here with a full shipment of metal, this Dire Telium will gain permanent income. May produce a variety of things in addition to beefed up stock Macrophage, such as defenses, carriers and siege units.
column2: 该结构是可怕巨噬细胞感染的中枢。其采集者将收集金属并带回此地。当可怕巨噬细胞带着满载金属返回时，该可怕 Telium 将获得永久收入。除加强版普通巨噬细胞外，还能生产各种物品，如防御工事、航母和攻城单位。

column1: This structure is a hub for the Macrophage Infestation. Macrophages will harvest metal and return it here. Killing this structure will Enrage the Macrophages it has produced, and should not be done lightly.
column2: 这个建筑是巨噬细胞感染的枢纽。巨噬细胞会采集金属并带回这里。摧毁这个建筑会激怒它所产生的巨噬细胞，所以不要轻易这么做。

column1: This structure produces powerful scourge monsters to defend your territory
column2: 此建筑生产强大的天灾怪物来保卫你的领土。

column1: This support structure built by the Conquest Lieutenant provides additional Reconquest budget.
column2: 这个由征服副官建造的支援结构提供额外的再征服预算。

column1: This support structure built by the Logistics Lieutenant greatly accellerates AI ship speeds.
column2: 这个由后勤副官建造的支援结构极大地加速了AI单位的速度。

column1: This tame elderling only takes its wrath on your foes.
column2: 这只驯服的长老只对你的敌人发泄怒火。

column1: This tanky ship is effective against enemies with low radiation shielding.
column2: 这个坚韧的单位对低辐射护盾的敌人有效。

column1: This tanky ship is effective against thinly armored targets.
column2: 这个坚韧的单位对薄装甲目标有效。

column1: This tanky spider slows and paralyzes its enemies.
column2: 这艘坚韧的蜘蛛舰能减速并麻痹敌人。

column1: This unusual system has only one planet and the planet itself is even stranger: a rocky world the size of a gas giant. It is not thought possible for this to form naturally, so one theory is someone consolidated the entire mineral wealth of the system together in preparation for the construction of ... something? Unfortunately, the result for us is almost no easily minable asteroids and a really, really big planet.
column2: 这个不寻常的星系只有一颗行星，而行星本身更加奇怪：一颗气态巨行星大小的岩石世界。人们认为这不可能自然形成，因此一种理论是某人将整个星系的全部矿物财富整合在一起，准备建造……什么东西？不幸的是，留给我们的结果是几乎没有容易开采的小行星和一个非常非常大的行星。

column1: This variant of the Templar serves the AI regardless of whether there is a Necromancer. These Templar build powerful defensive structures across the galaxy, to make your life harder. They also launch periodic assaults against you.  I have no idea how remotely balanced they will be against Non-Necromancer player types, but people have expressed an interest in finding out. The only change from the default behaviour is that Rifts won't spawn, since only the Necromancer can interact with them.  If you have this faction enabled and also turn on the Necromancer, you'll get two Templar factions, but I'm not sure how well behaved that will be. This is not supported behaviour.
column2: 该变体的圣殿骑士无论是否有死灵法师都会为AI服务。这些圣殿骑士在整个银河中建造强大的防御建筑，让你的生活更加艰难。他们也会定期对你发起突击。  我完全不知道他们对于非死灵法师玩家类型的平衡性如何，但有人表达了想要了解的意愿。与默认行为的唯一区别是裂痕不会生成，因为只有死灵法师可以与之交互。  如果你启用了该派系，同时也开启了死灵法师，你会得到两个圣殿骑士派系，但我不确定这会表现得多好。这不是受支持的行为。

column1: This vastly alters gameplay, so you should only turn it on if you're having dire performance issues or need to test something.  With this setting on, shots are never fired; instead, they instantly just hit their targets.             This makes battles look very unspectacular, visually, and it also changes balance in a variety of subtle ways.  This is mostly for playing on true toasters or testing something when shots are working improperly.
column2: 这会极大改变游戏玩法，只应在遇到严重性能问题或需要测试时启用。启用后，射击不会被发射，而是直接命中目标。             这会使战斗视觉效果变得平淡，也会以各种微妙方式改变游戏平衡。主要用于在性能极低的设备上运行游戏，或测试射击功能不正常的情况。

column1: This was done to keep the fuel mechanic from being too punishing. One developer concern was that players would be stretched thin in protecting their planets and unable to acquire more fuel to do so if it was consolidated into a single resource similar to energy.     Partly for that reason, Radon is more plentiful at the start of the game and also in the additional fuel stations scattered throughout the galaxy. This ensures the player can have a solid foundation and invest significantly in turrets and other defenses if they choose to do so, while still allowing somewhat tighter controls for mobile ships via Argon, and Arks/Golems/Outguard via Xenon. It also allows the balance for each of these different areas to be tuned independently without affecting the other resources if needed.  -Strategic Sage
column2: 这样做是为了避免燃料机制过于惩罚性。开发者担心的一个问题是，如果将燃料整合为类似能量的单一资源，玩家在保护行星时会捉襟见肘，无法获取更多燃料来维持防御。  部分基于这个原因，氡气在游戏开始时较为充足，在星系中分布的额外燃料站中也是如此。这确保了玩家可以有一个坚实的基础，如果他们选择的话可以大量投资于炮塔和其他防御设施，同时通过氩气对移动单位进行相对严格的控制，通过氙气控制方舟/巨像/前哨。这也允许在需要时独立调整这些不同领域的平衡，而不会影响其他资源。  -Strategic Sage

column1: To: Commander {PlayerName} From: Demetri Rosenbaum, Chief Communications Officer  Commander,  We’ve picked up faint background activity broadcasting from an anomalous AI data center. On further inspection, we’ve detected a heavily encrypted message originating from … well, somewhere off the warp grid, as best as we can tell. Incredibly, someone figured out a way to corrupt the data center’s transceiver, locking out the AI from accessing its external memory banks and hijacking its transmitter.   We almost missed a second, unencrypted message. It’s a looped recording, claiming there is a decentralized resistance movement against the AI. If we can decrypt the primary message, we will learn the hailing frequencies of these “Outguards,” as we’ve internally labeled them.  This “Outguard Beacon” can access only a couple of the Outguard frequencies, but we believe more of these beacons are hiding in plain sight. If we are able to successfully open a hailing channel, these Outguards will be powerful allies that we can call in desperation. The AI will certainly try to prevent this, and this should not be attempted without sufficient forces.    We will be able to share some of our technology with these Outguards, and they will be able to summon stronger forces if we have compatible ships. However, they lack the manufacturing capabilities to produce high mark ships as efficiently as our factories, so we can expect to see fewer ships as their mark increases. They will need time to regather their strength between summons, so we should be wary of calling without need.   As a personal note, it gives me hope to see signs of others fighting the machine menace. I’m sure they need us as much as we need them.
column2: 致：指挥官 {PlayerName} 发自：首席通信官德米特里·罗森鲍姆  指挥官，  我们检测到一个异常 AI 数据中心发出的微弱背景活动信号。经过进一步检查，我们发现了一条加密程度很高的消息，据我们判断，它似乎来自超空间网格之外的某个地方。令人难以置信的是，有人想出了一种方法来破坏数据中心的收发器，阻止 AI 访问其外部内存库并劫持其发射器。   我们差点错过第二条未加密的消息。这是一条循环录音，声称存在一个针对 AI 的去中心化抵抗运动。如果我们能够解密主消息，我们将得知这些我们内部称之为“前哨守卫”的组织的通讯频率。  这个“前哨守卫信标”只能访问几个前哨守卫的通讯频率，但我们相信还有更多这样的信标就隐藏在显眼的地方。如果我们能够成功打开通讯频道，这些前哨守卫将成为我们在绝境中可以求助的强大盟友。AI 肯定会试图阻止这一点，因此在没有足够兵力的情况下，不应尝试这样做。  我们将能够与这些前哨守卫分享我们的一些技术，如果我们有兼容的飞船，他们将能够召唤更强大的力量。然而，他们缺乏像我们的工厂那样高效生产高级战舰的制造能力，因此随着战舰等级的提高，我们预计看到的战舰数量会减少。他们在召唤之间需要时间重新集结力量，因此我们在求助时应谨慎行事。  作为个人感言，看到有其他人在对抗机器威胁的迹象让我充满希望。我相信他们和我们一样需要彼此。

column1: Turret designs are under research in three isolated sectors.  Most are recognizably human in origin, but the AI has been making various updates, including adapting in alien technology in some cases.  You can hack to retrieve the blueprints for just one per sector before the AI is alerted and shuts down that sector.  Once all three sectors are breached, the server will self-destruct.          A successful hack of this sort will grant a new defensive line ONLY to the battlestation or citadel that did the hack, but it will grant thrice the normal amount to them.  One a sector is hacked, it reveals a whole new set of potential defensive lines from the next sector.  As you hack the structure successive times, the AI response gets increasingly ferocious; so do be careful of that.  The last sector can also be prohibitively expensive to hack, so unless you have no other options you may wish to leave it at just two.

column1: Units in the game have a number of stats; Albedo, armor, etc...   These stats are properties describing units; they don't have any inherent mechanical impact. A unit's speed isn't directly affected by its engine stat, for example.  Some weapons systems do interact with those stats. Weapons might do bonus damage to units with certain types of armor (or less damage to units with certain types of armor), but a unit's armor has no mechanical impact on anything else in the game. The same is true for the other stats.  See https://wiki.arcengames.com/index.php?title=AI_War_2:_Units_of_Measurement
column2: 游戏中的单位有许多数据，如反照率、护甲等……  这些数据是描述单位的属性，它们本身并没有机械性的影响。例如，单位的速度并不直接受其引擎数据的影响。  一些武器系统确实会与这些数据产生交互。武器可能会对具有特定类型护甲的单位造成额外伤害（或者对某些类型护甲的单位造成较少伤害），但单位的护甲对游戏中的其他任何事物都没有机械性的影响。对于……（2244 个字符截断）

column1: Up to 10 Risk Analyzers are scattered throughout the galaxy. Each hour the AI uses them to analyze your presence, causing the AIP to go up 1 for each one. If you destroy one then it generates 10 AIP. If you capture them then you can feed the AI bad data; each captured Risk Analyzer brings the AIP down 2 per hour. The AI will launch Exogalactic Strikeforces against you with greater force the more Risk Analyzers you take. If an Analyzer is on an AI planet, it contributes very little to the Strikeforce's strength. If it's on a neutral planet, it adds a fair bit more. If you own the planet, it adds a LOT more strength over time.       <color=#f25e1c>HIGH IMPACT:</color> This is a notable boost to the AI, both increasing your AI Progress (AIP) and creating more attacks against you, the frequency and power of which depends on how you interact with them. Can open up some interesting strategies with the AIP reduction.
column2: 最多10个风险分析器散布在银河系各处。每小时AI会使用它们分析你的存在，每个分析器会使AIP增加1。如果摧毁一个分析器，会产生10点AIP。如果捕获它们，你可以向AI提供错误数据；每个被捕获的风险分析器每小时会使AIP降低2。你控制的分析器越多，AI发起的系外打击力量就越强大。如果分析器在AI行星上，对打击力量的贡献很小；在中立行星上贡献较大；如果在你拥有的行星上，随时间推移会极大增强打击力量。       <color=#f25e1c>高影响:</color> 这显著增强了AI，既增加了你的AI进度(AIP)，又创造了更多针对你的攻击，其频率和力量取决于你与它们的互动方式。可以通过AIP降低开启一些有趣的策略。

column1: Uses a potent but unstable ultra-capacitor variant, which was initially abandoned until an Enclave realized they could wire it to fully discharge when critically damaged.  The result is a fast, heavily armored Youngling that tears itself apart as it fires and unleashes a large lightning blast when destroyed, dealing increased damage the more shots it fired.

column2: 使用远比普通更强大的守护者，且数量也比正常情况下更多。

column2: 使用隐形运输旗舰和多个隐形或强化单位，深入敌后摧毁敌方据点。

column1: Usually AJEA does not display a notification when no faction is bleeding metal at least slightly significantly, or for some reason AJEA can't (reasonably) stabilize the economy. If this setting is enabled AJEA will always display its notification so long as it's enabled, running and converters exist, which makes it easy to see how good the economy may be.
column2: 通常AJEA不会在有派系严重失血或某种原因导致AJEA无法（合理地）稳定经济时显示通知。 如果启用此设置，只要AJEA启用、运行且有转换器存在，它就会始终显示通知，这样便于观察经济状况。

column1: Usually meant to be a moderate intensity faction that can help, but doesn't swing games by itself. However at higher intensities the number of forces it can recover from battles for future use can be excessive if not counter-balanced by the AI having some allies as well.
column2: 通常这是一个中等强度的派系，可以提供帮助但不会单独改变游戏进程。然而在较高强度下，如果AI没有一些盟友来平衡，它能从战斗中恢复用于未来的部队数量可能会过多。

column1: Vanilla is the standard tooltips, any other option is considered experimental and not part of the base game.  The second option, 'Experimental' does some work to show ship-class better and to use more icons within the tooltip for entity stats and inline-ship icons. The third option, 'Formatted' is a larger rewrite of all entity tooltips, including more icons, colors, line spacing, and rewording for clarity/brevity.

column1: Various remnants of humanity. While none will directly contend with us, their actions may not be entirely beneficial, especially if ignored
column2: 人类文明的零散残部。虽然它们不会直接与我们争夺，但其行动未必全然有益，尤其若对其置之不理。

column1: Various ship designs are under research in this structure in just a single sector, since this is the tutorial. In the main game, you can hack up to three times to steal blueprints, but here in the tutorial it is only one.  You can hack to retrieve the blueprints for just one per sector before the AI is alerted and shuts down that sector.  Once all the sectors are breached (in the tutorial, only one), the station will will self-destruct.          A successful hack will grant a new ship line to the hacking fleet, and then reveal a whole new set of potential ship lines from the next sector; it can later be moved to another fleet.  Normally, as you hack the structure successive times, the AI response gets increasingly ferocious; so in the main game it's a choice whether to keep hacking or not.  The last sector can also be prohibitively expensive to hack, so unless you have no other options you may wish to leave it at just two in the main game.  Here in the tutorial you don't have to worry about that.
column2: 由于这是教程，该建筑仅在一个区域内研究各种单位设计。在主游戏中，你最多可以破解三次来窃取蓝图，但在本教程中只能破解一次。在 AI 察觉并关闭该区域之前，你可以通过破解获取其中一个设计的蓝图。一旦所有区域（在教程中只有一个）都被攻破，该站点将自毁。          一次成功的破解将为执行破解的舰队授予一条新的单位生产线，然后揭示下一个区域的全新潜在单位生产线；之后它可以被转移到其他舰队。  通常情况下，随着你多次破解该建筑，AI 的反击会越来越猛烈；因此在主游戏中，是否继续破解是一个需要权衡的选择。最后一个区域的破解成本也可能高得令人望而却步，所以除非你别无选择，否则在主游戏中可能只破解前两个区域就够了。在本教程中，你无需担心这些问题。

column1: Various ship designs are under research in this structure in three isolated sectors.  Most are recognizably human in origin, but the AI has been making various updates, including adapting in alien technology in some cases.  You can hack to retrieve the blueprints for just one per sector before the AI is alerted and shuts down that sector.  Once all three sectors are breached, the station will self-destruct.          A successful hack will grant a new ship line to the hacking fleet, and then reveal a whole new set of potential ship lines from the next sector; it can later be moved to another fleet.  As you hack the structure successive times, the AI response gets increasingly ferocious; so do be careful of that.  The last sector can also be prohibitively expensive to hack, so unless you have no other options you may wish to leave it at just two.
column2: 该建筑的三个独立区域正在研究各种单位设计。大多数设计明显源自人类，但 AI 一直在进行各种改进，在某些情况下还融入了外星技术。在 AI 察觉并关闭该区域之前，你可以通过破解每个区域获取其中一个设计的蓝图。一旦三个区域都被攻破，该站点将自毁。          一次成功的破解将为执行破解的舰队授予一条新的单位生产线，然后揭示下一个区域的全新潜在单位生产线；之后它可以被转移到其他舰队。  随着你多次破解该建筑，AI 的反击会越来越猛烈；因此一定要小心。最后一个区域的破解成本也可能高得令人望而却步，所以除非你别无选择，否则可能只破解前两个区域就够了。

column1: Various things that you can capture or that give some other benefit are normally seeded a minimum of something like 3 or even 5 hops from human planets (when the map allows for that).               This allows for you to relax those restrictions, which can make for surprise early-game boons.  A Zenith Power Generator on your doorstep, and a SuperTerminal right next to it?  A Golem really close by?  Who knows!  It's worth noting that this only increases the restriction, but doesn't shift them all closer for sure.  Most of the time if this is increased all the way to 6, that will just mean 'anywhere in the galaxy' for things that are meant to be late-game otherwise.  This can make parts of the game easier, but it's ultimately going to be very random.
column2: 你可以捕获或提供其他好处的各种物品通常从人类行星至少3甚至5跳远的地方种植（当地图允许时）。               这允许你放宽这些限制，这可能带来意外的早期游戏福利。一个就在你家门口的天顶能量发生器，旁边还有一个超级终端？附近就有一个魔像？谁知道呢！  值得注意的是，这只增加限制，但不一定将它们全部移近。如果这个值增加到6，对于那些原本打算在游戏后期出现的东西，这通常只意味着'星系中的任何地方'。  这可以使游戏的某些部分变得更容易，但最终会变得非常随机。

column2: 非常强大的移动设施方舟旗舰。如果某舰队旗舰在同一或相邻行星上且缺少单位，则会自动生产替代品直接跃迁至该旗舰。同时生产无人机并产生一些能量。

column1: Very powerful nanobot-infested ship that does more damage to units in its tractor beams.
column2: 非常强大的被纳米机器人感染的战舰，对其牵引光束中的单位造成更多伤害。
非常强大的被纳米机器人感染的战舰。

column1: Very powerful ship scrubbed of its nanobots by the Zenith Trader, not as infectious as before but still very capable of zombifying things. The Trader won't sell you this if you already have two in the galaxy.
column2: 非常强大的战舰，其纳米机器人已被天顶商人净化，传染性不如从前，但仍极具使物体僵尸化的能力。如果星系中已有两艘此类战舰，商人将不会出售给你。

column1: Very powerful ship that annihilates groups of swarmers.
column2: 非常强大的单位，能歼灭成群的小型单位。

column1: Very powerful ship that deals disgusting damage to high energy usage targets.
column2: 非常强大的单位，对高能耗目标造成巨额伤害。

column1: Very powerful ship that deals disgusting damage to high energy usage targets. On death it splits into a number of Nucleophilic Hydras
column2: 非常强大的单位，对高能耗目标造成惊人伤害。死亡时分裂为若干亲核九头蛇。

column1: Very powerful ship that deals disgusting damage to high energy usage targets. The AI has made some hasty modifications to blindside the Devourer Golem with perfect radiation reflection and decreased damage upon arrival.
column2: 非常强大的单位，对高能量使用的目标造成惊人的伤害。AI 进行了一些仓促的改装，利用完美的辐射反射来偷袭吞噬者傀儡，并在刚抵达时减少伤害。

column1: Very powerful ship that deals disgusting damage with adaptive multishot guns. On death it splits into a number of Steel Hydras
column2: 非常强大的单位，使用自适应多管炮造成惊人伤害。死亡时分裂为若干钢铁九头蛇。

column1: Very powerful ship that deals high single target damage, and much more to forcefields.
column2: 非常强大的单位，能对单个目标造成高额伤害，对力场造成的伤害更高。

column1: Very powerful ship that deals high single target damage, and much more to forcefields. The AI has made some hasty modifications to blindside the Devourer Golem with perfect radiation reflection and decreased damage upon arrival. In exchange for lowered range and forcefield damage its output against all shields was increased.
column2: 非常强大的单位，对单个目标造成高伤害，对力场伤害更高。AI 进行了一些仓促的改装，利用完美的辐射反射来偷袭吞噬者傀儡，并在刚抵达时减少伤害。作为射程和力场伤害降低的交换，其对所有护盾的输出得到了提升。

column1: Very powerful ship that delivers deadly corrosive blasts that dissolve the hulls of their foes. On death it splits into a number of Corrosion Hydras.
column2: 非常强大的单位，释放致命的腐蚀爆炸溶解敌方船体。死亡时分裂为若干腐蚀九头蛇。

column1: Very powerful ship that delivers retributive shots based on how much damage it has taken. On death it splits into a number of Retribution Hydras.
column2: 非常强大的单位，根据所受伤害进行复仇反击。死亡时分裂为若干复仇九头蛇。

column1: Very powerful ship that does more damage as its health decrease. On death it splits into a number of Burlust Hydras
column2: 非常强大的单位，生命值越低造成的伤害越高。死亡时分裂为若干暴怒九头蛇。

column1: Very powerful ship that drains the life from its enemies, especially against ships with weak engines. On death it splits into a number of Bleeding Hydras
column2: 非常强大的单位，吸取敌人的生命，对引擎较弱的单位尤为有效。死亡时分裂为若干流血九头蛇。

column1: Very powerful ship that fires very painful missiles that demolish thinner hulled ships.
column2: 非常强大的单位，发射极具破坏力的导弹，能摧毁船体较薄的单位。

column1: Very powerful ship that has a strong coilbeam. On death it splits into a number of Spire Hydras
column2: 非常强大的单位，拥有强大的线圈光束。死亡时分裂为若干尖塔九头蛇。

column1: Very powerful ship that heals from feeding on weak enemies, and creates hostile-to-all zombies. On death it splits into a number of Burlust Hydras
column2: 非常强大的单位，通过吞噬弱小敌人来治疗自己并创造全敌对僵尸。死亡时分裂为若干暴怒九头蛇。

column1: Very powerful ship that suppresses the guns of its targets. On death it splits into a number of Suppressing Hydras
column2: 非常强大的单位，压制其目标的武器。死亡时分裂为若干压制九头蛇。

column1: Very powerful ship that uses an array of Polarizers to deal major damage to heavily armored ships. On death it splits into a number of Polarizer Hydras
column2: 非常强大的单位，使用极化器阵列对重装甲单位造成大量伤害。死亡时分裂为若干极化九头蛇。

column1: Very powerful ship with a scary Petard cannon for annihilating armored targets.
column2: 非常强大的单位，配备可怕的佩塔尔火炮，用于歼灭装甲目标。

column1: Very powerful ship with a very strong and large bubble forcefield, but weak weaponry. Units protected by this will deal full damage.
column2: 非常强大的单位，拥有非常强大且范围大的泡泡力场，但武器较弱。受其保护的单位将造成全额伤害。

column1: Very powerful ship with an AOE Tesla attack with a reload speed penalty.
column2: 非常强大的单位，拥有范围特斯拉攻击，但有装填速度惩罚。

column1: Very powerful ship with an AOE Tesla attack with a reload speed penalty. This varient also fires Tesla Torpedos.
column2: 非常强大的单位，拥有AOE特斯拉攻击但装填速度惩罚。此变体也发射特斯拉鱼雷。

column1: Very powerful tier 3 defensive structure; it fires swarms of corrosive rockets, designed to wear down large swarms of enemies.
column2: 非常强大的三级防御建筑；发射成群的腐蚀火箭，旨在消耗敌方大群单位。

column1: Very resilient to high-damage weapons, especially Orbital Mass Drivers and Sabots. It can never take more than 25% of its hull as damage from a single attack.
column2: 对高伤害武器极具韧性，尤其是轨道质量驱动器和脱壳弹。单次攻击永远无法对其造成超过25%船体的伤害。

column1: Very short range AOE blast, but protected against attacks from outside its range.
column2: 超短距离范围爆炸，但能抵御来自射程外的攻击。

column1: Very strong and allied to you.
Very strong and hostile to everyone.
column2: 非常强大且对所有势力怀有敌意。

column1: Very strong, and hates you in particular.
Very strong, and would like to be your friend and help out.
column2: 非常强大，但愿意成为您的朋友并提供帮助。

column1: Very useful!  Ignores what factions you select on the left dropdown.  Shows how much Threat strength there is at this planet from any source.  So this is threatfleet ships belonging to the AI Sentinels, and AI Hunter ships, mainly.
column2: 非常有用！忽略您在左侧下拉菜单中选择的阵营。显示该行星上来自任何来源的威胁强度。主要是AI哨兵的威胁舰队单位和AI猎手单位。

column1: Very weak and allied to you.
Very weak and allied to you.
Very weak and hostile to everyone.
column2: 非常弱小，对所有势力怀有敌意。

column1: Very weak and hostile to you.
Very weak, but would like to be your friend and help out.
column2: 非常弱小，但愿意成为您的朋友并提供帮助。
胜利场景: 色彩分级

column1: Vise wards encircle the Wrangler Destroyer, capturing smaller ships in its tractor beams and attacking them while they're vulnerable.
column2: 钳制守卫环绕在驯兽师驱逐舰周围，用牵引光束捕获小型舰船，并在它们脆弱时发动攻击。

column1: Volatile crystalline shard created by a Apatite Launcher. Rapidly generates electrical distortions around itself in a large area.
column2: 由磷灰石发射器产生的不稳定水晶碎片。在自身周围大范围内快速产生电畸变。

column1: Volume of all non-combat sound effects in general, relative to the combat sound effects.  Adjusting this keeps the relative volumes of sub-channels as they are.  Can range from 0 to 200.  This is relative to its starting value in the mixer, so the default is always 100.
column2: 所有非战斗音效相对于战斗音效的音量。调整此选项会保持各子频道的相对音量比例。范围0-200，相对于混音器中的起始值，默认始终为100。

column1: Volume of all sound effects in general, relative to the music.  Can range from 0 to 200.  This is relative to its starting value in the mixer, so the default is always 100.
column2: 所有音效相对于音乐的音量。范围0-200，相对于混音器中的起始值，默认始终为100。

column1: Volume of all sound in general, music and sound effects and so on.  Adjusting this keeps the relative volumes of sub-channels as they are.  Can range from 0 to 200.  This is relative to its starting value in the mixer, so the default is always 100.
column2: 所有声音的总音量，包括音乐和音效等。调整此选项会保持各子频道的相对音量比例。范围0-200，相对于混音器中的起始值，默认始终为100。

column1: Volume of click sound effects and other interface feedback.  Can range from 0 to 200.  This is relative to its starting value in the mixer, so the default is always 100.
column2: 点击音效和其他界面反馈的音量。范围0-200，相对于混音器中的起始值，默认始终为100。

column1: Volume of combat in general, relative to the interface and music.  Adjusting this keeps the relative volumes of sub-channels as they are.  Can range from 0 to 200.  The default is 60, because it's a bit overpowering sometimes, otherwise.
column2: 战斗音效相对于界面和音乐的音量。调整此选项会保持各子频道的相对音量比例。范围0-200，默认60，因为有时可能会过于响亮。

column1: Volume of larger ships of yours dying on other planets, so you can hear when combat is happening somewhere else in the galaxy at a distance.  Can range from 0 to 200.  This is relative to its starting value in the mixer, so the default is always 100.
column2: 你在其他行星上大型单位爆炸的音量，让你能听到银河系远处发生的战斗。范围0-200，相对于混音器中的起始值，默认始终为100。

column1: Volume of mainly things like wormhole traversals when you're on the same planet.  Can range from 0 to 200.  This is relative to its starting value in the mixer, which we felt was on the quiet side, so the default is 140.
column2: 当你观看行星战斗时，主要是虫洞穿越等音效的音量。范围0-200，相对于混音器中的起始值，我们认为起始值偏小，所以默认设为140。

column1: Volume of minor ships of yours dying on other planets, so you can hear when combat is happening somewhere else in the galaxy at a distance.  Can range from 0 to 200.  This is relative to its starting value in the mixer, so the default is always 100.
column2: 你在其他行星上小型单位爆炸的音量，让你能听到银河系远处发生的战斗。范围0-200，相对于混音器中的起始值，默认始终为100。

column1: Volume of the AI enemy.  Can range from 0 to 200.  This is relative to its starting value in the mixer, so the default is always 100.
column2: 敌方AI的音量。范围0-200，相对于混音器中的起始值，默认始终为100。

column1: Volume of the explosions of larger ships/structures when you're on the same planet.  Can range from 0 to 200.  This is relative to its starting value in the mixer, so the default is always 100.
column2: 当你在同一行星时，较大单位/建筑爆炸的音量。范围0-200，相对于混音器中的起始值，默认始终为100。

column1: Volume of the explosions of most ships/structures when you're on the same planet.  Can range from 0 to 200.  This is relative to its starting value in the mixer, so the default is always 100.
column2: 当你在同一行星时，大多数单位/建筑爆炸的音量。范围0-200，相对于混音器中的起始值，默认始终为100。

column1: Volume of the explosions of really important ships/structures when you're on the same planet.  Can range from 0 to 200.  This is relative to its starting value in the mixer, so the default is always 100.
column2: 当你在同一行星时，重要单位/建筑爆炸的音量。范围0-200，相对于混音器中的起始值，默认始终为100。

column1: Volume of the music, relative to all non-music sound.  Can range from 0 to 200.  This is relative to its starting value in the mixer, so the default is always 100.
column2: 音乐相对于其他非音乐声音的音量。范围0-200，相对于混音器中的起始值，默认始终为100。

column1: Volume of the sound of shots being fired when you're viewing combat on a planet.  Can range from 0 to 200.  The default is 40, because it's a bit overpowering sometimes, otherwise.
column2: 当你观看行星战斗时，武器开火的音量。范围0-200，默认40，因为有时可能会过于响亮。

column1: Volume of the sound of shots hitting their targets when you're viewing combat on a planet.  Can range from 0 to 200.  This is relative to its starting value in the mixer, so the default is always 100.
column2: 当你观看行星战斗时，武器命中目标的音量。范围0-200，相对于混音器中的起始值，默认始终为100。

column1: Volume of voice actors, mainly those responding to orders to ships.  Can range from 0 to 200.  This is relative to its starting value in the mixer, so the default is always 100.
column2: 语音演员的音量，主要是对单位指令的回应。范围0-200，相对于混音器中的起始值，默认始终为100。

column1: Volume of voice and nonverbal alerts of high importance.  Can range from 0 to 200.  This is relative to its starting value in the mixer, so the default is always 100.  Default is louder than average.
column2: 重要语音和非语音警报的音量。范围0-200，相对于混音器中的起始值，默认始终为100。默认值比平均值更响亮。

column1: Want to see the flairs on ship icons, such as Pursuit Mode, Hold Fire, or Paralysed?  Disable this to hide that, which may cause problems, and the only way to know what mode a unit is in is by having it selected and checking the active modes in the bottom right.  But it's cleaner, if you prefer that!
column2: 是否在单位图标上显示状态标记(如追击模式、停火或瘫痪)？禁用后将隐藏这些标记，可能会导致问题，您只能通过选中单位并查看右下角的活动模式来了解其状态。但如果您更喜欢简洁的界面，可以关闭此选项。

column1: Want to see the mark level indicators on ship icons?  Disable this to hide that... although that seems kinda foolish.  But it's cleaner, if you prefer that!
column2: 是否在单位图标上显示等级标记？禁用后将隐藏这些标记，虽然这看起来有点不明智。但如果您更喜欢简洁的界面，可以关闭此选项。

column1: Ward produced by advanced facilities of the Azaran Empire to protect against sudden assaults on the facilities.
column2: 由阿扎兰帝国高级设施产生的结界，用于保护设施免受突然袭击。

column1: Warden Fleet rally point. Destroying it delays the local Warden response.
column2: 守卫舰队集结点和增援点。

column1: Warheads giant weapons that you can acquire via hacking, and which are gone after a single use.  They tend to be very powerful.  Most of them are in DLC1.
column2: 飞弹武器是你可以通过入侵手段获取的巨型武器，使用一次后就会消失。它们通常非常强大，大多数在DLC1中。

column1: Warn when your Energy goes below this value.
column2: 当你的能量低于此值时发出警告。

column2: 当你的金属低于此值时发出警告。

column2: 黑暗天顶柱顶过梁正在跃迁，这里是黑暗天顶建造设施的地方。

column2: 黑暗天顶经济枢纽正在跃迁

column1: Was hidden inside the Artillery Golem prototype, and not happy. The AI has made modifications to blindside the Devourer Golem with perfect radiation reflection and decreased damage upon arrival. Its Plasma Torpedo launcher has fewer projectiles with more damage and is capable of focusing fire on a single target or spread it out if need be.
column2: 隐藏在火炮傀儡原型内部，而且很不高兴。AI 进行了改装，利用完美的辐射反射来偷袭吞噬者傀儡，并在刚抵达时减少伤害。其等离子鱼雷发射器拥有更少的飞弹但伤害更高，并能够集中火力攻击单个目标或根据需要分散攻击。

column1: Was hidden inside the Turiel Artillery, and not happy.
column2: 隐藏在Turiel火炮内部，而且不高兴。

column1: Was hidden inside the Warspite Artillery, and not happy.
column2: 原本隐藏在战争之怒火炮内部，现在非常愤怒。

column1: Watch your clock. The Imperial AI is always building more fortifications and hunters to patrol the empire.
column2: 看好你的时钟。帝国AI一直在建造更多的防御工事和猎手来巡逻帝国。

column1: We can overload the AI's security network to extract the records, but doing so will trigger a self destruct sequence.   Hacking this will allow the player to unlock a new Tech. Unlocking a Tech this way does not increase the cost of doing it with Science.
column2: 我们可以使 AI 的安全网络过载以提取记录，但这样做会触发自毁程序。   破解此目标将允许玩家解锁一项新科技。通过这种方式解锁科技不会增加使用科学点数解锁科技的成本。

column1: We discovered the hailing frequency the Zenith Trader responds to, and can briefly summon it to one of our planets. It will only remain for a brief time, so we must be willing to make our dealings quickly.
column2: 我们发现了天顶商人响应的呼叫频率，可以短暂地将其召唤到我们的一颗行星上。它只会停留很短的时间，所以我们必须迅速与其进行交易。

column1: We have encountered the Neinzul before, but never like this; now meet the full might of their Elderlings, wild hives, helpful sappers and more.        A new 'player type' of Necromancer also gives you entirely new ways to play the game -- gather Essence, fight the Templars, and harvest your enemies.  Initially Released: April 22nd, 2022
column2: 我们之前曾遇到过奈因祖尔，但从未像现在这样；现在来见识他们的长老、野生蜂群、有用的工兵等全部力量吧。        一种新的“玩家类型”——死灵法师，也为你提供了全新的游戏方式——收集精华，对抗圣殿骑士，并收割你的敌人。  初始发布日期：2022年4月22日

column1: We have previously encountered the Factoriel, which was less of a ship, and more a voracious swarm masquerading as one. This is like that. But larger. Much larger.
column2: 我们之前遇到过工厂，与其说是一艘船，不如说是一个伪装成船的贪婪蜂群。这个类似。但更大。大得多。

column1: We have previously encountered the Proteus, which was less of a ship, and more a voracious swarm masquerading as one. This is like that. But larger. Much larger.
column2: 我们之前遇到过普罗透斯，它与其说是一艘船，不如说是一个伪装成船的贪婪蜂群。这个也一样。但更大。大得多。

column1: We have received an offer of assistance by one who simply goes by Hydran. Their ship seems to be weak on offensive power, but is filled to the brim with paralyzing shots and redundancy systems.
column2: 我们收到了一位自称海德拉人的援助提议。他们的飞船似乎攻击力较弱，但装满了麻痹射击武器和冗余系统。

column1: We have succeeded in creating a living, growing by melding Zenith bio-organic self-expansion analyzed from the Devourer Chrysalises with Human armor and weapon tech. As it ranks up the ship will self-optimize, leading to higher damage resistance and weapon output, resulting in a vastly superior vessel. Even in its default form its weapons are diverse enough to deal with everything from the smallest bots to huge Golems.
column2: 我们成功地将从吞噬者蛹分析中获得的 Zenith 生物有机自我扩展与人类装甲和武器技术融合，创造了一个活着的、不断成长的单位。随着它升级，单位将自我优化，获得更高的伤害抗性和武器输出，最终成为一个极其优越的单位。即使在其默认形态下，其武器也足够多样化，可以应对从最小的机器人到巨大的傀儡的一切。

column1: We're getting transwarp signals from somewhere very far away, but we can't understand them.  Building this machine might just call in the cavalry, but also will intensely anger the AI.
column2: 我们从非常遥远的地方接收到超空间信号，但无法理解它们。建造这个装置可能会召唤援军，但也会激怒人工智能。

column1: We're getting transwarp signals from somewhere very far away, but we can't understand them.  Building this machine might just call in the cavalry, but also will intensely anger the AI.
column2: 我们正在接收到来自极远处的超时空信号，但无法解读其含义。建造这台机器可能招来援军，但也会极度激怒AI。

column1: We're getting transwarp signals from somewhere very far away, but we can't understand them.  Building this machine might just call in the cavalry, but also will intensely anger the AI. column1: Welcome to the first tutorial of AI War 2. This one is about moving the camera, plus selecting and ordering units.  Currently we're looking at our starting planet. Let's have a look around, first by moving the camera around.   First, move the mouse cursor to the edge of your screen. This will move the camera around in that direction. That can be pretty annoying for some people, though, so you can turn it off if you want.  Let's try something more conventional: use the WASD keys to move your camera around so that we can progress to the next step.  <color=#999999>Extra tip: you can grab-pan if you hold down your middle-mouse button (or scroll wheel as the case may be), which is super handy.</color>
column2: 欢迎来到《AI战争2》的第一个教程。本教程将介绍如何移动摄像头、选择和指挥单位。  我们目前正在查看我们的起始行星。让我们先四处看看，首先是移动摄像头。   首先，将鼠标光标移到屏幕边缘。这会使摄像头向该方向移动。不过对某些人来说，这个功能可能比较烦人，所以你可以关闭它。  让我们尝试一种更常规的方法：使用WASD键移动摄像头，这样我们就可以进入下一步。  <color=#999999>额外提示：你可以通过按住鼠标中键（或滚轮）来进行抓取式平移，这非常方便。</color>

column1: Welcome to the second tutorial of AI War 2. This one is about using the galaxy map, sending our view to different planets, and moving our units between them. column1: Welcome to the third tutorial of AI War 2. This one is about the basics of the Fleet system, which every unit of ours is in, as well as building those units, both ships and structures. column1: What Spire will inhabit this Sphere? Their overall personality, and even the sphere they reside in, changes based on your choice.  The Gray Spire are the most peaceful, and are the only type that are willing to fully ally themselves with you, so long as you stay away from their Sphere. They can wander up to 4 hops away from their Sphere planet. Their Sphere can be hacked for Warheads.  The Chromatic Spire are quite aggressive, and far outclass all but the Imperial Spire in strength. They will only give you a momentary warning before firing. They can wander up to 2 hops away from their Sphere planet. Their Sphere can be hacked for Interplanetary Weapons.
column2: 哪种尖塔将入驻这个星体？根据你的选择，它们的整体特性，甚至所处的星体都会发生变化。  灰色尖塔是最和平的，也是唯一愿意与你完全结盟的类型，只要你远离他们的星体。他们可以移动到距离星体最多 4 跳的位置。他们的星体可以被入侵以获取弹头。  多彩尖塔相当具有侵略性，其实力远超除帝国尖塔外的所有派系。它们只在开火前给你片刻警告。它们可以移动到距离星体最多 2 跳的位置。它们的星体可以被入侵以获取星际武器。

column1: When analyzing the Devourer Chrysalis Human scientists found out how the targeting of such a big entity works. Instead of having one central sensory array the Devourer has an incredible amount of smaller-scale sensors that link up and form a targeting network that can attack not just the entire size of a single planet, but is precise enough to measure enemies even through wormholes. By taking samples our own ships can emulate this technology.
column2: 在分析吞噬者蛹时，人类科学家发现了如此巨大的实体如何工作的 targeting 方式。吞噬者没有中央传感器阵列，而是拥有数量惊人的小型传感器，它们相互连接形成一个 targeting 网络，不仅可以攻击整个行星的范围，而且精确到足以通过虫洞测量敌人。通过取样，我们自己的单位可以模仿这种技术。
