The Svikari will begin transforming the planets they capture; once transformed the Svikari and its allies are more powerful there, and their enemies are weaker.
column2: 启用后，黑暗天顶斯维卡里将尝试引发芬布尔之冬，将星系中的所有行星改造得更适合他们及其盟友的需求。斯维卡里将开始改造他们占领的行星；一旦改造完成，斯维卡里及其盟友在这些行星上会更强大，而他们的敌人则会变弱。

column1: When enabled, Dark Zenith will attempt to bring about the Fimbulwinter, modifying all of the planets in the galaxy to be more suitable for their needs. The Dark Zenith will begin transforming the planets they capture; once transformed the DZ and its allies are more powerful there, and their enemies are weaker.
column2: 启用后，黑暗天顶将尝试引发芬布尔之冬，将星系中的所有行星改造得更适合他们的需求。黑暗天顶将开始改造他们占领的行星；一旦改造完成，黑暗天顶及其盟友在这些行星上会更强大，而他们的敌人则会变弱。

column1: When enabled, Dark Zenith will attempt to bring about the Fimbulwinter, modifying all of the planets in the galaxy to be more suitable for their needs. The Dark Zenith will begin transforming the planets they capture; once transformed the DZ and its allies are more powerful there, and their enemies are weaker.  DO NOT DISABLE.
column2: 启用后，暗天顶将尝试带来芬布尔之冬，改造银河中的所有行星以适应其需求。暗天顶将开始改造其占领的行星；一旦改造完成，DZ及其盟友在那里会更强大，而其敌人会更弱。  切勿禁用。

column1: When enabled, a 'Debug Details' button appears in the lobby, which you can click to have it pop up all the relevant information about the current setup from a very low-level debugging style.
column2: 启用后，大厅中会出现'调试详情'按钮，点击可弹出当前设置的所有相关信息，采用底层调试风格显示。

column1: When enabled, any ship lines in fleets will show what their underlying unique line numbers are.
column2: 启用后，舰队中的单位线会显示其底层唯一编号。

column1: When enabled, hovering over a ship that is blocked from rebuilding will tell you the reason.
column2: 启用后，悬停在无法重建的单位上会显示受阻原因。

column1: When enabled, hovering over a ship will make its tooltip show you info about its number of LODs, its poly count per LOD, at what distance it transfers between LODs, and what its current distance from the camera is.
column2: 启用后，悬停在单位上会显示其LOD(细节级别)数量、每个LOD的多边形数量、LOD切换距离以及当前与摄像机的距离。

column1: When enabled, hovering over a ship will tell you its location in in-game coordinates.
column2: 启用后，悬停在单位上会显示其在游戏中的坐标位置。

column1: When enabled, the planet hovertext will show the planets X,Y coordinates.
column2: 启用后，行星悬停文本将显示其X,Y坐标。

column1: When enabled, uses different logic for unit creation. Units will be of a much more diverse composition, rather than the normal end state of Eidolons everywhere.
column2: 启用后，使用不同的单位生成逻辑。单位组成将更加多样化，而不是通常的最终全是Eidolons。

column1: When examining the Chrysalis from a Mortar Devourer we gain further insight on long-range bombardment weapons. By sacrificing almost all mobility we are able to unleash more firepower against our enemies, specifically those shielded, and especially those with bubble forcefields, laying siege on enemy strongholds. In addition the adaptive hull technology allows us to direct extra energy to fortify the structure if shields go down.
column2: 检查迫击炮吞噬者的蛹时，我们进一步了解了远程轰炸武器。通过牺牲几乎所有的机动性，我们能够对敌人释放更多的火力，特别是那些有护盾的敌人，尤其是那些具有泡泡力场的敌人，从而围攻敌人的据点。此外，自适应船体技术允许我们在护盾下降时将额外能量引导至加固结构。

column1: When further energized Tachyons become less likely to pierce matter and instead reflect or get absorbed, making it possible to detect ships with exceptional albedo as well as allowing for FTL data and matter transmission technology.
column2: 当进一步充能后，超光速粒子穿透物质的可能性降低，取而代之的是反射或被吸收，这使得探测具有高反照率的单位成为可能，同时实现了超光速数据和物质传输技术。

column1: When generating a new map in the lobby, or loading a save game, or starting a quickstart, this will write details of when and where factions and other central mapdata is being added or removed into the main debug log.  The only real reason to turn this on is you're missing a bunch of factions or you're surprised by the order they are in or something like that.
column2: 在生成新地图、加载存档或快速开始时，将记录派系和其他核心地图数据的添加/移除详细信息到主调试日志。启用此选项的主要原因是您发现缺少某些派系或对派系顺序感到意外。

column1: When generating a new map in the lobby, write MapGen.txt in the PlayerData folder.  The only real reason to turn this on is if mapgen isn't really doing what you expect for some reason, or you just want some detailed insight into what is happening and in what order.
column2: 在大厅生成新地图时，将生成MapGen.txt文件到PlayerData文件夹。启用此选项的主要原因是地图生成未按预期工作，或者您想详细了解生成过程和顺序。

column1: When holding the key assigned to Controls > Overlays > Show Ship Orders (Players Only) also show ship orders for NPC ships.
column2: 按住'显示单位指令'快捷键时，同时显示NPC单位的指令。

column1: When in the Custom Game lobby, you can change your starting planet by clicking on another planet.
column2: 在自定义游戏大厅中，你可以通过点击另一个行星来更改起始行星。

column1: When loading a game, write WorldDeserializationDataSizes.txt in the PlayerData folder.  When a savegame is really large, turning this on lets us figure out what is taking up so much space so that we can potentially make some optimizations.
column2: 加载游戏时在PlayerData文件夹中写入WorldDeserializationDataSizes.txt。当存档文件过大时，启用此选项可帮助我们找出占用空间的内容，以便进行优化。

column1: When loading a game, write information about all the fireteams you're loading to disk.  When a savegame has a ton of fireteams and you don't know why, or who owns them or what they are doing, this helps debug.
column2: 加载游戏时将关于所有战斗小组的信息写入磁盘。当存档中有大量战斗小组且您不知道原因、所有者或它们的行为时，此功能有助于调试。

column1: When looking at centerpieces the ship lines are usually displayed based on strength, when it may be more important to sort by other properties. This defines in which order these apply, if all are equal the list continues: Mark Level > Current Unit Count > Max Unit Count > Transporting Count.
column2: 查看核心单位时，单位线通常基于强度显示，但按其他属性排序可能更重要。这定义了这些属性的应用顺序，如果全部相等则继续：标记等级 > 当前单位数量 > 最大单位数量 > 运输中数量。

column1: When looking at centerpieces with duplicate ship lines (i.e. having the same ship type twice or more in the same fleet) it saves a lot of space to combine these into a single item with a larger count (in tooltips) but you can disable this if you want to seem them individually.
column2: 查看具有重复单位线的核心单位(即同一舰队中有两次或更多相同单位类型)时，将它们合并为一个带有更大计数的项目可以节省大量空间(在工具提示中)，但如果您希望单独查看它们，可以禁用此选项。

column1: When placing clusters how near must they be to one another? This does not guarantee they won't be closer or overlapping but does enforce a maximum distance they can be freefloating alone.
column2: 放置簇时，它们必须彼此多近？这不能保证它们不会更近或重叠，但确实强制了它们可以单独自由漂浮的最大距离。

column1: When players own multiple planets next to each other each planet can harvest additional Hacking Points. This defines how many, if any. The max is 50.
column2: 当玩家拥有彼此相邻的多个行星时，每个行星可以收获额外的入侵点数。这定义了有多少（如果有的话）。最大值为50。

column1: When players own multiple planets next to each other each planet can harvest additional Science Points. This defines how many, if any. The max is 5 thousand.
column2: 当玩家拥有彼此相邻的多个行星时，每个行星可以收获额外的科学点数。这定义了有多少（如果有的话）。最大值为5,000。

column1: When saving a game, write WorldSerialization.txt, and when loading it write WorldDeserialization.txt -- both in the PlayerData folder.  The only real reason to turn this on is if a savegame won't load for some reason; this lets us do a diff of the two files and figure out where they are diverging.  Note that this won't help with an existing broken savegame.  This will only help if you have it turned on prior to creating a savegame you expect to be broken.  This is basically a way for us to test the savegame creation and load process, which otherwise can be incredibly opaque and take a lot of time to hunt down.
column2: 保存游戏时写入WorldSerialization.txt，加载时写入WorldDeserialization.txt到PlayerData文件夹。主要用途是当存档无法加载时，通过比较这两个文件找出差异点。  注意：这对已损坏的存档无效。必须在创建可能损坏的存档前启用此选项。这主要用于测试存档创建和加载过程，否则这个过程可能非常不透明且难以排查。

column1: When sending a game world across the network to a client, write NetworkWorldSerialization.txt, and when getting one from a host write NetworkWorldDeserialization.txt -- both in the PlayerData folder (but on two different computers).  The only real reason to turn this on is if a client is unable to join a host and gets an exception; this lets us do a diff of the two files and figure out what is different about what the host is trying to send and the client is trying to read.  Note these logs are often huge, sometimes hundreds of MB each.  Compressing them into a zip or tarball and then uploading them somewhere we can download them to find out what is happening is a good idea.  Hopefully as a player you will never need this, but this is basically a way for us to test the network world sync process, which otherwise can be incredibly opaque and take a lot of time to hunt down.
column2: 当向客户端发送游戏世界时，写入NetworkWorldSerialization.txt；当从主机接收时，写入NetworkWorldDeserialization.txt到PlayerData文件夹(位于两台不同电脑上)。主要用途是当客户端无法加入主机并出现异常时，通过比较这两个文件找出主机发送和客户端接收内容之间的差异。

column1: When sending orders to move ships between planets, hold this button to make sure your ships take the safest path through the galaxy.
column2: 在下达命令让单位在行星之间移动时，按住此按钮可确保您的单位选择星系中最安全的路径。

column1: When sending orders to move ships between planets, hold this button to make sure your ships take the shortest path.
column2: 在下达命令让单位在行星之间移动时，按住此按钮可确保您的单位选择星系中最短的路径。

column1: When the App window is not focused, it still runs at full speed normally. Also many of the repeated tasks done are the same while paused or not (and are necessary to update the ui). However, assuming you aren't in a multiplayer game, you can adjust that behavior here. Throttled will stop running many of the tasks, if the App is both paused and unfocused. Suspend will stop updating the entire App (including music).
column2: 当游戏窗口失去焦点时，通常仍会全速运行。许多重复任务无论是否暂停都会执行(这些任务对UI更新是必要的)。如果您不在多人游戏中，可以在此调整此行为：               - Throttled(节流)：如果游戏同时处于暂停和非焦点状态，会停止执行许多任务 - Suspend(暂停)：完全停止更新整个游戏(包括音乐)

column1: When the Chromatic Horror faction is enabled, it can move any structures it sees around the gravity well of a planet. This can cause a lot of chaos, and be very frustrating to players who want a lot of control over their turret positioning.  Disabling this will remove the major downside of the Chromatic Horror, so it will make the game much easier.
column2: 当启用变色恐怖阵营时，它可以在行星引力井周围移动它看到的任何结构。这可能会造成很多混乱，并且对希望对炮塔位置有很多控制的玩家来说非常令人沮丧。  禁用此选项将消除变色恐怖的主要缺点，因此会使游戏变得更容易。

column1: When the Human Civil War waged many factions used strike forces protected by powerful bubble forcefield carriers to extend the lifespan of small strike craft or light frigates. As a result 'Pyotic' technology, forcefield-piercing weaponry was developed and combined with translocators to knock back fragile ships under bigger guard craft.
column2: 人类内战中，许多派系使用由强大泡泡力场运载舰保护的突击部队来延长小型攻击艇或轻型护卫舰的寿命。因此开发了"派奥提克"技术——一种力场穿透武器，并与位移器结合使用，将更大型护卫舰下的脆弱单位击退。

column1: When the Necromancer is added to the game, it automatically adds an AI-allied Elderling faction. The Necromancer has access to critical resources by fighting the Elderlings, so setting this to a really low Intensity is not recommended.  This faction is identical to a 'normal' AI-Allied Elderlings faction.
column2: 当死灵法师加入游戏时，会自动添加一个与AI结盟的奈因祖尔长老派系。死灵法师可以通过与奈因祖尔长老战斗获取关键资源，因此不建议将此派系的强度设置得过低。  此派系与“正常”的与AI结盟的奈因祖尔长老派系相同。

column1: When the Necromancer would get resources, they instead get the base value multiplied by this setting. So if set to 3, you will get 3x the hacking, science and essence you would normally.  This is only for sandbox play, and will make the game much easier.
column2: 当亡灵巫师获得资源时，他们将获得基础值乘以该设置的值。因此，如果设置为3，你将获得正常情况下3倍的黑客点数、科研点数和精华。  这仅适用于沙盒模式，会使游戏变得容易很多。

column1: When the game is starting, add some random factions on top of the already-chosen factions. You won't know what they are from the game lobby; when combined with the 'Don't Show Unencountered Random Factions setting, this means you will have no idea what's out there.  The goal of this option is unpredictability; you might wind up with some very hard factions even if you select Easy, it's just much less likely.  This can be a very intense mode. The game does not guarantee that the resulting scenario will be winnable.
column2: 游戏开始时，在已选派系的基础上添加一些随机派系。从游戏大厅你不会知道它们是什么；当与'不显示未遇到的随机派系'设置结合时，这意味着你根本不知道外面有什么。  此选项的目标是不可预测性；即使你选择Easy，你也可能遇到一些非常困难的派系，只是可能性要小得多。  这可能是一种非常激烈的模式。游戏不保证由此产生的情景可以获胜。

column1: When the program is loaded, or after the xml files are reloaded into the in-memory data tables, write EntityTagDataDumps.txt in the PlayerData folder.    The purpose of this is to figure out what might be wrong if you are getting unexpected results as you mod things with tags.
column2: 游戏加载时或XML文件重载后，将实体标签数据导出到PlayerData/EntityTagDataDumps.txt文件。主要用于调试通过标签修改实体时出现的意外结果。

column1: When the program is loaded, write a text file for each one into a DataTableExports subfolder in the PlayerData folder.    The purpose of this is mainly to use with diffing tools between one run of the game and another, to see what sort of data changes happened.  If you are modding and made changes to some ships and want to see how those changes cascaded, this would be one way to do that.  This is also a way for us to verify correctness when we make structural changes internally.  This can also be a handy way just to look at what the data is, especially in ArcenRandomDrawBags that are filled from multiple sources, like fleet makeups, etc
column2: 游戏加载时，将每个数据表导出为文本文件到PlayerData/DataTableExports文件夹。主要用途：1)通过对比工具查看不同游戏运行间的数据变化；2)当修改单位等mod时，追踪修改的连锁影响；3)验证内部结构调整的正确性；4)查看随机数据池(如舰队组成等)的具体内容。

column1: When there are multiple ZAs in a galaxy, they sometimes have Civil Wars which can force players to run for cover.
column2: 当星系中有多个拱壁派势力时，他们有时会爆发内战，这可能会迫使玩家寻找掩护。

column1: When this crystal flowers a Sapper can come and harvest resources from it.  You can also choose to destroy this structure for metal. Doing this will prevent the Sappers from using it.
column2: 当这个水晶开花时，工兵可以前来从中采集资源。  你也可以选择摧毁这个建筑以获取金属。这样做将阻止工兵使用它。

column1: When this crystal flowers a Sapper can come and harvest resources from it.  You can also choose to destroy this structure for metal; it is worth more metal to kill it after flowering though. Doing this will prevent the Sappers from using it.
column2: 当这个水晶开花时，工兵可以前来从中采集资源。  你也可以选择摧毁这个建筑以获取金属；不过在它开花后摧毁能获得更多金属。这样做将阻止工兵使用它。

column1: When this is enabled, new Spire Cities and their flagships will be named after their planets, instead of having thematic names
column2: 启用此选项后，新的尖塔城市及其旗舰将以其所在行星命名，而不是使用主题化名称

column1: When this is enabled, new Starbases and their flagships will be named after their planets, instead of having thematic names
column2: 启用此选项后，新的星站及其旗舰将以它们所在的行星命名，而不是使用主题名称

column1: When this is enabled, new necropolises and their flagships will be named after their planets, instead of having thematic names
column2: 启用此选项后，新的亡者都市及其旗舰将以所在行星命名，而非采用主题性名称。

column1: When this is enabled, new strongholds and their flagships will be named after their planets, instead of having thematic names
column2: 启用此选项后，新的要塞及其旗舰将以它们所在的行星命名，而不是使用主题名称

column1: When this is enabled, the AI overlord final battle will be much more challenging, with additional Exogalactic Strikeforces and Wormhole Invasions.
column2: 启用此选项后，AI霸主的最终战斗将变得更具挑战性，会有额外的星系外打击部队和虫洞入侵。

column1: When this is on, any 'gimbal icon' material creation events will be logged as to what was created and how long it took to do so.
column2: 启用后，将记录所有'万向节图标'材质的创建事件，包括创建内容和耗时。

column1: When this is on, any area of effect weapons fire will log its details so that it can be examined and/or debugged.
column2: 启用后，将记录范围效果武器的详细计算过程，便于检查调试。

column1: When this is on, any multi-target line beam weapons fire will log its details so that it can be examined and/or debugged.
column2: 启用后，将记录多目标线束武器射击的详细计算过程，便于检查调试。

column1: When this is on, any targets of metal flows (left click the metal indicator in your HUD) will include the IDs so that you can tell when there are referrals to the same unit versus different ones.
column2: 启用后，金属流动目标(点击HUD中的金属指示器)将包含ID，便于区分相同单位和不同单位。

column1: When this is on, during startup it will log to the debug log any information about AddedToFleet_MinorFactionStrikecraft and AddedToFleet_MinorFactionFrigate.  If you are getting an error with some custom faction structure that lets you hack it like an ARS, this will let you see what is wrong with your xml.
column2: 启用后，启动时将记录自定义派系(AddedToFleet_MinorFactionStrikecraft和AddedToFactionFrigate)的舰队配置信息，便于调试XML错误。

column1: When this unit finishes arriving in the galaxy, you should be very afraid.
column2: 当这个单位抵达星系后，你可得小心了。

column1: When viewing any quickstart or saved game in the UI, if it has no .savemet create one from the source .save file.
column2: 在UI中查看任何快速开始或保存的游戏时，如果没有.savemet文件，则从源.save文件创建一个。

column1: When viewing any quickstart or saved game in the UI, resave its .savemet from the source .save file.
column2: 在UI中查看任何快速开始或保存的游戏时，从源.save文件重新保存其.savemet文件。

column1: When will the Dark Zenith invade the galaxy? With a full invasion the DZ will link new planets into the galaxy map.  Nota Bene: Immediate invasion is incredibly hard.
column2: 黑暗天顶何时会入侵星系？在全面入侵时，黑暗天顶会将新的行星连接到星系地图中。  注意：立即入侵会极其困难。

column1: When you are holding down the buttons that let you tilt and rotate the camera, the movements of your mouse will do those actions based on the sensitivity defined here.
column2: 调整相机旋转和倾斜操作的灵敏度。数值越高，鼠标移动对相机角度的影响越大。默认值0.001提供了平滑的控制体验，您可以根据个人偏好调整此值。

column1: When you are moving your mouse around the main view, how long should it wait before it shows a tooltip for the planet or unit or wormhole you are hovering over?  Default is no delay.
column2: 在主视图中移动鼠标时，悬停在行星、单位或虫洞上显示工具提示前应等待多长时间？默认为无延迟。

column1: When you are on a planet where you have never even explored it at all, it shows a really severe wave distortion pattern like an old TV.  Defaults to off.  This would have been unlikely to actually ever be triggered these days, as you cannot click through into unexplored planets.
column2: 当您查看从未探索过的行星时，显示类似老式电视的严重波纹失真效果。默认关闭。如今不太可能触发此效果，因为您无法点击进入未探索的行星。

column1: When you are on a planet where your intel is out of date, show a full-screen fuzz effect.  Defaults to on.  Beware that it may be hard to tell if you're looking at outdated intel without this effect on.  However, it does say 'Old Intel' at the top of the planet tab of the sidebar, so there is that other cue.
column2: 当您查看情报过时的行星时，显示全屏模糊效果。默认开启。请注意，如果没有此效果，可能难以辨别您查看的是过时情报。不过侧边栏行星标签顶部会显示'旧情报'作为提示。

column1: When you enable this, planets that aren't near any explored planets are hidden. You will discover the layout of the map as you explore.  With this enabled, the galaxy map will appear empty in the Game Lobby.

column1: Will majorly slow the game down, but dumps decoded sync messages to the disk in files inside the PlayerData/NetworkSyncMessages folder.  This only covers sync-style data, but with this logging enabled on both the client and host, this is a great way to see why serialization is failing, if it is.               Enable with care!  Since this data is being actively decoded as it is written, it is far larger (and in plain text) than the actual data being sent across the network.  A typical ratio might be 40MB of decoded data for 500kb of actual network traffic.  You can have a few GB of data on your disk after just a few minutes of letting the game run in this fashion.  Warning: do not use with 'Log All Decoded Network Data To Disk' also turned on, or you'll get errors.
column2: 会显著降低游戏速度，但会将解码的同步消息转储到PlayerData/NetworkSyncMessages文件夹中的文件中。这仅涵盖同步风格的数据，但在客户端和主机上都启用此日志记录，是查看序列化失败原因的好方法。  请谨慎启用！由于这些数据在被写入时会被主动解码，它们比实际通过网络发送的数据要大得多(而且是纯文本)。典型比例可能是40MB解码数据对应500kb实际网络流量。游戏运行几分钟后，您的磁盘上可能会有几GB的数据。  警告：不要同时启用'记录所有解码的网络数据到磁盘'，否则会出现错误。

column1: Will massively slow the game down, but dumps ALL messages as they are encored or decoded to the disk in files inside the PlayerData/NetworkSentDecodedData and PlayerData/NetworkReceivedDecodedData folders.  This covers absolutely all data, and includes message headers that other forms of decoded-data logging do not.  With this logging enabled on both the client and host, you can compare the output and see what serialization problems are happening, if there are any.             This is a last resort sort of debug option!  Since ALL data is being actively decoded as it is written, it is far larger (and in plain text) than the actual data being sent across the network.  A typical ratio might be 40MB of decoded data for 500kb of actual network traffic.  You can have a few GB of data on your disk after just part of a minute of letting the game run in this fashion.  Warning: do not use with 'Log All Decoded Network Sync Data To Disk' or any of its sub-options also turned on, or you'll get errors.
column2: 会极大降低游戏速度，但会将所有消息在编码或解码时转储到PlayerData/NetworkSentDecodedData和PlayerData/NetworkReceivedDecodedData文件夹中的文件中。这涵盖所有数据，包括其他形式的解码数据日志记录不包含的消息头。在客户端和主机上都启用此日志记录，可以比较输出并查看是否存在序列化问题。  这是最后的调试手段！由于所有数据在被写入时都会被主动解码，它们比实际通过网络发送的数据要大得多(而且是纯文本)。典型比例可能是40MB解码数据对应500kb实际网络流量。游戏运行不到一分钟，您的磁盘上可能会有几GB的数据。  警告：不要同时启用'记录所有解码的网络同步数据到磁盘'或其任何子选项，否则会出现错误。

column1: With multiple players the amount of Hacking Points gathered from planets may decline based on how many players there are. The Full Amount is set by the settings above. The scaling options are:  Soft Decline  -->  1 Player: Full Amount | 2 Players: 2/3 Per Player | 3+ Players: 1/2 Per Player. Players receive Hacking Points from all planets, no matter which player owns them, but not the full amount. Combined they receive more than a single player would.  Linear Decline  -->  1 Player: Full Amount, 2 Players: 1/2 Per Player, 3 Players: 1/3 Per Player, 4 Players: 1/4 Per Player. Players receive Hacking Points from all planets, no matter which player owns them, but not the full amount. The amount a single player would is split evenly between all players.  No Decline  -->  1+ Players: Full Amount Players receive Hacking Points from all planets, no matter which player owns them, and every player gets the full amount.  Individual Harvest  -->  1+ Players: Full Amount Players receive the full amount of Hacking Points but only harvest on planets they own. If a minor faction or another non-player source incurs AIP, and AIP generates Hacking Points, as a fallback the 'No Decline' logic is used.
column2: 在多个玩家的情况下，从行星收集的入侵点数量可能会根据玩家人数而减少。全量由上述设置确定。缩放选项是：  软衰减 --> 1名玩家：全量 | 2名玩家：每人2/3 | 3+名玩家：每人1/2。 玩家从所有行星接收入侵点数，无论哪个玩家拥有它们，但不是全量。合起来他们收到的比单个玩家要多。  线性衰减 --> 1名玩家：全量，2名玩家：每人1/2，3名玩家：每人1/3，4名玩家：每人1/4。 玩家从所有行星接收入侵点数，无论哪个玩家拥有它们，但不是全量。单个玩家会获得的数量在所有玩家之间平均分配。  无衰减 --> 1+名玩家：全量 玩家从所有行星接收入侵点数，无论哪个玩家拥有它们，每个玩家都获得全量。  个人收获 --> 1+名玩家：全量 玩家接收全量的入侵点数，但只在他们拥有的行星上收获。如果小派系或其他非玩家来源产生AIP，并且AIP生成入侵点数，作为后备，使用'无衰减'逻辑。

column1: With the ability to shift itself enemies into Multi-Phase this cruiser would already be a game changer, but scientists have managed to find a way of absorbing the dimensional energy surrounding the ship in Multi-Phase. As a result it is able to power the Matter Annihilator, a weapon with terrifying power and magnitude. It can only sustain itself in another dimension briefly, but that is enough to exterminate a small fleet each time.
column2: 凭借将自己和敌人转换到多重相位的能力，这艘巡洋舰已经是一个改变游戏规则的存在，但科学家们设法找到了一种吸收多重相位中单位周围维度能量的方法。因此，它能够为物质湮灭器提供动力，这是一种具有可怕力量和规模的武器。它只能在另一个维度中短暂维持，但这足以每次消灭一支小型舰队。

column1: With the power to radiate any moving target on the planet these frigates can erase entire enemy fleets given enough time. As a result the enemy puts special attack priority on them and the frigate was equipped with translocator waves to counter approaching bombers, but it still needs help against snipers. In addition it can amplify all damage of a medium-sized fleet, making it a terrifying foe indeed.

column1: Wow, you're a brave soul aren't you!  Deathwish is the most restrictive and punishing mode that AI War 2 offers. If you've made your way here, you probably know what you're in for already to a large extent.  If you have any questions about the various modes, please visit the Arcen Games discord where there is a dedicated expert_challenger_deathwish channel and feel free to ping Strategic Sage with your inquiries.  As always, the Mantis website awaits your feedback and/or bug reports as well.  Both are readily accessible from the main menu.  Deathwish has been amusingly called 'Full Sage' mode.  Fairness to the player is pretty much thrown out the window in some respects, with sadistic laughter following it on it's way.  It includes everything that comes with Logistician:  fuel, distributed economy, limited battlestations, etc.  You will also be greeted with the following additional insults by the AI, to which more may be added in the future:  Extreme AI Response.  Multipliers for Dire CPAs, Hacking exostrike responses, AI structures resistance to damage, etc. have been dialed up even further.  Dangerous Waves.  Wave warnings are completely off.  Believe me they're still coming, you just won't know about it until they show up.  Devastating Crippling.  Crippled flagships cost twice the metal to repair and also incur a notable HaP penalty.  Further Cheese Limitations.  Reverse beachheading - tractoring enemies through wormholes - is no longer possible for the player.  Beachheading on planets with Dire Guard Posts is also strictly forbidden.
column2: 哇，你可真勇敢！死亡愿望模式是《AI 战争 2》中限制最多、惩罚最严厉的模式。如果你来到了这里，大概率已经对等待你的挑战有了一定了解。如果你对各种模式有任何疑问，请访问阿尔森游戏的 Discord 频道，那里有一个专门的 expert_challenger_deathwish 频道，你可以随时向战略贤者提问。一如既往，螳螂网站也欢迎你的反馈和 bug 报告。这两个渠道都可以从主菜单轻松访问。  死亡愿望模式被戏称为“完全贤者”模式。在某些方面，对玩家的公平性几乎被抛诸脑后，取而代之的是恶意的嘲笑。它包含了后勤专家模式的所有内容：燃料管理、分布式经济、限制战列舰使用等。此外，AI 还会给你带来以下额外的“刁难”，未来可能还会增加更多：  极端 AI 反应。致命跨行星攻击、入侵外击反击、AI 结构的抗损能力等方面的乘数加成进一步提高。  危险波次。波次预警完全关闭。相信我，波次还是会来的，只是你要等到它们出现才会知道。  毁灭性受损。受损的旗舰修复成本翻倍，还会导致显著的入侵点数惩罚。  进一步限制“投机取巧”策略。反向滩头推进——通过虫洞牵引敌人——对玩家来说已不再可行。在有致命岗哨的行星上进行滩头推进也被严格禁止。

column1: Yes! It is advised to play with a relatively minimal number of other factions active, or even just against the AI(s) by themselves. It is also suggested to play on a 'semi-open' map type with a relative minimum of chokepoints.  The wide variety and dynamic potential of the available maps and factions in AI War 2 is one of the game's greatest strengths, but it also poses a tremendous obstacle when it comes to balancing this type of challenge. Fuel works by giving the AI additional targets in the player territory to attack, targets the player has to care about and defend. Chokepoint-heavy maps largely trivialize this by limiting access to a player's empire.  The other factions interact in dynamic and unpredictable ways, leading to chaotic maps that can be a great deal of fun to play. However, it is simply not possible to design a mechanic that can account for all of these possibilities and present an appropriate level of challenge, much less do so in an interesting way. Every reasonable effort has been made to accommodate specific factions; for example, an extra Argon station is seeded in Dark Zenith territory. But for players who enjoy using large numbers of factions, it is advised to have fuel off for those styles of play since it will not have the desired effect.  Fuel is also not recommend for campaigns involving the Fallen Spire (or Spire-Infused Empire) or Necromancer, or for multiplayer games.  -Strategic Sage
column2: 是的！建议在游戏中只激活较少数量的其他势力，甚至可以只与AI对抗。同时也建议在'半开放'类型的地图上进行游戏，这种地图的关键点相对较少。  《AI战争2》中丰富多样的地图和势力选择是游戏最大的优势之一，但在平衡这类挑战时也带来了巨大的障碍。燃料系统的工作原理是在玩家领地中为AI提供额外的攻击目标，这些目标需要玩家关注和防御。而关键点过多的地图会通过限制进入玩家帝国的通道，从而大大降低了这一机制的难度。  其他势力之间的互动方式是动态且不可预测的，这会导致混乱但非常有趣的地图。然而，要设计一个能够考虑所有这些可能性并提供适当挑战水平的机制是不可能的，更不用说要以有趣的方式来实现了。我们已经尽了最大努力来适应特定势力；例如，在黑暗天顶势力的领地中会额外生成一个氩气站。但对于喜欢使用大量势力的玩家，建议在这些游戏风格中关闭燃料系统，因为它不会产生预期的效果。  此外，不建议在涉及堕落尖塔（或尖塔注入帝国）或死灵法师的战役中使用燃料系统，多人游戏也不建议使用。  -Strategic Sage

column1: You can scout new worlds by hacking them.  Hacking is one of the tabs on the left sidebar of the UI.          However, a better way to scout is simply to capture new planets. There are no 'scout' units, and you can't send any of your ships to planets that you have not scouted by one of the methods above.  However, there are spy units, which logistical and military command stations can build.  You can send these to remote locations as essentially a hidden camera watching what your enemies are up to.

column1: You may observe in the game that the links between different wormholes can be different colours, and this is based on whoever controls the planets at either end of the link. If both ends of the link are owned by friendly factions then the link is Blue.  If the ends are owned by factions hostile to each other the link is Red.

column2: 你的行星需要炮塔！你的机动舰队需要外出作战，而炮塔单独就能对抗大约10倍于其数量的机动部队。也就是说，你也可以在敌方领土建立炮塔桥头堡给他们制造麻烦，所以考虑时不时地把机动平台带到敌人那里去。

column1: You want to destroy the AI.  You do this by destroying the AI Overlord unit -- if there are multiple AIs, then they each have one of these.          You win the game as soon as all of those are destroyed, so in a very real sense nothing else matters.  The problem is, you're weak and they are very strong.  They also control the entire galaxy, and you have very little.  So the ENTIRE flow of the game is essentially that you need to find a way to make yourself strong enough, but without making the AIs so strong that they crush you along the way.  That means, primarily, that you need to gather science, offensive fleets, and defensive turrets, as well as capture at least a few planets to use for your economy.  There's a bunch of other stuff you can also do to make yourself stronger, but we're just talking absolute basics.
column2: 你要摧毁 AI。你可以通过摧毁 AI 霸主单位来实现这一目标——如果有多个 AI，那么每个 AI 都有一个这样的单位。          一旦所有这些单位都被摧毁，你就赢得了游戏，所以从非常现实的意义上说，其他一切都无关紧要。  问题是，你很弱小，而它们非常强大。它们还控制着整个星系，而你拥有的很少。  所以游戏的整个流程本质上就是你需要找到一种方法让自己变得足够强大，但又不能让 AI 变得过于强大，以至于在这个过程中把你碾碎。  这主要意味着你需要收集科研点数、组建进攻舰队和建造防御炮塔，同时至少占领几个行星来发展经济。  你还可以做很多其他事情来让自己变得更强，但我们这里只谈最基本的。

column1: Your eminence, the forces of the {FactionColor}One True Zenith</color> welcome your arrival. Your leadership of our military is the final thing necessary to allow us to subdue this galaxy to our rule.  The economic and logistical aspects of our forces will automatically provide reinforcements to you; they are managed by low-caste servants. It would be dishonorable for someone of your military prowess to sully their appendages with such things directly. The Fleets menu's DZ Economy panel lets you direct what every Epistyle in our empire builds at a glance; the Hacking Menu can do the same for a single Epistyle, if that is more convenient. You can also give Transports orders (perhaps to send them away from a battle), but they will return to using their own logic once they finish your orders.  Clicking on the Hacking region of the resource bar will show you an economic overview.  Remember, our forces scale dramatically based on our economy. You will need to control a large number of planets to build enough Epistyles and Terminii; that is where our power comes from. Disruptions to our economy can be devastating.  If you grow weary or distracted during the battle, you can use a Galaxy Setting to have our forces fight on without your direct control. Covering captured planets with the Fimbulwinter grants us more science, which will be a critical way of strengthening our forces.  Note that we can't build Epistyles (which produce new ships and structures) on hostile planets, so we will need to destroy many command stations.  The AI are attempting to counter our strength with their Nadir forces. Crushing them will provide us even more resources.  We should make sure to apply the Fimbulwinter to the uncivilized planets in this galaxy to provide us with more Science.
column2: 陛下，{FactionColor}唯一真正的泽尼斯</color>的部队欢迎您的到来。您对我们军队的领导是让我们征服这个银河系的最后必要条件。  我们部队的经济和后勤方面将自动向您提供增援；它们由低种姓仆人管理。对于像您这样军事才能的人来说，直接用附肢处理这些事情将是不光彩的。您还可以使用黑客菜单来控制柱廊建造什么。您也可以给运输船命令（也许是为了让它们远离战斗），但一旦它们完成您的命令，它们将恢复使用自己的逻辑。  点击资源栏的黑客区域将显示经济概述。  请记住，我们的部队根据我们的经济大幅扩展。您需要控制大量行星来建造足够的柱廊和终端；那是我们力量的来源。对我们经济的破坏可能是毁灭性的。  如果您在战斗中感到疲倦或分心，您可以使用银河系设置让我们的部队在没有您直接控制的情况下继续作战。用芬布尔之冬覆盖被捕获的行星可以给我们更多的科学，这将是加强我们部队的关键方式。  请注意，我们无法在敌对行星上建造柱廊（生产新舰船和建筑），因此我们需要摧毁许多指挥站。  人工智能正试图用他们的深渊部队来对抗我们的力量。粉碎他们将为我们提供更多资源。  我们应该确保将芬布尔之冬应用于这个银河系中未开化的行星，为我们提供更多科学。

column1: Your offensive fleet leaders (transports, Arks, Golems, etc.) and defensive battlestations/citadels can't die.          However, at 1 remaining health they become 'crippled' and need to be repaired back to full before they can again perform most of their functions.
